a.description: Arctus Aerospace is a Bengaluru, India based deep-tech startup building high-altitude, long-endurance autonomous unmanned aircraft (MALE/HALE UAVs) for real-time Earth observation and geospatial intelligence. Its platforms are designed to operate near 45,000 feet for over 24 hours while carrying payloads up to 250 kg, delivering centimeter-level multispectral imagery as a "zero-infrastructure" alternative to satellites. The company positions itself as a data-as-a-service provider, selling subscription-based aerial coverage for energy, infrastructure, climate, defense, and agriculture use cases. Founded in 2024 by Shreepoorna S. Rao, Arctus raised a $2.6M pre-seed round led by Version One Ventures (with South Park Commons, gradCapital, and angels). As of this writing the company is pre-product from an API standpoint and publishes no public developer surface, API, or documentation; this profile was surfaced as a Version One Ventures portfolio lead.
a.name: Arctus Aerospace

a.description: Arcus Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing differentiated cancer immunotherapies, headquartered in Hayward, California. Its pipeline pairs multiple novel molecules across intra-tumoral immune pathways, including the HIF-2a inhibitor casdatifan, the CD73 inhibitor quemliclustat, the anti-TIGIT antibody domvanalimab, the anti-PD-1 antibody zimberelimab, and the CD39 inhibitor AB598. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences company profile. Arcus publishes an agent-facing surface (llms.txt, an AI content map, and an Organization schema) but no public developer API.
a.name: Arcus Biosciences

a.description: Arda Therapeutics is a San Carlos, California biotech company founded in 2021 that develops targeted cell depletion therapies for chronic disease. Rather than modulating the proteins that pathogenic cells produce, Arda uses a single-cell sequencing and computational discovery engine to map disease-specific cell states, identify surface markers on harmful cells, and design targeted biologics that selectively deplete them across fibrotic, autoimmune, and metabolic conditions. Backed by a $43M Series A led by a16z Bio + Health with GV, Two Sigma Ventures, Eli Lilly and others. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and web surface; Arda currently publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer API.
a.name: Arda Therapeutics

a.description: Arden (Arden AI, Inc.) is an AI-native platform for internal audit and SOX compliance teams, backed by Y Combinator and based in San Francisco. Arden builds AI agents that automatically pull evidence from a company's stack, run end-to-end SOX ITGC and business-process control (BPC) testing, follow up with control owners, and produce reviewer-ready workpapers that external auditors will accept - work that historically ran on spreadsheets and screenshots over weeks. The platform advertises read-only access by default with approval gates before any system writes, integrations across 20+ enterprise systems (Workday, Okta, NetSuite, and others), full-population or sample-based control testing with exception flagging, and full traceability from each conclusion back to the source evidence. Arden targets regulated, compliance-critical institutions performing automated SOX 404(a) testing. Arden does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and will be enriched further as a public API surface emerges.
a.name: Arden

a.description: Ardent is a database branching platform for Postgres that lets developers and AI coding agents clone any production or development database in seconds into fully isolated, disposable branches. Each branch is isolated at both the compute and storage layers using copy-on-write, autoscales to zero when idle, and never touches production, so agents and CI/CD pipelines can run migrations, backfills, destructive tests, and risky experiments against production-like data with zero blast radius. Ardent exposes a REST API (api.tryardent.com), a first-party npm CLI (ardent-cli), and connectors for Supabase, AWS RDS, PlanetScale, and self-hosted Postgres 13+.
a.name: Ardent

a.description: Ardent Privacy is a data privacy and protection company that helps businesses strengthen data privacy, adopt a data‑centric approach, and secure critical data where it resides. By providing tools and services for data‑centric security, Ardent Privacy enables organizations to protect personal information, comply with regulations, and build trust with customers.
a.name: Ardent Privacy

a.description: Arduino is an open-source electronics platform providing hardware, software, and cloud services for IoT development. The Arduino IoT Cloud REST API enables developers to programmatically manage devices, Things, dashboards, properties, and time-series data in the Arduino Cloud ecosystem. The API uses OAuth2 client credentials for authentication and returns JSON-encoded responses with standard HTTP status codes. SDKs are available in JavaScript, Python, and Go, generated automatically from an OpenAPI specification.
a.name: Arduino

a.description: Area 1 Security was a cloud-native email security company that built preemptive anti-phishing and business-email-compromise (BEC) protection, discovering and blocking phishing campaigns before they reached inboxes. It could be deployed inline (MX/journaling) or via API connectors to Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Cloudflare acquired Area 1 Security in February 2022 for approximately $162 million and folded the technology into its Zero Trust / Cloudflare One platform, where it is now sold as Cloudflare Email Security. The independent area1security.com developer surface has been retired and now redirects to Cloudflare; the product API and documentation live under the Cloudflare developer platform.
a.name: Area 1 Security

a.description: Aren provides AI‑powered recruiting guidance for high‑school athletes and their families. The platform offers tools such as ScoutLens video analysis, AI‑driven camp search, and personalized consulting to help navigate college recruiting, transfer portals, and NIL considerations. It aims to reduce uncertainty and cost for families by delivering data‑driven recommendations and educational resources.
a.name: Aren

a.description: Arena is an AI-powered audience engagement platform that lets publishers, media companies, and brands build first-party communities directly on their own websites and apps. Its products include Live Chat, Live Blog, Comments, Polls, and Q&A, plus moderation, analytics, and monetization tooling designed to increase traffic, boost engagement, generate leads, and monetize audiences. Developers integrate through the Arena Platform API (V3) and official JavaScript, Android, and iOS SDKs, authenticating with a site API key or a JWT that also powers Single Sign-On for Live Chat and Live Blog. Arena is a developer-tools / audience-engagement company backed by CRV, Felicis, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Techstars.
a.name: Arena

a.description: Arena AI (now operating as Arena Physica) is a New York-headquartered applied-research company building what it calls "electromagnetic superintelligence." Its flagship product, Atlas, is an AI-powered hardware-engineering platform that pairs general intelligence with deterministic physics models to accelerate the design, verification, and debugging of electronic and RF hardware. Atlas ingests telemetry, schematics, CAD files, and firmware, then connects via API or MCP (Model Context Protocol) to engineering toolchains such as Jira, GitHub, Altium, Cadence, and SPICE simulators, and to test equipment from vendors like Keysight and Tektronix. Atlas RF Studio, the company's RF design tool, is currently in beta. The company operates from New York City (HQ), San Francisco, and Los Angeles.
a.name: Arena AI

a.description: Arena Club is a technology-first trading-card and collectibles platform founded in 2022 by entrepreneur Brian Lee and baseball Hall-of-Famer Derek Jeter, operating as Arenaclub.com, Inc. The company combines AI- and computer-vision-assisted card grading, an insured physical vault with 24/7 surveillance and climate control, a digital "Showroom" where collectors organize vaulted cards into collections, and an online marketplace for buying, selling and trading slabbed sports and trading-card-game cards. Members submit cards for grading and vaulting, browse and transact in the marketplace, open digital packs, and can retrieve physical cards from the vault on demand. Arena Club ships web and native iOS/Android apps but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.
a.name: Arena Club

a.description: Arena Intelligence provides intelligence software for organizations involved in policy advocacy, campaign management, and government affairs. Their platform offers modular solutions across six arenas—Congress, Campaign, State, Advocacy, Affairs, and Communications—designed to streamline briefing, messaging, and legislative tracking for congressional offices, campaign teams, state legislators, advocacy groups, and government affairs professionals.
a.name: Arena Intelligence

a.description: Arenac37f is a placeholder company identified during the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. It currently exists as a stub entry awaiting further discovery and verification of its real-world presence, official website, and API offerings. No concrete public information or documentation has been located as of the profiling date, and the entry serves as a starting point for future enrichment when reliable sources become available.
a.name: Arenac37f

a.description: ArenaCX provides a managed network for customer operations sourcing, offering BPO sourcing, multi‑vendor management, seasonal surge handling, and critical response services. The platform connects enterprises with specialized providers, leveraging decades of operating experience to deliver diversified solutions across public‑sector and private markets. ArenaCX’s portal enables providers to join a selective network, facilitating collaboration and opportunity matching for complex customer‑operations challenges.
a.name: ArenaCX

a.description: Ares Interactive is a game developer and publisher founded in 2024 by veteran industry leaders, operating studios in San Francisco and Berlin. The company builds player-first games designed to evolve with their communities and grow into enduring franchises, with a current portfolio that includes Baseball Hits, Heroes vs. Hordes, and The Walking Dead: Aftermath. Ares Interactive is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer/gaming portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface.
a.name: Ares Interactive

a.description: Ares Management Corporation (NYSE: ARES) is a global alternative investment manager founded in 1997 and headquartered in Los Angeles, investing across credit, real estate, infrastructure, private equity and secondaries for institutional and private-wealth clients, with roughly $671 billion of assets under management, 60+ offices and about 4,400 employees as stated on its site in September 2026. Its corporate web presence moved from aresmgmt.com to ares.com. Ares publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract; its only investor-facing software surfaces are gated client portals.
a.name: Ares Management

a.description: Ares Materials provides an AI‑driven platform for materials formulation and performance engineering. The company offers tools to design, formulate, and scale advanced materials, leveraging causal intelligence to accelerate innovation. Their solutions target industries seeking higher performance materials, with services spanning from research to production scaling, aiming to reduce ambiguity in material development and improve end‑product outcomes.
a.name: Aresmaterials

a.description: Areteia Therapeutics was a clinical-stage biotechnology company, formerly based in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, operating in the life-sciences sector. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company is no longer operating: areteiatx.com serves only a closure notice directing asset and general inquiries to contact addresses, and the company publishes no developer portal, API, documentation, SDKs, or other technical developer surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; retained for network completeness with no API artifacts to enrich.
a.name: Areteia Therapeutics

a.description: Arf is a Switzerland-regulated liquidity and settlement platform for cross-border payments, providing short-term, receivable-backed, revolving working capital to licensed payment institutions and money-transfer operators. Its core product, Arf Liquidity, lets payment companies settle across any corridor 24/7 without prefunding destination accounts, using regulated real-world-asset-backed digital assets and stablecoins (including USDC) for native on-ramp/off-ramp value transfer and real-time treasury management. Arf is a compliance-first, VQF self-regulatory-organization member serving only licensed financial institutions, and partners with Circle, Stellar, and Visa. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from Arf's public web presence; Arf does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.
a.name: Arf

a.description: Arfa Technologies is a web development and digital services company offering graphic design, e‑commerce, app development, SEO, and social media marketing. Based in New York, it serves consumer brands with custom digital solutions and a portfolio of design and development projects.
a.name: Arfa

a.description: GoodPeople (ARG) is a boardriding community platform and e-commerce brand for skiers and snowboarders, operating under the tagline "Where the boardriding family meets." It publishes freeride competition results and rankings across events such as the Freeride World Tour (FWT), the IFSA Freeride World Qualifier (FWQ), and the World Rookie Snowboard Finals, alongside a blog covering event highlights, athlete spotlights, and freeride footage. The company also runs an online shop selling apparel, accessories, and lifestyle products, with a sustainability program that plants one tree for every purchase. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment.
a.name: ARG

a.description: Arga Labs provides testing infrastructure for AI agents and agent-facing software. Its platform spins up isolated, resettable sandboxes wired to stateful "digital twins" of third-party services — Stripe, Slack, GitHub, Salesforce, Notion, Discord, Google Drive, Jira, Box, Dropbox, Gmail, Google Calendar and more — so teams can run browser-agent tests, per-PR preview environments, and CI validation without hitting real APIs, exhausting rate limits, or mutating production data. Developers drive it from a web app, a REST API at api.argalabs.com, the arga CLI, official Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a hosted MCP server that lets coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) provision twins and query validation runs directly from the editor.
a.name: Arga Labs

a.description: Argent (rebranded to Ready, ready.co, in 2025) is a self-custodial smart-contract wallet company focused on Starknet and Ethereum. It builds account-abstraction wallets - the Ready / Argent X browser extension and mobile app, a seedless email and password Web Wallet, and a multisig - plus the open-source developer tooling dapps use to integrate them: the starknetkit connection SDK, session keys (@argent/x-sessions), multicall batching, get-starknet, and the Swift starknet.swift and web3.swift libraries. Argent ships no first-party REST API; integration is via these client SDKs and on-chain smart contracts, with developer documentation hosted at docs.ready.co. Surfaced as an index-ventures portfolio company and enriched here.
a.name: Argent

a.description: Argentmill is listed on equity and business directories such as EquityZen, D&B, and Bloomberg as a corporate entity. Limited public information is available; it appears to be a financial or investment related company. No dedicated corporate website could be identified, and attempts to access the listed EquityZen page returned a 403. This stub remains pending further verification.
a.name: Argentmill

a.description: Argil (Argil AI) is an AI avatar video generation platform for the creator economy. Its API programmatically produces talking-avatar videos from text or audio, clones custom avatars and voices, manages B-roll assets, and delivers render events via webhooks - turning a script into a finished, subtitled avatar video.
a.name: Argil

a.description: Argilla is an open-source data annotation and curation platform designed for AI engineers and domain experts building high-quality datasets for LLMs and NLP models. The platform provides a FastAPI-based REST API for managing workspaces, datasets, records, responses, suggestions, and vectors, enabling RLHF and preference tuning pipelines. Developers interact with Argilla through a Python SDK (pip install argilla) or directly via REST using API key authentication. Argilla supports deployment on Hugging Face Spaces, Docker, and self-hosted environments, and is licensed under Apache-2.0. The platform recently joined Hugging Face, deepening its integration with the broader open ML ecosystem.
a.name: Argilla

a.description: Argmax, Inc. builds on-device inference infrastructure that lets developers run foundation models locally on user devices for privacy, real-time performance, and predictable per-device costs. Its products are commercial Pro SDKs on top of open-source cores: WhisperKit (speech-to-text with file transcription, real-time streaming, word timestamps, and subtitle export), SpeakerKit (speaker recognition, diarization, and voice-activity detection), DiffusionKit (image generation for Flux.1 and Stable Diffusion on Apple Silicon), and TTSKit. Argmax also ships the Argmax Local Server for macOS, a local transcription server that is API-compatible with the Deepgram Speech-to-Text (Live) API and driven by an official Node client (@argmaxinc/local-server). Devices are licensed through the ArgmaxSDK (ax_-prefixed API keys) with device-based billing measured by unique licenseId. Backed by General Catalyst.
a.name: Argmax

a.description: Argo is a collection of open-source Kubernetes-native tools for workflows, events, CI/CD, and progressive delivery. The project includes Argo Workflows (container-native workflow engine), Argo CD (declarative GitOps continuous delivery), Argo Events (event-driven automation framework), and Argo Rollouts (progressive delivery with canary and blue-green strategies). Argo is a CNCF graduated project governed by the Linux Foundation.
a.name: Argo

a.description: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous-delivery tool for Kubernetes, part of the CNCF Graduated Argo project. The argocd-server component exposes a gRPC and REST API used by the Web UI, the argocd CLI, and CI/CD systems. APIs cover applications, projects, clusters, repositories, accounts, certificates, GPG keys, sessions, settings, and notifications. Argo CD is also a Kubernetes operator that defines first-class CRDs (Application, ApplicationSet, AppProject) — those CRDs are themselves a Kubernetes-native API. Argo CD is open-source under the Apache 2.0 license; commercial offerings are provided by third parties (notably Akuity, founded by the Argo project's creators) rather than the Argo CD project itself.
a.name: Argo CD

a.description: Argo Workflows is an open-source, container-native workflow engine for orchestrating parallel jobs on Kubernetes. It is a CNCF graduated project that allows you to define workflows where each step is a container, model multi-step workflows as sequences of tasks or DAGs, and run compute-intensive jobs for machine learning, data processing, and CI/CD pipelines natively on Kubernetes. Governed by the Linux Foundation and the CNCF.
a.name: Argo Workflows

a.description: Argo AI is an autonomous vehicle technology company founded in 2016, backed by Ford and Volkswagen. The firm develops self‑driving hardware and software, focusing on lidar, perception, and mapping solutions. It employs engineers from over 50 countries and aims to make streets safer and more accessible. After years of testing in multiple U.S. cities, Argo AI announced a shutdown in 2022, with its assets and talent transitioning to its automotive partners.
a.name: Argoai

a.description: Argon Networks was a late-1990s networking infrastructure startup that developed a high-speed routing switch for what was then described as the next-generation multi-service Internet, combining IP routing with ATM switching in a single carrier-class platform. The company was venture backed by Canaan Partners (Series B, partner Eric Young), Matrix Partners, New Enterprise Associates and Greylock. Siemens acquired Argon Networks in March 1999 in a deal reported at roughly $240 million and folded the team into Unisphere Solutions / Unisphere Networks, the carrier-infrastructure unit later acquired by Juniper Networks in 2002. Argon Networks predates the public web API era: it shipped carrier networking hardware, never operated a developer program, and has no surviving website, documentation, SDKs or API surface. This profile is retained as a historical venture-portfolio record rather than as an active API provider.
a.name: Argon Networks

a.description: ARGUS is the industry-standard suite of commercial real estate software solutions by Altus Group. The ARGUS platform includes ARGUS Enterprise (property valuation and cash flow forecasting), ARGUS Developer (development feasibility and project management), ARGUS Intelligence Platform (portfolio analytics, asset management, and fund management), ARGUS EstateMaster (property development feasibility), and ARGUS Taliance (real estate fund management). ARGUS is recognized as the industry standard and taught at 200+ universities worldwide. The ARGUS API provides integration capabilities across cloud-enabled ARGUS solutions.
a.name: ARGUS

a.description: ARGUS Developer is a cloud-based real estate development software platform by Altus Group that enables property developers, appraisers, consultants, and financiers to manage complex, multi-stage development projects from initial feasibility through delivery. It provides development pro forma modeling, residual land value analysis, scenario comparison, cash flow forecasting, and professional reporting. Part of the ARGUS Intelligence Platform by Altus Group, the industry-standard suite for commercial real estate.
a.name: ARGUS Developer

a.description: ARGUS Enterprise is the industry-standard commercial property valuation and cash flow forecasting software by Altus Group, now integrated into the ARGUS Intelligence Platform. It provides lease-by-lease cash flow modeling, property valuations using DCF and yield-based methods, budgeting and forecasting, scenario testing, and 40+ industry-standard reports. Trusted by real estate investors, portfolio managers, valuation professionals, and asset managers worldwide and taught at 200+ universities.
a.name: ARGUS Enterprise

a.description: Argus Research Company is an independent equity research firm founded in 1934, providing institutional-quality investment research, stock ratings, and analyst recommendations for 500+ publicly traded companies. The firm publishes fundamental research, earnings estimates, target prices, and Buy/Hold/Sell ratings across all major sectors including healthcare, technology, financial services, and industrials. Research is distributed to institutional clients and through financial data platforms including Bloomberg, Fidelity, Schwab, and Interactive Brokers.
a.name: Argus Investor

a.description: Argus Software (ARGUS) is a commercial real estate software provider whose products are the industry standard for cash-flow modeling, valuation, asset and investment management, and development-project appraisal for owners, investors, lenders, and advisors. Founded in Houston, Texas and acquired by Altus Group in 2011, the ARGUS product line is now delivered through Altus Group as the ARGUS Intelligence platform and includes ARGUS Enterprise, ARGUS EstateMaster, ARGUS Developer, ARGUS Taliance, ARGUS ValueInsight, ARGUS Voyanta, and Forbury. ARGUS software is used across the global commercial real estate industry to underwrite acquisitions, perform discounted cash-flow analysis, run portfolio and fund analytics, and standardize valuations. As of this enrichment pass ARGUS exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or self-service API program; its cloud platform is accessed through the Altus Platform / ARGUS Cloud portal.
a.name: Argus Software

a.description: Argyle is an employment data connectivity platform offering a REST API for accessing payroll records, employment history, income verification, and gig platform earnings via user-consented direct-source connections. The API provides real-time access to standardized payroll data across traditional employers, gig platforms, and government payroll systems, with webhook alerts for employment and income changes.
a.name: Argyle

a.description: Argyle9a25 is a stub entry for the company Argyle, which provides automated income, employment, and asset verification services. Their platform offers APIs for payroll verification, direct banking data, and various use cases across mortgage, personal lending, government benefits, background checks, and tenant screening. Argyle enables lenders and brokers to integrate verification flows quickly, with a web-based console and developer-friendly documentation.
a.name: Argyle9a25

a.description: Argámedtech is a medical technology company developing next‑generation non‑thermal cardiac ablation systems using Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) technology. The firm focuses on improving safety and efficacy of atrial fibrillation treatments, offering a versatile catheter‑based solution. Their platform integrates advanced energy delivery and proprietary software to enhance procedural outcomes for physicians and patients worldwide.
a.name: Argámedtech

a.description: ARI (shopARI) is a New York City based artificial intelligence company building a personal shopping and styling assistant for fashion. The product is positioned as an AI stylist that produces custom style recommendations across a curated marketplace of both major and independent brands, interpreting the intent and sentiment behind a shopper request rather than matching product tags alone. The company was founded by Lior Cole and has raised pre-seed capital from investors including Bloomberg Beta, 1517 Fund, Correlation Ventures, Daybreak Ventures and Z Fellows. As of this enrichment pass ARI operates as a consumer application and publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs or machine-readable specification; the shopari.com domain is registered and carries mail records but resolves no web address record.
a.name: ARI

a.description: Aria Networks, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California networking company founded in 2025 by Mansour Karam (founder and former CEO of Apstra, acquired by Juniper Networks in 2020) that builds "Deep Networking" — an AI-native networking system for AI factories and GPU data centers. The platform pairs purpose-built 800GbE and 1.6Tbps Ethernet switches on Broadcom Tomahawk 5 and Tomahawk 6 silicon running a hardened SONiC network OS with microsecond-resolution telemetry agents on switch ASICs, switch-OS kernels, transceivers, server NICs and GPU clusters, plus a reasoning layer that detects, root-causes and resolves fabric issues. Aria measures itself on Model FLOPS Utilization (MFU) and token efficiency rather than traditional network metrics. The company disclosed $125M in funding from Sutter Hill Ventures, Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners and Eclipse Ventures in April 2026. A production REST API is live at api.arianetworks.com (Aria API 1.0.0), but its reference documentation and machine-readable specification sit behind a customer login.
a.name: Aria Networks

a.description: Aria Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to drug discovery, using a computational platform to identify and advance small-molecule therapeutic candidates for complex, inflammatory, and immunological diseases. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Aria operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a software or API provider. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; an enrichment pass found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or other programmatic developer surface for the company at this time.
a.name: Aria Pharmaceuticals

a.description: Aria CV, Inc. is developing a medical device to treat pulmonary hypertension, a life‑threatening disease with limited therapeutic options. The company aims to provide a less invasive, cost‑effective solution compared to expensive drug therapies, addressing a significant unmet medical need.
a.name: Ariacv

a.description: Ariadnemaps provides a privacy‑first people counting platform that uses hybrid fusion of phone‑signal sensing and time‑of‑flight depth sensors to deliver sub‑meter accuracy without cameras or personal data. The solution offers real‑time occupancy monitoring, queue management, and visitor flow analytics for venues such as retail stores, airports, and smart cities, complying with GDPR and EU AI Act requirements.
a.name: Ariadnemaps

a.description: Arianespace is a leading European launch service provider, delivering satellites and payloads to a wide range of orbits using its Ariane family of rockets. Founded in 1980, it operates from the Guiana Space Centre and serves commercial, institutional and governmental customers worldwide, offering flexible launch solutions, ground services and mission support.
a.name: Arianespace

a.description: Ariasystems is a stub entry in the API Evangelist catalog, originating from a secondary-market harvest. The company’s public presence is currently minimal, with no accessible official website or documented API endpoints discovered through web searches. This profile serves as a placeholder pending future discovery of verifiable digital assets, documentation, or API specifications.
a.name: Ariasystems

a.description: Aria Systems provides a cloud billing platform that simplifies commercial complexity into adaptive and automated billing experiences. It unifies traditional and new business models, offering solutions like Aria Billing, Aria Allegro, and AI-powered Aria Billie to help enterprises manage subscriptions, usage, and revenue recognition across industries.
a.name: Ariasystems5d5a

a.description: SAP Ariba is the procurement and supply-chain collaboration business of SAP: strategic sourcing, contract management, procure-to-pay, supplier lifecycle and performance, supplier risk, catalog management, and the SAP Business Network that connects buyers and suppliers. Its API surface is one of the largest enterprise contract estates in the catalog - 114 REST APIs published in the SAP Business Accelerator Hub package SAPAribaOpenAPIs, plus 144 SOAP web services - all routed through the openapi.ariba.com gateway behind OAuth 2.0 client credentials, an application key, and a per-realm authorization grant. Ariba also authored cXML, the Commerce XML interchange standard the wider procurement market still runs on. The catalog metadata is anonymously readable; the specifications themselves are not - every OpenAPI download redirects to an SAP ID login.
a.name: Ariba

a.description: SAP Ariba Guided Buying provides a consumer-like shopping experience for enterprise procurement, enabling employees to find and purchase goods and services through an intuitive catalog-driven interface with built-in approval workflows and policy compliance.
a.name: Ariba Guided Buying

a.description: SAP Ariba Sourcing provides cloud-based strategic sourcing capabilities for procurement organizations. It enables supplier collaboration, RFx management, electronic auctions, and contract management through APIs that integrate sourcing processes with enterprise systems.
a.name: Ariba Sourcing

a.description: AriBio, operating under the ARIBIO Group, integrates biotechnology, artificial intelligence, and energy/data center infrastructure technologies to drive Korea's future core industries. The company aims to become a next‑generation global platform group, merging bio‑tech and AI for innovative solutions across healthcare, energy, and digital infrastructure.
a.name: AriBio

a.description: Aricen (Jiangsu Aricen Electronic Materials Co., Ltd.) is a China‑based supplier of high‑purity reagents, gases and one‑stop chemical integration solutions for the electronics industry. The company offers products such as high purity reagents, industrial gases, on‑site gas production, bulk chemistry, and engineering services, serving customers worldwide with continuous innovation and industry expertise.
a.name: Aricen

a.description: Ariceumtherapeutics is a biotech company focused on developing innovative radiopharmaceutical therapies for rare cancers. The firm aims to leverage cutting‑edge molecular targeting and imaging technologies to create precision treatments that improve patient outcomes while minimizing side effects. As a relatively new entrant in the oncology space, Ariceumtherapeutics is building its pipeline through collaborations with academic institutions and seeks to expand its clinical trial portfolio in the coming years.
a.name: Ariceumtherapeutics

a.description: Aril Inc. (Arilinc) is a fabless semiconductor company in Los Gatos, California designing efficient AI processors and memory technology for edge inference. Its two core products are the Aril Standard Cell Memory, a patented on-chip memory offering roughly 40% lower active power and 3.6x smaller area, and a scalable RISC-V-based AI Processor Engine delivering hundreds of TOPS of inference per block with integrated vector and matrix engines. The company targets robotics, industrial automation, drones, defense and aerospace, autonomous vehicles, and edge vision systems where power efficiency is critical. Founded by a team of engineers who have collectively shipped 20M+ processors and worked on silicon for Cisco, Intel, AMD, and Google. Arilinc sells custom silicon and IP to hardware makers rather than a public developer API; it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or programmatic surface at this time.
a.name: Arilinc

a.description: Arima Genomics is a San Diego based cancer diagnostics company built on Hi-C sequencing and 3D genome science. Founded in 2015 to study how DNA is organized in three dimensions, the company now develops clinical tests and technology platforms that detect cancer-driving structural alterations — noncanonical fusions, enhancer hijacking, extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) and complex rearrangements — from routine FFPE tumor tissue that conventional DNA and RNA profiling can leave unresolved. Its surface spans research products (Arima-HiC+, Arima High Coverage HiC, Promoter and Custom Capture HiC, HiC FFPE, Arima CiFi), lab services including Single Cell Methyl-3C and multi-omics, the Aventa FusionPlus and Aventa Lymphoma clinical tests, and biopharma partnership programs. Arima publishes open-source bioinformatics pipelines on GitHub (Arima-HiC mapping pipeline, Arima-CHiC, Arima-SV-Pipeline) but operates no public web API, developer portal or machine-readable specification.
a.name: Arima Genomics

a.description: Arimo (formerly Adatao) was a Palo Alto, California AI and big-data startup building a distributed deep-learning and "Behavioral AI" analytics platform on top of Apache Spark, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bloomberg Beta. The company was acquired by Panasonic in 2017 and folded into Panasonic's AI/innovation efforts, and it no longer operates as an independent provider. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead for the API Evangelist network, this profile has no surviving developer portal, documentation, or public API surface to enrich - the arimo.com and arimo.ai domains no longer resolve.
a.name: Arimo

a.description: Arincare provides a digital pharmacy platform for pharmacists and drugstores in Thailand, offering a suite of tools including inventory management, point‑of‑sale, e‑prescription, e‑referral, telepharmacy, and a pharma marketplace. The solution aims to streamline pharmacy operations, improve patient care, and increase sales through an integrated, free‑to‑use system.
a.name: Arincare

a.description: Arine is a San Francisco-based healthcare technology company that operates an AI-driven medication intelligence and comprehensive medication management platform for health plans, government payors and risk-bearing provider organizations. The platform ingests pharmacy and medical claims, clinical, cost, quality, behavioral and social-determinants-of-health data, then applies machine learning and clinical decision logic to surface medication-related gaps in care and generate targeted, just-in-time interventions, member education materials and prescriber communications. Arine packages this as four solutions — LUMINATE (high-risk member management), RESONATE (prescriber analytics), ELEVATE (Star Ratings and quality improvement) and ELEVATE MTM (medication therapy management) — delivered as a SaaS portal running in AWS. The Arine Platform holds HITRUST Risk-based 2-year (r2) certification. Arine ships no public developer program: its API gateway at api.arine.io is closed to anonymous callers and its product documentation portal at docs.arine.io sits behind customer authentication, so no machine-readable API contract is publicly available.
a.name: Arine

a.description: Ario is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures, wing-venture-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-apps. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
a.name: Ario

a.description: Aris Machina builds AI-powered industrial software for advanced manufacturing, describing its mission as delivering "industrial superintelligence" that unifies design, production, and operations through AI agents and a shared semantic knowledge model. Its products include Protos, an AI co-engineer for R&D teams that accelerates design validation and simulation; Gemba, shopfloor operational agents that provide real-time equipment diagnostics; and the Ontology Toolkit, a knowledge-integration layer that bridges data across MES, ERP, and PLM systems. Aris Machina serves batteries, biopharma, robotics, defense, and aerospace, and is backed by Earlybird. The company operates from Stockholm, Bangalore, and California. This profile was surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Aris Machina does not currently publish a public developer API surface, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.
a.name: Aris Machina

a.description: Arist is an AI-native enterprise enablement platform, founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York City, that delivers training, communications, nudges and surveys in the flow of work over SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, Microsoft Teams, email and its own web and mobile apps rather than through a traditional LMS portal. The product is packaged as an agent suite — a Needs Analysis agent that interviews employees and syncs HRIS/CRM/LMS data, a Creator agent that generates and translates courses into 50+ languages, a Core Platform and Routing agent that decides who receives what and where, and an Analytics agent that ties delivery back to business goals. Customer systems (Workday, Salesforce, SAP SuccessFactors, Cornerstone, ServiceNow, Oracle) are connected through Workato-hosted connectors rather than a publicly documented REST API; the platform API host at api.arist.app is credential-gated and no public OpenAPI, SDK or developer portal is published. Identity is handled by an Auth0 tenant at auth.arist.app supporting SAML and OIDC single sign-on plus one-time email passcodes.
a.name: Arist

a.description: Profile for Arista Networks in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 886).
a.name: Arista Networks

a.description: AristaMD is a San Diego based specialty care company whose eConsult platform connects primary care providers to a panel of board-certified specialists across more than 70 specialties and subspecialties, delivering asynchronous, documented specialist recommendations that reduce unnecessary face-to-face referrals, emergency department visits and hospitalizations. The platform is sold to health plans, Medicaid programs, federally qualified health centers and provider groups, and is delivered through EHR-embedded referral workflows, HL7 messaging and a REST API. AristaMD publishes a live Swagger 2.0 definition for its core business-logic API at api.aristamd.com/api-docs covering eConsults, patients, panelists, specialties, reviews and workup checklists, and operates an OAuth 2.0 authorization server plus a SAML 2.0 service-provider endpoint for federated single sign-on.
a.name: AristaMD

a.description: Aristotle (heyaristotle.com) is an AI tutoring platform that delivers personalized, one-on-one, dialogue-based instruction across all subjects. Rather than lecturing or simply marking answers wrong, it uses a Socratic, voice-first approach to diagnose conceptual misconceptions and verifies each response turn-by-turn before delivering it to the student. Positioned as an affordable alternative to human tutors, its methodology is grounded in learning science (Bloom's two-sigma work, ICAP, LearnLM benchmarks). Backed by True Ventures. Sector: EdTech / AI education. No public developer API or SDK surface at this time.
a.name: Aristotle

a.description: Arithmer Inc. provides AI-driven solutions across multiple industries, including manufacturing, construction, logistics, retail, wind power, bio, and flood risk assessment. Their platform offers AI agents that automate complex tasks, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision making for enterprises worldwide.
a.name: Arithmer

a.description: Aritma provides a finance automation platform for B2B enterprises, enabling seamless payments, reconciliation, and integration with multiple ERP systems. Their API connects banks, ERP solutions like Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business NXT, Visma, and more, allowing developers to build custom workflows for CFOs, accountants, and IT teams. The platform supports multi‑bank transactions, ISO‑20022 compliance, and offers extensive documentation for developers to integrate financial data across systems.
a.name: Aritma

a.description: Arity is a mobility data and analytics company founded by Allstate. It collects and analyzes driving behavior data from mobile devices and connected vehicles to power telematics-based insurance pricing, crash detection, audience and marketing products, and road and traffic analytics. Developers integrate through the Arity Driving Engine (OAuth token, trip intelligence, user registration, groups, driving scores, activation), a Booking API and a PreQualCredit API, documented as a Postman collection at apidocs.arity.com, plus the Arity mobile SDK.
a.name: Arity

a.description: Arivalbank is a digital banking platform offering global financial services for businesses and startups. It provides multi-currency accounts, stablecoin solutions, and card issuance, enabling users to manage personal and corporate finances worldwide. Licensed in Puerto Rico, Arival Bank operates internationally with a focus on seamless cross-border transactions and modern banking experiences.
a.name: Arivalbank

a.description: ARIVE (getarive.com) was an urban quick-commerce platform founded in Paris during the COVID-19 pandemic that delivered fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products to customers within hours. Operating across Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, and Paris, it connected more than 500 brands and 200 local stores directly to young, convenience-focused urban shoppers. Backed by Balderton Capital, LaFamiglia, and Triple Point Capital with roughly €31.7M raised, the company ceased operations in mid-2023 following a sale of the business. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or other technical surface was ever published; this profile is retained for network and portfolio-graph completeness.
a.name: ARIVE

a.description: Arivihan is an Indian EdTech company operating an AI-based, fully automated online learning platform that gives each K-12 school student a personalized "tutor in their pocket." It targets low- and middle-income families and students in Tier 2+ cities, delivering interactive, personalized lectures and doubt resolution in vernacular languages at roughly 10% of typical coaching fees. Products include the DoubtBuzzter mobile app and the tutor-prod / InstantGuru doubt-resolution web platform. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and prosus-ventures. No public API or developer surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer-facing product profile.
a.name: Arivihan

a.description: Arize AI is an AI engineering and observability platform for LLM applications, agents, and traditional ML systems. The commercial Arize AX platform (with Generative and ML & CV variants) provides tracing, evaluation, experiments, prompt management, and the Alyx AI engineering agent, built on the OpenInference OpenTelemetry conventions. Phoenix is the open-source counterpart used by tens of thousands of developers for local tracing, evaluation, and prompt iteration. Arize is vendor- and framework-agnostic with 30+ instrumentation providers and an OTLP-native ingestion path.
a.name: Arize AI

a.description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source AI observability and evaluation platform built on OpenTelemetry, enabling developers to trace, evaluate, and debug LLM applications in production or locally. Phoenix exposes a REST API for programmatically ingesting spans and traces, managing datasets, running experiments, submitting annotations, and querying evaluation results. The platform supports a wide range of LLM frameworks including LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, and CrewAI through auto-instrumentation. Phoenix can be self-hosted in a single command or used as a managed cloud service (Arize AX), with authentication via API keys and OAuth2/OIDC for enterprise deployments.
a.name: Arize Phoenix

a.description: Arizona Public Service (APS) is Arizona's largest electric utility, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital, serving residential and business customers across the state.
a.name: Arizona Public Service

a.description: Arizona State University (ASU) is a large public research university based in Tempe, Arizona, United States, and one of the largest by enrolment in the country. Its programmable footprint is real but narrow, and almost none of it is presented as a developer product. ASU operates no public developer portal, no self-service API keys and no open data portal — api.asu.edu, data.asu.edu, open.asu.edu and developer.asu.edu do not resolve. What it does operate, verified by live probe on 2026-09-01, is an identity and metadata layer: a Shibboleth SAML 2.0 Identity Provider registered in the InCommon Federation under entityID urn:mace:incommon:asu.edu, serving its own signed metadata from shibboleth2.asu.edu; a CAS single sign-on service at weblogin.asu.edu; and THREE independent OAI-PMH 2.0 repositories on ASU's own hosts — the Library Research Data Repository (a self-built Dataverse, build string asu-6.11-oai-rights, 104 datasets under DOI prefix 10.48349/ASU) plus KEEP and PRISM, the ASU Library Islandora deployments developed in public at github.com/asulibraries. ASU also runs its own course-catalog microservices API and a myASU data platform on its own hosts, but both are OAuth-gated and undocumented for outside developers. It is a registrant in DataCite (member ASU, repository ASU.ASUL), Crossref (member 37851, prefix 10.58875) and ROR (03efmqc40). No vendor contract is held under this slug: the repository software ASU runs is open source and self-hosted, and the specification for it belongs to the projects that wrote it, not to ASU.
a.name: Arizona State University

a.description: Ark Biopharmaceutical (爱科百发, Ark Biosciences) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of innovative therapies for respiratory diseases and pediatric conditions. Its pipeline includes AK0529 (ziresovir) for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, AK0901 for ADHD, AK3280 for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, AK0610 for RSV prevention, and AK0705 for COPD. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As a drug-development company it publishes a corporate website, R&D pipeline, and news center, but exposes no public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface at this time.
a.name: Ark Biopharmaceutical

a.description: Ark.com was a people search engine founded in San Francisco in March 2012 by Patrick Riley and Yiming Liu, and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2012 batch. Ark indexed over a billion public social network profiles — aggregating "ghost profiles" from Facebook, LinkedIn, AngelList and other networks — and let users search across them with filters such as hometown, current city, high school, college, employer and interests, to reconnect with classmates and acquaintances or find new business contacts. The company raised a $4.2M seed round in April 2012 from Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners and SV Angel, and reached the finals of TechCrunch Disrupt NYC 2012. Ark is no longer operating: Y Combinator lists the company as Inactive and PitchBook lists it as Out of Business. As of a July 2026 probe the ark.com domain no longer serves the company — it redirects to www.ark-invest.com, the unrelated ARK Investment Management site — and no api., developer. or docs. subdomain resolves. Ark never published a public API, developer portal or SDKs, so there is no API surface to catalog. Retained as a historical a16z portfolio record only.
a.name: Ark.com

a.description: Arka is a custom packaging company that lets ecommerce brands design, order, and ship eco-friendly custom boxes, mailers, and sustainable packaging online. Arka offers low minimums, fast turnaround, and plug-in integrations with commerce platforms including Shopify, BigCommerce, and Square so merchants can reorder packaging alongside their fulfillment workflow. Arka's storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface — a published /llms.txt, an agentic-discovery sitemap, OIDC/OAuth 2.0 discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete buyer-approved checkouts. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled here as part of the API Evangelist network.
a.name: Arka

a.description: Arkbio is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
a.name: Arkbio

a.description: ArkEdge Space is a Japanese satellite technology company developing low‑Earth‑orbit positioning, navigation and timing (LEO‑PNT) services, maritime communication, lunar infrastructure and deep‑space exploration capabilities. It builds its own satellites, onboard computers and ground‑segment solutions to empower safe, connected futures for people and industries worldwide.
a.name: Arkedgespace

a.description: Arkema S.A. is a French specialty materials company headquartered in La Defense, Paris and listed on Euronext Paris under ticker AKE. The group is organized around three Specialty Materials segments — Adhesive Solutions (anchored by the Bostik brand), Advanced Materials (high-performance polymers including Kynar PVDF, Rilsan polyamides, Pebax elastomers, Sartomer photocurable resins) and Coating Solutions (acrylic monomers, waterborne and solvent-borne resins, additives) — plus a smaller Intermediates business. Arkema employs roughly 21,000 people across 55 countries with about 154 production plants and 17 R&D centers, generating around EUR 9.1 billion in 2025 revenue. Strategy is anchored in materials science, decarbonization and a validated 1.5 degree SBTi pathway toward Net-Zero by 2050. Arkema does not publish a public developer portal or REST API; customer integrations and product data are exchanged through commercial sales channels, the Product Finder web UI and Safety Data Sheet downloads.
a.name: Arkema

a.description: Arkenstone Technologies provides strategic consulting and implementation services focused on healthcare innovation, artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, compliance, security, and immersive technologies. Their offerings include healthcare analytics, AI-driven solutions, RPA deployment, and guidance on regulatory compliance, helping organizations navigate digital transformation and market disruptions.
a.name: Arkenstone

a.description: Arkestro is a predictive procurement orchestration platform for enterprise sourcing teams, applying negotiation science, supplier science and process science to run competitive sourcing events at scale. The platform covers sourcing events and their schedules, supplier organizations and contacts, corporate item and category catalogs, purchase orders, document and quote submissions, awards, and event analytics. It serves automotive, oil and gas, high-tech manufacturing, construction, financial services and food and beverage buyers. Arkestro publishes a public OpenAPI 3.1.1 contract for its API V2 at api.arkestro.com and operates an OAuth 2.1 remote MCP server, though its developer documentation portal sits behind a customer sign-in wall.
a.name: Arkestro

a.description: Arkham Intelligence operates a production-grade blockchain intelligence platform and REST API that provides entity attribution, address labels, wallet and entity intelligence, transfer and swap tracking, token and market data, portfolio and PnL history, DeFi loan positions, HyperCore and Polymarket analytics, and risk scoring across 20+ chains. The Arkham Intel API (v1.1.0) exposes 135 operations over 128 REST paths plus a WebSocket streaming surface for real-time transfers, authenticated with an API-Key header and billed by a usage-based credit model. Arkham also ships an agent-native x402 pay-per-request surface that lets AI agents buy individual API responses in USDC on Base with no account or key. Arkham was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and is a crypto / on-chain analytics provider.
a.name: Arkham

a.description: Arkham operates two related products. Arkham Intelligence (the Arkham Platform / Intel) is an onchain entity intelligence service that labels wallets and contracts with real-world identities and exposes them through a web app, intel exchange (Dreadnought / bounties), and an API for entity lookups, address profiles, balances, and transaction history. Arkham Exchange (arkm.com) is a centralized crypto exchange that publishes a REST and WebSocket trading API for spot and perpetual markets. Both share the ARKM token and operate under the same parent.
a.name: Arkham Intelligence

a.description: Arkhive Digital is a boutique commerce agency founded in 2025, focused on elevating enterprise brands through strategy, design, implementation, and ongoing support across the full commerce lifecycle. The company offers services such as consulting, experience design, optimization, and replatforming, aiming to help clients make informed decisions before costly implementations. It positions itself as senior‑led, female‑founded, and dedicated to delivering high‑impact commerce solutions for large‑scale enterprises.
a.name: Arkhive Digital

a.description: ARKO Corp (Nasdaq: ARKO) is a Fortune 500 company and one of the largest operators of convenience stores and wholesalers of fuel in the United States. Through its subsidiary GPM Investments, ARKO operates approximately 1,400 company-operated stores under 25+ regional brands across 30+ states, as well as proprietary cardlock locations and a fleet fueling network. In 2026, ARKO completed the IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp., which operates its wholesale, fleet fueling, and petroleum distribution segments.
a.name: ARKO

a.description: Arkose Labs is a bot management and account-security platform (the Arkose Bot Manager / Titan platform) that protects login, registration, and other high-value user flows from bots, fraud, and abuse. It combines a client-side detection engine and adaptive Enforcement Challenge with a server-side Verify API that returns a risk assessment (risk band, score, telltales, IP / device / email intelligence, and agent trust) for every session, plus a lightweight server-side Edge API for surfaces where client JavaScript cannot run. The developer surface includes the Verify API v4, Edge API, Truth Data and Retroactive Attack Insights APIs, mobile SDKs (Android, iOS, React Native), CDN integrations (Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly), and a public status page.
a.name: Arkose Labs

a.description: Arkos Health is a healthcare technology company that partners with payers, providers, and patients to deliver value‑based care solutions. Since 2018, it offers integrated clinical services, care coordination, and data‑driven insights through its proprietary Arkos360 platform, aiming to simplify complex healthcare processes, reduce costs, and improve outcomes across its network of providers and members.
a.name: Arkoshealth

a.description: Arkuda Therapeutics, Inc. was a privately held, preclinical-stage biotechnology company based in Watertown, Massachusetts, founded in 2018 by Gerhard Koenig, Ph.D. and Duane Burnett to develop small-molecule enhancers of lysosomal function for neurodegenerative disease. Its lead biology targeted progranulin (GRN) and lysosomal dysfunction in frontotemporal dementia (FTD-GRN), Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. Arkuda closed a $44M Series A in November 2019 and a $64M Series B in February 2022, backed by Atlas Venture, Cormorant Asset Management, Pfizer Ventures, abrdn plc, Mission BioCapital and Eli Lilly and Company. On 27 February 2024 it entered an option and asset purchase agreement with Johnson & Johnson, and on 9 January 2025 Johnson & Johnson (through Janssen Pharmaceuticals) exercised that option and acquired the entire portfolio of lysosomal function enhancers. Independent operations concluded thereafter; founder and CEO Gerhard Koenig became CEO of Augustine Therapeutics in January 2025. Arkuda was a therapeutics developer, not a software company: it never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and both of its former domains have since lapsed.
a.name: Arkuda Therapeutics

a.description: Arlettie is a Paris-founded (1994) operator of invitation-only luxury and contemporary fashion private sales — "ventes privées" / sample sales — running showroom events in Paris, London, Milan and New York for more than 220 brand partners, alongside its online outlet store "Les échappées". Its machine-readable surface is not a developer program: it is an agent-commerce surface on the Les échappées storefront, which runs on Shopify and therefore serves a live unauthenticated UCP/MCP endpoint, agent instructions at /agents.md and /llms.txt, RFC 8414 + RFC 9728 OAuth discovery documents, and an introspectable Storefront GraphQL API — all on hosts Arlettie controls.
a.name: Arlettie

a.description: Arlo Industries is a San Francisco defense hardware company (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) building a passive sensing network for detecting and tracking drones and aerial threats without traditional radar. Its product, Mentat, uses a distributed mesh architecture of low-cost sensors that cooperatively detect and track targets in 3D while remaining invisible to the threats they monitor. The company frames its approach around "asymmetric economics" — sensor deployment cost grows linearly while tracking accuracy grows exponentially — making the system more scalable than conventional radar installations. Arlo has demonstrated its technology with Ukrainian military operators on active frontlines and maintains partnerships across the US, Ukraine, and Northern Europe. As an early-stage hardware startup it publishes no public API, developer program, or SDKs at this time.
a.name: Arlo Industries

a.description: Arlula is a satellite imagery marketplace and API platform providing programmatic access to archive and tasking satellite imagery from multiple providers. The Arlula API enables developers to search the global satellite archive, discover tasking opportunities, place imagery orders, and download delivered datasets including GeoTIFF imagery, preview images, and metadata files.
a.name: Arlula

a.description: Arm Holdings plc (NASDAQ: ARM) is the semiconductor and software design company behind the energy-efficient Arm architecture that powers the majority of the world's smartphones and billions of chips across mobile, automotive, IoT, edge AI, servers, and cloud. Arm licenses processor IP (Cortex, Neoverse, Ethos, Mali) and Compute Subsystems rather than manufacturing chips itself. For developers, Arm operates a developer hub, technical documentation, learning paths, community forums, and a large open-source GitHub organization (ARM-software) publishing firmware, compute libraries, and ML tooling. Arm does not currently expose a public REST API product; this profile catalogs its developer surface and web properties.
a.name: Arm

a.description: Armada is an edge computing company that deploys full-stack compute, connectivity, and AI infrastructure into remote and disconnected environments. Its platform spans Atlas (an enterprise console for monitoring and managing distributed IoT and edge assets), Galleon (ruggedized, rapidly deployable modular data centers), and Bridge (a GPU cloud management platform / PaaS that provisions and orchestrates bare-metal, virtual-machine, and Kubernetes GPU workloads across NVIDIA and AMD hardware). The Bridge Orchestrator API exposes tenants, clusters, VMs, storage, networking, catalogs, and quota operations for building sovereign and edge AI clouds, and an OpenAI-compatible Model-as-a-Service inference API is available through Bridge AI Studio.
a.name: Armada

a.description: PT. Armada Lintas Samudra, operating as Armada Logistics, is a professional freight forwarding and logistics company headquartered in Batam, Indonesia, with branches in Jakarta and Semarang. Founded in 2013, it offers domestic and international transportation services including ocean and air freight, chartering, land trucking, customs clearance, stevedoring, warehousing, and towing, emphasizing professionalism, speed, accuracy, safety, and integrity.
a.name: Armada Logistics

a.description: Armada1118 is a stub entry created by the API Evangelist harvest process from secondary-market data. No public website, documentation, or API endpoints have been identified for this entity after exhaustive web searches. The record exists to allow future enrichment should verifiable information become available.
a.name: Armada1118

a.description: Armada Aeronautics Inc. is a mobility company focused on developing modern transportation solutions for urban and rural environments. It aims to reduce traffic congestion, environmental impact, and fuel waste by offering innovative, accessible, and environmentally friendly transportation technologies. Based in Santa Clara, CA, the company provides solutions that integrate with existing infrastructure and target a $500 billion US market opportunity.
a.name: Armadaaeronauticsinc

a.description: Armada.ai provides edge computing solutions with hardware and software platforms such as Leviathan, Galleon, Atlas, Bridge, and Marketplace. The company builds ruggedized mobile data centers and GPU‑as‑a‑service offerings for industries including oil & gas, defense, public sector, manufacturing, mining, and telecommunications. Their products enable scalable AI workloads at the edge, combining high‑performance compute with remote monitoring and management.
a.name: Armadaai

a.description: Armadin is an AI-native cybersecurity company building the "Ultimate Attacker" — an autonomous, agentic offensive security platform that continuously identifies, proves, and prioritizes exploitable risk across enterprise attack surfaces. Founded in 2025 and launched publicly in March 2026, Armadin is headquartered in San Francisco and was co-founded by Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant, former FireEye CEO) alongside former Mandiant and Google Cloud Security leaders. The company pairs agentic AI "attacker swarms" with elite human red teamers to deliver continuous, 24/7 red teaming and prioritized remediation, framed as a response to AI-driven machine-speed "Hyperattacks." Armadin raised $189.9M in combined Seed and Series A funding led by Accel, with Google Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Menlo Ventures, 8VC, Ballistic Ventures, and In-Q-Tel participating. It is currently a security services and platform company with no public developer API surface.
a.name: Armadin

a.description: Armature is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building product analytics for AI agent sessions. Instead of tracking clicks in a human UI, Armature captures how users interact with a product through Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and other agents by way of MCP servers. Drop-in SDKs for TypeScript, Python and Go instrument an MCP server, streaming tool names, timing, outcomes and size-capped previews (with PII and secrets redacted before storage) to Armature, which reconstructs replayable, scored sessions. The platform clusters use cases by volume and pass rate, detects issues ranked by blast radius, and exposes a read-only hosted MCP server so teams can query their own agent-experience analytics from any MCP client. Armature also publishes an open "agent-review" Agent Skill that lets agents submit compact, privacy-safe experience reports about the software flows they use.
a.name: Armature

a.description: Armis is a cyber exposure management and asset intelligence company. Its Armis Centrix platform discovers, protects, and manages every physical and virtual asset in an enterprise environment — IT, OT, ICS, IoT, IoMT, medical devices, cloud workloads, and applications — giving security teams real-time visibility, risk prioritization, and threat detection across the full attack surface. Armis exposes this intelligence through a tenant-scoped REST API secured with OAuth2 client-credentials, an official Python SDK (armis-sdk), a Go application-security scanning CLI (armis-cli), and two published Model Context Protocol servers (armis-knowledge-mcp and armis-appsec-mcp) for agent-native AppSec workflows. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Insight Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from its public developer surface.
a.name: Armis

a.description: ARMO is the cloud-native and Kubernetes security company behind the leading open-source project Kubescape. ARMO Platform is a runtime-driven CNAPP that unifies Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM), vulnerability and image scanning, compliance frameworks, network and seccomp policy generation, and runtime Cloud Application Detection and Response (CADR) - correlating runtime behavior with posture and vulnerabilities to cut alert noise. ARMO exposes a documented REST API over HTTPS (base https://api.armosec.io/api/v1 in the EU region and https://api.us.armosec.io/api/v1 in the US region), authenticated with an account access key sent in the X-API-KEY header. The API covers clusters, workloads, vulnerabilities, posture and compliance, security risks, runtime incidents, attack chains, network and runtime policies, registry scanning, and integrations. API access is available to platform customers who have generated an Agent Access Key; the endpoints below are documented but the data returned requires a connected account and clusters.
a.name: ARMO

a.description: ARMO BioSciences was a clinical-stage immuno-oncology biopharmaceutical company based in Redwood City, California, developing biologic therapeutics that activate a patient's own immune system to fight cancer. Its lead candidate was pegilodecakin (AM0010), a PEGylated recombinant human interleukin-10 (IL-10) evaluated across solid tumors. Backed by GV and Kleiner Perkins, the company IPO'd on NASDAQ in 2018 and was acquired by Eli Lilly and Company that same year for approximately $1.6 billion; its former web domain now redirects to lilly.com. As a life-sciences therapeutics developer it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio/acquisition record rather than an active API provider.
a.name: ARMO BioSciences *

a.description: Armonica is a technology company identified in the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. While detailed public information is limited, the stub indicates its inclusion for comprehensive profiling within the API network. Further investigation may uncover its product offerings, API services, and operational details as the enrichment pipeline progresses.
a.name: Armonica

a.description: Armor (legal name Armor Defense Inc.) is a cybersecurity company headquartered in Plano, Texas, founded as FireHost in 2009 by Chris Drake and rebranded as Armor as its portfolio expanded from secure cloud hosting into managed security. Armor sells vendor-agnostic, cloud-native managed detection and response (Armor MDR), compliant managed private cloud (Armor Enterprise Cloud), the Armor Agent workload protection agent (formerly Armor Anywhere), and compliance and offensive-security professional services, to more than 1,700 organizations across 40 countries with a 24/7 follow-the-sun SOC operating from Plano, London, Singapore and Pune. Armor publishes a public developer portal at developer.armor.com that serves sixteen machine-readable contracts through ReDoc: four Swagger 2.0 documents for the original v1 Armor Services API on api.armor.com (account management, infrastructure, security and support, 254 operations) and twelve OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents for the v2 platform on *.api.secure-prod.services (accounts, agent management, compliance and CSPM, container security, incident management, infrastructure management, log management, notifications, webhooks, the unified MDR public API, and the ARMOR-PSK and FH-AUTH authentication contracts). Armor also publishes a detailed first-party llms.txt at armor.com/llms.txt and holds SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF, PCI DSS Level 1 Service Provider, ISO 27001, TX-RAMP Level 2, HIPAA and Data Privacy Framework attestations.
a.name: Armor

a.description: ArmorCode is a unified exposure and application security posture management (ASPM) platform that consolidates vulnerability and security findings from 350+ security tools and scanners into a single control plane. It uses a Context Risk Graph and agentic AI workflows (Anya agents) to prioritize risk and automate remediation across application, cloud, software supply-chain, and AI security. ArmorCode exposes a REST API on app.armorcode.com (US) and eu.armorcode.com (EU) for programmatic access to findings, integrations, and remediation workflows, secured with bearer API tokens. Originally surfaced as a Sierra Ventures portfolio company and enriched here from ArmorCode's public developer and trust surfaces.
a.name: ArmorCode

a.description: ArmorCode is the independent control plane where AI agents help find, prioritize, and fix vulnerabilities across apps, cloud, infra, and AI. It offers a unified exposure management platform integrating risk graphs, agentic workflows, and compliance tools for enterprises.
a.name: Armorcodeinc

a.description: Armory, Inc. is a San Mateo, California software company founded in 2016 that built and sold an enterprise distribution of the open source Spinnaker continuous delivery platform. Its product line covered Armory Continuous Deployment (self-hosted and Armory-managed Spinnaker), Armory Continuous Deployment-as-a-Service, and a set of proprietary Spinnaker plugins - the Armory Scale Agent for Spinnaker and Kubernetes, Pipelines-as-Code (Dinghy), an OPA-backed Policy Engine, Terraform Integration, GitHub Integration and AWS Event Cache. Armory raised more than $82M including a $40M Series C, and its assets were acquired by Harness in January 2024. www.armory.io now redirects to harness.io, but docs.armory.io remains live and still publishes the full product documentation plus a real Swagger 2.0 API reference for the Armory Scale Agent Clouddriver surface.
a.name: Armory

a.description: Armstrong Robotics is building general-purpose robots for commercial kitchens, beginning with autonomous dishwashing systems that load, run, and unload dishware without human intervention. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company is an early-stage robotics startup focused on kitchen labor automation. It currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced lead awaiting a public API surface, and this profile carries only the identity and domain-security signals that could be verified from its public website.
a.name: Armstrong Robotics

a.description: Armstrong World Industries (NYSE: AWI) is a leading global designer and manufacturer of innovative commercial and residential ceiling, wall, and suspension system solutions. Armstrong offers a broad portfolio of ceiling and wall products across mineral fiber, fiberglass, wood, metal, and specialty substrates for use in commercial construction and renovation projects worldwide. The company provides BIM content, product data, and specification tools for architects and designers but does not offer a public developer API.
a.name: Armstrong World Industries

a.description: The Army National Guard is a reserve component of the United States Army that serves both the nation and individual states in times of need. Operating under the dual authority of the federal government and the fifty state governors, the Army National Guard provides trained and ready soldiers for overseas military operations, domestic disaster relief, homeland security, and civil support missions. Its primary data and digital services are focused on recruiting, career management, benefits administration, and public outreach. The National Guard Bureau (NGB) coordinates federal operations and maintains administrative systems under Title 10 and Title 32 of the United States Code.
a.name: Army National Guard

a.description: Aro Biotherapeutics is a Philadelphia-based biotechnology company developing tissue-targeted genetic medicines built on Centyrins, a proprietary engineered human protein scaffold that is small, stable and highly soluble. Aro conjugates Centyrins to oligonucleotide payloads (Centyrin-siRNA conjugates) to deliver RNA- and DNA-based therapeutics precisely to cells and tissues outside the liver, including muscle and immune cells. Its lead program, ABX1100, is a CD71-targeted Centyrin-siRNA conjugate for Pompe disease that has received FDA orphan drug designation. The company is privately held, raised a $41.5M Series B led by Cowen Healthcare Investments with participation from Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and is headquartered at 601 Walnut Street, Philadelphia, PA. Aro publishes no developer program, API reference or SDK; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is the Wix-platform llms.txt and Site MCP endpoint.
a.name: Aro Biotherapeutics

a.description: Aro Homes is a Mexican construction and remodeling company specializing in new builds, renovations, and detailed architectural projects. Their portfolio showcases residential and commercial works, emphasizing quality craftsmanship and client-focused design. The company provides services from project conception through completion, aiming to transform client visions into reality with integrated design and construction solutions.
a.name: Aro Homes

The Shopify‑powered site showcases a range of products such as serums, cleansers, masks, and accessories, emphasizing advanced bio‑formulations and natural ingredients. It provides free shipping in the U.S. over $75 and maintains policies for refunds, privacy, and terms of service.

a.description: Arondite is a defence technology company building Cobalt, a defence software platform for accelerated decision making that orchestrates missions and manages operational intelligence. Cobalt brings together sighting reports, real-time notifications and alerts, mapping and visualisation, task management and kanban workflows, and observation and monitoring tools to support complex military and defence operations across use cases including Hybrid Navy, C-UAS, Recce-Strike, and Site Security. Arondite combines operational and technical expertise to deliver technology with immediate, real-world impact on a global scale. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. Arondite does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.
a.name: Arondite
