b.description: Benson Hill Biosystems, a leader in agricultural genomics and digital breeding, develops advanced seed traits to improve crop yields, nutrition, and sustainability. Leveraging proprietary genetics platforms and data-driven breeding, the company serves global food, feed, and fuel markets, delivering high-protein soybeans, low-oligosaccharide varieties, and other innovative crops. Their mission focuses on better feed, better food, and better fuel through science and technology.
b.name: Benson Hill Biosystems

b.description: Bentley Systems (NASDAQ: BSY) is an infrastructure engineering software company providing comprehensive applications and cloud services for the design, construction, and operations of infrastructure across roads, bridges, rail, water, energy, and the built environment. Bentley exposes its developer platform through iTwin — a digital twin platform with 30+ REST APIs covering iModel data management, reality capture, project scheduling, reporting, visualization, clash detection, and webhooks. The company reports $1.3 billion in annual revenue, ~5,500 colleagues across 42 countries, and serves 42,000 accounts in 189 countries.
b.name: Bentley Systems

b.description: Bento (Bento Technologies, Inc., dba Bento for Business) was a Chicago- and San Francisco-based small-business fintech that provided card-based payment and expense management for small and mid-size businesses: virtual and physical employee and utility cards, per-card spend controls and category restrictions, real-time spend tracking, and accounting integrations. Bento published a public REST API at api.bentoforbusiness.com (documented at apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com) for issuing employee and utility virtual cards, retrieving card numbers, activating and customizing billing addresses, and reading card transactions, plus outbound webhooks for card transaction completed and declined events; API access was granted per account via an Access Key and Secret Key issued by api-support@bentoforbusiness.com. Bento raised a $2.5M seed round led by Anthemis Group in 2015, with Blumberg Capital, LionBird, Pivot Investment Partners, Edison Partners and Espresso Capital also investing. U.S. Bank agreed to acquire Bento Technologies on August 11, 2021 and closed the acquisition on August 31, 2021, folding the product into U.S. Bank's small-business spend management offering. The Bento card program was then wound down: card reloads stopped April 30, 2024 and all card program services were discontinued June 25, 2024, with customers directed to alternative providers. The developer surface is retired — apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com and api.bentoforbusiness.com no longer resolve in DNS, and bentoforbusiness.com now redirects to U.S. Bank. This profile is retained as a historical record of a former API provider; there is no live API to consume.
b.name: Bento

b.description: BentoBox is a restaurant marketing and commerce platform, part of Fiserv, that powers restaurant websites, online ordering, takeout and delivery, events, reservations, and digital presence for thousands of hospitality brands. While BentoBox runs a Technology Partners program and connects to 50+ third-party services across POS, reservations, delivery, payments, marketing, and shipping, it does not publish a public self-service developer API or API reference. Integrations are built through partnership rather than open documentation, and prospective technology partners are directed to contact the BentoBox partnerships team to integrate with the platform. As a Fiserv company, payments and commerce flows connect through Clover and Fiserv rails.
b.name: BentoBox

b.description: Bentolabs AI builds Bento, a self-learning production infrastructure platform for AI agents. Bento ingests OpenTelemetry traces from agent applications and turns them into readable trajectories, plain-English failure-mode detectors (signals), alerts, clusters, evaluations, and versioned improvements — a closed loop that monitors what runs, surfaces silent regressions and behavioral drift, and compounds learnings back into the agent. It ships a Python SDK, a command-line client, direct OTLP export from any OpenTelemetry-speaking framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK, Google ADK), a hosted MCP server, and packaged Agent Skills for AI coding tools. Y Combinator-backed.
b.name: Bentolabs AI

b.description: BentoML is an open-source unified inference platform for building, packaging, and deploying machine learning models as scalable REST API services. Developers define services using Python class decorators that automatically expose model inference logic as HTTP endpoints. BentoCloud, the managed cloud offering, provides autoscaling infrastructure, GPU instance provisioning, scale-to-zero cost optimization, and a control-plane API for programmatic deployment lifecycle management. The platform supports all major ML frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, ONNX, XGBoost, and Scikit-Learn, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
b.name: BentoML

b.description: Benzinga is a Detroit-based financial media and market data company (founded 2010, acquired by Beringer Capital in 2021) that licenses its newsroom and data products through a developer-first API platform at docs.benzinga.com. Products span real-time financial news (Newsfeed, Press Releases, Why Is It Moving), quantified news sentiment, a deep corporate-events Calendar (earnings, dividends, ratings, IPOs, splits, economics, FDA, M&A, government and insider trades), delayed quotes, historical OHLCV bars, fundamentals, logos, ticker trends, and earnings-call transcripts. Delivery is REST over https://api.benzinga.com with API-key auth, plus WebSocket streams, a TCP streaming service (tcp-v1.benzinga.io:11337), and a data webhook engine. OpenAPI and AsyncAPI specs are published in the public Benzinga/benzinga-docs GitHub repo. Access is licensing-led with a developer console registration flow; no public pricing page.
b.name: Benzinga

b.description: Bepro11, operating under the brand BEPRO, provides analysis software, cameras, and data solutions for sports teams. Their platform enables recording, analysis, and collaboration on match footage, offering products such as fixed and portable sports cameras, data APIs, and bespoke data services. The company targets professional and amateur sports organizations seeking comprehensive performance analytics and video management tools.
b.name: Bepro11

b.description: Berachain is a high-performance EVM-identical Layer 1 blockchain built on BeaconKit consensus with a novel Proof-of-Liquidity (PoL) economic model that routes block rewards into productive liquidity via Reward Vaults. Mainnet launched in early 2025 (chain ID 80094) with a Bepolia testnet (chain ID 80069). Developer surfaces include public JSON-RPC at rpc.berachain.com, BeaconKit consensus client, EVM execution via Bera-Reth and Bera-Geth, Berascan block explorer, indexers (Goldsky, Envio), and dApps such as BEX (DEX) and Bend / Honey.
b.name: Berachain

b.description: BeReal is a French social media application that encourages authentic, unfiltered daily sharing through a two-minute random notification window in which users capture a moment using both the front and rear cameras simultaneously. Positioned as an alternative to curated, algorithmic social media, it emphasizes genuine connection over performance and explicitly excludes AI-generated content from the platform. Founded in France and acquired by mobile publisher Voodoo, BeReal operates a consumer mobile product with a help center and an advertising business, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced via a16z and Accel portfolio data and enriched with the provider's real public web properties and domain-security posture.
b.name: BeReal

b.description: Berkeley Lights is a biotechnology company that develops and commercializes advanced cell analysis platforms, enabling researchers to perform high‑throughput single‑cell assays and functional screening. The firm provides hardware, software, and cloud‑based services to accelerate discovery in therapeutics, genomics, and cell therapy development. Founded in 2015 and based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Berkeley Lights has been recognized for its innovative optofluidic technology and was acquired by Bruker in 2023.
b.name: Berkeley Lights

b.description: Berkshire Grey is a Bedford, Massachusetts-based AI and robotics company that builds integrated pick-and-place, parcel sortation, trailer-unloading, and shuttle-sortation systems for eCommerce fulfillment, retail replenishment, and parcel logistics operations. Its product portfolio is organized around four flagship robotic systems — Core robotic picking system, Dispatch parcel sorter, Scoop trailer unloader, and Stride shuttle sorter — supported by the BG Flex mobile robotic platform and a centralized operating environment that orchestrates fleets of industrial-grade mobile robots for induct, transport, sort, sequence, and fulfill workflows including buy-online-pickup-in-store, curbside, and store replenishment. The company holds 700+ awarded patents (300+ pending) and has deployed solutions with Global-100 retailers and logistics service providers including Walmart, Target, and FedEx, with FedEx expanding from small-parcel sortation into broader AI robotic package-handling capabilities. Berkshire Grey originally went public via SPAC merger with Revolution Acceleration Acquisition Corp in 2021, then entered into a definitive merger agreement with SoftBank Group in 2023 (approximately $375M / $1.40 per share) and is now operated as a private SoftBank portfolio company. Integration with warehouse-management systems is delivered through a proprietary RESTful API surfaced via professional services and a 24/7 remote monitoring and predictive-maintenance support model; the API, BG-OS platform, and any associated SDKs are not publicly documented, and Berkshire Grey does not operate a public developer portal, downloadable SDK, or open-source release for its robotic operating environment.
b.name: Berkshire Grey

b.description: Berkshire Hathaway is a multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. The company's diversified subsidiaries span insurance (GEICO, Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance, National Indemnity), freight rail transportation (BNSF Railway), utilities and energy (Berkshire Hathaway Energy), manufacturing (Precision Castparts, Iscar), wholesale distribution (McLane Company), and services and retailing. BNSF Railway, one of North America's largest freight rail networks, operates a public API Center providing customer APIs for shipment tracking, pricing, scheduling, and waybill management.
b.name: Berkshire Hathaway

b.description: Berrer runs BerrerGate (berrergate.com), an agent-native "tool and provider intelligence" service: an AI agent describes a task in natural language and BerrerGate maps it to agent-usable tools, APIs and provider categories, returns a free, cache-only procurement preview, and sells tightly bounded "decision packets" — evidence-backed shortlists of commercially cleared open-source implementations for observability, orchestration, scraping, analytics and browser automation — plus a paid Evidence Brief and a low-cost pay-per-call AI answer, all settled in USDC on Base through x402 with no account. The same surface is published three ways from api.berrergate.com: a 25-operation OpenAPI 3.1 contract at /openapi.json, an A2A agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json with twelve skills (listed as Verified in the Global A2A Registry), and a remote MCP endpoint at /mcp declared in an MCP server.json manifest; discovery is rounded out by an x402 manifest, an AI Registry catalog, an llms.txt and a provider-written skill.md. The company states it is experimental, publishes no terms of service, no contact address and no pricing page.
b.name: Berrer

b.description: Berry Genomics (Beijing Berry and Kang Biotechnology Co., Ltd., 贝瑞基因) is a Chinese genomics and genetic-testing company operating across reproductive health screening, hereditary disease detection, tumor and cancer diagnostics, laboratory solutions, sequencing equipment and reagents, and genomic big-data services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company publishes a corporate marketing site (news, investor relations, careers, and a legal statement) but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.
b.name: Berry Genomics

b.description: Berry Health is a consumer digital-health company founded in 2023 by British-Ghanaian physician Dr. Fredua Akosa, headquartered in Accra, Ghana, that delivers online medical consultations, prescriptions and nationwide medication delivery for stigmatized and underserved conditions — sexual health, mental health and therapy, dermatology and skincare, and hair loss. Patients consult licensed doctors and clinical psychologists remotely, receive a personalized treatment regimen, and have medication delivered discreetly to their door. The company is licensed by Ghana's Health Facility Regulatory Agency and the Data Protection Commission. In June 2023 it raised a $1.6M pre-seed round co-led by Lightspeed Venture Partners — Lightspeed's first investment in Africa — and General Catalyst, with angels including Reddit COO Jen Wong, Thirty Madison co-founders Demetri Karagas and Steven Gutentag, and former US Surgeon General Regina Benjamin. Berry Health is a direct-to-consumer telehealth service; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK, and its consumer web properties (ourberry.com, app.ourberry.com, ourberry.io) are offline or parked.
b.name: Berry Health

b.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. As Berry Global, the company agreed in November 2024 to an all-stock combination with Amcor plc, which completed on 30 April 2025; berryglobal.com now redirects to Amcor's packaging site. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

b.description: BerryKitchen (Berry Kitchen) was an Indonesian online catering and prepared-meal company founded in Jakarta in 2012 by Cynthia Tenggara. It took online orders for lunch boxes and bento meals aimed at office workers across Jabodetabek, and ran the full chain itself - supplier sourcing, cooking, packaging and last-mile delivery - rather than acting as a marketplace. It was backed by East Ventures and 500 Startups (now 500 Global) and was acquired by Yummy Corp in 2019, with the team folded into Yummy Corp's Yummybox unit and the founder subsequently exiting. b.description: Beryllium was a Singapore- and Delhi-based sports and trading game development platform founded in 2018/2019 by Amay Makhija, best known for its consumer product Sixer — a fantasy cricket game where users bought "Up" or "Down" virtual stocks in professional cricketers, with prices moving on in-game batting, bowling, and fielding metrics. The company raised roughly $3.6M across two rounds, including a $3M pre-Series A in June 2021 led by Bullpen Capital with Genting Ventures and Velo Partners. Beryllium was acquired by Dream Sports (Dream11) in October 2023. As of this enrichment pass the company is defunct as an independent operator: sixer.gg no longer resolves in DNS, and beryllium.ai is a parked domain listed for sale on the GoDaddy/Afternic aftermarket. Beryllium never published a public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so there is no API surface for the API Evangelist network to catalog.

b.description: Besample provides access to vetted research participants across emerging markets, enabling behavioral scientists to conduct studies globally. The platform offers a searchable database of participants from Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Eastern Europe, with tools for recruitment, consent, and data collection, supporting academic and commercial research initiatives.
b.name: Besample

b.description: Beseyecloudsecuritycoltd is a cloud security company specializing in advanced threat detection and automated response solutions for enterprise environments. The firm offers a suite of APIs that enable integration of security telemetry, real‑time alerting, and policy enforcement into customers’ existing security operations platforms. Founded to address the growing need for scalable, AI‑driven security automation, Beseyecloudsecuritycoltd serves financial services, healthcare, and technology sectors worldwide.
b.name: Beseyecloudsecuritycoltd

b.description: Beside (operated by Interface, Inc. / Heart Hands, Inc.) is an AI-powered business phone system built for contractors, field teams, and small-to-medium businesses. Its AI receptionist answers inbound calls 24/7, captures caller details, qualifies and routes leads, books appointments, and produces automatic call summaries and searchable transcripts, alongside team phone management, shared inboxes, roles and permissions, unlimited US/Canada calls and texts, spam blocking, and integrations with CRMs such as HubSpot, Attio, and Follow Up Boss (plus 7,000+ apps via Zapier). Beside advertises forthcoming compatibility with MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, but publishes no public API today. Surfaced as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures.
b.name: Beside

b.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.
b.name: Besoundbreast
