b.description: Biomodal (formerly Cambridge Epigenetix) is a Cambridge, UK genomics and epigenetics company whose duet multiomics solutions capture genetic and epigenetic information from a single low-input DNA sample in one experiment, giving researchers access to the six-base genome (the four canonical bases plus 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine). Its products include the duet multiomics solution evoC and duet +modC library-prep assays, the biomodal CLI and duet post-sequencing pipeline (alignment, methylation quantification, and variant calling), and the modality XPLR analysis software. The technology is applied to cancer and liquid-biopsy research, neurodegenerative disease, aging, precision medicine, and non-invasive prenatal testing. Biomodal is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences provider profile.
b.name: Biomodal

b.description: Bionaut Labs is a clinical-stage medical robotics company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, developing "Bionauts" — remote-controlled, magnetically steered microscale robots roughly the size of a grain of rice that travel through tissue to deliver drugs, biologics and nucleic acids directly to targets deep in the brain and central nervous system. Founded in 2016 by CEO Michael Shpigelmacher, the company is pursuing treatments for malignant glioma, Dandy-Walker syndrome, Parkinson's disease and Huntington's disease, and has raised more than $80 million from investors including Khosla Ventures. Its product is a therapeutic device and navigation platform regulated as a medical device, not software sold to developers: Bionaut Labs operates no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.
b.name: Bionaut Labs

b.description: Bionexo is Latin America's largest B2B healthcare supply-chain technology platform, founded in 2000 in Sao Paulo, Brazil. It connects hospitals, clinics, laboratories, health-plan operators, distributors, suppliers and industry through an integrated cloud suite spanning e-procurement and marketplace, the Tasy hospital ERP, Clinica nas Nuvens clinic management, and the Brasindice drug-price reference, covering supply-chain, clinical and financial operations end to end. The platform serves more than 11,000 clients and roughly 90 million patients a year across Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico, running the largest healthcare B2B marketplace in the region. For system-to-system integration Bionexo exposes a partner Integration API documented via Swagger/OpenAPI and a Data Receiving API for EDI-style exchange of purchase quotations and supply-chain data between customer and supplier ERP systems and the Bionexo marketplace.
b.name: Bionexo

b.description: Bionic was the pioneer of Application Security Posture Management (ASPM), offering a platform that mapped application architecture, services, and data flows in production without requiring source-code access or repository integration, in order to eliminate vulnerability noise and prioritize business-critical risk. CrowdStrike announced its acquisition of Bionic on September 19, 2023 (estimated $350M) and folded the technology into Falcon Cloud Security as its ASPM capability. The bionic.ai domain now wildcard-redirects to CrowdStrike; Bionic no longer maintains an independent developer portal, API, or documentation surface. This profile is retained as an acquired-company lead in the API Evangelist network.
b.name: Bionic

b.description: Bionic Panda Games was a cross-platform mobile social games company founded in March 2010 by Charles Hudson (CEO) and Mike Jimenez (CTO), headquartered in San Francisco, California. The studio focused on Android-first social and casual titles, shipping Aqua Pets (a fishing and aquarium simulation that reached several million downloads and a top-100 grossing spot on Android), Vacation Slots, and PicAPic Camera. It raised seed funding from SoftTech VC, Norwest Venture Partners, Google Ventures, 500 Startups, and angel investors before ceasing operations. b.description: BioOrbit is a London-based in-space manufacturing company, founded in 2023, that uses microgravity to crystallise protein-based biologic drugs at scale. Its autonomous BOX hardware — a compact, microwave-sized manufacturing unit designed to operate in low-Earth orbit — grows highly ordered crystalline forms of therapeutic proteins that reduce viscosity, enabling treatments normally given intravenously (including cancer therapies) to be reformulated as subcutaneous, self-injectable products. Co-founded by Dr Katie King and Dr Leonor Teles, BioOrbit raised the world's largest seed round for in-space manufacturing (~£9.8M / $13.2M) co-led by LocalGlobe and Breega with Seedcamp, Auxxo, Type One, 7percent and angels, and is supported by the UK Space Agency, ESA BIC and ESA BSGN. b.description: Biosplice Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 2008 by Osman Kibar and known until its 2020 rename as Samumed, LLC (samumed.com still redirects to biosplice.com). The company develops first-in-class small-molecule therapeutics that act on novel components of the Wnt signaling pathway and on the regulation of alternative pre-mRNA splicing. Its lead program is lorecivivint, an investigational intra-articular knee injection for osteoarthritis, positioned against a stated unmet need of "over 50 million US patients suffer from osteoarthritis, with no drugs available to arrest the disease"; the candidate has completed Phase 3 study and a New Drug Application has been submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Programs outside lorecivivint — neurology, diabetes and oncology — are developed by the company's affiliate TenaRx, Inc. The company is led by Erich Horsley (Chief Executive Officer) with Osman Kibar as Founder and Executive Chairman, Yusuf Yazici as Chief Medical Officer, Phil Wilson as Chief Financial Officer and Scott W. Bulcao as Chief Legal Officer. Biosplice is a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization, not a software vendor: biosplice.com is a small ASP.NET corporate site covering mission, board, management, advisors, programs, publications, news and careers, and the company publishes no developer program of any kind — no API, no SDK, no developer portal, no GitHub organization and no machine-readable API contract.

It serves biotech startups, frontier AI labs, and healthcare data companies. The company operates a cloud data lake for AI-ready omics data and runs research partnerships across the U.S., India, and China. Birches Health partners with 18+ state governments that have legalized sports betting and 100+ national insurance plans (including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Aetna, and Blue Cross Blue Shield) so most clients pay $0-25 per session, with a core program completed in about 12 weeks. b.description: Bird is a shared electric scooter and bike micromobility operator headquartered in Miami, Florida and operating as the global anchor brand of Third Lane Mobility, Inc. Founded in 2017 by Travis VanderZanden, Bird pioneered the dockless electric scooter category in Santa Monica, California and rapidly expanded to hundreds of cities across North America, Europe, and the Middle East. After overstating revenue, delisting from the NYSE in September 2023 (ticker BRDS), and filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy in December 2023, Bird emerged in April 2024 under the new private parent company Third Lane Mobility, Inc., which also owns the Spin brand acquired from TIER in September 2023. Bird operates the Bird Three e-scooter and a Bird Bikeshare service, plus the Bird Platform white-label program for independent fleet operators and a Cities partner program that ships "in-depth APIs" and operator dashboards to municipal partners. Bird publishes public General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) auto-discovery feeds at mds.bird.co for 88+ cities across 12 countries (AT, BE, CA, CH, DE, ES, FI, FR, IL, IT, PT, US), and operates a private city-data portal at city-data.bird.co for credentialed municipal API access. There is no public consumer / 3rd-party developer API or SDK — the consumer surface is the iOS and Android Bird apps, the Bird Three product site, and the Bikeshare site. The undocumented mobile backend at api.birdapp.com / api-auth.prod.birdapp.com is well-documented in the community WoBike project but is not officially sanctioned for third-party use.

b.description: Bird Buddy (Buddy Bird Inc, backed by General Catalyst) makes the world's most recognized smart bird feeder and companion mobile app for discovering and learning about birds. An AI vision-and-sound model identifies bird species from the photos and audio captured by its camera feeders, notifies owners of feathered visitors, and organizes captures into a personal collection with postcards and monthly reports. Bird Buddy does not publish an official public API; the app is powered by a private, account- authenticated GraphQL backend hosted on AWS, which the community has reverse-engineered through the third-party pybirdbuddy Python library and a Home Assistant integration.
b.name: BirdBuddy

b.description: Birdeye is an AI-powered customer experience and reputation management platform for multi-location brands. Its REST API enables developers to manage online reviews across 200+ sites, send surveys, respond to messages, automate review requests, and track reputation metrics including ratings, sentiment trends, and NPS scores. Integrations cover listings, webchat, appointments, payments, social posting, and customer insights.
b.name: Birdeye

b.description: Birdie is a UK homecare technology platform that gives domiciliary care agencies a single unified system for care management, rostering and scheduling, finance and invoicing, quality and compliance, medication management and clinically-validated assessments, backed by dedicated apps for carers and families. Over 1,000 homecare providers use Birdie to save time, reduce mistakes and evidence care quality, with a Q-Score that predicts CQC ratings in real time. Birdie is UK-hosted and holds ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus and NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit assurances. It is backed by Index Ventures. Birdie does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures its identity, domain security and compliance posture.
b.name: Birdie

b.description: Birdleap is currently listed as a stub entry in the API Evangelist catalog, originating from a secondary-market harvest. b.description: Birdstop is an American autonomous-drone and remote-sensing company that lets organizations monitor and inspect field assets at scale without personnel onsite. Its Fealty system is an all-weather, always-on drone that launches in under three seconds, flies for up to 45 minutes, cruises at 45 mph, and patrols 24/7 across public safety, utilities, transportation, construction, and data-center sites. Birdstop pairs networked UAVs and ground stations with computer vision and a patented optical/acoustic detect-and-avoid system to enable safe beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight under some of the FAA's most advanced approvals, delivering Observation-on-Demand intel over the internet. The company is FAA-authorized, SOC 2 certified, and NDAA compliant, and builds its drones in Detroit. Backed by Techstars, Birdstop currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.
b.name: Birdstop

b.description: Biren Technology is currently listed as a stub in the API Evangelist catalog with limited publicly available information. No official corporate website or API documentation could be identified after probing likely domains such as biren.com and biren.tech, which returned unrelated legal services or were unreachable. Consequently, the company’s online presence, API offerings, and technical details remain unknown at this time.

b.description: Biren Technology (Shanghai Biren Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company that designs general-purpose GPUs (GPGPUs) for AI training, inference, and high-performance computing. Its flagship BR100-series accelerators are programmed through BIRENSUPA, a CUDA-like software platform that bundles the BRCC compiler, a hardware abstraction layer, deep-learning and general-compute acceleration libraries, and a developer toolchain with support for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and PaddlePaddle. Biren distributes its drivers, SDK, and documentation through its developer.birentech.com developer community rather than a public web/REST API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.
b.name: Biren Technology

b.description: Birentechnology, operating as BIREN Technology, is a leading Chinese provider of general-purpose intelligent computing solutions. Founded in 2019, it develops GPU-based accelerators and a software ecosystem, serving AI data centers, telecom, finance and other industries. The company went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2026 (06082.HK).
b.name: Birentechnology

With over 80 outlets and a focus on slow‑cooked, sealed‑batch preparation, the brand emphasizes quality, regional depth, and rapid delivery through partners like Swiggy and Zomato. The company has raised funding for north‑India expansion and maintains a strong online ordering presence.
b.name: Biryaniblues

b.description: Biryanibykilo is an Indian online food ordering platform specializing in biryani and related dishes. It offers customers the ability to browse menus, place orders for delivery or pickup, and track order status through its website and mobile apps. The service focuses on a wide variety of regional biryani styles, catering to diverse taste preferences across India.
b.name: Biryanibykilo

b.description: Bishop Fox is an offensive security firm delivering penetration testing, red teaming, application and cloud security assessment, and continuous threat exposure management. Its managed Cosmos platform keeps a living inventory of an organization's external attack surface — domains, subdomains, DNS records, network ranges, IP addresses, open ports, and IP/hostname services — pairing continuous automated discovery with human operator validation so customers receive triaged, exploitable findings instead of scanner noise. Customers consume Cosmos data programmatically through the authenticated Cosmos v5 REST API at api.cosmos.bishopfox.com, secured with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials tokens issued by Bishop Fox's Auth0 tenant against the cosmos_public audience, and through bi-directional Jira and ServiceNow integrations plus AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare, and Oracle cloud connectors. Bishop Fox also publishes a widely used open-source offensive-security toolkit — Sliver, CloudFox, sj (Swagger Jacker), jsluice, and aimap — from its GitHub organization.
b.name: Bishop Fox

b.description: BiSiChem is a leading biotech company focused on discovery and development of innovative therapeutic drugs in immuno‑oncology, targeted therapy, and neuro‑degenerative diseases. They partner early‑stage programs, retain profit rights, and aim for first‑in‑class or second‑generation small‑molecule drugs, emphasizing good lives, better innovation, and best therapy.
b.name: Bisichem

b.description: Bison Trails was a blockchain infrastructure company founded in 2018 by Joe Lallouz and Aaron Henshaw, offering infrastructure-as-a-service for participating in and securing proof-of-stake and other blockchain networks across dozens of protocols (staking, validators, and node infrastructure). Backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and others, it was acquired by Coinbase in January 2021 and folded into Coinbase Cloud. The bisontrails.co domain now redirects to Coinbase's cloud/node infrastructure offering at coinbase.com/cloud, and no independent developer portal, documentation, or public API surface remains under the Bison Trails brand.
b.name: Bison Trails

b.description: Bit (teambit) is the platform for the modular web — a build system and cloud for component-driven development. Bit lets teams create, version, and share reusable components as standard npm packages across projects and frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Next.js and more), with independent build, test, and CI/CD per component. Every Bit feature is API-first: an aspect-based programmatic API plus a GraphQL API power the CLI, the web UI, and Bit Cloud. Bit ships a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and a published Claude Agent Skill so AI agents can intelligently create and reuse components without duplication. Backed by Insight Partners.
b.name: Bit

b.description: BIT ODD is a Helsinki-based mobile game studio founded in 2019 by former Supercell creative leads Lasse Louhento, Taneli Oksama, and Jani Lintunen. The studio hand-crafts casual mobile games driven by feeling and a sense of wonder rather than aggressive monetization, explicitly rejecting ad-spam and dark-pattern design. Backed by Index Ventures, Griffin Gaming Partners, and Makers Fund across a EUR 5M seed and a EUR 17M round, BIT ODD is a consumer entertainment company with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead and carries only the artifacts that can be honestly probed from its public web presence (domain security, legal pages).
b.name: BIT ODD

b.description: bit.bio is a Cambridge, UK synthetic biology company founded in 2016 by stem cell biologist and neurosurgeon Mark Kotter, headquartered at the Babraham Research Campus with a second site in San Francisco and a discovery subsidiary (bit.bio discovery GmbH) in Vienna. Its proprietary opti-ox cell coding technology uses a dual genomic safe harbour approach to deterministically reprogram human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) into defined, consistent human cell types at industrial scale. The company sells these as ioCells — ioWild Type Cells, ioDisease Model Cells and CRISPR-Ready ioCells covering neurons, microglia, hepatocytes, glial and muscle lineages — plus custom iPSC-derived cell development and expert-led CRISPR functional genomics screening services for research, drug discovery and cell therapy. Products are sold as physical cell vials through a web storefront and a distributor network; bit.bio publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract.
b.name: Bit.bio

b.description: Bit.io was a serverless, shareable PostgreSQL database platform that let developers spin up cloud Postgres databases in seconds, load and query data, and share them via a link, with programmatic access over the standard Postgres wire protocol. Founded by Adam Fletcher and Jonathan Mortensen and backed by Battery Ventures, bit.io was acquired by Databricks in May 2023; the standalone product was sunset on June 29, 2023 (database exports available through July 29, 2023) and the team moved to Databricks. This profile is retained as a defunct/acquired network record — there is no live API, developer portal, documentation, or discovery surface to enrich.
b.name: Bit.io

b.description: Bitaccess is a Canadian blockchain company (Ottawa, founded 2013, Y Combinator) that builds the enterprise software and hardware powering Bitcoin ATM (BTM) operations and fintech businesses in more than 15 countries. Its stack includes the Bitaccess BTM operating software, the Cash API for cash-in and cash-out crypto transaction flows, and the Catena blockchain suite for publishing complex datasets to public or private blockchains via smart contracts. Bitaccess maintains an in-house HD/multisig enterprise wallet built for high-velocity applications and publishes first-party open-source client libraries under the npm @bitaccess scope and the github.com/bitaccess organization, led by the coinlib unified Node.js/TypeScript crypto-payments library. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital.
b.name: BitAccess

b.description: Bitacora.io is a Mexican field-data and operations platform (a 500 Global / 500 LatAm Batch 14 startup) that helps deskless teams in construction, maintenance, and field services capture reports, photos, tasks, and events from the field. Its mobile and web apps work offline and sync to the cloud when connectivity returns, turning field activity into searchable records, PDF and Excel exports, map and gallery views, and real-time analytics dashboards for managers. Bitacora is a SaaS product rather than a developer-API company - it offers custom development, integrations, and KPI dashboards as professional services, but does not publish a public self-serve API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.
b.name: Bitacora.io

b.description: Bitauto (易车, Yiche) is one of China's largest automotive internet companies, founded in 2000 with the mission of making car ownership simpler. It operates consumer-facing platforms that provide car buyers with pricing, reviews, specifications, and automotive news across new and used vehicles, alongside an enterprise EP (dealer) platform offering web-based digital marketing and CRM applications to Chinese automobile dealers. Bitauto runs regional informational portals across 20+ countries cataloging Chinese car brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; as of enrichment Bitauto publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.
b.name: Bitauto

b.description: Bitbank is a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange offering spot, margin, lending, staking, and API trading services. It provides a public API for market data and order execution, targeting both retail and institutional clients. The platform emphasizes security, instant JPY withdrawals, and a wide range of crypto assets.
b.name: bitbank

b.description: Bitbiome is a data‑focused biotechnology platform that aggregates, curates, and provides access to a wide range of biological datasets and analytical tools. It aims to accelerate research and development in life sciences by offering APIs for dataset discovery, metadata retrieval, and integration with computational pipelines. The company positions itself as a bridge between raw biological data and actionable insights for scientists, developers, and enterprises in the biotech sector.
b.name: Bitbiome

b.description: Bitbond is a Berlin-based tokenization technology company (Bitbond GmbH) that provides an Asset Tokenization Suite for issuing, managing, and distributing digital assets on public blockchains. Its two developer-facing products are Token Tool, a self-serve platform and API for deploying and managing compliant ERC-20, ERC-1400, and ERC-721 smart contracts (minting, burning, transfers, vesting, token sales, airdrops, and payment automation) across 11+ EVM and non-EVM chains; and Offering Manager, an end-to-end securities-issuance platform with a public investor REST API covering offerings, orders, payments, KYC/AML, and investor profiles. Bitbond also ships an official Token Tool MCP server so AI agents can deploy and manage tokens, plus documented webhooks, testnet faucets, and a status page.
b.name: Bitbond

b.description: Bitbrand is a digital marketplace specializing in watch faces and collectible digital art. The platform showcases a variety of themed collections, ranging from kawaii characters to collaborations with artists and brands. Users can browse, purchase, and download watch face designs for smart devices, with detailed artist profiles and licensing information provided for each collection.
b.name: Bitbrand

b.description: Bitbucket is a Git-based source code repository hosting service owned by Atlassian offering both commercial plans and free accounts with unlimited private repositories, along with CI/CD pipelines, code reviews via pull requests, and code collaboration tools for development teams.
b.name: Bitbucket

b.description: Bitbucket Pipelines is Atlassian's built-in CI/CD service for Bitbucket Cloud, with cloud-hosted and self-hosted runners and YAML-defined pipelines. Pipelines is consumed via the Bitbucket Cloud REST API v2.0 under the /pipelines/ resource family. Atlassian publishes a Swagger 2.0 specification for the full Bitbucket Cloud API.
b.name: Bitbucket Pipelines

b.description: Bitcall provides a self‑service telecom platform offering cheap international voice termination, virtual numbers, SMS OTP verification, eSIM data plans, HLR/number lookup and account balance services, all accessible via a unified API key. Users can rent numbers, send bulk SMS, obtain one‑time passcodes, and manage eSIM subscriptions through the Bitcall API gateway.
b.name: Bitcall

b.description: Bitcasa, Inc. was an American cloud storage company (founded 2011 in St. Louis, Missouri; later based in Mountain View, California) known for its converged/infinite storage model and, for developers, the CloudFS API — a white-label cloud-storage platform that let third-party applications integrate file management, secure sharing, media transcoding, instant streaming, and zero-knowledge client-side encryption. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), CrunchFund, Pelion Venture Partners, Horizons Ventures, Samsung Ventures, and First Round Capital, Bitcasa wound down its consumer Bitcasa Drive service in 2016 and shut down all services in 2017. The company is defunct and the bitcasa.com domain is now parked, so no live developer surface, API documentation, or specifications remain to enrich.
b.name: Bitcasa

b.description: Bitcliq Technologies is a Portuguese software company that develops innovative digital solutions for the transport, fisheries and agri‑food industries. Their platform enables smarter food chains through real‑time data integration, traceability, and operational management for fleets and packaging. Bitcliq offers products such as Big Eye Smart Fishing and Lota Digital, serving national and international clients with cloud‑based services.
b.name: Bitcliq

b.description: BitClout is the original social-token network that launched the DeSo (Decentralized Social) blockchain, an open, layer-1 chain purpose-built for storing social data — profiles, posts, follows, creator coins, NFTs, and messages — fully on-chain. Backed by a16z and other top venture firms, the project rebranded to DeSo and exposes everything through an API-first, permissionless developer surface: a JSON HTTP backend API served by every node (transaction construction plus read/data endpoints), the DeSo Identity Service for key management and transaction signing, a first-party TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (deso-protocol), a Rosetta API implementation for exchange integration, an open-source core node, and a hosted MCP server for agent-based development. Openfund, a fully on-chain order-book DEX, is the flagship application built on the stack.
b.name: BitClout

b.description: DeSo (Decentralized Social, formerly BitClout) is an open-source layer-1 blockchain purpose-built for storage-heavy applications such as social media, NFTs, creator coins, and on-chain financial primitives. It exposes a permissionless HTTP JSON API served by any DeSo node (the public node runs at node.deso.org/api/v0), a GraphQL endpoint, the DeSo Identity service for derived-key authentication and transaction signing, a client-side TypeScript SDK (deso-protocol), a Python SDK, a Rosetta API implementation for exchange integrations, and an official MCP server for AI-assisted development. Originally launched as the BitClout prototype and backed by Pantera Capital, the project rebranded to DeSo and now powers a broad ecosystem of decentralized social apps.
b.name: BitClout (DeSo)

b.description: Bitcoin is the original decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency and open-source protocol, first described in the 2008 whitepaper by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is not a company or a hosted commercial API; the reference implementation, Bitcoin Core, exposes a local JSON-RPC interface for node operators and application developers to query the blockchain, manage wallets, build and broadcast transactions, and interact with the peer-to-peer network. bitcoin.org and the developer documentation site at developer.bitcoin.org publish developer guides, an extensive RPC API command reference, worked examples, and reference material for building Bitcoin applications. This profile was seeded as a Ribbit Capital portfolio-sector lead and enriched from Bitcoin's public developer surface.
b.name: Bitcoin

It advocates for larger block sizes to increase transaction throughput, supports the Bitcoin Unlimited client software, and provides educational resources, forums, and tools for developers and users to engage with the Bitcoin ecosystem.

b.description: BitcoinYield publishes live crypto yields (BTC, ETH, SOL and stablecoins) from about 220 platforms, each with an A-D risk grade, refreshed every three hours. The REST API (GET /api/v1/yields, /api/v1/offers, /api/v1/prices) and a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents (https://bitcoinyield.co/api/mcp, tools list_yields and list_offers) need no key, account or sign-up.

b.name: Bitculator

b.description: BitDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) launched in 2021 to fund and govern the growth of decentralized finance and the broader on-chain economy, with decisions made by holders of the BIT governance token. BitDAO incubated Mantle Network, an Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution, and in 2023 the BIT token merged into MNT as the project rebranded to Mantle; bitdao.io now redirects to mantle.xyz. BitDAO publishes governance, tokenomics, and litepaper documentation rather than a developer REST API. Sector: crypto.
b.name: BitDAO

b.description: bitdrift builds Capture, a cost-effective dynamic mobile observability platform for iOS, Android, and React Native. A lightweight on-device SDK stores high-volume telemetry locally and uploads only what is needed under real-time control from the bitdrift control plane, avoiding lengthy mobile release cycles to change what is collected. The platform surfaces Instant Insights dashboards, Workflows for custom metrics, funnels and session-capture rules, a Session Timeline for debugging, Issues & Crashes tracking, and Alerts. It is operated through a web portal and the `bd` CLI, and exposes a public, schema-first protobuf API over gRPC, Connect, and gRPC-over-JSON at api-public.bitdrift.io. bitdrift is a developer-tools company backed by Amplify Partners.
b.name: bitdrift

b.description: Bite provides AI‑native trade compliance and HTS classification software that automates tariff lookups, screening, and post‑entry audits. It integrates with ERP, EDI, and supplier systems to monitor, analyze, and manage risk across the global trade lifecycle, offering scalable plans from single checks to enterprise workflows.
b.name: Bite

b.description: BITE Data is an AI-native trade compliance platform for global commerce, built by regulatory and national-security data veterans and backed by Techstars and Refashiond Ventures (Leesburg, Virginia). BITE helps import/export teams, brokers, and supply-chain operators monitor, analyze, and manage risk across the trade lifecycle: AI-driven HTS/ECCN classification for SKUs and BOMs, tariff and duty lookups, IEEPA/Section 301 refund analysis, ACE report auditing, restricted-party and sanctions screening, UFLPA forced-labor and beneficial-ownership checks, and continuous compliance monitoring with alerts. The platform is offered as self-service web tooling (Standard, Pro, Business) with Enterprise ERP/TMS integration via secure API feeds; there is no public developer API specification at this time.
b.name: BITE Data

b.description: Bite Squad is a startup that provides a platform for ordering and delivering meals from local restaurants. The company aims to simplify the food ordering experience through an API that enables developers to integrate menu browsing, order placement, and delivery tracking into their applications. While detailed public information is limited, Bite Squad positions itself as a modern solution for on‑demand food services, targeting both consumers and partner restaurants seeking streamlined digital ordering capabilities.
b.name: Bite Squad

b.description: Bitfinder, Inc., doing business as Awair, builds indoor air quality (IAQ) monitors and a cloud platform used across homes, offices, schools, and commercial spaces. Its devices (Awair Element, Awair Omni, and 2nd Edition) measure the Awair Score along with temperature, humidity, CO2, chemicals (VOC), and fine dust (PM2.5). The Awair Home & OAuth Developer API lets developers, partners, and hobbyists read a user's registered devices and their air-data time series (latest, raw per-second, 5-minute-average, and 15-minute-average) on behalf of Awair users, authorized with an OAuth 2.0 or Developer Console Bearer token. Bitfinder was a Techstars portfolio company.
b.name: Bitfinder

b.description: bitFlyer is a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange. Its bitFlyer Lightning trading platform exposes a public and private HTTP API at api.bitflyer.com for market data, account assets, deposits and withdrawals, and order placement.
b.name: bitFlyer

b.description: Bitfount is a full-stack federated AI and data science platform that lets organisations train, fine-tune, evaluate, and run inference on sensitive data without moving it. Instead of centralising data, Bitfount "sends the AI model to the data" — datasets stay behind the owner's firewall on their own infrastructure at all times, protected by built-in privacy-enhancing technologies (differential privacy, private set intersection). Developers work through the open-source Bitfount Python SDK (typed wrappers around the Bitfount REST API on hub.bitfount.com), a no-code desktop app, or a Docker pod image. Typical use cases include federated learning, federated evaluation, clinical trials, biomedical research, trusted research environments, and cross-party data partnerships. Backed by speedinvest.
b.name: Bitfount

b.description: Bitfury Group is a blockchain technology company founded in 2011 as one of the earliest Bitcoin mining hardware makers and full-cycle infrastructure providers, and now operating as a technology incubator headquartered in London with data-center and hardware operations behind Bitcoin transaction processing. Its developer-facing surface is Exonum, the open-source (Apache-2.0) framework Bitfury Group Limited built for private and permissioned blockchain applications: an Exonum node exposes REST and WebSocket endpoints through its explorer service, system API plugin, supervisor and time-oracle services, and ships light clients for JavaScript, Python and Java plus a Rust crate family, a node CLI and published Protobuf message definitions. Bitfury also anchors permissioned chains into the Bitcoin blockchain and incubates Cipher Mining, Crystal, LiquidStack and Axelera AI.
b.name: BitFury

b.description: Bitfusion (Bitfusion.io) was a GPU virtualization startup whose FlexDirect software pooled and disaggregated GPUs across a network so machine learning and AI workloads could share accelerator hardware on demand. VMware acquired Bitfusion in August 2019 and folded the technology into vSphere as "vSphere Bitfusion." VMware/Broadcom later declared End of Availability for vSphere Bitfusion effective May 2023, with end of maintenance in May 2025. The independent company no longer operates and the bitfusion.io domain no longer resolves; there is no independent, active public API surface remaining for this provider.
b.name: Bitfusion

b.description: Bitfusion (bitfusion.io) was an Austin, Texas startup, backed by DCVC, that built "elastic AI" infrastructure software. Its FlexDirect platform was a transparent GPU/CPU virtualization layer that pooled network-attached accelerators (GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs) across TCP, RoCE, and InfiniBand into a single elastic compute cluster for sharing, scaling, and management of AI/ML workloads. VMware acquired Bitfusion in 2019 and folded FlexDirect into vSphere as vSphere Bitfusion (subsequently end-of-lifed). The independent company no longer operates, the bitfusion.io domain no longer resolves, and it exposes no public API, developer portal, or discoverable artifacts. Retained here as a DCVC portfolio record; defunct as an enrichment lead.
b.name: Bitfusion Io

b.description: Bitget is a cryptocurrency exchange and copy trading platform offering REST and WebSocket APIs for spot trading, futures (USDT-M, USDC-M, and Coin-M perpetual contracts), margin trading, copy trading, broker services, and earn products. Developers can access real-time market data, execute trades, manage accounts and sub-accounts, and integrate copy trading leader and follower workflows.
b.name: Bitget
