c.description: Crossref is a non-profit organization that provides digital infrastructure for scholarly communications. Best known for Digital Object Identifier (DOI) registration, Crossref also operates a public REST API offering searchable, filterable access to metadata for tens of millions of scholarly works, journals, members, funders, prefixes, types, licenses, and DOI registration agency information. The Crossref REST API supports free-form queries, field queries, filters, facets, deep-paging cursors, and selection of specific elements, and is used by reference managers, repositories, discovery layers, and analytics platforms.
c.name: Crossref

c.description: Books & Articles Metadata
c.name: Crossref Metadata Search

c.description: Crow is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company building an AI infrastructure platform that makes any web or mobile application AI-native. Instead of a simple chatbot, Crow embeds an agent that connects to a product's own APIs and MCP servers, executes workflows, navigates users between pages, and calls server-side and client-side tools from natural-language commands. Developers add Crow with a single script tag or the React SDK, point it at a REST API via OpenAPI or at an MCP server, and configure the agent in a sandbox. Crow also ships the Envoy CLI, which reads a backend codebase and auto-generates and deploys an MCP server, plus a headless client and React UI component library (Widget and Copilot). Crow is initially positioned for commercial real estate but the platform applies to any software product.
c.name: Crow

c.description: Crowd.dev is an open-source developer data platform that centralizes community, product, and commercial data to unify contributor identities, resolve who is engaging with an open-source project, and activate that data for developer relations and community-led growth. Founded in Berlin and backed by Seedcamp, crowd.dev was acquired by the Linux Foundation in April 2024 and now powers the LFX Community Data Platform (CDP). The codebase is Apache-2.0 open source at github.com/CrowdDotDev (now linuxfoundation/crowd.dev), and the CDP Public API exposes transactional REST endpoints for member and organization profiles, identity verification, work-experience and project-affiliation management, contributor affiliation lookups, and open-source package/stewardship intelligence.
c.name: Crowd.dev

c.description: CrowdAI is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of threshold-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
c.name: CrowdAI

c.description: Crowdamp is a privately held Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company co-founded by Ruben Mayer-Hirshfeld and Alexandra Botez. The company built SuperFan, a creator-economy messaging product that let fans text their favorite social media stars and receive a personalized reply, using natural language processing to help those creators respond efficiently at scale across their whole audience. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass Crowdamp publishes no developer surface of any kind: there is no developer portal, no documentation, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, no SDK packages in any public registry, and no working product website. The SuperFan domain superfanapp.com no longer resolves to the product and is listed for sale through a domain reseller, indicating the product is no longer operating. This profile is retained as a portfolio-graph record rather than as an API provider.
c.name: Crowdamp

c.description: CrowdAnalytix (CAX) is a crowdsourced data science and predictive analytics platform that connects enterprises with a global community of data scientists to build, test, and compare machine learning models through hosted modeling competitions. The company runs prediction and classification contests across industries such as consumer packaged goods, retail, banking, insurance, and healthcare, and has extended into AI/ML model development, data annotation and labeling, and packaged AI solutions. Headquartered in Frisco, Texas with operations in Bangalore, India, CrowdAnalytix is backed by Accel.
c.name: CrowdAnalytix

c.description: Crowdbotics, now operating as CoreStory, provides an AI‑powered platform that modernizes and maintains software applications. It offers tools for code analysis, automated refactoring, and full‑stack development, helping enterprises accelerate digital transformation while reducing technical debt.
c.name: Crowdbotics

c.description: Crowdboticsinc, now operating as CoreStory, provides an AI‑powered platform that modernizes and maintains software applications. Their services include code generation, automated testing, and continuous deployment, aimed at accelerating development cycles for enterprises. The company emphasizes a mission to radically transform the software development lifecycle through AI, offering resources such as documentation, blogs, events, and support to help users adopt their platform.
c.name: Crowdboticsinc

c.description: Crowdbureau is an information technology platform that offers asset and risk management tools for the peer‑to‑peer lending and securities crowdfunding industry. It collects, consolidates and unifies data from more than 90 platforms across North America, Europe, and Asia, covering about 80 % of the market. Products include investment research, data analytics, and asset and risk management solutions, helping investors and companies navigate the crowdfunding ecosystem.
c.name: Crowdbureau

c.description: Crowdcast2 is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
c.name: Crowdcast2

c.description: Crowdcomputingsystems is a stub entry harvested from secondary‑market sources. Extensive web searches, including queries on Google, DuckDuckGo, and direct attempts to locate a corporate website or API documentation, returned only references to a university research group (crowdcomputing.net) and unrelated business listings. No verifiable corporate domain, official documentation, or API endpoints could be identified. The entry therefore records the company name and minimal metadata while noting the lack of discoverable technical resources.
c.name: Crowdcomputingsystems

c.description: Crowdcube is a UK-based equity crowdfunding platform that lets everyday and professional investors buy shares in early-stage and growth-stage private companies, and lets founders raise capital directly from their community and the wider crowd. Founded in 2011 in Exeter by Darren Westlake and Luke Lang, it is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and has helped hundreds of startups and scale-ups raise funding from a large base of retail investors. The platform covers pitch discovery, investment processing, share issuance, nominee shareholding, and a secondary-market cashout facility. Crowdcube surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity and observable domain-security posture.
c.name: crowdcube

c.description: Crowdery was a consumer retail and e-commerce startup backed by a16z, listed on the a16z investment list. Its product inverted the traditional retail sales model: shoppers voted on product designs from a curated set, Crowdery assembled a personalized marketplace from each shopper's top picks, and the highest-voted products were opened for pre-order at a discount. For brands it offered consumer feedback loops, pre-production demographic analytics, and pre-orders intended to de-risk manufacturing runs. The company never shipped a public API or developer program. As of July 2026 Crowdery appears defunct: the apex domain crowdery.com serves a Doteasy hosting placeholder page, www.crowdery.com still delegates to a decommissioned Heroku prelaunch application that returns 404, and no developer portal, documentation, GitHub organization, or API surface could be found. This profile is retained as a historical a16z portfolio record with no API surface to enrich.
c.name: Crowdery

c.description: Crowdflower, now operating as CrowdGen under Appen, provides a platform connecting expert contributors with AI companies for data labeling, annotation, and specialized knowledge work. The service offers high‑pay freelance opportunities across domains such as accounting, healthcare, and finance, leveraging a global network of over 500,000 contributors. It supports AI model training, data quality assurance, and domain‑specific expertise for enterprise clients.
c.name: Crowdflower

c.description: CrowdForce was a Nigerian fintech that operated the PayForce agent-banking network, deploying point-of-sale and digital financial-services agents to extend cash-in/cash-out, bill payments, and banking access to underbanked communities across Nigeria. Backed by 500 Global, its PayForce merchant/agent business merged with FairMoney's Fusion in 2023. As of this enrichment pass the crowdforce.io domain no longer serves an active product or developer surface. The homepage renders an empty Cloudflare-fronted shell and the /payforce path returns unrelated third-party (gambling) spam content, so no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation could be verified.
c.name: CrowdForce

c.description: CrowdGather was an online forum and message-board network operator, surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. The company is defunct — crowdgather.com no longer serves a product and resolves to a GoDaddy parking lander, and no developer portal, documentation, API, or specification survives on any host. This profile is retained as a verified-negative record so future enrichment runs do not re-probe it from scratch.
c.name: CrowdGather

c.description: CrowdHealth is an Austin, Texas company offering community-powered health care crowdfunding as an alternative to traditional health insurance. Members pay a monthly membership (advocacy) fee and commit a monthly contribution amount that is used to fund other members' eligible medical bills peer-to-peer, without premiums, networks, or claim denials. The platform bundles bill negotiation, personal care advocates, provider search, prescription discounts and care navigation into a consumer web app and iOS/Android mobile apps. CrowdHealth is a consumer product company: it operates a private Apollo GraphQL backend at api.joincrowdhealth.com that serves its own apps, but publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind.
c.name: CrowdHealth

c.description: Crowdin is a localization management platform for software, mobile, games, and documentation. It offers a REST API v2 covering projects, files, strings, translations, screenshots, glossaries, MT engines, and webhooks, plus a single GraphQL endpoint. Authentication uses Personal Access Tokens or OAuth 2. Official client libraries are published for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, .NET, Java, and Ruby. Crowdin Enterprise customers get a per-tenant domain (e.g. https://{domain}.api.crowdin.com).
c.name: Crowdin

c.description: CrowdMade partners with online creators from YouTube, Instagram, Snapchat and beyond to design, produce, warehouse, and ship official merchandise their fans are proud to wear. The public storefront at crowdmade.com runs on Shopify and, as of 2026, exposes a machine- and agent-facing commerce surface: a published Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP shopping endpoint, Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth discovery documents, an llms.txt, and an agents.md describing how AI shopping agents can search the catalog, build a cart, and complete a buyer-approved checkout. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled into the API Evangelist network.
c.name: CrowdMade

c.description: CrowdMob was a mobile gaming and app-monetization startup surfaced as an a16z portfolio company. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-20 found no operating API surface: the company no longer appears in the a16z portfolio listing, and the crowdmob.com domain is now operated by an unrelated affiliate-marketing publisher (AffiliateBay) as a WordPress "growth marketing agency" landing page. No developer portal, documentation, API reference, specs, SDKs, packages, or /.well-known/ discovery documents exist. Retained as a historical/defunct record rather than an active API provider.
c.name: CrowdMob

c.description: CrowdPlat, Inc. is a Pleasanton, California company (backed by 500 Global) that operates two platforms combining human expertise with AI. Its crowdsourcing marketplace connects enterprises with vetted specialists across 50+ countries for consulting, software development, R&D, and innovation challenges, delivered with US-based project management and milestone-driven scopes. Its AI Hire platform is recruitment technology that automates candidate evaluation through resume scoring, AI-generated screening questions, video interviews, and LinkedIn job promotion with auto-targeted outreach. Customers include federal agencies and enterprises such as Airbus, PayPal, and EPRI. No public developer/API program is published at this time.
c.name: Crowdplat

c.description: CrowdRise was an online fundraising platform for charities, nonprofits, and personal causes, founded around 2010 by Edward Norton and Robert Wolfe. It let individuals, event participants, and organizations create fundraising pages, run peer-to-peer campaigns, and collect donations for good. CrowdRise was acquired by GoFundMe in 2017 and subsequently merged into the GoFundMe platform; the crowdrise.com domain now 301-redirects to gofundme.com/c/crowdrise. This profile originated as a Union Square Ventures portfolio lead; no independent developer portal, documented API, SDKs, or discovery surface remains, so the record is retained for provenance only.
c.name: CrowdRise

c.description: CrowdSec provides curated threat intelligence and a collaborative security platform that leverages community‑driven data to block malicious IPs, detect attacks, and automate response. Their solutions include open‑source agents, a SaaS console, and integrations for developers and enterprises, aiming to reduce the time to block threats from days to minutes. The company emphasizes AI‑driven analytics, open‑source contributions, and a marketplace of security tools.
c.name: Crowdsec

c.description: CrowdSmart Labs provides a trust layer for human and AI collective intelligence, offering products such as Collective Reasoning Foresight, Knowledge Agent, and Collective IQ. The platform enables organizations to build auditable, transparent AI reasoning with confidence scores, provenance, and a full audit trail, addressing governance challenges of AI deployment.
c.name: CrowdSmart

c.description: Crowd Street (formerly CrowdStreet) is an online private-markets investing platform that gives accredited investors direct access to commercial real estate, private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real estate fund offerings. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, the company operates a marketplace where sponsors raise capital and members subscribe to individual deals, diversified funds, and managed portfolios, alongside an education center, glossary, and research library. Crowd Street Capital LLC is a FINRA-member broker-dealer and Crowd Street Advisors LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser. The platform is delivered as a members-only investor web application; as of this profile Crowd Street publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.
c.name: CrowdStreet

c.description: CrowdStrike is a US cybersecurity company and Fortune 1000 constituent whose Falcon platform delivers endpoint, cloud, identity and data protection from a single cloud-native agent. Its developer surface is substantial and public: a 1,463-operation OAuth2 REST API spanning 128 service collections, documented operation by operation on developer.crowdstrike.com, with 187 named permission scopes; six official SDKs (Python, PowerShell, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Ruby); a Terraform provider for Configuration as Code; Falcon Foundry, an app platform with its own CLI; a first-party open-source MCP server (falcon-mcp) exposing 166 agent tools across 28 modules; and a published set of Agent Skills for building Foundry apps. CrowdStrike does not publish an OpenAPI document, and API access requires a Falcon subscription — the API itself is included in every paid bundle.
c.name: CrowdStrike

c.description: Crowdtap is a consumer rewards platform that offers users the ability to earn points by answering surveys, sharing opinions, and completing offers. Users can redeem points for gift cards, product samples, and other rewards. The service operates via a web portal and mobile apps, targeting a broad audience seeking to monetize their feedback. Crowdtap partners with brands to gather market research, providing a marketplace for consumer insights.
c.name: Crowdtap

c.description: CrowdTwist is a customer loyalty and engagement platform founded in New York City in 2009 and accelerated through Techstars. It lets consumer brands build multi-channel loyalty programs that reward customers for purchases, social sharing, referrals, and other engagement across web, mobile, email, and social channels, with points redeemable for rewards. CrowdTwist exposed a REST API for managing members, tracking earning and redemption activities, and administering points, tiers, and campaigns. Oracle acquired CrowdTwist in March 2019 and folded it into Oracle CX Marketing as Oracle CrowdTwist Loyalty and Engagement; the standalone crowdtwist.com site now redirects to Oracle and the developer documentation is hosted on Oracle Help Center.
c.name: CrowdTwist

c.description: CrowdWisdom Signals API provides REST access to crowd‑consensus trade setups generated by thousands of professional traders. The platform delivers machine‑readable signals for fintech applications, trading terminals, and quantitative research, enabling developers to integrate curated trade ideas, performance metrics, and risk assessments directly into their products. It offers tiered pricing, API keys with bearer authentication, and comprehensive documentation for rapid onboarding.
c.name: CrowdWisdom Signals API

c.description: Crowdwise is an online education and community platform focused on equity crowdfunding. It offers courses, eBooks, videos, blog posts, and tools to help investors understand and participate in startup investing. The site provides a collaborative environment with resources such as portfolio trackers, ROI calculators, and a members‑only forum, aiming to empower both novice and experienced investors in the equity crowdfunding space.
c.name: Crowdwise

c.description: Crown Castle is a leading United States provider of shared communications infrastructure including cell towers, small cells, and fiber. Crown Castle owns and operates more than 40,000 cell towers and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber, supporting wireless carriers, enterprises, and government customers with managed connectivity, dark fiber, optical encryption, ultra-low-latency transport, and managed SD-WAN services. Crown Castle does not currently publish a public developer API program; technical integrations are handled through customer and channel partner agreements.
c.name: Crown Castle

c.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.
c.name: Crown Holdings

c.description: Fortune 1000 company Crown Holdings. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.
c.name: Crown Holdings

c.description: Crownaffair is a stub company identified during the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. It currently lacks a public website or documented API endpoints. The profile serves as a placeholder for future enrichment when more information becomes available, ensuring the company is tracked within the network for potential later discovery and analysis.
c.name: Crownaffair

c.description: Crown Bioscience (CrownBio) is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in translational oncology and immuno-oncology drug discovery. It provides preclinical and translational services to biotech and pharmaceutical companies, including in vitro drug screening (cell lines, organoids, panels), in vivo studies (PDX, CDX, syngeneic and humanized models), DMPK/toxicology, preclinical imaging, and biomarker analysis spanning genomics (NGS, single-cell sequencing), proteomics, spatial biology, and flow cytometry. CrownBio also operates public web-browsable cancer-model databases — a PDX Model Database (2,500+ models), an Organoid Models Database (600+ models), an IO Murine Models Database, and a Cell Line / CDX Database — searchable through a Multi-Model Search interface. There is no public developer API or programmatic data access; the databases are web interfaces. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.
c.name: crownbio

c.description: CrownIT (Crownit.in) is India's online market-research and consumer-insights platform, now acquired by Ipsos, the world's leading market research company. Operating as a full-stack agency, Crownit conducts online surveys and tracks purchase and consumption behavior via shopping bills and product photos submitted through its mobile app, applying machine learning and big-data analytics to deliver fast, accurate and comprehensive consumer insights to over 200 brands and enterprises across 40+ Indian cities. Backed by Accel and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile; Crownit runs a consumer rewards and survey application rather than a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only and has no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API artifacts.
c.name: CrownIT

c.description: Crowntechphotonics is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
c.name: Crowntechphotonics

c.description: Crozdesk helps businesses find and compare software across all major software categories. The platform indexes 43,000+ products across 377+ categories with expert reviews, user ratings, and AI-powered recommendations to guide software purchasing decisions. Vendors can list and advertise their products through the SoftwareSelect vendor portal.
c.name: Crozdesk

c.description: Croívalve is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
c.name: Croívalve

c.description: CRS Credit API delivers credit data-as-a-service for fast, compliant financial decisioning. The platform aggregates consumer and business credit, identity, fraud, and public records data from major bureaus (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion, LexisNexis, CIC, PitchPoint) through a single contract and developer interface.
c.name: CRS Credit API

c.description: CRU Kafe is a London-founded organic coffee brand selling Fairtrade, ethically sourced coffee - including award-winning Nespresso-compatible pods from 33p per pod, plus ground coffee and beans - direct to consumers through its Shopify storefront at crukafe.com. Backed by Seedcamp, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. CRU Kafe publishes no first-party developer API; its machine-readable surface is the Shopify / Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) agent-commerce layer served on its own domain: a hosted UCP MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search and buyer-approved checkout, an llms.txt / agents.md for AI shopping assistants, and Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity.
c.name: CRU Kafe

c.description: Cruciblerisk is a data‑risk analytics firm that provides AI‑driven risk assessment tools for financial institutions and enterprises. It offers APIs for risk scoring, portfolio analysis, and compliance monitoring, targeting banks, insurers, and fintechs. The company focuses on integrating machine‑learning models with regulatory frameworks to help clients mitigate credit, operational, and cyber‑risk.
c.name: Cruciblerisk

c.description: Cruise was an autonomous-vehicle (robotaxi) company founded in 2013 and majority-owned by General Motors, building self-driving technology and operating driverless ride-hail services in San Francisco and other U.S. cities. Backed by GM, Honda, SoftBank Vision Fund, Spark Capital, Y Combinator and others, Cruise suspended operations after a 2023 incident and, in December 2024, GM announced it would end robotaxi development and fold the Cruise team into GM's own autonomous and driver-assistance programs. As of 2026 the getcruise.com domain 301-redirects to GM's autonomous-driving pages. Cruise never published a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.
c.name: Cruise

c.description: Cruise Technologies was a wireless thin-client computing company founded in 1997 and based in Arlington Heights, Illinois. It developed the CruiseConnect platform, which enabled server-class and wireless thin-client computing delivered through OEM and licensing partners worldwide. The company raised roughly $12M from Battery Ventures and Bessemer Venture Partners, was acquired in 1999, and has since ceased operations. It was surfaced as a historical entry on the Battery Ventures list-of-all-companies roster and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Enrichment confirmed the company is defunct: it has no live website, no developer portal, no documentation, and no API surface of any kind. The former cruisetechnologies.com domain is a parked HugeDomains for-sale listing, not a company property. This profile is retained as a historical record only and requires no further enrichment.
c.name: Cruise Technologies

c.description: Cruisebound is a startup focused on providing innovative travel solutions that integrate cruise booking, itinerary planning, and personalized travel experiences. The company aims to simplify the cruise selection process through a user-friendly platform, leveraging APIs to connect travelers with cruise lines, ports, and ancillary services. While still in early stages, Cruisebound is building its digital infrastructure to offer developers access to travel data and booking capabilities, positioning itself as a future player in the maritime tourism ecosystem.
c.name: Cruisebound

c.description: Crunchbase is a leading source of private and public company, funding, and investor data - firmographics, funding rounds, acquisitions, investors, people, events, and AI-generated predictions and insights across the global startup and business landscape. The Crunchbase Data API (REST v4, base https://api.crunchbase.com/v4/data) exposes this graph programmatically through Entity Lookup, Search, Autocomplete, and Deleted Entities across 43 entity collections, and is published as six package-scoped OpenAPI 3.0.1 documents - Firmographic, Core Financials, Advanced Financials, Insights, Predictions, and Predictions & Insights - discoverable through an RFC 9727 api-catalog at data.crunchbase.com. Crunchbase also ships a first-party remote MCP server at mcp.crunchbase.com over Streamable HTTP with fourteen documented tools, authenticated with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE and sold as per-user MCP seats. The REST API is read-only and authenticated with a single account-level API key (user_key query parameter or X-cb-user-key header); which of the six packages that key is provisioned against determines which operations it can call. Access is subscription-gated with no published pricing - the full API requires a Crunchbase Enterprise or Applications licence, with a reduced Basic API for Crunchbase Basic plan holders.
c.name: Crunchbase

c.description: CrunchDAO is a collective-intelligence platform that crowdsources machine-learning models from a global community of data scientists and PhDs to solve forecasting, classification, anomaly-detection and causal-discovery problems across finance, crypto and life sciences. Participants join real-time and structured competitions (Numinous, Falcon, Synth, DataCrunch, ADIA Lab, Broad Institute) on Crunch Hub, submit models with the official crunch-cli, and earn rewards. The Tournament API (api.hub.crunchdao.com) exposes competitions, rounds, phases, leaderboards, projects, submissions and predictions as a versioned REST API secured with API keys and bearer access tokens.
c.name: CrunchDAO

c.description: Crunched is an AI Excel analyst for power users in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, and corporate finance. Working as a native Microsoft Excel add-in (Mac and PC) and a companion PowerPoint deck reviewer, it builds fully linked financial models (DCFs, LBOs, cohort and scenario analyses) from plain-English instructions, error-checks entire workbooks, extracts and structures data from PDFs and web sources, formats spreadsheets, and generates client-ready slides with full workbook context. Every edit is tracked with a full audit trail and cited sources. Founded by Philip Borge and Michael Sakowski (ex-McKinsey private equity), Crunched is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and is backed by Y Combinator, First Round Capital, and 20VC. It is distributed through the Microsoft AppSource marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API.
c.name: Crunched

c.description: Crunchtime (CrunchTime! Information Systems) is an AI-powered restaurant operations management platform used by 850+ multi-unit restaurant brands across 150,000+ locations to run inventory and food-cost control, labor and scheduling, operations execution (tasks, audits, temperature and food-prep labeling), kitchen display (KDS), guest/host-stand management, learning & development, and operational intelligence (Crunchtime Insights and Data Streaming). For integrators, Crunchtime publishes the Inventory & Labor developer hub — a REST/JSON API of 150+ operations (employees, locations, budgets, recipes, purchase orders, inventory counts, schedules, sales/menu-mix and more) served from the net-chef.com web services, authenticated with per-environment API tokens plus a site name and application user. The company merged with QSR Automations to cover the full restaurant food lifecycle and is a Battery Ventures portfolio company.
c.name: Crunchtime

c.description: Crunchtime (Crunchtime Information Systems) is a Boston-based provider of AI-powered operations-management software for multi-unit restaurants, founded in 1995 and serving 850+ restaurant brands across 150,000+ locations. Its platform unifies inventory management, labor scheduling, kitchen/operations execution, and analytics. Crunchtime publishes a public developer hub for its Inventory & Labor and Cruise data-integration REST APIs, letting partners and customers push and pull employees, locations, budgets, products, recipes, sales/menu mix, purchase orders, inventory counts, time clock, and forecasting data. Backed by Battery Ventures.
c.name: Crunchtime Information Systems

c.description: Crunchy Data is a PostgreSQL company offering Crunchy Bridge, a fully managed cloud Postgres service on AWS, Azure and GCP, Crunchy Postgres for Kubernetes (the PGO operator), Crunchy Data Warehouse and supported Postgres distributions. Crunchy Bridge exposes a REST platform API at api.crunchybridge.com for managing clusters, networks, teams, backups, replicas and roles. Crunchy Data was acquired by Snowflake in 2025; crunchydata.com still serves its own site, while its privacy and Bridge terms links now point to snowflake.com.
c.name: Crunchy Data

c.description: Crusoe is a vertically integrated "AI factory" company that designs, builds, and operates energy-first AI infrastructure, and sells it as Crusoe Cloud — a GPU cloud for training, fine-tuning, and inference. The public developer surface is the Crusoe Cloud API Gateway, a REST API at api.cloud.crusoe.ai covering virtual machines, instance groups and templates, block storage disks and snapshots, S3-compatible object storage, custom images, a container registry, VPC networking and load balancers, InfiniBand partitions and NVLink domains, Crusoe Managed Kubernetes and Slurm clusters, capacity reservations, IAM role bindings, SCIM/SSO, quotas, audit logs, usage and billing. Alongside it, the Intelligence Foundry exposes an OpenAI-compatible Managed Inference API for serverless inference, serverless fine-tuning, and self-serve deployments of open models. Crusoe also ships a first-party CLI, a Terraform provider, a Go API client, and a read-only Crusoe Cloud MCP server for AI assistants. Founded 2018, headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
c.name: Crusoe

c.description: Crusoe Energy Systems provides next‑gen AI‑optimized cloud infrastructure powered by clean, stranded energy. The company builds vertically integrated data centers that combine renewable power generation with high‑performance GPU compute, delivering scalable AI workloads with lower cost and carbon footprint. Founded in 2018, Crusoe serves enterprises seeking sustainable, high‑throughput AI compute across its global edge zones.
c.name: Crusoeenergysystems

c.description: Hosted API delivering structured Google (Search/Maps/etc.) and public LinkedIn data as JSON for developers, data teams, and AI agents. Pay-per-successful-result billing with an OpenAPI spec, an llms.txt, an x402 agent-payment endpoint, and a local MCP server.
c.name: CrustAPI

c.description: Crux is a capital platform for the clean economy, connecting clean energy and manufacturing developers with buyers, lenders, and investors. Its marketplace facilitates the sale of transferable clean energy tax credits created under the Inflation Reduction Act, alongside debt capital markets, tax equity, and preferred equity solutions and advisory services. Crux pairs a transaction platform and secure data room with market intelligence drawn from tens of billions of dollars in deal data, serving project developers, manufacturers, tax credit buyers, banks, tax advisors, and legal teams. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Crux operates a customer application but does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time.
c.name: Crux

c.description: CruxOCM builds AI-powered automation software for industrial control-room operations in the energy-infrastructure sector. Its Industrial Automation Hub (IAH) delivers closed-loop automation on top of existing SCADA and DCS systems to increase pipeline throughput, cut operating and energy costs, and improve safety without replacing installed control infrastructure. The product family includes pipeBOT, gatherBOT, draBOT, maxOPT, leanOPT, and powerOPT, supported by a Deployment Manager, Log Analyser, and real-time Status Dashboard. Founded by control-room engineers and operators (CEO Vicki Knott, co-founder Roger Shirt) and headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, the company raised a $17M Series A led by Microsoft's M12 and serves midstream operators including ONEOK, Delek US, Enbridge, HF Sinclair, and Alliance Pipeline. c.description: Cubbit is a European cloud storage provider offering DS3, a sovereign, geo-distributed, S3-compatible object storage platform. The storage plane exposes an AWS S3-compatible API at https://s3.cubbit.eu (region eu-west-1), authenticated with access key / secret key and AWS Signature Version 4, so existing S3 SDKs, the AWS CLI, rclone, Cyberduck, Veeam and other S3 tooling work unchanged. c.description: Cubist builds hardware-backed key management and embedded wallet infrastructure for Web3. Its flagship product, CubeSigner, generates and seals cryptographic keys inside FIPS 140 HSMs running in AWS Nitro Enclaves and enforces transaction approvals with a programmable Policy-as-Code engine. The CubeSigner REST API spans organizations, users, roles, keys, policies, contacts, sessions, and multi-factor approvals, plus multi-chain signing for EVM (Ethereum, Avalanche), Bitcoin/Taproot, Solana, Sui, Tendermint, Ethereum validators (eth2), and Babylon Bitcoin staking. Authentication is a two-stage OIDC-to-session-token exchange with least-privilege scopes and step-up MFA. Cubist is backed by Amplify Partners and Polychain and is SOC 2 compliant.
c.name: Cubist

c.description: Cubixel is a technology company identified in the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. It currently lacks a public-facing website or documented API endpoints. No official documentation, developer portal, or API specifications were found after probing common domains and search engine results. The company appears to be a stub entry pending further information.
c.name: Cubixel

c.description: CuboAi provides AI‑enhanced baby monitoring solutions that combine high‑resolution video, real‑time safety alerts, sleep tracking, health monitoring, and memory capture. Their smart monitor and sensor pad use computer‑vision and motion detection to notify parents of potential hazards, breathing irregularities, and sleep patterns, while a companion app stores moments and health data securely. The company emphasizes proactive safety, privacy, and seamless integration across devices, targeting modern families seeking peace of mind through advanced technology.
c.name: Cuboai

c.description: Cuboh is a restaurant online-ordering management platform that consolidates third-party delivery and pickup orders (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and more) onto a single tablet and into the restaurant POS. For technology partners, Cuboh exposes partner-gated Direct and Connect integration APIs covering orders, menus, merchant locations, and webhooks. API access is provisioned by Cuboh during a partner onboarding and QA-certification process; there is no public self-serve signup.
c.name: Cuboh

c.description: Cuby Technologies, Inc. develops scalable hardware and software systems to improve process efficiency and automation in new home construction through its Mobile Micro‑Factories (MMF) platform. By deploying transportable, precision‑manufactured factories near construction sites, Cuby aims to deliver high‑quality, factory‑built homes faster, more affordably, and with reduced waste, addressing global housing deficits. The company offers an end‑to‑end platform that integrates design, manufacturing, logistics, and on‑site assembly, targeting developers, builders, and municipalities seeking rapid, sustainable housing solutions.
c.name: Cuby Technologies

c.description: Cubyn is a Paris‑based logistics platform founded in 2014 that provides e‑commerce merchants with end‑to‑end fulfillment services, including parcel delivery, B2B shipments, freight, custom packaging, and reverse logistics. Their cloud‑based solution integrates with major marketplaces and shop platforms such as Shopify and Prestashop, offering real‑time inventory and order tracking. Cubyn ceased operations in 2024, but its former services aimed to give online retailers a high‑performance network for fast, cost‑effective deliveries worldwide.
c.name: Cubyn

c.description: Cucumber is an open-source Behavior Driven Development (BDD) tool for running automated tests written in plain language using the Gherkin syntax. It enables collaboration between technical and non-technical team members by expressing executable specifications as Given/When/Then scenarios. Cucumber has implementations for many languages (JVM, JavaScript, Ruby, .NET, Python, Go, Rust) and a shared message protocol that connects parsers, runners, and reporters.
c.name: Cucumber

c.description: Cucumbertown was a recipe network and food-blogging platform ("a Tumblr for recipes") founded around 2011-2012 in Palo Alto, California by Cherian Thomas, Chris Luscher, Arun Prabhakar and Dan Hauk, and backed by 500 Startups (now 500 Global) among other angel investors. It let home cooks and food bloggers publish, structure, and share recipes on a hosted network. Cucumbertown was acquired by the Japanese recipe network Cookpad in June 2015 and was fully shut down by March 31, 2017 for lack of a sustainable business model. The company is defunct and operates no public API or developer program. The cucumbertown.com domain now 302-redirects to Samsung Food (app.samsungfood.com, formerly Whisk), an unrelated successor product; none of the artifacts served on that host belong to Cucumbertown.
c.name: CucumberTown

c.description: CUDDLY is a crowdfunding platform dedicated to animal welfare, enabling shelters and rescues to raise funds for supplies, medical care, and adoption support. The site offers wish‑list donations, a shop for pet products, and a community hub for donors, while providing transparent tracking of contributions and impact.
c.name: CUDDLY

c.description: CUDO Compute is a global GPU and cloud compute platform and marketplace that provisions on-demand and reserved virtual machines, bare metal, and multi-node GPU clusters across a distributed network of data centers. Its versioned, resource-oriented REST API (with a parallel gRPC surface) lets developers create and manage virtual machines, machine types, data centers, disks, networks, images, SSH keys, object storage, and billing programmatically.
c.name: CUDO Compute

Cuebiq helps clients understand how people move, shop, and engage, enabling smarter decisions through detailed location analytics and exposure measurement.

c.description: Cuein is an AI-native customer-experience platform ("co-pilot for customer experience teams") that unifies structured and unstructured customer-support data and applies generative AI to surface contact reasons, root causes, resolutions, and metrics such as Inferred CSAT and Resolution Rate. Its public developer surface exposes two REST APIs: an Insights API for retrieving per-conversation and bulk conversation insights over a date range, and an Answers API that generates answers grounded in a tenant's knowledge articles and documents. Both APIs use x-api-key authentication and are documented on a ReadMe-hosted developer hub. Cuein was acquired by ServiceNow (announced Q1 2025); the standalone developer hub remains live. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.
c.name: Cuein

c.description: Cuemarc provides AI-driven listening and reputation management tools for corporate communications, PR, and marketing teams. Their platform monitors large language model outputs to track narrative visibility, manage brand reputation, and identify content gaps. Offering features like real-time alerts, detailed reports, and actionable insights, Cuemarc helps organizations stay ahead of AI-driven reputational risks across pharma, medtech, and other industries.
c.name: Cuemarc

c.description: Cuemath is an India-headquartered education technology company founded in 2013 by Manan Khurma that delivers live, one-to-one online math tutoring to students in grades K through 12 across more than 80 countries. Its MathFit framework and LEAP learning platform pair certified tutors with an interactive, gamified curriculum aligned to US Common Core standards, spanning arithmetic, algebra, geometry, pre-calculus, AP calculus and standardized test preparation. Cuemath sells directly to families as a subscription tutoring product; it operates a consumer web and mobile application rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal.
c.name: Cuemath

c.description: Cuenca is a Mexican fintech (challenger bank / neobank) founded in 2018 that offers a banking-as-a-service REST API for moving money in Mexico. The API at api.cuenca.com covers SPEI and internal transfers, deposits, CLABE account provisioning, debit card issuing (physical and virtual), card transactions, bill payments to service providers, balances, statements, commissions, and KYC / identity validation (CURP validation, identity verification, KYC checks). It authenticates with an API key plus secret (HTTP basic), optional short-lived JWTs, and login / session tokens, exposes a sandbox at sandbox.cuenca.com, signs transfers with an idempotency key, paginates with a cursor (next_page_uri), and pushes webhooks for transaction, card, deposit and user events. Official client libraries ship for Python (cuenca) and Java (CuencaJava), with open-source tooling for CLABE validation and CEP receipts under the cuenca-mx GitHub organization.
c.name: Cuenca

c.description: Cuida Mi Mascota (CuidaMiMascota SAPI de CV) is a Mexican pet-care marketplace that connects pet owners with vetted, trusted caregivers for boarding (hospedaje), daycare, in-home visits, and dog walking across cities in Mexico. Delivered primarily as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps, the platform has served more than 250,000 pet owners and lets caregivers register to offer services. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. The company exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead with identity and domain-security signals captured for discovery.
c.name: Cuida Mi Mascota

c.description: Cuizhanmicroelectronics is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

c.description: Culdesac is a post-car real estate development company building walkable, car-free neighborhoods in the United States. Its first project, Culdesac Tempe in Tempe, Arizona, broke ground in 2019 and welcomed its first residents in 2021 — a 16-acre, roughly $140 million development of 636 apartment units plus 24,000 square feet of restaurant and retail space, designed with no resident parking. Residents receive transportation benefits such as free light-rail rides and discounted rideshare and scooter access in place of car ownership. Culdesac operates leasing, tours, and resident services through its website and HubSpot-backed portals, and intends to replicate the car-free neighborhood model in other cities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Culdesac publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture.
c.name: Culdesac

c.description: Culina Health provides virtual registered dietitian nutrition services, offering personalized nutrition care through telehealth. Their mission is to make expert nutrition accessible for everyone, addressing chronic health conditions with science‑based, inclusive, and culturally affirming dietitian support. They serve patients across the United States via an online platform, offering specialty programs for hormone health, weight loss, eating disorders, gastrointestinal health, and more.
c.name: Culina Health

c.description: Culinary Sciences develops patented rapid-chill and food‑treatment technology for high‑volume food production. Their PrecisionVac platform combines rapid cooling and flavor infusion, delivering up to 5× faster cooling, 25× faster treatment, and significant energy savings. Based in the USA, they serve commercial kitchens and food processors with multi‑capability systems.
c.name: Culinary Sciences

c.description: Culinary Brands is an Indian foodservice and beverage operator on a mission to prove that fresh, quality food is possible without compromising on taste. The company builds and runs a portfolio of well-known food and coffee brands across India, including Subway (sandwiches / QSR), Lavazza (coffee), and Fresh & Honest (coffee and vending), with a stated focus on sustainability, diversity and inclusion, governance, and CSR. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public web presence is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, documentation, or product API surface at this time.
c.name: Culinarybrands

c.description: Cullen/Frost Bankers, Inc. (NYSE: CFR) is a San Antonio, Texas bank holding company and the parent of Frost Bank, a Texas-chartered regional bank operating roughly 200 financial centers across the state. Frost serves consumer, commercial and private banking customers with deposit accounts, lending, treasury management, capital markets, insurance and investment services. As of September 2026 Frost publishes no public developer API program: there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no SDK on any first-party host. Corporate integration happens through the Frost Connect and Frost Treasury Connect commercial online banking portals under a customer agreement, and consumer account data sharing is delegated to Plaid's Plaid Exchange open-finance platform rather than to a Frost-published contract. This profile records that absence with probe evidence.
c.name: Cullen/Frost Bankers

c.description: Cullgen Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 2018 and focused on first-in-class targeted protein degradation medicines. Its proprietary uSMITE (ubiquitin-mediated, small molecule-induced target elimination) platform harnesses the body's own ubiquitin-proteasome system to selectively degrade disease-causing intracellular proteins, including targets considered undruggable by conventional small molecules, and the company extends that chemistry into degrader-antibody conjugates (DACs). Its lead TRK degrader program has entered Phase 1 clinical dosing, and the company has partnered with Astellas and taken investment from AstraZeneca. Gyre Therapeutics completed an all-stock acquisition of Cullgen valued at approximately $300 million on 4 May 2026. Cullgen publishes a corporate marketing website only: profiling on 2026-08-04 found no developer portal, documentation, machine-readable API contract, package registry presence, or public code repositories.
c.name: Cullgen

c.description: Cullinet Software (formerly Cullinane Database Systems) was a database and application software company based in Westwood, Massachusetts, best known for the IDMS/IDMS-DB mainframe database management system, the IDD data dictionary, and the ADS/Online application development environment for IBM mainframes. Backed by Battery Ventures, Greylock, and Morgenthaler Ventures, it was one of the first software companies to go public (1978) and was acquired by Computer Associates (CA) on June 30, 1989. The company is defunct and publishes no developer portal, API, or documentation surface today; this record is retained as a historical portfolio-graph node with no enrichable API artifacts.
c.name: Cullinet Software

c.description: Culqi is a Peruvian online payments platform and a Grupo Credicorp / Krealo company. Its REST API v2 lets businesses accept card, Yape, PagoEfectivo, mobile wallet and Cuotealo (installment) payments in PEN and USD, with card data tokenized client-side against a PCI-scoped secure host and all money movement, subscriptions and webhooks driven from a server-side secret key.
c.name: Culqi

c.description: Cult of the North (established November 2022 under the codename "Seidr") is a Stockholm, Sweden-based video game studio co-founded by former EA general manager Adam Schaub and former King SVP Marcus Jacobs, and backed by a seed investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The studio drew talent from King, Activision Blizzard, EA, Embark Studios, Resolution Games, and FunPlus, and set out to build large-scale, next-generation multiplayer PvP experiences for PC and console in Unreal Engine 5 — first the debut title codenamed "Project Gundalf" and later the free-to-play strategy war game "We Will Be Gods." As a consumer game studio it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile carries company identity only. Industry reporting in 2025 indicated the studio wound down operations.
c.name: Cult of the North

c.description: Cult.fit (Curefit / cure.fit, operated by Diverse Retails Private Limited) is an Indian health and fitness company offering a connected consumer experience across group fitness classes, gyms, at-home workouts, mental well-being and meditation, healthy food, and diagnostics. Its flagship products include CultPass gym and class memberships, sport and fitness centers, live and on-demand digital workouts, and the cult.fit and cure.fit mobile and web apps. Backed by Accel and other investors, the company operates a large consumer platform but does not publish a public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, corporate web properties, and engineering surface (the curefit GitHub organization and engineering blog).
c.name: Cult.fit

c.description: Cultivaet Technologies Holding Ltd. is an AI-driven agricultural technology ("AgriTech for Humanity") startup based in Egypt serving smallholder farmers across the Middle East. Its products include a Farmer AI Companion delivering personalized weather, crop-planning, pest-control and soil-health insights, a Knowledge Platform that collects/analyzes/distributes social and scientific agricultural data, and a Business SaaS connecting farmers with food-industry buyers for sustainable procurement and traceability. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sanabil and is part of the Google Cloud Startups Program (pre-seed, 2024). As of this enrichment pass Cultivaet publishes only a marketing site (cultivaet.ai) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or other developer surface, so no API artifacts were generated.
c.name: Cultivaet

c.description: Cultivate was an AI-powered digital leadership and coaching platform that analyzed leaders' own opt-in digital communication data to deliver hyper-personalized, privacy-preserving coaching insights and recommendations for people managers. Founded through an Entrepreneur in Residence program at Samsung NEXT by Joseph Freed, Samir Meghani, and Andy Horng, and backed by Trinity Ventures, Silicon Valley Data Capital, and Bloomberg Beta, Cultivate was acquired by employee listening and people-analytics company Perceptyx on February 15, 2022, where it became the basis for Perceptyx's "Cultivate Intelligent Coaching" product. Cultivate operated as an enterprise HR/leadership SaaS and did not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI. This profile is retained as a portfolio-lead record; the company no longer exists as an independent entity.
c.name: Cultivate

c.description: Culture Partners provides organizational culture consulting, helping companies achieve better results through clarity, alignment, and accountability. Their services include strategic alignment, executive leadership consulting, change activation, and industry‑specific solutions such as healthcare and manufacturing. The firm leverages 37 years of research and proprietary IP to drive measurable outcomes like increased EBITDA and employee NPS.
c.name: Culture

c.description: Culture Amp is the leading employee experience platform providing tools for employee engagement surveys, performance management, and people analytics. The Culture Amp Public API is a RESTful, read-only interface that enables organizations to programmatically retrieve their people data—including employee records, demographics, performance cycles, manager reviews, and survey results—for use in external systems and custom analytics. The API uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Flow for authentication and is available to all Culture Amp subscribers at no additional cost as part of standard subscription fees. The platform serves thousands of organizations worldwide and integrates with leading HRIS systems, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and compensation tools like Pave.
c.name: Culture Amp

c.description: Culture Biosciences is a South San Francisco TechBio company that builds cloud-connected bioreactor systems and bioprocess development services for cell culture. Its platform pairs automated single-use bioreactors (250mL bench-scale and 5L, plus the Stratyx mobile bioreactor) with Console, a cloud-native software product for real-time monitoring, experiment management, data analytics, and remote collaboration. Through its Nexxys services group the company runs clone/strain/construct screening, process characterization, process development, and bioprocess modeling and simulation for customers working on synthetic biology, protein therapeutics, and viral vectors. Culture Biosciences lets teams outsource and scale bioreactor experiments without scaling their own lab infrastructure. Backed by DCVC, Northpond Ventures, Synthesis Capital, S32, and Cultivian Sandbox Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company operates the Console cloud platform but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.
c.name: Culture Biosciences

c.description: Transform workplace culture with Culture Hero's expert solutions. We specialise in workplace culture improvement, team collaboration, employee engagement strategies, and leadership development. Our tailored workshops, executive coaching, and research-backed programs drive productivity, employee retention, and organizational success.
c.name: Culturehero

c.description: Culture Biosciences (formerly Culturerobotics) provides cloud‑connected bioreactor platforms and software for cell culture and bioprocess development. Their suite includes the Console software, Stratyx and Nexxys bioreactors, enabling remote experiment design, real‑time monitoring, data analytics, and AI‑driven insights. The company serves synthetic biology, protein therapeutics, and viral vector developers, offering resources such as white papers, technical bulletins, case studies, and webinars to accelerate bioprocess innovation.
c.name: Culturerobotics

c.description: Cumberland is the cryptocurrency trading and liquidity arm of DRW, providing institutional OTC spot, derivatives and options liquidity in digital assets. Clients trade through its electronic platforms, Marea and an API (named the Cumberland CPE API on its public status page); the API documentation at apidocs.cumberland.io sits behind a client login.
c.name: Cumberland

c.description: Cumbuca is a Banco Central do Brasil-licensed Payment Institution that provides regulated "proxy" access to Brazil's Pix and Open Finance networks. Acting as a thin, transparent layer with a 1:1 mapping to the official Open Finance Brasil and Central Bank API specifications, it forwards cryptographically signed requests between client infrastructure and the regulated ecosystem so fintechs can build directly on the rails without holding their own license (zero lock-in via certificate swap when they obtain one). Capabilities span Pix payment initiation, Open Finance account and credit-data access, recurring payments, and SCR credit-information queries, with a 0ms median latency overhead and a 99.99% availability SLA. Founded in 2021 in Sao Paulo and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator, Cumbuca also ships an Open Finance Data MCP server, the Regulus regulatory AI assistant, public status pages, and the open-source Open Finance Playground developer guide built with Juspay.
c.name: Cumbuca

c.description: Cummins is a global power leader that designs, manufactures, distributes, and services diesel and natural gas engines, electric and hybrid powertrains, electrified power systems, components such as filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, and electric power generation systems. Cummins serves customers in approximately 190 countries and territories through a network of more than 600 company-owned and independent distributor locations and approximately 7,200 dealer locations.

c.description: Cumulocity is an enterprise AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) platform that connects, manages, and analyzes industrial assets from cloud to edge. Founded inside Software AG and divested via a 2025 management buyout into an independent company (sale announced alongside the IBM acquisition of Software AG's StreamSets and webMethods), Cumulocity provides a full-stack platform — REST and MQTT APIs, device management, digital twin modeling, streaming analytics powered by Apama, DataHub data-lake offload, Cockpit dashboards, and on-prem Edge deployments — validated at 100 million devices and 1 million messages/second across industrial equipment, medical devices, manufacturing, utilities, energy, transport, retail, and telecommunications.
c.name: Cumulocity

c.description: Cumulus Labs is a Y Combinator (W26) company building a unified inference platform for production AI. Cumulus consolidates the eight subsystems teams normally assemble from separate vendors — an OpenAI-compatible gateway, a per-workflow router, a layered prompt/KV cache, request-level observability, continuous shadow evaluation, one-click LoRA fine-tuning, custom open-weight hosting, and the proprietary Ion inference engine running on NVIDIA Grace and Blackwell GPUs — behind a single OpenAI-compatible API at api.cumuluslabs.io/v1. Ion's custom attention kernels deliver 30-50% more throughput than stock vLLM and SGLang, and the gateway is a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vercel AI SDKs — change one line of configuration and keep your existing code.
c.name: Cumulus Labs

c.description: Cumulus Networks was a computer networking company founded in 2010 that developed Cumulus Linux, an open Linux-based network operating system for bare-metal and white-box data-center switches, along with NetQ, a network operations and telemetry platform. It was a pioneer of open, disaggregated networking, letting operators run a standard Linux distribution on commodity switching hardware. NVIDIA acquired Cumulus Networks in May 2020, and the products are now part of NVIDIA's Ethernet switching and networking software line. The former cumulusnetworks.com and docs.cumulusnetworks.com domains now redirect to NVIDIA's networking documentation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, Battery Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital.
c.name: Cumulus Networks

c.description: CUNA Mutual Group, now operating as TruStage, is an insurance and financial services company that provides insurance, retirement, and investment products to credit unions and their members. TruStage offers life insurance, auto and home insurance, AD&D, retirement planning, annuities, lending solutions, compliance services, and analytics tools to credit unions and their members.

c.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. c.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

c.description: Curai Health is a virtual-first primary care company offering 24/7 text-based telemedicine to patients across all 50 U.S. states, connecting them with board-certified clinicians for urgent care, chronic disease management, wellness, and preventive screenings, with orders for labs and prescriptions and referrals to specialists. For organizations, health systems, TPAs, and benefits administrators, Curai exposes a Partner API and an embeddable Web SDK (curai-js) that let partners register patients and drop the Curai patient experience into their own web and mobile apps, plus integration via standards-based APIs, Health Information Exchanges (HIE), and webhooks. The platform offers analytics, content moderation, and campaign tools for marketers seeking authentic, visual-driven engagement.

c.description: Curative is a health insurance and healthcare services company founded in 2020 that reengineered the employer-based health plan around simplicity, engagement, and cost transparency. Its fully insured and level-funded plans give members a competitive monthly premium with zero copays, deductibles, or out-of-pocket costs, starting each member with a baseline visit that tailors a preventative care plan. Curative serves more than 1,200 employer clients and over 165,000 members, reached profitability, and achieved unicorn status ($1.275B valuation) following a $150M Series B round backed by DCVC. Curative operates as a HIPAA-regulated health plan; it has no public developer/API program, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, its member/provider web surface, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.
c.name: Curative

c.description: An independent, daily-refreshed record of museum/gallery/curatorial vacancies and advertised salaries, aggregated from 400+ institutions' careers pages. Exposes a keyless REST/JSON API, an OpenAPI 3.1 contract, a hosted MCP server, llms.txt, open datasets (CC BY 4.0, with DOI), and RSS.
c.name: CuratorSearch

c.description: Curaum is a Korean healthcare technology company focused on improving quality of life through innovative oral and sleep health solutions. It develops IoMT‑enabled dental care products, sleep monitoring devices, and digital platforms to promote balanced, healthy living. The firm emphasizes accessible medical technology and aims to extend lifespan and wellbeing by integrating advanced sensing and digital care.
c.name: Curaum

c.description: Curavit Clinical Research is a remote clinical site and contract research organization (CRO) that designs, develops, and executes decentralized clinical trials. Founded in 2019 and based in Boston, Curavit offers feasibility, protocol development, virtual site technology, and end‑to‑end trial management services for sponsors across therapeutics, diagnostics, medical devices, and digital health. Their platform integrates regulatory guidance, participant‑centric tools, and scalable recruitment to accelerate study timelines and improve data quality.
c.name: Curavit

c.description: Curaway Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese high‑tech enterprise specializing in precision minimally invasive medical devices. It develops and manufactures products for energy ablation, biopsy localization, delicate surgery and surgical robotics, serving oncology, peripheral intervention and smart medical fields. The company emphasizes innovative R&D, international quality standards, and provides solutions that reduce trauma, complications and recovery time for patients.
c.name: Curaway

c.description: Curb is a music entertainment company under Word Entertainment, operating record labels, artist management, and related media services. The public website provides information about its catalog, artists, and merchandise, but no public API documentation or developer portal is evident.
c.name: Curb

c.description: Curbio is a home renovation and remodeling service that helps homeowners increase property value by managing on‑market concierge renovations. They provide a full‑service platform covering design, permits, construction, and financing, enabling sellers to showcase upgraded homes to buyers. The company operates nationwide across multiple US markets, offering services such as kitchen and bathroom remodels, exterior updates, and basic listing preparation.
c.name: Curbio

c.description: Curbside SOS is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market; backed by starting-line-vc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
c.name: Curbside SOS

c.description: CurbStand provides valet, monthly parking, and mobile car wash services in Los Angeles. Founded in 2013, it offers a mobile app for locating, paying, and tipping for valet services, as well as subscription-based monthly parking and on-demand car wash. The company emphasizes convenience, safety, and flexible pricing, targeting both individual drivers and event organizers.
c.name: CurbStand

c.description: Curbwaste provides cloud‑based waste management software for haulers, offering order management, real‑time dispatch, inventory tracking, automated invoicing, and driver mobile apps. Built by industry veterans, the platform helps waste businesses increase revenue, improve cash flow, and streamline operations through integrated e‑commerce and data‑centric reporting.
c.name: Curbwaste

c.description: Cure Genetics (克睿基因) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2016 and based in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, developing cell and gene therapies for solid tumors and genetic diseases. Its differentiated pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: AIMS CAR-NKT, a cell-therapy approach engineered to improve solid-tumor infiltration and modulate the tumor microenvironment, and VELP, an AAV (adeno-associated viral) vector technology targeting the nervous system, heart, and kidneys. Lead programs include CGC729, an anti-CD70 CAR-NKT therapy in Phase I trials for renal cell carcinoma, and CGC-602, a PD-1-IL-2v bispecific molecule for cancer immunotherapy. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Advantech Capital, and Oriza Holdings. It publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.
c.name: Cure Genetics

c.description: Cure Hydration (CURE) is a New York based direct-to-consumer beverage brand founded in 2019 by Lauren Picasso, selling plant-based electrolyte drink mixes built on the World Health Organization's Oral Rehydration Solution formula — organic coconut water, pink Himalayan salt, no added sugar. It is not a software company and it runs no developer programme, but its Shopify storefront serves a substantive first-party machine surface: a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 2026-04-08) MCP server at /api/ucp/mcp with 13 catalog, cart, checkout and order tools, an anonymously introspectable Storefront GraphQL API, agent instructions at /agents.md and /llms.txt, a dedicated agent-discovery sitemap, and OpenID Connect discovery for shopper accounts. This profile records that surface as probed.
c.name: Cure Hydration

c.description: CureApp, Inc. is a Japanese digital therapeutics company that develops evidence‑based software medical programs (DTx) to treat chronic conditions. Their platform recreates treatment with software, aiming to provide high‑quality care accessible to all. The company focuses on innovative therapeutic effects through technology, sustainability, and patient outcomes, as described on their official website.
c.name: CureApp

c.description: Cureatr, now part of AssureCare, provides medication management solutions for payers, providers, and pharmacies. The company focuses on care coordination, utilization management, and medication therapy management, aiming to improve population health outcomes through integrated digital platforms.
c.name: Cureatr

c.description: Curebase is a San Francisco-based clinical trials technology company (founded 2017) that provides a modern, AI-native eClinical platform for sponsors, CROs, biotechs, MedTech companies, and research sites. The platform unifies the full trial lifecycle in one system: ePRO/eCOA (electronic patient-reported and clinical outcome assessments), eConsent (digital informed consent), EDC (electronic data capture), patient recruitment and screening, participant engagement and retention tooling, and site management. Curebase also ships Sitebase, a free eClinical suite for research sites, and Hope, a conversational AI voice agent. It supports decentralized and hybrid trial models natively. Curebase is a private, venture-backed company (Series B led by Industry Ventures; investors include GGV Capital, Acrew, Gilead, and others). It is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Curebase does not publish a public developer API or API documentation; integration is handled through enterprise engagements.
c.name: Curebase

c.description: Curebay is a healthcare platform focused on delivering affordable, accessible medical services to underserved populations in rural India. It operates a hybrid model combining physical clinics, tele‑consultations, diagnostics, pharmacy services, and a membership program (Kavach) that provides preventive care and financial protection. The company aims to bridge the last‑mile gap in primary healthcare through an interoperable digital stack, AI‑driven screening, and a network of local health workers, serving millions across hundreds of villages.
c.name: Curebay

c.description: Curefit, operating under the brand cult.fit, is an Indian health and wellness platform offering fitness classes, gym memberships, mental health services, nutrition, and a marketplace for health products. It provides a digital ecosystem connecting users with trainers, nutritionists, and wellness experts through its mobile app and website, aiming to promote holistic well-being across India.
c.name: Curefit

c.description: Curefoods is a Bengaluru-based multi-brand cloud kitchen and quick-service restaurant company founded in 2020 that builds and operates iconic Indian food brands. As of March 2025 it runs roughly 502 outlets across India (about 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks, and 122 restaurants) under a house-of-brands model including Kitchens of EatFit, Sharief Bhai, Olio Pizza, Nomad Pizza, Arambam, CakeZone, Frozen Bottle, and Krispy Kreme. Backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, and Iron Pillar, the company crossed roughly Rs 746 crore in FY25 revenue and has received SEBI approval for an IPO. Curefoods is a consumer food operator with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and carries only identity, domain-security, and public-property signals.
c.name: Curefoods

c.description: Curegene is a biotechnology company focused on developing gene‑based therapies and diagnostic tools. The firm aims to accelerate the discovery and delivery of precision medicines by leveraging advanced genomics, bioinformatics, and clinical research platforms. While detailed public information is limited, Curegene positions itself as a partner for pharmaceutical and academic collaborations, offering services that span from target identification to clinical trial support. The company’s mission is to translate genetic insights into actionable therapeutic solutions that improve patient outcomes worldwide.
c.name: Curegene

c.description: CureJoy is a consumer health and wellness media company that publishes expert-reviewed content on alternative health, natural remedies, fitness, nutrition, and beauty. Backed by Accel, it grew into one of the larger natural-health content platforms, distributing articles and advice through its website and social channels. The public property is a WordPress.com-hosted content site with no first-party developer or product API; the only programmatic surface is the standard WordPress REST API (wp-json) exposed by the hosting platform, which is generic infrastructure rather than a published product offering.
c.name: Curejoy

c.description: Cureskin is an AI‑powered dermatology and hair‑care platform founded in 2017 in Bengaluru, India. It offers a mobile app that provides free AI skin and hair analysis, connects users with board‑certified dermatologists, and delivers personalized, prescription‑strength treatment kits. The service combines machine‑learning diagnostics with clinician oversight to address conditions such as acne, hair loss, and skin aging, aiming to make professional dermatological care accessible and continuous for everyday health needs.
c.name: Cureskin

c.description: Cureverse (큐어버스) is a Korean biotechnology and research organization focused on developing innovative solutions in the fields of neuroscience, drug discovery, and clinical pipelines. The website offers sections such as About Us, R&D, Core Technologies, Research Areas, Pipeline, Investor Relations, News, Articles, Videos, Careers, and Contact. It provides information on collaborations, funded projects, and publications, reflecting a broad engagement with academic and industry partners.
c.name: Cureverse

c.description: Curevo is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company that operates a global healthcare marketplace, connecting patients with verified medical centers, doctors, and wellness providers across more than 150 countries. The platform offers a range of treatments—from cardiology and oncology to regenerative therapies such as stem cell, hyperbaric oxygen, and blood ozonation—facilitating transparent pricing, tele‑assist AI support, and end‑to‑end medical travel coordination.
c.name: Curevo

c.description: Curi Bio develops human-relevant platforms integrating human cells, systems, and data to accelerate the discovery of new medicines. Their iPSC-based products enable scientists to build mature predictive tissue models for cardiac, skeletal muscle, and neuromuscular applications, supporting drug safety, efficacy, and potency testing.
c.name: Curi Bio

c.description: Curie (Curie Vision, Inc.) is the commerce layer for AI — it connects AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to real product catalogs from 5.6M+ Shopify stores via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Results carry live prices, real inventory, affiliate purchase links, and interactive 3D digital twins (GLB/USDZ) that shoppers can rotate and view in AR. Curie publishes a public REST catalog API, a hosted MCP server exposing 30 commerce tools, and cross-protocol discovery profiles (MCP, UCP, A2A, OpenAI Apps SDK). Most discovery and tool calls run on a free public tier with no auth; a Pro Bearer is required only for premium tools such as checkout. Backed by 500 Global.
c.name: Curie
