e.description: Ecologi is a Bristol, UK climate action platform and B Corp founded in 2019 that lets individuals and businesses fund verified reforestation, carbon avoidance, carbon removal, and habitat restoration projects through monthly subscriptions, pay-as-you-go purchases, and a public Impact API. The platform has funded over 95 million trees, avoided 4.1 million tonnes of CO2e, removed 61,000 tonnes of CO2e, and restored 102,000 square metres of habitat across projects in Guatemala, Brazil, Kenya, Uganda, India, Pakistan, the UK, and beyond. Ecologi serves over 16,000 businesses with an end-to-end Measure, Reduce, Report (3Rs) workflow aligned to SBTi, GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1, SECR, and CSRD, and exposes a public REST API (and a Zapier app and Shopify app) so any business can automate climate impact per order, per signup, per invoice, or per workflow event. The Impact API supports trees, local trees (UK/US/AU/BR), carbon avoidance, carbon removal, and habitat restoration as programmable purchases, with bearer-token auth, test mode, and idempotency keys; a separate public Reporting API exposes any user account's impact totals without authentication for embedding climate-positive badges.
e.name: Ecologi

e.description: EcoMap Technologies is an ecosystem intelligence software company (Baltimore, MD) that helps economic development organizations, chambers of commerce, universities, arts agencies, bioscience associations, and state and local governments map, connect, and measure their entrepreneurial ecosystems. Its platform turns scattered regional resource directories, referrals, and stakeholder relationships into a measurable, reportable network. Products span EcoMap Discover (resource hub and navigation), the Ecosystem Relationship Manager, an AI-powered Ecosystem ChatBot, the Economic Intelligence Monitor for regional benchmarking, and a Nonprofit Intelligence Dashboard. EcoMap reports 250,000+ resources mapped across 100+ ecosystems nationwide.
e.name: EcoMap Technologies

e.description: EcomExperts is a Latin American ecommerce ERP and technology platform that helps online sellers manage, synchronize, and automate their stores from a single screen. It centralizes omnichannel operations across marketplaces and sales channels (including multi-account Mercado Libre management), synchronizes prices and stock in real time, and issues electronic invoices automatically in bulk. Delivered as a SaaS application with a hosted dashboard and a 7-day free trial, EcomExperts operates across Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EcomExperts does not currently publish a public developer platform, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures company identity and public-surface signals only.
e.name: EcomExperts

e.description: ECOMMPAY is a London-headquartered international payment service provider and direct card acquirer founded in 2012, authorised by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 607597), PCI DSS Level 1 certified, and holding Visa and Mastercard Principal Membership. It operates its own payment gateway, acquiring, and certified processing platform, serving e-commerce merchants across Europe, the UK, and global markets with card processing, 100+ alternative and local payment methods, open banking, payouts, multi-currency settlement, and fraud prevention. Its developer surface is API-native but signature-authenticated rather than token-based: merchants integrate through a hosted Payment Page API, a server-to-server Gate API for direct payment processing, a Data API for reporting and reconciliation, and a Dashboard for operational management, all documented on a public developer portal with callbacks/webhooks and multi-language SDKs. Its home market is the United Kingdom.
e.name: ECOMMPAY

e.description: EcoMom was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub lead for enrichment. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-20 found no operating company surface behind the ecomom.com domain. The domain's nameservers are ns1/ns2.afternic.com and every request to ecomom.com issues a 307 redirect to an Afternic listing headlined "The domain name ecomom.com is for sale!" with no published price. The host serves a wildcard soft-200 parking page - arbitrary paths, including a deliberately nonsense control path, all return HTTP 200 with text/html that redirects to /lander - so the 200 status codes returned for /.well-known/security.txt, /.well-known/openid-configuration, /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, /.well-known/api-catalog, /.well-known/ai-plugin.json, /llms.txt and /openapi.json are parking artifacts and not real documents. The api, developer, docs and www subdomains resolve to the same two parking IPs. There is no developer portal, no documentation, no specification and no API surface to catalog, so no enrichment artifacts were written for this company.

e.description: EDF Energy Ltd is the British integrated energy business wholly owned by Electricite de France (EDF), the French state-owned utility. Formed in 2002 from London Electricity, SWEB and SEEBOARD and enlarged by the 2009 acquisition of British Energy, it is one of the largest suppliers of electricity and gas in Great Britain with roughly five million customer accounts, and it is also Britain's largest generator of zero-carbon electricity — it operates the country's fleet of operating nuclear power stations (the advanced gas-cooled reactors at Hartlepool, Heysham 1, Heysham 2 and Torness, and the Sizewell B pressurised water reactor), is building Hinkley Point C, and owns wind, solar, battery (Pivot Power) and EV charging (Pod Point) businesses. It therefore sits at both ends of the GB value chain: a licensed generator and wholesale market participant, and the retailer of record holding the customer relationship, the billing account and the meter data. Its API posture is the opposite of the mandated-utility pattern. The United Kingdom has no consumer energy data-portability right — no Consumer Data Right, no Green Button obligation. Britain mandated infrastructure instead: the licensed Smart DCC monopoly carries smart-meter traffic under the Smart Energy Code, and EDF is bound by that as a licensed supplier, but it confers no third-party consumer data API. And yet EDF publishes one of the more substantial public API programmes of any European utility, because it does not run its own retail platform: in 2023 EDF licensed Kraken from Octopus Energy Group and completed the migration of 5.8 million customer accounts in fifteen months, so EDF's API is Kraken's API, branded for EDF GB at developer.edfgb-kraken.energy. That portal is fully public and was confirmed live at HTTP 200 on 2026-07-27. It publishes a first-party OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for a 27-path REST API, a second OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for a 16-path customer-migration API, and a GraphQL API whose schema — 2,492 types, 246 queries, 417 mutations — was harvested by anonymous introspection with no key and no account. EDF's retail tariff and product data is genuinely open: GET https://api.edfgb-kraken.energy/v1/products/ returned 21 live products at HTTP 200 anonymously, and the GraphQL energyProducts query returns real EDF tariffs with brand "EDF". Consumer usage and billing data is documented in the same contracts but requires an Authorization token issued to the account holder, or an OAuth application authorised against the OpenID Connect server at auth.edfgb-kraken.energy, whose anonymously served discovery document advertises 111 scopes including request:consumption-data and view:smartflex-data. Open market data is the gap: EDF discloses its REMIT generation unavailability on its own website as an HTML table, but the XML and CSV export links it publishes on that very page both return HTTP 404, and the machine-readable channel for those disclosures is Elexon's BMRS platform, which EDF does not operate — 27 EDF REMIT messages under registration code 48X000000000022A were confirmed there in a single week. Open on tariffs, gated on consumer data, broken on its own market-data exports, and none of it compelled.
e.name: EDF Energy

e.description: Editas Medicine is a clinical-stage genome editing company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing durable, precision CRISPR-based gene editing medicines for people with serious diseases. The company works across in vivo and ex vivo approaches and holds foundational CRISPR/Cas9 and Cas12a intellectual property, advancing a pipeline that has included programs in sickle cell disease, beta-thalassemia and inherited retinal disorders. Editas Medicine trades on Nasdaq under the ticker EDIT and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). As a life-sciences research and therapeutics organization it publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture.
e.name: Editas Medicine

e.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.
e.name: EDITED

e.description: editonthefly is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of slow-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
e.name: editonthefly

e.description: EditorConfig helps maintain consistent coding styles for multiple developers working on the same project across various editors and IDEs. The EditorConfig project consists of a file format for defining coding styles and a collection of text editor plugins that enable editors to read the file format and adhere to defined styles. EditorConfig files are easily readable and work well with version control systems. The format uses an INI-style syntax compatible with the Python configparser library, with filepath glob patterns similar to gitignore.
e.name: EditorConfig

e.description: Edlink is an education-integration platform offering a unified API for rostering and school data across SIS and LMS systems. The Edlink Graph API exposes normalized districts, schools, classes, sections, courses, people, and enrollments from hundreds of source systems behind a single Bearer-authenticated REST interface, plus SSO, source integrations, and change events.
e.name: Edlink

e.description: Edme Insurance Brokers Ltd (formerly Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, ABIBL) is an India-based composite insurance broker offering corporate, retail, and reinsurance solutions across 30+ industries including aviation, marine, energy, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, technology, and the BFSI and FMCG sectors. The company provides tailored risk management, employee benefits, and claims advisory services, backed by digital customer portals for policy and claims management and employee benefits. Edme is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Edme publishes no public developer program or API surface at this time.
e.name: Edme Insurance Brokers

e.description: Edmodo was an education technology company that operated a K-12 social learning network and learning management platform connecting teachers, students, and parents, and at its peak ran a developer platform and app store for third-party education apps. It was acquired by NetDragon in 2018 and the service was shut down in September 2022. Surfaced as a portfolio company of union-square-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the edmodo.com domain resolves only to a parked lander page and exposes no live developer, API, or documentation surface.
e.name: Edmodo

e.description: Edmunds is a popular automotive resource website that provides consumers with valuable information and tools to help them make informed decisions about buying and selling cars. They offer expert reviews, comparison tools, price guides, and a variety of resources to help users research and find the perfect vehicle for their needs.
e.name: Edmunds

e.description: EDN is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
e.name: EDN

e.description: Edools is a Brazilian e-learning and digital-education platform for creating, hosting, and selling online courses, learning paths, and training programs under a white-label school (LMS) with a Netflix-style members area, video hosting, and student engagement tools. The platform is now delivered as HeroSpark (edools.com redirects to herospark.com), a digital-product sales suite for course creators covering checkout, payments (SparkPay), members areas, and a student mobile app. Edools exposes a token-authenticated REST API (base host per-school on myedools.com) for team, content, and student management, plus first-party Ruby and PHP client libraries and theme development tooling, letting integrators sync courses, students, enrollments, and school products with external systems.
e.name: Edools

e.description: Edra is an AI automation platform that analyzes an organization's existing business data - tickets, logs, messages, and system records - to automatically discover and document how operational processes actually run, then turns that knowledge into workflows that AI agents can execute reliably. The company targets knowledge-intensive functions such as IT service management and technical support, and integrates with common enterprise systems including ServiceNow, JIRA, Zendesk, Salesforce, and Outlook. Edra was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Edra publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.
e.name: Edra

e.description: eDreams ODIGEO is a leading online travel agency operating globally, offering a comprehensive platform for booking flights, hotels, vacation packages, and car rentals. The company provides a range of travel services through its website and mobile apps, serving millions of customers worldwide. It is part of the ODIGEO group, which includes other travel brands, and focuses on delivering competitive prices, a user-friendly experience, and extensive travel options across numerous destinations.
e.name: eDreams ODIGEO

e.description: EdSights is a student voice and engagement platform for higher education. It pairs an AI-powered SMS chatbot with real-time analytics to collect continuous feedback from students, surface persistence and well-being risk, and flag individuals who need staff intervention. Its Student Voice Score (SVS) benchmarks student satisfaction the way NPS benchmarks customers, and institutional dashboards help retention, advising, and student-success teams act on that feedback throughout the academic journey. EdSights serves 290+ colleges and universities and connects to campus systems — Banner SIS, Slate, Salesforce, Starfish, EAB Navigate360, and Pharos — via SFTP data feeds. The company is Techstars-backed. As of this profile EdSights exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhooks; integration is data-file (SFTP) based, so most API-artifact enrichment is not applicable.
e.name: EdSights

e.description: EduAdvisor is a Malaysian education platform that helps students compare, plan and apply for tertiary education. It provides course and university comparison tools, scholarship matching, study-abroad guidance, and free education counseling, working directly with 100+ universities and colleges in Malaysia and abroad to streamline applications for prospective students. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EduAdvisor currently operates as a consumer-facing WordPress web platform with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass.
e.name: EduAdvisor

e.description: Educ-up is a French social-impact education group founded in 2016 by Mohamed El Mazzouji, headquartered in Saint-Denis, La Réunion with establishments in metropolitan France including Montreuil (Seine-Saint-Denis). It operates two consumer- and professional-facing brands rather than a software product: Domissori, launched in 2019, which places Montessori-trained educators in family homes for childcare, educational workshops and academic tutoring across Vannes, Chambéry, Lyon, Grenoble, Perpignan, Montpellier, Marseille and Saint-Denis; and Edacademy, a Qualiopi-certified training and apprenticeship centre for early-childhood and personal-care professions (CAP AEPE, Titre Pro ADVF, Bac Pro ASSP, parenting and Montessori support). The group also runs Ed'solidaire, a subsidy scheme that opens paid childcare to low-income families. Investors include Serena, M Capital, Inco Ventures, MakeSense and Racine2. Edacademy delivers its programmes through a self-hosted Moodle learning platform at formation.edacademy.fr, but that is an end-user LMS: as of August 2026 Educ-up publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its corporate domain educ-up.fr now redirects to a parked IONOS default site.
e.name: Educ-up

e.description: Education Holdings 1 operates The Princeton Review, an educational services company offering standardized test preparation, one-on-one and on-demand tutoring, and college, graduate, medical, and law school admissions counseling. The Princeton Review prepares students for the SAT, ACT, PSAT, AP, MCAT, DAT, OAT, LSAT, GRE, GMAT, SSAT, ISEE, and SHSAT through live, self-paced, and honors courses, publishes college and graduate school rankings and guidebooks, and provides free practice tests, events, and study resources. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The Princeton Review operates a consumer web presence rather than a public developer program; it publishes an llms.txt AI-discovery file but does not expose a documented public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.
e.name: Education Holdings 1 (The Princeton Review)

e.description: Education Management Corporation was one of the largest providers of post-secondary education in North America, operating The Art Institutes, Argosy University, Brown Mackie College, and South University.
e.name: Education Management Corporation

e.description: Educative is an online learning platform that provides high-quality, interactive courses for developers of all skill levels. With a focus on practical, hands-on learning, Educative offers courses on a wide range of topics, from programming languages like Python and JavaScript to data structures and algorithms. Each course is created by expert instructors and includes quizzes, coding challenges, and real-world projects to help learners apply their knowledge.
e.name: Educative

e.description: EduFi (EDUFI PTE. LTD) is a Singapore-incorporated education-financing fintech operating Pakistan's first Study Now, Pay Later (SNPL) digital platform, with expansion into Saudi Arabia and Oman. The Shariah-approved platform lets parents and students finance private schooling, higher education, and international student loans through quick, collateral-free approvals with direct disbursement to educational institutes and convenient monthly installments. EduFi also provides partner educational institutes a free ERP system and subsidized SNPL for their students, and works with financial institutions to fund receivables. Backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist; EduFi publishes a consumer marketing and application surface but no public developer/API program.
e.name: EDUFI

e.description: eduFire was an online education startup surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-19 found that the company's primary domain, edufire.com, no longer resolves (no DNS A or NS records), indicating the company is defunct. No live developer portal, API surface, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or any other artifact could be located to enrich, so this profile remains an identity-only stub.
e.name: eduFire

e.description: eduGAIN provides a federated identity service that enables simple, secure single‑sign‑on access to thousands of educational services worldwide. It connects over 80 participant federations and more than 10,000 identity and service providers, allowing students, researchers, staff, and institutions to access online resources with reduced account management complexity.
e.name: eduGAIN

e.description: EduKart was an Indian online education startup, backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), that sold certificate, diploma and degree courses from partner universities and training institutes to Indian learners. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company is now defunct — repeated probes of edukart.com find a parked hosting placeholder rather than a live business, and no developer, API, documentation or SDK surface exists to catalog.
e.name: Edukart

e.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.
e.name: Edukita

e.description: EduPristine is a Mumbai-based finance, accounting, and analytics training institute founded in 2008, offering classroom and online certification-prep and professional up-skilling programs. Its catalog spans financial modeling, CFA, FRM, ACCA, US CPA and US CMA, business analytics and data science, digital marketing, financial accounting (Big 4 aligned), and healthcare/medical coding. EduPristine runs training centers across India alongside self-paced and instructor-led online courses, and is part of Adtalem Global Education. Sector: edtech. No public developer API or documented API surface was found during enrichment; the corporate website sits behind a WAF that blocks automated discovery of a well-known or developer surface.
e.name: EduPristine

e.description: Edviro is an AI platform for building operations and energy optimization, aimed at facility managers and building operators of large commercial buildings. It pulls scattered building data - utility bills, smart meters, building management systems (BMS), submeters, sensors, and work-order platforms - into one place, then follows an Ingest, Detect, Act, and Verify workflow: it consolidates the data, catches energy waste and anomalies in real time, dispatches work orders and adjusts setpoints, and proves the resulting savings against meter data and utility bills. The platform also builds a digital twin of each building to simulate capital projects and forecast ROI before purchase, and produces audit-grade Measurement and Verification (M&V) reporting. Edviro is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco.
e.name: Edviro

e.description: Edvisor.io is a B2B international-education recruitment platform that connects education agencies with 700+ partner schools across 80+ countries. Agencies browse school portfolios with live pricing, build and send student quotes, manage the student journey from inquiry through enrollment, and track commissions and invoices; schools distribute programs to 5,000+ active agencies, grow and manage their agency network, and analyze their enrollment pipeline. The platform has processed over $2B in tuition. Edvisor exposes a GraphQL API at api-v2.edvisor.io/graphql (226 queries, 203 mutations, Bearer API-key auth) plus webhooks for two-way synchronization with external CRM and back-office systems.
e.name: Edvisor.io

e.description: Edward Jones is a financial services firm dedicated to serving the needs of individual investors through a network of branch offices across the United States and Canada.
e.name: Edward Jones

e.description: Edwards Lifesciences is a global leader in patient-focused innovations for structural heart disease and critical care monitoring, providing transcatheter and surgical heart valves, hemodynamic monitoring, and critical care products.
e.name: Edwards Lifesciences

e.description: edX is an online learning platform now operated by 2U; the underlying Open edX software is open source. Open edX exposes a comprehensive REST API surface (Enrollment, Courses, Users, Catalog, Discussion, Grades, LTI, Enterprise) and hosts a public API at api.edx.org for partners.
e.name: edX

e.description: EDX Markets is an institutional cryptocurrency exchange that operates the world's only centrally cleared crypto trading venue, combining deep liquidity, transparent markets, low trading costs and ultra-low-latency matching-engine technology. It runs a spot exchange (EDX Markets), a perpetual-futures exchange (EDXM International, based in Singapore), a central clearinghouse with daily net settlement and bankruptcy-remote member accounts (EDXM Global), and a white-label crypto-as-a-service platform (EDX FlowConnect). Connectivity for members is delivered over the FIX protocol — FIX 5.0 SP2 order entry and drop copy plus FIX and binary (SBE) market data, transported over mutually authenticated TLS — rather than a public REST/OpenAPI. EDX is backed by institutional partners and was surfaced through the pantera-capital portfolio.
e.name: EDX Markets

e.description: Edyoucated is a German SaaS company offering an AI-powered corporate learning and skills-management platform for mid-to-large enterprises. The product combines a learning management / learning experience system (central management of training, mandatory compliance training, seminar administration, AI-assisted content creation, blended learning, and learning analytics) with skills management (skill cataloging, assessments, gap analysis, expert identification, and career guidance) to give organizations a common language for skills and personalized learning pathways. It also offers consulting for custom skill-taxonomy development. Customers include Deutsche Bahn, BASF, Shopware, and Finanz Informatik. Edyoucated is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer/API surface, developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation.
e.name: Edyoucated

e.description: Eeki Foods is a food company listed in the General Catalyst portfolio and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer surface: eekifoods.com serves a pre-launch "Launching Soon" placeholder page, there are no api./docs./developer. subdomains in DNS, no /.well-known/ discovery documents, no llms.txt, no first-party client libraries on npm or PyPI, and no GitHub organization or repositories. The domain is held and mail-enabled (Google Workspace MX) and serves valid TLS 1.3 with HSTS, so this remains a live lead worth re-checking once the company launches a public product surface.
e.name: Eeki Foods

e.description: eero makes home mesh Wi-Fi systems that are simple, powerful, secure, and reliable. eero pioneered home mesh wifi and sells products for homes, businesses, service providers, pro installers, and communities, including the eero Pro 7, eero PoE 7, and eero Signal, plus the eero Plus subscription for enhanced security and multi-network management. Devices are managed through the award-winning eero app and are deployed across 27+ countries. eero LLC is based in San Francisco, CA and is an Amazon company. eero does not publish a public developer API or first-party SDK; the eero app communicates with a private, unpublished backend.
e.name: Eero

e.description: eEye Digital Security was an American cybersecurity company and an early pioneer of commercial vulnerability management and vulnerability research. BeyondTrust acquired eEye Digital Security in May 2012, and the company no longer operates as an independent entity or brand. Its former domain, eeye.com, now resolves to BeyondTrust infrastructure — the www host no longer presents a valid TLS certificate, and the domain's DMARC reporting addresses point at beyondtrust.com. eEye publishes no developer portal, documentation, API, SDK, package, or discovery surface of its own; the successor product surface, including the BeyondTrust Password Safe API, is catalogued in the API Evangelist network under the beyondtrust profile. This record is retained as a historical company entry and an acquisition pointer rather than as an active API provider.
e.name: eEye Digital Security

e.description: EFEX (efex.com, formerly efexpay.com) is a cross-border payments and treasury fintech serving businesses across the Americas. It enables international transfers to 140+ countries, bulk and mass payouts for payroll and multi-beneficiary disbursement, multi-currency business accounts (USD, MXN, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY), international collections in local currency across 24+ countries, and FX and currency management for treasury optimization. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California with operations across Mexico (Mexico City, Monterrey, Tijuana, Queretaro, Guadalajara) and Colombia, EFEX is authorized by Mexico's CNBV as a money transmitter (registration 22469) and regulated by FinCEN in the United States. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company exposes a business web/app product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.
e.name: EFEX (Ventu)

e.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Effa

e.description: EFFECT Photonics is an optical-semiconductor company headquartered at High Tech Campus 37 in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, with sites in the United Kingdom, the United States and Taiwan. Spun out of Eindhoven University of Technology, it designs and manufactures coherent optical transceiver subsystems and monolithically integrated Indium Phosphide (InP) photonic integrated circuits, including its pico and nano Integrable Tunable Laser Assemblies for 100G, 400G and 800G coherent links across telecom access and metro networks, data-center interconnect and AI scale-across infrastructure. It operates no developer API programme and publishes no product, network-management or transceiver-control API, no developer portal, no SDK and no pricing. It is catalogued here because its corporate website runs a live WordPress REST API with 290 discoverable routes — including a publicly readable optical-product catalogue with hardware taxonomies (product line, form factor, output power, tuning range, operating temperature, target application, management interface) and a first-party `effect/v1` namespace — and because that same install exposes two Model Context Protocol servers guarded by an OAuth 2.1 authorization server the host advertises through RFC 8414 and RFC 9728 metadata.
e.name: EFFECT Photonics

e.description: Effectful Technologies is the company behind Effect, an open-source ecosystem of production-grade TypeScript libraries. The flagship `effect` library is a composable standard library and execution engine that unifies error handling, resource management, concurrency, dependency injection, observability, schema, and testability, letting developers focus on what a program should accomplish rather than how. Effect is positioned as "Layer 0" of a broader vision extending into distributed systems — RPC, SQL, clustering, AI integrations, and durable execution. The ecosystem ships as first-party npm packages under the `effect` and `@effect/*` scopes (MIT licensed) from the Effect-TS GitHub organization. Effectful is developer-tooling / library company, not an HTTP API provider, and is backed by Amplify Partners.
e.name: Effectful

e.description: Effectiv is a real-time fraud and risk decisioning platform for banks and fintechs, founded in 2021 and acquired by Socure in 2024 for approximately $136M. Its AI-driven decisioning engine and orchestration layer let risk teams automate decisions across the customer lifecycle, integrating 50+ third-party data and solution providers behind one developer-friendly API. The platform spans identity verification (KYC and Know-Your-Business KYB), payment and identity fraud controls across card, ACH, wire, check, and real-time payment rails, AML transaction monitoring, and credit underwriting, backed by a unified case-management workspace and client-side Device Intelligence SDKs for iOS and React Native.
e.name: Effectiv

e.description: Efference AI is a robotics perception and compute company building the hardware-plus-software foundation for data-driven robotics at scale. Founded in 2025 by Gianluca Bencomo and based in San Francisco (Y Combinator Fall 2025), Efference treats machine vision as a software problem, pairing affordable stereo-camera hardware with learned 3D-perception foundation models ("cheap hardware + great algorithms"). Its M1 device targets distributed, robotics-grade data collection at scale, while the H1 stereo system is built for real-time cloud inference with foundation models. The company serves autonomous vehicles, humanoid robots, and drones, and publishes hardware-interfacing documentation and firmware through its GitHub organization. As of this profile Efference exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or authenticated service surface.
e.name: Efference AI

e.description: Efficient Capital Labs (ECL) is a fintech providing fast, flexible non-dilutive, revenue-based capital to global B2B SaaS and AI companies. Founded in 2022 and backed by QED Investors, ECL turns predictable recurring revenue (ARR) into upfront growth capital without dilution, using its AURA AI underwriting engine for cross-border funding decisions in days rather than months. Its product suite spans Non-Dilutive Capital, ECL Flex (capital, payments, and financial insights), ECL Flow (cross-border payments with up to $1M/month free transfers), and Embedded Finance that lets platforms embed ECL financing into their own experience. ECL reports $200M+ deployed across 250+ founders globally with an 80%+ return-customer rate.
e.name: Efficient Capital Labs

e.description: Efficient Computer builds general-purpose, energy-minimal processors for edge and embedded AI. Its Fabric architecture is a reconfigurable spatial dataflow array that maps application graphs directly onto hardware, eliminating the wasteful data movement of traditional Von Neumann CPUs. The Electron E1 processor pairs the Fabric with an integrated RISC-V scalar core to deliver up to 100x better energy efficiency than low-power CPUs, and the proprietary effcc compiler acts as a drop-in replacement for GCC/Clang that extracts dataflow from C, C++, and TensorFlow Lite while preserving GDB-compatible debugging. Efficient Computer is a silicon and developer-toolchain company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, backed by Union Square Ventures, targeting on-device AI inference, IoT, and industrial and physical-AI systems that must run for years on a single charge.
e.name: Efficient Computer

e.description: Efficient Frontier was a digital advertising optimization and search marketing company founded in 2002 that applied algorithmic, finance-inspired bid optimization to manage over $1 billion in annual marketing spend across search, display, and social (notably Facebook ad buying) for enterprise clients such as Discover, Travelodge, and Match.com. Adobe acquired the company in late 2011 (announced November 30, 2011; completed January 2012) and folded its multi-channel ad forecasting, execution, and optimization capabilities into the Adobe Digital Marketing / Advertising Cloud. The efrontier.com domain now redirects to adobe.com and the company has no independent website, developer portal, or public API.
e.name: Efficient Frontier

e.description: Efflux (Efflux Systems, Inc.) is a Baltimore, Maryland cybersecurity company founded in 2014 that operates a near real-time asset intelligence and attack-surface platform. Efflux delivers fresh intelligence about the assets of organizations, networks, and services — offered as a one-time Asset Map, scheduled monitoring, or on-demand custom scanning. Its differentiator is radical transparency: rather than opaque risk scores and surface-level abstractions, Efflux records and exposes every scan it runs, every asset it discovers, and every attribution it makes, so teams can see what was found, how it was discovered, and why it matters — raw information and formatted insights side by side. Data is accessible via export, download, share, and a programmatic API. The company is backed by 500 Global, Granite Hill Capital Partners, TEDCO, and Three Tree Ventures, and is currently in early access with a public waitlist.
e.name: Efflux Systems

e.description: effx was a San Francisco developer-tools startup, founded in 2018 by Joey Parsons, that built a modern microservice catalog to help engineering teams navigate and operate microservices architectures — tracking service ownership, cataloging services, enforcing service standards, tracking migrations, and supporting incident response. The company raised a $3.9M seed round led by Kleiner Perkins alongside Cowboy Ventures. effx was acquired by Figma in 2021; the product was shut down and the team joined Figma's engineering organization. effx.com is now an acquisition/farewell notice and there is no live API, developer documentation, SDK, or public source surface to enrich.
e.name: effx

e.description: eFishery is an Indonesian aquaculture technology ("fishtech") company founded in 2013 in Bandung by Gibran Huzaifah and Chrisna Aditya. Its platform combined an IoT smart auto-feeder (eFeeder) that dispenses feed to fish and shrimp ponds and streams pond telemetry to a smartphone app, with an integrated services layer: eFisheryKu / eFarm farm-management software, eFund (including the Kabayan "pay later" financing product) linking smallholder farmers to lenders, and eFresh / eMart marketplaces connecting farmers to feed suppliers and downstream buyers. The company raised a $90M Series C (2022) and a $200M Series D (2023) at a unicorn valuation, backed by investors including 500 Global, Aqua-Spark, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Temasek, and Northstar. In late 2024 an audit alleged large-scale financial-statement fraud dating to 2018; both founders resigned and the company underwent multiple rounds of layoffs and restructuring through 2025. This record was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; eFishery exposes no public developer API or developer portal, and its primary efishery.com domain currently resolves to a parked/forwarding host.
e.name: eFishery

e.description: Efreshli is a Cairo, Egypt based online home-furnishing and interior-design commerce platform founded in 2018 by Heba El Gabaly. The company lets consumers design and shop their space online, pairing an e-commerce catalog of furniture, decor, lighting, rugs, bedding, and kitchen and dining goods with AI-assisted room design tools, curated collections, a gift registry, an Efreshli Pro membership, and a B2B / trade program that connects a network of vendors and brands. Efreshli is backed by 500 Global, Algebra Ventures, Marakez, and angel investor Tarek Sakr. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Efreshli operates a consumer e-commerce web storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.
e.name: Efreshli

e.description: Efí (formerly Gerencianet) is a Brazilian payment institution and digital bank that exposes well-documented public REST APIs for the Brazilian financial system - Pix (immediate and dated charges, send/receive, refunds, webhooks), Boletos and Charges (Cobranças), Carnê installment booklets, subscriptions and payment links, Pix via Open Finance, and account financial services. Pix and Open Finance APIs require OAuth2 client-credentials plus a mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificate as mandated by the Brazilian Central Bank; the Cobranças API uses OAuth2 without mTLS.
e.name: Efí

e.description: Efí Pay (formerly Gerencianet) is a Brazilian fintech and Banco Central-licensed payment institution headquartered in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. It provides a developer-first payments stack covering Pix (instant payments), Boleto / Bolix / Carnê (Brazilian bank slips), credit-card processing, recurring billing (assinaturas + carnês), marketplace splits, programmatic account opening (BaaS), Open Finance payment initiation, bill-payment automation, and CNAB statement extraction. The company rebranded from Gerencianet to Efí Pay / Efí Bank in 2022 and is rated at the top tier by Banco Central for its Pix API. The technical surface is exposed as five distinct REST APIs (Cobranças, Pix, Open Finance, Pagamentos, Contas) with twelve official SDKs plus e-commerce plugins.
e.name: Efí Pay (Gerencianet)

e.description: Egab is a journalism platform founded in late 2020 and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, that connects local journalists across the Global South — the Middle East, Africa, and beyond (60+ countries) — with international media outlets. It specializes in solutions journalism, offering journalists mentoring, editorial support, skills development, and fair compensation from pitch to publication, while giving newsrooms cost-efficient access to authentic, exclusive stories and diverse local contributors without flying in reporters.
e.name: Egab

e.description: eGenesis is a biotechnology company working at the intersection of genome engineering and transplantation to make organ transplants accessible to all. Using a multiplex CRISPR gene-editing and genome-engineering platform, eGenesis engineers porcine (pig) donor organs that are immunologically and molecularly compatible with human recipients and free of porcine endogenous retroviruses, aiming to end waitlist mortality by removing donor-organ scarcity as a barrier to transplantation. Its pipeline spans kidney, liver, and heart xenotransplantation programs; the U.S. FDA has cleared its IND for EGEN-2784, a genetically engineered porcine kidney, to begin a Phase 1/2/3 trial in patients with end-stage kidney disease. eGenesis is a private, venture-backed company (investors include Lux Capital). This API Evangelist profile tracks the company for network discovery; eGenesis publishes a corporate and scientific web presence but does not currently expose a public developer API.
e.name: eGenesis

e.description: Eggrock (Eggrock Modular Solutions; legally Innovative Modular Pre-Fabrication LLC) is a North American manufacturer of prefabricated "bathroom-in-a-box" pods — complete, custom, ready-to-install bathrooms built off-site using BIM-driven design and lean manufacturing for hotels, hospitals, dormitories, military barracks, and other multi-unit construction projects. Off-site fabrication compresses construction schedules and improves quality versus building bathrooms on site. In 2012 Eggrock licensed exclusive North American manufacturing and distribution to Oldcastle Precast. It is a construction / building-products manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.
e.name: Eggrock

e.description: eGifter is a digital gift card platform that allows people to easily send and receive gift cards for a wide variety of retailers and brands. Users can choose from hundreds of options including popular stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Whether it's for a birthday, holiday, or just to show appreciation, eGifter makes it simple to find the perfect gift for any occasion.
e.name: eGifter

e.description: Egnyte is an enterprise content collaboration and file sharing platform that provides secure cloud and hybrid file storage, document collaboration, governance, and data security controls for regulated industries. Egnyte's Public API exposes the file system, users, groups, permissions, audit reporting, links, and workflow capabilities so partners and customers can build custom integrations. Authentication is handled via OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code, Implicit, Resource Owner, and Refresh Token flows) scoped per API surface.
e.name: Egnyte

e.description: EGYM is a Munich-headquartered fitness and health technology company that builds the connected-gym platform used by commercial fitness operators worldwide: Smart Strength and Smart Flex networked equipment, the EGYM Genius AI training engine, the EGYM Fitness Hub and Trainer apps, and the EGYM Wellpass / Corporate Fitness membership network that lets employers give staff access to thousands of partner venues. For developers, EGYM operates a public developer portal at developer.egym.com covering eight machine-readable APIs across three integration audiences — member-management-system (MMS) vendors syncing members, memberships, RFID/NFC credentials, check-ins, products and trainer tasks into EGYM Cloud; equipment vendors submitting body, cardio and flexibility measurements from devices or backends; and analytics consumers exporting workout and measurement data. EGYM also publishes an official documentation MCP server, an llms.txt, a written AI-agent instruction page, a dated change log, published rate limits and a documented webhook event catalog.
e.name: EGYM

e.description: eHarmony is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of sequoia-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
e.name: eHarmony

e.description: eHealth, Inc. (NASDAQ: EHTH) operates a licensed online health insurance marketplace where U.S. consumers can compare and enroll in health coverage from more than 180 insurance carriers across all 50 states and Washington, D.C. Founded in 1997, the company offers individual and family plans, Medicare products (Medicare Advantage, Medigap, and Part D prescription drug plans), small-business coverage, and Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA). eHealth also provides a partner-facing developer API, documented at its gated developer portal, that lets affiliates and partners embed health-insurance shopping, quoting, and enrollment into their own applications.
e.name: eHealth

e.description: EHRbase is an open source openEHR Clinical Data Repository (CDR) - a standards-based backend for storing, versioning and querying structured clinical data. It implements the official openEHR REST API (ITS-REST 1.0.2) against openEHR Reference Model 1.1.0, is queried with the Archetype Query Language (AQL), and adds Simplified Data Template projections (flat and structured JSON web templates) that make deeply nested openEHR compositions practical to write against. It is Apache-2.0 software each organization self-hosts - no vendor API host, no signup, no metering - maintained by vitagroup AG with the openEHR community, with a commercial distribution (HIP EHRbase) adding multi-tenancy, IHE ATNA audit logging, AQL event triggers, Saga-pattern transaction compensation and SLAs. A public credential-free sandbox at sandkiste.ehrbase.org serves its live OpenAPI 3.1.0 contract of 63 operations.
e.name: EHRbase

e.description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) is the independent statistical and analytical agency within the U.S. Department of Energy, created by the Department of Energy Organization Act of 1977, that collects, analyzes, and disseminates energy information for the United States. EIA sits at the measurement layer of the American energy value chain rather than the operating layer - it does not generate, transmit, distribute, or retail energy, and it does not regulate anyone. Instead it compels the industry to report through mandatory survey forms (EIA-860, EIA-861, EIA-923, EIA-176, EIA-914, EIA-930 and dozens more) and then publishes the result as the reference statistics for electricity, natural gas, petroleum, coal, nuclear, renewables, emissions, and international energy. EIA's API posture is the strongest of any organization in this sector and a genuine benchmark for government data anywhere. The Open Data APIv2 at api.eia.gov/v2 is a fully RESTful, self-documenting, hierarchically routed API covering more than two million time series, described by a real downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 contract carrying 225 paths and 278 operations, opened by a free API key that is emailed automatically from a public registration form with no review, no accreditation, and no licence to sign. A companion bulk download facility at api.eia.gov/bulk serves the same data as manifest-indexed zip archives and requires no key at all. The split that defines this sector is absolute here. EIA's market, system, and grid data is wide open - hourly balancing-authority demand and interchange, wholesale and spot prices, generator-level capacity and operations - while EIA publishes no consumer energy data API of any kind. There is no Green Button, no ESPI, no Download My Data, no Connect My Data, no consent flow, and no customer usage or billing endpoint, because individual customer data is never collected by EIA in the first place; its surveys arrive already aggregated from utilities and are further protected by statutory confidentiality. EIA is therefore the clearest instance of the recurring finding in this series - a federal data agency that publishes a far better documented, far more accessible API than the regulated utilities whose numbers it reports.
e.name: EIA

e.description: EidoStack provides an AI model evaluation workspace that lets developers compare, test, and analyze large language models across providers. The platform offers side‑by‑side quality, cost, token, and context comparisons, enabling informed decisions before production deployment. Features include free tier testing, secure API key handling, detailed analytics, and tools for prompt regression, model benchmarking, and workflow integration across multiple AI providers.
e.name: EidoStack

e.description: Eigen Technologies is a London-based intelligent document processing (IDP) and data-extraction company that uses natural language processing, object detection and machine learning to extract, classify and interpret structured data from unstructured documents at scale. Its no-code platform lets teams in financial services, insurance, law and professional services pull hundreds of datapoints out of contracts, loan agreements and filings to manage risk, automate processes and meet regulatory obligations, with extracted data pushed downstream via its document-processing API. Founded in 2014 and backed by Goldman Sachs, Temasek, Lakestar, Dawn Capital, ING Ventures, Anthemis and the Sony Innovation Fund, Eigen was acquired by contract-lifecycle-management platform Sirion in June 2024.
e.name: Eigen

e.description: Shanghai Eigencomm Technology Co., Ltd. is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2017 and headquartered in the Zhangjiang district of Shanghai, China, dedicated to the research, design, and sale of cellular Internet of Things (IoT) communication chipsets and their supporting software. Eigencomm has mass-produced NB-IoT and Cat.1bis chip series that power smart meters, smart security, mobile payment, shared devices, asset trackers, charging piles, wearables, smart firefighting, and smart home appliances, and is developing 5G silicon. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund II, Qiming Venture Partners, and others, having raised roughly USD 171M across multiple rounds. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes no public web API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.
e.name: eigencomm

e.description: EigenDA is a secure, high-throughput, decentralized data availability (DA) service built on top of Ethereum using EigenLayer restaking primitives. Developed by Eigen Labs and operated as the flagship product of EigenCloud, EigenDA accepts blobs of rollup data from rollup sequencers, erasure-codes them, distributes the chunks across a network of EigenLayer-restaked operators, and produces aggregate BLS signatures that anchor data availability on Ethereum L1. The service is positioned as a hyperscale DA layer for rollups, advertising 1 GB/s of design throughput and is secured by 4M+ ETH restaked through EigenLayer with validators that include Coinbase, Google, Nethermind, and Puffer. EigenDA is consumed today by rollups and chains including Celo, MegaETH, and Aevo, with integrations available for Arbitrum Orbit, OP Stack, Nitro, and the Sovereign SDK. The protocol exposes a gRPC API surface across a Disperser (blob ingest and status), Relays (blob and chunk retrieval), Retriever (reconstructive retrieval), Churner (operator registration), and Validator/Node endpoints. v2 of the protocol introduces a payment vault and the GetPaymentState RPC on the Disperser, replacing per-account static throughput reservations with a programmatic payments surface. The reference implementation is open source in Go (with a Rust client and SDKs in Rust and TypeScript), licensed Apache-2.0 / MIT, and developed in the open on GitHub.
e.name: EigenDA

e.description: EigenLayer is a restaking protocol on Ethereum operated by Layr Labs that lets stakers re-use staked ETH (or liquid-staking tokens) to secure additional off-chain services called Actively Validated Services (AVSs). The team has since unified the restaking layer with EigenDA (data availability), EigenCompute (verifiable off-chain compute), and EigenAI (deterministic inference) under the EigenCloud brand. Developer surface includes the EigenLayer core smart contracts, AVS framework, EigenSDK in Go and TypeScript, EigenCloud CLI, and language SDKs for EigenCompute / EigenDA / EigenAI.
e.name: EigenLayer

e.description: EigenPal is an AI document-automation platform that replaces manual document reading and data entry for enterprises. Teams build directed graphs of typed steps (workflows) or Git-backed agents that parse, extract, classify, transform, and route data from messy scans, handwritten forms, invoices, KYC documents, claims, shipping forms, contracts, and receipts. Workflows are authored as plain files, evaluated against datasets with automated scoring before going live, and deployed on-prem or in the cloud. A public REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs, and a CLI let developers start and monitor runs, manage files and datasets, collect human reviews, run evaluation experiments, and receive signed run-lifecycle webhooks.
e.name: Eigenpal

e.description: Eigentech (eigentech.ai) is an artificial intelligence technology company, reported to have been founded around 2016 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, that applies AI and machine learning to business and industrial domains. Its platform is positioned to help enterprises improve operational efficiency, optimize workflows, and strengthen data-driven decision-making by embedding AI into existing business processes. Eigentech is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for the enrichment pipeline. NOTE - as of the latest enrichment pass the company website (https://eigentech.ai) does not resolve and no public developer, documentation, or API surface could be reached, so no API artifacts could be harvested without fabrication.
e.name: Eigentech

e.description: Eight Sleep builds the Pod, a temperature-regulating smart mattress cover with Autopilot AI sleep optimization, sleep and biometric tracking, thermal alarms, and an adjustable Base. Eight Sleep does NOT publish an official public developer API. This catalog documents the UNOFFICIAL, community-reverse-engineered client API (auth-api.8slp.net, client-api.8slp.net, app-api.8slp.net) that powers the Eight Sleep mobile app and is used by open-source projects such as pyEight and the Home Assistant Eight Sleep integration. Endpoints can change without notice and are not supported by Eight Sleep.
e.name: Eight Sleep

e.description: Eightfold AI is an agentic Talent Intelligence Platform that combines enterprise HR data with insights from more than a billion career profiles to power talent acquisition, talent management, workforce planning, internal mobility, resource management, and AI-driven interviewing. The platform is delivered as enterprise SaaS with sales-led onboarding; APIs and ATS/HRIS integrations are exposed to customers and certified partners (e.g. Oracle Fusion Cloud Recruiting) under contract rather than via a public, self-serve developer portal.
e.name: Eightfold AI

e.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company that integrates Nobel Prize-winning super-resolution single-molecule tracking (SMT) microscopy, advanced engineering, automation, and high-performance computing to visualize and measure the real-time movement of individual proteins in living cells. This proprietary live-cell imaging platform screens protein-ligand interactions across millions of cells per day, generating large, high-dimensional datasets that power the discovery and development of novel small-molecule medicines. Eikon advances a clinical- and preclinical-stage oncology and immunology pipeline, including EIK1001 (a TLR7/8 agonist) and IMP1734 (a selective PARP1 inhibitor). Backed by General Catalyst, the company is headquartered in Millbrae, California with offices in New York and Jersey City.
e.name: Eikon

e.description: EIN Presswire, operated by Newsmatics Inc. of Washington, D.C., is a press release distribution service for businesses, agencies, nonprofits and public figures. Releases are submitted through its web form, editorially reviewed, and syndicated to AP News, the USA TODAY Network, Nexstar Media Group, Google News, Bing, Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, Moody's NewsEdge, Naviga and 3,900+ Affinity Group Publications, then published as RSS feeds broken out by industry, country and US state. Distribution is sold as prepaid packages rather than subscriptions, and there is no public developer API: the company's own FAQ states that press releases are only accepted through the website submission form.
e.name: EIN Newswire

e.description: Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) is a public technical university in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, and one of the four institutions of the 4TU federation. It operates no public developer portal, publishes no institution-authored API contract, and offers no self-serve API keys — and this profile says so rather than padding the gap. Everything machine-readable that carries the TU/e name is a deployment of somebody else's software: the TU/e Research Portal and its Pure Web Service REST API are Elsevier Pure 5.35.x running at pure.tue.nl, the student mobile app at osiris.tue.nl is Caci Osiris, library discovery is OCLC WorldCat, and research datasets are minted through the 4TU.ResearchData Figshare consortium. What TU/e genuinely operates on its own domain is narrower and real: a live, fully conformant OAI-PMH 2.0 harvesting endpoint at pure.tue.nl/ws/oai serving seven metadata formats and the OpenAIRE CERIF 1.2 CRIS profile, and a SAML 2.0 identity-provider entity registered in the SURFconext federation and so reachable through eduGAIN. Thirty-seven OpenAPI documents previously attributed to TU/e in this repository were Elsevier's Pure product contract (info.title "Pure …", contact pure-support@elsevier.com, relative servers "/ws/api", shipped identically by nine other universities) and have been removed; the tenant relationships they described are recorded here instead. Departmental research groups publish open source across many separate GitHub organizations, but the university runs no single official engineering org.
e.name: Eindhoven University of Technology

e.description: EINO (eino.ai) is an AI-native platform for designing, simulating, validating, and monitoring wireless networks — Wi-Fi, Cellular, DAS, Fixed Wireless, LoRa, IoT, and 5G/LTE. It builds connectivity digital twins that let network providers, systems integrators, and enterprises automate network design (cutting multi-day design cycles to minutes) and run 24/7 agentic monitoring with real-time anomaly detection and root-cause analysis. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York City, EINO is backed by 500 Global and Techstars. The company exposes a SaaS web application and a product knowledge base rather than a public developer API.
e.name: EINO

e.description: Einride is a Swedish freight technology company delivering an end-to-end platform for electric and autonomous road freight, combining purpose-built autonomous trucks, electric vehicles, smart charging, and the Saga operating software. Its developer-facing product, Einride Extend, exposes open, resource-oriented APIs (designed with Google AIP) over both gRPC and HTTP for booking truck tours and creating, releasing, and tracking shipments. The Extend APIs are alpha (v1beta1) and offered to select developers during an early-access phase, with a saga CLI, Buf Schema Registry proto module, and React UI component library. Einride serves customers including PepsiCo, Heineken, and DP World across Europe, the US, and the Middle East.
e.name: Einride

e.description: EIS Group (EIS Ltd) is a United States core-systems vendor for insurance, founded in 2008 out of Exigen Insurance Solutions and headquartered in San Francisco, California. EIS sells the EIS Platform and EIS OneSuite — a cloud-native, microservices core suite covering customer management, policy administration, billing, and claims — across group benefits, property and casualty / general, protection, life and annuities, and pet insurance. EIS markets itself as API-first and claims thousands of open REST APIs (1,100 digital APIs announced in 2019, 9,000+ claimed for OneSuite) fronted by the EIS DXP API middleware, but none of that surface is public. There is no self-serve developer portal on eisgroup.com; the documentation host docs.eisgroup.com answers HTTP 401 behind an HTTP Basic realm named "EIS Group Users", so the entire API reference is a customer/partner login wall. No OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, or public Postman collection could be retrieved. The only public code EIS ships is two open-source GitHub repositories (kraken-rules, ui-render), which are libraries rather than APIs. ACORD is attested only indirectly — an analyst evaluation hosted on eisgroup.com states the system integrates using "web services, APIs, RESTful APIs, ACORD and certified ACORD" — with no ACORD artifacts, AL3 mappings, or IVANS/agency-download detail published. What EIS does publish is a substantial certification posture — a certified MACH Alliance membership (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native SaaS, Headless) and a full ISO stack covering 27001, 27701, 22301, 27017, 27018, 27035-1, 12207, 15288, 25000 and ISO/IEC 42001, which EIS announced in June 2025 as the first cloud-native insurance core platform provider to obtain. One first-party package is public, eis-ui-render on npm. This is the canonical United States core-systems posture — the APIs exist and are sold, but they are reachable only through a licensed implementation.
e.name: EIS Group

e.description: Eisen is an AI-enabled compliance operations platform for financial institutions and digital asset companies, managing escheatment (unclaimed property), disbursement, customer outreach, and 1099 tax reporting across all account types. Its product suite includes an Escheatment Manager that tracks state compliance deadlines and dormancy rules, a Disbursement Manager that automates personalized customer payments, an Outreach Manager that re-engages dormant account holders, and a 1099 Reporting Manager for tax reporting. Eisen handles dormant accounts, stale checks, account wind-downs, and forced closures, and is backed by Cowboy Ventures, Homebrew, and Index Ventures. As of this profile Eisen exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation; this record captures its identity and public web surface.
e.name: Eisen

e.description: Ejara is a Cameroon-based, regulated fintech platform giving people across Francophone Africa and its diaspora access to digital savings and investment products through a mobile app. Founded in 2020 in Douala by Nelly Chatue-Diop, Baptiste Andrieux, and Tierno Tall, Ejara lets users save from as little as 1,000 CFA francs in BEAC-guaranteed savings plans earning up to 5% annual interest, and buy, sell, and self-custody cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins using blockchain-based non-custodial wallets. The company is licensed by COSUMAF in the CEMAC zone (SGP-06/2021) and registered with France's Autorite des marches financiers (AMF-E2022-056), and raised an $8M Series A led by Anthemis and Dragonfly. Ejara operates as a consumer mobile application on iOS and Android rather than a public API provider; this profile tracks its developer surface, including open-source blockchain libraries on GitHub, for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Ejara

e.description: Ejari (ايجاري) is a Riyadh-based property-technology and fintech company transforming the rental market in Saudi Arabia with a rent-now, pay-later (RNPL) model. Ejari pays a tenant's full annual rent to the landlord up front, then lets the tenant repay in twelve calm monthly installments, replacing the Kingdom's traditional single-cheque annual rent requirement. Founded in 2022 by Yazeed Al-Shamsi, Fahad Albedah, Mohammed Alkhelewy and Khalid Almunif, the company operates across 17+ Saudi cities and is building toward a full-service, Sharia-compliant real-estate super app. Ejari is backed by 500 Global and won the 2024 KPMG Global Tech Innovator competition.
e.name: Ejari Co.

e.description: Ejen2u is a Malaysian reseller and agent-management technology company that operates one of the country's largest cloud-based reseller ecosystems for MSME brand owners, stockists, agents, dropshippers, and affiliates. Its platform spans EjenGO, a digital reseller and stockist management system; WEMAP, an entrepreneurial education program; and EjenVenture, custom reseller-network solutions for corporate brands, alongside fintech and logistics integrations (Pos Laju, Boost, Curlec, Delyva, J&T). Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Ejen2u is backed by 500 Global, Gobi Partners, and Artem Ventures, and has facilitated hundreds of millions of ringgit in reseller commerce across a network of hundreds of thousands of agents. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile is an API Evangelist network entry enriched from public sources.
e.name: Ejen2u

e.description: Eka Robotics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts robotics-AI company founded in 2025 that is building intelligence for the physical world in its native language: force. Its Vision-Force-Action (VFA) model combines vision, force sensing, and action to give robots generality, performance, and safety for close human-robot interaction. The team pioneers self-supervised robot learning, large-scale robot learning, world models, reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real transfer, drawing talent from MIT, Berkeley, Harvard, DeepMind, and Boston Dynamics. Co-founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal (Improbable AI Lab), the company is an early-stage research-and-hardware venture and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Eka Robotics

e.description: Eko Health Inc. is an Oakland, California digital health company that builds FDA-cleared digital stethoscopes (CORE 500, CORE Digital Attachment, DUO, and the 3M Littmann CORE) together with cloud software and AI algorithms for the detection of cardiovascular and pulmonary disease. Its platform pairs the hardware with the Eko App (iOS/Android), the Eko web Dashboard, Eko AI murmur/AFib/low-ejection-fraction detection, and SENSORA, an enterprise AI cardiac disease detection platform for health systems. For integrators Eko publishes Eko Connect — an Enterprise SDK and API surface that live-streams auscultation audio and single-lead ECG into third-party telehealth, telemedicine cart, and life-science applications. The Enterprise SDK and its backing REST API at api.ekodevices.com are commercially gated: there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve documentation, and access is arranged through Eko sales. The company's public agent-facing surface is its Shopify storefront, which serves a live anonymous MCP server, an agents.md / llms.txt, and Universal Commerce Protocol discovery.
e.name: Eko Health

e.description: eKomoditi (PT Ekomoditi Solutions Indonesia) is a Southeast Asian agriculture-technology company, founded in 2015 and based in Jakarta, that builds digital plantation-management software for oil palm, rubber, sugar, and durian estates. Its flagship Electronic Plantation Control System (ePCS) replaces paper-based field recording with a mobile in-field Android app, an eGIS geographic mapping application, mills automation, and business-intelligence analytics — capturing harvesting, fertilization, pest-management, worker, and transport data for same-day reporting, labor-fraud monitoring, quality control, and traceability. eKomoditi also offers aerial-mapping drone services, a plantation marketplace, and due-diligence consulting. The company is backed by 500 Global and ZB Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.
e.name: Ekomoditi

e.description: Ekpa is an early-stage consumer fintech from Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, building autonomous research agents for trading. The product connects to a user's brokerage accounts through SnapTrade and consolidates accounts, positions, news, and research into a single dashboard, with AI-generated position analysis grounded in news, analyst ratings, and SEC filings. Ekpa is research-and-education only and makes no buy or sell recommendations, leaving every decision to the user. As of this profile Ekpa publishes a single marketing site at goekpa.com and exposes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable artifacts.
e.name: Ekpa

e.description: Eksab is a Cairo-based daily fantasy sports and football-prediction platform for the MENA region. Founded in 2017 by Aly Mahmoud, it lets fans predict the scores and outcomes of live football matches, earn points based on the accuracy of their picks, and win prizes through free and paid competitions. The platform has grown to over 700,000 registered users making more than a million picks each month, and in 2022 became the exclusive fantasy sports partner of the Egyptian Premier League. Eksab is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), 4DX Ventures, and others across roughly $3.7M in seed funding. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Eksab is a consumer mobile/web product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.
e.name: Eksab

e.description: Ekuaibao (合思 / HOSE, formerly 易快报) is a Chinese AI-powered spend-management and expense-control SaaS platform used by more than 7,000 enterprises. It unifies expense reimbursement, business-travel booking and management, corporate payment and settlement, invoice OCR and validation, budget control, BI analytics and electronic accounting archiving. The company operates the 合思开放平台 (Ekuaibao Open Platform), a substantial REST API of 200+ documented operations across two dozen modules — contacts, corporation, budgets, expense flows, forms, fee types, pay and payer info, city and currency master data, data links, matrices, delegates and outbound-message webhooks — letting external systems (OA, ERP, HR, travel) synchronize staff, departments, budgets, documents, invoices and approvals. Access is token-based: an appKey/appSecurity pair is exchanged for a short-lived accessToken (v1) or a JWT-based tenant/platform token (v3).
e.name: Ekuaibao

e.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.
e.name: El-Dokan

e.description: Profile for Elanco Animal Health in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 768).
e.name: Elanco Animal Health

e.description: Elastic is a software company that builds search-powered solutions for observability, security, and search use cases. The Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, and related tools) lets organizations ingest, search, analyze, and visualize structured and unstructured data in real time. Elastic Cloud delivers managed Elasticsearch and Kibana deployments with REST APIs for both data operations and deployment management.
e.name: Elastic

e.description: Elastic Email provides a cloud‑based email delivery platform offering transactional email, marketing campaigns, automation, and a robust API for developers. The service includes email templates, contact management, analytics, and integrations with popular tools, enabling businesses to send and track emails programmatically at scale.
e.name: Elastic Email

e.description: Elastic Observability is Elastic's unified logs, metrics, traces and profiling solution, built on the Elastic Stack. Its published machine-readable contract is the Observability Intake API served by APM Server: a newline-delimited JSON event intake for Elastic APM agents, a central agent-configuration endpoint, and native OpenTelemetry Protocol ingest over both OTLP/HTTP and OTLP/gRPC. Analysis of the telemetry once it has landed happens through Kibana and, for agents, through the Elastic Agent Builder MCP server, which exposes sixteen observability.* tools over a deployment-scoped endpoint.
e.name: Elastic Observability

e.description: Elastic Path is a headless commerce platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for managing catalogs, products, price books, promotions, carts, orders, subscriptions, payments, and customer accounts in composable commerce architectures. It is designed for B2B, D2C, and multi-brand enterprise retailers building API-first, microservices-based shopping experiences.
e.name: Elastic Path

e.description: The Elastic Stack (formerly known as the ELK Stack) is a collection of open-source products from Elastic designed to help users take data from any source, in any format, and search, analyze, and visualize that data in real-time. The stack includes Elasticsearch for search and analytics, Kibana for visualization, Logstash for data processing, and Beats for data shipping.
e.name: Elastic Stack

e.description: The Elastic Stack (formerly known as the ELK Stack) is the collection of open-source products from Elastic — Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Beats/Elastic Agent — designed for taking data from any source, in any format, and searching, analyzing, and visualizing it in real time. It is widely used for log management, observability, security analytics (SIEM), and increasingly as a vector database and retrieval layer for RAG and agentic AI applications. Elastic publishes machine-readable OpenAPI descriptions for all three of its programmable surfaces: the Elasticsearch REST API, the Kibana APIs, and the Elastic Cloud control-plane API. The stack is deployment-hosted — self-managed, Elastic Cloud Hosted, or Elastic Cloud Serverless — so the Elasticsearch and Kibana base URLs are always specific to the customer's own cluster or project.
e.name: Elastic Stack

e.description: Elastic IO is a cloud-based integration platform that helps businesses effortlessly connect their various applications, systems, and services. By providing a user-friendly interface and a wide range of pre-built connectors, elastic.io allows organizations to automate and streamline their data integration processes.
e.name: Elastic.io

e.description: Elastica was a Silicon Valley cloud security startup that pioneered the Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) category, using data science and machine learning to give enterprises visibility into and control over Shadow IT and sanctioned SaaS applications. Its CloudSOC platform combined an API-based control mode (connecting directly to cloud apps such as Office 365, Box, Salesforce, and Google Workspace) with an inline gateway mode for data-loss-prevention, threat detection, and compliance. Backed by Mayfield, Pelion Venture Partners, and Third Point Ventures, Elastica was acquired by Blue Coat Systems for $280 million in November 2015; Blue Coat (with Elastica and Perspecsys) was in turn acquired by Symantec in 2016, where the technology became the Symantec CloudSOC CASB, later part of Broadcom's enterprise security portfolio. Elastica no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no active public developer surface, API, or SDK.
e.name: Elastica

e.description: ElasticBox was a multi-cloud application management and deployment platform founded in 2011 by former Microsoft engineers Alberto Arias Maestro, Amadeo Casas, and Ravi Srivatsav (AngelPad-backed, offices in San Francisco and Madrid).
