Its "boxes" model let enterprise IT define, version, and orchestrate application deployments across more than a dozen clouds — AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM SoftLayer, VMware, vCloud Air and others — with a self-service catalog, a REST API (token-authenticated, JSON), and a Jenkins CI plug-in. The company raised roughly $12.4M across three rounds, including a $9M Series A in 2014 with participation from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Nexus Venture Partners, Intel Capital and Sierra Ventures. CenturyLink acquired ElasticBox in June 2016 and rebuilt the technology as CenturyLink Cloud Application Manager (now part of Lumen). The standalone ElasticBox product, its developer portal, and its public API documentation have been retired; the elasticbox.com domain no longer serves the platform. This profile is preserved as a historical portfolio-lead record — no live, first-party API surface remains to enrich.
e.name: ElasticBox

e.description: ElasticRun (legally NTEx Transportation Services Pvt Ltd) is a Pune, India based B2B e-commerce and rural logistics platform founded in 2016 by Sandeep Deshmukh, Saurabh Nigam and Shitiz Bansal. It operates an aggregated, variable-capacity transportation network that stitches together idle logistics capacity to connect FMCG brands and manufacturers to the mom-and-pop kirana stores of rural and semi-urban India. The platform blends mobile technology with local entrepreneurs to run an assisted-commerce model spanning 125,000+ kiranas and 80,000+ villages across 26 states, offering last-mile delivery, B2B distribution and supply-chain services. ElasticRun is backed by Prosus Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is a network stub: no public developer API, documentation or SDKs were found during enrichment.
e.name: ElasticRun

e.description: Elasticsearch is an open source search and analytics engine for all types of data, including textual, numerical, geospatial, structured, and unstructured. It provides a RESTful API for indexing, searching, and managing data, with powerful aggregation capabilities and real-time analytics at scale.
e.name: Elasticsearch

e.description: Elastifile was an enterprise cloud file-storage company founded in 2013 in Tel Aviv, Israel. It built a software-defined, scale-out distributed file system (the Elastifile Cloud File System / ECFS) that delivered elastic, high-performance NFS-compatible shared storage for enterprise-grade applications running at scale in the public cloud, with the ability to scale capacity out or in on demand. Backed by Battery Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners (among others), Elastifile was acquired by Google Cloud in August 2019 (reported at roughly $200M) and its technology was folded into Google Cloud Filestore, powering the Filestore High Scale / Enterprise tiers. Elastifile no longer operates as an independent company or brand: elastifile.com redirects to Google Cloud Filestore, and there is no standalone Elastifile developer portal, API, or SDK surface to enrich.
e.name: Elastifile

e.description: Elation Health is a United States clinical-first electronic health record (EHR/EMR) and healthcare technology company, founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, serving independent primary care practices, value-based care organizations, digital health startups, and health-tech partners. Beyond its provider-facing EHR, Elation ships a broad, well-documented public REST API (v2.0) that lets partners read and write clinical and administrative data - patient profiles and demographics, allergies and problems, visit notes, clinical and lab/imaging orders, patient documents, scheduling, billing, insurance and eligibility, messaging, practice and user management, care gaps, and data import - authenticated with OAuth2. The API is documented on a ReadMe developer portal backed by machine-readable OpenAPI definitions, augmented with event subscription webhooks and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agentic access. Elation also operates login-gated HL7 FHIR R4 and SMART-on-FHIR interoperability endpoints for ONC/CMS 21st Century Cures Act information-blocking compliance, exposed to registered applications rather than anonymously. Positioned as an independent challenger to the US EHR duopoly, Elation targets the primary-care and value-based-care segment of the largest, most commercial healthcare-API market.
e.name: Elation Health

e.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.
e.name: ElCoach

e.description: Elderly Care Match is a Washington State senior-care directory and placement service that helps families find and compare licensed adult family homes (AFH), assisted living, memory care, nursing homes / skilled nursing and independent living, with listings that are free to browse, many cross-checked against the WA DSHS/ALTSA licence registry, and coverage strongest across the Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue / Puget Sound metro. Its only machine interface is an Agent2Agent (A2A 1.0) agent: a card served at /.well-known/agent-card.json and a JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint at https://www.elderlycarematch.com/a2a/v1 that answers anonymously with four read-only skills — search facilities by location, care type, Medicaid acceptance, vacancy and price; fetch a facility's public profile; search the Learning Center guides; and hand a family off to a care advisor by returning a public form URL. It publishes no OpenAPI, SDK or MCP server; llms.txt is the documentation and robots.txt explicitly welcomes AI crawlers on /.well-known/ and /a2a/.
e.name: Elderly Care Match

e.description: El Dorado is a stablecoin-powered payments SuperApp for Latin America whose public API provides crypto onramp/offramp (buy and sell) infrastructure across Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia, Panama, Paraguay, the Dominican Republic and more. The API lets partners create buy and sell quotes and orders that convert between local fiat currencies (USD, ARS, BRL, COP, PEN and others) and crypto (settled in USDT on Arbitrum), with built-in KYC verification, 80+ local payment methods, and an embeddable Exchange Widget for no-code or low-code integration. Authentication uses per-partner ClientID and ReferralID headers plus a JWT bearer token obtained via an OTP login flow. El Dorado is backed by Multicoin Capital, Coinbase Ventures and Berkeley SkyDeck and has surpassed 500,000 users.
e.name: Eldorado

e.description: Elead (eLEAD / Elead CRM) is an automotive dealership CRM for sales, BDC, and service, now part of CDK Global. Elead exposes a set of partner-gated Vehicle Sales REST APIs - Sales Opportunities, Sales Customers, Sales Activities, and Product Reference Data - published through the CDK Fortellis Automotive Commerce Exchange. The APIs let certified software providers and dealers search and manage prospects/customers, sales opportunities (leads), vehicles of interest and trade-ins, sales teams, and activities inside Elead CRM. Access is not open self-service - developers must be Fortellis users, create a Fortellis solution to obtain client credentials, and have the dealer activate the subscription. There is no public WebSocket API.
e.name: Elead

e.description: Eleanor Health is a value-based, whole-person addiction and mental health care provider delivering virtual and in-person treatment for substance use disorders — including opioid, alcohol, stimulant, and prescription drug use — through medication for addiction treatment (MAT), therapy, peer recovery support, and health coaching. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company partners with health plans and Medicaid programs across multiple U.S. states to deliver measurement-based, outcomes-driven behavioral healthcare. Eleanor Health is backed by General Catalyst. It does not publish a public developer API program; member scheduling and clinical records run on athenahealth, and its public GitHub organization holds internal engineering tooling rather than a first-party API.
e.name: Eleanor Health

e.description: Electio (Electio Technologies) is a San Francisco-based, General Catalyst-backed software company building modern control-system software for energy production and transportation infrastructure. The company modernizes the legacy industrial control layers behind power generation, oil and gas, and transportation networks with next-generation software for monitoring, automation, and operational reliability. Electio is an early-stage, largely stealth company: it publishes a company website, a careers page, a contact page, and a privacy policy, but has not released a public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation as of this profile. This entry was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and enriched as an identity-only lead.
e.name: Electio

e.description: The U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC) is an independent, bipartisan federal commission established by the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (HAVA). It adopts the Voluntary Voting System Guidelines, accredits voting system test laboratories, certifies voting systems, administers and audits HAVA grant funds, and is the national clearinghouse for election administration information. The EAC publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no API key programme, but serves two real anonymous machine surfaces it does not advertise: a live read-only JSON:API 1.0 at https://www.eac.gov/jsonapi (Drupal 10, 216 resource types) carrying the certified voting system register, accredited test labs, manufacturers, Engineering Change Orders, Notices of Clarification, NVRA state pages, per-state registration deadlines, HAVA grant financials and 561 Clearinghouse Awards; and a Project Open Data v1.1 catalog at https://www.eac.gov/data.json listing the EAVS bulk datasets. Both verified.
e.name: Election Assistance Commission

e.description: Election.org Public Data API provides free, anonymous access to a wide range of civic election data, including linked civic JSON datasets and federal CSV files. Users can retrieve information on candidates, results, campaign finance, and more, supporting public insight and research without requiring authentication or payment.
e.name: Election.org Public Data API

e.description: Electra (legal name Electrasteel, Inc.) is a Boulder, Colorado clean-industrial company founded in 2020 that is reinventing ironmaking. Instead of smelting iron ore with fossil fuels in a blast furnace, Electra uses an electrochemical process — an acidic leach plus electrowinning driven by renewable electricity — to dissolve a broad range of iron ores, including low-grade and previously uncommercialized ores, and plate out 99% pure iron at roughly 60°C while recovering high-value co-minerals and emitting oxygen. The modular design lets units be added as building blocks for rapid scaling and lets the process follow intermittent renewable power. Electra has raised over $200M from Rio Tinto, BHP Ventures, POSCO, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Amazon's Climate Pledge Fund, Capricorn and Lowercarbon Capital, runs a pilot plant in Boulder, and is building a demonstration plant in Colorado. It is an industrial manufacturer with no public developer program: as of this profile it publishes no API, developer portal, documentation, machine-readable specification, or /.well-known discovery surface.
e.name: Electra

e.description: Electra is a European operator of ultra-fast electric-vehicle charging, headquartered at 104 rue de Richelieu in the 2nd arrondissement of Paris and led by co-founder and CEO Aurelien de Meaux. It designs, finances, installs and operates its own DC fast-charging stations rather than reselling someone else's hardware, advertising 770+ live stations with 68 more under construction, charge rates up to 400 kW, and a target of 2,200 stations / 15,000 charge points across Europe by 2030. Its own pricing and station pages cover France, Belgium, Spain, Italy, Germany, Austria, the Netherlands and Switzerland, with city hubs in Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Antwerp, Liege, Milan, Bologna, Turin, Madrid, Barcelona and Zurich. The commercial surface is consumer- and fleet-facing: a mobile app, an Electra+ subscription that cuts up to 0.20 EUR/kWh, an RFID charging card, Autocharge and Plug&Charge, and a fleet dashboard at business.go-electra.com. It is a Serena portfolio company and has raised a 160 MEUR round, a 304 MEUR Series B and a 433 MEUR debt facility. Electra publishes NO developer portal, NO API documentation, NO OpenAPI, NO llms.txt, NO MCP server and NO A2A agent card — every one of those was probed and missed on 2026-08-17. What it does run, and what almost nobody looking at the marketing site would find, is a real machine-readable API: a live Open Charge Point Interface implementation in the Charge Point Operator role at https://ocpi.go-electra.com/ocpi/cpo, serving BOTH OCPI 2.1.1 and OCPI 2.2.1 concurrently. Its version-negotiation endpoints answer anonymously with HTTP 200 and enumerate the full module inventory — cdrs, commands, credentials, locations, sessions, tariffs and tokens, with SENDER/RECEIVER roles declared on the 2.2.1 surface — while every data module itself returns HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Token realm="Application"`, OCPI's own bilateral token scheme. That is a documented open industry standard, fully implemented, discoverable without credentials and readable only with a roaming agreement; its production use is evidenced by the 180+ e-mobility service provider cards Electra's own help centre lists as accepted at its chargers.
e.name: Electra

e.description: Electra Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2018 and pioneering first-in-class antibody therapies directed at signal regulatory proteins (SIRP) for immunological diseases and cancer. Its lead candidate, ELA026 (ipsoprubart), is a monoclonal antibody targeting SIRP-alpha/beta1/gamma on myeloid cells and T lymphocytes to selectively deplete the pathological immune cells that drive the cytokine storm in secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (sHLH); it is in the pivotal SURPASS Phase 2/3 study. A second SIRP-targeted program, ELA822, is directed at activated T lymphocytes for immunology and inflammation indications. The company has raised roughly $267M from investors including OrbiMed, Nextech Invest, EQT Life Sciences and Westlake Village BioPartners. Electra publishes a corporate website, pipeline, publications, clinical-trial and news pages, but no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.
e.name: Electra Therapeutics

e.description: Electra is an American aerospace manufacturer developing hybrid-electric "Ultra Short" aircraft that combine blown lift with hybrid-electric propulsion to take off and land in roughly 150 feet, removing the runway from regional air travel. Founded in 2020 by Dr. John Langford, the founder of Aurora Flight Sciences, with MIT professors John Hansman and Mark Drela as technical advisors, Electra flew its EL2 Goldfinch technology demonstrator in November 2023 and submitted an FAA Part 23 type-certification application for the nine-passenger EL9 Ultra Short in December 2025. The company reports more than 2,200 pre-orders from over 60 operators, and works both a commercial regional air-mobility market and a defense last-tactical-leg airlift market backed by U.S. Air Force SBIR Phase III and STTR contracts. It is headquartered in Manassas, Virginia, with operations in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Switzerland and a production facility under development at AirPark Ohio adjacent to Springfield-Beckley Municipal Airport. Strategic investors include Lockheed Martin Ventures, Honeywell and Safran. Electra publishes no developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; the one public, anonymous JSON API it serves is the Statamic CMS content surface behind its newsroom, discovered and documented here by probe.
e.name: Electra.aero

e.description: Electric (Electric AI) is an IT and security management platform for small and medium-sized businesses, consolidating device management, application and SaaS management, security posture monitoring with automatic remediation, and employee onboarding/offboarding into a single platform that requires no in-house IT skills and syncs with HR systems. Founded in New York and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Electric bundles partner tooling (JumpCloud MDM/SSO, Keeper, ThreatDown, Harmony Email, Perimeter81 VPN, Drata) behind an AI-powered IT Hub, help desk, and hardware procurement service. It is not a developer-API company: there is no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company and enriched from Electric's public web surface.
e.name: Electric

e.description: Electric Capital is an engineering-led venture capital firm founded in 2018 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, investing in founders building frontier technologies across crypto, cryptography, distributed systems, and AI. The firm backs user-owned technology and cryptographic infrastructure that reduces reliance on intermediaries and gives users control, privacy, and access. Electric Capital invests from pre-seed through growth, with typical checks ranging from roughly $1M to $15M+, and has deployed more than $3B since inception across multiple funds (including a $1B raise announced in 2022). Its portfolio spans DeFi, layer-1 and layer-2 infrastructure, exchanges, developer tools, security, identity, and select AI, fintech, healthcare, and deep-tech companies, with notable investments including Solana, Kraken, EigenLayer/EigenCloud, dYdX, Magic Eden, Sui/Mysten Labs, NEAR, Consensys, and Aave. The firm is also known for authoring the widely cited annual Electric Capital Developer Report.
e.name: Electric Capital

e.description: The Electric Car Scheme is a UK B Corp providing electric vehicle salary sacrifice as an employee benefit. Employees lease any electric car of their choice with the monthly cost deducted from gross salary before Income Tax and National Insurance, saving 20-50% versus a personal lease, while employers save on Class 1A National Insurance. Packages are all-inclusive (lease, insurance, maintenance, servicing and breakdown) with Complete Protection covering employees who leave partway through a lease term. The company integrates with employer payroll systems via API or SFTP and offers Single Sign-On for employees, plus an included Charge Scheme for charging access.
e.name: Electric Car Scheme

e.description: Electric Hydrogen (EH2) is a Massachusetts-based clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and commissions the world's most powerful PEM electrolyzers, packaged into a fully-integrated 100MW HYPRPlant that turns water and renewable electricity into the lowest-cost green hydrogen. The complete plant solution bundles power conversion, gas processing, water treatment, and thermal management so heavy industry can decarbonize ammonia, e-fuels, steel, and refining at gigawatt scale. Founded in 2020 and led by CEO Raffi Garabedian, EH2 operates a 1.2GW gigafactory in Devens, Massachusetts, became green hydrogen's first unicorn with a $380M Series C, and is backed by Fifth Wall, Fortescue, Energy Impact Partners, bp Ventures, Temasek, and Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund. This profile enriches the API Evangelist network stub with the company's real public web surface.
e.name: Electric Hydrogen

e.description: Electricity Maps provides electricity grid data - carbon intensity and power production/consumption breakdown - for 200+ zones worldwide, in real time, as historical series, and as 24-72 hour forecasts. The REST API serves the same data behind the live electricity map at app.electricitymap.org, authenticated with an auth-token header.
e.name: Electricity Maps

e.description: Electricity North West — rebranded SP Electricity North West in August 2025 after Iberdrola acquired it and folded it in alongside SP Energy Networks — is the regulated electricity distribution network operator for the North West of England, running roughly 13,000 km of overhead line and more than 44,000 km of underground cable from Cumbria to Manchester. It is a poles-and-wires business in the regulated middle of the United Kingdom value chain: it owns the meter point and the network, it earns a regulated revenue under Ofgem's RIIO-ED2 price control, and it never bills the household — the supplier does. Its API posture is a clean split and worth stating plainly. On the MARKET-DATA side it is genuinely API-native for a network operator: it runs an Opendatasoft-hosted open data portal at electricitynorthwest.opendatasoft.com carrying 146 datasets — embedded capacity register, DFES scenarios, LV headroom and peak demand, network capacity heatmaps, GSP connection queue, GIS conductor and substation layers — served through the documented Opendatasoft Explore REST API v2.1 (and legacy v2.0) with a real OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract, a DCAT-AP catalogue export, and an in-portal API console. 96 of those datasets are CC BY 4.0 and 8 are Open Government Licence v3.0, but 41 sit under a bespoke "SP ENW Shared Licence" rather than an open one. On the CONSUMER-DATA side there is nothing: the United Kingdom has no consumer energy data-portability right equivalent to Australia's Consumer Data Right, Great Britain's smart-meter mandate produced infrastructure (the licensed Smart DCC) rather than a data right, Green Button has no UK footprint, and Electricity North West publishes no customer usage or billing API of any kind. The obligation that actually binds it is Ofgem's Data Best Practice Guidance under the RIIO-ED2 digitalisation licence condition — an open-data duty, not a consumer data right — and the portal is a real, verifiable implementation of it. Note that the corporate site www.enwl.co.uk sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge and returns HTTP 403 to every non-browser client, so no part of the main website is machine-readable.
e.name: Electricity North West

e.description: ElectricSQL (Electric) is a local-first sync engine for Postgres that streams live database changes to embedded clients in browsers, apps, and AI agents via an HTTP-based Shape sync protocol. It exposes a low-level HTTP API and TypeScript, Elixir, and other client SDKs that materialize real-time Postgres data into local state with sub-millisecond reactivity. Developers can run Electric self-hosted as a Docker service or use Electric Cloud, a managed offering with pay-as-you-go and subscription plans. The platform also underpins PGlite (an embeddable Postgres under 3 MB) and Durable Streams for reliable agent messaging, making it a broader data-infrastructure toolkit for building collaborative and multi-agent systems.
e.name: ElectricSQL

e.description: Electrify America is the largest open EV fast-charging network in the United States, operating more than 5,600 DC fast chargers at over 1,080 locations across the US and Canada. Subsidiary of Volkswagen Group of America, the network offers charging speeds up to 350 kW and supports CCS, CHAdeMO, and NACS connectors. Electrify America provides REST APIs through a partner developer portal that enables automotive OEMs and enterprise integrators to locate charging stations, check real-time charger availability, retrieve session pricing, and manage charging sessions. Authentication is handled via OAuth2 / Auth0. A consumer-facing mobile app (iOS/Android) provides pass-based subscription plans (Pass and Pass+) with per-kWh pricing, and the Plug&Charge standard (ISO 15118) is supported at all stations for certificate-based auto-authentication.
e.name: Electrify America

e.description: Electroflow Technologies is a United States deep-tech company (founded 2023, headquartered in San Bruno, California) developing an electrochemical direct lithium extraction (DLE) process that pulls lithium from dilute North American brines containing under 200ppm lithium using renewable electricity and minimal chemicals. Its cell uses anodes that absorb lithium ions from brine on one pass and release them into a carbonate solution on the reverse pass, producing battery-grade lithium carbonate that is reacted with iron and phosphate to make lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cathode powder domestically — a three-step route versus the traditional ten-step process, targeting LFP material at roughly 40% below Chinese producers. The company raised a $10M seed round in October 2025 led by Union Square Ventures with Voyager Ventures, Fifty Years, and Harpoon Ventures, and counts Breakthrough Energy among its backers. Electroflow is a hardware and battery-materials company; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal only.
e.name: Electroflow

e.description: Electrolux is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: stockholm-trip) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
e.name: Electrolux

e.description: Electronic Arts (EA) is a global leader in digital interactive entertainment, developing and delivering games, content, and online services for internet-connected consoles, mobile devices, and personal computers. EA's portfolio includes franchises such as EA SPORTS FC, Madden NFL, Battlefield, The Sims, Apex Legends, and Need for Speed, supported by online services like the EA app, EA Play, and EA Help. EA runs no public developer portal and publishes no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or gRPC contract. Its one API programme is the EA SPORTS FC Community API, announced 2026-07-27, which lets a player grant an approved community site (FUT.GG, FUTBIN, FUTWIZ) delegated read access to Ultimate Team data through EA's OAuth flow; EA states it is not accepting further partner requests. The only machine-readable documents EA serves anywhere are the OpenID Connect Discovery and RFC 8414 authorization-server metadata on accounts.ea.com, plus the JWKS they reference.
e.name: Electronic Arts

e.description: Electronic Payment Exchange (EPX) is a full-stack, PCI-compliant payments platform that has processed card, ACH, and alternative payments for merchants and banks across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean for more than forty years. Now part of North (North American Bancard), EPX combines the roles of ISO, merchant acquirer, gateway, and front-end and back-end processor under one contract. Its BRIC technology issues a unique token for every transaction so cardholder data never touches the merchant environment. Developers integrate through EPX Hosted Checkout, the Hosted Pay Page, the Browser Post API, and the North EPX Custom Pay REST API, all documented on the North Developer portal, supporting sales, authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, recurring billing, and batch settlement with EMV, tokenization, and encryption throughout.
e.name: Electronic payment Exchange Inc

e.description: ElectronX is a CFTC-regulated financial exchange (Designated Contract Market) and clearinghouse (Derivatives Clearing Organization) operating the first U.S.-regulated, direct-access power derivatives market. It offers 1MW hourly bounded futures and binary options that let energy market participants hedge intraday electricity price volatility across ISOs including ERCOT, PJM, MISO, and CAISO. Traders connect through a browser-based platform or programmatically via a FIX API providing order entry, market data, and drop copy sessions. ElectronX is backed by DCVC and has raised more than $55M across seed and Series A rounds to democratize access to electricity risk-management tools for battery storage operators, distributed energy resource aggregators, trading firms, and commercial power consumers.
e.name: Electronx

e.description: Elegen is a synthetic biology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California that manufactures high-accuracy synthetic DNA through its proprietary cell-free ENFINIA platform. Rather than relying on traditional cell-based cloning, ENFINIA combines microfluidics, artificial intelligence, and robotics to produce long, clonal-quality, high-complexity DNA at speed and low cost. The ENFINIA product line includes Linear DNA up to 7 kb delivered in 6-8 business days, Plasmid DNA up to 15 kb, and IVT Ready DNA with encoded poly(A) tails for mRNA workflows, each NGS-verified to 99.999% per-base accuracy. Elegen serves researchers and therapeutics developers across mRNA vaccines, cell and gene therapy, CRISPR genome editing, and protein expression. Customers submit and order sequences through the online ENFINIA ordering portal; Elegen does not currently publish a public developer API. The company is backed by a16z Bio + Health, KdT Ventures, 8VC, Digitalis Ventures, Agilent, and others, and raised a $35M Series B in 2024.
e.name: Elegen

e.description: Elekta provides radiation oncology and cancer care solutions, offering advanced radiotherapy equipment, software, and services. The company focuses on innovative treatments such as MR-Linac, adaptive radiotherapy, and oncology informatics, serving healthcare providers worldwide.
e.name: Elekta

e.description: Elektrik is a medium voltage (MV) equipment procurement platform for electrical distributors, contractors, and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms. Founded in 2020 by Mario Dealba out of the Techstars Alabama EnergyTech Accelerator, the company streamlines sourcing of medium- to high-voltage supplies (roughly 5kV-35kV / 600V-69kV) including MV cable, terminations, splices, deadbreak and loadbreak connectors, and transformers. Buyers build part lists and specifications in the web app and Elektrik surfaces matching products across leading manufacturers such as TE Connectivity, BURNDY, Richards Manufacturing, and PFISTERER, compressing a traditionally slow, quote-driven procurement cycle. Backed by Techstars and growth capital, Elektrik is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI.
e.name: Elektrik App

e.description: Elektrofi is a Boston-based biopharmaceutical formulation technology company reinventing how biologic therapies are delivered to patients. Its Hypercon ultra-high-concentration microparticle platform and Elektroject process turn monoclonal antibodies, therapeutic proteins, and other large-molecule drugs into stable, syringe-injectable formulations suited to small-volume, at-home subcutaneous self-administration instead of intravenous infusion. The company has partnered with Eli Lilly and Janssen Biotech (Johnson & Johnson) on multi-target drug-delivery collaborations, and was acquired by Halozyme Therapeutics in November 2025. Elektrofi is a biotechnology company and does not publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company entity within the network.
e.name: Elektrofi

e.description: Element (Element Finance) is an Andreessen Horowitz-backed decentralized finance protocol for fixed and variable yield on crypto assets. The protocol splits an interest-bearing position into tradable Principal Tokens (PTs) and Yield Tokens (YTs) so users can lock in a fixed rate by buying discounted principal, or take variable-rate exposure, redeeming at face value on maturity via on-chain AMMs. It also ships the Council governance framework (voting vaults, delegation, the Governance Steering Council) that powers the Element DAO. Element is a smart-contract protocol on Ethereum rather than a hosted REST API: developers integrate through the on-chain contracts, the elf-sdk TypeScript library, and the published contract reference. The team has since rebranded to DELV (delvtech).
e.name: Element

e.description: element 5 AG was a German e-commerce and digital-distribution company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Cologne, Germany. It operated a platform that let software developers and publishers sell their products and licenses directly to customers online, growing to more than 10,000 clients across 150 countries and becoming one of Europe's leading software e-commerce providers. element 5 was acquired by U.S.-based Digital River (its direct competitor) for roughly $120M and subsequently absorbed and renamed Digital River GmbH, ceasing to operate as an independent company. It was an early Earlybird Venture Capital portfolio company; this profile records its identity and exit. No live independent API or developer surface remains to enrich.
e.name: element 5 AG

e.description: Element AI was a Montreal, Quebec-based artificial intelligence company founded in 2016 by Jean-Francois Gagne, Yoshua Bengio, Nicolas Chapados, Philippe Beaudoin, Anne Martel, and Jean-Sebastien Cournoyer. It operated as an AI systems integrator and professional-services firm with the mission of putting advanced AI capabilities - natural language processing, computer vision, document intelligence, and conversational AI - in reach of traditional enterprises. After raising roughly US$102M plus Canadian government funding and reaching an estimated US$600-700M valuation in 2019, the company ran short of runway and was acquired by ServiceNow (announced November 30, 2020; closed January 8, 2021 for approximately US$230M). Its research group became ServiceNow Research and its former domain now redirects there. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no standalone public API, developer portal, or SDKs.
e.name: Element AI

e.description: Element Biosciences is a San Diego based life-sciences instrumentation company that builds benchtop DNA sequencing and multiomics systems — the AVITI, AVITI LT, AVITI24 and VITARI platforms — around its proprietary Avidite Base Chemistry (ABC), which decouples signal generation from nucleotide incorporation to deliver high-accuracy base calling at lower cost than conventional sequencing-by-synthesis. Instrument output is managed through ElemBio Cloud, the company's analysis and data-management platform, which runs bioinformatics workflows such as Bases2Fastq and Cells2Stats and streams run data into customer-owned cloud storage connections. ElemBio Cloud exposes a public, versioned REST API — the Element Biosciences Cloud API — plus a first-party cross-platform CLI, giving labs programmatic access to sequencing and multiomics runs, workflow executions, registered instruments, storage connections and the files those resources produce, for dashboards, fleet monitoring, LIMS read-back and custom automation.
e.name: Element Biosciences

e.description: Element Science is a San Francisco-based medical device and digital health company focused on high-risk cardiovascular patients. Its flagship product is the Jewel Patch-Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (P-WCD) — a low-profile, water-resistant wearable that continuously monitors for and treats life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in patients at temporary elevated risk of sudden cardiac arrest. The Jewel received FDA Premarket Approval in 2025 and CE Mark / UKCA marking in January 2024. Element Science is a portfolio company of GV. Added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; no public developer API or machine-readable specification has been identified for this provider at the time of enrichment.
e.name: Element Science

e.description: Element Zero is a green-materials technology company decarbonizing the production of iron and other critical metals. Its patented non-aqueous electrochemical process converts any grade of metal ore (iron, nickel, titanium, lithium) into high-purity metal with zero carbon emissions, using 30-40% less energy than conventional smelting and operating at low temperatures so it can run on intermittent renewable energy (wind, solar, hydro). Based in Perth and northern Western Australia near the world's largest iron-ore ports, the company is scaling a modular platform aimed at the roughly 8% of global CO2 emissions from iron and steelmaking, including its Pilbara Iron Super Hub at Port Hedland. Backed by a US$10M seed round led by Playground Global. This is an industrial deep-tech company with no public API or developer platform; the profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.
e.name: Element Zero

e.description: Element5 is a post-acute healthcare workflow automation platform that uses coordinated AI agents (Neos) to automate revenue cycle management (RCM) and back-office operations for home health, hospice, and palliative care providers. Its platform automates eligibility and benefit verification, prior authorization submission, claims processing, denials management, remittance and collections, and audit/compliance workflows, escalating only exceptions to human agents. Element5 exposes a public workflow API (Element5 API v2.2.0) protected by API keys that lets clients submit authorization and eligibility requests, process X12 270/271 eligibility transactions, upload and fetch file objects, and monitor long-running tasks via polling or webhook callbacks. The company is backed by Insight Partners and serves the post-acute care sector.
e.name: Element5

e.description: Elemental (Elemental Technologies) was a Portland, Oregon video encoding and multiscreen delivery company founded in 2006 and backed by General Catalyst. Its software powered large over-the-top and broadcast video providers before Amazon Web Services acquired the company in 2015. The business now operates as the AWS Elemental brand within AWS Media Services, spanning cloud services (MediaConvert, MediaLive, MediaPackage, MediaConnect, MediaStore, MediaTailor) and on-premises appliances and software (Elemental Live, Elemental Server, Elemental Conductor, Elemental Statmux, Elemental Link). Elemental no longer operates an independent developer portal; its API surface is delivered through AWS SDKs and the AWS Elemental documentation. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; the investment exited via acquisition.
e.name: Elemental

e.description: Elemental Cognition is a New York based artificial intelligence company founded in 2015 by Dr. David Ferrucci, the researcher who led the IBM Watson Jeopardy! project. The company builds a neuro-symbolic AI platform that pairs fine-tuned large language models with a formal, multi-strategy reasoning engine, so that answers are produced by the reasoning engine over an explicit Formal Knowledge Model rather than by the language model itself. The platform is marketed for high-stakes decision work in supply chain, life sciences, higher education, travel and investment management, and it was the reasoning layer behind Bridgewater's AI investment fund. Elemental Cognition packaged this as the Cogent and Cora enterprise applications, delivered as SaaS on Google Cloud, in a customer's own cloud, or on premises. The company does not run a public developer program: the platform generates callable cloud APIs automatically from each customer's own knowledge model, so the contract is tenant-specific and never published publicly.
e.name: Elemental Cognition

e.description: Elemental Machines is a Cambridge, Massachusetts LabOps connectivity company that instruments laboratories and manufacturing floors with IoT sensors and a vendor-agnostic cloud platform for environmental monitoring, cold-storage and freezer health, equipment utilization, alerting, calibration and compliance reporting across life sciences R&D, biomanufacturing, academia and government facilities. The platform ingests sensor and third-party equipment data at 15-second resolution and exposes it through a public REST API at api.elementalmachines.io covering machines, machine samples and sample statistics, utilization (aggregated, hourly and status), alert logs, alert rules, users, user activities, customer groups, release notes and a server status check, authenticated with OAuth 2.0 access tokens. The same data is pushed into ELN/LIMS/SDMS, QMS, MES, BMS and CMMS systems and data warehouses through the company's data-integration services. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified, operates calibration to ISO 17025, and positions the platform as a 21 CFR Part 11 / ALCOA+ compliant recording system for GxP-regulated laboratories.
e.name: Elemental Machines

e.description: Elementary is an AI-powered machine-vision inspection company for manufacturing, founded in 2017 in South Pasadena, California (originally Elementary Robotics). Its VisionStream self-training edge AI detects production defects in seconds without rules, labeling, or tuning, while the QualityOS cloud platform delivers traceability, analytics, and MES/ERP integration across production lines. Elementary inspects over one billion parts annually for Fortune 500 manufacturers across food & beverage, automotive, consumer packaged goods, electronics, and life sciences, and is backed by Rockwell Automation, Tiger Global, Toyota Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Fika Ventures, and Idealab. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.
e.name: Elementary

e.description: Elementl, Inc. is the company behind Dagster, rebranded as Dagster Labs in August 2023. Founded in 2018 by Nick Schrock (creator of GraphQL) and led by CEO Pete Hunt, the San Francisco company builds Dagster, an open-source, Apache-2.0 licensed, cloud-native data orchestration platform, and Dagster+, its managed cloud offering. Dagster's defining innovation is the Software-Defined Asset model, which treats data tables, ML models, and datasets as first-class, versioned objects with built-in lineage, data quality checks, and observability rather than as ordered task lists. The platform exposes a GraphQL API and a REST API for reporting external asset materializations, checks, and observations, plus Python and CLI clients. The company has raised roughly $48.8M, including a $33M Series B (2023) led by Georgian with participation from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Amplify, 8VC, Human Capital, Hanover, and Slow. The Dagster product API surface is catalogued separately in the api-evangelist/dagster profile.
e.name: Elementl

e.description: Elementor is a WordPress website builder that lets users design pixel-perfect websites through a visual drag-and-drop editor, without writing code. Beyond the core page builder it ships Elementor Pro, the Hello theme, a hosted Elementor Cloud/Website offering, and an AI-assisted "Elementor One" plan set. For developers, Elementor is an extensible platform rather than a hosted REST API: it exposes a PHP extension surface (widgets, controls, dynamic tags, form actions, hooks, and managers), a WP-CLI command set, an auto-generated PHP code reference at code.elementor.com, and a family of first-party npm packages under the @elementor scope (editor UI, icons, design tokens). This profile catalogs Elementor's public developer and product surface for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Elementor

e.description: Elementum is an AI-native process automation and orchestration platform that lets enterprises build custom business workflows that coordinate people, rules, LLMs, and AI agents without moving data out of the customer's own data warehouse (its "Zero Persistence" / CloudLink model, with first-class Snowflake integration). Originally a multi-enterprise supply chain orchestration vendor, Elementum pivoted to general enterprise AI orchestration spanning supply chain, finance, healthcare, and compliance. It exposes a versioned REST API (v1, US and EU regions) secured with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials for records, apps, elements, tasks, attachments, comments, watchers, related items, agents, automations, flows, skills, tables, views, groups, and users, plus a public documentation MCP server, SAML SSO/SCIM provisioning, and service accounts for agents and automations. Elementum is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Snowflake Ventures, and others.
e.name: Elementum

e.description: Elementus is a New York blockchain intelligence company founded in 2017 that attributes on-chain addresses to real-world entities across multiple chains, and sells that attribution graph to compliance, investigations and market-intelligence teams. Its public API surface is the Attribution API, a key-authenticated REST service at attribution-api.elementus.io that resolves batches of blockchain addresses to a beneficial owner, custodian, entity name and OFAC/SDN sanction status. As of the 2026-08-12 probe every Elementus web host — the marketing site, the app and the API — is unresolvable in DNS, so the developer surface documented here is reconstructed from the company's own public GitHub organization rather than from a live site.
e.name: Elementus

e.description: Elemy (formerly Sprout Therapy) was a US pediatric behavioral-health startup providing in-home Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children with autism, reaching unicorn valuation on backing from SoftBank Vision Fund, General Catalyst, and 8VC. In late 2022 it wound down its direct-care therapy division and pivoted to software; in 2023 it rebranded to Tilly (tillytherapy.com), a HIPAA-compliant ABA practice-management and AI platform covering intake, scheduling, authorizations, billing, payroll, and family engagement for autism-care providers. The original elemy.com domain no longer resolves. Tilly is a closed SaaS product with no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation as of this profile.
e.name: Elemy

e.description: Eleos Health is the most widely adopted AI platform in behavioral and community-based healthcare. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Eleos delivers purpose-built AI workflow agents that span clinical documentation, compliance, and revenue cycle management. The platform embeds directly inside providers' existing web-based electronic health records (EHRs) via a lightweight browser extension for both in-person and telehealth sessions, turning ambient session capture or quick text summaries into structured, payer-ready progress notes and cutting documentation time by roughly 70%. Eleos Compliance reviews every note against common risk areas (note cloning, empty notes, interventions, progress mentions, action plans, and the golden thread), and its revenue cycle tooling automates eligibility checks and claim protection. Deployed across 120+ care organizations in 30+ states, Eleos integrates without custom API builds; it is backed by Menlo Ventures and Greenfield Partners.
e.name: Eleos Health

e.description: Elephant Healthcare is a global health-technology company, headquartered in the UK, that partners with governments to digitise and strengthen public health systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Its flagship product, ElephantOS, is a mobile- and offline-first electronic health record (EHR) that streamlines clinical workflows for primary and secondary care facilities, serving over 19 million contracted patients across Nigeria, Kenya and Pakistan. The company also builds Elephant Nudge, a clinical co-pilot that guides and rewards quality of care, and Elephant Platform, an emerging AI-driven marketplace that connects clinicians to third-party healthcare software, medical devices and supply-chain partners. Elephant is backed by General Catalyst and Seedcamp. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.
e.name: Elephant Healthcare

e.description: Elephantech Inc. (founded January 2014 in Tokyo as AgIC Inc., renamed Elephantech in September 2017) develops, manufactures and sells precision metal inkjet printing equipment, advanced conductive materials, and flexible printed circuit board products, including its SustainaCircuits multilayer PCB line and NeuralJet printing technology. The company positions itself as decarbonizing electronics manufacturing by replacing subtractive copper etching with additive inkjet deposition. It is a hardware and materials manufacturer with roughly 150 employees, headquartered at 4-3-8 Hatchobori, Chuo-ku, Tokyo; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.
e.name: Elephantech

e.description: Elephas Biosciences Corporation is a Madison, Wisconsin precision-oncology company that builds elive, a first-in-class functional immune-profiling platform that measures how a patient's own live tumor tissue responds to immunotherapy. The platform combines elive Edge (an automated instrument that cuts core-needle biopsies into uniform 300-micron viable fragments), elive Gel (a proprietary hydrogel that preserves the native tumor microenvironment) and the elive Method (a sequential treatment and cytokine-analysis strategy) to return a functional response readout within roughly 72 hours of biopsy. Clinicians receive elive test reports through a secure, cloud-based web application; researchers and drug developers receive custom reports plus raw data for in-house analysis. The company raised a $40M Series B-2 in November 2025 to commercialize elive as a laboratory developed test. Its digital surface is the Elephas Portal (portal.elephas.com), an Angular single-page application backed by an ASP.NET Core API at portal.elephasapis.com that is authenticated with Azure AD B2C on the company-controlled na.login.elephas.com identity host. No public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract is published.
e.name: Elephas Biosciences

e.description: Elephint is an electronics-photonics integration company building integrated photonic systems-on-a-chip (SoC) technologies. Its focus areas span photonic integrated circuits, silicon photonics, free-space optical communication, fiber optics, optical amplifiers, coherent beam combining, wavefront control, photonic signal processing, photonic computing, and artificial intelligence. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Elephint is a deep-tech hardware company that presently publishes only a company website (https://elephint.ai) and does not expose a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.
e.name: Elephint

e.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.
e.name: Eleqtron

e.description: EAS Innovations Inc operates ELEV8, an end-to-end, cloud-based dealer management system (DMS) built for independent auto dealers and automotive finance companies. The platform unifies real-time accounting, inventory management, CRM and desking, loan servicing, payments and collections into a single fully-integrated system. It offers per-seat pricing, user-based access rights, user-level audit logs, whitelisted IP addresses, multi-rooftop access and department-level restrictions, and is delivered as a SaaS web application at app.elev8dms.com. EAS Innovations is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API is currently published.
e.name: ELEV8

e.description: Elevance Health (formerly Anthem) is a Fortune 500 health benefits company serving members through Blue Cross and Blue Shield affiliated health plans across multiple states, offering medical, pharmacy, dental, vision and specialty insurance. Its entire public API surface is HL7 FHIR, published to satisfy the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule: a member-consented Patient Access API (FHIR R4, CARIN Blue Button, SMART on FHIR), a read-only Provider Directory API (Da Vinci PDEX Plan Net) whose CapabilityStatement is readable with no credentials, a Formulary API (Da Vinci PDEX US Drug Formulary), and a legacy Patient360 FHIR DSTU2 endpoint running CareEvolution HIEBus. There is no OpenAPI, no SDK and no pricing — the contracts are the FHIR CapabilityStatements the servers publish about themselves. Elevance has committed in its own endpoint support document to shipping Payer-to-Payer, Prior Authorization and Provider Access APIs by 1 January 2027 under CMS-0057-F; none of the three exists today.
e.name: Elevance Health

e.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.
e.name: Elevarm

e.description: Elevate is an AI-powered, cloud-native consumer-directed benefits administration platform for health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), health reimbursement arrangements (HRAs), and commuter, lifestyle, and family-forming accounts. Built API-first and white-label, the platform lets benefits administrators, third-party administrators (TPAs), PEOs, brokers, financial institutions, and health plans embed real-time account management, instant claims processing, and reimbursement into their own front ends. Members view, plan, and manage every pre-tax benefit from a single web and mobile dashboard with one card across all accounts. Founded in 2020, Elevate is backed by Anthemis, Fin Capital, Norwest Venture Partners, Greycroft, Bowery Capital, Firebolt Ventures, and SaaS Ventures. Its complete API set is partner-gated (access via demo/contract); the platform is HIPAA and AICPA SOC compliant.
e.name: Elevate

e.description: ElevateBio is an advanced therapies technology company and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for cell and gene therapies, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. Through its BaseCamp cGMP manufacturing and process-development business and its centers of excellence, ElevateBio provides end-to-end capabilities spanning gene editing, viral vectors (AAV and lentivirus), mRNA and RNA therapeutics, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), analytical and process development, and regulatory CMC support, helping partners advance genetic medicines from concept through commercialization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network, ElevateBio operates as a science- and manufacturing-driven organization rather than a public API provider; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.
e.name: ElevateBio

e.description: Elevation Pharmaceuticals was a San Diego specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 2008 by Cam Garner, Bill Gerhart, and Ahmet Tutuncu to develop next-generation aerosol/inhalation therapies for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It raised a $30 million Series A in 2010 backed by Canaan Partners, TPG Growth, Care Capital, and Mesa Verde Venture Partners, and was acquired by Sunovion Pharmaceuticals in August 2012. The company is no longer independently operating; its domain now resolves to Sunovion nameservers and it publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a Canaan Partners portfolio record.
e.name: Elevation Pharmaceuticals

e.description: Elevation Spine is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Monterey, California, founded in 2015, that designs and manufactures integrated-fixation spinal implants. Its Saber platform combines interbody support with in-line spike or screw fixation in a single construct; the flagship Saber-C anterior cervical fusion system is a zero-profile ACDF device cleared as an anterior cervical plate, and the company received FDA 510(k) clearance for Saber-C AVIA, a porous 3D-printed titanium interbody, in July 2026. Elevation Spine sells physical surgical implants and instrumentation to hospitals and surgeons through distributors; it operates a Webflow marketing site and a customer login portal, and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.
e.name: Elevation Spine

e.description: ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company building voice and audio models, founded in 2022 and launched publicly in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. It sells across three platforms: ElevenCreative (text to speech, speech to text, voice cloning and design, music, sound effects, dubbing, Studio, image and video across 70+ languages), ElevenAgents (an enterprise platform for voice and chat agents with telephony, testing, evaluation and analytics), and ElevenAPI (direct developer access to the audio foundation models over HTTP and WebSocket). It publishes a single first-party OpenAPI 3.1.0 covering 390 operations, official SDKs for Python, JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin and Flutter, a Rust CLI, a hosted remote MCP server with four data-residency endpoints, and ten Agent Skills of its own.
e.name: ElevenLabs

e.description: Elexon is the UK's Balancing and Settlement Code (BSC) Company, responsible for administering the electricity balancing and settlement arrangements in Great Britain. As the operator of the Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service (BMRS), Elexon publishes a publicly accessible REST API — the Insights Solution API — that provides free, no-key access to real-time and historical data from the UK electricity market. The API covers balancing mechanism dynamic and physical data per Balancing Mechanism Unit (BMU), bid-offer acceptances, balancing services adjustments, physical notifications, generation availability forecasts, settlement reports, meter readings, and UK market transparency data mandated under European legislation. All data is returned in JSON, XML, or CSV format. A companion near-real-time push service (IRIS — Insights Real-time Information Service) streams the same datasets over WebSocket/STOMP for latency-sensitive consumers. The API is freely accessible to industry participants and the public with no registration or API key required, and data may be reused with attribution ("Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right").
e.name: Elexon

e.description: Elhub is Norway's national IT platform (datahub) for collecting and distributing electricity data, owned and operated by Elhub AS, a public company owned by Statnett SF. Grid companies, electricity suppliers and service providers use Elhub to exchange metering values and customer information for more than 4 million metering points, and it handles supplier switching and settlement processes. Households and businesses use Elhub Min side to view and share their own electricity data. The Elhub API Portal (api.elhub.no) offers public open-data APIs (Energy Data API, CC BY 4.0) and Maskinporten-protected APIs including Data Export, Market Data, Access, Settlement and Metering Values APIs.
e.name: Elhub

e.description: Natural Language Processing Tools for Thai Language
e.name: ELI

e.description: Eli Lilly and Company is a Fortune 500 global pharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and sells human pharmaceutical products in therapeutic areas including diabetes, oncology, immunology, and neuroscience. Eli Lilly does not currently publish a public developer API portal; the company exposes selected machine learning models through its Lilly TuneLab platform to partner biotechs but does not offer general purpose, self-serve APIs.
e.name: Eli Lilly

e.description: Eliance Corporation was a Minneapolis-based provider of bundled payment-processing and back-office e-commerce services that enabled online merchants to accept and process payment transactions over the Internet, lowering the barriers to entry for e-commerce. It was a portfolio company of Insight Partners and has since exited. During enrichment no active company website, developer portal, public API, OpenAPI specification, or documentation surface could be found, so no API artifacts were produced.
e.name: Eliance Corporation

e.description: Eligible provides insurance billing APIs for healthcare businesses, enabling the integration of insurance billing experiences into healthcare applications. The platform supports eligibility verification, coverage discovery, claims submission and tracking, payment estimation, enrollment, and remittance processing across a large network of US payers.
e.name: Eligible

e.description: Elion Therapeutics is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for life-threatening invasive fungal infections (IFIs). Formerly known as Sfunga Therapeutics, the company was founded on the belief that mechanistic insight into natural products enables targeted optimization of them. Its lead candidate, SF001, is a next-generation polyene antifungal — a rationally designed analog of amphotericin B intended to retain broad fungicidal activity while mitigating the systemic toxicity that limits the parent molecule. SF001 received FDA Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) and Fast Track designations in 2023 and has advanced from a first-in-human single-ascending-dose study into multiple-ascending-dose evaluation. Elion closed an $81 million Series B in June 2024 led by Deerfield Management and the AMR Action Fund, with participation from Illinois Ventures. Elion is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract, and this profile records that absence rather than any API surface.
e.name: Elion Therapeutics

e.description: Eliq is a Swedish energy-data company (Eliq AB, Gothenburg) that gives utilities and energy-app developers an API layer over household energy data. Its Data Management API ingests users, locations, meters, consumption readings and tariff price formulas — synchronously or as asynchronous NDJSON bulk jobs — and its Insights API returns presentation-ready analytics on top of that data: consumption and cost by day, week, month and year, CO2 footprint, appliance-level disaggregation (NILM), day-ahead market prices, peak power and dynamic capacity, tariff comparison, PV production, forecasting, anomaly detection, similar-homes benchmarking, budgets and personalised advice. An Intelligence API adds portfolio segmentation for utility service and growth teams, and an OAuth 2.0 Auth API issues app and delegated tokens for all of it. Eliq also ships 20 embeddable web components and pushes notification webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256. Access is commercial — credentials are issued by an account manager — but all four OpenAPI contracts are published publicly.
e.name: Eliq

e.description: ELISA (Enabling Linux in Safety Applications) is a Linux Foundation collaborative project that builds the shared tools, processes and evidence needed to use Linux in safety-critical systems. Its working groups and special interest groups span automotive, aerospace, medical devices, railways, space-grade Linux and open-source engineering process, producing white papers, case studies, kernel analysis tooling and a public technical directory. ELISA develops two tools of its own: BASIL, a software quality management and traceability application with an HTTP REST API and SPDX 3.0.1 export, and ks-nav, kernel-source navigation tooling. ELISA itself publishes a machine-readable API surface at https://elisa.tech/wp-json/ — declared through an RFC 9727 api-catalog and described by a live OpenAPI 3.0.0 document — plus an llms.txt and permissive Content Signals for AI use.
e.name: ELISA

e.description: EliseAI is an agentic AI platform that automates communications and operations for the housing and healthcare industries. For property management it offers LeasingAI, ResidentAI, EliseCRM, VoiceAI, AI-guided tours, and automation for maintenance, renewals, move-in, delinquency, lease audits and fee transparency across SMS, email, chat and voice channels. For healthcare, its HealthAI automates patient scheduling, intake and communication with HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Elise integrates with leading PMS, CRM, EHR and RCM systems. API and integration access is provisioned through the EliseAI developer portal; the company does not publish a self-serve public OpenAPI. This profile was surfaced as a venture portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.
e.name: EliseAI

e.description: Elisity is a San Jose-based cybersecurity company (founded 2019, backed by Insight Partners) that builds an AI-powered, identity-based microsegmentation platform for Zero Trust security. Elisity discovers, classifies, and continuously monitors every user, workload, and device, then enforces dynamic least-privilege policies to stop lateral movement, without agents, new hardware, or network changes, by leveraging the Cisco, Arista, and Juniper switches organizations already own. The platform centers on Elisity IdentityGraph (real-time asset visibility enriched from sources like Active Directory, CrowdStrike, and Armis), a Dynamic Policy Engine, lightweight Virtual Edge container software that syncs policy to existing infrastructure, and the Cloud Control Center admin portal. Its product API and Open Connector integration API are documented inside the authenticated Cloud Control Center rather than a public developer portal. Elisity is used by Fortune 500 healthcare systems, manufacturers, and pharmaceutical firms for IoMT, OT/ICS, and enterprise segmentation.
e.name: Elisity

e.description: Elite Business Ventures, LLC (EBV, ebvinc.com) is a San Diego-based workplace compliance company founded in 2005 that has helped over one million businesses stay compliant with federal and state labor laws and workplace safety regulations. It operates through two primary brands: PosterElite, a white-label labor-law-poster compliance platform embedded by HR, payroll, HCM, PEO, and workforce-management providers under their own brand; and Osha4Less.com, an ecommerce store of affordable OSHA and labor-law compliance products for small businesses. EBV is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. The company exposes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or documentation surface — partner integration is handled through direct white-label / reseller arrangements rather than a self-service developer program.
e.name: Elite Business Ventures

e.description: Elium is a European enterprise knowledge-management SaaS platform, founded in 2007 as Knowledge Plaza and renamed Elium in 2017, headquartered in Louvain-la-Neuve, Belgium. Teams capture, validate and govern company knowledge as structured articles - which Elium calls "stories" - inside spaces, using templates, multi-step approval, expiration management, duplicate and gap detection, and in-place multilingual translation. The same governed corpus is then served to people and to AI agents through AI search, smart assistants, external portals and integrations. Programmatically Elium is a GraphQL provider, not a REST one: each customer platform serves its own per-tenant GraphQL endpoint with 17 queries, 206 mutations and 18 subscriptions, documented in a fully published SpectaQL reference, secured with OAuth 2.0 on a single apiv1 scope. In June 2026 Elium added a per-tenant remote Model Context Protocol server exposing three read-only knowledge tools to ChatGPT, Claude and custom agents. API and MCP access are Enterprise-plan only. Elium is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and SecNumCloud-qualified, with EU-default and sovereign French hosting options.
e.name: Elium

e.description: Elixir Medical Corporation is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Milpitas, California, developing implant and interventional platforms for coronary and peripheral artery disease. Its DynamX sirolimus-eluting coronary bioadaptor is designed to restore vessel pulsatility and compliance rather than permanently cage the artery, and holds a European CE mark, Japanese PMDA approval and a U.S. FDA Breakthrough Device designation; the LithiX Hertz Contact intravascular lithotripsy system and the DESyne family of drug-eluting stents round out the portfolio. Elixir Medical operates no developer program and publishes no product, device or clinical API. The only machine-readable surface it serves is the default WordPress REST API of its corporate marketing site, alongside an SEO-plugin-generated llms.txt.
e.name: Elixir Medical

e.description: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics (Cayman) Limited is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017, with offices in Taipei, Taiwan and Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing precision immunotherapies for neuroinflammation, autoimmune disease and cancer. Its clinical pipeline is led by enrupatinib (EI-1071), a small-molecule CSF-1R inhibitor in development for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative indications, and EI-001, a fully human anti-interferon-gamma monoclonal antibody in Phase 2 for vitiligo, alongside preclinical EI-012 (anti-CD36) and EI-220 (mRNA) oncology programs. The company publishes a corporate and investor-relations website only: there is no developer portal, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind on its own hosts.
e.name: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics

e.description: Eliyan Corporation is a fabless semiconductor company in Santa Clara, California that develops chiplet and chip-to-chip interconnect physical-layer (PHY) IP for multi-die and AI infrastructure systems. Its NuLink die-to-die and die-to-memory PHY, NuLink-X chip-to-chip PHY, NuLink-XD 224G PAM4 SerDes for electro-optical modules, and NuGear chiplets let designers build multi-die architectures on standard organic substrates as well as advanced packaging, using simultaneous bidirectional signaling and support for UCIe, Bunch of Wires (BoW) and its own UMI interface. Eliyan licenses silicon IP and sells chiplets to semiconductor and hyperscale customers rather than operating a public web API; the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.
e.name: Eliyan

e.description: Elk is a nimble, MIT-licensed Mastodon web client maintained by Anthony Fu, Daniel Roe, Kevin Deng and Patak. It runs as a Nuxt 4 progressive web app at elk.zone and connects to any Mastodon-compatible instance the user chooses, speaking the Mastodon Client API through Masto.js with WebSocket streaming and Web Push notifications. Elk sells no API product and issues no credential of its own: its small server surface at elk.zone/api exists to list sign-in instances and broker the OAuth 2.0 handshake with the user's own server, and every timeline, post and notification call goes to that instance directly.
e.name: Elk

e.description: ELKROOM CO., LTD. is a consumer mobile-gaming studio and 500 Global portfolio company behind the OXO product family. Its flagship OXO Game Launcher is an Android game launcher and optimization tool that organizes a player's games and automatically tracks play history, journals, monthly reports, rankings, and community activity, and has surpassed five million downloads on Google Play. The company also builds OXO Gameplay, an AI-powered gaming content and social platform for Android and iOS, and Stricer, a cloud-based AI video analysis and highlight-editing tool on the web. ELKROOM operates consumer applications rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, product surface, and legal/policy pages. Tagline: "You Chase Glory. We Make It Legendary."
e.name: ELKROOM

e.description: Ellevest is a women-founded, women-led wealth management and financial planning firm dedicated to closing the gender wealth gap. The platform delivers personalized investment management and comprehensive financial planning for high-net-worth individuals, families, and institutions, with services including portfolio management, retirement and estate planning, tax strategy, and cash flow analysis. Ellevest leverages REST-based internal APIs for portfolio management, financial coaching, banking operations, and personalized investment goal tracking, with third-party account connectivity available through Open Banking aggregators such as Plaid.
e.name: Ellevest

e.description: Elligo Health Research is a healthcare-enabling clinical research organization (CRO) that embeds clinical trials directly into real-world healthcare settings. Through its proprietary IntElligo Research Stack and System of Accelerated Research (SOAR) model, Elligo connects sponsors and CROs to known, diverse patient populations across 115+ hospitals and health systems, 200+ healthcare-based sites, and 100+ research-based sites. Services span site networks, patient access and recruitment, decentralized and hybrid trial solutions, site support and staffing, and concierge patient retention and travel logistics. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Elligo is tracked as a portfolio-lead in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.
e.name: Elligo Health Research

e.description: Ellipsis is a managed cloud platform for running autonomous coding agents at scale. Engineering teams define agents as YAML config files that live in their repositories, and Ellipsis runs them in isolated, ephemeral sandboxes to review pull requests, fix bugs, build features, and investigate production issues. Agents trigger automatically on cron schedules, GitHub pull-request lifecycle events, or @ellipsis-dev mentions, and can also be launched on demand from the dashboard, the REST API, or the `agent` CLI. The platform runs Claude, Codex, and Gemini models, enforces hard budget caps and scoped per-session credentials, retains zero source code, and provides full observability with audit trails and replayable execution. Ellipsis (YC W24) serves 400+ engineering teams across 67,000+ connected repositories.
e.name: Ellipsis

e.description: Ellipsis Drive is a cloud-native spatial data management platform that lets teams upload, store, process, share, and serve raster, vector, and 3D point-cloud geospatial data through a single interoperable interface. Uploaded files are automatically processed into high-performance Tile Pyramid Archives (rasters) and Paged Vector Tiles (vectors) and served through standard OGC protocols (WMS, WMTS, WFS, WCS, XYZ, and vector tiles) alongside a REST API v3 with Bearer-token and OAuth2 authorization. Official SDKs and integrations cover Python, R, and JavaScript, plus plugins for QGIS, ArcGIS (JS, Pro, and Server), Mapbox GL, Leaflet, React-Leaflet, and Power BI. The platform offers storage-based pricing, license-free data sharing and consumption, subscriptions for selling spatial data, and both instant SaaS and private self-hosted deployments.
e.name: Ellipsis Drive

e.description: Ellipsis Health is a healthcare AI company that has established the human voice as a vital sign for mental health, using clinically validated vocal-biomarker technology, natural language processing, and acoustic models to identify, measure, and monitor the severity of depression and anxiety from short samples of natural speech. Its flagship product, Sage, is an emotionally intelligent, agentic AI care manager that conducts 24/7 patient-engagement calls for health plans, health systems, specialty care, and pharma, handling program enrollment, benefits verification, clinical assessments and surveys, and care coordination. Sage is powered by Ellipsis' patented Empathy Engine, trained on millions of live clinical patient calls, and runs on HIPAA and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant infrastructure. Ellipsis Health integrates with health plans and systems such as Cigna, and exposes a private partner API (used by partners like Augmedix) rather than a public developer platform. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, and CVS Health Ventures.
e.name: Ellipsis Health

e.description: Ellipsis Labs builds decentralized finance applications and infrastructure on Solana. Its flagship product is Phoenix, a fully on-chain, atomically-settled limit order book exchange for spot assets, now expanded with Phoenix Perps for on-chain perpetual futures. The team also develops Atlas (a high-performance DeFi Layer 2), Gavel (token distribution and liquidity bootstrapping), and Plasma (a sandwich-resistant AMM reference implementation). Ellipsis exposes its protocol to developers through open-source SDKs (TypeScript, Rust, Python), command-line tools, and on-chain Solana programs rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Electric Capital and Paradigm.
e.name: Ellipsis Labs

e.description: Ellipsus is a collaborative writing platform built for creative and fiction writers, combining a modern text editor with granular, Git-style version control so authors can draft, branch, share, and merge work together across devices. Founded in 2022 and operated by a small distributed team across Berlin (Germany), Madrid (Spain), and Szczecin (Poland), the product threads collaboration through every stage of writing — organizing drafts, discussing feedback, tracking changes, and preserving public version history — with a writers-first, artist-ownership, anti-AI-generated-content stance. Ellipsus offers a free tier and a paid Plus license, and is backed by Speedinvest. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.
e.name: Ellipsus

e.description: Elliptic is a blockchain analytics and crypto compliance platform providing REST APIs for transaction screening, wallet risk scoring, entity identification, and AML compliance. Their APIs enable financial institutions, exchanges, and DeFi platforms to automate crypto risk screening across 60+ blockchains, reduce investigation time by up to 90%, and meet AML regulatory requirements with sub-second response times.
e.name: Elliptic

e.description: Ellis is a modern business immigration platform and law firm that helps company People and HR teams secure U.S. work visas and green cards for skilled talent.
