The platform processes 25M+ API requests monthly across the EEA and maintains 1,000+ ASPSP integrations, serving accounting and ERP platforms, credit risk and KYC providers, wealth managers, and payment service providers including Qred Bank, Fimento, CapitalBox, and iDenfy. Enable Banking is GDPR and DORA compliant with an active PSD3 / FIDA roadmap.
e.name: Enable Banking

e.description: Enable Midstream Partners was a midstream energy company engaged in the gathering, processing, transportation, and storage of natural gas, natural gas liquids, and crude oil. Enable Midstream Partners was acquired by Energy Transfer LP in December 2021 and operations have been integrated into Energy Transfer's midstream business. No public developer APIs are published for this entity.
e.name: Enable Midstream Partners

e.description: Enapi (ENAPI) operates a unified roaming and clearing platform for the electric vehicle charging industry, brokering transactions between Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and e-Mobility Service Providers (eMSPs). Rather than exposing a proprietary API, Enapi implements the open OCPI (Open Charge Point Interface) standard out-of-the-box across versions 2.1.1, 2.2.1, and 2.3.0, operating as an OCPI HUB that handles version interoperability, message routing, and endpoint fan-out on behalf of partners. Its three product lines are Roaming (peer-to-peer commercial connections while Enapi handles the technical integration), Technical (standardized OCPI onboarding with automated testing and a staging environment), and Financial CDR Clearing (real-time Charge Detail Record validation, dispute flagging, and settlement). As of early 2024 the platform connects over 700,000 charge points and works with most major eMSPs including partners such as TotalEnergies, ChargePoint, ubitricity, Plugsurfing, Monta, and Eneco.
e.name: Enapi

e.description: Enbala Power Networks was a distributed-energy-resource (DER) and grid-flexibility software company (Concerto DER management platform). It was surfaced as an obvious-ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment pass the company has no live public developer or API presence. enbala.com serves an expired TLS certificate and 301-redirects to www.generacgs.com (Generac Grid Services), which no longer resolves in DNS. No OpenAPI, docs host, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, or webhook surface could be located. Treat this profile as a defunct/acquired lead rather than an active API provider.
e.name: Enbala

e.description: Enboarder is an employee onboarding and people-activation platform used by HR teams, managers and IT to design, automate and measure personalized employee journeys across preboarding, onboarding, compliance, internal transitions, offboarding and enablement. It exposes a regional REST API for launching, updating, cancelling and reporting on workflows, managing employee profiles and exporting form data, a SCIM 2.0 endpoint for user provisioning, and an outbound Webhook module that posts configurable JSON payloads to downstream systems such as Slack, Jira and ServiceNow. API access is region-scoped across Australia, the EU, the United States and Canada, and is authenticated with either an account API key or OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
e.name: Enboarder

e.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.
e.name: Encentive

e.description: Encharge is a behavior-based marketing automation platform built for SaaS companies, with a visual flow builder, broadcasts, segments, lead scoring, A/B testing, native forms, custom objects, and 50+ native integrations (HubSpot, Stripe, Salesforce, Segment, Facebook Ads, and more). The platform combines email marketing automation, user profiles, and product-event tracking to send targeted emails based on what users do (or do not do) in a SaaS product. Encharge exposes three developer surfaces: a REST API of 69 operations covering people, person fields, segments, tags, broadcasts, email templates, sending domains, custom objects and event subscriptions, described by a published OpenAPI 3.0 definition; a prose-documented Transactional Email API; and an Ingest API for streaming people and product events from a backend. All three authenticate with the same account token, passed in the X-Encharge-Token header or a token query parameter, with OAuth 2 available for partner apps.
e.name: Encharge

e.description: Enclave (enclave.ai) is an AI-powered application and cloud security platform that operates as an "agentic security engineer." It continuously builds a living model of an organization's attack surface across services and cloud providers, then autonomously triages and investigates vulnerability findings against known CVEs to determine real-world exploitability and reachability. Rather than flooding teams with signature-based noise, Enclave traces data flows to confirm whether a CVE is actually reachable, surfaces cross-service exploits that traditional scanners miss, and routes prioritized remediation plans with proof to the owning teams. Founded by veterans from Stripe, Box, VMware, Salesforce, and Yelp, the company is backed by 8VC and Marc Benioff. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.
e.name: Enclave

e.description: Encoded Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation gene therapies for neurological disorders, translating precision genetic science into transformative genetic medicines. Its Genetic Medicines Product Engine supports a pipeline led by ETX101, an investigational AAV gene therapy for SCN1A-positive Dravet Syndrome, alongside additional research programs. Backed by GV, Menlo Ventures, and SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences profile. As a clinical-stage therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity for the network.
e.name: Encoded Therapeutics

e.description: Encompass is the dominant mortgage loan origination system (LOS), a product of ICE Mortgage Technology (formerly Ellie Mae, acquired by Intercontinental Exchange / ICE in 2020). Its developer program, Encompass Developer Connect, exposes REST APIs that let partners and lenders configure, customize, and administer loan information and resources programmatically - loan manufacturing, loan pipeline, borrower pairs, contacts, eFolder documents and attachments, milestones, conditions, users, product and pricing, and event webhooks. Access is partner/tenant-gated (OAuth 2.0 credentials issued per Encompass instance by a super administrator), but the API reference is publicly documented at developer.icemortgagetechnology.com.
e.name: Encompass

e.description: Encompass Developer Connect is the ICE Mortgage Technology REST API platform that allows developers to configure, customize, and administer loan information and resources programmatically. It covers loan manufacturing, loan pipeline, product and pricing, compliance, documents and eFolder, loan data extracts, and loan folders. Access is authenticated via OAuth 2.0 with support for user impersonation, ISV partner API users, and federated SAML SSO.
e.name: Encompass Developer Connect

e.description: Encompass Health is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Encompass Health API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: Encompass Health

e.description: Encord is a computer vision data labeling and model evaluation platform that provides tools and APIs for managing datasets, annotation tasks, labels, and quality workflows at scale. The platform supports multimodal data including images, video, audio, DICOM, point clouds, and text. Encord exposes a REST API and a Python SDK (encord) for programmatically managing projects, datasets, ontologies, storage, and automated labeling workflows. Authentication is handled via SSH private key or service account credentials, with separate US and UK API endpoints available. Encord is used by AI teams in healthcare, autonomous systems, and other industries to accelerate model development by streamlining data curation, annotation, and evaluation pipelines.
e.name: Encord

e.description: Encore is a backend application framework and developer cloud that lets engineering teams build type-safe distributed systems in TypeScript (Encore.ts) and Go (Encore.go) using declarative Infrastructure from Code. Developers describe APIs, databases, Pub/Sub, object storage, caches, cron jobs, and secrets as typed code primitives; the framework provisions matching infrastructure locally with no Docker Compose, and Encore Cloud provisions equivalent managed resources in the customer's own AWS or GCP account. The platform ships built-in distributed tracing, a local development dashboard, auto-generated API docs and client SDKs, a Model Context Protocol server for AI agents, preview environments per pull request, and CI/CD — positioning Encore as an opinionated alternative to PaaS and a productivity layer on top of hyperscaler infrastructure.
e.name: Encore

e.description: Encore HQ is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
e.name: Encore HQ

e.description: Encore Music Technologies, Inc. ("Encore") is a consumer live-music technology company based in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2020 by Ian Edelman, Jonathan Gray, and recording artist Kid Cudi. Its mobile app lets artists perform live inside custom augmented-reality environments directly from a phone while fans join, react, and pay artists in real time through gamified microtransactions such as a ten-cent "clap." The company raised a $9M seed round led by Battery Ventures in February 2022, with participation from 468 Capital, Kayak Ventures, Parade Ventures, and others. Encore ships consumer iOS and Android apps rather than a public developer platform; as of this pass it exposes no documented public API, and its marketing website (clapforencore.com) does not currently resolve to a live server.
e.name: Encore Music Technologies

e.description: End Close is an automated reconciliation platform for payments companies and other high-volume transaction businesses. Its REST API connects payment processors, bank accounts, and accounting systems, continuously matches transactions across those sources into reconciliations, surfaces exceptions with full context, and automates their resolution using rules and agents. The v1 API covers data streams, records, reconciliations, matches, rules, stories, exceptions, bank accounts and balances, bulk/async ingestion, and webhooks. Backed by Y Combinator.
e.name: End Close

e.description: End Game Interactive, Inc. (ENDGAME) is a Bellevue, Washington video game studio founded by Yang C. Liu and Luke Zbihlyj that builds free-to-play, cross-platform real-time multiplayer titles for browser, mobile and desktop — including ZombsRoyale.io, Zombs.io, Spinz.io, BOPZ.io, Fishington, Betrayal, Super Squad, Match City Puzzle and Fate Arena. The studio describes itself as technology-driven, running small agile teams against a proprietary "ENDGAME ENGINE" alongside Unity and Unreal, with AI-assisted pipelines for asset creation, animation, sound design and voicelines. It raised a $3M seed round in 2020 from Makers Fund, Supercell, Kevin Lin and Scooter Braun among others. ENDGAME is a consumer game publisher: as of this profile it operates no public developer program, no documented API, and no machine-readable contract on any of its web properties.
e.name: End Game Interactive

e.description: Endeavor was a global sports and entertainment company representing talent and owning and operating events, with subsidiaries including WME, IMG, and UFC. Following the 2024 take-private transaction by Silver Lake and the separation of TKO Group Holdings (UFC and WWE), the remaining talent, media, marketing, and licensing businesses were rebranded as WME Group. This repository tracks Endeavor as a corporate entity. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no OpenAPI; the only machine-readable surfaces on its own hosts are the wmegrp.com WordPress content API, which is anonymously readable, and a live but authentication-gated WordPress MCP Adapter endpoint.
e.name: Endeavor

e.description: Endeavor BioMedicines is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California, developing medicines aimed at reversing — not merely slowing — the course of life-threatening fibrotic and oncologic disease. Its lead investigational candidate, taladegib (ENV-101), is an inhibitor of the Hedgehog signaling pathway in clinical development for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and it has in-licensed HMBD-501, a next-generation HER3-targeted antibody-drug conjugate. Endeavor publishes no developer program or product API; the machine-readable surface profiled here is the public WordPress REST API served from its corporate website, together with an authenticated WordPress MCP server and the RFC 8414 / RFC 9728 OAuth 2.1 discovery documents that host advertises.
e.name: Endeavor BioMedicines

e.description: Endeavor Catalyst is the rules-based, co-investment fund of Endeavor Global, the nonprofit that supports high-impact entrepreneurs worldwide. The fund invests exclusively in companies led by Endeavor Entrepreneurs across Series A through D+ rounds, recycling proceeds back into Endeavor's mission of building entrepreneurial ecosystems in emerging and underserved markets. Endeavor Catalyst I is the first vintage in this fund family; across all vintages the program manages $540M+ in assets with 405+ active investments spanning 35+ markets, including 71 companies valued at $1B+ and 37 realized exits. This profile tracks the firm as a venture-capital entity in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API.
e.name: Endeavor Catalyst I

e.description: Endeavour Energy is the regulated electricity distribution network service provider (DNSP) for Greater Western Sydney, the Blue Mountains, the Illawarra, the Southern Highlands, the South Coast and Central West of New South Wales, Australia, delivering power to around 2.8 million people over the poles-and-wires network it owns and operates. It sits between transmission and retail in the value chain - it moves electricity and hosts the meters, but it does not sell energy to consumers, so it holds no retail billing relationship. Its API posture is a sharp split. On the market and network side it is genuinely open: a live Opendatasoft portal at data.endeavourenergy.com.au serves eight network datasets (poles, conductors, distribution districts, other network assets, distribution substation available capacity, and live planned/unplanned/single-premise outages) through a documented, anonymous, no-key REST Explore API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract, most of it under the Open Database Licence. On the consumer side it is closed and, more importantly, unobligated: Australia's Consumer Data Right was extended to energy, but the designation put the data-holder obligation on electricity retailers as primary holders and AEMO as the secondary holder and gateway, not on distributors. Endeavour Energy appears nowhere in the 84 brands of the CDR energy data holder register, publishes no CDR base URI, and makes no reference to the Consumer Data Right anywhere on its corporate site. It does operate a CSIP-AUS (Common Smart Inverter Profile - Australia) utility server for NSW flexible exports and the emergency backstop mechanism, but that machine interface is device-facing and entirely undocumented publicly. The open data portal itself is not linked from the corporate website.
e.name: Endeavour Energy

e.description: Endel is a wellness technology company that generates personalized, adaptive soundscapes to help people focus, relax, sleep, and stay active. Its patented technology creates endless real-time audio that responds to inputs such as time of day, weather, circadian rhythm, heart rate, and location, delivered across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, web, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Alexa. Endel is a consumer application; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface, so this repo captures its identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.
e.name: Endel

e.description: Endgame (Endgame Labs, Inc.) is a context graph platform for go-to-market teams and AI agents that turns sales calls, CRM records, emails, Slack conversations, meeting transcripts, and uploaded documents into structured, queryable revenue intelligence. Sales and RevOps users ask questions across their book of business in natural language, and connected AI assistants reach the same knowledge through the Endgame MCP Server. The public REST API (rooted at /api/v1) lets developers create and manage Endgame threads programmatically over HTTPS with Bearer-token authentication, while a broad connector surface ingests context from Salesforce, Gong, Chorus, Clari Copilot, Zoom, Notion, Confluence, Highspot, Seismic, Snowflake, Slack, Microsoft Teams/SharePoint/Outlook, and Google Drive. Endgame was surfaced through the API Evangelist VC-portfolio pipeline and has been enriched from its published developer documentation, OpenAPI, MCP server, and trust/security programs.
e.name: Endgame

e.description: Endl is a financial-technology company offering "the operating account for borderless businesses." The platform lets consulting firms, agencies, contractors, marketplaces, and importers/exporters collect payments in 9+ currencies, send to 160+ countries, hold balances in USD, EUR, GBP and regulated stablecoins, and spend through physical and virtual Visa corporate cards with spend controls — all from a single dashboard. Endl positions itself against Wise, Payoneer, Revolut, Deel, Mercury and Airwallex, and is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently advertised; the product is dashboard-first.
e.name: Endl

e.description: Endless Studios LLC is a game development learning platform where aspiring creators learn to build video games through real, pro-studio projects. Its Endstar game engine lets creators code and collaborate in real time, while structured programs (Launchpad for beginners, Capstone for advanced participants) pair learners with 30+ game-industry mentors, expert playtesting, and collaborator matching across design, art, and programming. Learners build portfolios of shipped games to show potential employers. The company runs university, government, and partner programs (including a UAE national game-making competition) and is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment (consumer/creator-facing product on the studio.endlessstudios.com app).
e.name: Endless Studios

e.description: Endless West is a Detroit-based molecular spirits manufacturer that applies food and molecular science to create alcoholic beverages without traditional distilling or aging. The company operates a TTB-approved production facility offering bulk base spirits and ready-to-bottle liquids, turnkey and private-label packaged brands, pre-made concentrates, and contract co-packing and bottling services for other brands and entrepreneurs. Its proprietary Glyph Molecular Spirit showcases a sustainability approach that reduces water usage and CO2 footprint versus conventional distillation. Endless West is a consumer-products and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Endless West

e.description: Endo Health is building Glow, an AI-native clinic for women's weight loss. Describing itself as "the emotional layer of healthcare" and aiming to "make health addictive," the company treats the drivers behind symptoms rather than the symptoms alone, delivering conversational, connection-first care through a mobile health app. Its stated mission is to advance human lifespan by one year. Endo Health is backed by General Catalyst and a16z Speedrun, with teams in San Francisco and Seoul. This is a consumer digital-health product; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface has been published at this time.
e.name: Endo Health

e.description: Endo International was a specialty pharmaceutical company best known for Xiaflex (collagenase clostridium histolyticum), branded urology and orthopedic products, and a large sterile-injectables and generics business (Par Pharmaceutical). Endo filed Chapter 11 in August 2022 amid mass opioid litigation tied to its legacy Opana ER franchise, and emerged in April 2024 as the private company Endo, Inc., owned by its former creditors. On July 31, 2025, Endo combined with Mallinckrodt; the merged group then separated in November 2025 into two independent companies — Keenova Therapeutics (specialty branded therapeutics, including the former Endo Xiaflex/urology/orthopedics portfolio and Mallinckrodt specialty brands) and Par Health (generics, sterile injectables, and pharmaceutical Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients manufacturing). Endo no longer operates as a standalone public-facing pharmaceutical company. There is no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or technology API surface associated with Endo, the post-emergence Endo Inc, Keenova Therapeutics, or Par Health. Any references to "API" on the successor companies' sites refer to pharmaceutical Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, not software application programming interfaces.
e.name: Endo International

e.description: EndoGastric Solutions is a medical device company focused on treating gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). Its flagship offering is the TIF (Transoral Incisionless Fundoplication) 2.0 procedure, performed with the EsophyX Z+ device and SerosaFuse non-resorbable polypropylene fasteners to endoscopically reconstruct the natural antireflux barrier at the esophagogastric junction, plus the combined cTIF procedure that pairs hiatal hernia repair with TIF. The company sells devices and clinician training rather than software, and it has since been acquired by Merit Medical — the endogastricsolutions.com domain now redirects to merit.com/solutions/tif-2-0/. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and carries no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface.
e.name: Endogastric Solutions

e.description: EndoQuest Robotics is a Houston, Texas medical device company — founded in 2017 and operating as ColubrisMX until its June 2022 rebrand — developing what it calls the world's first flexible endoluminal robotic surgical system. Its Endoluminal Surgical (ELS) System pairs an ergonomic physician console (high-definition monitor, hand controllers, foot pedals) with a mobile patient cart and positioning arm, driving two 6mm flexible robotic instruments and a 3.7mm high-definition robotic camera through the EndoDrive, with up to seven degrees of freedom and additional channels for insufflation, suction, irrigation and third-party accessories. The design targets scar-free minimally invasive procedures inside the gastrointestinal tract — including appendectomy and cholecystectomy — performed through natural orifices or a single transumbilical incision. The company was accepted into the FDA's Safer Technologies Program in December 2023, received an investigational device exemption in December 2024, and began first colorectal cases in its PARADIGM pivotal multicenter study in May 2025. The system is not FDA-cleared and is not for commercial sale. EndoQuest sells surgical robotics hardware, not software: it publishes no API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its nine-page marketing site carries no developer surface.
e.name: EndoQuest Robotics

e.description: Endor Labs is a software supply chain security and application security platform built around reachability-based Software Composition Analysis (SCA), SBOM/VEX, secrets and SAST scanning, CI/CD discovery, and AI security. Its public REST API at https://api.endorlabs.com/v1 is a uniform resource API over namespaces, exposing projects, packages, findings, policies, scan results, and more, driven by the endorctl CLI.
e.name: Endor Labs

e.description: Endotronix, Inc. is a Naperville, Illinois medical device and digital health company founded in 2007 and acquired by Edwards Lifesciences in July 2024, where it now operates as a wholly owned subsidiary. Endotronix builds the Cordella Heart Failure System, an integrated remote heart-failure management platform combining an implantable wireless pulmonary artery (PA) pressure sensor — granted FDA premarket approval in June 2024 — with a patient-facing myCordella tablet application, connected home vitals peripherals (blood pressure cuff, weight scale, pulse oximeter), and the myCordella Patient Management Portal, a cloud-based web application clinicians use to review transmitted PA pressure, vitals and symptom data and to titrate guideline-directed medical therapy. The company publishes clinical evidence (PROACTIVE-HF), instructions for use and device manuals, but operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification on any Endotronix host.
e.name: Endotronix

e.description: Endovascular Engineering is a medical-device company developing minimally invasive thrombectomy technology for the removal of blood clots. Its lead product, the Helo PE Thrombectomy System, targets pulmonary embolism, pairing a small catheter profile with large-bore clot engagement via a self-expanding funnel and dual-action high-speed agitation plus physician-controlled aspiration for single-pass navigation of complex vasculature. The Helo system is investigational only and not commercially available. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. The company publishes a marketing and clinical-overview website but no public developer, API, SDK, or technical-documentation surface.
e.name: Endovascularengineering

e.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.
e.name: Endowus

e.description: Endurance Energy is a renewable-energy developer building subsea geothermal power systems that harness volcanic activity beneath the seafloor to generate continuous, weather-independent electricity. Its first product, Adelie, is a planned 100 kW subsea power system slated for deployment in September 2026 at the Axial Seamount caldera off the Oregon coast, targeting island nations, industrial facilities, and data centers that need firm baseload power. The company is venture-backed (a Series A led by Founders Fund) and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Felicis portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes no public developer surface, API, SDK, or documentation; this entry captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.
e.name: Endurance Energy

e.description: EnduroSat is a Sofia, Bulgaria-based satellite manufacturer and space service provider working to make space universally accessible by lowering the cost and complexity of accessing space data. The company builds CubeSat and SmallSat platforms (FRAME Max, FRAME L, FRAME S buses and 8U/12U/16U CubeSats), avionics and communication modules (X-Band SDR, S-Band and UHF transceivers, EPS power modules, solar panels, and antennas), and delivers end-to-end Space Service, SpaceOps, and SpaceDev offerings that take customers from idea to orbit in roughly six months. EnduroSat has deployed 100+ satellites with 3,500+ modules in operation, downlinked 500+ TB of data, and serves ~450 customers including NASA, ESA, and IBM Space. It maintains an open-source GitHub organization publishing Cubesat Space Protocol (CSP) implementations and NextGen ground-station and onboard API frameworks. Backed by Founders Fund and GV.
e.name: EnduroSat

e.description: ENDVR provides a sell‑through enablement platform that connects brands, retailers, and frontline teams. The network powers real‑time product availability insights, digital education, sales incentives, consumer cashback, and display maintenance tools. Brands can activate stores for free, access pricing calculators, and integrate with mobile apps on iOS and Android. ENDVR aims to boost sell‑through in every door by offering data‑driven insights and collaborative tools for brand and retail teams.
e.name: ENDVR

e.description: enechain operates the largest energy exchange in Japan, offering trading opportunities for wholesale electricity and environmental values across an over-the-counter marketplace that connects energy market participants. Headquartered in Tokyo, the company builds energy markets that help buyers and sellers discover prices, manage risk, and trade power and environmental-value products, under the mission "Building Energy Markets, Coloring Our Society." enechain was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation surface at this time.
e.name: enechain

e.description: Enedis is the French public electricity distribution network operator, managing the grid for millions of customers across France. It modernizes, maintains, and services the electricity distribution infrastructure, providing metering, outage management, and customer support. As a public service entity, Enedis plays a key role in France’s energy transition and grid reliability.
e.name: Enedis

e.description: Enel is a multinational energy company and one of the world’s leading integrated electricity and gas operators. It focuses on renewable energy, digital innovation, and sustainability, providing electricity and gas to millions of customers worldwide. Enel operates in over 30 countries, invests heavily in clean energy projects, and drives digital transformation across its services.
e.name: Enel

e.description: Enel X is the advanced-energy-services business line of the Enel Group, an Italian multinational utility headquartered in Rome. Enel X delivers smart energy products and services across electrification, e-mobility, demand response, virtual power plants, and distributed energy resource (DER) management for residential, commercial, industrial, public-sector, and utility customers. Its principal offerings include the Enel X Way app and network for electric-vehicle charging (the consolidated successor to JuicePass and JuiceNet), the JuiceBox and JuicePedestal hardware lines, the JuiceNet Utility Edition managed-charging platform, the DER.OS / DER optimization software (now run as Calibrant Energy in North America after Enel's 2023 divestiture of its North American demand-response business), Enel X Flex flexibility management software, and VPP Connect, a set of API endpoints that lets third-party DER operators — OEMs, automation providers, and equipment manufacturers — aggregate EV chargers, batteries, HVAC systems, heat pumps, and other controllable assets into Enel's virtual power plant and earn revenue from demand-response and grid-services programs via either the open Automated Demand Response (oADR) protocol or a custom Enel API. Enel X exposes additional non-public surfaces — including the emobility.enelx.com OAuth/charging endpoints used by the Enel X Way mobile apps — but does not publish OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a developer portal; VPP Connect documentation is delivered under partnership agreement after a guided onboarding process. The official Enelx GitHub organization has effectively no public engineering presence, and the legacy JuiceNet public API has been deprecated as part of the platform migration to Enel X Way.
e.name: Enel X

e.description: EnerGaia is a spirulina producer, incorporated in Thailand in April 2009 and now headquartered in Singapore, that grows nutrient-dense microalgae in proprietary closed bioreactors rather than open ponds to deliver clean, consistent spirulina for food and beverage manufacturers. The company originated from research into using microalgae to capture industrial CO2 from power-plant flue gas and has since focused on making spirulina a mainstream, sustainable food ingredient. Its product line includes Fresh Spirulina Paste, Fresh-Frozen Spirulina, and Freeze-Dried Spirulina Powder, used in beverages, egg substitutes, noodles, meat replacements, pastas, and snacks. EnerGaia is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.
e.name: EnerGaia

e.description: Energen Corporation was a U.S. oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, with operations focused on the Permian Basin in west Texas and southeast New Mexico. In November 2018, Energen was acquired by Diamondback Energy in an all-stock transaction, and the Energen brand was retired as its assets were integrated into Diamondback. No public developer APIs are currently published; this repository preserves the corporate record.
e.name: Energen

e.description: Energizer Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Energizer Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: Energizer Holdings

e.description: Energy and Utilities is a topic profile in the API Evangelist Network cataloging the API surfaces that move data across the modern electricity, gas, and water value chain. It indexes utility data integration APIs, grid and wholesale market operator APIs, federal energy data programs, renewable energy research APIs, weather APIs that drive grid demand and solar forecasting, EV charging interoperability protocols, and the Green Button family of customer energy data standards. The repo provides a baseline catalog plus shared semantics (JSON Schema, JSON-LD, vocabulary, examples) for the meter reading / energy data point that ties every one of these surfaces together.
e.name: Energy and Utilities

e.description: The Energy-Charts API, provided by Fraunhofer ISE, delivers European energy data including electricity production by source, day-ahead spot market prices, cross-border electricity trading and physical flows, grid frequency, installed capacity, and renewable energy share forecasts. It covers more than 40 European countries and bidding zones, supports ISO 8601, daily, and UNIX timestamp formats, and is largely licensed under CC BY 4.0.
e.name: Energy Charts API

e.description: Energy Future Holdings was a Dallas-based privately held energy company involved in electricity generation, mining, wholesale energy trading, transmission and distribution, and retail electricity through subsidiaries Luminant, Oncor, and TXU Energy. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2014 and was succeeded by Vistra Corp (which absorbed Luminant and TXU Energy generation/retail operations) and Sempra Texas Utilities (which acquired Oncor). No active developer APIs are offered under the Energy Future Holdings name.
e.name: Energy Future Holdings

e.description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) is committed to its free and open data by making it available through an Application Programming Interface (API) and its open data tools. The EIA Open Data API v2 is multi-faceted and contains time-series datasets organized by the main energy categories, including electricity, natural gas, petroleum, coal, nuclear, renewables, total energy, international energy statistics, the State Energy Data System (SEDS), and CO2 emissions aggregates.
e.name: Energy Information Administration

e.description: Energy Micro was a Norwegian fabless semiconductor company, founded in 2007 and headquartered in Oslo, best known for its EFM32 "Gecko" family of energy-friendly 32-bit ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and the EFR radio products targeting low-power embedded and IoT applications. The company was acquired by Silicon Labs in 2013 and fully absorbed into that company's product lines; its former energymicro.com domain now redirects to silabs.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment found no independent, first-party API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or MCP surface for Energy Micro as a standalone entity — the developer tooling for its EFM32 line lives under Silicon Labs today.
e.name: Energy Micro

e.description: Energy Queensland Limited is the Queensland Government-owned corporation formed on 30 June 2016 by merging Ergon Energy and Energex. It is the whole Queensland electricity value chain below transmission in a single holding company: Energex distributes to roughly 1.5 million connections across South East Queensland, Ergon Energy Network distributes across regional Queensland, Ergon Energy Retail is the notified-price retailer for about 760,000 regional customers, Yurika sells energy services and telecommunications, and SPARQ Solutions provides group ICT. That dual role is what makes its API posture worth recording precisely, because the two halves of the business sit on opposite sides of a statutory line. The RETAIL half is a designated Consumer Data Right energy data holder and its implementation is verified live, not claimed: "Ergon Energy Retail" (ABN 11121177802) is listed on the ACCC CDR Register with publicBaseUri https://public.cdr.ergonretail.com.au and productBaseUri https://cdr.energymadeeasy.gov.au/ergon, both of which answered HTTP 200 to anonymous, standards-conformant calls on 2026-07-27, returning 36 REGULATED electricity plans and a CDS discovery status of OK. The DISTRIBUTION half - the poles and wires - is not a CDR data holder at all, publishes no developer portal, no open-data API and no machine-readable contract, and has no developer., developers., api., docs. or data. subdomain in DNS on energyq.com.au, ergon.com.au or energex.com.au. Its network data reaches the public as PDF and XLSX planning reports, registration-free but non-programmatic map viewers, and exactly one open-licensed spatial dataset deposited on the Queensland Government's CKAN portal. The split is the finding: a mandate transplanted from banking produced a real, anonymous, standardised API on the regulated retail side and changed nothing whatsoever on the network side it never touched.
e.name: Energy Queensland

e.description: Energy Robotics GmbH, now trading as Korial, is a Darmstadt, Germany enterprise AI platform (spun out of TU Darmstadt robotics research) for fully autonomous industrial operations. It is hardware-agnostic, unifying mixed-vendor robots, legged and tracked ground robots, drones, fixed cameras, and field sensors into a single governed AI operating layer that turns live telemetry into verified insight and orchestrated action across oil & gas, chemicals, power & utilities, and critical infrastructure. The platform spans four modules: Kore (the AI core with LLM, agentic workflows, embedded AI skills, and fleet/device supervision), Connect (an integration backbone exposing bidirectional governed APIs into ERP, EAM, SCADA, historians and ICS/OT systems), Recreate (digital twins and mission simulation), and Sustain (support, onboarding, and managed mission execution). Korial reports 1,000,000+ autonomous inspections, 100+ global deployments, and named customers including Shell, bp, Repsol, Petrobras, Pluspetrol, Chevron, E.ON, Evonik, BASF, and Merck. Rebranded from Energy Robotics GmbH on 4 May 2026.
e.name: Energy Robotics

e.description: Energy Transfer is one of the largest and most diversified midstream energy companies in North America, owning and operating natural gas, crude oil, NGL, and refined products pipelines, terminals, and storage facilities.
e.name: Energy Transfer

e.description: Energy Transfer Equity, L.P. (ETE) was a master limited partnership that owned and operated a diverse portfolio of midstream energy assets. In October 2018, ETE merged with its operating subsidiary Energy Transfer Partners (ETP) to form a single publicly traded partnership, Energy Transfer LP (NYSE: ET). All developer resources, including the Messenger+ API for pipeline messaging and gas scheduling, are now provided under the Energy Transfer LP brand.
e.name: Energy Transfer Equity

e.description: Energy Vault Holdings (NYSE: NRGV) is a Swiss-founded, US-headquartered energy storage company delivering grid-scale storage hardware, software, and services worldwide. Its portfolio spans battery energy storage (B-VAULT), gravity-based storage (G-VAULT / EVx), and green-hydrogen storage (H-VAULT), unified by VaultOS, an energy management software platform providing real-time monitoring, operational control, and optimized dispatch across storage and generation assets, alongside Vault Bidder and Vault Manager for market bidding and asset management. The company serves utilities, independent power producers, and large energy users, with more than 1.4 GWh deployed since 2023. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Energy Vault is a frontier-tech company in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; VaultOS is delivered as a proprietary, deployment-integrated platform rather than a public API product.
e.name: Energy Vault

e.description: EnergyAustralia is one of Australia's "big three" gentailers — a vertically integrated electricity and gas business owned by Hong Kong's CLP Group and headquartered in Melbourne, generating from Yallourn, Mount Piper and Hallett alongside wind assets and retailing to more than 1.7 million residential and business customers across Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia and the ACT. It sits on both sides of the National Electricity Market value chain: a scheduled generator into the NEM, and a retailer of record holding the customer relationship, the billing account and the meter data. Its API posture is entirely a function of the Consumer Data Right rather than of any product strategy. EnergyAustralia is a designated and live CDR energy data holder — brand id 1cc7833a-b834-ed11-a832-000d3a8830d6 in the ACCC CDR Register, public base URI https://authncdr.energyaustralia.com.au — but the only anonymously reachable contract carrying its name is the Product Reference Data surface, and that is hosted by the Australian Energy Regulator's Energy Made Easy CDR gateway, not by EnergyAustralia. The company publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI of its own, no open market or generation data, and no self-serve signup; its own gateway at api.energyaustralia.com.au (MuleSoft Anypoint) answers 403 to the public. Consumer usage, billing and DER data is real, standardised and live, but reachable only by an ACCC-accredited data recipient under consent. Open on plans, closed on everything else.
e.name: EnergyAustralia

e.description: EnergyBank is a New Zealand deep-tech energy company developing next-generation energy storage for the offshore wind market. Its core approach firms floating offshore wind generation at the turbine so that compute modules can be co-located with the generation itself — taking "data to the power rather than electricity to the data" — which removes the need for a grid connection, enables consentless high-seas deployment, and allows direct ocean cooling of the co-located compute. The company was founded by CEO Tim Hawkey and CTO Alex Szczepaniak, and its team combines applied mathematicians, electronics engineers, and business development staff with advisors drawn from subsea turbomachinery. EnergyBank is venture backed by Version One Ventures, Blackbird, Icehouse Ventures, Outset Ventures, Promus Ventures, Nuance Capital, and Boost VC. As of this enrichment pass EnergyBank publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification — it is a hardware and energy-infrastructure company rather than an API provider.
e.name: EnergyBank

e.description: ENERGYDATA.info is a organization open-data portal running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 1,190 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.
e.name: ENERGYDATA.info

e.description: EnergyHub is a Brooklyn, New York distributed energy resource management system (DERMS) vendor and an independent subsidiary of Alarm.com (Nasdaq ALRM), operating in its home market of the United States. Its Edge DERMS platform (formerly marketed as Mercury DERMS) lets electric utilities enroll, forecast, dispatch, and measure customer-owned distributed energy resources - smart thermostats, batteries, electric vehicles and EV chargers, solar inverters, and commercial and industrial loads - as virtual power plants, and the company says it has been running load control programs since 2009. EnergyHub sits squarely in the private middle layer of the energy value chain. It is not a utility, not a retailer, and not a market operator, so no consumer energy data mandate applies to it: there is no Green Button obligation, no Consumer Data Right designation, and no Ontario regulation in play. Its API posture is honestly partner-only and entirely undocumented in public. Two APIs are publicly announced by the company - the Mercury Edge Connect API, which EnergyHub states is "based on the Open ADR standard", and a Marketplace API for demand-response pre-enrollment at the device point of sale - but neither has public reference documentation, a published base URI, a schema, or a self-serve signup. The knowledge base at help.energyhub.com serves a public landing page while every technical guide and device-partner integration article behind it is gated by an Okta SSO login. A live host at mec.energyhub.com answers TLS with a valid DigiCert certificate and rejects every anonymous request with "400 No required SSL certificate was sent", which is mutual-TLS client-certificate enforcement rather than a public API. No consumer usage or billing data API exists for third parties, and no open grid or market data is published, so EnergyHub is closed on both the consumer-data and the market-data axis, and a developer gets in only by signing a commercial or DER partner agreement.
e.name: EnergyHub

e.description: Energysquare is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of partech and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: Industrial, Energy & IoT. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
e.name: Energysquare

e.description: EnergyX (Energy Exploration Technologies, Inc.) is a critical-materials technology company founded in 2018 by Teague Egan and headquartered in Austin, Texas, with operations in Texarkana, Antofagasta in Chile, and San Juan, Puerto Rico. It develops direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology — a modular, brine-agnostic flow sheet combining adsorbents, solvent extraction and its own selective membranes under the GET-Lit platform — together with SoLiS lithium-metal battery technology and NUKE-it membranes for lithium-6/7 isotope separation and nuclear fuel-cycle applications. The company produces lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate and lithium dihydrogen phosphate, holds a large patent portfolio, and controls lithium resources in Chile and the United States including the Black Giant project. EnergyX is a materials and process-technology company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no SDKs and no developer portal. The only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website at energyx.com, which is captured here for discovery purposes and is anonymously readable but read-only.
e.name: EnergyX

e.description: EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications, manufacturing batteries, chargers, accessories, and outdoor equipment enclosures. EnerSys serves motive power, reserve power, aerospace and defense, and specialty markets. While EnerSys offers a number of customer-facing web tools (Battery Sizing Program, Motive Power configurator, CARB Compliance Calculator) and product-level telemetry such as the Wi-iQ battery monitoring system and NexSys iON connected fleet platform, no public developer APIs or open specifications have been published as of this index.
e.name: EnerSys

e.description: Enertiv is a commercial real estate sustainability and decarbonization technology company serving owners and operators of large CRE portfolios. Its platform combines portfolio-scale utility data collection and ESG reporting (Report), asset-specific carbon planning that pairs AI recommendations with on-site equipment surveys (Decarbonize), and real-time monitoring with fault detection and operational optimization (Optimize). Additional workflow tools cover automated tenant utility billing and maintenance/work-order management, with integrations into property management systems such as Yardi and MRI. The company guarantees 100% utility data coverage — including tenant-controlled utilities — and has worked with 100+ large portfolios over more than fifteen years.
e.name: Enertiv

e.description: Enervee operates an AI-powered white-label marketplace platform that helps utilities and government energy programs scale energy efficiency across 39 million-plus households in North America. Its stack spans a utility-branded online store for efficient appliances and equipment across 40-plus product categories (HVAC, water heaters, heat pumps, smart thermostats, EV chargers), the Enervee Score - a proprietary 0-100 energy-efficiency rating updated daily - Eco Financing embedded lending at checkout through national bank partners, and Instant Rebates that automatically stack utility, government, and manufacturer incentives at checkout. Enervee is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company's public security, trust, and identity posture for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Enervee

e.description: EnerVenue is a Fremont, California-based energy infrastructure company building long-duration stationary energy storage using a metal-hydrogen (nickel-hydrogen) battery chemistry derived from NASA-heritage technology that has powered the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station since the 1980s. Co-founded by Stanford materials scientist Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue refined the orbital nickel-hydrogen cell into a grid-scale "Energy Storage Vessel" (ESV) targeting a 30-year, 30,000+ cycle service life with 100% usable depth of discharge, ~90% round-trip efficiency, an operating range of -20 C to +60 C, no thermal runaway risk, and no active thermal management. The ESV's aqueous metal cell (AMC) uses a nickel hydroxide cathode, a nickel-alloy anode, an alkaline electrolyte, and hermetically sealed hydrogen gas storage built from steel, nickel, fiberglass, resin, and water — no lithium, cobalt, or rare earths. EnerVenue is scaling manufacturing through a one-million- square-foot gigafactory in Shelby County, Kentucky (1 GWh phase one, scaling toward 20 GWh per year with ~$1B of follow-on investment) plus a high-volume line in Changzhou, China (250 MWh by Q3 2026, 1 GWh in 2027). Customer commitments exceed 7 GWh and include Pine Gate Renewables (2.4 GWh, multi-year), Green Energy Renewable Solutions (Nicon Industries), Sonnell Power Solutions, and VedantaESS. The company closed a $300M Series B in 2026 to fund the gigafactory build-out. EnerVenue sells hardware, EPC-integrated storage systems, and long-duration service warranties — it does not publish a developer API, SDK, public OpenAPI specification, or open-source repository.
e.name: EnerVenue

e.description: Eneryield is a Gothenburg, Sweden based company (a Techstars portfolio company) building AI-powered fault prediction and analytics for electric power systems. Its flagship product, Eneryield IntelliView, uses explainable AI to forecast power outages before they occur by analyzing voltage and current signals from digital relays and merging units on overhead lines, underground cables, and underwater cables. The cloud-based platform integrates directly into existing utility monitoring systems without additional hardware, giving grid operators transparent root-cause analysis so they can move to proactive maintenance and reduce operational cost and downtime. As of this profile, Eneryield publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Eneryield

e.description: Enevate Corporation was an Irvine, California battery technology company that developed and licensed silicon-dominant lithium-ion anode and cell technology — marketed as HD-Energy and XFC-Energy — aimed at extreme fast charging (roughly five minutes to a substantial state of charge), high energy density, and cold-weather performance for electric vehicles, with a licensing rather than cell-manufacturing business model. It was a materials and cell-chemistry licensor, not a software vendor, and it never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or webhook surface. As of an August 2026 probe the company's own domain no longer serves a company website: enevate.com redirects to a "Website Temporarily Unavailable" domain notice stating the prior Enevate Corporation website has been retired and the domain is now under new ownership following an asset acquisition process, and that all previously published statements about products, services, partnerships and company operations should no longer be considered current. This profile is retained as a recorded absence with the probe evidence attached.
e.name: Enevate

e.description: Enfabrica is a semiconductor company building networking silicon and systems for large-scale AI and accelerated-computing infrastructure. Its ACF-S ("Accelerated Compute Fabric") SuperNIC targets maximum throughput with fault-tolerant, multipath connectivity across AI clusters, and its EMFASYS elastic memory fabric system provides memory offload for AI inference workloads. Enfabrica is backed by Spark Capital. The company publishes a technical blog and company news, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security signals rather than API artifacts.
e.name: Enfabrica

e.description: Enfuce provides a cloud‑native, tenant‑isolated, API‑first platform for card issuing, processing, licensing, ledger, fraud & dispute management, and data analytics. It serves banks, fintechs, fleet providers and enterprises, offering real‑time decisioning at scale, modular services, and compliance with PSD3, DORA and AMLA standards.
e.name: Enfuce

e.description: Enfusion is a cloud-native, front-to-back investment management platform for hedge funds and asset managers, unifying portfolio management (PMS), order and execution management (OEMS), pre- and post-trade compliance, a unified IBOR/ABOR accounting book of record, and analytics on a single SaaS database. It serves over 1,000 clients across 30 countries, offers direct connectivity to 300+ liquidity sources via FIX, and maintains a 4M+ instrument security master. Enfusion was acquired by Clearwater Analytics (CWAN) in 2025; the enfusion.com domain now redirects to cwan.com, where Enfusion is offered as a product line. There is no public developer portal or open API specification: the platform API and knowledge base are gated behind the client web application and Zendesk help center. This profile was surfaced as an ICONIQ Capital portfolio lead and enriched from public marketing, support, and legal surfaces.
e.name: Enfusion

e.description: Engagedly is a people strategy execution platform with a REST API for managing performance reviews, goal tracking, 360 feedback, learning paths, and employee recognition programs. The API enables programmatic access to users, departments, locations, job titles, activities, and organizational data using header-based authentication with client and secret keys.
e.name: Engagedly

e.description: engageSPARK is a mobile messaging and engagement platform for reaching hard-to-reach populations in low- and middle-income countries at scale. It lets NGOs, researchers, microfinance institutions, and businesses run SMS, automated voice (IVR), WhatsApp, and pre-paid airtime top-up campaigns across 180+ countries without writing code, or programmatically through its HTTP API. The engageSPARK API (api.engagespark.com, v1) exposes token-authenticated endpoints for sending SMS, WhatsApp, and airtime top-ups, managing contacts and organizations, subscribing and unsubscribing contacts to voice and SMS campaigns, reading message and top-up history, checking organization balance, and managing files. Incoming-SMS and campaign-action webhooks let the platform push survey responses and inbound messages into external systems such as Salesforce or Qualtrics.
e.name: engageSPARK

e.description: Engagespot is a notification infrastructure platform that provides developers with a unified REST API to send multi-channel notifications including in-app, email, web push, mobile push, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, and webhooks from a single integration. The platform includes a pre-built customizable in-app notification inbox, a visual workflow editor for complex messaging logic, and a fine-grained user preference management system. Engagespot handles over 850 million monthly notifications and 3.7 billion API requests with 99.98% uptime, supporting data residency in both US and EU regions. Teams can manage notification templates, monitor delivery logs, and connect to third-party providers such as SendGrid, AWS SES, Firebase, Twilio, and APNS through a centralized dashboard.
e.name: Engagespot

e.description: EngFlow provides remote build execution, remote caching, CI runners, and a Build & Test UI that accelerate large-scale software builds for Bazel, BuildStream, Goma, Pants, Soong, CMake, and Buck2. EngFlow clusters expose a gRPC / Protocol Buffers API surface — the open Remote Execution API (REAPI v2) and Remote Asset API, plus EngFlow's own cluster, IAM, authentication, event store, result store, secret, notification, and resource-usage services, all published as Protocol Buffer interface definitions in the EngFlow/engflowapis repository. Clusters authenticate via mTLS, cluster-issued JWT bearer tokens, OIDC federation, SAML, GitHub tokens, and basic auth, and provision users over SCIM 2.0. EngFlow was founded by former Google/Bazel engineers and is backed by a16z.
e.name: EngFlow

e.description: Enghouse Systems Limited (TSX: ENGH) is a publicly traded Canadian enterprise software and services company headquartered in Markham, Ontario and founded in 1984. It builds mission-critical, communications-focused software delivered on-premise and via the cloud, organized into two segments: the Interactive Management Group (Enghouse Interactive — omnichannel contact centre, customer experience, IVR, video collaboration and AI-assisted agent tooling) and the Asset Management Group (Enghouse Networks — telecom OSS/BSS, media and broadcast, and network monitoring; plus transportation, public-safety and transit systems). The company grows largely through acquisition of specialized software brands.
e.name: Enghouse

e.description: ENGIE is a global energy player headquartered in France, providing electricity, natural gas, and energy services to millions of customers worldwide. The company focuses on sustainable development, renewable energy projects, and digital transformation of its operations. ENGIE’s portfolio includes power generation, distribution, and innovative solutions for energy efficiency, electric mobility, and smart grids, positioning it as a leader in the transition to low‑carbon economies.
e.name: ENGIE

e.description: ENGIE Insight Services (formerly Ecova, now operating as ENGIE Impact) is a sustainability and resource-management company that helps corporations, cities, and governments reduce their environmental footprint and operating costs. It provides energy, water, and waste expense management, utility bill auditing and payment, data management, sustainability consulting, and decarbonization strategy across a large portfolio of client sites. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile has been enriched with domain-security and discovery probes; the company publishes no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.
e.name: ENGIE Insight Services

e.description: Engine (formerly Hotel Engine, rebranded in 2024) is a Denver, Colorado business travel and spend platform for booking and managing lodging, flights, rental cars, group travel, and meeting and event spaces, with travel policy enforcement, trip approvals, consolidated DirectBill invoicing, and the Engine X charge card. Engine says it serves 25,000+ businesses and 1.2 million travelers with negotiated rates across 1,000,000+ hotel properties. Its API product is Omni — a partner-facing lodging inventory API offered over gRPC and HTTP/JSON, authenticated with mutual TLS, that covers property content, real-time rate shopping, booking, folio generation, and cancellation. Omni is protobuf-first: the proto contracts are published under Apache 2.0 on GitHub and the Swagger document, descriptor set, and JVM client bindings are generated from them and released per version.
e.name: Engine

e.description: Engine ML was a machine-learning infrastructure startup (founded 2018, backed by Kleiner Perkins) that offered a hosted platform for distributed model training and experiment tracking. Its product surface centered on the `engine` command-line tool and the `eml` Python library, which let data scientists launch experiments, track code, system utilization, logs, and output files, and run image classifiers (PyTorch/TensorFlow/Keras) against datasets such as MNIST. The company appears to be defunct: engineml.com serves an empty page behind an expired TLS certificate (expired March 2023), the documentation site docs.engineml.com returns an empty S3 bucket, and the public GitHub organization (EngineML) has not been updated since 2020-2021. No live API, OpenAPI description, package-registry release, or reachable developer docs could be found. This profile preserves the historical identity and the still- live GitHub organization as the only verifiable surviving surface.
e.name: Engine ML

e.description: Englease is an online English language learning platform serving students across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, founded by Omar Shihan and headquartered in Dubai Internet City, UAE. The platform blends live classes running 16 hours a day across all seven days, self-paced on-demand courses, pronunciation and practice tools, and conversation clubs, with proficiency-based learning paths from beginner to advanced and UK-accredited certifications. Englease serves individuals, corporations, schools, and specific industries including hospitality, call centers, retail, banking, and healthcare. Englease Technologies SPV Ltd is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network for tracking. The consumer product is delivered through a web/app experience; no public developer API surface has been identified.
e.name: Englease Technologies SPV

e.description: English Central is an online English language learning platform that combines a large library of authentic video content with speech-recognition-driven pronunciation practice, adaptive vocabulary and quiz tools, and live one-on-one lessons with tutors. It serves individual learners as well as schools, universities, and enterprise/partner programs (including regional partners in Japan and elsewhere). Backed by GV (Google Ventures), it operates in the consumer education / EdTech sector. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment; partner integrations appear to be handled privately.

e.description: Engrail Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision-neuroscience pharmaceutical company founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Diego, California. It applies precision chemistry and pharmacology to scientifically validated mechanisms of action, developing targeted small-molecule therapies for neuropsychiatric and neurodevelopmental diseases with significant unmet need — including generalized anxiety disorder, major depressive disorder characterized by anhedonia, post-traumatic stress disorder and rare neurodegenerative conditions. Its lead program, ENX-102, is a highly selective GABA-A alpha-2,3,5 positive allosteric modulator in Phase 2 (the ENCALM trial) for generalized anxiety disorder; ENX-104 is in clinical development for anhedonic depression. The company closed an oversubscribed $157M Series B in March 2024 co-led by F-Prime Capital, Forbion and Norwest Venture Partners, bringing total capital raised since inception past $220M. Engrail publishes no product or developer API; the machine-readable surfaces catalogued here are the public read-only content API and the OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol servers exposed by its corporate website.
e.name: Engrail Therapeutics

e.description: Engram is an early-stage AI company building models that learn from an organization's unique context and data, with the pitch that they can match or beat frontier models while using only 1%-10% of the tokens ("AI has learned the world. Now it should learn yours."). Positioned as a learned AI memory layer and backed by Kleiner Perkins, Engram is at a pre-product / research stage: as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation, pricing, blog, sign-up, or GitHub organization. This profile captures the company's public identity only; there is no developer or API surface available to enrich.
e.name: Engram

The solution abstracts diverse market protocols, message formats, identifiers, and deadlines, allowing seamless asset trading across bidding zones. By offering a comprehensive market communication layer, Engrate reduces integration complexity, accelerates time‑to‑market, and supports cost‑of‑energy analysis, documentation, and developer tools. Book a demo or explore the docs to learn how Engrate simplifies energy market interactions.

e.description: Enhanced Radar is a San Francisco-based applied AI company building intelligent systems for aviation, the world's most complex transportation domain. Its work centers on pilot-controller communications, where the company owns the full pipeline from data collection through in-house labeling and quality assurance to produce high-quality aviation AI training datasets. Products include Pattern, an aviation operational intelligence platform; ATC.com, a live air traffic control radio service; and Y4, an aviation understanding model announced in February 2026. Enhanced Radar has demonstrated real-time detection of runway incursion risks and raised $7 million in May 2026. It is backed by DCVC and Initialized Capital. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.
e.name: Enhanced Radar

e.description: Enigma Analytics (Enigma Technologies) operates a knowledge graph of every U.S. business — 100M+ business registrations and 2B+ relationships spanning brands, legal entities, operating locations, addresses, and the people behind them, enriched with 750M+ anonymized cards and 30B+ annual card transactions. Enigma exposes this business identity infrastructure through three developer surfaces — a Relay-style GraphQL API, a KYB REST API, and a sanctions Screen API — plus a hosted Console and an OAuth 2.1 remote MCP server, powering Know Your Business (KYB) onboarding, sanctions and watchlist screening, negative-news and government-archive checks, TIN and SSN verification, card-transaction analytics, and payment underwriting and go-to-market signals for banks, fintechs, and payments platforms. Pricing is published and self-serve, metered in credits at one cent each.
e.name: Enigma Analytics

e.description: Enigma Health (Enigma Global eHealth) is a Netherlands-based digital health startup building a secure, private eHealth portal intended to connect patients, doctors and healthcare institutions, and to give patients lifelong, worldwide access to their own electronic health record together with a digital vaccine passport kept in sync with that record. Founded by Dutch GP and global-health researcher Remko Schats and incubated at UtrechtInc, the company is a Startup level Industry Partner of the openEHR International Foundation, placing its intended data layer on the openEHR clinical data platform standard rather than a proprietary record format. As of September 2026 the company is pre-launch: enigma-health.org serves a single 'Coming Soon' page and Enigma Health publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract.
e.name: Enigma Health

e.description: Enigma Labs operates a crowdsourced platform for reporting, tracking, and analyzing unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) and UFO sightings, positioning itself as a destination for UFO sighting alerts and aerial intelligence. Through a mobile app (iOS and Google Play) and a web platform with a map interface and sighting-submission flow, a global community of sky watchers contributes reports that the company enriches with data science, machine-learning analysis, real-time alerts, and historical context. Enigma Labs reports over 57,000 sightings, more than 570,000 sky watchers, and around 2,000 high-signal UAP events, and has been featured by NBC News, PBS Nova, Scientific American, The Guardian, and The New Yorker. It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence as a consumer-facing product rather than an API provider.

e.description: Enjamb Labs builds an AI-agent platform for pharmaceutical drug development. Its browser-based "integrated research environment" runs specialized agents across the full R&D lifecycle -- clinical evidence synthesis, trial design and statistical programming, and regulatory submission preparation -- while connecting to the systems pharma teams already use (Benchling, Veeva, Medidata, SAS) so no data migration is required. The workspace bundles Word/Excel/PowerPoint editors, Python and R compute environments, and 100+ scientific integrations, and emphasizes auditability, traceability, and human review, keeping each output attached to its sources, files, code, and decisions. Backed by Y Combinator and Founders, Inc., Enjamb reports early usage across major pharmaceutical companies including Johnson & Johnson, Merck, AbbVie, Bristol Myers Squibb, and Sanofi.
e.name: Enjamb Labs

e.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.
e.name: Enjoei

e.description: Enjoy Technology (Enjoy Technologies) was a "commerce at home" mobile-retail startup founded in 2014 by Ron Johnson, the former Apple senior vice president of retail and JCPenney CEO, and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company brought the retail store experience to customers' homes, dispatching mobile experts to deliver, set up, and demonstrate consumer electronics on behalf of partners such as carriers and device makers. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Oak Investment Partners, and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Enjoy went public via SPAC in 2021 and declared bankruptcy in 2022, with its assets subsequently acquired. Enjoy never operated a public developer program or API; this profile is retained as a historical portfolio-company record.
e.name: Enjoy Technologies

e.description: EnjoyHQ was a centralized user-research and customer-feedback repository — a single source of truth where product and UX teams stored, tagged, searched, and analyzed qualitative and quantitative research (interviews, surveys, support tickets, NPS scores, and app-store reviews). Backed by Point Nine Capital, it was acquired by UserTesting in 2021 and folded into the UserTesting Human Insight Platform. Its brand domain getenjoyhq.com now issues a permanent (HTTP 308) redirect to usertesting.com/platform/enjoyhq, and EnjoyHQ no longer operates an independent developer, documentation, or API surface.
e.name: EnjoyHQ

e.description: Enko Chem, Inc. (Enko) is an agricultural life sciences company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Mystic, Connecticut, where it operates an 89,000 sq ft research lab and greenhouse campus. Enko discovers and develops next-generation crop protection chemistry — weed, disease, insect and soil-pest control — using its proprietary ENKOMPASS platform, which combines DNA-encoded library screening, structure-based design, artificial intelligence and machine learning to identify new modes of action and lead molecules faster and at lower cost than conventional agrochemical R&D. Enko works through partnerships with Syngenta, Bayer, Nufarm and the Gates Foundation Strategic Investment Fund rather than selling software, and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.
e.name: Enko Chem

e.description: Enlaza Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in La Jolla, California developing first-in-class covalent protein biologics for cancer and other serious diseases. Its proprietary War-Lock technology uses engineered unnatural amino acids to enable protein drugs — including antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers — to bind their disease targets irreversibly, aiming for sustained target occupancy and a prolonged biologic effect with minimal systemic exposure across oncology and immuno-oncology applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer API surface.

e.description: Enlitic is a healthcare AI company building the Curie platform to standardize, anonymize, and manage medical imaging data across radiology and enterprise imaging workflows. Its products include ENDEX for real-time DICOM data standardization and enrichment, ENCOG for automated PHI/PII anonymization of imaging data, Migratek for large-scale imaging data migration, and Ensight for imaging data management and analytics. Enlitic serves radiologists, imaging IT teams, executives, and researchers to improve imaging data quality, interoperability, and operational efficiency. Enlitic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through its products and a customer support portal. Backed by Amplify Partners and DCVC.
e.name: Enlitic

e.description: ENMAX Corporation is the Calgary-based energy company owned outright by The City of Calgary, describing itself on its own about page as "a regulated wires company, a competitive power generator and an energy retailer" operating "across Alberta and Maine." It spans three tiers of the value chain at once: ENMAX Power owns and operates the regulated electricity distribution and transmission system inside Calgary, ENMAX Energy generates power and sells electricity and natural gas into Alberta's deregulated retail market under the Easymax brand, and Versant Power — acquired from Emera in 2020 — is the transmission and distribution utility for northern and eastern Maine. Its API posture is the exact inverse of the Ontario utilities it is usually compared to, and the inversion is the finding. No consumer energy data mandate binds ENMAX anywhere it operates: Alberta has no Green Button regulation, Ontario's O. Reg. 633/21 does not reach across the provincial border, Canada has no national equivalent, and Maine imposes no Green Button obligation on Versant Power. Unmandated, ENMAX built nothing — its own support documentation states plainly that the Energy Insights usage view inside a customer's Easymax account "is view-only within your online account and can't be exported at this time," which is a harder closure than most: not merely no API, but no CSV, no XML, and no Green Button either. There is no developer portal, no developer, api, docs or data subdomain, no OpenAPI, and no published third-party data path. What ENMAX does publish openly is grid data. Its Hosting Capacity, Load Capacity and Service Area maps, linked from enmax.com/system-resources, are ArcGIS Online web applications backed by ArcGIS REST feature services that answer anonymous machine-readable queries with no key, no signup and no terms — distribution-feeder DER hosting headroom and remaining load capacity for the Calgary service territory, the data a solar or storage developer actually needs.
