ENMAX never calls this an API and documents none of it, but it is real, it is open, and it is queryable. Wide open on grid data, completely shut on customer data.
e.name: ENMAX

e.description: Ennis Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ennis Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: Ennis

e.description: Ennoble Care is a physician-led home-based healthcare provider delivering primary care, palliative care, and hospice care to seniors in the comfort of their own homes. Founded to bring the doctor back to the housecall, the company offers in-home primary care and chronic disease management, post-acute care transitions, advance care planning, bereavement services, and respite care across 13 states and Washington, DC (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia). Ennoble Care is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile has been enriched by the API Evangelist network; Ennoble Care is a healthcare-services company and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.
e.name: Ennoble Care

e.description: Enode provides a single API to connect and control electric vehicles, chargers, HVAC systems, batteries, solar inverters, and smart meters across more than a thousand hardware brands. The energy-transition API links end-user devices via OAuth, normalizes telemetry, and exposes smart-charging and device-control endpoints for energy apps, VPPs, and home energy management.
e.name: Enode

e.description: Ēnosys (formerly Flare Finance) is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform building on the Flare and Songbird networks. Its product suite spans DEX V2 and V3 automated market makers with liquidity provision, collateralized Loans, yield Farms with a token launchpad, a cross-chain Bridge, DeFi price Oracles built on the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO), the Skopos blockchain indexer, Oryy multi-signature self-custody vaults, and an NFT suite (Gallery, Ermis, Clover). Enosys interfaces are smart-contract based rather than a conventional REST API; developer integration happens through published Solidity contracts, subgraphs, and price-feed connectors in the flrfinance GitHub organization.
e.name: Enosys Markets

e.description: ENOUGH (brand name ABUNDA) is a food-technology company that produces mycoprotein through a zero-waste fermentation process, growing fungi on grain-derived sugars. Operating as a B2B ingredient supplier to retailers and food brands, ENOUGH makes nutrient-dense, sustainable meat and seafood alternatives — including burgers, chicken-style products, noodles, and snacks — that use dramatically less water and produce far less CO2 than conventional animal protein. The company operates one of the world's largest mycoprotein fermentation facilities and is backed by DCVC. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; ENOUGH is a food-ingredient business and publishes no public developer API surface.
e.name: Enough

e.description: Enpal is a Berlin-based residential clean-energy company and one of Germany's market leaders in home solar. It sells and finances complete home energy systems — rooftop solar PV, battery storage, air-to-water heat pumps, EV wallbox chargers, and a dynamic electricity tariff — orchestrated by its Enpal.One+ smart energy-management platform, with flexible purchase and zero-down financing options. Enpal serves over 130,000 German households and operates business (business.enpal.de) and installer partner (enpal.pro) channels alongside its consumer offering. Backed by HV Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was created from a VC-portfolio lead; Enpal publishes a consumer website and customer portal but no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.
e.name: Enpal

e.description: Enphase Energy is a Petaluma, California home-energy technology manufacturer and the dominant supplier of solar microinverters in the United States, shipping IQ Microinverters, IQ Batteries, IQ EV Chargers and the Envoy/IQ Gateway that ties them together through the Enlighten cloud. It sits on the DER side of the energy value chain rather than the utility side: it does not own meters, sell electricity, or operate a grid, so no consumer energy data mandate reaches it — there is no Green Button, ESPI or NAESB implementation anywhere in its developer surface, and the United States has no compulsory retail energy data right to designate it under. Its API posture is nevertheless unusually open for this sector. The Enphase Developer Portal at developer-v4.enphase.com is a genuine self-serve 3scale portal where anyone can register, create an application and subscribe to a free Watt plan, and it publishes three complete, anonymously downloadable machine-readable contracts covering 124 paths and 148 operations. The split that defines Enphase is consumer-data-open, market-data-closed: a third-party developer can retrieve an individual homeowner's site production, consumption, battery and EV charger telemetry through documented OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flows with the system owner's explicit approval, but Enphase publishes no open grid, wholesale market or system-wide generation data of any kind. Access is tiered — self-serve for monitoring, application-approval for installer commissioning (10+ installations required), and partner-only for the Virtual Power Plant API, which is the one place a real standard appears: OCPP 1.6 for EV charger control against third-party CSMS platforms.
e.name: Enphase Energy

e.description: Enpirion was a fabless semiconductor company specializing in high-frequency power-management integrated circuits, best known for its PowerSoC family of integrated DC-DC converters that combined the controller, MOSFETs, and inductor in a single package for point-of-load power conversion in networking, computing, and industrial systems. The company was acquired by Altera in 2013 and subsequently absorbed into Intel with Altera in 2015; the Enpirion brand and its enpirion.com developer/product site are now defunct. It never operated a public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK program, so this record is retained as a company identity stub rather than an active API provider.
e.name: Enpirion

e.description: Enplug is a cloud-based digital signage and content-management platform that powers communications on screens across retail, hospitality, corporate, and public-venue locations, with content apps for social feeds, dashboards, video, wayfinding, and menus managed from a central web dashboard. Enplug was acquired by Spectrio, and enplug.com now redirects to Spectrio's Enplug acquisition page; the legacy Enplug cloud login remains live at login.enplug.com. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead; Enplug exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries identity and domain-security signals only.
e.name: Enplug

e.description: EnPro Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EnPro Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: EnPro Industries

e.description: Enrich is a private, invite-only membership network for senior technology leaders — VPs, Directors, and CXOs from companies including Google, Slack, Anthropic, and OpenAI. It runs peer-led conversations with executive coaching, curated small-group and monthly in-person dinners, expert-led operator discussions, topic-based peer groups (organizational design, career transitions), and a private Slack community for real-time peer advice. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and Cowboy Ventures, and added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead. Enrich publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface — it is a community/membership product, not an API provider.
e.name: enrich

e.description: Enrich (enrich.so), operated by Enrich Labs, is a person and company data enrichment API for B2B go-to-market, sales, and web intelligence teams. From a single REST interface at https://dev.enrich.so/api/v3 it resolves a professional profile from an email address (reverse email lookup), finds and verifies professional email addresses, finds mobile and phone numbers, resolves a company and geolocation from an IP address, searches a lead-finder database of people and organizations, finds employees at a company, and scrapes LinkedIn company followers. Fifty-one operations across nine products, every one of them metered against a single prepaid credit balance and refunded when a lookup finds nothing. Every bulk product follows one submit/poll/results shape with reserve-and-settle billing, ten typed webhook callbacks, RFC 9457 problem details on every error, and official TypeScript and Go SDKs. Enrich also operates a first-party remote MCP server at mcp.enrich.so with OAuth 2.0 and dynamic client registration.
e.name: Enrich

e.description: Ensembl is a genome annotation database and browser maintained by the European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) and the Wellcome Sanger Institute. It provides comprehensive genome data for vertebrates and other eukaryotic organisms, covering gene annotation, variant data, regulatory features, comparative genomics, and evolutionary analysis across hundreds of species. The Ensembl REST API offers language-agnostic HTTP access to this genome data without requiring local database installations or Perl API dependencies.
e.name: Ensembl

e.description: Ensighten is an enterprise tag management, data governance, and client-side website security platform. It gives digital, marketing, and privacy teams centralized control over the third-party tags, scripts, and vendor code that run on their web and mobile properties, enforcing consent and privacy rules (GDPR, CCPA) at the point of data collection. The platform combines server- and client-side tag management, malicious-script and data-leakage detection (client-side security), and consent management. Ensighten was acquired by CHEQ (CHEQ AI Technologies Ltd.) and is now delivered as part of CHEQ's Control & Compliance / Go-to-Market Security suite; the ensighten.com domain 301-redirects to cheq.ai. This company profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Ensighten does publish a public REST contract: the Ensighten Manage API, documented as an API Blueprint at manageexternalapi.docs.apiary.io and served in production from manage-api.ensighten.com. It covers 66 operations across Spaces, Publish Paths, Deployments, Conditions, Data Definitions, Event Definitions, Labels, Users, Roles, SCIM 2.0 user/group provisioning, Git-enabled spaces, and TDN jobs. Authentication is either an X-API-Key API key or an OAuth 2.0 Resource Owner Password Credentials bearer token from /auth/token.
e.name: Ensighten

e.description: Ensign Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ensign Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: Ensign Group

e.description: enSilo was an endpoint-security company founded in 2014 (San Francisco and Herzliya, Israel) that delivered automated endpoint detection and response (EDR), real-time post-infection protection, and data-exfiltration prevention in a single agent. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and other investors, enSilo was acquired by Fortinet in October 2019 and its technology was folded into the FortiEDR product line. The independent enSilo brand, developer surface, and public API no longer exist; the ensilo.com domain now redirects to Fortinet's site. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company lead and carries no live API artifacts.
e.name: Ensilo

e.description: Enso is onchain infrastructure that turns DeFi product intent into signer-ready transaction data. Its Route API finds the optimal path between any two tokens or positions across 250+ protocols and multiple chains, while the Bundle API composes ordered onchain Actions (deposit, swap, borrow, bridge, flashloan, transfer and more) into a single executable transaction. Enso also exposes protocol, token, price and balance data, a Quoter for a simulate-then-validate transaction-safety model, cross-chain routing over Stargate/LayerZero, Chainlink CCIP, Relay and Circle CCTP, and prebuilt React widgets (Checkout, cross-chain route). Developers authenticate with a Bearer API key and integrate via the @ensofinance/sdk TypeScript SDK. Backed by Multicoin Capital and Techstars; 100+ apps and 1,900+ developers build on Enso.
e.name: Enso

e.description: Ensoma is a privately held, clinical-stage genomic medicines company developing in vivo hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) engineering. Its platform pairs an off-the-shelf in vivo delivery system built on high-capacity virus-like particles that preferentially bind HSCs with a gene engineering toolkit spanning base editing and high-efficiency gene integration, carrying payloads of roughly 35 kilobases so that changes from single-base edits through multi-gene insertions can be made without ex vivo cell collection, manipulation, or transplant conditioning. The company is pursuing programs across genetic disease, immune disorders, and oncology, including EN-374 for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, and is backed by 5AM Ventures, F-Prime Capital, RTW Investments, Alexandria Venture Investments, Cormorant Asset Management, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Enrichment found no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI contract, MCP server, or agent card — this is a therapeutics R&D company, not an API provider. Its only public machine-readable output is open-source computational genomics and sequencing-pipeline code published under its GitHub organization.
e.name: Ensoma

e.description: Ensurance Limited (ASX:ENA) was an Australian ASX-listed insurance underwriting agency headquartered in Perth, Western Australia, marketing itself as "innovating the online insurance sector." Its Australian arm, Ensurance Underwriting Australia, operated as a wholesale underwriting agency under an Australian Financial Services Licence, assembling a consortium of local and international capacity — including Lloyd's, Swiss Re and XL Catlin — behind construction-specific products sold exclusively through intermediaries: Licensed Builder Annual Construction, Plant and Liability, Project-Specific Construction, Trades Liability, Owner Builder, and Home and Contents insurance, distributed to a broker network the company described as 340-plus intermediaries. A sister company, Ensurance UK Limited, ran as a Managing General Agent authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and a coverholder at Lloyd's. The group's API posture is nil and always was. Ensurance never published a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook or event catalogue. What the company called its "customised online platform" for intermediaries was BOB (bob.ensurance.com.au), a form-based, session-login ASP.NET MVC quote-and-proposal wizard keyed to per-agent codes — an agent login wall, not a programmable interface. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference appears anywhere in the company's live or archived web estate. As of this review the ensurance.com.au TLS certificate has expired and every path on the domain, along with the ensurance.ltd domain family, blanket 301-redirects to Chase Underwriting Solutions Pty Ltd, an Australian professional-lines underwriting agency that likewise publishes no API. Ensurance is recorded here as a partner-gated, no-public-API insurance provider in the Australian market — a faithful data point for a sector where the Consumer Data Right was designated for general insurance and then deferred, leaving carriers and underwriting agencies with no forcing function to expose anything.
e.name: Ensurance

e.description: Ent is an intent-aware security platform for the enterprise that protects work as it happens. The company reads human, AI agent, and application activity in real time to understand intent and act at the moment of risk, rather than relying on after-the-fact logs and static policies. Ent is an early-stage security company backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security-disclosure surface. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI have been published to date, so API and specification artifacts are not yet applicable.
e.name: Ent

e.description: Entact Bio is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company based in Watertown, Massachusetts, developing a new class of small-molecule precision medicines called Enhancement-Targeting Chimeric (ENTAC) molecules. Where targeted protein degradation removes disease-causing proteins, Entact Bio works in the opposite direction: its ENTAC molecules recruit deubiquitinases (DUBs) to strip ubiquitin chains from beneficial proteins in order to extend their half-life, relocate them, or otherwise restore their function. The company's proprietary Encompass platform combines biological, chemical, and computational tools to identify disease targets amenable to protein enhancement across oncology, autoimmune disease, and rare genetic disorders. Entact Bio launched in December 2022 with an $81 million Series A co-led by Qiming Venture Partners USA and venBio Partners, with participation from Abingworth, Brandon Capital, and others. It is a therapeutics research organization and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API artifacts.
e.name: Entact Bio

e.description: Entalpic is an AI-driven materials science company that designs molecules and materials for industrial processes by combining machine learning, atomistic simulations, and experimental feedback loops to engineer surfaces and materials at the atomic scale. Its work spans a Discovery Engine for high-throughput screening of chemical spaces, process modeling with ML-plus-CFD digital twins, and quantum/atomistic simulation for surface chemistry, applied to semiconductors and thin-film coatings, battery cathode and interface chemistry, catalysis and active-site design, and advanced specialty materials. Founded in 2024 with research roots at the Mila AI lab, the company is based at Station F in Paris and Mila in Montreal and raised an 8.5M euro seed round. Entalpic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its public web surface for the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Entalpic

e.description: Entegris is a global supplier of advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The company develops and manufactures specialty chemicals, gases, filtration and purification systems, advanced materials handling, and process control products. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically supported through sales engineering, the supplier portal, and product documentation.
e.name: Entegris

e.description: Entelo is an AI-powered talent-sourcing and recruiting-automation platform for finding, engaging, and hiring candidates using predictive analytics, diversity-aware search, and candidate-engagement tooling. Entelo was acquired and is now delivered as "Entelo Recruit" within Rival (rival-hr.com), an AI-powered HR orchestration suite spanning recruiting, workflow, learning, and performance. Its former domain entelo.com now 301-redirects to Rival. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published for the Entelo/Rival Recruit product.
e.name: Entelo

e.description: Enter is a Berlin-based residential energy-efficiency company that positions itself as Germany's largest energy advisor, combining on-site building analysis with installation of heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, battery storage, EV wallboxes, and home energy-management systems. It guides homeowners through energy consulting, subsidy (Foerderung) applications, and financing, and reports 37,000+ completed projects and 150M+ EUR in secured subsidies. Enter is a B2C service provider with no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; it was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.
e.name: Enter

e.description: Entera is an AI-powered SaaS and services platform for single-family rental (SFR) real estate investing, describing itself as the operating system for single-family real estate. It helps operators, funds, new-construction companies, agents, and service partners buy, sell, and operate homes at scale across 34+ U.S. residential markets. The platform spans acquisitions (asset discovery, underwriting, diligence coordination), dispositions (pricing, buyer targeting, offer management), transaction enablement, market data and intelligence, and expert brokerage services. Entera is backed by investors including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Entera exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI/SDK surface; this profile captures its published company, legal, and brand properties plus a live domain-security probe.
e.name: Entera

e.description: Entergram is a CRM built specifically for Telegram. It connects personal Telegram accounts (not bots) into a shared team workspace where sales, support, community and trading teams manage conversations at scale — a multi-account inbox, a CRM table and Kanban pipeline, custom columns and labels, broadcast messaging, and a ticketing system with assignment, SLA and status tracking. Its developer surface has three parts: a workspace-scoped REST API (X-API-Key) covering accounts, contacts, groups, chats, messages, custom fields, tickets, webhooks and resumable events; a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for personal Telegram accounts (OAuth2 + PKCE) that lets AI agents read chats, manage tickets and update CRM fields; and outbound webhooks for incoming/outgoing message events, plus a Make.com integration.
e.name: Entergram

e.description: Entergy Corporation is an integrated energy company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, providing electricity to more than 3 million utility customers across Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas. The company operates power generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure including nuclear, renewable, and hydroelectric resources. While Entergy does not publish a public developer API portal, it operates customer-facing digital tools (myEntergy account portal, outage map, energy efficiency toolkit) that interact with internal systems via private APIs.
e.name: Entergy

e.description: Enterpret is a customer intelligence platform that unifies feedback from 50+ sources — support tickets, sales and success calls, surveys, reviews, app stores, and social — into a single source of truth built on a proprietary Customer Knowledge Graph and Adaptive Taxonomy. Product, CX, and go-to-market teams use it to quantify what is driving churn, prioritize the roadmap, and surface win/loss reasons. Its Wisdom AI and hosted MCP server let teams query customer feedback in natural language from Claude, Cursor, Notion, Slack, ChatGPT, and other agents, with citations back to source records.
e.name: Enterpret

e.description: Enterprise Mobility is the Clayton, Missouri parent of Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent a Car, and the largest car rental provider in the world — 90,000+ team members, 9,500+ rental branches across more than 90 countries and territories, a global fleet of over 2.4 million vehicles and $39 billion in 2025 fiscal-year revenue. Beyond leisure and corporate car rental it operates fleet management, flexible vehicle hire, carsharing, vanpooling, truck rental, car sales, vehicle subscription and the ARMS / Entegral replacement-rental technology used by insurers, collision repairers and dealerships. In the United States travel distribution chain it is a ground-transportation supplier whose inventory reaches buyers through GDS and OTA intermediaries, corporate travel programs and its own direct brand sites, rather than through any published public booking API. Its API posture is partner-gated and honestly so: EHI runs a real API Marketplace at developer.ehi.com with public marketing overviews for three business lines — Rental, Replacement Rental and Commute — but the API catalog, API specs, guides and release notes all sit behind Azure AD B2C sign-in and the portal states access is for "an Enterprise employee or trusted Partner" who should "contact your account manager ... to request access". No OpenAPI is published for those business lines; probes of /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ return AEM soft-404 HTML or 404. What is public is the plumbing around the gate: the production API gateway at api.ehi.com is a live Kong Gateway behind Imperva, the marketplace's own experience API publishes three POST endpoints in the portal's anonymous page source, the Azure AD B2C tenant serves two readable OpenID Connect discovery documents, and the sign-in link enumerates fourteen OAuth scopes covering catalog search, client-application registration and authorization requests. The published API License Agreement grants only a "limited, revocable, non-transferable, non-sublicensable, non-exclusive" right, restricts use to the licensee's internal purpose, states the licensee has no ownership rights in Renter Information, and on termination requires the licensee to "delete or return any copies of the APIs and Enterprise Content" — public docs shell, gated specs, no exit path.
e.name: Enterprise Mobility

e.description: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. is one of the largest publicly traded partnerships and a leading North American provider of midstream energy services, headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company operates more than 50,000 miles of pipeline and over 300 million barrels of liquids storage, providing crude oil and natural gas transportation, NGL processing and fractionation, petrochemical and refined product logistics, storage, and marine transportation services. The company does not publish a public developer API portal but maintains internal and partner-facing integration capabilities for pipeline operations and energy logistics.
e.name: Enterprise Products Partners

e.description: Entire is a developer platform built for both humans and AI agents, founded by former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke and launched with a $60M seed round. It pairs fast, distributed, Git-compatible hosting with agent session management: the Entire CLI hooks into your Git workflow and captures every coding-agent session — prompts, tool calls, and decisions — as Checkpoints indexed alongside commits, creating a searchable record of how code was written. Features include session-to-commit pairing, secret detection and user-defined redaction, multi-agent parallel review, cross-agent work resumption, and a distributed Git mirroring network for fast, rate-limit-free clones.
e.name: Entire

e.description: Entity-Relationship (ER) modeling is a data modeling technique used to describe the data requirements for an information system. ER diagrams visually represent entities (objects or concepts), their attributes, and the relationships between them. ER modeling is a fundamental tool in database design and system analysis, with notation variants including Chen's original notation, Crow's Foot notation, and Barker's notation.
e.name: Entity Relationship

e.description: Entity Sport (Entity Digital Sports) provides real-time sports data APIs, with cricket as its flagship product. The Cricket API V2 delivers competitions and seasons, fixtures and results, ball-by-ball live scoring, detailed scorecards, fantasy points, player and team profiles, standings, and betting odds over a token-authenticated REST interface.
e.name: Entity Sport

e.description: Entocycle is a London-based insect farming technology company building industrial-scale, controlled-environment facilities that use black soldier fly bioconversion to turn organic waste streams into insect protein for animal feed and organic fertilizer (frass). Its platform combines modular climate-controlled farm infrastructure, real-time AI-driven insect monitoring that counts and tracks insects across their lifecycle, and fully automated production systems to standardize output across deployments worldwide. Entocycle partners with waste management companies, agricultural producers, insect companies, and offtake buyers to develop and operate circular-economy insect farms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.
e.name: Entocycle

e.description: Entrata is a property management platform for multifamily housing that provides an all-in-one operating system for autonomous property management. Its REST API enables integration partners to access and manage properties, residents, leases, maintenance, payments, and reporting data in near real-time. API access requires a signed Developer Interface Agreement and is available only to approved partners with shared clients.
e.name: Entrata

e.description: Entre Rios Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Argentina running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 121 datasets.
e.name: Entre Rios Open Data

e.description: Entrepreneur First (EF) is a talent investor that backs exceptional individuals before they have a company, pairing them into cofounding teams and providing pre-seed capital, mentorship, and a global network to build technology startups from scratch. Founded in London in 2011 by Matt Clifford and Alice Bentinck, EF runs cohort-based programs across Europe, Asia, and North America and has helped launch hundreds of venture-backed companies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Greylock and added to the API Evangelist network; EF publishes no public developer API surface.
e.name: Entrepreneur First

e.description: Entrino.net provides access control and pass management solutions for venues and events. Their platform enables organizers to manage visitor entry, issue digital passes, and enforce security policies in real time. With multi‑regional support, Entrino offers customizable access rules, analytics, and integration options for ticketing systems, ensuring smooth and secure experiences for both staff and attendees.
e.name: Entrino.net

e.description: Entropik is a human-insights company whose Decode platform uses Emotion AI — facial coding, eye and gaze tracking, and voice-tonality analysis — to help enterprises understand consumer and user behavior at scale. Decode combines an AI Moderator for automated, human-like qualitative interviews, consumer and shopper insights, webcam-based UX and user research, AI creative attention and emotion prediction, and a centralized Insights Hub research repository with a research copilot. Entropik reports serving 150+ enterprise clients across CPG, technology and software, healthcare and pharma, financial services, and retail and e-commerce. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Entropik does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, product surface, trust and compliance posture, and domain security.
e.name: Entropik

e.description: Entropy is a threshold-signature network for trustless, programmable key management and distributed key generation (DKG). Positioned as "the Autonomous Agent Network," Entropy lets users and agents produce cryptographic signatures without any single party ever holding the private key, using on-chain WASM "programs" that define the exact conditions under which a signature may be generated. Built as a Substrate-based blockchain with a network of Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) servers running inside Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), Entropy delivers secure crypto custody, programmable signing, and distributed key management for Web3 and autonomous-agent use cases. Backed by a16z and surfaced into the API Evangelist network via the venture-portfolio pipeline.
e.name: Entropy

e.description: Entrust is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: gartner-mq) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
e.name: Entrust

e.description: Entry Point AI provides a platform that enables users to build, fine‑tune, and deploy AI models efficiently. It offers tools for data transformation, synthetic data generation, and model training, all accessible through a unified workflow. The service supports various use cases such as content creation, classification, and predictive analytics, targeting developers and enterprises seeking to integrate AI capabilities without extensive infrastructure overhead.
e.name: Entry Point AI

e.description: ENTSO-E, the European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity, operates the Transparency Platform - the central publication point for pan-European electricity market data under EU Regulation 543/2013. Its free RESTful API returns day-ahead prices, system load, generation, balancing, and cross-border transmission data for every European bidding zone and control area as IEC 62325 XML market documents, selected by coded documentType and processType parameters against a single endpoint.
e.name: ENTSO-E

e.description: Entur AS is a Norwegian state-owned technology company ("et statlig eid teknologiselskap") that works to make it easier to choose public transport across Norway. It runs the national journey planner at entur.no and its app, sells tickets, and operates the national data platform for public transport. Through Entur for Developers it publishes open services (journey planner, geocoder, real-time vehicle and mobility data) and open data for free, plus partner services that require authentication.
e.name: Entur

e.description: Entyre Care is a US home health care provider that helps people who care for a friend or family member at home get paid for the care they already provide. Through state Medicaid structured / self-directed family caregiving programs, Entyre Care guides caregivers through eligibility and enrollment, handles the paperwork, and delivers financial compensation alongside professional caregiving guidance and emotional support. The company operates in Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, Ohio, Virginia, and Wisconsin, offering tools such as a compensation calculator, a step-by-step guide to getting paid, and localized care teams. Entyre Care is a consumer-facing healthcare services business and does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and enriched with the company's real identity and public web properties.
e.name: Entyre Care

e.description: Entytle, Inc. (founded 2014, Austin, Texas) provides an Installed Base Intelligence SaaS platform for equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It unifies fragmented data from ERP, CRM, FSM systems, and spreadsheets into a single "Source of Truth" for an OEM's installed base, then applies purpose-built AI and a Data Quality Engine to surface aftermarket revenue opportunities, predict parts/service/upgrade needs, and prevent customer churn. Products include Aftermarket IQ (IB 360, Customer Central, Customer Loyalty Manager, Predictive Opportunities, Wallet Share Assessment), an AI Quote Agent, Asset Lifecycle Management, IB HealthCheck, and a Data Quality Engine. Customers include Johnson Controls, Baker Hughes, Xylem, GEA, Dematic, Duravant, and Peerless Pump. Surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched from Entytle's public surface; Entytle exposes an enterprise application (Entytle Insyghts) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK.
e.name: Entytle

e.description: Enuma, Inc. is a Berkeley, California educational technology company that builds award-winning, self-guided digital learning apps for young children, including the Todo Math series, Todo Classroom, and the Kitkit School / Enuma Global program. Founded by Sooinn Lee and Gunho Lee, Enuma designs research-based, game-like early literacy and numeracy experiences that work for all learners, including children with special needs and those in low-resource settings. The company co-won the $10M Global Learning XPRIZE for its open-source Kitkit School tablet curriculum. Enuma is a consumer and classroom education company that ships mobile applications through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or event surface. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified company identity by the API Evangelist pipeline.
e.name: Enuma

e.description: Enurgen is a solar energy software company whose DUET platform uses 3D physics-based modeling to optimize photovoltaic assets across their entire lifecycle. The platform spans three products - Design, Construction, and Operations - helping large-scale solar developers, independent power producers, EPC engineers, and asset managers improve energy yield estimates, validate construction against expected performance, and monitor plants in production to close the gap between forecasted (P50) and actual field output. Enurgen is a Techstars-backed company; customers include Scatec, Potentia, Lightsource, Eni, and Kiewit. The company operates a customer web application at app.enurgen.com but does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass that captures the company's public web properties and domain security posture.
e.name: Enurgen

e.description: env0 -- now trading as "env zero" -- is an infrastructure-as-code automation and cloud governance platform for Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and Helm. It provisions and manages cloud environments from reusable templates, orchestrates multi-environment workflows with dependencies, enforces custom approval and guardrail policies, detects and remediates infrastructure drift, runs a private module and provider registry, and adds cost estimation, actual-cost visibility and budget thresholds on top. The public REST API at https://api.env0.com publishes 327 operations across 30 areas and authenticates with HTTP Basic using an API Key ID and Secret. env zero also ships a first-party CLI, a Terraform provider, an official MCP server, a published Agent Skill and a conformant A2A agent card.
e.name: Env0

e.description: Envariant is building the control layer for foundation models — an AI interpretability SDK that lets teams inspect, steer, and control model behavior. The SDK exposes a compact set of primitives: detect and causally trace behaviors like hallucinations or invariant violations, reason inductively and steer outputs programmatically, extract human-readable domain principles, and synthesize targeted edge cases — moving verification upstream, directly into the model's latent space, with no bespoke engineering required. Envariant is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco. The SDK is in pre-release beta, so no public API, OpenAPI, or developer documentation is available yet; this profile captures the company identity ahead of a public developer surface.
e.name: Envariant

e.description: Envato runs Envato Market (per-asset marketplaces like ThemeForest, CodeCanyon, AudioJungle, VideoHive, GraphicRiver, 3DOcean, PhotoDune) and Envato Elements (subscription-based unlimited stock media). The Envato API exposes Market endpoints for items, search, downloads, user accounts, and earnings; Elements has a separate affiliate API.
e.name: Envato

e.description: Enveda (Enveda Biosciences) is a Boulder, Colorado based clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2019 that discovers medicines by decoding the chemistry of the natural world. It combines high-throughput mass spectrometry, metabolomics, robotics and machine learning — including PRISM, a foundation model trained on more than a billion small- molecule mass spectra — to build a searchable library of plant-derived molecules and translate them into drug candidates. Enveda has raised over $360M across Series B, C and D rounds from Premji Invest, Kinnevik, Lux Capital, Dimension and Sanofi, reached unicorn status in 2026, and runs FDA-cleared clinical programs including ENV-294 (atopic dermatitis and asthma), ENV-308 (obesity) and ENV-6946 (inflammatory bowel disease). Enveda publishes no product or developer API; the machine-readable surface on enveda.com is a published llms.txt plus the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) that serves the company newsroom, In-Veda blog, leadership profiles, clinical-trial site directory and media library as JSON, alongside a WordPress MCP Adapter endpoint that is present but authentication-gated. Its open science is published as research code and data in the github.com/enveda organization.
e.name: Enveda

e.description: Enveil is a privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) company whose ZeroReveal platform lets organizations securely use, search, and analyze data while it is being processed, without moving, replicating, or exposing it. Built on homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, and trusted execution environments, ZeroReveal Search delivers encrypted search, analytics, and watchlisting as a point-to-point proxy layer, while ZeroReveal Machine Learning provides encrypted training (SMPC-based federated learning) and encrypted model evaluation. Enveil serves financial services, healthcare and insurance, government and public sector, and secure-AI use cases spanning cross-silo data collaboration, fraud detection, secure data monetization, and privacy-preserving AI. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.
e.name: Enveil

e.description: Envelop Risk is a technology-led reinsurance underwriting and analytics firm specializing in cyber and other complex, emerging risks. The company combines actuarial science, machine learning, and cyber threat intelligence to model, price, and underwrite cyber (re)insurance for insurers, MGAs, and capital-market partners. Its platforms include CyberTooth (cyber risk modeling and augmented underwriting), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Envelop Capital Markets, and Envelop Risk Solutions (product development, analytics, modeling support). Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Envelop Risk surpassed a $1bn gross-written-premium milestone. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-company lead; the company does not publish a public developer portal, API, or SDKs at this time.
e.name: Envelop Risk

e.description: Enverus is an energy-dedicated SaaS company providing analytics, market intelligence, and workflow automation across the global energy value chain — oil and gas, power and renewables, minerals, midstream, trading and risk, and financial services. Its developer surface is the Enverus DirectAccess API (formerly Drillinginfo DirectAccess), a token-authenticated REST API that delivers bulk access to Enverus' energy datasets — well origins, rigs, permits, producing entities, production, and related upstream data — with server-side filter functions, field selection, and cursor-based pagination. Enverus serves 8,000+ companies and 35,000+ energy customers from its Austin, Texas headquarters.
e.name: Enverus

e.description: Envestnet is an ever-evolving network of data-driven services, products, tools, and technologies designed to enable the Intelligent Financial Life. Our robust financial wellness ecosystem offers solutions for every role in the financial advice industry, including the Yodlee account aggregation, verification, credit, insights, and personalized view APIs.
e.name: Envestnet

e.description: Enviance (now Cority Enviance) is an environmental, health, and safety (EHS) compliance-management SaaS platform. Originally an independent cloud environmental-compliance vendor, Enviance was acquired by Cority and its product now ships as "Cority Enviance." The platform manages regulatory requirements, compliance tasks, emissions and environmental events, chemicals and materials inventories, documents, workflows, and reporting for enterprises in regulated industries. Its EMS REST API (the "Cority Enviance App API") exposes 250+ operations across 39 service areas — Activity, Chemical, Material, Compliance, Requirement, Event, Task, Workflow, Document, Report, Portal, Bulk data, SCIM identity, and more — for building custom interfaces and integrating Enviance with corporate and third-party systems.
e.name: Enviance

e.description: EnviCore is a Calgary, Alberta based sustainability and materials-technology company, backed by Techstars, that produces low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials for the mining and construction industries. Its low-temperature process repurposes industrial waste, mine tailings, clays, and pozzolans into valuable cement replacements, reducing CO2 emissions and supporting a circular economy. EnviCore does not publish a developer API, but its public website exposes an agentic surface: a published llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI-agent access to public site content.
e.name: EnviCore

e.description: Envio is a high-performance blockchain data indexing platform providing developers with the fastest and most flexible way to access on-chain data. Its core products — HyperIndex, HyperSync, and HyperRPC — enable real-time and historical indexing across 100+ EVM networks and beyond, exposing indexed smart contract events through auto-generated GraphQL APIs and a REST-based HyperSync data retrieval layer. Envio Cloud offers fully managed hosting with git-based deployments, zero-downtime rollbacks, and multi-region support.
e.name: Envio

e.description: Enviri Corporation, formerly known as Harsco Corporation, is a trusted global leader in environmental solutions, developing and refining methods of recycling and beneficial reuse for industrial customers. Enviri operates through three divisions: Clean Earth (hazardous waste management and recycling), Harsco Environmental (services to the global steel industry), and Harsco Rail (rail-track maintenance equipment and services). Enviri does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs.
e.name: Enviri (formerly Harsco)

e.description: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) is the federal department responsible for weather, climate, water and environmental protection in Canada, and operates the Meteorological Service of Canada. It runs an OGC-standard GeoServer at geo.ec.gc.ca which responds correctly to WMS, WFS and OGC API - Features requests but, when probed on 2026-08-20, published no layers, no feature types and no collections through it.
e.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada

e.description: Envisage Technologies LLC builds the Acadis Readiness Suite, a unified public-safety training, compliance, and performance management software platform used by more than 10,000 agencies and 2 million-plus first responders across law enforcement, fire and rescue, corrections, emergency communications, federal, military, and local-government organizations. Product lines include the Acadis Readiness Suite (recruit & hire, training & testing, compliance management, academy automation, performance management, internal affairs and case management, inventory, budgeting, and a blended/virtual LMS), Guardian Tracking (an early-intervention system for smaller agencies), and the Acadis Network for individuals. The company operates as envisagenow.com (now redirecting to acadis.com) and is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Envisage publishes no public developer API; this profile is API Evangelist enrichment assembled from publicly discoverable surfaces only, including the Acadis Readiness Community Salesforce Experience Cloud identity provider.
e.name: Envisagenow

e.description: Envisia (Envisia Therapeutics, Inc.) was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, spun out of Liquidia Technologies to apply PRINT (Particle Replication In Non-wetting Templates) particle-engineering to sustained-release ophthalmic therapeutics. Its lead candidate, ENV515 (travoprost) extended-release, was an intracameral implant intended to lower intraocular pressure in glaucoma patients for months from a single administration. The company was venture-backed by Canaan Partners, New Enterprise Associates, Morningside, and Batterson Venture Capital, and was acquired by Aerie Pharmaceuticals in October 2016. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface, and its former web domains no longer resolve; this profile is retained as a VC-portfolio lead record with no API artifacts to enrich.
e.name: Envisia

e.description: Envisics is a British deep-technology company headquartered in Milton Keynes, United Kingdom, that pioneers dynamic holography for automotive augmented-reality head-up displays (AR HUD). The work began with Dr Jamieson Christmas' PhD at Cambridge University in 2004, continued through Two Trees Photonics (founded 2010, acquired by DAQRI in 2015) which built the world's first laser holographic HUD for Jaguar Land Rover, and was spun out as the independent company Envisics on 1 January 2018. Its Dynamic Holography Platform and next-generation Holographic Waveguide Technology combine proprietary algorithms with simpler, fewer and more robust optics to deliver multi-plane AR imagery at under 10% of the optical power of conventional systems; first-generation technology shipped in over 150,000 Jaguar and Land Rover vehicles and second-generation technology was slated for the Cadillac LYRIQ-V and 2026 Cadillac VISTIQ. Investors included Hyundai Mobis, General Motors Ventures, Stellantis, InMotion Ventures (Jaguar Land Rover) and Tarsadia Investments. Envisics is an automotive hardware and optics supplier rather than a software vendor: it publishes no commercial or developer-facing product API, no developer portal, and no SDKs. The only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website at envisics.com, captured here for discovery purposes and anonymously readable but read-only. Envisics Ltd. entered administration on 22 April 2026 under the Insolvency Act 1986, with Geoff Rowley and Simon Carvill-Biggs of FRP Advisory Trading Limited appointed as Joint Administrators.
e.name: Envisics

e.description: Envision Energy is a Chinese green-technology company founded in 2007 by Lei Zhang and headquartered in Shanghai. It designs and manufactures smart wind turbines, operates one of the world's largest fleets of connected wind and solar assets, and builds net-zero industrial parks. Its business spans energy storage and batteries (through Envision AESC), green hydrogen and green ammonia, and the EnOS AIoT operating system delivered by its Envision Digital arm, which connects and manages energy and IoT devices at scale. Envision was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia China) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; its public digital surface is a marketing site and the EnOS platform, which is documented on region-restricted hosts not reachable for spec discovery in this pass.
e.name: Envision Energy

e.description: Envision Healthcare is a leading provider of physician-led services and ambulatory surgery services in the United States, supporting healthcare professionals across emergency, anesthesiology, radiology, women's and children's, and surgery. No public developer APIs have been identified for Envision Healthcare Holdings at this time.
e.name: Envision Healthcare Holdings

e.description: Envista Holdings is a global family of dental products companies and a Fortune 1000 firm whose brands include Nobel Biocare, Ormco, KaVo, and Implant Direct. The company manufactures and supplies dental implants, orthodontic systems, imaging equipment, and consumables to clinicians worldwide. Envista does not publish a public, unified developer portal or external API; integrations are generally handled at the individual brand level for clinical software and imaging workflows.
e.name: Envista Holdings

e.description: Envoy is a high-performance, open-source edge and service proxy designed for cloud-native applications and microservice architectures. It provides advanced load balancing, observability, and traffic management features, and serves as the data plane for many service mesh implementations including Istio.
e.name: Envoy

e.description: Envoy Gateway is a CNCF project that manages Envoy Proxy as a standalone or Kubernetes-based application gateway. It implements the Kubernetes Gateway API and extends it with its own API group, gateway.envoyproxy.io, whose eight Custom Resource Definitions cover infrastructure shape, client and backend traffic behaviour, security policy, extensibility and direct xDS patching. There is no REST API and no hosted endpoint: the machine-readable contract is the CRD structural schemas plus two first-party gRPC services — an extension server hook and a remote infrastructure provider — that Envoy Gateway calls out to. Apache-2.0 licensed and free, with a published compatibility matrix giving every release a dated end of life, and Gateway API v1.6.1 core and extended conformance certified by report in the standard body's own repository.
e.name: Envoy Gateway

e.description: Envoy Proxy is an open-source edge and service proxy that is designed for cloud-native applications. It acts as a gateway for all incoming and outgoing traffic within a microservices architecture, providing functionalities such as load balancing, service discovery, encryption, authentication, and observability. Envoy Proxy is known for its high performance and low latency, making it a popular choice for companies seeking to optimize their network traffic and improve overall system efficiency.
e.name: Envoy Proxy

e.description: EnvoyWorldWide (Envoy WorldWide, Inc.) was a Massachusetts-based automated notification and interactive multi-channel messaging company, backed by Battery Ventures, that sold hosted alerting and customer-communication services. The company rebranded as Varolii Corporation in the mid-2000s, and the envoyworldwide.com property was retired. As of this enrichment pass the domain has no A record and its most recent archived captures show a parked "Under Construction" placeholder rather than a company site. No developer portal, documentation, API reference, SDK, package, or GitHub organization could be located on any public surface. This profile is retained as a historical network entry with no active API surface.
e.name: EnvoyWorldWide

e.description: Enya is a Singapore-based sustainable period-care consumer brand backed by 500 Global (500 Southeast Asia) and Crusade Partners. Founded by Christian Teo, Enya sells certified organic cotton sanitary pads, liners, tampons, menstrual cups, period underwear and heating patches direct-to-consumer and via subscription (15/30/45/90-day cadence) across Singapore, Asia and the Middle East, through its enya.sg storefront, Shopee and retail partners such as DKSH. It is a consumer packaged-goods / e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.
e.name: Enya

e.description: Enzai is an enterprise AI governance platform that helps organizations adopt AI while managing regulatory and operational risk. Its product suite spans agentic AI governance (real-time analysis, risk flagging, and agent-sprawl management), AI use-case intake and approval workflows, a centralized AI registry inventorying first- and third-party AI systems, and compliance frameworks that map AI initiatives to the EU AI Act, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001. Enzai is headquartered in Belfast with a London office, is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by venture capital including Seedcamp. No public API or developer portal is published at this time.
e.name: Enzai

e.description: Enzo Biochem, Inc. (operating as Enzo Life Sciences) is a life sciences company specializing in labeling and detection technologies for biomedical research and drug development. Trading under the tagline "Scientists Enabling Scientists," Enzo develops and manufactures research reagents and assays including AMPIVIEW RNA probes for in-situ hybridization and FISH, antibodies, ELISA immunoassays, immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, and CELLESTIAL cell-based assays. Its biopharma arm provides drug discovery services, target identification and validation, assay development, in vitro toxicology, and GMP manufacturing. Products are sold through an online catalog and account portal at enzo.com rather than a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub company lead and enriched with the identity, website, and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.
e.name: Enzo Biochem

e.description: Enzyme is a cloud-based electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) for the life sciences, serving medical device, digital health, and biopharma companies. The platform is 21 CFR Part 11 compliant and validated out-of-box, spanning the full product lifecycle: document control, change control, and training as core functions; design control, risk management, and supplier management for premarket; and audits, complaints, nonconformance, and CAPA for postmarket. It integrates with enterprise tools including Microsoft Office 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Google Workspace, and Jenkins, and is designed to scale from startup through IPO-stage organizations. Enzyme was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC (Data Collective) and was acquired by Greenlight Guru.
e.name: Enzyme

e.description: Enzymit is a synthetic biology company based in Rehovot, Israel that designs novel enzymes and enables cell-free biomanufacturing. Its proprietary platform combines computational protein design, deep learning, and high-throughput testing to develop enzymes for biochemicals, food and beverage, personal care, and health and nutrition markets, with applications spanning hyaluronic acid production, cultivated-meat ingredients, and biosensors. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Enzymit publishes open research tools such as SolvIT (protein solubility prediction) and the StabilizeIT platform, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.
e.name: Enzymit

e.description: Eo Computer (EO, Inc.) was an early-1990s hardtech company, backed by Kleiner Perkins, that built the EO Personal Communicator - a pen-based tablet computer running GO Corporation's PenPoint operating system. AT&T became the principal backer and later shut the company down in 1994. The company is defunct: it has no website, developer program, public API, SDKs, or any published developer surface, so there is nothing for the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline to search, generate, or derive. This profile is retained as a historical portfolio record of a dead, non-API hardware company.
e.name: Eo Computer

e.description: EOD Historical Data (EODHD) provides institutional-grade financial data through a REST API at https://eodhd.com/api covering 150,000+ tickers across 60+ global exchanges. The API spans end-of-day historical prices (30+ years), real-time OHLCV, intraday bars, fundamentals (income statements, balance sheets, cash flows), ETF and mutual fund data, options chains with Greeks, dividends, splits, corporate actions, technical indicators, financial news with sentiment, insider transactions, macroeconomic indicators, ESG data, and WebSocket streaming. Authentication is via api_token query parameter; output is JSON, CSV, or XML.
e.name: EOD Historical Data

e.description: Access historical end-of-day stock prices, intraday data, US stock options, and real-time prices with free and advanced plans. EODHD provides financial data for 150,000+ tickers, including stocks, ETFs, funds, and currencies worldwide, through 68+ REST endpoints, WebSocket streaming, an official OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification, an OAuth-secured MCP server with 86 tools, and a published Claude Skills plugin.
e.name: EODHD

e.description: EOG Resources is one of the largest crude oil and natural gas exploration and production companies in the United States, with operations in major producing basins.
e.name: EOG Resources

e.description: eola is a London-based online booking and business-management platform for the activity and leisure industry. It gives tour operators, surf and watersports schools, outdoor activity centres, adventure and winter-sports providers, course and rental businesses, and multi-site operators a single system to sell experiences and run their operations. The platform covers online and onsite point-of-sale bookings, a product builder for activities, memberships, class passes and rentals, instructor and resource scheduling, online waivers and questionnaires with AI checking, payments and reconciliation, marketing tools (discount codes, credit vouchers, review links, branded multi-language emails), reporting and analytics, an activity marketplace, and eola AI features. eola is backed by Techstars. It operates as a closed SaaS product: bookings are embedded via a first-party booking widget and business dashboard rather than a documented public developer API.
e.name: eola

e.description: Eon is a next-generation cloud backup and data-protection platform that turns cloud backups into live, searchable, strategic assets across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. It provides agentless backup, cloud backup posture management, ransomware protection, global search over backups, live and granular file/resource restore, and a zero-ETL data-lake storage tier that makes old snapshots useful for analytics and AI. Eon exposes a REST API (OpenAPI 3.0, 99 operations) covering source/restore accounts, resources, vaults, snapshots, backup policies, restores, jobs, IAM, billing, and multi-party action approvals, with an official Go SDK and Terraform provider. Backed by BOND Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
e.name: Eon

e.description: Eon Laboratories is a pharmaceutical manufacturer that develops, manufactures, and markets a broad range of generic pharmaceutical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a generic-drug maker rather than a software or API producer, Eon Laboratories publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications, so this profile carries company identity only and no API artifacts. The record will be revisited if the company later exposes a developer or partner API surface.
e.name: Eon Laboratories

e.description: Eon Pass (EonPass) is an AI-powered anti-counterfeiting and brand-protection software platform. It helps brand-protection and enforcement teams identify, investigate, and take down counterfeiters by analyzing more than 24 data sources — including marketplace activity, corporate records, logistics data, and investigation signals — to build comprehensive profiles of suspected bad actors. Teams track suspects, manage cases, and coordinate enforcement actions from a unified dashboard, with the platform reporting takedown-efficiency improvements of up to 20%. Eon Pass is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published; this profile is maintained as an enrichment lead in the API Evangelist network.
e.name: Eon Pass

e.description: Eos AI is a San Francisco healthcare technology company building an autonomous operating system for healthcare that helps clinics and hospitals identify eligible patients and enable early care interventions. The platform connects to fragmented clinical systems (EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing), resolves patient identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history that can be searched and analyzed as one distributed database. Two harmonization products anchor the stack: VERA standardizes medical imaging across scanners, sites, and protocols to improve model performance and shorten deployment, and LUCIA structures EHR free text, ICD, SNOMED, and clinical signals into a unified representation for downstream analytics. On top of the harmonized data, Eos runs predictive models over full patient trajectories and drives automations into hospital workflows, reporting roughly 3x administrative productivity and 37% revenue recovery in early deployments. Founded in 2025 by Arya Khokhar and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Its application is gated at my.helloeos.ai; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date, so this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.
e.name: Eos AI

e.description: EOS Data Analytics (EOSDA) provides satellite imagery and analytics platforms for agriculture, forestry, infrastructure, and environmental monitoring. Their solutions include LandViewer for visualizing satellite data, Crop Monitoring for precision agriculture, and EOS RayVision for advanced visualisation. The company offers a Satellite Data API that gives programmatic access to high‑resolution imagery, analytics, and AI‑driven insights, serving sectors such as finance, insurance, and disaster response.
e.name: EOS Data Analytics

e.description: EOSIO, now known as the Antelope protocol, is a free, open-source blockchain software protocol that provides developers and entrepreneurs with a platform on which to build, deploy, and run high-performing blockchain applications. Reference node software (nodeos) exposes HTTP/JSON RPC plugins for chain reads, history queries, transaction submission, and producer operations.
e.name: EOSIO

e.description: EP Energy Corporation was an independent exploration and production company engaged in the acquisition and development of unconventional onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States, principally in the Eagle Ford shale and the Uinta basin. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October 2019 and emerged in October 2020. Verdun Oil Company II LLC, an EnCap Investments portfolio company, completed its acquisition of EP Energy on 30 March 2022 for approximately $1.45 billion, with the Utah/Uinta assets divested post-closing under an FTC order. EP Energy is no longer an operating company. It never published an API, SDK, or developer program, and its corporate domain epenergy.com now redirects to the acquirer, verdunoilco.com. The unrelated hyphenated domain ep-energy.com is a GoDaddy aftermarket listing offered for sale and is not an EP Energy surface.
e.name: EP Energy

e.description: Web services, data products, and open data spanning the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Programmatic access to air quality, water quality, hazardous waste, toxic releases, facility compliance, power-sector emissions, computational toxicology, and watershed assessments through dozens of public APIs.
e.name: EPA — U.S. Environmental Protection Agency

e.description: EPA.gov is an alias for the Environmental Protection Agency entry. The canonical APIs.json index for U.S. EPA APIs and data services is maintained in the environmental-protection-agency repository, which catalogs EPA's Envirofacts Data Service, Air Quality System (AQS), UV Index, and ECHO Compliance and Enforcement APIs. Refer to the canonical record for current API listings, properties, and metadata.
e.name: EPA.gov

e.description: EPAM Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EPAM Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
e.name: EPAM Systems

e.description: EPCOR Utilities Inc. is a municipally owned Canadian utility headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, wholly owned by the City of Edmonton, that builds and operates electricity distribution and transmission, water and wastewater, and natural gas distribution systems across Alberta, Ontario and British Columbia in Canada and in Arizona, New Mexico and Texas in the United States. In its Alberta home market it is both a wires company for Edmonton and, through EPCOR Energy Alberta, a regulated-rate electricity retailer, sitting at the distribution-and-retail end of the value chain rather than in generation (generation was spun out as Capital Power in 2009). EPCOR runs no developer programme: epcor.com publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI and no llms.txt, and the developer., developers., api., docs. and data. subdomains do not resolve. It nonetheless operates two real programmatic surfaces. The first is compelled: the Green Button Download My Data and Connect My Data service its three Ontario service areas - natural gas in the Aylmer area and electricity in the Collingwood and Kincardine areas - must run under Ontario's energy data regulation (O. Reg. 633/21), delivered behind a customer login and a third-party vendor registration portal, with EPCOR stating Green Button Alliance certification but publishing no base URI, no ESPI version and no technical contract. The second is accidental and entirely open: a public ArcGIS Online organization (owner epcor_outages) whose 36 production feature services - Edmonton power outage areas, Canadian water main breaks, water infrastructure projects, scheduled field events, and the outage and service-area layers for fourteen EPCOR Water USA districts in Arizona and New Mexico - answer anonymous ArcGIS REST queries with live data. EPCOR documents none of it, licenses none of it and announces none of it. The result is a utility that is open where a province compelled it, open where nobody noticed, and closed everywhere it would count as a product; wholesale market and system data still comes from AESO and IESO, not from EPCOR.
e.name: EPCOR

e.description: EPEX SPOT SE, the European Power Exchange, operates the organised short-term electricity markets across thirteen European countries - day-ahead and intraday auctions on the MATS trading system and continuous intraday trading on the M7 trading system. Day-ahead prices set on EPEX SPOT are the reference for much of the European power sector. EPEX SPOT exposes real machine-readable interfaces, but none of them are open self-serve APIs - trading APIs (MATS, M7) require exchange membership, and read-only market data APIs and SFTP file feeds require a paid Market Data Services subscription ordered through the EEX Group Webshop.
e.name: EPEX SPOT

e.description: EPFL (École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne) is a Swiss federal institute of technology in Lausanne and one of the two federal technical universities in the ETH Domain. Measured on what it actually operates rather than what runs under its name, EPFL is unusual among research universities: it runs FOUR public, unauthenticated APIs on its own registrable domain. The Actu news API (actu.epfl.ch) and the Memento events API (memento.epfl.ch) are Django REST Framework services with live interactive CoreAPI documentation; Infoscience (infoscience.epfl.ch) is EPFL's self-hosted DSpace-CRIS repository serving a HAL/HATEOAS REST API and a working OAI-PMH provider; and GETprime (getprime.epfl.ch), from the Gene Expression Core Facility, answers primer-design queries over HTTP. EPFL publishes no OpenAPI for any of them and operates no developer portal, no API gateway (api.epfl.ch resolves only to RFC 1918 space), no plans, no rate-limit documentation and no deprecation policy — every OpenAPI in this repo is derived by API Evangelist and marked as such. Its library discovery runs on Ex Libris Primo/Alma through the SLSP consortium and its identity provider endpoint is hosted by SWITCH edu-ID; both are recorded here as tenant relationships, not as EPFL engineering. There is no public course-catalog or timetable API.
e.name: EPFL

e.description: Ephemeral Solutions is the company entity behind Ephemeral Tattoo, the direct-to-consumer brand at ephemeraltattoos.com (ephemeral.tattoo) known for "made-to-fade" semi-permanent tattoos applied with a vegan ink formulated to fade naturally over roughly one to three years, removing the need for laser removal. The company operates two sides of a marketplace: a consumer service that connects people with approved partner tattoo artists, and a business line that sells its proprietary fading ink to professional tattoo artists and studios. It runs an editorial blog, a lookbook of tattoo examples, a How It Works explainer, and an FAQ. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or agent surface, so this profile carries only verified identity and domain-security signals.
e.name: Ephemeral Solutions

e.description: EpiBiologics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in San Mateo, California, developing bispecific antibodies for directed extracellular protein degradation. Its proprietary EpiTAC platform leverages an atlas of 270+ degradation-inducing cell-surface receptors to build tissue-selective therapies that degrade disease-causing proteins while sparing healthy tissue, targeting cancer, autoimmune, and other serious diseases. The company dosed its first patient with EPI-326 (an EGFR-driven solid-tumor bispecific) in a Phase 1 study in April 2026 and closed a $107M Series B round in January 2026. Backed by GV, EpiBiologics was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer/API surface.
e.name: EpiBiologics

e.description: Epic Bio (legally Epicrispr Biotechnologies, Inc.) is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2018 by Stanford CRISPR pioneer Stanley Qi, Ph.D. It develops epigenetic editing therapies that modulate gene expression without cutting DNA, built on its proprietary Gene Expression Modulation System (GEMS) platform — a combination of ultracompact DNA-binding proteins (CasMINI, CasONYX), tailored guide RNAs, and a large library of transcriptional and epigenomic modulators. Its lead program EPI-321 is in first-in-human clinical study for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), with preclinical programs in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia. The company is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes a corporate and scientific website but no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.
e.name: Epic Bio

e.description: Epic Cleantec is a San Francisco based water technology company that designs, builds and operates onsite water reuse systems for buildings. Its OneWater and OneWater Rain systems collect, treat and recycle a building's greywater, blackwater, rainwater and condensate onsite — recovering up to 95% of wastewater for non-potable uses such as toilet flushing, irrigation, cooling towers and laundry — alongside wastewater heat recovery and a soil amendment product line. The technology grew out of work on the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation Reinvent the Toilet Challenge and is deployed in multifamily, commercial office, hospitality, stadium, data center, higher education and community-scale developments across North America. Systems ship with PLC/SCADA control and a cloud-connected Eco-Insights reporting dashboard for remote monitoring, alarms and utility savings reporting, but Epic Cleantec publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; the data surface is delivered to building owners and operators as a hosted dashboard rather than as a public API.
e.name: Epic CleanTec

e.description: Epic Games is the studio behind Fortnite, the Unreal Engine, the Epic Games Store, MetaHuman, RealityScan, Twinmotion, RAD Game Tools, and the Epic Online Services (EOS) backend. Epic operates a unified developer portal at dev.epicgames.com that hosts the EOS SDK and REST APIs (Auth, Connect, Friends, Presence, Lobby, Sessions, Achievements, Stats, Leaderboards, Player Data Storage, Title Storage, Voice, Sanctions, Anti-Cheat, Reports, P2P, Ecom, User Info), the Unreal Engine documentation, the Epic Games Store publishing tools, and the Kids Web Services (KWS) compliance platform. EOS is cross-platform and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, iOS, Android, and web. This profile rolls Epic's developer-facing surfaces into a single index; the Unreal Engine surface has its own dedicated profile.
e.name: Epic Games

e.description: Epic Sciences is a San Diego, California clinical diagnostics company founded in 2008 that develops blood-based "liquid biopsy" tests for oncology. Its platform, licensed from the Peter Kuhn laboratory at Scripps Research, isolates and characterizes rare circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from whole blood using specialized assays and digital pathology algorithms, and is paired with circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) sequencing to inform treatment selection and track how a tumor evolves. Its lead product, DefineMBC, is a comprehensive blood biopsy for metastatic breast cancer whose 56-gene ctDNA panel received Medicare coverage in April 2023. The company also runs its platform as a service for pharmaceutical partners measuring outcomes in clinical trials, and in 2020 partnered with Predicine to combine CTC and ctDNA analysis in a single offering. Epic Sciences is privately held and has raised roughly $204M across seven rounds through a Series G in April 2023. It is a laboratory diagnostics provider, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer program, SDK or machine-readable specification.
e.name: Epic Sciences

e.description: Epic Systems Corporation is a privately held electronic health record (EHR/EMR) software company founded in 1979 and headquartered in Verona, Wisconsin, United States. Epic's software supports the medical records of a large share of U.S. hospital systems and academic medical centers, and its "Epic on FHIR" developer program (fhir.epic.com / open.epic.com) exposes a standards-based HL7 FHIR interoperability surface for patient- and provider-facing apps. Epic serves live, public sandbox FHIR endpoints across three FHIR versions - R4 (4.0.1), STU3 (3.0.1), and DSTU2 (1.0.2) - aligned to the US Core implementation guides, with SMART on FHIR / OAuth 2.0 authorization, CDS Hooks, and FHIR Bulk Data ($export) access. Production access requires client registration and a health system's participation; the developer sandbox, specifications, and CapabilityStatements are openly published. Epic is a core node of the U.S. healthcare interoperability landscape shaped by the ONC/CMS 21st Century Cures Act information-blocking rules and TEFCA.
e.name: Epic Systems

e.description: Epic! Creations, Inc. operates Epic, an award-winning digital reading and learning platform for children twelve and under.
