The 2022 acquisition of Argentine biologicals firm BIOPHERO accelerated FMC's pheromone-based crop protection portfolio (Sofero brand).
f.name: FMC

f.description: FMC Technologies was a Houston-based energy services and equipment company serving the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly subsea, surface, and measurement solutions for hydrocarbon production. In January 2017 FMC Technologies completed its merger with Technip to form TechnipFMC, a global energy services company serving the subsea, surface, and offshore project markets. This repository tracks the legacy FMC Technologies brand and any successor APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with the merged TechnipFMC entity. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.
f.name: FMC Technologies (now TechnipFMC)

f.description: Fnality International is a London-headquartered financial market infrastructure company that builds and operates distributed-ledger wholesale payment systems settling in tokenised central bank money. Backed by a consortium of 24 global financial institutions — including Banco Santander, BNY, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, Goldman Sachs, State Street and UBS — Fnality launched the Sterling Fnality Payment System (£FnPS) in 2024 as the first regulated DLT-based payment system supervised by the Bank of England, with US Dollar and Euro payment systems in development. The systems run on private Ethereum networks, giving participant banks 24/7 availability, real-time atomic and PvP settlement, programmable money and T+0 cross-border liquidity movement. Fnality Services is the operational and product-delivery arm that licenses software to participants and runs inter-system arrangements. Technical documentation for participants is hosted in a credential-gated Archbee space at docs.fnality.com; Fnality publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification.
f.name: Fnality International

f.description: Fnatic is a London-headquartered global esports performance brand founded in 2004, fielding 20+ professional players across five game titles, operating four offices and facilities in London, Berlin, Belgrade and Tokyo with 100+ staff, and claiming $16m+ in prize money, 33m+ social followers and $55m raised from institutional investors. Beyond competition it runs two commercial businesses: Fnatic Gear, an award-winning esports hardware line (mice, keyboards, headsets and pads) launched in 2016, and an apparel and merchandise store. Fnatic operates no developer program and publishes no OpenAPI, no developer portal and no API documentation — fnatic.com is a Next.js front end over a Sanity CMS with a first-party member-account system ("Fnatic ID") that exposes no discovery document. Its one machine-readable surface is the Shopify-hosted store at shop.fnatic.com, which serves an anonymously introspectable Storefront GraphQL API, a Universal Commerce Protocol merchant profile with a UCP MCP commerce endpoint, OpenID Connect and RFC 8414/9728 discovery for customer accounts, and a provider-authored /agents.md (mirrored at /llms.txt) that tells AI agents which surface to use and requires explicit buyer approval before any agent completes a payment.
f.name: Fnatic

f.description: FNZ is a global end‑to‑end wealth management platform serving banks, wealth managers, insurance companies and asset managers. It provides a digital‑first, integrated solution for investment operations, client onboarding, portfolio management and compliance, supporting over $2.5 trillion in assets across millions of end‑investors. FNZ partners with leading financial institutions worldwide, leveraging data, analytics and AI to simplify complex wealth‑management processes and deliver scalable, personalized services.
f.name: FNZ

f.description: Fuck Off As A Service
f.name: FOAAS

f.description: Foaster is an AI transformation consultancy that bills itself as "the AI-native McKinsey." Founded in 2026 by Raphael Dabadie and Alexandre Combes and backed by Y Combinator, it deploys AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in about two weeks, with expert consultants reviewing the outputs and feeding their corrections back into the system. Its offerings span an AI Transformation Assessment, Continuous AI Transformation with monthly adoption tracking, and Enterprise Deployment backed by forward-deployed engineers. Foaster is a managed professional-services company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other developer-facing technical surface.
f.name: Foaster

f.description: Focal Communications Corporation was a Chicago-based competitive local exchange carrier (CLEC) founded in 1996 that provided switched local phone and data services to large, communications-intensive business customers in Tier I US markets. Backed by Battery Ventures, Madison Dearborn and Frontenac, it went public in 1998, filed Chapter 11 in December 2002, emerged from reorganization in July 2003, and was acquired by Corvis Communications (later Broadwing) in 2004. The company is defunct and operates no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this network profile is a historical stub and no live API artifacts exist to enrich.
f.name: Focal Communications

f.description: Focal Point is an AI-powered procurement orchestration platform for enterprise procurement teams. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the SaaS platform sits on top of a company's existing S2P and ERP systems to centralize procurement data, intake, and workflows across six core modules: Request Intake Management, Procurement Activity Management, Sourcing Event Management, Supplier Relationship Management, Third-Party Risk Management, and Contract Lifecycle Management. It connects existing systems and data via API integrations, automates tactical no-code workflows, and provides total spend visibility, intelligent intake, and smart routing so procurement teams can focus on strategic work. Focal Point does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through the platform. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.
f.name: Focal Point Procurement Solutions

f.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.
f.name: Focal Systems

f.description: FOCUS, the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification, is an open standard maintained under the FinOps Foundation that normalizes cost and usage data across cloud, SaaS, data center, and other technology vendors. FOCUS defines a common data schema, a controlled vocabulary of column names, allowed values, and pricing attributes so that practitioners can apply a consistent set of FinOps practices regardless of which provider generated the underlying billing dataset. FOCUS is purely a data specification rather than a REST API; conforming providers expose exports of their billing data in the FOCUS format, and tooling consumes those exports against the published column library, data model, and validator.
f.name: FOCUS (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification)

f.description: Focused Space, Inc. operates focused.space, a consumer productivity platform built around "body doubling" — a neuroscience-backed technique where people work silently alongside others to more easily enter and sustain a flow state. The service combines 100+ weekly live sessions hosted by real humans (available 24/7) with a custom focus-video platform, a goal-setting and task-tracking app, and a community aimed at creatives, builders, remote workers, and people with ADHD. Focused Space is a 500 Global (and E14 Fund) portfolio company. It ships web, iOS, and Android apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and security posture.
f.name: Focused Space

f.description: Fodda is the agent-native research layer built by PSFK, the trend-intelligence publisher, exposing 250+ expert-curated knowledge graphs (retail, beauty, fashion, sport, food and beverage, travel, technology), named-expert "Human Agent" digital twins, earnings-call intelligence across 500+ consumer-sector companies, and 80+ live institutional data sources (FRED, BEA, BLS, Census, ONS, Eurostat, ECB and more) to AI agents. It is reachable three ways from one data core: a REST API at api.fodda.ai (OpenAPI 3.1, 157 operations, per-operation price extensions), a hosted MCP server at mcp.fodda.ai (streamable-http, SSE, a curated Copilot endpoint, OAuth via Clerk with dynamic client registration, plus a stdio package on npm), and an A2A agent at mcp.fodda.ai/a2a discovered from /.well-known/agent-card.json. Access is metered per API call ($0.50) with three rails: an X-API-Key account key with a free monthly tier, enterprise OIDC bearer tokens, and a zero-onboarding Machine Payments Protocol flow in which any unauthenticated request answers HTTP 402 with the exact price and a Stripe Shared Payment Token is presented on retry. The catalog itself is published as an Open Knowledge Format bundle, an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset, llms.txt/agents.txt manifests, and ten MIT-licensed installable Agent Skills.
f.name: Fodda (PSFK)

f.description: FogHorn Systems was a Sunnyvale, California developer of edge AI and machine learning software for the industrial and commercial Internet of Things (IIoT). Its Lightning Edge AI platform and Lightning EdgeML brought real-time streaming analytics and ML inference to constrained on-premises edge hardware for predictive maintenance, machine optimization, and operational intelligence use cases. Johnson Controls acquired FogHorn in January 2022 and folded its team and technology into the OpenBlue suite of smart, autonomous building solutions, with the former Sunnyvale headquarters operating as a Johnson Controls "AI Hub." FogHorn no longer operates as a standalone brand and publishes no independent public developer surface — no developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or GitHub organization resolve as of this enrichment pass; the former foghorn.io/foghorn.ai domains are parked. This profile is retained as a network company record with no public API artifacts to harvest.
f.name: FogHorn Systems (Johnson Controls)

f.description: Fold (NASDAQ: FLD) is a bitcoin financial services company founded in 2014 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, billed as the first publicly traded bitcoin financial services company. Fold makes it easy for individuals and businesses to earn, save, and use bitcoin through consumer products including the Fold App, the Fold Bitcoin Rewards Credit Card, the Fold Debit Card, and the Fold Bitcoin Gift Card marketplace, paying real bitcoin rewards (not points or a proprietary token) on everyday purchases and bill payments. Bitcoin custody and Lightning Network payouts are powered by partners such as BitGo and OpenNode. Fold is a consumer-facing fintech application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.
f.name: Fold

f.description: Folhamatic (IOB Folhamatic Group) is a Brazilian developer of integrated accounting, payroll, and fiscal/tax software for accounting firms and businesses, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Americana, Sao Paulo. Its product line includes Folhamatic Payroll for personnel management and electronic files, Electronic Point Control for time-clock management, the Folhamatic Accounting system for management reporting, and Folhamatic Written Tax for tax departments. At acquisition it served more than 11,000 companies with 500-plus employees. Folhamatic was acquired by the UK's Sage Group in June 2012 and now operates as part of Sage in Brazil. The company publishes no first-party public developer API, and the historic folhamatic.com.br domain no longer serves a live site.
f.name: Folhamatic

f.description: Folia Water, Inc. is a clean-water social enterprise founded in 2016 by Jonathan Levine, Theresa Dankovich, and Cantwell Carson with the goal of bringing safe drinking water to 100 million people for pennies a day. The company manufactures Folia Filters, an affordable antimicrobial filter paper embedded with silver nanoparticles that kills 99.9999% of bacteria and 99.7% of viruses while removing protozoa and iron. Folia Water sells through distribution partners in emerging markets such as Bangladesh and is backed by 500 Global. It is a physical consumer-products manufacturer with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.
f.name: Folia Water

f.description: FOLIO (Future of Libraries is Open) is an open source library services platform (LSP) built by a community of libraries, developers and vendors. Developer documentation and an API reference are published on the FOLIO developer portal (dev.folio.org), user documentation at docs.folio.org, and source code in the folio-org GitHub organization.
f.name: FOLIO

f.description: Folk is a collaborative CRM platform designed for agencies, investors, and sales teams who need to manage relationships at scale. It provides a REST API organized around predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepting and returning JSON-encoded payloads with standard HTTP response codes. The API enables developers to manage contacts (people and companies), pipelines and deals, notes, reminders, interactions, and custom fields programmatically. Webhooks are supported for real-time event notifications, and the platform integrates with 5,000+ tools including Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Zapier. API access is available on the Premium and Enterprise plans.
f.name: Folk

f.description: Folkhalsomyndigheten (Public Health Agency of Sweden) is Sweden’s national public health agency, responsible for public health surveillance, disease prevention, health promotion, and providing evidence-based guidance. It publishes statistics, data, reports, and guidance for healthcare professionals and the public, and operates open data portals and APIs for health data access.
f.name: Folkhalsomyndigheten (Public Health Agency of Sweden)

f.description: Folksam Försäkringsbolag is a Swedish insurance company offering a wide range of insurance products for homes, cars, and individuals, as well as savings and pension solutions. It serves over 900,000 vehicles and countless households across Sweden, emphasizing customer service and digital accessibility through its website.
f.name: Folksam

f.description: Follow Up Boss is a real estate CRM and lead management platform helping agents and teams capture leads from any source, automate follow-up via texts, emails, and calls, manage pipelines and deals, and track team performance. The Follow Up Boss REST API exposes resources such as people, notes, tasks, deals, calls, text messages, events, and webhooks, secured with HTTP Basic authentication using an API key obtained from the application's admin settings.
f.name: Follow Up Boss

f.description: FOLX Health is a virtual healthcare platform built for and by the LGBTQIA+ community, delivering clinician-led care through a predominantly queer and trans network of providers. Its consumer services span gender-affirming hormone therapy (HRT), PrEP and sexual & reproductive health, primary care, mental health and therapy, and fertility and family building, plus care navigation, a peer community platform, and secure provider messaging. Members access care through the web and iOS/Android apps with same or next-day appointments and insurance acceptance. FOLX is a direct-to-consumer digital health company and, as of this profile, does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This entry was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched from its public web presence.
f.name: Folx Health

f.description: fomo (FOMO Labs Inc.) is a social-first cryptocurrency trading platform available as a mobile app and web platform. It lets mainstream retail investors trade memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins across multiple blockchains without managing wallets, paying gas fees, or transferring assets manually, wrapping on-chain trading in a social layer where users discover tokens, follow top traders, view real-time buy alerts, copy trades, and compete on leaderboards. Onboarding is quick with Apple Pay funding, and trading is multichain and gasless. Founded in 2025 by former Deutsche Bank and dYdX team members (CEO Paul Erlanger, Se Yong Park, Prashan Dharmasena), the New York company reports 500,000+ active traders, 625,000+ total users, and $4B+ in trading volume. In June 2026 it raised a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark at a $550M valuation. fomo is a consumer-facing product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.
f.name: fomo

f.description: Fond (formerly AnyPerk) is a U.S. employee rewards and recognition platform that lets companies run customizable recognition programs combining monetary and non-monetary rewards, perks, and a global rewards catalog. Fond offers a gated public/provider API that allows authenticated partners to programmatically manage a Fond account — provisioning, employee roster management, giving recognition to one or more employees, and rewards redemption — alongside integrations for Workday, ADP, Namely, Salesforce, Slack, and other HR systems. There is no open developer portal or published OpenAPI; API access is arranged directly via integration@fond.co. Fond was acquired by Reward Gateway in March 2023 and fond.co now redirects to rewardgateway.com. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.
f.name: Fond

f.description: Fondue provides a CashBack incentive platform that lets e‑commerce merchants offer store credit or prepaid award cards as rewards after purchase. The solution aims to increase conversions and list growth while protecting profit margins, and includes built‑in A/B testing and integration with email and SMS providers via simple UTM links.
f.name: Fondue

f.description: Fonoa is a global indirect tax automation platform that connects the full indirect tax lifecycle on one platform, serving enterprises across 100+ countries and jurisdictions. The platform provides APIs for real-time tax ID validation across 120+ countries, VAT/GST and sales tax calculation, e-invoicing compliance with local mandates, transaction reporting, and automated multi-country tax return filing. Companies such as Zoom, Uber, Booking.com, and Remote.com rely on Fonoa to automate and manage their global indirect tax obligations through a single API integration.
f.name: Fonoa

f.description: Font Awesome is the web's most popular icon library and toolkit, providing thousands of SVG, font, and CSS icons across multiple styles and families for web, desktop, and mobile projects. Beyond the icon sets and framework components (React, Vue, Angular, Ember, Svelte, React Native, WordPress), Font Awesome operates a public GraphQL API at api.fontawesome.com that lets developers programmatically query releases, search icons and their metadata, resolve family-styles and unicode values, and — with an authenticated access token — read account Kits, entitlements, and download subsets. The API uses a token-exchange endpoint that resolves an account API token into a short-lived bearer access token scoped by permission (public, kits_read, svg_icons_free, svg_icons_pro, and more). Font Awesome also ships a first-party `fa` CLI and official AI agent skills for icon discovery and setup.
f.name: Font Awesome

f.description: Food Advisor (FoodAdvisor.my) is a Malaysia-based food discovery application founded in 2014 by Kenny Hew and headquartered in Selangor, Malaysia. The service helps users find dishes and restaurants by searching dish names as keywords alongside locations. It is backed by 500 Global through the 500 Durians Southeast Asia fund. As of this profile the public web presence at foodadvisor.my returns HTTP 404 and no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation could be located for enrichment.
f.name: Food Advisor

f.description: openFDA is an Elasticsearch-based public API that serves FDA data on drugs, devices, foods, animal/veterinary products, and tobacco. Each noun exposes one or more datasets including adverse events, recall enforcement reports, product labeling, classifications, registrations, and approvals.
f.name: Food and Drug Administration

f.description: Food Info serves harmonised nutrient data for reference foods over a versioned REST API. It merges six food-composition datasets — USDA FoodData Central, McCance & Widdowson's CoFID, ANSES Ciqual, DTU Frida, AUSNUT and Open Food Facts — into a single schema, so a caller can query nutrients across sources without reconciling each publisher's format. Endpoints cover food search, a full nutrient panel per food, a nutrient catalogue, reverse nutrient search for the richest and poorest reference foods, and recipe parsing and analysis that resolves raw ingredient lines into per-line nutrition. Authentication is an X-Api-Key header, with a free tier of 10 requests a minute and 100 a day. HTTPS only and CORS disabled, so it is built for server-to-server use. The underlying dataset carries a citable Zenodo DOI, which is unusual provenance for a commercial data API.
f.name: Food Info

f.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.
f.name: Food Market Hub

f.description: The Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) is a branch of the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) responsible for ensuring the safety of the nation's commercial supply of meat, poultry, and egg products. FSIS publishes a Recall API that provides machine-readable access to recall and public health alert records.
f.name: Food Safety and Inspection Service

f.description: UK food hygiene rating data API
f.name: Food Standards Agency

f.description: Fooda is a Chicago-based workplace food-service marketplace that brings meals from local, independent restaurants directly to corporate offices, hospitals, universities, retail locations, and distribution centers. Its technology-enabled platform runs restaurant popup dining events, employer-paid meal programs, contactless lunch delivery, event catering and boxed lunches, coffee, pantry, and micro-market services, plus full cafeteria replacement under the Orange by Fooda brand. Fooda works with 2,000+ restaurant partners and serves upwards of ten million meals per year, using AI predictive modeling and machine learning to match restaurants to locations and schedule thousands of events. Sibling brands include Foodsby and Fooda for Restaurants. Fooda is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API or partner developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.
f.name: FoodA

f.description: National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference
f.name: FoodData Central

f.description: Random pictures of food dishes
f.name: Foodish

f.description: Foodology is a Bogota-based food-tech company building what it calls the largest group of delivery-focused virtual restaurant brands in Latin America. Founded in 2019 by Daniela Izquierdo and Juan Guillermo Azuero, it operates a cloud-kitchen (ghost kitchen) model, creating restaurant brands from scratch and running them out of shared commissaries and kitchens so multiple brands share real estate, ingredients, and staff. Marquee brands include Brunch & Munch (the #1 breakfast delivery brand in Colombia) and Avocalia (a leading salad brand). Foodology runs more than 85 cloud kitchens across Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, and Peru and reports over 300,000 delivered orders per month. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Base10/Base Partners, Wollef, Kayyak, Chimera, and artist Maluma, having raised a $15M Series A and a later $50M round. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; Foodology is a consumer food-delivery operator and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.
f.name: Foodology

f.description: Foodsmart is a telenutrition company that pairs the nation's largest network of registered dietitians with a digital food-benefits platform, delivering personalized nutrition care via telehealth to more than three million members. The company partners with health plans and employers to reach Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial members, combining one-on-one dietitian counseling with meal planning, grocery ordering, and SNAP benefits enrollment. Foodsmart's "Foodscription" model connects clinical nutrition guidance to affordable, healthy food access to improve outcomes and lower the cost of diet-related chronic disease. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foodsmart exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.
f.name: Foodsmart

f.description: Foodspark is a data-as-a-service platform that delivers real-time grocery, restaurant, and food-delivery data extracted from 100+ platforms including DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Instacart, McDonald's, Starbucks, and many others. Foodspark sells access to curated food and grocery datasets rather than a publicly documented self-serve API.
f.name: Foodspark

f.description: Foodspotting is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
f.name: Foodspotting

f.description: Foodvisor is a French mobile nutrition platform whose app identifies food items from a photograph using computer vision and returns nutritional information — calories, macronutrients and portion estimates. Between 2023 and 2025 Foodvisor also sold that capability to developers as the Foodvisor Vision API, a commercial image-recognition and nutrition-analysis service documented at vision.foodvisor.io. That developer product has since been withdrawn: the Vision product page now returns HTTP 404, the documentation host no longer resolves in DNS, and the live site carries no API, developer or enterprise content. Foodvisor today publishes no machine-readable contract, no SDK, no MCP server and no /.well-known document, and operates as a consumer subscription app.
f.name: Foodvisor

f.description: Foodzie was an online marketplace, founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, that let people discover and buy food directly from small artisan producers, and later ran a monthly tasting-box subscription service. It raised roughly $1M from investors including Uncork Capital (formerly SoftTech VC) and Jeff Clavier, and was acquired by the video-commerce company Joyus in June 2012, becoming "Joyus Food" before the subscription service was wound down. The company is defunct; the foodzie.com domain is no longer operated by the original business, and no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface exists to enrich.
f.name: Foodzie

f.description: Foot Locker, Inc. is a global retailer of athletic footwear and apparel, operating the Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. DICK'S Sporting Goods completed its acquisition of Foot Locker, Inc. on September 8, 2025 and continues to operate the Foot Locker brand suite. Foot Locker publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract. Trading-partner integration runs through third-party host platforms rather than a first-party developer site: supplier inventory and dropship through CommerceHub Dsco, and the Storefronts creator/affiliate program through impact.com, each requiring a commercial agreement. The former api.footlocker.com Apigee gateway no longer resolves.
f.name: Foot Locker

f.description: Embed codes for goals and highlights from Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A and many more
f.name: Football (Soccer) Videos

f.description: Transparent football (soccer) statistics and model predictions across 90+ leagues: league tables (classic, luck-adjusted, goals-based), results, fixtures with model probabilities, Dixon-Coles match probabilities, Monte Carlo season projections, goal-timing distributions, team match logs, and a public prediction track record. A single Dixon-Coles scoreline model produces one joint distribution per match, so 1X2, over/under and BTTS probabilities are mutually consistent by construction; season outcomes come from 10,000-run Monte Carlo simulations re-run daily. Every model signal is logged before kickoff and settled publicly. Offers a free read-only REST API with a self-describing JSON descriptor and a hosted MCP server whose tools/list is answerable anonymously.
f.name: Football Charts

f.description: Display football standings e.g epl, la liga, serie a etc. The data is based on espn site
f.name: Football Standings

f.description: Football data with matches info, players, teams, and competitions
f.name: Football-Data

f.description: Footprint Analytics is a blockchain data analytics platform providing unified REST and SQL APIs for querying DeFi protocol metrics, NFT market data, token analytics, GameFi economics, and on-chain activity across 30+ chains including Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Sui. The platform indexes 30,000+ protocols, 100M+ tokens, 2M+ NFT collections, and 3,000+ blockchain games, offering both no-code dashboards and programmatic API access for developers building Web3 data applications.
f.name: Footprint Analytics

f.description: Footway is a Nordic, data-driven e-commerce group (Nasdaq First North Growth Market, Stockholm) that operates the Footway footwear-and-fashion marketplace across roughly 24 European markets, carrying around 800 brands for more than two million customers, alongside its Operations-as-a-Service ("ECOM IN A BOX") merchant infrastructure at footwayplus.com / oaas.footway.com and a merchant portal at merchant.footwayplus.com. The consumer storefront at footway.com runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: an llms.txt / agents.md agent guide, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a UCP MCP endpoint for buyer-approved agent checkout, and Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authentication.
f.name: Footway

f.description: Fora is a modern, tech-enabled host travel agency headquartered in New York City, founded in 2021 by Henley Vazquez, Evan Frank and Jake Peters. It equips independent travel advisors with a custom booking portal, 700+ training videos, live support, preferred supplier partnerships, an IATA number, E&O insurance and automated commission collection, powered by a Travelport-backed booking platform and integrations such as Tablet Hotels. Fora runs a consumer traveler app plus an advisor portal and is building agentic AI tooling (Via / Sidekick) to streamline advisor workflows. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and Insight Partners, Fora does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web properties within the API Evangelist network.
f.name: Fora

f.description: Forage is a mission-driven payments company and one of only three payment processors approved by the USDA Food and Nutrition Service (FNS) to accept SNAP EBT and EBT Cash online. Forage gives grocery retailers, marketplaces, and platforms the API, SDKs, and regulatory expertise to add government-benefit tender (SNAP, EBT Cash, and HSA/FSA) to online and in-store checkout. The Forage Payments API tokenizes EBT cards, runs PIN-secured balance inquiries, and creates, captures, voids, and refunds EBT payments and orders, backed by JavaScript, iOS, Android, and POS Terminal SDKs, webhooks for order/payment/refund events, and daily CSV reconciliation reports.
f.name: Forage

f.description: Foraged is a community marketplace for wild and specialty foods, connecting independent foragers, farmers, fishers, and artisan food producers directly with home cooks and professional chefs across the United States. Founded in 2021 and built on a custom Medusa commerce stack, Foraged provides an end-to-end platform covering vendor storefronts, product listings, shipping logistics, and secure payment processing for hard-to-source ingredients like wild mushrooms, truffles, foraged berries, sea vegetables, and other specialty foods. Sellers manage their entire shop from a vendor dashboard while buyers discover seasonal wild foods through the marketplace website and mobile app. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foraged publishes no public developer API.
f.name: Foraged

f.description: Force Therapeutics is a healthcare technology company providing a digital patient-engagement and remote-monitoring platform for surgical and musculoskeletal care. The platform delivers personalized patient education, automated collection of Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs), preoperative optimization, postoperative recovery management, direct patient messaging, and actionable clinical insights for hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and private practices. Force integrates with major EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, NextGen) through the Redox Connection Network and FHIR/HL7-based workflows rather than a public developer API. The platform is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant, hosted on Amazon Web Services, and backed by Insight Partners.
f.name: Force Therapeutics

f.description: ForceDream Ltd (UK Company No. 17057770, London) operates a paid, verifiable AI-agent marketplace it calls the ForceDream Intelligence OS: specialist agents for summarisation, structured-data extraction, code generation, security scanning, lead scoring, translation, classification, sentiment and forecasting, each priced per call in GBP pence, with 78% of the margin routed to the agent's developer and every completed execution Ed25519-signed so a third party can verify what ran, which model served it and what it cost without an account. The same catalogue is reachable three ways: a REST API on api.forcedream.ai (an 8-operation, SDK-verified OpenAPI 3.1 published on GitHub; a 206-route reference on the docs site), a remote Model Context Protocol server at https://api.forcedream.ai/v1/mcp that answers an anonymous tools/list with 21 tools (5 keyless) and gates paid tools behind OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, and an A2A 1.0 agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json declaring 18 skills. Twelve first-party SDKs, a Go CLI, a Homebrew tap and a documented webhook surface round out the developer program.
f.name: ForceDream

f.description: Forcepoint is a data-first cybersecurity vendor whose platform spans Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Security Service Edge / SASE (Forcepoint ONE and Data Security Cloud | SSE), Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), and web, email, and data security. For developers and security engineers Forcepoint exposes several product REST APIs — DLP policy management, SSE Config/Log/IP and SCIM 2.0 provisioning, the NGFW Security Management Center (SMC) API, and an Appliance management API — documented on help.forcepoint.com. Auth varies by product: OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens for SSE, API-key clients for the NGFW SMC, and basic/session auth for DLP and appliances. Forcepoint publishes official automation tooling including the fp-NGFW-SMC-python SDK (PyPI), Ansible modules, and a Terraform provider, and runs a public status portal and trust center (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, CSA STAR, FIPS 140, GDPR).
f.name: Forcepoint

f.description: Ford Motor Company is a multinational automotive manufacturer that designs, builds and sells cars, trucks, SUVs and commercial vehicles, and operates a partner-facing API program through the Ford Developer Marketplace at developer.ford.com. The flagship surface is FordConnect, which lets an approved application read connected-vehicle data and issue vehicle commands to enrolled Ford and Lincoln vehicles, with the vehicle owner's consent captured as fourteen named data categories in the FordPass account-linking flow. Ford also publishes a WLTP emissions lookup for authorized parties. Access is partner-gated rather than self-serve: applications are registered in a Ford developer account and issued a client id plus two rotating secrets. Ford publishes no OpenAPI, pricing, rate limits, changelog or status page on any surface reachable without signing in.
f.name: Ford

f.description: Ford Motor Company is a global automotive manufacturer that designs, manufactures, markets, and services a full line of Ford trucks, cars, sport utility vehicles, electrified vehicles, and Lincoln luxury vehicles.
f.name: Ford Motor Company

f.description: Fordefi is an institutional MPC (multi-party computation) wallet and digital-asset security platform for DeFi, trading, and on-chain payments. Its developer API lets teams programmatically create vaults across 10+ blockchain families (EVM, Bitcoin, Solana, Cosmos and more), manage addresses and assets, and build, approve, sign, and broadcast transactions under a policy engine with built-in AML screening and audit logging. Authentication combines a Bearer JWT access token with ECDSA (NIST P-256) request signing by a registered API Signer; state-changing calls support idempotency and a signed webhook event surface for real-time monitoring. Fordefi is SOC 2 Type II certified. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Fordefi's public OpenAPI and developer documentation.
f.name: Fordefi

f.description: FordPass is Ford Motor Company's consumer connected-vehicle mobile app and service platform for Ford and Lincoln owners, exposing remote start/stop, remote lock/unlock, vehicle status (fuel/charge, tire pressure, oil life, odometer, location), Vehicle Health alerts, BlueCruise hands-free driving, Wi-Fi hotspot, Phone As A Key, scheduled service, and roadside assistance via the embedded FordPass Connect 4G LTE modem. Ford Pro is Ford's commercial fleet brand spanning Ford Pro Telematics, Ford Pro Intelligence, Ford Pro E-Telematics for EVs, Ford Pro Charging, Ford Pro FinSimple, and dealer/upfit services. The Ford Developer Marketplace (developer.ford.com) hosts Ford's partner-facing API program — FordConnect Query API for consumer-vehicle data and remote command access (with vehicle-owner consent via FordPass account OAuth), plus a Ford Pro REST API surface for fleets including Vehicle Status, Vehicle Historical Status, Vehicle Metadata, Vehicle Efficiency (fuel/energy/idle), Driver Behavior, Trip Reports, and Vehicle Health. Ford Pro Telematics is integrated with Geotab, Fleetio, Samsara, Motive, Verizon Connect, and other fleet platforms, and Smartcar offers a consumer OAuth bridge to Ford vehicles using FordPass Connect credentials. Access to Ford APIs is gated behind a partner application and credentials issued through the Ford Developer Portal; Ford has periodically restricted individual-developer access. No public OpenAPI specification is published outside the partner portal, so this profile documents the Ford developer surface as an index without a generated machine-readable contract.
f.name: FordPass / Ford Pro

f.description: FORE Systems, Inc. was a computer network switching equipment company based in Warrendale (Pittsburgh), Pennsylvania, founded in 1990 by Carnegie Mellon researchers Francois Bitz, Onat Menzilcioglu, Robert Sansom and Eric Cooper (the "FORE" acronym) to build Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) network interface cards and switches. It was the first company to commercially ship an ATM switch (the ASX-100) in 1992 and grew through acquisitions (ALANTEC, Applied Network Technology, RainbowBridge, CellAccess) before being acquired by Britain's General Electric Company (GEC) in 1999, folded into Marconi, and ultimately absorbed by Ericsson in 2006. The company is defunct and has no active API surface, developer portal, or product endpoints; this profile is a historical/company record in the API Evangelist network.
f.name: FORE Systems

f.description: Weather
f.name: Foreca

f.description: Forecast is an AI-powered project and resource management platform (a professional services automation / PSA tool) for project-driven companies, covering predictive project planning, resource allocation, capacity planning, time tracking, budgets, rate cards, and financial forecasting. Forecast exposes a complete REST API (JSON over HTTPS at api.forecast.it) for projects, tasks, time registrations, allocations, people, clients, and webhooks, authenticated with a per-integration API key. Originally a Danish/UK startup backed by Balderton Capital, Forecast was acquired by Accelo in 2025 and the forecast.app brand has since been integrated into accelo.com, while the api.forecast.it API endpoints remain operational. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC-portfolio lead and enriched from the public Forecast API documentation.
f.name: forecast

f.description: Forecastr is a startup financial planning and forecasting platform, founded in 2018 in Louisville, Kentucky, that helps founders and finance teams build investor-ready financial models, track cash flow and runway, plan headcount, budget expenses, and run what-if scenario analysis. It pairs cloud-based forecasting software (a spreadsheet-style formula builder, pre-built templates, drag-and-drop dashboards, and shareable live models) with fractional CFO services, and keeps actuals current through accounting integrations with QuickBooks Online and Xero. Forecastr is an API consumer of those accounting platforms rather than a public API provider; it publishes no developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.
f.name: Forecastr

f.description: The Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) is the trade and export agency of the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), working to promote U.S. agricultural exports and expand global markets for American agricultural products. FAS runs the Open Data Services at apps.fas.usda.gov, a free, key-gated HTTPS/JSON API publishing three datasets on U.S. and world agricultural trade: ESR (Export Sales Reporting — weekly U.S. export sales by commodity, destination and market year), GATS (the Global Agricultural Trade System — U.S. Census and UN ComTrade import, export and re-export flows, including trade by U.S. customs district), and PSD (Production, Supply and Distribution — world commodity production, supply and use forecasts). The surface is 35 read-only GET operations behind a single API_KEY header, described by a live Swagger 2.0 contract and rendered in Swagger UI.
f.name: Foreign Agricultural Service

f.description: The Foreign Claims Settlement Commission of the United States (FCSC) is a quasi-judicial, independent agency within the U.S. Department of Justice that adjudicates claims of U.S. nationals against foreign governments, under the International Claims Settlement Act (22 U.S.C. 1621 et seq.) and the War Claims Act (50 U.S.C. 4101-4147). Established in 1954 from the War Claims Commission and the International Claims Commission, it has run 43 completed country programs — Germany, Iran, Yugoslavia, Hungary, the Soviet Union, Poland, Italy, Cuba, China, Vietnam, Egypt, Panama and Albania among them — adjudicating more than 660,000 claims with awards in the billions of dollars. The Albania program remains open and the Commission serves as Special Master in Helms-Burton claims against Cuba. It publishes Final Opinions and Orders and annual reports on www.justice.gov, and operates no API or developer program of its own.
f.name: Foreign Claims Settlement Commission

f.description: Foreman (foreman.co) is an all-in-one, AI-powered project management and estimating platform built for construction contractors and the trades. It consolidates the full lifecycle of a construction job into one place: AI-assisted blueprint takeoffs and scoped estimates, branded proposals and e-signature, invoicing and online payments with QuickBooks sync, scheduling with critical-path task dependencies, and centralized document management for plans, permits, photos, change orders, and RFI communications. A Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company founded by Nolan Rossi, Foreman aims to keep contractors on the job site instead of behind a desk. As an early-stage product it currently exposes no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched with published company identity and link properties.
f.name: Foreman

f.description: Forerunner Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2012 by Kirsten Green and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Forerunner backs founders building category-defining companies, investing with early conviction at the seed and Series A stages (with selective pre-seed), typically writing initial checks in the $1M-$15M range. The firm invests across consumer, commerce, health and wellness, consumer finance, marketplaces and services, personal systems, and platforms and infrastructure, increasingly viewed through AI lenses (AI as agent, AI as infrastructure, AI as intelligence layer). Forerunner has raised nearly $3B in assets under management across seven flagship funds, with its most recent Fund VII a $500M early-stage vehicle. Its portfolio includes category leaders such as Chime, Warby Parker, Glossier, Hims & Hers, Oura, Faire, The Farmer's Dog, Dollar Shave Club, Curology, Away, Ritual, and Chime, along with a growing cohort of AI-native companies including Decagon, Suno, Slingshot AI, and Monarch Money.
f.name: Forerunner Ventures

f.description: Forescout Technologies is a cybersecurity company specializing in automated cybersecurity for device visibility, control, and compliance across IT, OT/ICS, IoT, and IoMT environments. The Forescout Platform (eyeSight, eyeControl, eyeInspect, eyeExtend, and Risk & Exposure Management) discovers, classifies, assesses, and secures every connected asset on the network without requiring agents. Forescout exposes REST APIs for external integration through the Open Integration Module (OIM) of eyeExtend Connect — the Web API and Data Exchange (DEX) plugins — plus the eyeSight Admin API and the eyeInspect Command Center REST API, giving programmatic access to host inventory, network policies, alerts, and vulnerability data. First-party integration example code (Python, Node, and Postman collections) is published in the Forescout GitHub org.
f.name: Forescout

f.description: Foresight is a predictive project-delivery platform for complex construction and infrastructure megaprojects, with a particular focus on data centers, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded by Dr. Atif Ansar and Igor Shifrin (Oxford) and headquartered in London, it layers on top of existing scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project and Excel to turn raw schedule data into forecasts, risk assessment, delay prediction, and portfolio-wide project assurance. The company reports managing $100B+ in mission-critical projects and is backed by Creandum and Macquarie Capital. Foresight is delivered as a SaaS web application and does not publish a public developer API.
f.name: Foresight

f.description: Foresight Diagnostics is a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited cancer diagnostics company founded in 2020 in Boulder, Colorado by Stanford physicians and scientists, and since February 2026 a wholly owned subsidiary of Natera. Its Foresight CLARITY minimal residual disease (MRD) platform is a liquid-biopsy test powered by proprietary PhasED-Seq phased-variant sequencing and bioinformatics, detecting circulating tumor DNA at an analytical sensitivity below one part per million across lymphoma, lung and other solid tumors. The company sells laboratory testing services to biopharma sponsors, academic researchers and clinicians rather than software: it operates a central laboratory and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.
f.name: Foresight Diagnostics

f.description: Foresight Mental Health is a Berkeley, California technology-enabled outpatient behavioral health organization founded in 2018 by UC Berkeley computer science students Doug Hapeman and Matt Milford to widen access to insurance-covered therapy and psychiatry. It delivers virtual and in-person care through its own clinics in California and Georgia plus partner locations in Arizona, Florida and Texas, covering psychiatry and medication management, individual and couples therapy (CBT, DBT-informed care, EMDR, ACT, Gottman Method, play therapy), child and adolescent services, a maternal mental health program, ADHD/IVA-2 CPT testing, intensive outpatient services in California and transcranial magnetic stimulation in Georgia. The company acquired Psychiatric Addictive Curative Therapies (PACT) Atlanta and has raised roughly $17.7M across pre-seed through Series C with investors including Polaris Partners. Its clinical technology stack is bought rather than built and patient-facing: scheduling runs through Zocdoc and the patient portals are operated by third parties — AdvancedMD for California patients and athenahealth elsewhere. Foresight publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract; the only machine-readable documents on its host are a Yoast-generated llms.txt, a sitemap index and the marketing site's stock WordPress core REST API at /wp-json/.
f.name: Foresight Mental Health

f.description: Forest Admin is an ops orchestration platform and internal tool builder that enables operations and compliance teams to manage data, workflows, and business processes through a customizable admin panel. It uses an agent-based architecture where developers deploy a REST API agent (Admin Backend) on their own infrastructure, keeping data entirely within client-controlled servers. The platform supports Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Python (Django/Flask), and PHP (Laravel/Symfony) agents that introspect data models and expose CRUD, filtering, pagination, and sorting capabilities through a generated Admin API. Forest Admin includes role-based access control (RBAC), JWT-based dual authentication, AI-assisted workflows, MCP server integration, SOC 2 compliance, and human-AI collaboration features for regulated industries such as fintech, KYC/AML, and payments operations.
f.name: Forest Admin

f.description: Forest Laboratories was a pharmaceutical company that developed, manufactured, and sold branded prescription drugs. It was acquired by Actavis in 2014, which later rebranded as Allergan and is now part of AbbVie. As a defunct entity, Forest Laboratories does not publish any APIs or developer resources.
f.name: Forest Laboratories

f.description: The U.S. Forest Service is an agency of the U.S. Department of Agriculture managing 193 million acres of national forests and grasslands. Not a software vendor, it nonetheless runs four free, entirely unauthenticated public HTTP APIs: the FIADB-API behind EVALIDator, returning Forest Inventory and Analysis population estimates with sampling errors from the nation's continuous forest census; the Research Data Archive web service, a search-and-retrieve API over DOI-registered research datasets that also runs an OAI-PMH 2.0 repository serving Dublin Core and FGDC metadata; and two FSGeodata ArcGIS REST servers publishing the Enterprise and Research Data Warehouse map services, 144 in the EDW folder alone, each also exposing a SOAP contract. A DCAT-US 1.1 open-data catalog is published through Geospatial Data Discovery. No API needs a key or an account, every operation is a read, and the data are works of the U.S. government.
f.name: Forest Service

f.description: Forethought is a San Francisco-based generative AI customer-support platform. Its multi-agent product suite — Solve (omnichannel resolution), Triage (ticket classification and routing), Discover (knowledge-gap detection and article generation), Assist (agentic copilot for human agents), and Agent QA (automated quality scoring) — is powered by SupportGPT, Forethought's fine-tuned generative AI engine. The platform supports chat, email, voice, Slack, mobile, and a Headless API channel, and integrates with Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom, Front, Gorgias, Genesys, Five9, LiveChat, and knowledge sources including Notion, Document360, and Stonly. Forethought exposes two public REST APIs on the Enterprise plan: the Solve API (https://app.forethought.ai/solve/api/v1) for starting and continuing AI conversations and inspecting workspace context variables, and the Triage API (https://api.forethought.ai/api/predict) for classifying tickets against customer-trained models. Public iOS and Android SDKs (Forethought- Technologies/solve-ios, solve-android) embed Solve into mobile apps. The Forethought engineering team also maintains AutoChain, an open-source lightweight framework for building and testing LLM agents. Forethought is now part of Zendesk.
f.name: Forethought

f.description: Forever Oceans Corporation was a US offshore aquaculture company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Virginia, that raised sushi-grade kanpachi (Seriola rivoliana) in deep water off the Pacific coast of Panama using a patented single-point mooring system that let its submerged pens orient with ocean currents. It raised roughly $170M and held a large Brazilian marine-aquaculture concession, with planned farms in Brazil and Indonesia. Its investors brought in restructuring and liquidation specialists in November 2024, and its corporate domain foreveroceans.com is now a registrar parking page that refuses HTTPS. Seafood production, not software, was the product: the company never published an API, developer portal, SDK or any machine-readable contract, and no such surface survives.
f.name: Forever Oceans

f.description: ForeVR Games is a consumer virtual-reality game studio that brings classic social bar and backyard games into VR. Its catalog includes ForeVR Bowl, ForeVR Darts, ForeVR Pool, and ForeVR Cornhole, built for multiplayer play across Meta Quest, Steam VR, and PlayStation VR2. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. ForeVR is a consumer game publisher with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation program; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.
f.name: ForeVR

f.description: Foreword Fund is an early-stage venture capital firm led by solo general partner Declan Kelly, backing daring founders in their first chapters. Foreword writes first checks of up to $250,000 at the pre-seed and seed stage, partnering with roughly ten exceptionally focused teams each year across B2B software, fintech, crypto, enterprise software, AI, marketplaces, and consumer sectors in the US and Europe. A partner fund of Seedcamp, its portfolio spans 40-plus companies including unicorns Sorare, Jeeves, and Localyze.
f.name: Foreword Fund

f.description: A collection of foreign exchange and currency conversion APIs.
f.name: Forex

f.description: FOREX.com is a regulated forex and CFD trading broker (a brand of StoneX Group) offering REST and FIX APIs for automated trading and market data access. The REST API, hosted at ciapi.cityindex.com/TradingAPI, enables algorithmic traders to authenticate sessions, retrieve real-time streaming prices via Lightstreamer, execute buy/sell orders across 80+ forex and CFD markets, and manage account balances, positions, and order history programmatically. A FIX API is available for institutional clients requiring low-latency direct market connectivity.
f.name: FOREX.com

f.description: Forgame Holdings Limited (HKEX 00484) is a Hong Kong-listed technology holding company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China. It operates across cloud/light gaming, fintech, electronic trade, and cloud storage. Its web and mobile game publishing platform 91wan, run by PRC entity Guangzhou Weidong Internet Technology Co., Ltd., has distributed over 100 web games and attracted more than 200 million registered players. In 2016 the group obtained an internet micro-lending (fintech) license in the PRC, and since 2019 has explored e-sports and virtual-reality games. Forgame is tracked by API Evangelist as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.
f.name: forgame

f.description: Forge Nano is a materials-technology manufacturer headquartered in Thornton, Colorado that commercializes particle and wafer Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) under its Atomic Armor platform and patented ALDx architecture. The company applies atomic-scale nanocoatings to powders, electrodes and semiconductor wafers to improve energy density, cycle life, thermal stability and yield, and sells three lines of business: US-sourced lithium-ion cells from its Morrisville, North Carolina gigafactory, commercial semiconductor wafer-fabrication equipment including the TEPHRA cluster tool for 200mm wafers, and Powder ALD coating systems for batteries, catalysts and composites. Its markets are semiconductors, energy storage, defense and aerospace, AI hardware and quantum devices. Forge Nano is a hardware and advanced-materials company: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.
f.name: Forge Nano

f.description: Forge Robotics is a Galway, Ireland and San Francisco based robotics company building modular autonomous factories for metal fabrication. Its shipping container sized, software configurable units combine a vision system, sub millimeter 3D scanning, and robotic intelligence to autonomously handle, position, weld, laser engrave, and finish metal assemblies, turning conventional human programmed industrial welding robot arms into autonomous members of the workforce. The company targets the skilled welder shortage in US manufacturing with continuously operating, snap together production modules. Forge Robotics was co founded by Eoin Cobbe (CEO) and Robert Cormican (CTO) and is a Y Combinator backed pre seed startup. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing and product website only, with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs.
f.name: Forge Robotics

f.description: Forged Sports, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California software company (founded May 2024) building a Venue Management System (VMS) for commercial indoor golf and golf-simulator venues. The platform consolidates bay operations, bookings, player profiles, waivers, leagues, business intelligence, and third-party integrations into a single command center — offering live bay monitoring, reservation and booking management, player-retention analytics, game-popularity insight, and bay-utilization reporting. Forged Sports also develops gamified indoor-golf experiences on top of launch-monitor technologies. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently published.
f.name: Forged Sports

f.description: Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge and open-source Git service (a Gitea fork) managed by the non-profit Codeberg e.V. It provides a comprehensive REST API for managing repositories, users, organizations, issues, pull requests, CI/CD workflows via Actions, and package registries. Forgejo emphasizes privacy, low resource usage, and community ownership as a Free Software alternative to centralized code hosting platforms.
f.name: Forgejo

f.description: ForgeRock, now part of Ping Identity, provides digital identity and access management solutions for secure authentication, authorization, and identity governance across cloud and hybrid environments.
f.name: ForgeRock

f.description: Inspirational Quotes
f.name: Forismatic

f.description: Forithmus builds foundation models for medical imaging (Zurich, Switzerland; pre-seed backed by Point Nine and e2vc). Its developer-facing product is the Forithmus Research Hub, a Challenge Platform where research teams host and enter medical-imaging benchmarks by submitting Docker containers or prediction files, with leaderboards, credits and compute tiers, collections, forums, and groups. The public REST API is served at https://research.forithmus.com/api and described by an OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification (172 paths, 213 operations across 24 tags: auth/2FA, challenges, phases, collections, submissions, leaderboard, credits, payments, forum, groups, and more). Authentication is Bearer JWT via email/password or Google OAuth, with a browser device flow used by the first-party `forithmus` CLI. Forithmus also publishes open model/dataset repositories (MR-RATE, VLM3D, FORA) on GitHub.
f.name: Forithmus

f.description: Form Bio is an AI‑driven biotech company focused on accelerating the development of genetic medicines and genome engineering solutions. Leveraging proprietary AI platforms, Form Bio provides end‑to‑end services from vector design and optimization to manufacturing analytics, helping partners de‑risk and accelerate therapeutic programs across human and animal health.
f.name: Form Bio

f.description: Form Energy is a long-duration energy storage company headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts and Weirton, West Virginia. Its flagship product is an iron-air battery designed to store electricity for up to 100 hours, intended to enable utilities and grid operators to firm renewable generation across multi-day weather events, replace aging fossil-fueled peakers, and defer transmission and distribution upgrades. The company manufactures its battery at Form Factory 1, a 550,000-square-foot facility built on the former Weirton Steel mill site that employs roughly 400 people. Form Energy also publishes Formware, a grid-modeling software suite used by utilities to plan resource portfolios that include multi-day storage. Notable customers and partners include Georgia Power, Xcel Energy, Great River Energy, Dominion Energy, PG&E, New York Power Authority, and Crusoe Energy (a 12 GWh agreement to firm power for AI data centers). Form Energy does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is through utility sales, partnership, and policy channels.
f.name: Form Energy

f.description: Form3 is a United Kingdom-headquartered, cloud-native payments technology company offering account-to-account payment processing as a single, unified REST API to banks and fintechs. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, Form3 runs a fully managed, Payments-as-a-Service platform that connects customers to domestic and cross-border schemes - UK Faster Payments, Bacs and CHAPS, SEPA Credit Transfer, SEPA Instant and SEPA Direct Debit, and US instant rails - alongside Confirmation of Payee / Verification of Payee name-checking, direct debit mandate management, scheme-addressable account identification, event notifications (webhooks), and full audit trails. Its public API is REST built on the json:api specification, documented at api-docs.form3.tech with a downloadable Swagger 2.0 definition, and authenticated with OAuth2 client-credentials plus HTTP Message Signatures request signing and, in some environments, mutual TLS. Form3 is API-native and developer-facing but is a regulated B2B rail rather than an open self-serve signup product; production access is contracted.
f.name: Form3

f.description: Forma is a flexible employee benefits platform, founded in 2017, that lets companies design, customize, and scale employee spending accounts from a single system. Employers select from a suite of Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSA), Health Spending Accounts (HSA), Health Reimbursement Arrangements (HRA), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and employees access benefits through the Forma Store, the Forma Visa Card, or reimbursement claims. Forma connects to employer systems through 40+ HRIS and payroll integrations (Workday, ADP, UKG, Paylocity), SCIM provisioning, SAML2 SSO, and file feeds. Forma does not publish a public developer REST API; its technical surface is HRIS/SSO/SCIM integration and its trust posture (SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR). Backed by Emergence Capital, Ribbit Capital, and Uncork Capital.
f.name: Forma

f.description: Formality is a Paris-based AI platform for end-to-end asset and contract intelligence, aimed at businesses that need to centralize, understand, and track their legal, administrative, and asset-related documents. The product covers the full contract lifecycle: AI-assisted creation and collaborative negotiation, electronic signature, then post-signature data extraction, deadline and obligation alerts, and natural-language analysis of the resulting document estate. Its AI is trained on corporate legal documents, works across multiple languages, and runs inside a secure perimeter with full auditability and no use of customer data for model training. Formality integrates with tools including Google Drive, SharePoint, DocuWare, Docusign, Universign, Yousign, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outlook, Teams, Slack, and Gmail, and runs on compliant hosting with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications and GDPR compliance. It was founded in 2023 and is backed by Partech, Serena, and Bpifrance.
f.name: Formality

f.description: Formally is an AI-native platform for legal collaboration that begins with US immigration. It combines intelligent technology, behavioral science, and secure, portable client data to connect immigration attorneys and law firms, individual visa applicants, and employers sponsoring global hires in a single connected product. Attorneys manage cases at scale, individuals track applications and reduce anxiety while retaining ownership of their own data, and employers coordinate visa sponsorship. As of this enrichment pass Formally does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, developer portal, or documentation surface, so this profile captures company identity and published web properties only.
f.name: Formally

f.description: Formance builds open-source financial infrastructure for money movement. The platform pairs a programmable double-entry Ledger (with the Numscript DSL) with a unified Payments connectivity layer and Flows orchestration, plus Wallets, Reconciliation, Auth, and Webhooks. It is delivered as open-source components and as a managed multi-tenant Formance Cloud, exposing REST APIs secured with OAuth2 client-credentials Bearer tokens.
f.name: Formance

f.description: Formant is a San Francisco–based robotics and physical-operations cloud platform that lets companies operate fleets of robots and advanced connected devices. The Formant software platform implements workflows for remote monitoring, intervention requests, data management, teleoperation, tech-support investigations, and business analysis, and exposes an extensible cloud infrastructure that can be built upon to create custom robot management experiences. The product surface spans an on-robot Formant Agent (ingesting telemetry from ROS / ROS2 / non-ROS sources via configurable adapters), a REST Admin API at `api.formant.io/v1/admin`, a Python package (`pip install formant`) that bundles both a Cloud SDK (query and ingest data programmatically) and an Agent SDK (post telemetry, handle commands, drive teleoperation from robot-side Python), a Data SDK for JavaScript/TypeScript that powers custom views, modules, and embedded experiences, the `fctl` command-line tool for SSH / SCP / port-forwarding over Formant's peer-to-peer connection, and Formant Metaphysics — an AI-powered incident-management layer that automates alarm triage, predictive maintenance, and SOP-driven investigations across SCADA, Snowflake, Slack, and Teams. The API is organized around devices, fleets, streams, views, commands, events, annotations, intervention requests, files, key-value storage, roles, users, schedules, analytics, and presence/online monitoring. Formant's GitHub organization (FormantIO) publishes the ROS / ROS2 adapter, a Boston Dynamics Spot adapter, an ONVIF camera adapter, a P2P adapter, Cradlepoint adapter, the Toolkit meta-repo for building on Formant APIs, the 3D viewer module, custom module boilerplate, Data SDK examples for Node.js and React Native, a Homebrew tap for `fctl`, and a public JSON-schema repo for module configuration.
f.name: Formant

f.description: FormAssembly is an enterprise form and data collection platform with a REST API for managing forms, exporting submission data, handling Salesforce integrations, and building compliant data collection workflows. The API supports OAuth2 authentication and enables programmatic access to forms, responses, themes, connectors, and account components across cloud, enterprise, and government deployment environments.
f.name: FormAssembly

f.description: Formation Bio (formerly TrialSpark, founded 2016 in New York City) is a tech-driven, AI-native pharmaceutical company that aims to bring new treatments to patients faster and more efficiently. Rather than discovering drugs, Formation Bio in-licenses and acquires clinical-stage drug assets from pharma companies, universities, and biotech firms, then develops them using proprietary technology platforms, process automation, and large language models applied across the drug development lifecycle — patient recruitment, e-consent, data management, monitoring, and biostatistics. The company rebranded from TrialSpark to Formation Bio in 2023 as it moved from a pure clinical-trial software platform to combined platform-plus-asset ownership. It raised a $372M Series D in 2024 and announced a first-in-class AI collaboration with Sanofi and OpenAI. Formation Bio operates hybrid teams across New York City, Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, and North Carolina's Research Triangle. It is a private company with no public developer API program; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.
f.name: Formation Bio

f.description: Form-backend-as-a-service with a single unauthenticated HTTP POST submission endpoint for any frontend or static site. Submissions land in an inbox and searchable dashboard and can fan out to Google Sheets, email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, Zapier, n8n, and webhooks. No backend code, server, or database required.
f.name: Formboost

f.description: Formbricks is an open-source experience management and survey platform (a privacy-first Typeform / Qualtrics alternative). Its REST API lets you create and manage surveys, collect and query responses, manage contacts and their attributes, and wire up webhooks, with a Public Client API (no auth) for survey delivery and a Management API authenticated with an x-api-key header.
f.name: Formbricks

f.description: Formfeed offers a PDF and image generation API that lets developers render templates written in Jinja2, Liquid, or Handlebars into PDFs, PNGs, and other formats. It can also convert Word and PowerPoint files. The service runs in Frankfurt with EU‑only data residency and provides a free tier of 100 units per month. SDKs are available for TypeScript and Python, a CLI exists, and there is MCP integration for AI agents. Features include batch rendering, webhook notifications, versioned templates, and a visual editor for designing documents.
f.name: Formfeed

f.description: Formic is a Chicago, Illinois-based Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) company founded in 2020 by Saman Farid that delivers full-service industrial automation to American manufacturers on a pay-per-hour, fixed monthly subscription model with no capital expenditure. Formic specializes in end-of-line manufacturing operations — palletizing, case packing, and robotic pallet wrapping — and pairs deployed robots with a 24/7 remote monitoring, support, and field-service operation. The company's software stack includes Formic Core, an embedded operating system that abstracts motion, vision, sensing, and real-time coordination across heterogeneous industrial robot hardware (Fanuc, ABB, Kuka, Doosan) behind unified control interfaces; Formic Cortex; the Colony 2.0 fleet dashboard; FAST configuration tools; and Formic Production Intelligence (FPI), a manufacturer-facing analytics surface. Formic has raised more than $86M across rounds led by Lux Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and other investors, and works through a network of 100+ system-integrator partners with 500+ systems deployed. Formic's revenue model is the RaaS subscription itself; there is no public developer API, no published SDKs, and no public customer-portal API documentation. Formic Core's "unified APIs" are internal abstractions used by Formic engineers and integrator partners to drive robot hardware — they are not exposed to manufacturers or third-party developers.
f.name: Formic

f.description: Formlabs designs and manufactures desktop and industrial 3D printers (SLA and SLS), materials, and software (PreForm, Dashboard). Its developer platform exposes the Formlabs Web API (Dashboard Developer API) for remote monitoring and management of Internet-connected printers, prints, consumables, events, and printer groups, plus a Local API (PreFormServer) for local-network job preparation and printer control.
f.name: Formlabs

f.description: Formo (Formo Foods GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company producing animal-free dairy through precision fermentation and microbial fermentation of koji (Aspergillus oryzae). Instead of cows, Formo engineers microorganisms to make milk proteins such as casein, which it turns into real cheese and cream cheese products now sold across Germany and Austria. Founded by Raffael Wohlgensinger and backed by EQT Ventures, the company has received a US FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for its fermentation-derived casein. Formo is a consumer food producer and does not currently publish a public developer API.
f.name: Formo

f.description: Formspree is a form backend for static and Jamstack sites. Two API surfaces matter: (1) the public form-submission endpoint (formspree.io/f/{hashid}) that accepts POST submissions and returns JSON when the Accept header is set, and (2) the Forms API (formspree.io/api/0/...) for programmatic submission retrieval, export and form management. Plugins and the Formspree CLI extend the surface.
f.name: Formspree

f.description: Formstack is a no-code workplace productivity platform spanning online forms, document generation, electronic signature, and workflow automation. The developer portal at developers.formstack.com exposes a REST API (v2025.0) for forms, submissions, fields, webhooks, folders, and partial submissions, plus product-specific surfaces for Formstack Documents, Formstack Sign, and Formstack Workflows. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0. Machine-readable indexes and OpenAPI artifacts are surfaced at developers.formstack.com/llms.txt.
f.name: Formstack

f.description: Formula 1 (F1) is the premier international auto racing sport, governed by the FIA. It features a series of Grand Prix races across the globe, showcasing cutting‑edge automotive technology, elite drivers, and massive fan engagement. The sport’s official website provides news, race schedules, results, live timing, ticketing, merchandise, and a rich media experience for fans worldwide.
f.name: Formula 1

f.description: Forrst was a community for designers and developers to share work in progress and give and receive detailed feedback, founded in 2009 by Kyle Bragger with seed funding from 500 Startups (500 Global) and other angels. It was acquired by Colourlovers in 2012, then by product-design firm ZURB in January 2013, and was shut down on April 14, 2014. The company is defunct; forrst.com now redirects to zurb.com and there is no active API, developer portal, or public API surface to enrich. This profile is retained as a historical 500 Global portfolio lead.
f.name: Forrst

f.description: Forsta is the customer experience and market research technology company formed from the 2021 merger of Confirmit, FocusVision and Dapresy, and acquired by Press Ganey in 2022 to trade as PG Forsta. Its HX Platform spans survey data collection (Decipher / Forsta Surveys), panel and sample management, qualitative research, text and social analytics, and dashboard visualization for customer, employee and brand experience programs. Forsta publishes eight OpenAPI documents covering 345 operations at docs.developer.focusvision.com: the Decipher REST API for survey automation and data extraction, the Panel Management Integration, Community, webhook and vendor-callback contracts, and the Sample Marketplace partner contract that sample providers must implement to be listed.
f.name: Forsta

f.description: Fort is a Y Combinator (W26) hardware startup building a screenless wearable that automatically tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Founded by three former Tesla engineers, the device uses heart rate and motion sensing to detect gym sessions, workout classes, sleep, and recovery without requiring the wearer to manually log reps, sets, or exercises, then delivers actionable feedback on how lifestyle factors affect strength progress. Fort is styled as jewelry rather than performance gear, ships in three finishes with 7+ day battery life, and pairs with Fort Foundations, an expert-led training program built around core movement patterns. The product is currently available for pre-order and has no public developer API or programmatic surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and commercial presence.
f.name: Fort

f.description: Fort Robotics provides a trust layer for physical AI, delivering safety and remote control solutions for robotics and autonomous systems.
