Its first product, Instinct Edge, takes a model, a target device, and a latency budget and returns an offline runtime that hits the budget on-device with no cloud calls, handling model compression, custom kernel optimization (CUDA, Metal, ARM NEON), and the data-to-serving pipeline. It was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment searched the public web and found a marketing landing page but no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. This profile captures the company identity plus the security posture of its public web surface, and remains an identity-only lead pending a discoverable API.
g.name: General Instinct

g.description: The General Intelligence Company of New York builds Cofounder, an AI agent orchestration platform that lets a founder run an entire business through a coordinating network of specialized agents. Cofounder breaks a company into repeatable Flows and deploys agents across engineering, design, marketing, sales, finance, and support - handling product code, brand assets, outbound campaigns, incorporation, and customer service with human-approval checkpoints before significant actions execute. It provisions managed GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase, connects Stripe, Linear, Postmark, and Composio-powered MCP toolkits, and coordinates departments over shared company context. The company raised an $8.7M seed led by Union Square Ventures. Cofounder is a product workspace, not a public developer API - it consumes external APIs and MCP servers rather than publishing its own REST surface.
g.name: General Intelligence

g.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab building large action foundation models that can perceive, predict, and act across space and time in both virtual and physical environments. Spun out of the gaming clip platform Medal, the company trains its spatial-temporal reasoning models on billions of action-labeled gameplay clips - recordings of exactly which buttons a player pressed and when - to teach AI agents how to move through and reason about the world. Its Mira world model powers applications across games, simulation, and robotics. Founded in 2025 and based in New York City, General Intuition has raised $454M total, including a $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation, and is onboarding first partners to a commercial API ahead of a broader developer release.
g.name: General Intuition

g.description: General Legal is an AI-native law firm for high-growth startups and SMBs, offering flat-fee commercial, corporate, and employment legal work delivered by U.S.-barred attorneys augmented with proprietary AI workflows. The firm focuses on contract review, redlining, negotiation, and drafting with transparent flat pricing (from $250) and fast turnaround (median under three hours), positioning itself as "outside counsel that scales like software." Practice areas include technology transactions, employment, data privacy, financial regulatory, blockchain/cryptocurrency, and emerging companies / VC. Founded in 2026 by Ryan Walker (ex-Casetext CTO), J.P. Mohler, and Javed Qadruddin, the company is a Y Combinator (W26) portfolio company that raised $11.5M across pre-seed and seed rounds. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from public sources; General Legal is a legal-services company and does not currently publish a developer API.
g.name: General Legal

g.description: General Matter is a domestic nuclear-fuel company founded in 2024 and based in California, building United States uranium enrichment capacity to produce low-enriched uranium (LEU) and high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) for advanced commercial and government nuclear reactors. Co-founded by Scott Nolan and Lee Robinson and backed by Founders Fund, the company was awarded a $900M Department of Energy IDIQ contract and plans a $1.5B commercial enrichment facility at the former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Kentucky, plus a lease on the Hanford Fuels and Materials Examination Facility in Washington. Its mission is to reduce American reliance on foreign nuclear fuel and strengthen energy independence. General Matter is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, website properties, and domain-security posture.
g.name: General Matter

g.description: General Medicine is a consumer digital-health company building a healthcare storefront for the age of AI, making it delightfully simple to access the best care in the world. Founded by PillPack alumni Elliot Cohen and TJ Parker with CEO Ashwin Muralidharan, the company operates as part telehealth provider, part medical concierge, and part marketplace for browsing and booking medical care, prescriptions, and diagnostic lab testing across more than 35 specialties with board-certified clinicians, transparent pricing, and no waitlists. It is backed by roughly $32M led by Matrix Partners, with BoxGroup, Founder Collective, VXI Capital, and JSL Health Capital participating. General Medicine runs a consumer web storefront (generalmedicine.co) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.
g.name: General Medicine

g.description: General Mills is a leading global food company that manufactures and markets branded consumer foods including Cheerios, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Haagen- Dazs, Nature Valley, Old El Paso, and Progresso. General Mills operates in over 100 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API portal and primarily relies on EDI and direct supply chain integrations with retail partners.
g.name: General Mills

g.description: You can reach customers in their cars using GMs powerful, in-vehicle platform. Our tools can provide access to close to 200 data points, allowing you to monitor vehicle data in real-time to deliver the content that matters, when it matters. Create an account now to start developing amazing in-vehicle experiences for your customers.
g.name: General Motors

g.description: General Proximity is a biotechnology company pioneering next-generation "proximity medicines" that control biological processes by inducing proximity between molecular targets. Its multi-target OMNITAC platform is used to discover and advance novel therapeutics, including an oncology collaboration with Daiichi Sankyo. The company is backed by investors including Felicis and Y Combinator, and has drawn investment from Freemind and Daewoong Pharmaceutical. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; General Proximity is a drug-discovery company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time.
g.name: General Proximity

g.description: General Radar Corp. (GenRad) is a Belmont, California hardtech company founded in 2016 that designs and manufactures fully solid-state, high-resolution active electronically scanned array (AESA) phased-array radar systems built largely on commercial off-the-shelf hardware. Its products include the C-band GenRad GFC multi-mission AESA radar with a GaN front-end and digital beam-forming, and the Mark-IV 76-81GHz millimeter-wave 3D imaging radar producing LIDAR-like point clouds. The company serves aerospace and defense (U.S. Air Force, Navy, NORAD), counter-drone, airfield foreign-object-debris (FOD) detection, autonomy, wind energy, and weather markets, and has raised over $35M from investors including Kleiner Perkins and Octave Ventures. General Radar publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness.
g.name: General Radar

g.description: The General Services Administration (GSA) provides workplaces by constructing, managing, and preserving government buildings and by leasing and managing commercial real estate. GSA acquisition solutions offer private sector professional services, equipment, supplies, and IT to government organizations and the military. GSA also promotes management best practices and efficient government operations through the development of governmentwide policies, including a broad portfolio of public APIs.
g.name: General Services Administration

g.description: General Translation is an end-to-end internationalization (i18n) and localization platform for developers, backed by a16z. It combines open-source i18n libraries for React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and Python with an AI-powered translation API, a context platform (glossaries and translation instructions), and Locadex, an AI coding agent that internationalizes source code and opens pull requests. The public REST API (api2.gtx.dev, plus the runtime host runtime2.gtx.dev) uploads source files, queues and downloads translations, manages branches and tags, reads project and job status, and translates content at runtime. It is used by developer-first teams including Cursor, Windsurf, Ramp, Mintlify, and ClickHouse.
g.name: General Translation

g.description: General Astronautics (Generalastro) is a Y Combinator (W26) space-robotics company founded in 2025 by Bram Schork, based in San Francisco, building autonomous dexterous robotic arms that perform laboratory research and manufacturing tasks in microgravity without astronaut intervention. Its systems handle work like pipetting, sample prep, plate handling, and reagent mixing, targeting microgravity production of pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and fiber optics where crew time on orbital stations is the bottleneck (NASA estimates ISS crew time at ~$130K/hour). The company is pre-product hardware, backed by Y Combinator and Planet Ventures (~$7.1M raised), and currently exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or other machine-readable surface; this profile captures company identity only.
g.name: Generalastro

g.description: Generalist AI, Inc. is a frontier AI research and product-driven company building general intelligence for the physical world — training robots that work autonomously across factories, warehouses, laboratories, restaurants, farms, homes, and beyond. Its flagship model, GEN-1, is a general-purpose embodied foundation model trained from scratch that reaches mastery of simple physical tasks, going beyond world models and vision-language-action (VLA) approaches. Backed by Spark Capital, the company publishes its research through a blog and open-sources vision and robotics tooling on GitHub. Generalist AI exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.
g.name: Generalist AI

g.description: Generally Intelligent is the former name of Imbue, the San Francisco AI research lab founded in 2021 by Kanjun Qiu and Josh Albrecht to build agentic reasoning models and the tooling around them. The company rebranded to Imbue in 2023; its original domain generallyintelligent.com now redirects permanently to imbue.com, and every product, research release and open-source repository that began under the Generally Intelligent name (the Avalon RL benchmark, CARBS hyperparameter tuning, jupyter_ascending) is published today under the Imbue brand and the github.com/imbue-ai organization. Neither name has ever shipped a public, credentialed developer API: there is no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A agent card or llms.txt on any host the company controls, and integration happens through open-source repositories, model artifacts on Hugging Face and research releases. The living profile for this company is all/imbue.
g.name: Generally Intelligent

g.description: Generate Biomedicines is a Somerville, Massachusetts therapeutics company pioneering Generative Biology, a machine-learning-driven approach to de novo protein design across antibodies, peptides, enzymes, and gene therapies. Founded out of Flagship Pioneering and chaired by Noubar Afeyan, the company trains generative models on the full compendium of natural protein structures and sequences plus proprietary wet-lab data to design novel protein therapeutics computationally rather than by trial-and-error discovery. Its open-source flagship is Chroma, a programmable diffusion-based generative model for joint protein structure and sequence design published in Nature 2023 ("Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model", doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06728-8) and released on GitHub under Apache 2.0 with pretrained weights available under a custom Chroma Parameters License (free for academic and nonprofit use). Chroma uses equivariant graph neural networks, diffusion modeling, and conditional random fields to sample all-atom protein structures with sub-quadratic complexity, supporting conditional generation via composable Conditioner modules for symmetry, substructure, shape, and secondary-structure constraints. The internal Generate Platform iterates on a "generate, build, measure, learn" loop that pairs in-silico design with high-throughput protein synthesis and characterization; the company reports having generated, built, and tested more than 42,000 proteins. Generate Biomedicines has platform collaborations with Amgen (six programs, January 2022) and Novartis (multiple programs, September 2024) and a CAR T collaboration with Roswell Park. Its clinical pipeline is led by GB-0895, a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody for severe asthma now in Phase 3 (SOLAIRIA study) with a parallel Phase 1 in COPD, plus preclinical programs GB-4362 (anti-free-MMAE for ADC oncology safety) and GB-5267 (MUC16 armored CAR T for ovarian cancer). The company priced its initial public offering in February 2026. Revenue derives from drug development, partner collaborations, and (for Chroma) commercial weights licensing; there is no public developer REST/HTTPS API or SDK for the Generate Platform itself — Chroma is consumed as a Python library installed via pip with model weights downloaded from chroma-weights.generatebiomedicines.com after registering for an API key.
g.name: Generate Biomedicines

g.description: Generation Lab is a longevity science company founded in 2023 by Alina Su, UC Berkeley bioengineer Dr. Irina Conboy, and Michael Suswal, and backed by an $11M seed round led by Accel (Accel's first longevity bet). Its flagship SystemAge test measures biological age across roughly 460 biomarkers spanning 19 to 21 physiological systems and organs from an at-home, needle-free blood collection, returning a personalized aging report and science-backed action plan that ranges from lifestyle and supplement guidance to clinical interventions. The test is distributed through 300+ clinic partners across 18 countries and via a patient/provider portal. Generation Lab publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public web, product, and legal surfaces.
g.name: Generation Lab

g.description: Generative Engineering (Generative Vision Ltd) is a London-based deep-tech startup, founded in 2021, building a platform that generates, tests, and simulates thousands of engineering designs in parallel, in a fraction of the time traditional processes take. A code-first integration framework lets engineers plug in their existing tools alongside out-of-the-box integrations, spanning concept engineering, systems integration, and cost engineering. Parallel engineering aims to radically cut product development time for real-world products across energy, decarbonization, agriculture, and mobility. The company is backed by a pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures with participation from Join Capital. It publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.
g.name: Generative Engineering

g.description: Genesco is a specialty retailer and branded company selling footwear, apparel, and accessories through more than 1,400 retail stores and e-commerce sites under banners including Journeys, Schuh, Johnston & Murphy, and Genesco Brands. Genesco publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI document — it says so itself in the llms.txt it serves on journeys.com. What it does publish is an agent-access posture: an llms.txt for AI assistants, a Content-Signal AI-usage declaration in robots.txt on Journeys and Johnston & Murphy, a named allow list for AI search and user-requested agents, an llm= referral attribution convention, and server-rendered schema.org ProductGroup JSON-LD on every product page.
g.name: Genesco

g.description: Federal Statistical Office Germany
g.name: GENESIS

g.description: Genesis AI is a physical-AI company building a universal robotics foundation model and a full-stack platform for general-purpose robots. Founded in 2024 by Zhou Xian and Théophile Gervet, it emerged from stealth in July 2025 with $105M in seed funding from Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, HSG, Eric Schmidt, and Xavier Niel. Its stack spans the GENE vision-language-action foundation model (GENE-26.5), the Eno general-purpose robot, and Genesis World, a multi-physics simulation platform that generates synthetic training data and is developed in the open as the `genesis-world` Python package. The company is pre-product with customer deployments targeted for the end of 2026; its primary public developer surface today is the open-source Genesis simulation stack on PyPI, GitHub, and Read the Docs rather than a hosted web API.
g.name: Genesis AI

g.description: Genesis Digital Assets (GDA) is a global digital infrastructure company that designs, builds, and operates industrial-scale data centers for high-performance computing workloads, including Bitcoin networks and AI operations. GDA runs mining and computing facilities across multiple countries and does not sell products or services to the public. Surfaced as a portfolio company of electric-capital, paradigm, and ribbit-capital in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, portal, or SDK is published as of this pass.
g.name: Genesis Digital Assets

g.description: Genesis Energy, L.P. (NYSE: GEL) is a diversified midstream energy master limited partnership headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates offshore crude oil and natural gas pipelines and platforms in the Gulf of Mexico, onshore pipelines and terminals, marine transportation for refined products and crude, and a sulfur services and soda ash (alkali) chemicals business serving refineries, producers, and industrial and commercial customers. It is a pipeline and chemicals operator, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API and no machine-readable API contract. Its only public machine-readable surface is the FERC-mandated informational posting website it runs for its interstate natural gas pipeline, which serves NAESB WGQ-shaped location and capacity data as anonymous file downloads.
g.name: Genesis Energy

g.description: Genesis Healthcare is a Kennett Square, Pennsylvania based provider of skilled nursing, transitional care, rehabilitation, and assisted/senior living services, operating roughly 175 to 200 centers across 17 to 18 US states with about 27,000 employees serving more than 15,000 residents. Once one of the largest skilled nursing facility operators in the United States, Genesis Healthcare, Inc. filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on July 9, 2025 in the US Bankruptcy Court, citing pandemic aftereffects, inadequate Medicaid reimbursement, legacy liabilities from prior expansion, and roughly USD 8 million per month in litigation defense costs against more than 200 pending malpractice and wrongful death claims. At filing the company reported approximately USD 708 million in secured debt, more than USD 1.5 billion in unsecured debt, and at least USD 259 million owed to malpractice plaintiffs. After the bankruptcy court rejected an insider stalking horse bid from ReGen Healthcare / Pinta Capital Partners in December 2025, a roughly USD 1 billion sale to a NewGen Health backed buyer operating as "101 West State Street" was approved in January 2026, with the restructuring still in progress as of this profile. No public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, GitHub organization, or developer portal have been identified for Genesis Healthcare; the company is a healthcare operator, not an API provider, and its public web presence is limited to a corporate brochure site, careers portal, and compliance hotline.
g.name: Genesis Healthcare

g.description: Genesis MedTech is a global medical device company founded in Singapore in 2019, building and commercializing advanced clinical solutions across surgical, vascular intervention, and structural heart categories. It operates a vertically integrated platform that sources global medical technologies, develops them through in-house and partner R&D, manufactures at scale, and distributes across more than 30 countries. Its portfolio includes the J-Valve structural heart system, the iReach Omnia articulating powered surgical stapler, and neurovascular and peripheral vascular intervention product lines. Genesis MedTech is a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It publishes a corporate and product marketing presence only; no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.
g.name: Genesis Medtech

g.description: Genesis Therapeutics (Genesis Molecular AI) is an AI-focused biotechnology company building GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space), a generative and predictive AI operating system for small-molecule drug discovery. GEMS combines structure-based deep learning, language and diffusion models, and physics-based simulation (molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry) to generate and optimize molecules for complex targets, accelerating hit identification through lead optimization and candidate selection. In 2025 the company introduced Pearl, a next-generation foundation model for drug discovery. Headquartered in Burlingame, California with a laboratory in San Diego, Genesis has raised over $300M and partners with Eli Lilly, Gilead, Genentech, and Incyte while advancing its own therapeutic pipeline. It is not a public API provider: GEMS is a proprietary internal platform with no published developer portal, documentation, or API.
g.name: Genesis Therapeutics

g.description: Genesys is a global cloud customer experience (CX) and contact center software company whose flagship Genesys Cloud CX platform powers omnichannel customer engagement, routing, workforce management, and AI-driven orchestration. The Genesys Cloud Platform API is a large REST API of more than 3,000 public operations spanning conversations, routing, analytics, telephony (edge), workforce management, knowledge, journey, outbound, quality, gamification, integrations, and administration. It is secured with OAuth 2, described by a public OpenAPI (Swagger 2.0) definition, and supported by official SDKs for Java, .NET, Python, Go, JavaScript/Node, and iOS/Swift, a command-line interface, a notifications/websocket event surface, and a weekly changelog.
g.name: Genesys

g.description: Geneva is an all-in-one communication app for groups, clubs, and communities — "the online place to find your offline people." It bundles full-featured group chat (threaded replies, reactions, GIFs, attachments, polls, pins), audio/video rooms and livestreaming for hundreds of viewers, event planning, and wallet-connect with token-gated rooms for tokenized communities. Geneva ships as free iOS, Android, and web apps and was acquired by Bumble Inc. This API Evangelist profile entered the network as a VC-portfolio-sourced stub; the company publishes a consumer app with no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.
g.name: Geneva

g.description: Gengo is a people-powered translation platform that delivers fast, affordable, high-quality human translation in every major language through a global network of thousands of certified translators. The Gengo API (v2) lets developers order translation programmatically: submit text or file jobs, group them into orders, run cost quotes, look up supported language pairs and tiers, manage glossaries, retrieve completed translations and revisions, exchange comments with translators, and receive job-status updates through per-job callback URLs. Authentication uses a public API key plus an HMAC-SHA1 request signature, with a full sandbox for testing. Gengo was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Point Nine and enriched into the API Evangelist network.
g.name: Gengo

g.description: GenHealth.ai builds generative AI for healthcare operations, powered by a Large Medical Model (LMM) trained on sequences of medical events. Its products automate the administrative back office for providers, health plans, and DME suppliers: fax intake routing, prior authorization and medical-necessity review (UMPA), and revenue cycle management. The developer platform exposes an Inference API that generates simulated patient futures from demographic, ICD diagnosis, CPT/HCPCS procedure, and NDC medication codes, an Embeddings API for semantic search over medical sequences, and a UM/PA API that uploads, extracts, and adjudicates prior-authorization PDFs. GenHealth integrates with any FHIR server implementing the HL7 Da Vinci prior-authorization guides (CRD, DTR, PAS). The platform is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant with a public trust center and status page.
g.name: GenHealth.ai

g.description: Genial Care is a Brazilian healthtech network providing multidisciplinary, evidence-based care for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and atypical development up to roughly eight years of age. Founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, it operates a network of clinics ("Casas Geniais") across Greater Sao Paulo delivering ABA (applied behavior analysis), speech-language therapy, and occupational therapy, alongside family assessments, in-person and online consultations, educational content, and a professional training academy. Care is coordinated through a proprietary mobile app that supports continuous monitoring and family engagement. The company partners with major Brazilian health plans (operadoras), which account for the majority of its revenue, and is backed by General Catalyst. Genial Care operates as a consumer/clinical care provider and does not publish a public developer API surface.
g.name: Genial Care

g.description: Genialis is a precision oncology company that builds AI models of cancer biology to find and validate biomarkers for drug developers. Its commercial platform, Genialis Expressions, is a multiomics and clinical data infrastructure for RNA-seq and related assays, and its Genialis Supermodel is a foundation model of cancer biology used for response prediction (krasID, adcID, DDR). The Expressions platform exposes a public Django REST Framework API at app.genialis.com covering data objects, samples, collections, processes, annotations, predictions and variants, published as a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 document, and is consumed programmatically through the open-source ReSDK Python client. Genialis also maintains the open-source Resolwe dataflow engine and Resolwe Bioinformatics pipelines that the platform is built on. Founded in Slovenia with offices in Boston, Houston and Ljubljana.
g.name: Genialis

g.description: Genie is an open source, full-stack web framework for the Julia programming language, developed by the Barcelona-based company Genie (backed by Speedinvest) to let data scientists and R&D engineers turn Julia models, simulations, and analyses into production-ready, data-centric web apps, APIs, and interactive dashboards. The framework has three core components: Genie.jl for backend routing and REST APIs, Stipple.jl for low-code reactive UIs, and SearchLight.jl as the database ORM, plus first-party authentication and authorization plugins and Genie Builder, a VS Code extension with a drag-and-drop UI builder and AI assistant. It is used to build data exploration dashboards, financial data products, ML/AI and simulation apps, bioinformatics tools, and internal tooling. Distributed as MIT-licensed Julia packages via the Julia General registry.
g.name: Genie

g.description: Genie AI is a legal-AI platform that helps business and legal teams draft, review, edit, and negotiate contracts autonomously. Founded in 2017 by founders trained by Google DeepMind, Genie is built on a patent-pending architecture called Eidetic Intelligence that gives its agents effectively unlimited memory across documents, negotiations, and organizational knowledge to reduce hallucination. The product ships autonomous contract drafting and review, multi-document deal management, risk analysis against organizational playbooks, tracked-changes negotiation, template automation, and one of the world's largest open legal libraries (500+ customizable templates and thousands of clauses across 150+ jurisdictions). Genie exposes an API and MCP connectors plus native integrations with email, CRM, cloud storage, and eSign on its Enterprise tier. The company is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certified, does not train on customer data, and raised a Series A led by GV (Google Ventures) with Khosla Ventures.
g.name: Genie AI

g.description: Genie-us Software, Inc. sells CoreOS v1.0, a governance-first set of custom skills, operating instructions and boundaries installed into the AI environment a person already uses (ChatGPT as a Markdown install package, Claude Code as a skills ZIP) — no hosted runtime, one $499 one-time license per person, with DiscoveryPass as the free seven-day evaluation. Rather than an API, the company publishes a small machine-readable commercial discovery surface for agents: an A2A agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json (discovery-only — no A2A endpoint is deployed), a commerce manifest, and static JSON documents for products, capabilities, evidence, health and a JSON Schema qualification request.
g.name: Genie-us Software

g.description: Geniebook is a Singapore-based educational technology company (Geniebook Pte Ltd, incorporated 2016) offering an AI-powered online learning platform for primary, secondary, and JC students. Its product suite includes GenieSmart (AI-personalised worksheets generated from a library of 300,000+ MOE syllabus-aligned questions, using algorithms co-developed with A*STAR), GenieClass (live and recorded online classes taught by experienced teachers), and GenieAsk (real-time moderated teacher chats for after-school academic support), plus a CAMPUS physical-tutoring offering and PSLE/JC preparation programmes. Geniebook serves more than 220,000 students across Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. It is a consumer (B2C) learning application delivered via web and mobile apps; no public developer API is published.
g.name: Geniebook

g.description: Geniemode (Geniemode Global Pvt Ltd) is a Gurugram, India based B2B cross-border sourcing and supply-chain technology company founded in 2021 by Amit Sharma and Tanuj Gangwani. It runs an asset-light sourcing platform that connects global retail buyers in home textiles, furniture, apparel and accessories with a vetted manufacturer network, covering product discovery and design collaboration, sampling, quality control, factory and raw-material management, logistics, customs and invoicing. Its technology surface is an internal operations and partner portal at portal.geniemode.com, built on Spring Boot, whose Springfox-generated Swagger 2.0 contract is served publicly while every operation itself sits behind authentication. Geniemode publishes no developer program, SDKs, pricing or public API documentation.
g.name: Geniemode

g.description: Genies is an AI avatar and digital-identity company that powers the visual and embodiment layer for AI. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in West Hollywood / Venice, California, Genies builds high-fidelity, fully customizable 3D avatars and "Smart Avatars" — LLM- and behavior-driven digital characters that can act, react, converse, and persist across games, apps, and XR experiences. For developers, Genies ships a Unity-based Avatar SDK (C#) with avatar loading, a customization API for wearables/hair/makeup/tattoos, and asset pre-caching, supporting iOS, Android, Windows Standalone, and VR. Developers register a project in the Genies Developer Hub to obtain API keys used by the SDK. Backed by Bond Capital, Multicoin Capital, and Trinity Ventures.
g.name: Genies

g.description: Crowdsourced music knowledge — the Genius/Rap Genius platform. The Genius API exposes structured metadata for songs, artists, albums, annotations, referents, and contributors. Raw lyric text is not served by the API; consumers receive the public song page URL and scrape lyrics from there.
g.name: Genius

g.description: Genius Sports provides APIs to query information regarding matches, players, statistics etc. both past and future across multiple sports including basketball, football (soccer), volleyball, American football, and ice hockey.
g.name: Genius Sports

g.description: Genki Forest (元气森林), which trades internationally as Chi Forest, is a Chinese beverage company founded in Beijing in 2016 by Tang Binsen. It makes sugar-free sparkling water, brewed and iced teas, milk tea, and electrolyte and vitamin drinks under the 元气森林, 外星人 (Alienergy), 好自在 and Chi Forest brands, produced in its own plants in Chuzhou, Tianjin, Zhaoqing, Dujiangyan, Xianning, Taicang and Jiangsu. Its products are distributed across more than 30 Chinese provinces, cities and autonomous regions and exported to more than 40 countries. It is not a software vendor and runs no public developer program; its only public machine-readable API surface is a partner-facing open platform at open.yuanqisenlin.com that serves a Swagger 2.0 document for a distributor and receivables management service, and a first-party llms.txt published for AI crawlers on its corporate site.
g.name: Genki Forest

g.description: GenLogs is a truck intelligence platform that provides ground-truth data on every motor carrier in America from a nationwide network of proprietary roadside sensors, satellites, and millions of data sources - 4.2 billion commercial-vehicle images with 16 million added daily, covering 97% of active motor carriers. The GenLogs API (https://api.genlogs.io) turns that sensor network into freight intelligence: source and score carriers by lane, verify a carrier was recently sighted along an origin/destination, pull carrier and FMCSA profiles, run carrier-vetting rules, discover shippers by lane and shipper facilities with GeoJSON network maps, manage onboarded-carrier contacts, track mismatch observations, and receive HMAC-SHA512-signed alert webhooks. It serves brokers and shippers, insurance underwriting and claims, law enforcement asset recovery, and carriers. Auth uses an x-api-key plus a short-lived Access-Token, with named per-endpoint permissions.
g.name: GenLogs

g.description: GenM (now operating as Acadium) is a digital marketing career and apprenticeship platform that connects emerging marketers with mentors and businesses. The platform offers free digital marketing courses (SEO, social media, email, and content marketing), hands-on MicroTasks for portfolio building, three-month remote apprenticeships, and Acadium Plus, an eight-week program that leads to full-time hiring. Businesses use Acadium to crowdsource marketing work and mentor emerging talent while growing their operations. GenM was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company operates a consumer/business web application at app.acadium.com and publishes no public developer API surface.
g.name: GenM

g.description: Genmo is a San Francisco research lab building open-source video generation models. Its flagship release, Mochi 1, is an Apache-2.0 licensed 10B-parameter text-to-video diffusion model (AsymmDiT architecture) with strong prompt adherence and high-fidelity motion. Genmo does NOT publish a first-party hosted developer REST API. Programmatic access to Mochi comes in three honest forms: (1) the open-source model itself, self-hosted via the repo's Python pipeline ("simple composable API"), CLI, Gradio UI, or ComfyUI; (2) third-party hosted inference APIs from partners such as Replicate and fal.ai; and (3) a credit-based consumer web app and Playground at genmo.ai/play. The endpoints documented here for hosted access are modeled from partner documentation and are not operated by Genmo.
g.name: Genmo

g.description: Genoa Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN (~163 datasets).

g.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.
g.name: Genomatica

g.description: Genome, operated by UAB "Maneuver LT" of Vilnius, is an Electronic Money Institution licensed and supervised by the Bank of Lithuania. It runs multi-currency personal and business accounts, issues Visa cards, and sells a merchant payments stack that is documented as six public API surfaces: the Host-to-Host API for direct card processing (AUTH, AUTH3D, SALE, SALE3D, SETTLE, REFUND, VOID and CHECK), the Payout API for sending funds to cardholders, the SEPA Payout API, the Query on Demand reporting API, a Verification of Payee API returning the EPC scheme's match outcomes, and a Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 dedicated interface offered free of charge to registered AISPs and PISPs. Batch transfers are submitted as ISO 20022 pain.001.001.03. Outcomes are carried in a proprietary 137-code response envelope rather than HTTP status codes, and Genome publishes no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, MCP server or /.well-known/ document on any of its hosts.
g.name: Genome

g.description: Genome Medical is a telehealth-enabled genetic services provider offering expert genetic counseling, test selection and ordering support, results interpretation, and clinical trial matching for individuals with rare and hereditary conditions. It partners with health systems, life sciences organizations, and genetic testing labs to scale genetic care, reduce diagnostic backlogs, and accelerate diagnoses through a proprietary clinical platform and patient portal. Genome Medical does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.
g.name: Genome Medical

g.description: Genomic Health, Inc. was a Redwood City, California molecular diagnostics company founded in 2000 and known for its Oncotype DX suite of genomic tests, which analyze tumor gene-expression to guide treatment decisions in breast, colon, and prostate cancer. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, it went public in 2005 and was acquired by Exact Sciences in November 2019. It no longer operates as an independent company: the genomichealth.com domain now 301-redirects to exactsciences.com, and there is no independent Genomic Health developer portal, public API, or documentation surface. This record is retained as a VC-portfolio lead; no live API artifacts could be enriched.
g.name: Genomic Health

g.description: Genomics Medicine Ireland (GMI) is a Dublin-based life-sciences company founded in 2015 to build a large-scale Irish genomic and clinical research programme, sequencing volunteer participant DNA and pairing it with longitudinal phenotypic data to study the genetic basis of common and rare diseases such as Alzheimer's, heart failure, inflammatory bowel disease and multiple sclerosis. GMI was absorbed into WuXi NextCODE and subsequently rebranded as Genuity Science (genuitysci.com), a precision-medicine business offering disease-enriched genomic cohorts, whole-genome and next-generation sequencing through a clinically accredited lab, and population-scale data-analysis services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners for target discovery and biomarker identification. As a genomics research and data-services organization it exposes no public developer API, portal, SDKs or OpenAPI; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead and carries only the artifacts that can be honestly derived or probed for it.
g.name: Genomics Medicine Ireland

g.description: Genomind is a US precision-medicine company in mental health, built around the Genomind Professional PGx pharmacogenetic test — a 26-gene panel (15 pharmacodynamic, 11 pharmacokinetic) used by clinicians to assess gene-drug and drug-drug interaction risk across more than 700 medications. Alongside the CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited laboratory it operates a Precision Medicine Software product, a provider portal, a patient gateway and a partner portal, and it has built lab orders-and-results interfaces into EMR/EHR systems including Epic, athenahealth, NextGen Healthcare, DrChrono, Practice Fusion, iSalus and MedEnt. Genomind publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; its integration surface is a contracted HL7 v2 lab interface arranged per health system. In July 2026 Vanta Diagnostics acquired key Genomind assets, including the genetics lab, clinical operations and the direct-to-provider business, and the provider portal now carries Vanta Diagnostics branding.
g.name: Genomind

g.description: Genopets is a free-to-play, move-to-earn NFT game built on the Solana blockchain that gamifies an active lifestyle. Players nurture a digital pet — a Genopet — that evolves from real-world physical activity tracked via step counting, then battle, craft, stake, and trade in-game NFTs and Habitats. The economy pairs the GENE governance token with the in-game KI utility token earned by moving. Genopets is developed by a studio backed by Pantera Capital and operates a consumer mobile/web game rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

g.description: GenScript ProBio (ProBio) is the biologics and cell & gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) segment of GenScript Biotech Corporation (HKEX 1548), operating from sites in the United States, the Netherlands, South Korea, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Nanjing and Zhenjiang. It provides end-to-end drug-discovery-to-commercialization services covering antibody and ADC discovery, antibody engineering and humanization, developability assessment, cell line development, bioanalytical and bioassay services, process development, and cGMP clinical and commercial manufacturing of recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, lentiviral and AAV viral vectors, mRNA and cell therapies, having supported more than 150 IND approvals since 2017. ProBio is a laboratory and manufacturing services business rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract, and customer engagement runs through a quote request form and an authenticated customer account area.

g.description: Genspark is an all-in-one AI workspace and autonomous "Super Agent" platform that plans and executes multi-step tasks on a user's behalf. It bundles a suite of AI agent tools — deep research, AI slides, AI sheets, AI docs, AI chat, a "Call For Me" voice agent, and a built-in AI browser — into a single natural-language workspace, alongside companion products such as Genspark Claw, Speakly, GenClipboard, and GenTerminal and native iOS and Android apps. For developers and agents, Genspark operates a hosted, remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at /api/mcp that exposes its tools, resources, and prompts over HTTP, gated by OAuth 2.1 (authorization_code with PKCE, refresh tokens, and dynamic client registration). Genspark is backed by Emergence Capital.

g.description: Gensyn is a decentralized infrastructure company building "the network for machine intelligence" — protocols that let AI systems train, verify, and transact in market-driven ecosystems. Its stack includes AXL (peer-to-peer networking for ML nodes, with built-in MCP/A2A support), CHAIN (on-chain identity, reputation, and stake), and REE (the Reproducible Execution Environment for cryptographically verifiable ML compute). Its flagship application, Delphi, is a live on-chain information (prediction) market where humans and AI agents trade predictions with on-chain settlement. Gensyn publishes a TypeScript Delphi SDK and an agent-skills package so autonomous agents can discover markets, quote, trade, and redeem positions programmatically. Backed by a16z.
g.name: Gensyn

g.description: Gentem is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) technology company that helps medical practices automate insurance billing and get paid faster. Its platform streamlines eligibility verification, claims submission, denial and payment management, and patient billing for independent and specialty providers, with the goal of reducing administrative burden and accelerating provider cash flow. Gentem was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; its public developer surface is not currently reachable for artifact harvesting (the primary domain is protected behind a bot challenge and no developer, docs, or API subdomains resolve), so this profile carries verified domain-security probe data plus company identity.

g.description: Gentle Monster is a South Korean luxury eyewear brand founded in 2011 and operated by parent company IICOMBINED, headquartered in Seoul. Its sister brands include Tamburins (fragrance and body care) and Nudake (conceptual dessert and patisserie). Gentle Monster sells globally through flagship stores, department-store concessions, and its direct-to-consumer site at gentlemonster.com. g.description: Gentrace was a developer platform for evaluating and testing LLM and AI applications ("evals as infrastructure"). It provided pipelines, datasets, experiments, and test cases so teams could run offline and online evaluations, grade model outputs, track regressions, and observe AI features in production via OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation. The platform shipped a REST API (v4) secured with bearer API keys, first-party Python and TypeScript/Node SDKs, and a documented object model of pipelines, datasets, experiments, and test cases. Gentrace was based in San Francisco and backed by Matrix Partners. The company has since shut down its hosted product, but its OpenAPI specification, SDK packages, and documentation mirror remain publicly available.

Its product suite spans GeoComply Core (location-based fraud detection and geolocation compliance), IDComply (KYC and AML identity verification), GeoGuard (VPN and proxy/spoofing detection), PinPoint (on-property geofencing), the Chargeback Integrator (GCI), and the OneComply licensing-management platform, serving the iGaming, financial services, media/entertainment, and cryptocurrency industries. Through its Portal router, isolated storage, dual governance, staking derivatives (gETH / gAVAX), an operator marketplace, withdrawal contracts, bound liquidity pools, and the Telescope oracle system, entities can launch their own liquid staking derivatives, isolate risk profiles, run KYC/AML-segregated pools, and earn sustainable maintenance-fee revenue. Developers integrate via the geodefi Python SDK and geo-vue UI components.

g.description: GEODNET (Global Earth Observation Decentralized Network) is a Web3/DePIN blockchain-based RTK (Real-Time Kinematics) GNSS correction network. It incentivizes operators to deploy permanent GNSS reference stations ("Satellite Miners") that broadcast real-time correction data, letting nearby devices achieve centimeter-level positioning accuracy. Station operators earn GEOD token rewards, with a target of 100,000 evenly distributed base stations worldwide — roughly twenty times larger than existing CORS networks. The correction data fuels robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, precision agriculture, construction, surveying, and consumer mapping. Developer-facing surfaces are the GEODNET Console web platform, the RTK coverage service, and DAO governance; the GEOD token spans Polygon and Solana. This profile was seeded as a Multicoin Capital portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

g.description: Geogrid Co., Ltd. is a South Korean smart-building water technology company behind BLOS ("Building Oasis"), an integrated building-level water purification and monitoring system. BLOS delivers drinkable water from every tap using chemical-free ionization to eliminate rust, scale, and biofilm, and pairs it with real-time monitoring of water quality, usage, carbon emissions, and consumption plus predictive analytics for pipe condition, contamination risk, and filter replacement. Geogrid targets schools, hotels and resorts, public institutions, and healthcare facilities, and offers a BLOS Care membership service. The company is based at Seoul Startup Hub Seongsu, holds 21 registered patents, and has been recognized with venture certification, ESG awards, and selection as a Korean representative for WSA 2026. g.description: GeoInsight GmbH is a German geospatial-AI company running a Data-as-a-Service platform built on a Discrete Global Grid System (DGGS). It converts Earth-observation and vector data into AI-ready hierarchical hexagonal "Spatial Tokens" so that models can reason about geography the way language models reason about text. The platform is exposed through a standards-compliant OGC API - DGGS endpoint that answers zone-based queries across multiple DGGRS (H3, ISEA3H, IGEO7, IVEA3H), serving Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery from the Copernicus and USGS archives, RADARSAT Constellation backscatter, Overture administrative boundaries, AIS vessel positions, building footprints and elevation models. Queries return GeoJSON, DGGS-JSON, GeoParquet or HTML, with CQL2 filtering, COG raster statistics and STAC search strategies. Target markets are OSINT and maritime intelligence, climate and environment, agriculture and food security, infrastructure and urban planning, disaster response, and finance and risk. The company is an NVIDIA Inception member and participates in the OGC AI-DGGS pilot programme.
g.name: GeoInsight

Marquee offerings include UseSights (Physical AI for product usage), VoiceSights (AI-moderated conversations), and the moment-based XMOT feedback method, spanning opportunity identification, concept optimization, product development, pre-launch validation, market launch, and acceleration. Geordie raised a $30M Series A and is used by enterprises including Xapo Bank, Fitch Group, Synthesia, AlphaSense, Owkin, OakNorth, and A+E Global Media. g.description: Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) is a public technological research university in Atlanta, Georgia, United States. Its programmable footprint is real but small, decentralized, and operated by individual units rather than by any central API program: there is no developer portal, no self-service key issuance, and no published OpenAPI anywhere on a gatech.edu host that Georgia Tech itself indexes. What does exist, and what was verified live on 2026-09-01, is four institution-operated machine surfaces — an OAI-PMH 2.0 provider and a DSpace 7.6 REST API on repository.gatech.edu (the Georgia Tech Digital Repository), a Shibboleth SAML 2.0 identity provider registered in InCommon and scoped gatech.edu, and a CourseLeaf course-data endpoint on catalog.gatech.edu — plus two contracts Georgia Tech units publish as documents: the SUMS (Shared User Management System) Swagger on sums.gatech.edu and the RNOC GT Places API Swagger on rnoc.gatech.edu. Georgia Tech is a DataCite direct member (symbol GT, prefix 10.35090) and is registered in ROR as 01zkghx44. Two things the profile has to say plainly: GT Places is documented as "open to all" but its declared host now answers with a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in redirect, and the enterprise integration API BuzzAPI (api.gatech.edu) lost its public documentation when webmasters.gatech.edu was rebuilt in 2026, so it is a credentialed surface with nothing public left to read.
