Hexcel is a critical materials supplier to Boeing and Airbus and supports more than 100 defense programs; it has no public developer portal, REST APIs, SDKs, or machine-readable product catalog. Customer interaction with technical resources is PDF-based (datasheets, technology manuals, brochures), and the company's GitHub organization (github.com/Hexcel) is registered but empty.
h.name: Hexcel

h.description: Hexing Electrical Co., Ltd. (海兴电力 / Hexing) is a Chinese energy-technology company focused on smart power distribution and utilization, new energy, smart water and gas, water treatment and clean water, and marine electrification. Beyond hardware, Hexing delivers integrated solutions and project delivery spanning metering devices, communication networks (RF, PLC, cellular, NB-IoT), MDC / MDM / AMI platforms, billing systems, distribution automation, energy storage (BESS), EV charging, water metering, seawater desalination and electric marine propulsion. The company reports 34 years of industry experience, operations across 110+ countries and 17 global manufacturing hubs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and profiled in the API Evangelist network; Hexing publishes no public developer/API surface today, so this profile captures corporate identity plus the AI knowledge file (llms.txt) the company publishes for AI search / RAG.
h.name: Hexing Electrical

h.description: Hexion is a global leader in thermosetting resins, providing a broad range of adhesive, structural, and specialty resins to a wide variety of industries including coatings, construction, electronics, and automotive. Their purpose is to activate science to change our world.
h.name: Hexion

h.description: heycater! is a B2B catering marketplace that connects companies with vetted catering partners across Germany and the United Kingdom, letting businesses request, compare, and book corporate food services through a single platform. Its service lines span heykantine! (daily office meals for teams of 50+), Meetings & Catering (event catering from 10 people drawing on 700+ vetted caterers), hey! Events (full-service event planning for ~100+ guests), and a Pantry Service for office beverages and snacks. The platform serves 2,500+ companies, including Spotify, Airbnb, Meta, and Salesforce, and has fulfilled more than 250,000 catering orders, returning comparable quotes within 48 hours at no cost. heycater! does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.
h.name: Hey

h.description: Hey API builds open-source OpenAPI code generators and a hosted specification registry. @hey-api/openapi-ts turns an OpenAPI document into production-grade TypeScript — SDKs, types, Zod/Valibot/TypeBox validators, TanStack Query and SWR hooks, MSW and Playwright test doubles, and Fastify/NestJS/Hono/Express server handlers — across more than twenty plugins and eight HTTP client runtimes, with a sibling Python generator emitting Pydantic models. It draws over four million npm downloads a week and is used by Vercel, PayPal, AWS, Autodesk and OpenCode. The Hey API Platform (api.heyapi.dev) adds a build-attested registry: CI uploads each OpenAPI document with its repository, branch, commit and workflow provenance, and consumers resolve it back by branch, tag, version or exact commit for reproducible client generation.
h.name: Hey API

h.description: Heyclicky (product name Clicky) is a consumer macOS application from the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch that puts an AI assistant right next to your cursor. In Talk Mode a hotkey lets you ask about whatever is on screen and get spoken, on-screen guidance; in Agent Mode you can command autonomous agents to build, research, or perform tasks in the background, and it can connect to services like Notion, Gmail, and Calendar. The app is screen-aware, works across any application with no plugins, and ships as a notarized macOS binary distributed via a Sparkle appcast on GitHub. Heyclicky is a consumer desktop product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.
h.name: Heyclicky

h.description: Heyday is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of general-catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: Heyday

h.description: HeyForm is an open-source conversational form builder that enables anyone to create engaging forms, surveys, quizzes, and polls without coding. It provides a REST API and webhook integrations for creating and managing forms, collecting responses, configuring conditional logic, and embedding forms in any web application. With 30+ integrations including Zapier, Slack, Google Sheets, Airtable, HubSpot, and Stripe, HeyForm suits small businesses and developers who want full data ownership. Licensed under AGPL-3.0, it can be self-hosted or used via the managed cloud service.
h.name: HeyForm

h.description: HeyGen is an AI video generation platform that creates studio-quality avatar videos, voice clones, and translated video content from simple text prompts. The product line includes Avatar V (digital twins), Photo Avatar, Avatar IV, the Starfish text-to-speech engine, the Video Agent API, Video Translation, and Lipsync. HeyGen serves sales, marketing, e-learning, and localization teams with both self-serve pay-as-you-go API access (starting at a $5 minimum) and enterprise contracts. The company is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant and has powered 50M+ generated videos.
h.name: HeyGen

h.description: Heygo (formerly GoGuides) was a London-based consumer platform for live, interactive virtual tours, where local guides livestreamed real-time walking tours of destinations around the world to remote audiences on a tip-based model. It was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Point Nine. As of this enrichment pass the public site origin is unreachable (HTTP 522 behind Cloudflare) with no mail (MX/SPF/DMARC) records, indicating the service is no longer operating; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or other machine-readable API surface could be located.
h.name: Heygo

h.description: HeyMilo AI is an agentic recruiting platform for high-volume hiring teams — staffing agencies, corporate recruiters, BPOs, franchises, and data-annotation operations. It combines candidate sourcing from your ATS, conversational SMS and smart-form pre-screening, resume analysis, and live AI voice and video interviews (with built-in cheat detection), then scores and ranks candidates with analytics, reporting, and fully white-labeled workflows. The HeyMilo Public API (v2.0.0, base https://api.heymilo.ai) exposes programmatic control over interviewers (postings), candidate ingestion, interview data and transcripts, questions, webhooks, templates, voices, phone numbers, domains, and ATS push/resolve — authenticated with an X-API-KEY header and rate limited to 300 requests per minute. A read-only hosted MCP server at https://mcp.heymilo.ai/mcp lets any MCP client query candidates, jobs, and interviews in natural language. HeyMilo raised $6M to scale agentic recruiting and is backed by Canaan Partners.
h.name: HeyMilo

h.description: Heyo is a social marketing platform for building and running online promotions such as sweepstakes, contests, giveaways, quizzes, and coupons. Businesses use Heyo's drag-and-drop campaign builder and landing pages to create interactive campaign apps that publish to the web, mobile, and social networks including Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. It is used to grow email marketing lists, generate sales leads, acquire new customers, reward existing customers, and increase social followers, with templated promotion apps and a free trial. Heyo is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was acquired by Votigo, Inc. in January 2016, continuing to operate as a stand-alone self-serve brand. Heyo publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal; the product is used entirely through the web dashboard at platform.heyo.com.
h.name: Heyo

h.description: Heytea is a Chinese premium modern tea-beverage chain founded in 2012 in Jiangmen, Guangdong. It pioneered cheese-topped tea and fresh-fruit "new-style tea" and has grown to thousands of stores across mainland China and international markets including Singapore, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and the United States. Backed by investors including Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and IDG Capital, Heytea runs its own mobile ordering app and retail loyalty program. As a consumer food-and-beverage retailer it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; this profile is retained in the network as a company identity lead.
h.name: Heytea

h.description: Heyzap was a mobile-game advertising, discovery, and monetization company. It began as a social game-discovery network and pivoted into a mobile ad mediation platform, offering iOS, Android, Unity, Cordova, and Adobe AIR/ANE SDKs that let game developers serve and mediate ads across networks such as AdMob, AppLovin, Vungle, Chartboost, AdColony, and Facebook Audience Network. Heyzap was acquired by Fyber (RNTS Media) in 2016 and its brand was later folded into Digital Turbine. Heyzap never published a public REST API; its developer surface was the mobile ad-mediation SDKs distributed via GitHub (github.com/Heyzap) and package registries. The heyzap.com domain is now parked/for-sale and the developer documentation site no longer resolves; this profile preserves the historical, first-party SDK artifacts that remain publicly available. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.
h.name: Heyzap

h.description: HF Sinclair is an independent energy company that produces and markets gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, specialty lubricant products, and renewable diesel fuel through refineries and a brand network of branded fuel stations.
h.name: HF Sinclair

h.description: Provides weather forecast data for cities in Brazil
h.name: HG Weather

h.description: Homecare management platform with a REST API for scheduling aide visits, verifying care delivery via telephony and mobile, managing authorizations, and processing Medicaid billing. Provides EVV (Electronic Visit Verification) APIs for third-party integration with state Medicaid systems.
h.name: HHAeXchange

h.description: hhgregg is an electronics retailer offering products such as televisions, cameras, professional video equipment, laptops, headphones, drones, and more, with free shipping and installation services on many products.
h.name: hhgregg

h.description: The US Department of Health and Human Services provides data APIs for health programs, public health datasets, grants data, and interoperability standards for health information. HHS operates a broad ecosystem of APIs spanning FDA drug and device data, grants opportunity search, health IT open data, HRSA health center locators, and public health content syndication through its agencies including FDA, HRSA, ONC, and ODPHP.
h.name: HHS (US Department of Health and Human Services)

h.description: Hi Marley is an intelligent conversational platform built for the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry, delivering carrier-to-policyholder communication over SMS. The platform connects carriers, policyholders, and service providers through a single messaging fabric to streamline claims — including Conversational FNOL (First Notice of Loss) intake, Total Loss Assist for auto claims, and Workflow Assist for property claims — layered with AI coaching, sentiment analysis, and data insights. Trusted by 130+ carriers, including four of the top ten U.S. insurers across auto, property, and workers compensation lines. Hi Marley is backed by Emergence Capital and True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or self-service onboarding was found; the product is delivered as a closed SaaS to insurance carriers.
h.name: Hi Marley

h.description: hi.health is a cashless, real-time claims and payments platform for the insurance industry, now operated as "hi.health by Pliant" after joining Pliant. It replaces legacy reimbursement models with instantly issued virtual and physical cards whose spend is programmatically controlled per policy, merchant, currency and country. Members pay nothing upfront: eligible claims are settled in real time at the point of care across health, home, travel, corporate and auto insurance lines, and structured transaction data is streamed back to insurers for dashboards, reconciliation and fraud prevention. The developer surface is Pliant's PCI-DSS-certified Cards-as-a-Service (CaaS) and Pro API: OAuth2 client-credentials access, asynchronous callback/webhook events, and a full sandbox, which partners embed to issue and manage cards, cardholders, transactions, receipts, payments and external transfers.
h.name: hi.health

h.description: Hibachi is a stablecoin-native, privacy-first decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and FX trading. Built by contributors from Citadel, Tower Research, IMC, Meta, Google and Amazon, it pairs a low-latency central-limit-orderbook trading engine with a zk-verified settlement layer, so collateral only moves on-chain when validated by a zero-knowledge proof. Hibachi exposes a public REST and WebSocket API across two hosts (api.hibachi.xyz for account, trading and capital operations; data-api.hibachi.xyz for market data), an official Python SDK, a TypeScript example integration, and a CCXT integration. Authentication uses an API key in the Authorization header, and order, withdraw and transfer operations additionally require an ECDSA or HMAC request signature. It is backed by Electric Capital.
h.name: Hibachi

h.description: Hibernate ORM is a powerful object/relational mapping solution for Java applications, providing a framework for mapping an object-oriented domain model to a relational database.
h.name: Hibernate ORM

h.description: HiBob is a modern HR platform (known as Bob) offering a REST API for managing employee profiles, onboarding, time off, attendance, payroll integration, goals, documents, workforce planning, and company culture data. The API supports service user authentication and webhooks for event-driven integrations across HR workflows.
h.name: HiBob

h.description: HiCustomer (ハイカスタマー) was a Japanese Customer Success Management (CSM) SaaS built specifically for SaaS companies. Its platform aggregated customer data scattered across BI tools, CRMs, and chat tools to visualize product usage, communication history, revenue, and contract information in one place. Teams used configurable health-score rules to monitor account health across the customer lifecycle, and custom alerts to surface churn and upsell signals at the right moment, with time-series analysis to make customer-success outreach repeatable. The company also offered customer-success consulting, and later pivoted to a digital sales room product, "Arch by HiCustomer". On 2024-09-13 HiCustomer Inc. sold the Arch business to the Tokyo-listed adtech company Geniee, Inc. (TSE 6562), which absorbed it into GENIEE SFA/CRM and rebranded it Geniee DSR. As of this enrichment pass the hicustomer.jp domain no longer resolves to a live site (its authoritative AWS Route 53 zone is delegated but empty) and the product is discontinued; the last archived homepage (Oct 2024) is a STUDIO-built single-page "About the company" placeholder. No public developer API, documentation, SDK, or developer portal was ever published — the Wayback record for hicustomer.jp contains no /api, /docs, /developers, /pricing or /status path at any point in its history.
h.name: HiCustomer

h.description: Hidden Door is an interactive storytelling platform where roleplay meets fan fiction, letting players step into imaginative worlds and shape branching narratives through their choices. Players pick a pre-built world, add modifiers, create a character, and experience a unique story with a full cast of characters, where every playthrough differs. Creators can build playable worlds in as little as thirty minutes, then share, publish, and get paid when others play. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Homebrew and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. Hidden Door ships a consumer web experience and publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. Sector: AI / entertainment.
h.name: Hidden Door

h.description: Hidden Leaf Games is an independent video game development studio founded in 2019 and based in the United States. The studio builds competitive multiplayer games centered on competition, progression, and social play, with a stated mission of delivering a world-class experience where games are meant to be played together regardless of skill level or platform. The company is led by CEO David Li and President Bao Lam and raised seed funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2021. Hidden Leaf Games is a consumer gaming company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile tracks it as a portfolio-sourced lead in the API Evangelist network for ongoing enrichment.
h.name: Hidden Leaf Games

h.description: Hidden Level is a U.S.-based defense and aerospace technology company that turns radio-frequency (RF) activity into trusted airspace intelligence. Its passive RF sensing platform detects and tracks unmanned aerial systems (drones) and other activity across air, ground, sea, and space domains without requiring emitters or heavy on-site infrastructure. Hidden Level packages this as hardware sensor platforms, software platforms, and data platforms serving defense and military, critical infrastructure protection, homeland security, and public safety customers. The company hosts its platform on AWS with least-privilege access, MFA, and TLS 1.3 API communications, aligns corporate controls to NIST SP 800-171, and emphasizes U.S. design and manufacturing. Backed by Costanoa Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Hidden Level's public web and security surface; the company does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.
h.name: Hidden Level

h.description: Hidden Road is a global, multi-asset non-bank prime broker and clearing firm serving institutional counterparties across digital assets, foreign exchange, precious metals, exchange-traded derivatives, OTC swaps and fixed-income repo. Ripple acquired Hidden Road for $1.25B in 2025 and now operates it as Ripple Prime; hiddenroad.com redirects to ripple.com/products/prime-brokerage/. Hidden Road ships a real, customer-only API suite — the Account Activity API (streamed balances, trades, positions and fees over a bitemporal store), the Risk API (real-time margin utilisation and tail-risk metrics), the Automated Treasury Management API (programmatic collateral and credit-limit distribution) and an OTC surface — served from https://api.hiddenroad.com/v0/ behind an Auth0 OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization server at auth.hiddenroad.com. No public reference, OpenAPI, SDK or sandbox documentation is published; the only machine-readable artifact a member of the public can read is the daily MiCA post-trade transparency CSV feed the firm's Netherlands entity publishes under its EU regulatory obligation.
h.name: Hidden Road

h.description: HiddenLayer is an Austin, Texas-based AI security company founded in March 2022 by Chris Sestito (CEO), Tanner Burns (Chief Scientist), and Jim Ballard (CIO) — former Cylance researchers who encountered a real-world attack on production ML models. HiddenLayer builds an AI Security Platform that protects machine learning and generative AI systems across their entire lifecycle, comprising four integrated modules: AI Discovery (catalogs AI assets and eliminates shadow AI), AI Supply Chain Security (Model Scanner inspects models, weights, and pickle/RDS files for malicious payloads and backdoors), AI Attack Simulation (continuous adversarial red-teaming for agentic and generative systems), and AI Runtime Security / AIDR (a real-time detection-and-response firewall using deterministic classifiers that sit outside the model inference path to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect attacks, data leakage, and malicious tool calls in agentic and MCP systems). The platform exposes native connectors for CI/CD, MLOps, SIEM/SOAR, API gateways, and major data and cloud platforms, plus guardrail integrations for OpenAI Agents, LangChain, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure APIM, and a GitHub Action for Model Scanner. HiddenLayer publishes Python, TypeScript, and Java/Kotlin SDKs and research-grade tooling such as HiddenPickle (Python pickle disassembler/patcher) and HiddenPromise (R .rdx/.rdb/.rds disassembler). The company has raised $56M total ($50M Series A in September 2023 led by M12 / Microsoft's Venture Fund and Moore Strategic Ventures, with Booz Allen Ventures, IBM Ventures, Capital One Ventures, and Ten Eleven Ventures participating) and serves Fortune 500 enterprises, financial services, and US Federal agencies. The HiddenLayer SaaS console and REST API are gated behind enterprise sales and not publicly self-serve, placing this profile in Tier-3 (enterprise-gated) coverage.
h.name: HiddenLayer

h.description: HidrateSpark is the world's smartest water bottle brand, tracking daily water intake with a Bluetooth-connected sensor puck that glows to remind you to drink and syncs to the HidrateSpark hydration app, Fitbit, and Apple Watch. The company (originally Hidrate, Inc., a Techstars-backed startup) sells its smart bottles and accessories through a Shopify-hosted direct-to-consumer storefront at hidratespark.com. It does not publish a first-party developer or product API; the only machine-facing surface is the Shopify platform layer — OIDC/OAuth customer accounts and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) agent-commerce endpoints that let buyer-approved AI shopping agents browse and check out.
h.name: Hidrate

h.description: Hifi is a stablecoin and money-movement infrastructure company that provides composable financial APIs for moving, converting, routing, and settling value across bank rails and stablecoins. The platform covers fiat on-ramps and off-ramps, crypto transfers, token swaps, cross-chain bridging, virtual accounts, wallets and custody, KYC and compliance onboarding, settlement rules and orchestration addresses, transfer approvals, and reporting. Hifi is registered as a Money Services Business and partners with Cross River Bank for regulated banking, letting developers build global payouts, treasury automation, escrow flows, and multi-chain settlement programmatically over a single REST API secured with bearer API keys.
h.name: Hifi

h.description: HiGear is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: HiGear

h.description: Higgsfield is a multi-model generative AI platform for video, image, editing, storyboarding, and commercial content creation. Its public developer API (platform.higgsfield.ai) exposes 100+ generative models — Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance, Hailuo, FLUX, Nano Banana, Reve, and Higgsfield's own Soul / DoP / Popcorn models — behind a single asynchronous request/response contract: POST a model endpoint to enqueue a generation, then poll the request status or receive a webhook when it completes. The platform ships an official Python SDK (higgsfield-client), a Node.js/TypeScript SDK (@higgsfield/client), a cross-platform CLI (@higgsfield/cli), a remote MCP server (mcp.higgsfield.ai) for agent access, and a public set of Agent Skills for Claude, Cursor, and Codex. Backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures.
h.name: Higgsfield

h.description: High Alpha is a venture firm and venture studio based in Indianapolis, Indiana that creates and funds early-stage B2B SaaS companies. Through its Capital arm it makes pre-seed to Series B investments across the United States, and through its Studio it co-founds companies with entrepreneurs, providing design, brand, marketing, recruiting, product design, and go-to-market services. Founded by ExactTarget co-founder and CEO Scott Dorsey along with Eric Tobias, Mike Fitzgerald, and Studio Science founder Kristian Andersen, High Alpha pioneered the venture studio model and publishes the annual SaaS Benchmarks Report. Studio and portfolio companies include Salesloft, Lessonly, Attentive, Logik.ai, LogicGate, Dwolla, Zylo, and project44.
h.name: High Alpha

h.description: High Fidelity provides live spatial audio technology for apps and games. Its Spatial Audio Client Library (hifi-spatial-audio, MIT) lets developers embed realistic positional voice — 3D azimuth/distance transforms, nearfield "whisper" audio, noise reduction, and many simultaneous speakers over the Opus codec — into web and native applications, and previously connected them to a hosted Spatial Audio API server via signed connection JWTs. Apps including Clubhouse, Hubbub, Breakroom, and Soundstage used the technology. The hosted API service has since been discontinued; the SDK remains open source, and the company's active product is Quad, a spatial social platform that recreates physical meeting spaces. High Fidelity was founded by Philip Rosedale and is a portfolio company of GV.
h.name: High Fidelity

h.description: HighJump Software was a Minneapolis-based provider of supply chain execution software, best known for its warehouse management system (WMS) and its extensible, configurable architecture for distribution, direct-store-delivery, and manufacturing operations. The company was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2014, expanded through acquisitions (Accellos, Nexus, TrueCommerce lines), then acquired by Körber in 2017 and folded into Körber Supply Chain Software. As of 2024 the portfolio was rebranded Infios. The standalone HighJump brand is retired: highjump.com now 301-redirects to infios.com, and the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification. This profile is retained as a historical / acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network.
h.name: High Jump Software

h.description: High Mark Credit Information Services (now operating as CRIF High Mark) is one of India's four RBI-licensed credit bureaus, headquartered in Mumbai. It maintains credit information on retail, microfinance, and commercial borrowers, and delivers credit reports, bureau scores, analytics, portfolio monitoring, fraud-detection, and origination-decisioning solutions to banks, NBFCs, microfinance institutions, insurers, and telecom providers. The bureau is best known for its microfinance credit information services and pan-India retail and commercial credit databases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal or API specification, so this profile captures company identity and domain security posture only.
h.name: High Mark Credit Information Services

h.description: High Mobility provides a connected car API platform that enables developers to build apps using real-time data from vehicles. The platform provides access to car data such as location, fuel level, door locks, diagnostics, and other vehicle telemetry data.
h.name: High Mobility

h.description: The High Performance Software Foundation (HPSF) is a Linux Foundation project and neutral hub for open source high performance computing software, founded in 2024 and governed by a Governing Board, a Technical Advisory Council (TAC) and an Outreach Committee. HPSF hosts and supports a portable core software stack for HPC - including Spack, Kokkos, Apptainer, E4S, HPX, Charliecloud, Chapel, Viskores, Flux Framework and Wi4MPI - across Core, Established and Emerging project stages, and runs HPSFcon alongside a presence at SC and CppCon. Organizations join at Premier, General or Associate tier; projects apply to the TAC. HPSF publishes no developer program and ships no SDKs, but hpsf.io is a machine-readable surface in its own right: it serves an RFC 9727 /.well-known/api-catalog linkset, an llms.txt, a Content-Signal AI usage preference in robots.txt, and two live OpenAPI documents describing a publicly callable events API covering HPSF conferences, venues, organizers and event taxonomies. The WordPress wp/v2 content routes are advertised in the namespace list but are disabled on this installation.
h.name: High Performance Software Foundation

h.description: High Tech indexes the APIs, data services, and reference artifacts that power the electronics, semiconductor, hardware, and IoT industries. The landscape covers electronic component data and distribution (Octopart / Nexar, Digi-Key, Mouser, Arrow Electronics, Avnet, Newark / element14), ECAD and PCB design data (SnapEDA, Ultra Librarian, Altium 365 via Nexar Design), hardware lifecycle and IoT device management (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, Particle, Golioth), bill-of-materials and component-search workflows used across hardware product engineering, and the authoritative manufacturer data that anchors a component record (manufacturer part number, manufacturer, datasheet, lifecycle status, RoHS / REACH compliance, real-time inventory and pricing across distributors). This index captures the canonical providers, the shape of a component record as JSON Schema, a JSON-LD context aligning with schema.org Product / Offer / Organization, and the domain vocabulary used across the high-tech component supply chain.
h.name: High Tech

h.description: High5health (HighFive Healthcare) is a dental support organization that partners with endodontists and oral surgeons to run the business side of their specialty practices so the doctors can focus on patient care. Its managed services span human resources, accounting and legal, payroll, payor negotiations and credentialing, marketing, recruiting, revenue cycle management, IT and cybersecurity, procurement, insurance and risk management, and tax preparation. The company is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. It operates as a healthcare business-services provider and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK.
h.name: High5health

h.description: Higharc is an AI-powered homebuilding software platform founded in 2018 by Marc Minor and headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, with team members across San Francisco and Atlanta. Its design-to-construction cloud platform lets residential builders design homes from scratch, configure market-proven plans, and turn every home into shoppable 3D visuals, plan-based estimating data, and permit-ready construction documents. The product surface spans Studio (design), Config (plan configuration), Showroom (3D visualization), Estimate (material takeoffs), Build (construction documents), Photoreal (renderings), and enterprise AI Estimating, unifying architecture, sales, and construction operations. Higharc is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.
h.name: Higharc

h.description: Highbeam is a business banking and finance platform built for modern consumer brands (direct-to-consumer and e-commerce). It brings together operating and high-yield accounts, a charge card that pays cashback on advertising spend, working capital and credit lines, automated bill pay, and spend intelligence, alongside Luma, an applied-AI finance assistant. Banking services are delivered through partner banks (Thread Bank, member FDIC) and Airwallex. Highbeam is based in New York City. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this entry captures the company identity, its public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.
h.name: Highbeam

h.description: HighByte provides Industrial DataOps software that enables organizations to ingest, transform, and operationalize data from diverse sources such as PLCs, IoT devices, and enterprise systems. Their platform offers a unified namespace, real‑time data pipelines, and AI‑ready datasets, helping manufacturers accelerate digital transformation and build AI‑driven applications. HighByte’s solutions include the Intelligence Hub, REST Data Server, and MCP services, delivering secure, scalable data management for modern industrial environments.
h.name: HighByte

h.description: Higher Logic provides powerful, personal online community software that helps organizations engage members, retain customers, and grow audiences. Their platform offers community forums, member engagement tools, integrations, and analytics to build lasting relationships and drive advocacy across professional and trade associations, nonprofits, and businesses.
h.name: Higher Logic

h.description: Highfive was a video collaboration and conferencing company (highfive.com) surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of gv and lightspeed-venture-partners. The brand was acquired by and folded into Dialpad: highfive.com now issues a 301 redirect to dialpad.com/highfive, and developer.highfive.com no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN). Highfive exposes no independent developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or /.well-known/ discovery surface of its own; any current programmatic capability lives under the Dialpad platform. This profile is retained as an enrichment lead; only a domain-security probe of the surviving highfive.com domain yielded real data.
h.name: Highfive

h.description: HighLevel provides an all‑in‑one SaaS platform for marketing agencies, offering CRM, funnel building, email & SMS automation, reputation management, and client communication tools, enabling agencies to deliver comprehensive digital marketing services.
h.name: HighLevel

h.description: highlig is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of slow-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: highlig

h.description: Highlight is a General Catalyst portfolio company added to the API Evangelist network as a stub via the VC-portfolio harvest. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-20 found no active developer API surface to catalog: the company's primary domain (highlightyourbrand.com) now returns only a JavaScript redirect to a parked "/lander" page, and the source portfolio harvest already flagged the entry as a non-API provider (is_api_provider false, no URL captured). Note that the developer-observability platform highlight.io is a DISTINCT company (YC-backed, acquired by LaunchDarkly) and is NOT this General Catalyst portfolio company, so its API artifacts were deliberately not attributed here.
h.name: Highlight

h.description: Highlight (highlight.io) is the open-source, full-stack monitoring platform — session replay, error monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and metrics in a single tool. Built on OpenTelemetry, rrweb, and ClickHouse, Highlight correlates server-side spans and logs back to the originating browser session so engineers can move from a customer report to the exact line of code in one click. Available as a hosted SaaS on three commercial tiers (Free / Pay-as-you-go / Business / Enterprise) and as a fully open-source self-hosted deployment (Dev / Hobby / Enterprise) under Apache 2.0.
h.name: Highlight (highlight.io)

h.description: Highlightly is a real-time sports data and highlights API covering football, basketball, American football, hockey, baseball, cricket, rugby, volleyball, and handball across 950+ leagues. Its REST APIs serve live scores, matches, standings, team and player statistics, head-to-head records, odds, and on-demand video highlight clips, available directly via highlightly.net hosts or through RapidAPI.
h.name: Highlightly

h.description: Highline is an embedded payment infrastructure company whose Pay by Paycheck product captures funds from a consumer's payroll before they reach the checking account and routes them to billers and lenders. The platform pairs with payroll providers to create a split direct deposit at payroll run time, so designated bills are paid on time and in full, and the remainder is deposited to the consumer's bank as normal. Highline ships an API-first developer experience with hosted documentation at docs.highline.co, a Highline Link client widget, webhook-based notifications, sandbox simulations, daily ACH settlements, and an llms.txt for AI agents. The company is sometimes referenced as highline.fi but operates today at highline.co.
h.name: Highline

h.description: Highly is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: Highly

h.description: Highnote is a modern, unified embedded-finance and banking-as-a-service platform for card issuing, card acquiring, credit, and real-time money movement, with a built-in real-time programmable ledger and full program management. The entire platform is driven by a single GraphQL API at https://api.us.highnote.com/graphql (test https://api.us.test.highnote.com/graphql), authenticated with a base64-encoded API key over HTTP Basic auth. One endpoint covers card products, US person and business account holders (KYC/KYB onboarding), financial accounts and credit lines, virtual/physical/tokenized payment cards, transaction authorization and clearing, disputes, spend and velocity rules, collaborative authorization, multi-rail money movement (ACH, wire, RTP, push-to-card), and outbound webhook event notifications. Highnote is a US-based platform serving digital-first businesses embedding financial products; access is enterprise, contract-gated, with self-serve dashboard signup and a test environment.
h.name: Highnote

h.description: HighRadius is an AI-powered autonomous finance platform for the Office of the CFO, automating the Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), and Treasury processes with a network of orchestrated AI agents. The platform covers invoicing, collections, cash application, deductions, credit, dispute management, financial close, reconciliation, consolidation, and cash forecasting. HighRadius serves 1,500+ enterprise customers and ships pre-built integrations with 50+ ERPs and systems including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through those pre-built ERP connectors and partner engagements rather than a public self-serve developer API; the company publishes a Trust Center documenting SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and GDPR posture.
h.name: HighRadius

h.description: Highrise is a mobile-first virtual world by Pocket Worlds Inc where users create avatars, hang out in social rooms, design and trade fashion items, and build custom worlds. Alongside the consumer app, Highrise operates a developer platform for creators: a WebSocket Bot API for running programmable bots inside rooms (official Python and .NET SDKs), a read-only REST Web API exposing public users, rooms, posts, items and grabs data, and Highrise Studio with an Engine API and Cloud API for scripting worlds and games in Lua. Bots authenticate with an API token minted from the Highrise account settings and are bound to a room ID.
h.name: Highrise

h.description: Highspot is a sales enablement and go-to-market platform whose API surface splits in two. A per-tenant REST API at https://api-{instance}.highspot.com/v1.0 covers spots, items, item content, users, groups, pitches and analytics, authenticated with an API client key and secret issued from account settings; it has no public reference and no published OpenAPI. Alongside it Highspot runs a first-party remote MCP server at https://mcp.highspot.com/mcp, verified live, secured with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration, PKCE, scopes mcp:read / mcp:write / offline_access) and discoverable through RFC 8414 and RFC 9728 metadata documents. The MCP server exposes content search, instant answers, deal context, content recommendations, linked pitches, Digital Room generation and Highspot Agents to OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft Copilot clients. Both the MCP server and the Insights Layer APIs are gated to the top "Best" subscription tier.
h.name: Highspot

h.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.
h.name: Highstock

h.description: Hightouch is a composable Customer Data Platform (CDP) and agentic marketing platform that activates data directly from cloud warehouses and lakehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and Redshift to more than 290 SaaS destinations, without copying or storing customer data. The platform covers Reverse ETL, Customer Studio audience building and journey orchestration, identity resolution, first-party event collection with SDKs for web and mobile, real-time personalization, AI Decisioning, Match Booster and an Ad Studio for advertising creative. Developers get a bearer-authenticated REST API at https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1 covering sources, models, destinations, syncs and runs, campaigns, decision-engine flows, event contracts and identity graphs, plus an `ht` CLI, Git Sync for version-controlled resource YAML, workspace environments with approval flows, a public documentation MCP server, and an A2A agent card for the Hightouch Marketing Agent.
h.name: Hightouch

h.description: Highway 9 Networks is a Silicon Valley company delivering AI Wireless Infrastructure as a Service through its Virtual Mobile/AI Cloud (VMC) platform. The platform combines a cloud control plane (Mobile Center), a distributed 5G core and edge AI services (Mobile Edge), private 5G wireless infrastructure (Mobile Network), and connected device/workload groupings (Mobile Zones) to give enterprises deterministic, ultra-reliable private mobile networks and in-building cellular coverage. It targets manufacturing and warehousing (autonomous robots, drones, logistics), higher education (AI labs and research), and energy (predictive maintenance, remote operations). The Mobile Center Streaming APIs let partners integrate configuration, device management, monitoring, analytics, and operational workflows with the platform. Founded by an ex-VMware team behind NSX/SDN, hybrid cloud, and the Telco 5G/Edge cloud platform.
h.name: Highway9

h.description: Higlobe is a regulated cross-border money transfer service that lets freelancers, independent contractors, and businesses receive international payments from clients in the United States and the European Union. Members open a USD or EUR receiving account, share a payment request or account details with their payer, and withdraw funds to a local bank account with near-instant, 24/7 settlement at a flat, low cost. The platform also offers a Visa Signature card, a yield on account balances, and payer-facing payment requests. Higlobe is registered as a Money Service Business (MSB) with FinCEN under the U.S. Department of the Treasury and publishes a SOC 2 Type 2 / SOC 3 security posture. Higlobe is a consumer/business fintech product and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, security, and commercial surface. Backed by Battery Ventures; added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.
h.name: Higlobe

h.description: Higo is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: payments. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: Higo

h.description: Higress is a cloud-native API gateway built on Istio and Envoy, providing enterprise-grade API gateway capabilities including traffic management, security, observability, and AI plugin support. It is an open-source project under the CNCF ecosystem.
h.name: Higress

h.description: HiGuests (Hi Guests Vacation Homes Rental LLC, License 765614) is a Dubai-based short-term rental property management company. It offers full-service management for vacation homes and furnished apartments, listing owners' properties across 20+ booking channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, and others), and handling profile creation, dynamic pricing, booking and guest communications, 24/7 guest support, check-in/check-out, housekeeping, and maintenance, alongside transparent owner reporting. HiGuests markets a zero-commission subscription plan for landlords and operates a guest-facing booking site. It is a hospitality services business, not an API/developer platform; no public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.
h.name: HiGuest

h.description: HiHello is a digital business card and professional-presence platform that lets individuals and teams create, share, and manage modern contact cards, email signatures, and virtual backgrounds. It replaces paper business cards with QR-code and link-based sharing, captures inbound contacts, and syncs them into CRMs and address books. For organizations it adds branded team cards, centralized administration, SSO (OAuth 2.0 and SAML), SCIM/HRIS provisioning, and analytics. HiHello integrates with tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Google Contacts, Outlook, Zapier, and Okta. The company was surfaced as a Foundry Group portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. HiHello does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; integration is delivered through pre-built connectors and enterprise identity protocols.
h.name: HiHello

h.description: HiJoJo Partners Inc. (HiJoJo Partners株式会社) is a Tokyo-based independent asset management and fintech group, established in November 2017 and registered with the Director of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau (No. 3065) for Type II Financial Instruments Business, Investment Management Business, and Investment Advisory and Agency Business. The firm forms, sells and manages funds that give Japanese institutional and individual investors access to late-stage private and pre-IPO companies, and works to develop Japan's secondary market for unlisted shares. It operates three lines: HiJoJo Prime (in-person advisory for investors with 100M JPY or more in investable assets), HiJoJo.com (an online fund platform for individual investors with 30M JPY or more), and HiJoJo Private Market Solution for institutional investors and startups. HiJoJo joined the Nasdaq Private Market investor consortium in 2024 to expand secondary-market access in Japan. Its investor-facing platform is delivered as an authenticated member web application; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.
h.name: HiJoJo Partners

h.description: HijUp is an Indonesia-based modest-fashion e-commerce marketplace selling Muslim women's clothing online — abayas, blouses, dresses, tunics, printed scarves, hijabs, mukena, khimar, and related accessories — aggregating a large catalog of local Indonesian modest-wear brands (over a hundred labels listed under its brands directory) into a single storefront with international shipping. The company operates a consumer-facing shopping site (product catalog, categories, cart, checkout, and customer accounts) rather than a public developer platform; it publishes no API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. HijUp is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Public contact is customer@hijup.com and +6221-78-24-001.
h.name: HijUp

h.description: Hike Private Limited is a New Delhi consumer internet company founded in 2011 by Kavin Bharti Mittal. It is best known for Hike Messenger, launched in December 2012 and at its peak one of India's largest homegrown messaging apps, which the company retired in January 2021 to pivot into the Rush Gaming Universe — a mobile-first skill-gaming platform that layered Web3 ownership and play-to-earn mechanics over roughly fourteen casual titles. Hike raised approximately $261M across seven rounds from investors including SoftBank, Tencent, Tiger Global and Polygon, and reached unicorn valuation in 2021. In September 2025, after India's Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act banned real-money gaming, the founder announced a complete wind-down of the company and of Rush. As of August 2026 hike.in still resolves but serves an HTTP 502 behind an expired certificate, and every developer-facing subdomain is NXDOMAIN; the company publishes no API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract.
h.name: Hike

h.description: Hilbert's AI is an AI-native growth infrastructure platform for B2C companies, backed by a16z. It unifies fragmented product, marketing, and finance data into a single source of truth and layers agentic automation on top through four intelligence stages: Detect (anomalies, churn signals, and behavioral shifts), Reason (ML/deep-learning root-cause analysis and forecasting), Act (autonomous growth interventions such as churn plays and channel adjustments), and Optimize (continuous budget and strategy tuning). A natural-language interface lets growth, product, and finance teams collapse months-long decision cycles into minutes without writing code or navigating dashboards. Hilbert connects to existing data and paid-media stacks via prebuilt integrations (Meta, Google, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, Google Analytics 4, Triple Whale, Klaviyo, Braze) and states SOC 2 on its own site. The product is delivered as a hosted application. There is no public developer program, but the application backend does publish a reachable Swagger UI and an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at https://app-api.hilberts.ai/api-docs, which declares the platform's security schemes and core data models while shipping an empty paths object, so no operations are documented.
h.name: Hilbert's AI

h.description: Hildebrand Technology Limited is a London-based energy data company and, since 2019, the United Kingdom's first independent DCC Other User with a direct connection to the Smart Data Communications Company network. It sits between Britain's mandated smart-metering infrastructure and the applications built on top of it: it makes Glow hardware (CADs, in-home displays, sub-meters, temperature sensors), ingests and stores smart-meter reads at scale, and republishes them through the Glowmarkt Platform APIs, the consumer Bright app, and the commercial Glow Data Service. Its API posture is an honest reflection of the British market seam — Britain mandated the metering INFRASTRUCTURE, not a consumer data right, so there is no Consumer Data Right or Green Button obligation on Hildebrand and no standards-conformant data-sharing surface to point at. What exists instead is a proprietary but genuinely well-documented platform: five public Swagger 2.0 definitions are served anonymously from api.glowmarkt.com/api-docs, and any individual who installs Bright, creates an account and passes meter-point verification can call the same production API for their own household data with a published applicationId. Third-party organisational access to other people's data is the closed half — it runs through Glow Data Service on a signed contract from GBP 595/month per MPxN, with consumer verification and consent captured per meter point. Hildebrand publishes no open grid or market data of any kind: every documented endpoint returns HTTP 400 without an applicationId header, so this is a closed-market-data, consent-gated-consumer-data provider.
h.name: Hildebrand

h.description: Hill House Home is a digital-first lifestyle brand that brings beauty and joy to everyday rituals. Since launching with bedding in 2016 it has extended its collections to bath, baby, accessories and apparel, including the widely beloved Nap Dress. The direct-to-consumer storefront at hillhousehome.com runs on Shopify and exposes a live, public Storefront MCP server (catalog search, cart, and store-policy tools) at /api/mcp, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect discovery for customer-scoped access. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and enriched from its public commerce surface.
h.name: Hill House

h.description: Hill International is a global construction consulting firm founded in 1976 in Mt. Laurel, New Jersey, providing program, project, and construction management, project management oversight, claims and dispute resolution, estimating and cost management, facilities management, project monitoring, troubled project turnaround, commissioning, and project labor agreement consulting to public and private sector owners across more than 100 offices in 42 countries. In December 2022 Hill agreed to be acquired by Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI), the parent of STV, with the take-private transaction closing in May 2023 — Hill now operates as a GISI Consulting Group company alongside STV, GEI Consultants, LiRo-Hill, Layton Construction, and the broader GISI portfolio. Hill International is a professional services firm and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or any developer portal.
h.name: Hill International

h.description: Hill-Rom Holdings was a global medical technology company best known for its hospital beds, patient support systems, Welch Allyn vital signs monitors, and Bardy Diagnostics cardiac monitoring devices. Hill-Rom was acquired by Baxter International (NYSE: BAX) in December 2021 for $12.4 billion and now operates as Baxter's Hillrom and Front Line Care segment, continuing to deliver connected care, smart beds, vital signs monitoring, and clinical workflow solutions to hospitals and health systems worldwide.
h.name: Hill-Rom Holdings

h.description: Hillenbrand is a global manufacturer of highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and systems serving the plastics, food, and recycling industries. The company operates across more than 60 global locations with a portfolio of leading industrial brands. Hillenbrand reports approximately $2.7 billion in annual revenue and employs over 8,000 associates worldwide.
h.name: Hillenbrand

h.description: HilleVax was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel vaccines, most notably HIL-214, a virus-like-particle based vaccine candidate aimed at preventing moderate-to-severe acute gastroenteritis caused by norovirus infection. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Enrichment probing found no developer program, no API, no developer portal, and no public API documentation of any kind, which is expected for a clinical-stage vaccine developer rather than a technology/API producer. The company's primary domain (hillevax.com) now redirects to xoma.com (XOMA Royalty), indicating HilleVax has been acquired and wound down as an independent operating company; XOMA Royalty itself was subsequently acquired by Ligand (closed July 2026). This profile is retained as a company/identity record with no API surface.
h.name: HilleVax

h.description: Hillhouse Investment (formerly Hillhouse Capital) is a global investment firm founded in 2005 by Lei Zhang with seed capital from the Yale University endowment, and is one of Asia's largest private-market investors, managing an estimated US$100 billion in assets as of 2026. Headquartered in Singapore with offices in Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, New York, London, and Abu Dhabi, the firm invests globally across all stages of a company's life cycle, spanning public equities, growth equity, private equity buyouts, venture capital (through its early-stage arm GL Ventures, launched in 2020), and real assets. Hillhouse describes itself as disciplined and pragmatic investors who prioritize business fundamentals and deep, bottom-up industry research, with sector focus on healthcare, industrials, energy transition, business services, and consumer. Its portfolio spans companies headquartered in more than 25 countries and has included category-defining businesses such as Tencent, JD.com, Baidu, Zoom, BeiGene, Miniso, Airbnb, Uber, and Didi. Backers have historically included major university endowments (Yale, Stanford, Princeton, MIT, University of Pennsylvania, University of Texas) and CPPIB.
h.name: Hillhouse Investment

h.description: Hillshire Brands was a U.S.-based food company that produced and sold meat-centric food solutions including Jimmy Dean, Ball Park, Hillshire Farm, State Fair, and Sara Lee branded products. The company was acquired by Tyson Foods in 2014 and its operations have been integrated into the Tyson Foods organization. Hillshire Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or API documentation.
h.name: Hillshire Brands

h.description: Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH, dual-listed on NYSE Texas) is a Dallas-based financial services holding company that operates through three wholly owned subsidiaries: PlainsCapital Bank, a Texas commercial bank; HilltopSecurities, a full-service investment bank covering public finance, wealth management, fixed income capital markets and structured finance; and PrimeLending, a national residential mortgage originator. Hilltop Holdings itself is a holding company, not a software vendor — it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable specification at the holding-company level, and the subsidiaries surface their technology as end-user platforms (MOmentum Advisor, HilltopBancSystems, loan servicing portals) rather than as public APIs. This profile records that public surface as it actually is: a corporate site that serves an llms.txt and nothing else a machine can consume.
h.name: Hilltop Holdings

h.description: Hilltops IT, operating as ConnectIt Software Development, provides integration and add‑on solutions for business software systems such as QuoteWerks, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, and Monday.com. Based in the UK, they deliver bespoke development, migration, and support services to improve efficiency and profitability for their clients.
h.name: Hilltops IT

h.description: Hilos is a WhatsApp Business Platform automation company (backed by 500 Global and Techstars, now part of ActiveCampaign) that helps businesses capture leads, qualify prospects, and automate follow-ups over WhatsApp's Cloud API. Its REST API exposes contacts, inbox conversations, WhatsApp message templates, and no-code flow executions, authenticated with an `Authorization: Token` API key against https://api.hilos.io/api/ and paginated with `page` / `page_size` query parameters.
h.name: Hilos

h.description: Hilt is a zero-custody Solana payments company operated in the United Kingdom by Paul Wild trading as Hilt (London). It ships four connected products: PayMe (a free receiving link and QR for an OAuth-verified X handle, sender pays a flat 2% fee), Direct Checkout (a no-account SOL / USDC / single-token checkout link), Hilt Pay Workspace (the merchant dashboard for hosted checkout, embeds, WooCommerce, receipts, memberships, native Solana USDC subscriptions and signed webhooks) and Hilt Pay API, the developer and agent product under /v1/access that turns an HTTP 402 into an operating record: x402 V2 payment requirement, Solana USDC or native SOL settlement, receipt, entitlement, atomic metered usage consumption, MPP payment channels and webhook trail. Hilt publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 contract (165 operations on api.hilt.so), a hosted MCP gateway and an OAuth-gated PayMe MCP connector, an A2A agent card, llms.txt on three hosts, TypeScript and Python SDKs, a CLI, Postman assets and a documented sandbox. Live pricing is $0/month plus 1% per successful settlement.
h.name: Hilt

h.description: Hilton is one of the largest and fastest-growing hospitality companies in the world, with a portfolio of hotel brands across luxury, full-service, focused-service, and timeshare segments. Hilton operates a developer program that exposes APIs for hotel search, availability, reservations, loyalty program integration, and partner distribution. Most Hilton APIs are partner-gated and require credentials issued through the Hilton developer program.
h.name: Hilton

h.description: Hims is the men's brand of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS), a U.S.-based direct-to-consumer telehealth platform. Through forhims.com it connects patients with licensed medical providers and affiliated pharmacies to offer treatment for sexual health, hair loss, dermatology and skincare, mental health, and weight loss, including provider consultations, personalized prescriptions, and recurring subscription fulfillment shipped to the customer. Hims & Hers operates the sibling Hers brand for women and runs its own pharmacy and fulfillment operations. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and trust surface; Hims does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record is identity- and security-focused rather than spec-bearing.
h.name: Hims

h.description: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth platform headquartered in San Francisco that connects consumers with licensed providers and ships personalized treatments across men's and women's health categories. Hims serves men with offerings spanning sexual health, hair loss, mental health, dermatology, and weight loss; Hers serves women with birth control, hair, skin, mental health, and weight management; both brands include compounded GLP-1 weight-loss programs. International expansion has been driven by the acquisitions of ZAVA (Europe, 2025) and Eucalyptus Health (Australia, 2026). Hims & Hers is primarily a consumer D2C product; no public developer API has been identified, and B2B and partner integrations are gated. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.
h.name: Hims & Hers Health

h.description: Hinge is a relationship-oriented dating app owned by Match Group, marketed as "designed to be deleted" with a product focus on prompt-driven profiles and compatibility matching intended to drive actual dates rather than prolonged in-app engagement. Hinge Labs is the company's in-house research arm publishing data on dating behavior and outcomes. Hinge is a consumer mobile product; no public developer or partner API has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.
h.name: Hinge

h.description: Hinge Health is a San Francisco-based digital musculoskeletal (MSK) care company founded in 2014 by Daniel Perez and Gabriel Mecklenburg, delivering virtual physical therapy, pelvic health, and chronic pain care to enterprise health plans, employers, and their members. The platform combines on-demand exercise therapy with a multidisciplinary care team — physical therapists, health coaches, board-certified physicians, and orthopedic specialists — augmented by 3D motion tracking, computer vision, and an in-house AI Care Assistant. Hinge Health develops Enso, an FDA-cleared, drug-free wearable that delivers proprietary electrical stimulation waveforms for pain relief, and operates HingeConnect, an EMR/claims interoperability layer that ingests records from more than one million external providers across 120,000+ care sites to coordinate care, surface surgical and opioid risk, and feed real-time clinical context into the digital clinic. The company also runs HingeSelect, a national provider network for in-person MSK care, and contracts with all five major US national health plans plus employers including Boeing, Salesforce, and US Foods. Hinge Health raised more than $1 billion from Insight Partners, Tiger Global, Coatue, and Atomico before completing its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker HNGE on May 22, 2025, pricing at $32/share and opening at $39.25 for an initial market capitalization above $3 billion. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hinge Health, Enso, or HingeConnect — the platform is sold as a managed clinical service to health plans and employers, and the HingeConnect interoperability surface is operated internally rather than exposed to third-party developers.
h.name: Hinge Health

h.description: Hintsa Performance is a Finnish performance-coaching company founded by Dr. Aki Hintsa, applying methods developed over 30+ years working with Formula 1 drivers and elite athletes to help executives, leaders, and individuals achieve sustainable success. Its "Circle of Better Life" model combines Nordic wellbeing with performance principles proven in Formula 1, delivered as bespoke coaching programs across three segments (sports, businesses, and individuals). The company reports 3,500+ intensive executive coaching programmes delivered for 500+ organisations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or discovery surface (.well-known, llms.txt) was found during enrichment — this is a non-API wellbeing/coaching business.
h.name: Hinsta

h.description: Hint Inc. is a San Francisco based beverage company founded in 2005 by Kara Goldin, known for fruit-infused unsweetened water sold in still, sparkling, caffeinated and kids formats across 25+ flavors. A large share of its business is direct-to-consumer through its own storefront at drinkhint.com, which runs on Shopify. Hint publishes no traditional developer program, SDKs or OpenAPI, but the storefront does expose a live, anonymous agent surface: an agents.md / llms.txt agent instruction document, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, and a Model Context Protocol endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp that answers tools/list with 13 real catalog, cart, checkout and order tools. Checkout explicitly requires contemporaneous human approval before payment.
h.name: Hint

h.description: Hint Health is the leading direct primary care (DPC) technology platform, powering thousands of DPC practices with software for membership management, automated billing, clinical workflows, and provider networks. The Hint REST API provides programmatic access to clinic operations including patient enrollment, membership billing, practice configuration, clinical data management, charges, invoices, webhooks, and OAuth-based partner integrations.
h.name: Hint Health

h.description: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) is U.S. legislation providing data privacy and security provisions for safeguarding medical information. HIPAA compliance is required for healthcare providers, health plans, and their business associates handling protected health information (PHI).
h.name: HIPAA

h.description: HiPay is a European omnichannel payment platform headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France, offering REST APIs for online payments, in-store terminal management, fraud prevention, 3DS authentication, tokenization, marketplace payments, and payment reporting. Founded in 2011, HiPay is listed on Euronext Growth Paris and processes over €7.5 billion in transactions annually across five European countries.
h.name: HiPay

h.description: Hipcamp is the #1 app to find and book campsites globally, with real-time availability across more than 500,000 sites in the United States, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Campers search national parks, state parks, RV resorts, and private land stays (farms, ranches, vineyards) in one app, with filters, Pro map layers (BLM/USFS land, cell coverage, dark skies), road-trip search, and free availability alerts. Hosts list and manage campsites, sync calendars, and take weekly payouts. Hipcamp integrates with campground reservation systems (ResNexus, Cloudbeds, Newbook, RMS, Bedful) but publishes no public developer API — /api and /graphql are internal-only. Surfaced as an a16z / Bond Capital / Slow Ventures portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.
h.name: Hipcamp

h.description: HipChat was Atlassian's team chat platform, providing persistent group chat, video, file sharing, and an extensive integration ecosystem. Atlassian discontinued HipChat Cloud, Stride, HipChat Server, and HipChat Data Center on February 15, 2019 after selling the IP to Slack in July 2018 and committing to a joint migration path for customers. This profile preserves the historical API surface (REST API v2, Webhooks, Connect add-on framework) for archival and migration-pattern research; no live endpoints remain.
h.name: HipChat

h.description: Hiphen Plant provides advanced image analytics solutions for agricultural research. As plant scientists, they build tools that revolutionize how plants can be assessed, bringing the power of image analytics to agricultural research programs for decision-making on genetics, chemistry, and practices.
h.name: Hiphen Plant

h.description: Hippo is a US homeowners insurance carrier headquartered in Palo Alto, California, operating as the insurance subsidiary of Hippo Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HIPO). Founded in 2015, Hippo modernizes home insurance with instant online quotes — typically under sixty seconds — and a smart home oriented approach that pairs policies with proactive home maintenance guidance through the Hippo Home mobile app, DIY checklists, home health scoring, and partnerships with smart device makers. The company writes homeowners, condo, landlord, flood, auto, and pet policies and operates as both a direct-to-consumer brand and an MGA distributing through a network of 70+ carrier partners, including Bamboo, Stillwater, Nationwide, American Integrity, Liberty Mutual, and Progressive. Hippo's underwriting capacity is anchored by its wholly-owned admitted carrier, Spinnaker Insurance Company, acquired in 2020. Hippo serves 500K+ homeowners across the United States, with concentrated presence in Texas, California, Arizona, Colorado, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia. There is no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hippo or Spinnaker; the GitHub organization hippoinsurance exists but has no public repositories, and the api.hippo.com hostname is not exposed to the public internet. Integrations with smart home device partners, agents, and MGA carriers are handled through private partner channels rather than an open developer program.
h.name: Hippo

h.description: Hippo Harvest is a controlled-environment agriculture company based in Pescadero, California, founded in 2019, that grows USDA-certified-organic leafy greens in modular greenhouses run by custom autonomous mobile robots and machine learning. Its closed-loop, direct-to-root watering and nutrient system is published by the company as using 92% less water, 55% less fertilizer and 94% less land than conventional field agriculture, while pricing to compete with field-grown product. Hippo Harvest sells packaged salad greens (spring mix, spinach, 50/50 blend, butter lettuce) into grocery retail rather than selling software: the robotics, computer vision and growing-control stack is internal operating infrastructure, not a product. It raised a $21M Series B led by Standard Investments in February 2024 and a $30M Series C led by Cox Farms in July 2026, and is permitting a 30-acre facility in Hollister, California. No public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind was found on any host the company controls.
h.name: Hippo Harvest

h.description: Hippo, the US homeowners insurance company at hippo.com. This is a duplicate slug: Hippo is profiled in the hippo-com repository (slug follows the hippo.com domain), which is canonical. Consolidated 2026-10-13, approved by Kin Lane.
h.name: Hippo Insurance

h.description: Hippocratic AI builds safety-focused generative AI agents for non-diagnostic healthcare tasks, powered by its Polaris constellation architecture. Polaris 5.0 is a multi-trillion-parameter constellation of specialized models clinically validated by U.S.-licensed clinicians. Hippocratic AI sells agents such as Nurse Co-Pilot and AI Front Door to health systems, payors, and life-sciences organizations through enterprise sales rather than a self-service public API.
h.name: Hippocratic AI

h.description: Hipster is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global, gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: Hipster

h.description: Hiptype is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
h.name: Hiptype

h.description: Exchange rates between 162 currency & 300 crypto currency update each 5 min, accurate, no limits
h.name: Hirak Exchange Rates

h.description: Face detection, face recognition with age estimation/gender estimation, accurate, no quota limits
h.name: Hirak FaceAPI

h.description: Ip to location with country code, currency code & currency name, fast response, unlimited requests
h.name: Hirak IP to Country

h.description: Image to text -text recognition- from image more than 100 language, accurate, unlimited requests
h.name: Hirak OCR

h.description: Translate between 21 of most used languages, accurate, unlimited requests
h.name: Hirak Translation

h.description: HireArt is a workforce management platform that helps enterprises source, employ, and manage their contingent workforce - contract workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors - through a single self-serve system. Its products span Employer of Record (EOR), on-demand sourcing and recruitment, a Vendor Management System (VMS), worker classification and compliance (1099 vs. W-2 with indemnification), program management, and freelancer management. Customers include Toyota Research Institute, Zoox, Via, Scale AI, Dropbox, Meta Quest, Carta, and Rover. HireArt was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.
h.name: HireArt

h.description: Hireguide is a structured-interviewing and hiring-intelligence platform, originally a Techstars-backed startup, that helped talent teams run consistent, evidence-based interviews with guided question banks, scorecards, interview recording and AI-assisted candidate evaluation grounded in industrial-organizational hiring science. Hireguide's team and technology were acquired by HireVue in 2026; the primary domain now redirects to HireVue's AI Interviewer platform, while trust.hireguide.com remains live and Hireguide-branded, publishing the company's compliance posture (SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; no independent public developer/API surface was found for Hireguide.
h.name: Hireguide

h.description: HireLayer provides a suite of recruiting APIs that enable developers to parse resumes, extract structured data, and match candidates to job descriptions. Their platform offers five core APIs covering resume parsing, job parsing, candidate‑job matching, candidate ranking, and skills matching. Users can access these services via a single API key and credit‑based billing, with documentation, pricing, and a free trial available online. The company targets ATS integrations, HR tech solutions, and staffing agencies, positioning itself as a flexible, cloud‑based recruiting API provider.
h.name: HireLayer

h.description: HireLogic, Inc. is a US (Great Falls, Virginia) HR-technology company building an AI interview intelligence platform for staffing, recruiting and in-house talent teams. Its AI joins video, phone and in-person interviews to produce automated interview notes, transcripts, structured candidate summaries, topic highlights and hiring-signal analytics, so recruiters stop hand-writing notes and hiring managers can compare candidates on evidence rather than recall. The product surface includes instant interview insights, an interview chatbot for querying past interviews, intake-call insights, smart resume analysis and ranking, automated AI interviews, recruiting-team analytics, and a mobile companion app for in-person interviews. It integrates with Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, and connects to applicant tracking systems through the Merge unified API as a consumer of that service. HireLogic raised a $4M seed round in 2022. It is delivered strictly as an end-user SaaS product: as of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract.
h.name: HireLogic

h.description: Hireology is a purpose-built applicant tracking system (ATS) and hiring platform for multi-location, high-volume employers, with deep specialization in retail automotive, healthcare (including long-term and home care), and hospitality. The platform spans the full hiring lifecycle — candidate sourcing and job distribution, applicant engagement and texting, structured screening and skills assessments, interview and evaluation workflows, hiring decisions, and onboarding handoff — plus reporting and analytics that help operators hire consistently, faster, and at scale across locations. Hireology integrates with payroll, HRIS, background-check, scheduling, and job-board partners such as ADP, UKG, BambooHR, Indeed, CDK, Dealertrack, and Accurate. It maintains a SOC 2 Type II program and a public Trust Center. Hireology does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI specification; integrations are delivered through named partner connectors. It was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures.
h.name: Hireology

h.description: HireRight is a leading global provider of employment background screening, drug and health screening, and workforce verification services, helping more than 28,000 organizations across 200+ countries and territories run and manage their screening programs. Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, HireRight offers 250+ products and services spanning criminal, financial, identity, education and employment verification, compliance, driving records, and Form I-9 checks, and screened roughly 85 million people in 2025. HireRight does not publish a public developer REST API or developer portal; its integration surface is partner- and contract-based, delivered through 70+ prebuilt connectors with 45+ HCM and ATS partners (including Workday, ADP, Oracle, and UKG) and the Applicant Center candidate experience. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public, machine-readable, and security/compliance surface (llms.txt, trust center, disclosure, domain security) rather than an open API.
h.name: HireRight
