This is a defunct/historical entity with no independent, live developer or API surface. The enrichment pass found no attributable API to enrich; the live i2group.com intelligence-analysis APIs belong to a different, unrelated company (a name collision), and the "insight-partners" backing appears to be an erroneous VC-portfolio match.
i.name: I2 Technologies Inc (THINK SYSTEMS)

i.description: Outpace legacy and unproven modern platforms with i2c’s next generation platform and composable solutions built for speed, reliability and scale. i2c Inc. provides a comprehensive suite of banking and payments APIs, enabling fintechs and enterprises to integrate core financial services quickly and securely.
i.name: i2c

i.description: i2x is a German real-time AI platform for contact centers, built by i2x GmbH in Mönchengladbach. It provides live agent assistance that surfaces contextual recommendations during calls in under 0.4 seconds, including automatic detection of purchase signals and faster agent onboarding; full-coverage call analysis with automatic transcription plus quality, compliance, and sales-opportunity scoring across 100% of conversations; and voicebots for automated inbound/outbound telephony and virtual agent-training scenarios. The platform emphasizes DSGVO/GDPR compliance with EU-only hosting in German data centers, prepared works-council documentation, and EU AI Act alignment, positioning itself as an alternative to US-cloud-dependent conversation-intelligence tools. i2x publishes no developer program: no API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL specification, no SDK on any package registry, no public GitHub organization, no MCP server, no agent card, no status page and no pricing — the only commercial entry point is a demo-request form. A private, login-gated API host does exist at api.eu.i2x.ai serving the customer web application at app.i2x.ai, but it is undocumented and is not offered as an integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital.
i.name: i2x

i.description: A free, no-authentication open-data REST API from i6eal (a German AI studio operated by Syka Ventures UG) exposing 16 AI-related datasets and monitors for Germany and the EU as static JSON/CSV/JSON-LD/Atom files served over HTTPS from CloudFront. Coverage spans public procurement, federal budget lines, case law, supervisory authorities, standardisation work items, EU AI Act transparency evidence, medical devices, clinical trials, platform automation, enforcement actions and adoption statistics. Backed by a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract with 83 GET operations, a DCAT JSON-LD catalogue of 16 datasets and 82 distributions, a provider-published llms.txt, and per-dataset Atom change feeds. No authentication, no registration, no published rate limit; CORS is open and responses carry ETag validators. The i6eal compilation is CC BY 4.0; underlying official records retain their source-specific rights.
i.name: i6eal Open AI Data API

i.description: IA Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm based in New York City, at 920 Broadway, 15th Floor. It backs founders building data-driven businesses across financial technology, machine learning, and infrastructure, typically at the seed and early stage. IA Ventures was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent firm within the API Evangelist network and is profiled here as a venture-capital company rather than an API producer: it publishes a minimal single-page website and does not expose a public API, developer portal, or event surface. This profile captures the firm's identity and the security posture of its public domain.
i.name: IA Ventures

i.description: IAB Technology Laboratory (IAB Tech Lab) is the non-profit consortium that writes the technical standards the digital advertising supply chain runs on — OpenRTB (real-time bidding), AdCOM, OpenDirect (programmatic direct), VAST and VMAP (video ad serving), the Transparency and Consent Framework and Global Privacy Platform (consent signals), ads.txt, app-ads.txt and sellers.json (supply-chain transparency), the Open Measurement SDK and the content/audience/ad-product taxonomies. Its machine-readable contracts are published in the open on GitHub: an OpenRTB 2.x Protocol Buffers definition, the AdCOM protobuf, an OpenDirect Swagger specification, VAST XSDs, and an agentic-advertising stack (buyer-agent, seller-agent, Deals API, Agentic RTB Framework gRPC) that ships OpenAPI 3.1 contracts, JSON Schema primitives, MCP servers and A2A agent cards as reference implementations. The Tech Lab Tools Portal and its Core API sit behind a member login.
i.name: IAB Tech Lab

i.description: IAC (InterActiveCorp) is a media and internet company comprising widely known consumer brands such as Vimeo, Dotdash Meredith (People Inc.), Angi, Care.com, Search (Ask Media Group, Investopedia), and Emerging brands including Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, Daily Burn, Apalon, Mosaic Group, and NurseFly. No consolidated public developer APIs are documented at the parent company level; subsidiaries may operate their own developer programs.
i.name: IAC/InterActiveCorp

i.description: IAD Group (I@D International) is a European real-estate network company that combines real estate, digital tools, and network marketing to digitalize the traditional agency model through a network of independent agents rather than brick-and-mortar offices. Founded in France, IAD operates across France, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Germany, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States (Florida), with roughly 20,000 independent agents, around 500 employees, more than 96,000 online property listings, and 521 million euros in 2025 turnover. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. IAD publishes a consumer/agent web presence but no public developer platform or API surface at this time.
i.name: IAD

i.description: IAG Research, Inc. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: unknown. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: IAG Research, Inc.

i.description: Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a framework of policies and technologies that ensures the right users have appropriate access to technology resources. IAM encompasses authentication, authorization, and the management of digital identities across systems. This index tracks IAM-related APIs, standards, and developer resources.
i.name: IAM

i.description: Iambic Therapeutics is a clinical-stage AI drug discovery company headquartered in San Diego. Its proprietary AI platform pairs the NeuralPLexer 3D generative model for protein-ligand structure prediction with the Enchant multimodal transformer for clinical and preclinical endpoint prediction, integrated with automated wet-lab capabilities. Iambic's clinical pipeline includes IAM1363 (HER2), IAM-K1 (KIF18A), and IAM-C1 (CDK2/4) in oncology. Iambic is a therapeutics developer rather than an API provider and does not publish a public developer API or open-source platform.
i.name: Iambic Therapeutics

i.description: Buddy (iambuddy.com, now buddy.insure) is a digital insurance commerce platform that turns insurance product rules, pricing, and workflows into structured data via its Insurance Object Notation (ION) engine, so carriers, MGAs, brokers, and agents can sell P&C insurance online across direct, agent-assisted, embedded, and agentic channels without core-system changes. Its Offer Element embeddable checkout widget adds quote, apply, bind, and pay in a few lines of code, and Buddy MCP connects insurance products to AI assistants such as Claude for conversational selling. Founded by Charles Merritt and David Vogeleer in Richmond, Virginia, Buddy is licensed in all 50 states and is SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI DSS compliant, working with carriers including Allstate, Aon, W.R. Berkley, Chubb, Great American, and Starr.
i.name: iambuddy.com

i.description: ianacare ("iana" = I Am Not Alone) is a Boston-based caregiver support and navigation platform that sells to employers, health plans and providers as a benefit for the working family caregivers in their populations. Founded in 2018 by Jessica Kim and Steven Lee, it pairs a consumer mobile app — where a caregiver mobilizes an informal care team, coordinates practical tasks, unlocks employer benefits and finds local resources — with human Caregiver Navigators, and positions itself as a partner for fulfilling CMS GUIDE Model dementia-care requirements. The company raised a $12.1M Series A in January 2022 led by Greycroft with 8VC, SemperVirens, Able Partners and the Brown Angel Group. ianacare ships software only as an end-user product: the iOS and Android apps and the app.ianacare.com web client are backed by first-party hosts (iana.ianacare.com behind a JWT bearer token, api.ianacare.com behind a CloudFront 403) and by ianacare's own Auth0 custom domain auth.ianacare.com, which is the single machine-readable contract the company publishes. There is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDK, CLI, webhook catalog, MCP server or agent card on any ianacare host.
i.name: ianacare

i.description: Iantrek, Inc. is a venture-backed ophthalmic medical technology company headquartered in White Plains, New York, pioneering the field it calls bio-interventional ophthalmic surgery (BIOS) for the treatment of glaucoma. Founded in 2019 by ophthalmic innovator Sean Ianchulev, MD, MPH, the company develops micro-interventional surgical devices that reinforce and restore the eye's natural aqueous outflow pathways with biologic allograft tissue rather than bypassing or removing tissue. Its commercial and pipeline portfolio includes AlloFlo Uveo, AlloSert Uveo, C-Rex and AlloSpan Canal. Iantrek has raised approximately $103M across its rounds, including a $42M Series C used to launch AlloFlo Uveo in the United States in October 2025. Iantrek publishes a corporate and surgeon-facing marketing website at iantrekmed.com; it operates no public developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.
i.name: Iantrek

i.description: IASIS Healthcare was a leading owner and operator of acute care hospitals in growing urban markets in the United States before being acquired by Steward Health Care in 2017. Operations and any legacy developer resources have since been consolidated under Steward Health Care.

i.description: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) is the global trade association representing and serving the airline industry. IATA sets standards for the aviation industry, promotes cooperation among airlines, and operates an Open API Hub providing access to airline-published APIs for flight status, destinations, baggage, ticket validation, cargo, digital identity, and related aviation data services.
i.name: IATA

i.description: IATI Registry is a open data portal open-data portal running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 13,656 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.
i.name: IATI Registry

i.description: iBanFirst is a Brussels-headquartered cross-border payment and foreign-exchange platform for businesses, licensed as a payment institution by the National Bank of Belgium (company number 0849.872.824) and operating across Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Romania, Bulgaria, Italy, Hungary and the United Kingdom. It provides multi-currency "augmented currency accounts" with dedicated IBANs, SWIFT and SEPA payments with payment tracking, spot FX in 30+ currencies, and fixed forward payment contracts for currency-risk hedging. Its developer surface is a public REST API (iBanFirst API 1.6.0, 38 operations over accounts, financial movements, beneficiaries, payments, spot trades, fixed forwards, documents and webhook subscriptions), X-WSSE token authentication, HMAC-SHA256-signed webhooks for payment and trade events, a separate eIDAS/QWAC-gated PSD2 XS2A API for AIS and PIS third-party providers, and a hosted first-party remote MCP server that gives agents read access to treasury data.
i.name: iBanFirst

i.description: Pre-payout IBAN screening for developers and AI agents — validation, issuing-bank identification against national bank registers, Swiss clearing including QR-IID, bank-level sanctions, SEPA and VoP reachability, and risk scoring across 89 IBAN countries.
i.name: IBANforge

i.description: iBasis is a global communications solutions provider serving mobile operators, MVNOs, over-the-top players, and IoT device companies worldwide. Its portfolio spans international and managed voice, 5G data roaming and roaming hub/breakout, A2P and RCS messaging monetization, and IoT connectivity built on eSIM technology, the Simfony connectivity-management platform, MVNO-as-a-Service, and fixed wireless access. iBasis also offers signaling and fraud security (FraudLock iQ360, Security iQ360, Signaling Vulnerability Scanner) and business intelligence for carriers. Customer and partner operations run through the eCare portal behind single sign-on; iBasis does not currently publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specifications, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched from the public iBasis web presence and live domain probes.
i.name: iBasis

i.description: Iberdrola, S.A., is a multinational electric utility company headquartered in Bilbao, Spain. It is one of the world’s leading electricity producers and distributors, operating in multiple countries across Europe, the United States, and Latin America. The company focuses on renewable energy generation, smart grid technologies, and sustainable energy solutions, serving millions of customers worldwide. Iberdrola’s digital transformation includes a range of APIs for energy data, billing, smart devices, and sustainability reporting, enabling developers and partners to integrate with its services and promote greener energy consumption.
i.name: Iberdrola

i.description: IBEX Process Technology was a semiconductor-industry technology company based in Lowell, Massachusetts, founded around 2000, that developed neural-network-based process control systems for semiconductor fabrication. The company raised roughly $6.8M across two funding rounds and is now defunct (deadpooled), with an Involuntary Revocation status on its Massachusetts registration. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub from battery-ventures data; enrichment finds no live website, no developer/API surface, and no machine-readable specifications to harvest.

Its IBM Vault® product is highlighted as a tool for identity protection and regulatory compliance, and IBM hosts webinars on trust, identity, and governance in the AI era. The company targets organizations seeking secure identity management and access control across their systems.

i.description: IBM App Connect is an integration platform that enables organizations to connect applications, data, and services across cloud and on-premises environments. It provides low-code integration capabilities with pre-built connectors and a flow editor for building integration flows.

i.description: IBM Db2 is a family of data management products from IBM that includes relational and hybrid database servers running on cloud, distributed, and z/OS platforms, supporting transactional, analytical, and AI workloads. Db2 exposes RESTful services that let applications create, discover, execute, and manage user-defined services natively against the database, and IBM Db2 as a Service on IBM Cloud provides a managed REST API for administering and querying cloud-hosted Db2 databases. Authentication is performed via HTTP basic auth, client certificates, or IBM Cloud IAM Bearer tokens depending on the deployment.
i.name: IBM Db2

i.description: IBM Watson Language Translator was a REST API service for translating text between 35+ languages, detecting input language automatically, and creating custom domain-specific translation models using TMX, XLIFF, or CSV training data. The service supported neural machine translation (NMT) and was available through IBM Cloud. IBM deprecated the service in June 2023 and fully withdrew it in December 2024.

The platform combines an Apache-2.0 software stack (Qiskit, qiskit-ibm-runtime, qiskit-ibm-catalog, Qiskit Aer, Qiskit Serverless, Qiskit Functions) with a tiered access model (Open / Pay-As-You-Go / Flex / Premium / On-Premises) and is the longest-running commercial quantum computing API surface in the industry.

The platform integrates with AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, VMware, and dozens of APM and ITSM tools.

i.description: iboss, Inc. is a Boston-headquartered cybersecurity company founded in 2003 that operates an AI-powered, cloud-native Zero Trust SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) platform used by more than 4,000 enterprise, US federal, state and local government, and K-12 education organizations. The platform consolidates Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), DNS security, SD-WAN and AI chat monitoring into a single containerized service in which each customer receives dedicated gateway containers rather than shared infrastructure. iboss is FedRAMP and StateRAMP authorized and holds SOC 2 Type II, FIPS 140-2, HIPAA, CJIS, FERPA and GDPR alignment. Platform administration and reporting run over an authenticated REST surface at api.ibosscloud.com/ibcloud/web, which third parties including Datadog, Axonius, Google Security Operations and D3 Security integrate against; iboss publishes no public OpenAPI definition, developer portal or API reference, and its documentation host redirects to a sign-in-gated GitBook space.
i.name: iboss

i.description: Ibotta is a Denver-based consumer technology company (NYSE: IBTA) that operates a cash-back rewards platform and the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN), a digital promotions and retail-media network. Consumers earn real cash back on everyday purchases in-store and online through the Ibotta mobile app, browser extension, and connected retailer loyalty accounts. For brands, agencies, and retailers, the Ibotta Performance Network distributes digital rebates and promotions to more than 200 million shoppers across Ibotta's owned properties and a network of partner retailers and publishers (including Walmart, Dollar General, Family Dollar, and others). Ibotta was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GGV Capital. Ibotta publishes exactly one machine-readable API contract: the Ibotta Product API (an OpenAPI 3.0.1 document at ibotta.com/bex-api/api-docs.json), declared by the ChatGPT plugin manifest Ibotta still serves at ibotta.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json — a single product-search operation backing the Ibotta browser extension, gated by a service bearer token that is not self-serve. The Ibotta Performance Network APIs that partners actually integrate against are documented only inside the IPN partner portal (portal.ipn.ibotta.com), which is behind Auth0 and reached through a sales conversation; no public IPN API reference, pricing, or rate-limit documentation exists.
i.name: Ibotta

i.description: iCapital (Institutional Capital Network, Inc.) is a New York-headquartered financial technology company, founded in 2013, that operates the alternative investments marketplace and the operating infrastructure behind it. Its platform lets wealth managers, RIAs, family offices and institutional investors research, subscribe to, service and report on private markets funds, hedge funds, structured investments, annuities, model portfolios and separately managed accounts, while asset managers use it to distribute those products into the wealth channel. iCapital Marketplace advertises access to funds from 700+ asset managers and reports $945B+ in global platform assets. Around the marketplace sit Architect (portfolio construction and analytics), Data Solutions (alternative data management and consolidated reporting), Identity Solutions (KYC/AML), and iCapital DLT, an API-first distributed ledger platform built on the Canton Network. Integration with custodians, fund administrators, transfer agents and advisor platforms (BNY, Fidelity, Envestnet, Orion, Morningstar, Vestmark, TradePMR, GeoWealth, Ultimus, UMB) happens through SSO, embedded workflows and partner data integrations. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment pass iCapital publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable API contract or client SDKs; API documentation is described as available to integration partners only, through the sales and technical-support organization.
i.name: iCapital Network

i.description: Icardio.AI (iCardio.ai) builds artificial-intelligence software that automates the interpretation of cardiac ultrasound (echocardiography). Its FDA 510(k)-cleared products include EchoMeasure, which identifies cardiac phases and automatically measures anatomical structures to produce comprehensive echo reports, and CardioVision, which automatically detects aortic stenosis and structural heart disease from ultrasound clips (also granted FDA Breakthrough Device Designation). Additional tooling includes EchoCheck image-quality and view classification, quantitative linear and volumetric measurements, qualitative structural-disease analysis, and EchoGPT image-to-text description. The company trains on a database of 200M+ echocardiography images and partners with ultrasound manufacturers, PACS vendors, and healthcare systems, offering API integration into enterprise PACS workflows. Icardio.AI is a Techstars portfolio company.
i.name: Icardio.AI

i.description: Icarus is an aerospace and defense company building autonomous, solar-powered stratospheric aircraft for persistent surveillance and connectivity. Its APOLLO platform operates continuously above 60,000 feet, delivering rapid aerial intelligence, wide-area coverage across 1,000+ square miles, and always-on, low-latency (5-10ms) direct-to-device communications for weeks-long missions without ground infrastructure. Founded in 2023 and based in El Segundo, California, Icarus was part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch. The company operates in the defense/aerospace hardware space and does not currently publish any public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical developer surface; this profile captures its identity for the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Icarus

i.description: Iceberg Quantum is a quantum architecture firm building fault-tolerant quantum computing systems around LDPC (Low-Density Parity-Check) error-correction codes. Its designs aim to cut the hardware overhead of quantum error correction by more than an order of magnitude, and its Pinnacle architecture claims roughly 10x lower overhead through modular lattice surgery and time-overhead compression. The company is hardware- and architecture-focused rather than a software/API provider; it partners with qubit hardware makers (PsiQuantum, Diraq, Oxford Ionics) and is backed by DCVC, Blackbird, and LocalGlobe. Surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking; there is no public API, SDK, or developer surface to enrich at this stage.
i.name: Iceberg Quantum

i.description: iceonline (冰场联盟) operates an enterprise-grade backend management platform for ice rinks in China, published at www.iceonline.cn as a login-gated single-page administrative console branded "冰场联盟 企业级后台管理系统" (Ice Rink Alliance Enterprise Management System). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the public surface is a private SPA with no discoverable API: no OpenAPI/Swagger, SDK, developer portal, changelog, or security.txt was found — every probed path (including /.well-known/*, /swagger.json, /openapi.json) returns the SPA shell rather than a real document. Only live domain-security posture (TLS/DNS) could be captured this round.

i.description: Iceotope Technologies is a Sheffield, UK precision liquid cooling company founded in 2005 as a research-driven "green computing" venture, now supplying chassis-level liquid cooling for AI, HPC, data center and edge infrastructure. Its "direct to everything" single-phase immersion approach removes heat from every component rather than the processor alone, and ships as two product lines: KUL BOX for near-edge AI and HPC deployments, and KUL AI liquid-cooled server chassis for high-density rack environments. The company licenses its thermal IP (228 patents granted, allowed and pending) and works through OEM/ODM partnerships with vendors including HPE, Intel and nVent. Iceotope is a hardware and thermal-engineering business: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.
i.name: Iceotope

i.description: Icera Semiconductor (icerasemi.com) was a British fabless semiconductor company known for soft-modem and baseband processor chipsets for wireless devices, and was acquired by NVIDIA in 2011. It was surfaced as a portfolio lead of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company no longer operates independently; as of this enrichment pass the domain www.icerasemi.com returns a shared-hosting error page with no live product, developer, API, or documentation surface, so there is nothing beyond domain-level metadata to enrich.
i.name: icerasemi

i.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.
i.name: Icertis

i.description: ICEYE operates the world's largest constellation of small Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellites, delivering all-weather day-and-night imagery down to 25 cm resolution across multiple modes. The ICEYE API Platform at api.iceye.com exposes a Catalog API over an archive of 60,000+ SAR scenes and a Tasking API that lets customers schedule the constellation up to 14 days in advance without a feasibility study or human-in-the-loop. A companion Company API exposes account context. Beyond raw imagery, ICEYE publishes natural catastrophe products - Flood Insights, Wildfire Insights, and Hurricane Insights - used by insurance, government, banking, and utilities customers, and ships Gen 4 ISR, ISR Cell, Connect, and Federate sovereign mission systems for defense and intelligence.
i.name: ICEYE

i.description: ICF (NASDAQ: ICFI), formerly ICF International, is a global consulting and digital services firm headquartered in Reston, Virginia, delivering management, technology, and policy consulting to US federal agencies, state and local governments, utilities, and commercial clients. ICF serves markets spanning government, energy, environment, infrastructure, transportation, health, education, social programs, public safety, and disaster management, with approximately 9,000 employees worldwide. The firm has invested in an in-house AI offering branded "ICF Fathom," but no public REST APIs, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation have been identified. ICF's work is delivered under contract rather than through a productized developer platform.
i.name: ICF (ICF International)

i.description: iChase Co., Ltd. (iCHASE) builds AI-powered biosecurity and precision-farming systems for modern agriculture. Its integrated computer-vision monitoring platform protects livestock and optimizes growth for dairy, poultry, warehouse/industrial, and utility operations. Flagship products include the AI Bird Repeller, which detects birds in real time and deploys automated, chemical-free laser deterrence to reduce avian-flu and contamination risk, and InsightScale, which uses 3D scanning and AI weight prediction to track poultry Average Daily Gain and uniformity without stressful manual weighing. iCHASE is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program, a 2024 THRIVE Top 100 Global Innovator, and a 500 Global portfolio company. The site markets an "Open API" capability, but no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs were discoverable at the time of enrichment.

i.name: iCIMS

i.description: ICON Technology, Inc. is an Austin, Texas construction-technology company building large-scale robotic 3D printing systems, materials, and software to make home building faster, more affordable, and more resilient. Its flagship Titan 3D construction printer, orchestrated by the proprietary BuildOS software that translates architectural designs into robotic tool paths and manages material flow, can print the wall system of a 2,500 sq. ft. home in under seven days. ICON operates a Design + Build division delivering 3D-printed homes and communities, a Technology division selling its printers and building systems to other builders, the CODEX digital home design catalog, and ICON Prime. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Bond Capital and Pantera Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a venture-portfolio lead; ICON publishes a marketing and product presence but no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.
i.name: ICON

i.description: ICON Aircraft is an American light-sport aircraft manufacturer founded in 2006 by Kirk Hawkins and Steen Strand and headquartered in Vacaville, California. It designs, builds and sells the ICON A5, an amphibious two-seat S-LSA with folding wings, a spin-resistant airframe, an optional ICON Parachute System and a Rotax 912iS engine, sold alongside flight training, a certified pre-owned program and a service-provider network. The A5 entered production in 2016 and received FAA type certification in the primary category in December 2023. Since April 2025 ICON has been a sister company of Flight Design under Shang Gong Group. ICON is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no product API, no SDKs and no developer portal. Two machine-readable surfaces do exist on its own domains and are profiled here — the WordPress REST content API behind www.iconaircraft.com, which is anonymously readable and read-only, and the Shopify-hosted Shop ICON merchandise storefront at store.iconaircraft.com, which serves storefront JSON plus a live, anonymous Universal Commerce Protocol MCP endpoint with thirteen catalog, cart, checkout and order tools.

i.description: Icon Source is a Denver, Colorado marketplace that connects brands, marketing agencies and universities with professional and college athletes for endorsement, appearance, speaking and social-media deals, including Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) engagements. Founded in 2018 by Chase Garrett, the platform lets brands search and filter verified athletes by location, interest, rate, audience size and demographics, build and send contracts, and pay athletes in-platform, charging a 10% transaction fee on each deal that is signed and closed. A companion product, Icon Suite (launched March 2022), gives universities NIL disclosure and compliance tooling. Icon Source is delivered strictly as an end-user product — a web application at prod.iconsource.app plus iOS and Android apps — and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

Founded by veterans of GTA, Forza, Just Cause, and Sleeping Dogs with AI researchers from Cambridge and Imperial College, the company is backed by Northzone. i.description: iconik is a hybrid cloud media asset management (MAM) platform for video and media teams, letting organizations ingest, organize, search, collaborate on, and distribute media across cloud and on-premise storage without vendor lock-in. iconik is API-first: nearly everything in the product is exposed through a set of versioned REST microservice APIs - Assets, Collections, Metadata, Search, Files, and Jobs - so integrators can automate ingest, enrich metadata, drive search and discovery, manage files and formats across connected storages, and orchestrate asynchronous work. The API is authenticated with an application ID and an auth token generated by an administrator in the web UI, and event notifications are delivered as HTTP webhooks.

i.description: ICONIQ Capital is a global investment firm founded in December 2011 by Divesh Makan, Michael Anders, and Chad Boeding, headquartered in San Francisco, California with offices in Palo Alto, New York, London, and Singapore. Its venture arm, ICONIQ Growth, partners with founders from inception through IPO and beyond, backing category-leading technology companies across enterprise software, infrastructure, data, developer tools, fintech, security, healthcare IT, and — since 2023 — artificial intelligence as a core theme. ICONIQ Growth has invested in 140+ companies and produced notable outcomes including Snowflake, Airbnb, GitLab, HashiCorp, Datadog, Docusign, Adyen, Uber, Zoom, and Procore, alongside active AI positions in Anthropic, OpenAI, Writer, Glean, ElevenLabs, and Sierra.

i.description: iContainers is a digital freight forwarder founded in 2007 in Barcelona and now part of Agility Logistics, following its 2019/2022 merger with Shipa Freight. The platform lets SMEs, importers/exporters, moving companies, freight agents and individuals search, compare, book, insure, document and track international ocean freight (FCL and LCL), air freight, air express and customs clearance across 250,000+ trade routes to 300+ destinations. Developer access is published as the "Brutus API" — an OpenAPI 3.0.0 contract rendered on developer.icontainers.com covering FCL/LCL/air/LTL quoting, rate price calculation, place/port search, booking a rate, booking track-and-trace, and booking document upload/download — secured with JWT bearer tokens. iContainers also sells a white-label freight forwarding portal, and its operational layer is supplied by the third-party platform VelocityOS.ai.
i.name: iContainers

i.description: iControl is a Swedish construction-technology company whose mobile application digitalizes documentation on construction sites, replacing paper-based protocols and inspection records with real-time digital capture. Field personnel create, share, and manage project documentation from the job site, with offline capture that syncs when connectivity returns, drawing and blueprint uploads, and team collaboration. Marketed under the promise "Skriv aldrig ett protokoll igen" (never write a protocol again), iControl is used by leading Nordic contractors including NCC, JM, Veidekke, ARCONA, and In3prenor across infrastructure, residential, commercial, and public-facility projects. The company is headquartered in Stockholm and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. iControl exposes a consumer-facing web and mobile application; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK was found during enrichment.
i.name: iControl

i.description: IControl Networks was a smart-home and home-security platform company (OpenHome / Connect, Piper) backed by Kleiner Perkins. It was acquired by Comcast in 2017 (the platform underpinned Xfinity Home) with its residential SaaS business sold to Alarm.com; it no longer operates as an independent entity. Enrichment probe (2026-07-20): the icontrol.com domain no longer serves a website and is now delegated to Comcast nameservers (dns10x.comcast.net); icontrolnetworks.com, developer.icontrol.com, and api.icontrol.com do not resolve. No live developer portal, documentation, or public API surface exists to harvest. Sector: hardtech / IoT.
i.name: IControl Networks

i.description: The Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research (ICPSR) at the University of Michigan provides a curated archive of social science data, offering tools for data discovery, access, and management. It supports researchers, educators, and policymakers with datasets spanning health, politics, economics, and more, and provides documentation, help guides, and membership resources.
i.name: ICPSR

i.description: iCracked is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: iCracked

i.description: GraphQL based NFT API
i.name: icy.tools

i.description: ID Analytics was a San Diego-based identity risk and fraud analytics company founded in 2002. It operated the ID Network, a cross-industry consortium of consumer identity behavior, and productized it as ID Score and related fraud-detection, credit-risk, and identity-verification analytics used by financial services, telecommunications, and government. The company was acquired by LifeLock in 2012, passed to Symantec when it bought LifeLock in 2017, and was sold to LexisNexis Risk Solutions in 2020, where its capabilities are now delivered. It no longer operates an independent developer portal or public API; idanalytics.com now redirects to LexisNexis Risk Solutions.
i.name: Id Analytics

i.description: ID Analyzer is a cloud-based identity verification platform providing REST APIs for extracting and validating data from passports, driver licenses, and ID cards across 190+ countries. Core capabilities include document OCR with anti-forgery detection, biometric face matching and liveness verification, AML/PEP sanctions screening, and a hosted DocuPass KYC onboarding flow. The platform is ISO 27001 certified and compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, and NIST IAL2 standards.
i.name: ID Analyzer

i.description: ID Planet is a Web3 GameFi company building an EVM-compatible blockchain ecosystem for blockchain gaming. Its published ecosystem spans ID Planet Chain, the ID Explorer block explorer, the ID Wallet multi-chain wallet, ID SWAP (a decentralized exchange), ID PLANETXC (a centralized exchange) and an NFT marketplace, alongside first-party game titles Infinitar (5v5 MOBA), Runesoul (ARPG) and CoolGods (MOBA). The $ID governance token is issued as a BEP20 asset on BNB Chain with a total supply of 7,800,000,000 and a mining/burn distribution model. Company material is published as a GitBook whitepaper in eight languages. As of 2026-08-22 ID Planet publishes no developer portal, API reference, RPC endpoint, chain ID or machine-readable specification on any host it controls, so this profile is identity and documentation only.
i.name: ID Planet

i.description: ID.me is a digital identity network that provides NIST 800-63-3 IAL2/AAL2 identity verification, single sign-on, and group affiliation (community) verification for government agencies, healthcare, and commercial partners. For developers, ID.me exposes an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 identity provider (authorization code flow with PKCE, plus SAML 2.0 federation), a REST Services API for telecom and document verification, an Applications API, a Document Passback API, and a Shared Signals Framework (SSF) event stream for fraud and verification signals. Native iOS and Android SDKs, a button widget, conversion tracking, and multi-language sample code round out the developer surface, letting relying parties add strong identity proofing and attribute exchange to any application or IAM platform (Okta, Keycloak, Entra, PingOne, AWS Cognito).
i.name: ID.me

i.description: Ideal Invest (operating as Pravaler) is a Brazilian fintech founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sao Paulo that provides private student financing for higher education. Through its Pravaler platform, students can split tuition payments across roughly twice the duration of a course, with a 100% digital, low-bureaucracy application, competitive monthly interest rates, and no ENEM requirement. Pravaler works with a network of 500+ partner higher-education institutions and has financed more than 400,000 students, channeling over R$12 billion into Brazilian education. The company is backed by Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Pravaler exposes a consumer web platform (simulation, application, digital signature) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or partner integration surface.
i.name: Ideal Invest

i.description: Ideal Power Inc. (NASDAQ: IPWR), formerly Ideal Power Converters, is an Austin, Texas power semiconductor company developing bidirectional bipolar junction transistor (B-TRAN) technology for ultra-low conduction losses, bidirectional current flow, and fast fault protection and switching. Its product portfolio includes B-TRAN power switches, SymCool power modules, and B-TRAN Known Good Die, targeting data centers, energy storage systems, power grids, solid-state circuit breakers, and EV charging infrastructure. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; the company publishes a corporate and investor web presence but no public developer API or programmatic surface at this time.
i.name: Ideal Power Converters

i.description: IDEAYA Biosciences is a clinical-stage precision medicine oncology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California (NASDAQ IDYA), focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing targeted therapeutics for genetically defined cancer patient populations. Its research spans PKC inhibition in uveal melanoma, antibody-drug conjugate and DNA-damage-response combinations, synthetic-lethal MTAP-pathway programs, and KAT6/7 epigenetic inhibition, led by the investigational candidate darovasertib in registrational uveal melanoma trials. The company maintains a corporate and investor-relations web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API.
i.name: Ideaya Biosciences

i.description: IDEC Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: IDEC Pharmaceuticals

i.description: IDECSI is a Microsoft 365 and on-premises data security platform focused on Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) and Data Access Governance (DAG). It helps mid-size and large enterprises eliminate access, permission, and sharing risks across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and file systems, with advanced monitoring, permission analysis, and user-driven security workflows. IDECSI serves large organizations such as L'Oreal, TotalEnergies, SNCF, Renault, and ADP, and aligns with regulatory frameworks including NIS2, DORA, and the EU AI Act. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and help center but no public developer API or specification at this time.
i.name: Idecsi

i.description: iDenfy is an identity verification platform providing KYC, KYB, and AML compliance solutions. The iDenfy API enables businesses to verify identities, check for fraud, and comply with regulatory requirements through automated document verification, facial recognition, AML screening, business verification, and bank verification services.
i.name: iDenfy

i.description: Identify Software Ltd. was an Israeli enterprise-software company founded in 1996 in Petah Tikva by Yochi Slonim, backed by earlybird (invested 2001). It built application performance management, software-testing, and business-process-automation tooling that helped IT teams reproduce, diagnose, and resolve production application problems, best known for its AppSight problem-resolution suite. It is a legacy portfolio entry rather than an active API provider: the identify.software domain is parked/for-sale, there is no live developer portal, documentation, or public API surface to enrich, so this profile is retained as a historical VC-portfolio lead only.
i.name: Identify Software

i.description: Identify3D developed software to secure the digital (additive / 3D-printing) manufacturing supply chain by encrypting, distributing, and tracing digital part files, so that a part could only be produced by an authorized user, machine, and material and non-conforming or counterfeit parts could not enter the physical supply chain. The suite coupled part designs with production criteria (designated user, machine, material) and provided intellectual-property protection, digital-rights management, and traceability for distributed manufacturing. Founded in San Francisco and backed by Uncork Capital, Identify3D was acquired by Materialise NV in October 2021 and its technology was folded into the Materialise CO-AM distributed-manufacturing platform. The company no longer operates a standalone product, developer portal, or public API; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for historical and VC portfolio-graph purposes.
i.name: Identify3D

i.description: Identiq operates a privacy-preserving, peer-to-peer identity validation network that lets member companies confirm a customer is already known and trusted by other members without any party sharing, exposing, or centralizing personal data. Its patented anonymized protocol keeps identity data encrypted inside each member's own environment while answering cross-network trust queries in real time. Products include customer identification, sign-up validation, risk-based onboarding, payment optimization, and trust & safety, serving travel, e-commerce, ticketing, fintech, telco, and marketplace verticals. Identiq is a cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; it publishes a public trust center but no public developer API.
i.name: Identiq

i.description: Ideogram is an image generation platform notable for industry-leading text-in-image rendering. The Ideogram API (3.0 and beyond) supports generation, edit, inpaint, remix, reframe, replace background, layerize text, upscale, describe, and remove background, plus custom model training with dataset and asset management. Authenticated REST API with published OpenAPI 3.1 spec.
i.name: Ideogram

i.description: Ideon provides data management and connectivity solutions for employee benefits, offering APIs for plan and rate data, provider directories, enrollment, and market insights. Their platform enables carriers, brokers, and employers to access accurate, up-to-date benefits information, improve quoting, and streamline enrollment processes.
i.name: Ideon

i.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.
i.name: Ideon Technologies

i.description: IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX) is a global engineered products company that designs and manufactures pumps, flow meters, valves, fluidics systems, precision components, and fire and safety equipment. IDEX serves health, science, water, energy, semiconductor, aerospace, fire and safety, and industrial markets through three segments: Fluid and Metering Technologies, Health and Science Technologies, and Fire and Safety / Diversified Products.
i.name: IDEX

i.description: IDEXX Laboratories is a global leader in veterinary diagnostics, offering reference laboratory testing, in-house analyzers (IDEXX VetLab Station), diagnostic imaging (IDEXX Web PACS), and practice management software (Cornerstone, Neo, and ezyVet, which IDEXX acquired in 2021). IDEXX connects the practice to its diagnostic ecosystem through VetConnect PLUS - a diagnostic results and ordering platform - and through partner integration APIs for Web PACS imaging and reference/in-house lab results. These developer integrations are partner-gated - the developer portal at developer.vetconnectplus.com requires an authenticated login, and partner access is granted only after an approved IDEXX integration request. Web PACS API Partner integrations authenticate with OAuth 2.0-style credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, and Grant Type) issued by IDEXX customer support. IDEXX does not publish an open, unauthenticated API reference, OpenAPI description, or pricing; the logical APIs below are modeled from IDEXX's public product and integration pages, not from a public endpoint reference.
i.name: IDEXX

i.description: Profile for IDEXX Laboratories in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 887).
i.name: IDEXX Laboratories

i.description: IDG Capital is a global investment firm founded in Boston in 1993 and headquartered in Hong Kong, widely recognized as one of the first foreign venture investors to enter China. Over more than 30 years it has grown into a multi-stage platform spanning venture capital, growth capital, buyout, secondary markets, and public markets, with reported assets under management of roughly $20–23 billion. The firm has backed 1,800+ companies and realized 600+ exits, employing 300+ staff (about 40% investment professionals) across 12 offices on three continents, including Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Singapore, Seoul, Boston, New York, Barcelona, Muscat, and the Cayman Islands. IDG Capital concentrates on Consumer, Consumer Technology, Healthcare, and Fintech/Web3, and its portfolio includes early bets on many of China's technology leaders — Tencent, Baidu, Xiaomi, Meituan, ByteDance, and Ctrip — alongside global names such as Coinbase, Circle, Farfetch, Moncler, Acne Studios, and Insta360.
i.name: IDG Capital

i.description: IDI Insurance is an insurance provider that appears on Battery Ventures' portfolio company list (recorded there as acquired) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal could be located for the company, and the source portfolio data marks it is_api_provider false, so no API artifacts have been captured. This profile remains a lead pending the discovery of a public API surface.
i.name: IDI Insurance

i.description: iDialogue Inc. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: iDialogue

i.description: Access millions of museum specimens from organizations around the world
i.name: iDigBio

i.description: Idle Finance is a decentralized yield automation protocol that has operated since 2019, enabling users and integrators to optimize yield generation across DeFi. The platform offers REST APIs for querying Best Yield and Yield Tranches pools, APY and TVL metrics, historical rates, and governance staking information. Idle aggregates yield sources across protocols such as Compound, Aave, Morpho, and Clearpool, and supports multiple chains including Ethereum, Polygon, Polygon zkEVM, and Optimism.
i.name: Idle Finance

i.description: IDnow is a European identity-verification platform offering automated (AutoIdent) and human-assisted (VideoIdent) KYC/identity proofing, plus eID and qualified electronic signing (eSign). Its RESTful gateway API lets companies create identification orders, drive the verification flow, retrieve results and documents, and subscribe to status webhooks.
i.name: IDnow

i.description: Idoven builds artificial-intelligence solutions for cardiovascular care. Its flagship platform, Willem, is a CE-marked Class IIa medical device that analyzes electrocardiograms (ECGs) to detect, diagnose, and monitor cardiac disease, identifying 22 cardiac patterns and 4 intervals across ambulatory devices, diagnostic ECGs, and insertable cardiac monitors. Idoven serves MedTech companies, Life Sciences (cardiotoxicity monitoring and disease-risk scoring for pharma trials), and preventative remote-screening programs. The Willem API supports bi-directional data exchange in EDF, HL7, DICOM, JSON, XML, and PDF. The company is headquartered in Spain, holds an extensive ISO and IEC certification program, and is backed by Insight Partners and Northzone. Sector: healthcare / cardiology AI.
i.name: IDOVEN

i.description: IDrive Inc. provides cloud backup and IDrive e2, an S3-compatible object storage service. For developers it publishes the IDrive e2 Reseller API (a REST/JSON API at api.idrivee2.com for managing users, regions, access keys, CNAME whitelabeling and subusers, authenticated with an API key sent in a token header), the S3-compatible storage endpoints themselves, and IDrive e2 MCP, an OAuth-protected hosted Model Context Protocol server at mcp.idrivee2.com/s3 (with a self-hosted option) exposing 65 bucket and object tools to AI clients.
i.name: IDrive

i.description: IDRX is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR), issued by a regulated Indonesian entity and available across multiple EVM chains and Solana. Its REST API lets business (organization) accounts onboard KYC-verified users, register bank accounts, and process mint (fiat IDR -> IDRX / USDT on-chain), redeem (IDRX -> fiat IDR to a bank account), and bridge (cross-chain) transactions, plus query swap rates, fees, supported bank methods, and transaction history. Requests are authenticated with an API key and an HMAC-SHA256 request signature, and settlement is confirmed via single-delivery webhooks or transaction-history polling. IDRX is a portfolio company of a16z (crypto).
i.name: IDRX

i.description: IDSManager (Jiuzhou Yunteng, 九州云腾) is a Chinese enterprise cybersecurity vendor providing unified identity management and zero-trust security. Its IDaaS platform centralizes account lifecycle, authentication, and authorization around a 5A framework (application center, unique accounts, single sign-on, centralized authorization, transparent auditing). The product line spans the IPG identity authentication series, MFA combining biometrics and digital certificates, the SPG secure application authentication series with Web and API gateways, and an SDP identity-defined perimeter for zero-trust access. It targets cloud migration, mobile-office security, and regulatory compliance across internet, finance, government, manufacturing, and education sectors. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is currently published.
i.name: idsmanager

i.description: IDwall (idwall.co) is a Brazilian identity verification, KYC, and anti-fraud platform. Its REST API lets companies run background checks and consult public data sources, validate documents such as the CNH (Brazilian driver's license), assemble verification reports (relatorios) from configurable matrices (matrizes), retrieve previously queried people (pessoas), and receive webhook notifications when a report's status changes. Authentication is a per-account API token passed in the Authorization header; the production base URL is https://api-v2.idwall.co and all responses are JSON. There is no sandbox - contracted tokens run against production. IDwall was backed by 500 Global and GGV Capital.
i.name: IDwall

i.description: IEC Common Information Model (CIM) is an international standard developed by the International Electrotechnical Commission for representing electrical power system data and facilitating data exchange between applications.
i.name: Iec Cim

i.description: iECURE is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company developing variant-agnostic, in vivo targeted gene insertion therapies for rare, life-threatening inherited metabolic diseases, with an initial focus on urea cycle disorders and other neurometabolic conditions of the liver. The company takes its name from iecur, the Latin word for liver, and was founded on the translational gene therapy research of James M. Wilson, M.D., Ph.D., advancing its pipeline in partnership with the University of Pennsylvania Gene Therapy Program. Its lead candidate, ECUR-506, pairs a dual-AAV delivery approach with Precision BioSciences' ARCUS nuclease to insert a functional copy of the OTC gene into the genome of infants with neonatal-onset ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency; it is in the OTC-HOPE study and has received FDA Orphan Drug, Rare Pediatric Disease, Fast Track and RMAT designations plus EU orphan designation, with clinical trial clearances in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia and the EU. Discovery-stage programs target citrullinemia type 1 and phenylketonuria. iECURE has raised roughly $115 million across a $50 million Series A in 2021 and a $65 million Series A-1 in 2022 from Versant Ventures, OrbiMed, Novo Holdings, the Qatar Investment Authority, LYFE Capital and Double Point Ventures. iECURE runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal or API documentation. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind iecure.com, catalogued here.
i.name: iECURE

i.description: IEEE Xplore is the authoritative technical library operated by the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), providing access to over 6 million documents spanning engineering, computer science, electronics, and technology. The IEEE Xplore API suite exposes a REST-based Metadata Search API for querying and retrieving abstracts and metadata across the full corpus, a DOI API for resolving up to 25 DOIs per request, an Open Access API for full-text retrieval of freely available articles, and a Full-Text Access API for institutional subscribers. API access requires key-based registration through the IEEE Developer Portal.
i.name: IEEE Xplore

i.description: The Independent Electricity System Operator (IESO) is the Crown corporation that operates Ontario's bulk electricity system and administers the province's wholesale electricity market, balancing supply and demand in real time, running the day-ahead and real-time energy and operating reserve markets, procuring capacity and transmission rights, planning the provincial grid, and delivering the Save on Energy conservation programs. It sits at the top of Canada's largest provincial electricity value chain — upstream of the licensed local distribution companies that bill retail customers — which is why its API posture splits cleanly in two. Its market and system data surface is genuinely open: a public report repository at reports-public.ieso.ca serves 139 report directories of demand, price, generation-by-fuel, intertie flow, outage, adequacy and settlement data as CSV, XML and XLSX over anonymous HTTPS with no account, key or registration, backed by published XSD schemas and a public interface specification. Its programmatic APIs are the opposite: the Axway SecureTransport REST API at reports.ieso.ca/api/v1.4, the SOAP Market Information Management web services, and the Appian-based Online IESO registration, retrofit, dispatch and outage web services are all reserved for registered Ontario market participants with IESO-issued machine accounts. IESO publishes no consumer energy-data API: Ontario's Green Button mandate (O. Reg. 633/21) binds licensed electricity and gas distributors, not the system operator, so there is no retail usage or billing surface here at all.
i.name: IESO

i.description: IEX Group, Inc. operates IEX Exchange, a U.S. national securities exchange for equities founded to make trading fairer and more transparent, along with IEX Options (coming soon). IEX is known for its Speed Bump, the IEX Signal, and the D-Limit order type. Its developer- and data-facing surface is market data and connectivity rather than a public REST API: real-time depth-of-book and top-of-book feeds (DEEP+, DEEP, and TOPS, plus their SNAP variants) are distributed over the binary IEX Transport Protocol (IEX-TP v1), with published feed specifications, downloadable historical PCAP samples, and market statistics. Data access is arranged through a Data Subscriber Agreement and direct or third-party connectivity. Sector: fintech / financial markets infrastructure. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, ICONIQ Capital, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures.
i.name: IEX

i.description: IEX Cloud was a cloud-based financial data platform from IEX Group offering market data, fundamentals, news, options, and reference APIs at https://cloud.iexapis.com/v1. The service was sunset on August 31, 2024 by IEX Group. The entry below is preserved as historical reference for migration patterns; endpoints are no longer reachable.
i.name: IEX Cloud

i.description: Integrated Finance (IF) is a modular fintech infrastructure platform — a "financial operating system" — that lets companies build banking, card, and payment experiences for their users without becoming a bank. Its orchestration layers (IF API interface, IF CORE workflow, IF CONNECT integration) sit on top of multiple banking, card-issuing, FX, and compliance providers and expose a single REST API covering clients and users, real / virtual / shared-pool accounts, incoming and outgoing bank transfers, currency exchanges, card issuing and processing (including 3DS and PIN management), beneficiary verification, generic transactions, and open-banking consents. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 on Keycloak (JWT client assertion, client_credentials); the API supports idempotency on all POST endpoints, Ed25519-signed webhooks with automatic retry, and a full sandbox environment for testing.
i.name: IF

i.description: If Insurance is a leading insurance provider in the Nordics, offering a wide range of personal and corporate insurance products including home, vehicle, health, and travel coverage. The company focuses on digital customer experiences, providing online policy management, claims handling, and personalized advice through its web portal and mobile apps. With a strong market presence and commitment to innovation, If Insurance serves millions of customers across several European countries.
i.name: If Insurance

i.description: iFood is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
i.name: iFood

i.description: IFS is a global enterprise software company providing cloud ERP, enterprise asset management, field service management, and enterprise service management platforms. APIs enable integration with IFS Cloud across manufacturing, energy, aerospace, defense, and service industries. IFS is headquartered in Linköping, Sweden with operations in over 90 countries.
i.name: IFS

i.description: IFTTT (If This Then That) is a consumer and prosumer automation platform that connects more than 750 apps, devices, and services through conditional Applets that chain triggers to actions. The IFTTT Maker Webhooks service exposes a public HTTP API that lets developers fire triggers and execute Applets from any internet-connected device using a personal Webhooks key for authentication, with both form-encoded and JSON payload variants supported.
i.name: IFTTT

i.description: Spreadbetting and CFD Market Data
i.name: IG

i.description: iGaming Tools (i-gaming.tools) is an independent data provider that documents online casino slot games and the industry around them. Its own automated pipeline drives headless browsers against live provider demos to extract 45+ structured fields per slot — RTP and up to 30 variants, volatility, max win, reels, bet mechanic, full paytables with per-symbol payouts and hex colours, bonus rounds, and ~21 screenshots with WebP derivatives — alongside slot providers, game series, themes, features, licensing regulators, ingested industry news, iGaming job vacancies and a computed search-demand layer. Access is a token-authenticated, read-only REST API (OpenAPI 3.0.3, 29 GET operations, cursor pagination, ETag/304, ?updated_since incremental sync with tombstone reconcile) plus a free unauthenticated hosted MCP server exposing 17 read-only tools, and two llms.txt files. It is not a casino, operator or betting service.
i.name: iGaming Tools

i.description: IGDB (Internet Game Database) is the world's most comprehensive video game database. The IGDB API provides access to a complete, holistic, accurate, and up-to-date data representation of the video game market, including game products, consumer opinions, and gaming industry information.
i.name: IGDB

i.description: iGent AI is a UK-based artificial intelligence company (Altrincham, Cheshire) building Maestro, an autonomous AI software-engineering agent. Maestro pairs adaptive autonomy with an ensemble of frontier AI models to plan, generate, test, and refine code across large multi-file codebases inside secure cloud sandboxes, letting developers start from scratch, upload existing code, or clone a repository. Founded by Sean Ward (CEO) and Martin Szummer (CTO), iGent AI is backed by HV Capital, XTX Markets Ventures, Twinpath VC, 10x Founders, and Dhyan VC. The product publishes developer documentation, a quick-start guide, integrations, skills, and a credits-based billing model. iGent was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network; it does not currently publish a first-party public REST API.
i.name: iGent

i.description: igetget is the English name for 得到 (Dedao), a Chinese knowledge-service and lifelong-learning platform operated by Beijing Siwei Zaowu Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京思维造物信息科技股份有限公司), the company behind Luojisiwei (罗辑思维) founded by Luo Zhenyu. The app sells curated courses, expert lectures, ebooks, and audiobooks across finance, economics, law, management, psychology, and self-improvement, alongside an enterprise edition, a web edition, and the annual "Time's Friend" (时间的朋友) New Year's Eve lecture. It is a consumer content product; enrichment found no public API specification or developer documentation, only an open-platform (开放平台) login surface at open.igetget.com. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.
i.name: igetget

i.description: IgGenix, Inc. is a clinical-stage antibody discovery and development company in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2019 on work from Stephen Quake's laboratory at Stanford in collaboration with allergy clinician-researcher Kari Nadeau. Its SEQ SIFTER platform uses single-cell RNA sequencing to capture the rare IgE-producing B cells circulating in allergic patients' blood, then re-engineers those sequences into fully human, high-affinity, allergen-specific IgG antibodies designed to block the allergic cascade before it starts. Lead program IGNX001 is a human IgG4 monoclonal antibody for peanut allergy, in the Phase 1 ACCELERATE Peanut trial, with discovery programs against alpha-gal syndrome, nsLTP allergens and atopic dermatitis autoantigens. The company has raised roughly $75M across seed, Series A and a $40M Series B. IgGenix publishes no product or developer API and no developer program; the only machine-readable surface on iggenix.com is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) served at https://iggenix.com/wp-json/, which returns the company's press releases, peer-reviewed publications, conference abstracts, careers post type, pages, media library, taxonomies and site search as anonymous JSON. The OpenAPI definitions in this repository were derived mechanically from that route index; IgGenix publishes none of its own.
i.name: IgGenix

i.description: Igloo is a full-stack insurtech firm headquartered in Singapore and operating across six Southeast Asian markets (Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam). It makes insurance simple, accessible, and affordable by embedding coverage into the platforms consumers already use, working with 100+ partners across e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, logistics, and lifestyle (including Shopee, Foodpanda, GCash, AIS, and Siam Commercial Bank). Its product line spans motor, mobile phone, travel, pet, personal accident, cyber, loan protection, e-commerce purchase protection, and blockchain-powered weather-index insurance. i.description: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (trading as IHG Hotels & Resorts) is a British asset-light hotel group headquartered at Windsor Dials, 1 Arthur Road, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1RS, United Kingdom, with an Americas office at 3 Ravinia Drive, Atlanta, Georgia. Its own corporate site states 7,014 hotels and 1,035,589 rooms across more than 100 countries, around 400,000 colleagues, 20 brands and the IHG One Rewards loyalty programme (figures read from ihgplc.com on 2026-07-28). The brand portfolio spans Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, HUALUXE, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resorts, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Garner, avid, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites, IHG Army Hotels and Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. In the distribution chain IHG sits on the supply side as a franchisor and manager rather than an owner: it aggregates independently owned and operated properties into a single central reservation system and pushes that inventory out through its own ihg.com and app direct channels, through the three GDSs and their agency terminals, through OTAs and wholesalers, and through corporate and group channels. Critically, IHG does not run its own reservation platform any more. It announced a partnership with Amadeus in 2015 to build a cloud Guest Reservation System to replace HOLIDEX, its proprietary system in service since 1965, and migrated onto it across 2018 and early 2019 — so the hotel group most likely to be a lock-in vendor is itself a customer of a GDS company's platform, and group bookings land in Amadeus Delphi and Meeting Broker. Its API posture, stated honestly, is gated and undocumented. There is no live developer portal. The one that existed — PartnerConnect RoomService at pcroomservice.ihg.com, a TIBCO Mashery portal publishing five rate, availability and hotel-content APIs — is decommissioned: the hostname is NXDOMAIN on Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 resolvers as of 2026-07-28 and the Internet Archive holds no page capture after 2019. What remains live is partnerconnect.ihg.com (HTTP 200), an affiliate marketing programme whose signup routes to Commission Junction and which still advertises "access to real-time hotel rates, availability and hotel content API's" without linking to any technical resource. Real API hostnames exist — api.ihg.com CNAMEs to ihg.api.mashery.com with an sb-ihg.mashery.com sandbox, and apis.ihg.com, b2b.ihg.com, mcp.ihg.com, booking.ihg.com and concerto.ihg.com all sit behind Akamai — but every one returns 403 Access Denied or 401 on every path probed, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, XSD, OpenTravel/OTA or HTNG reference is published anywhere by IHG. apis[] is deliberately empty: listing an Akamai-gated hostname or a decommissioned 2017 portal as a live API would be fabrication. The value of this record is the switchingCost block in review.yml, which captures what published IHG documents actually say about what it costs to leave — including the archived RoomService Terms of Use classing "API parameters" as Confidential Information and binding partners to the Master PartnerConnect Terms and Conditions plus the Six Continents Hotels E-commerce Master Service Agreement, and the current IHG One Rewards member terms stating that members whose accounts are cancelled "by IHG or by the Member, will forfeit all Points, Point vouchers, Reward Nights, and any other benefits associated with the account".
i.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts

i.description: Illustra Information Technologies was an object-relational database company founded in 1992 by Michael Stonebraker, Gary Morgenthaler and several of Stonebraker's students to commercialize the Postgres research project. NASA selected it in 1995 to store millions of satellite images. Informix Corporation acquired the company in 1996 and folded the object-relational engine and DataBlades into what became Informix Universal Server; that lineage passed to IBM and is now maintained by HCL Technologies. Illustra no longer exists as an independent entity and publishes no standalone website, developer portal, or API. i.description: Imandra Inc. delivers Reasoning as a Service — combining artificial intelligence with formal verification and automated reasoning. Its neurosymbolic platform builds mathematical models of software so that AI systems can understand, verify, and justify code behavior, prove correctness, and uncover hidden bugs. Core products include ImandraX, a cloud-native automated reasoning engine and theorem prover exposed over a protobuf/gRPC API; CodeLogician, an AI coding agent (with CLI and MCP server) that formalizes source code and reasons about it; IPL (Imandra Protocol Language) for modeling financial messaging protocols; and SpecLogician, which converts natural language into formal models. The tools are delivered through the hosted Imandra Universe platform and target financial infrastructure, autonomous workflows, and regulated industries where trustworthy, explainable AI reasoning is critical.

i.description: Imara Corporation was a lithium-ion battery technology startup founded in 2006 in Menlo Park, California, that grew out of research at SRI International. Backed by Battery Ventures and Nth Power, it raised roughly $15.65M and reached commercial cell production in 2009 before shutting down around 2010-2011 for lack of manufacturing funding. i.description: IMB Bank (IMB Ltd, ABN 92 087 651 974) is a member-owned Australian mutual bank founded in 1880 as the Illawarra Mutual Building Society in Wollongong, New South Wales. It is an authorised deposit-taking institution (ADI) regulated by APRA and ASIC, offering home loans, personal and business banking, deposits, cards and insurance to members across NSW, Victoria and the ACT. As a mutual, IMB is owned by its members rather than external shareholders. Under Australia's Consumer Data Right (CDR / Open Banking), IMB operates as a data holder and exposes a public, unauthenticated Product Reference Data (PRD) API conforming to the Consumer Data Standards, alongside an accredited data recipient (ADR) consent flow for sharing member banking data. IMB also runs a public developer sandbox and marketplace at developer.openbanking.imb.com.au.

i.description: imBee is an AI-powered business omnichannel messaging platform headquartered in Hong Kong that unifies customer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WeChat, LINE, and SMS into a single enterprise-grade inbox. The platform layers team assignment, tagging, marketing broadcast, chatbot and workflow automation, 300+ pre-built integrations (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Okta SSO), and generative-AI tools (AiskBee knowledge assistant and an autonomous AI Agent) on top of the official WhatsApp Business Platform APIs. imBee is ISO 27001 certified with message-level data masking, role-based access, and audit logging, and serves 10,000+ enterprises across 60+ industries in Asia-Pacific with particular strength in Financial Services, Healthcare, Hospitality, Logistics, Property Management, and Retail. Founded in 2019, imBee raised US$5M in Series A funding led by DCM Ventures in 2022.
i.name: imbee

i.description: Imbria Pharmaceuticals is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in the Boston area that is developing novel cardiovascular therapies targeting cardiac energy metabolism. Its lead candidate, ninerafaxstat, is a first-in-class partial fatty acid oxidation (pFOX) inhibitor designed to shift myocardial substrate utilization toward glucose oxidation, generating more ATP per unit of oxygen consumed and improving cardiac metabolic efficiency without affecting heart rate, rhythm, ejection fraction or blood pressure. Ninerafaxstat is in the global FORTITUDE-HCM Phase 2b trial (NCT07023614) for symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM), which has no approved treatments, and holds FDA Orphan Drug Designation for that indication; a Phase 2b in cardiometabolic HFpEF is planned. The company is backed by RA Capital, SV Health Investors, Deep Track Capital, Catalio Capital Management, AN Ventures and Cytokinetics. Imbria is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract.
i.name: Imbria Pharmaceuticals

i.description: Imbue is a San Francisco AI research lab building agentic foundation models for reasoning and the human tooling around them, with a stated mission of AI that is loyal to its user. The team trains large reasoning models in-house (including a 70B model trained from scratch with open-sourced tooling and evaluation datasets) and publishes research on agent and reasoning architectures, reinforcement learning, data generation, and the scientific theory of deep learning. Imbue ships practical tools that emerge from the research, including Sculptor and mngr for orchestrating parallel coding agents, Bouncer for filtering social feeds, and Blueprint and Vet. There is no public commercial inference API; integration happens through open-sourced repositories, model artifacts on Hugging Face, and research releases.
i.name: Imbue

i.description: IMDb provides a premier source of global entertainment metadata, including over 12 million titles, 16 million cast and crew entries, and extensive box office data. The new GraphQL‑backed API, available via AWS Data Exchange, offers on‑demand access to ratings, analytics, and detailed metadata for developers building entertainment‑focused applications.
i.name: IMDb

i.description: Community web service (operated under the IMDb-API / TV-API brand) providing movie, TV series and cast information in JSON. Aggregates data from IMDb, TheMovieDb, Wikipedia, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TheTVDB, FilmAffinity and YouTube. Originally hosted at imdb-api.com and migrated to tv-api.com. Operated by the IMDb-API GitHub user (open source C# client library and Windows client app). NOT an official IMDb / Amazon product — IMDb itself does not expose a public API; community scrapers such as this one (alongside OMDb, TMDB and Apify's IMDb scraper) fill the gap.
i.name: IMDb-API

i.description: Unofficial IMDb Movie / Series Information
i.name: IMDbOT

i.description: iMedeon, Inc. was a mobile workforce management software company based in Atlanta, Georgia, providing wireless web applications to optimize scheduling, routing, and the dispatch and management of mobile field workforces (the iM:Work suite).
