i.description: Infracost is a cloud cost estimation tool for Terraform that shows infrastructure cost breakdowns and diffs directly in pull requests. Infracost provides an API for programmatic access to cloud pricing data and cost estimates.
i.name: Infracost

i.description: Infraspeak is an intelligent facilities and maintenance management platform (CMMS/IWMS/IFM) founded in Porto, Portugal, that connects an entire operation with end-to-end collaboration, complete asset visibility, and intelligent automation. Facility and maintenance teams use Infraspeak to manage assets, work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, failures, stock, suppliers, and contracts across buildings and sites. The platform exposes a public REST API (currently v3) hosted at api.infraspeak.com and documented on Stoplight, plus a growing integrations layer ("Infraspeak Hub") with connectors for ERP, PMS, BMS, energy, and collaboration systems such as SAP, Xero, and Opera. Infraspeak is backed by 500 Global and other investors.
i.name: Infraspeak

i.description: InfStones is an enterprise-grade blockchain infrastructure platform providing node deployment and management, non-custodial staking, and reliable RPC/JSON-RPC API access across 50+ blockchains including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Cosmos, Solana, Cardano, Tezos, TRON, and ZetaChain. Developers connect to hosted full and archive nodes over standard EVM JSON-RPC, Tendermint, and Cosmos gRPC-REST endpoints authenticated by a per-project API key, deploy dedicated validator and staking nodes, and query on-chain data through a single unified developer console. The platform holds SOC 2 Type I and Type II attestation and serves major exchanges, protocols, and institutional clients globally. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund.
i.name: InfStones

i.description: Infura (now MetaMask Developer) is a Web3 RPC provider operated by ConsenSys/MetaMask offering JSON-RPC and REST APIs for 23+ blockchain networks including Ethereum, Linea, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, BNB, Solana, Starknet, plus IPFS and a Gas API. Backed by the Decentralized Infrastructure Network (DIN) for failover.
i.name: Infura

i.description: Interaction with the Ethereum mainnet and several testnets
i.name: INFURA Ethereum

i.description: InfuseAI is the company behind Recce, an open-source AI data-review agent for dbt teams. Recce validates how code changes impact data by automatically running schema diffs, data diffs, row counts, profile/value/histogram diffs, and downstream column-level lineage / impact analysis on pull requests, so data teams catch breaking changes before they reach production. It ships as a first-party Python CLI (recce) plus a managed cloud platform (Recce Cloud) that adds an AI agent to explain findings, collaboration on PR reviews, and CI/CD integration. Recce is Apache-2.0 licensed and SOC 2 compliant. InfuseAI, a 500 Global portfolio company, originally built the PrimeHub MLOps platform before focusing on Recce; the product now lives at reccehq.com while the GitHub org remains InfuseAI.
i.name: InfuseAI

i.description: Infusionsoft, now branded as Keap and owned by Thryv Holdings, is a sales and marketing automation CRM built for small businesses that combines contact management, tagging, email marketing, campaign and automation sequences, e-commerce orders and subscriptions, sales pipelines, appointments and invoicing in a single platform. Keap publishes three machine-readable REST contracts: a 399-operation OpenAPI 3.1 for REST v2, a 141-operation OpenAPI 3.1 for REST v1, and a separate 45-operation Pipelines (deals) API, alongside a deprecated XML-RPC surface. Everything authenticates as a bearer token, either an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code token or a Personal Access Token or Service Account Key. Keap's event surface is REST Hooks and lives only on v1. There are no granular OAuth scopes and no idempotency keys anywhere in the API.
i.name: Infusionsoft (Keap)

i.description: InfutorData (part of ActiveProspect, formerly Infutor / Jornaya / LeadiD) is a consumer identity and data-solutions provider that helps marketers identify, understand, and reach consumers while maintaining privacy and compliance. Its platform delivers identity resolution and completion, identity scoring, consumer data enrichment and attributes, audience activation, and lead-quality and TCPA compliance tooling (TCPA Guardian, LeadiD tokens). Real-time query APIs on api.leadid.com support authentication, lead audit, intelligence, and privacy-guardian lookups, documented in the InfutorData help center. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.
i.name: Infutor

i.description: A Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Amsterdam. Provides retail banking, direct banking, commercial banking, and wholesale banking services to millions of customers across Europe and globally. Operates a public Developer Portal exposing Open Banking, PSD2, and payment-related APIs for third-party developers and fintech partners.
i.name: ING

i.description: ING Australia is the retail banking division of ING Bank (Australia) Limited (ABN 24 000 893 292), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Dutch multinational ING Groep N.V. headquartered in Amsterdam. Launched in 1999 as ING Direct and rebranded to ING in 2017, it is a branchless, digital-first direct bank offering everyday transaction and savings accounts, home loans, superannuation, and insurance to Australian consumers. It is not a customer-owned mutual; it is a foreign-owned Authorised Deposit-taking Institution (ADI) regulated by APRA and ASIC. As an active ADI, ING is an accredited data holder under Australia's Consumer Data Right (CDR / Open Banking) and exposes the mandatory public, unauthenticated Product Reference Data (PRD) API conforming to the Consumer Data Standards (CDS). Authenticated consumer-data sharing follows the CDR ecosystem model (OAuth2 / OIDC FAPI profile via accredited data recipients); ING does not operate a broad, self-serve public developer portal.
i.name: ING Australia

i.description: Ingenico is a global leader in seamless payment solutions, offering a wide range of point‑of‑sale terminals, digital payment services, and integrated commerce platforms. The company serves merchants across retail, hospitality, transportation, and other industries, enabling secure, fast, and flexible transactions both in‑store and online. With a focus on innovation, Ingenio supports emerging payment methods, tokenization, and omnichannel experiences, backed by robust security and compliance frameworks.
i.name: Ingenico

i.description: Profile for Ingersoll Rand in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 881).
i.name: Ingersoll Rand

i.description: ingest0r operates the Cook County (Chicago) property records API at api.ingest0r.com — a pay-per-call, agent-native REST API over Cook County, Illinois public records (~1.9M parcels, refreshed nightly) that resolves a street address to its parcel PIN, then returns parcel details, recorded sales and deed history, building permits linked to the PIN, property-tax assessment history and comparable-sales valuation as one joined answer. There is no signup and no API key: address search and a fixed sample are always free, the first 25 PIN-route calls per client per day return real data free, and past that the routes answer HTTP 402 and are settled per call in USDC on Base or Solana through the x402 protocol ($0.01, $0.03 and $0.10). The provider publishes an OpenAPI 3.1, an A2A agent card, a live streamable-HTTP MCP server with five tools, llms.txt, an x402 resource list, a machine-readable price card and changelog, and a security.txt — all on api.ingest0r.com. The operator identifies itself only as "independent" (the agent card's provider.organization) with a personal contact address; the apex ingest0r.com has no DNS A record, so the API host is the website.
i.name: ingest0r

i.description: Ingles Markets is a regional supermarket chain in the southeastern United States. The company operates retail grocery stores and provides store locator, weekly ad, and digital coupon experiences through its consumer website. No public developer API is currently published.
i.name: Ingles Markets

i.description: © 2025 - All Rights Reserved. Ingram Micro Inc. - Privacy Policy | Terms of Use.
i.name: Ingram Micro

i.description: Ingredion Incorporated is a Fortune 500 global ingredient solutions provider headquartered in Westchester, Illinois, that turns grains, fruits, vegetables and other plant materials into starches, sweeteners, plant-based proteins, texturizers, and clean-label and sugar-reduction systems for food, beverage, brewing, animal nutrition, pharmaceutical and industrial manufacturers across more than 120 countries. Ingredion publishes no developer program and no machine-readable API contract; its customer-facing ordering, document and support surface is the login-only MyIngredion portal, which runs on Salesforce Experience Cloud under Ingredion's own domain and is the only host serving an anonymously readable discovery document.
i.name: Ingredion

i.description: Ingresse is a Brazilian ticketing-as-a-service (TaaS) platform that powers event ticket sales, access control, and the attendee experience for organizers and partners. Its public developer platform lets integrators build tools and services on top of Ingresse — creating events, selling and validating tickets, managing users, and handling payments — through a versioned REST API (v1 and v2) authenticated with an individually issued API key. Ingresse publishes first-party SDKs for JavaScript/Node, Android, iOS, and PHP, plus message-queue libraries, and hosts its reference documentation on a ReadMe developer portal. Ingresse is backed by 500 Global.
i.name: Ingresse

i.description: INGU is a pipeline integrity technology company delivering inline inspection for oil & gas and water/wastewater pipelines through its Pipers multi-sensor free-floating inspection system paired with AI analytics and GIS-based pipeline viewer software. The platform performs leak detection, deposit and wall-condition assessment, and detection of gas pockets, magnetic features, bends, and hot taps across pipelines of any diameter or material. INGU has inspected over 900 pipelines for operators including Chevron, Shell, TotalEnergies, SUEZ, and Vale. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; the company publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.
i.name: INGU

i.description: Inhabit is a global PropTech software company operating a portfolio of specialized platforms for the residential and vacation rental property management markets, including ResMan, Streamline, LiveRez, Anyone Home, ResidentIQ, ePremium, Rental Guardian, Lynnbrook Group payments, Western Reporting screening, and Bluetent marketing. Its integrated tools span property management, resident and guest CRM and contact center, payments processing, renters and property insurance, tenant screening and income verification, utility billing, and marketing websites, serving multifamily, single-family, student, affordable, HOA and condo, and short-term vacation rental operators worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners.
i.name: Inhabit

i.description: Inhabitr is a Chicago-founded furnishing company that operates an AI-assisted furniture rental and procurement platform for commercial real estate and residential customers. Its business side (inhabitr.ai) furnishes hospitality, multifamily, student housing, short-term rental, co-living, senior living and office properties end to end — design, sourcing, procurement, delivery, installation and asset tracking — while its consumer storefront (inhabitr.com) rents furniture, sets and decor to households on flexible terms with a browser-based Home Designer tool. The company describes real-time connectivity to warehouses, manufacturers and retailers as the "furniture cloud" behind its bidding and fulfillment, but it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract of any kind as of this profiling pass.
i.name: Inhabitr

i.description: Inherent (Inherent Laboratories Ltd) is an early-stage AI research lab building recursively self-improving AI systems for scientific discovery — "AI scientists" intended to augment human researchers rather than replace them. Incorporated as a Public Benefit Corporation and backed by Index Ventures, the company frames itself as a reimagined research institution pursuing general-purpose inventive AI, autonomous-lab capabilities, and human-machine teaming across scientific domains. As of this profile it publishes a manifesto and careers page but no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or product surface — this repo tracks it as a lead for enrichment as those surfaces emerge.
i.name: Inherent

i.description: Iniciador is a Brazilian Open Finance infrastructure company that provides the regulated rails, APIs, and managed operations banks, payment institutions, fintechs, and platforms use to participate in Brazil's Open Finance ecosystem. It operates as a Payment Initiator (Iniciadora de Pagamentos), Data Receptor, Account Holder, and Data Transmitter, reportedly processing roughly one in three Pix initiations nationally and over a billion API data calls monthly. Its product surface spans Pague com Seu Banco, Pix Inteligente, Pix Biometria, Pix Automatico, Pix por Aproximacao, agentic payments, and data products such as real-time Dados Bancarios and Cadastro Expresso one-click onboarding. The platform is a FAPI / Open Finance Brasil OAuth2 + OpenID Connect provider using private_key_jwt client authentication, mTLS-bound access tokens, pushed authorization requests (PAR), and PS256 signed request objects.
i.name: Iniciador

i.description: Init 6 is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Init 6

i.description: Initial Therapeutics, Inc. is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company in South San Francisco, California, discovering and developing a new class of small-molecule medicines designed to halt pathogenic protein formation in its earliest stages. Its proprietary STOPS platform — Selective Termination of Protein Synthesis — intercepts the translation of a target protein inside the exit tunnel of the ribosome, recognizing the nascent primary linear sequence rather than a fully folded three-dimensional structure, an approach the company positions as starkly differentiated from targeted protein degradation and from interventions that can only act on proteins after they are fully formed. The company launched publicly on May 1, 2023 with a $75 million Series A from Apple Tree Partners, was co-founded with academic scientists Jamie H. D. Cate (UC Berkeley), Brian Paegel (UC Irvine) and Kevan Shokat (UCSF/UC Berkeley), and builds on ribosome biochemistry, proteomics, medicinal chemistry, DNA-encoded library technology and chemical genetics, with early programs aimed at oncology targets long considered undruggable. Initial Therapeutics is a therapeutics discovery company, not a software vendor: it publishes a small marketing website and no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.
i.name: Initial Therapeutics

i.description: Initialized Capital is a seed-stage venture capital firm founded in 2012 by Garry Tan, Alexis Ohanian, and Harjeet (Harj) Taggar, with offices in San Francisco and New York. The firm is hyper-focused on the seed stage, typically investing before a startup's success strikes other investors as inevitable and favoring companies that have raised little to no prior capital. Rather than thematic investing, Initialized centers its thesis on strong founding teams and acts as a de facto extended founding team from 0 to 1, providing operational support across product design, engineering, recruiting, storytelling, go-to-market, and Series A fundraising. It invests broadly across enterprise SaaS, consumer, marketplaces, fintech, crypto, healthcare, climate, hardware, real estate, and frontier/AI technology. As of 2021 the firm had raised more than $3.2B across its funds and has backed 200+ companies, including 28 unicorns such as Coinbase, Instacart, Cruise, Flexport, Reddit, Opendoor, Rippling, and Patreon, with portfolio companies creating an aggregate of over $200B in market value.
i.name: Initialized Capital

i.description: Injective is a Layer 1 blockchain purpose-built for Web3 finance, enabling users, institutions, and AI agents to trade, tokenize, and transact on-chain with native financial primitives including an on-chain central-limit order book, derivatives (perpetuals, expiry and pre-launch futures, options), spot markets, real-world-asset tokenization, stablecoins, and near-zero-fee payments with instant finality. Developers integrate through the Injective Chain LCD/REST API, a high-throughput Indexer API (gRPC, gRPC-web, and REST), a Chain Stream WebSocket for real-time market and account events, first-party SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and CosmWasm, the injectived CLI, an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and a suite of packaged Agent Skills for AI-driven trading and integration.
i.name: Injective

i.description: INK Games is an Austin, Texas gaming company building a free-to-earn mobile gaming and social platform under the banner "Play. Win. Earn." Its flagship title is Prize Kingdoms, a mobile kingdom-building game distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play in which players compete and earn real cash prizes. Two platform services sit behind the games: Ink ID, the single account and passkey-based authentication layer, and InkPay, the payments and earnings system that pays players and influencers ongoing royalties tied to the reach of their personal INK referral code. The team is drawn from EA, Zynga, SciPlay and Buffalo Studios. INK Games operates no public developer program — it publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK or specification, and its shares trade only on private secondary markets.
i.name: INK Games

i.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.
i.name: Inkblot Therapy

i.description: Inkbox is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce company selling semi-permanent temporary tattoos. Its proprietary "For Now Ink" formula is made with Genipa plant extract and develops into the skin to last up to about two weeks, longer than surface-level temporary tattoos. Inkbox sells thousands of pre-designed tattoos from independent artists and offers a custom service where customers upload their own artwork to create personalized designs. The business operates as a consumer retail brand with an online store, and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.
i.name: Inkbox

i.description: Inkeep is an AI support and agent platform for documentation and products. Its developer platform exposes an OpenAI-compatible RAG / chat completions API over your own content, an Analytics API for logging conversations, feedback, and events, and an Agents / management surface for building and operating AI agents and copilot experiences.
i.name: Inkeep

i.description: Inkit is a Secure Document Generation (SDG) platform that enables organizations to generate, sign, store, and distribute documents in total privacy. The platform provides a REST API for rendering HTML templates into PDFs, automating document workflows, and managing digital signatures at scale. Inkit supports enterprise-grade security and compliance including HIPAA, SOC 2, FedRAMP, and IL4/IL5 certifications, making it suitable for regulated industries such as financial services, utilities, and government. The API allows developers to generate documents from templates, invoke workflow automation, manage mail piece delivery, and integrate document operations into their own applications using SDKs available for Python, Node.js, Go, and Java.
i.name: Inkit

i.description: Inkitt is a data-driven storytelling and self-publishing technology company that runs a reading and writing community (inkitt.com) and the paid serialized-fiction reading app Galatea. It uses reader-engagement analytics and algorithms to discover promising manuscripts from independent authors and develop the most popular into commercial fiction and adaptations across its Inkitt and Galatea platforms. Founded in 2013 and backed by Earlybird, HV Capital, Khosla Ventures, Kleiner Perkins and Speedinvest, Inkitt operates consumer mobile and web reading products rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, domain-security, and GitHub surface.
i.name: Inkitt

i.description: Inkling is a frontline employee training and enablement platform (now part of Echo360) that delivers mission-critical knowledge, learning pathways, and operational workflows to essential workers across retail, hospitality, healthcare, and manufacturing. Its products include the Habitat content authoring tool, mobile Knowledge & Training modules, InkForms operational checklists, certification pathways, reporting and analytics, and LMS/LXP integrations. Inkling publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through LMS/LXP connectors and professional services. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched with the provider's public identity, security posture, and site properties.
i.name: Inkling

i.description: Inkra Networks is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Inkra Networks

i.description: InkSoft is a custom apparel e-commerce, online store, and design platform for screen printers, embroiderers, and print shops - part of the Inktavo family alongside Printful and GraphicsFlow. It provides hosted online stores, a browser-based Design Studio, product catalogs, art/clip-art libraries, and order management. InkSoft exposes a documented but license-gated developer surface, the InkSoft API 2, a per-store RPC-style HTTP API returning XML or JSON with CORS support. It lets partners and store owners build custom storefronts, product catalog pages, design galleries, cart and checkout flows, and single sign-on against a specific web store. API access requires an InkSoft Unlimited license and an additional monthly fee, so the reference is public but production use is account-gated.
i.name: InkSoft

i.description: Inloop Robotics (InLoop) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup in San Francisco offering robotics-as-a-service for warehouses, fulfillment centers, and light manufacturing. Its bimanual "Loop V1" robot performs box assembly, kitting, visual inspection, content preparation, unpackaging, and order pick-and-pack. The system runs a hybrid-autonomy, human-in-the-loop model: onboard AI handles routine work while remote teleoperators take over on edge cases, and production failures feed continuous learning. InLoop sells this as a flat monthly subscription that bundles the hardware, ongoing AI updates, and 24/7 teleassistance fallback, rather than selling robots outright. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site only, with no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record tracks it as an API Evangelist network lead pending any future developer/API program.
i.name: Inloop Robotics

i.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite communications operator founded in 1979, originally as the International Maritime Satellite Organization, providing voice, data, broadband, and IoT services over a global L-band, Ka-band, and multi-band fleet of geostationary satellites. In May 2023 Viasat completed its acquisition of Inmarsat, and the combined company now operates Inmarsat's GX (Global Xpress), BGAN, IsatData Pro (IDP), and Fleet Xpress services alongside Viasat's ViaSat-3 constellation as a unified multi-orbit network. Inmarsat serves four core markets — Maritime (NexusWave, Fleet Xpress, Fleet One, FleetBroadband, Inmarsat C/GMDSS), Aviation (SwiftBroadband, GX Aviation, Jet ConneX, SB-S safety services), Government (L-TAC, GX, BGAN M2M), and Enterprise/IoT (BGAN M2M, IsatData Pro, IsatM2M, NB-NTN). Inmarsat operates a developer program at developer.inmarsat.com with documented APIs for BGAN network management, GSPS voice, Global Xpress, IsatData Pro messaging, Fleet Edge assurance, and Fleet Edge hardware replacement; access to interactive Swagger documentation is gated behind developer registration and approval, though the IsatData Pro Messaging API has an open-source Apache-2.0 Node.js client published on GitHub. Inmarsat is also one of the participating operators in the GSMA NB-NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) standards work for satellite-extended cellular IoT, with Viasat-led proof-of-concept code for NIDD (Non-IP Data Delivery) published under the inmarsat-enterprise GitHub organization.
i.name: Inmarsat

i.description: Inmemori is a French funeral services company ("pompes funebres") that organizes and manages personalized funeral arrangements with an emphasis on transparency, fair pricing, and full handling of legal and administrative procedures. Available 24/7 across agencies in Paris, Bordeaux, Nantes, and Lyon, Inmemori supports families through burial and cremation, secular and religious ceremonies (Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Buddhist), coffins, urns and floral arrangements, funeral pre-planning, and online memorial tribute pages. Backed by Partech, the company operates in the consumer end-of-life services sector. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; Inmemori publishes a consumer website and blog but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.
i.name: Inmemori

i.description: InMobi is a global advertising technology and mobile marketing platform headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. It positions itself as the intelligence layer of the consumer internet, connecting brands and consumers across mobile apps and the open web. InMobi's enterprise platforms include InMobi Advertising for brand building, app growth and ad monetization; the InMobi Exchange, a programmatic OpenRTB 2.5 ad exchange for demand-side platforms; InMobi DSP performance solutions; and InMobi CMP (Choice), an IAB TCF-certified consent management platform. InMobi operates four documented, live REST APIs — the Publisher Reporting API 3.0 for inventory performance data, the Ad Management API for managing apps and placements, the DSP Cost API for asynchronous spend reporting, and a Server-to-Server Ad Request API — alongside native mobile ad SDKs for Android (Maven Central) and iOS (CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager). No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, OAuth server or REST client library is published for any of them. Consumer brands include Glance and the 1Weather app.
i.name: InMobi

i.description: Innago is a free property management software platform with a REST API for managing leases, tenant applications, rent collection, maintenance requests, invoicing, and landlord-tenant communication. The API uses Bearer token and API key authentication and provides endpoints for properties, units, tenants, leases, invoices, payments, expenses, and maintenance tickets.
i.name: Innago

i.description: Inner Loop Capital is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Inner Loop Capital

i.description: InnerSpace (InnerSpace Technologies Inc.) is a workplace analytics company that measures how physical space is used by leveraging a building's existing Wi-Fi infrastructure rather than dedicated occupancy sensors. Its patented Predictive Hyperbolic Location Fingerprinting (PHLF) technology locates and counts people to within roughly four feet to reveal occupancy, movement, and space-utilization patterns across sites, buildings, floors, and zones. The InnerSpace platform serves hybrid-workplace management, real-estate portfolio optimization, higher-education, and employee-experience use cases for enterprises including Microsoft, KPMG, Indeed, and LinkedIn. A GraphQL API (v2) at api.innerspace.io exposes building, zone, site, floor, group, and insights data to customers with active contracts, authenticated via an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials exchange that returns a session token.
i.name: InnerSpace

i.description: InnerTrends is a UK-based analytics and data consultancy that operates as a fractional data department for SaaS marketing and growth teams. Founded in 2015 and based in Norwich, England, it builds a marketing and growth data warehouse that consolidates customer and attribution data, delivers custom reports and customer-journey deep-dive analyses, and provides tracking and measurement consulting for product-led and subscription businesses. The company is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.
i.name: Innertrends

i.description: Inngest is an event-driven durable execution platform for background jobs, step functions, scheduled workflows, and AI agent orchestration. It exposes a v1 event ingestion and run inspection API, a v2 management API (accounts, environments, apps, webhooks, keys, function invocation, runs, traces), official SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Kotlin, AgentKit for multi-agent systems, Connect for persistent worker connections, Realtime streaming, Signals, Durable Endpoints, Insights (SQL over events and runs), and a heavily-marketed local Dev Server CLI.
i.name: Inngest

i.description: Innohub is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Innohub

i.description: Innospec is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Innospec API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
i.name: Innospec

i.description: Innostic is a China-based medical-device distribution and healthcare supply-chain company, established in 2015 and originally profiled as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence at www.innostic.com now resolves to the Shanghai Jianfa Zhixin Medical Technology group, which operates across medical-device distribution, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), hospital supply-chain management (SPD and centralized distribution), and consumer healthcare supply-chain services for manufacturers, distributors, and hospitals. The company is a B2B healthcare logistics and distribution firm; its only online systems are internal, login-gated operational platforms (Zhixin, U9, OA). As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile records verified company identity and a domain-security probe; there is no public API surface to catalog.
i.name: innostic

i.description: Innovaccer is a healthcare AI cloud company whose FHIR-enabled Data Activation Platform unifies fragmented patient and clinical data across EHRs, claims, and other sources into a longitudinal record that powers population health, care management, analytics, and agentic healthcare applications. The company is HITRUST CSF certified and publishes open-source developer surfaces including the Masala Design System (a React component library) and the Healthcare Model Context Protocol (HMCP), an OAuth 2.0 / SMART on FHIR protocol for healthcare AI agents. Its core platform API is offered to customers and partners through the Innovaccer developer portal (Nucleus / Datashop Engine).
i.name: Innovaccer

i.description: Innovapptive is a Houston-headquartered industrial software company whose AI-first Connected Worker Platform (CWP) digitizes frontline work across maintenance, operations, warehouse, EHS and continuous-improvement processes for asset-intensive industries — oil and gas, chemicals, mining and metals, power generation and manufacturing. The platform is built around deep, bi-directional integration with systems of record (SAP ECC and S/4HANA, IBM Maximo, Oracle, Infor, PI and SCADA) through its no-code Integration Manager and RACE configuration engine, and ships as product suites including mWorkOrder, mInventory, mRounds / Operator Rounds, iMaintenance, iPermits, mAssetTag and Digital Work Instructions. Its public developer surface is narrow: a documented external Operator Rounds REST API on the CBO (Connected Business Operations) host, secured with tenant-scoped API keys, plus a large Oxygen-published documentation estate at docs.innovapptive.com covering every dated release train.
i.name: Innovapptive

i.description: Innovent Biologics (信达生物制药) is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 2011 and headquartered in the Suzhou Industrial Park, China, that discovers, develops, manufactures, and commercializes high-quality biologic medicines for the treatment of oncology, autoimmune, cardiovascular and metabolic, and ophthalmology diseases. Its portfolio includes the PD-1 inhibitor Tyvyt (sintilimab), developed in partnership with Eli Lilly, alongside a broad pipeline of monoclonal antibodies and other biologics. Innovent is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (01801.HK) and was surfaced through the Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) portfolio. Innovent is a therapeutics company and does not publish a public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate and domain-security identity in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Innovent

i.description: Innovid provides a global independent omnichannel advertising platform that enables brands to create, deliver, and measure interactive video, display, and connected TV ads across all digital channels. The platform offers tools for ad authoring, dynamic creative optimization, audience management, and comprehensive analytics, helping advertisers achieve personalized, data‑driven campaigns at scale.
i.name: Innovid

i.description: Innovist is an Accel-backed, science-backed direct-to-consumer personal care house based in India, building and operating a portfolio of skincare, haircare and suncare brands including Chemist At Play, Bare Anatomy and Sunscoop. It sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at innovist.com, offering free delivery and category-wide discounts across skin, hair and sun care. While Innovist does not publish a traditional developer API program, its storefront natively implements agent-facing commerce surfaces: a customer-account OpenID Connect identity layer, a published llms.txt / agents.md for AI shopping assistants, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets approved agents search the catalog, build carts and complete buyer-approved checkouts.
i.name: Innovist

i.description: Innoviti Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based payment technology company and RBI-authorized payment aggregator (online and, since January 2026, in-store) operating under India's Payment & Settlements Act 2007. Founded in 2002, Innoviti builds collections, reconciliation, and revenue-assurance infrastructure for large organized retail. Its products include innoviti unipay (an enterprise payment and reconciliation platform for omnichannel settlements and leakage control), innoviti genie (a sales acceleration and dealer-margin platform for mobile and electronics retail), and innoviti link (a POS-free mobile collection app accepting cards, UPI, and EMI). The company serves enterprise retailers including Samsung, Reliance Retail, Tanishq, Shoppers Stop, and More Retail, holds multiple payment-communication patents, and maintains PCI DSS, PCI P2PE, and PCI PIN certifications. Added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation was found during enrichment.
i.name: Innoviti

i.description: Innovium, Inc. was a Santa Clara, California semiconductor company founded in 2014 that designed high-bandwidth Ethernet switch silicon (the TERALYNX family) for cloud and enterprise data centers, competing with Broadcom on high-radix, low-latency switching with deep buffers and built-in telemetry/analytics. Backed by Greylock and other deep-tech investors, Innovium was acquired by Marvell Technology in 2021 (~$1.1B) and its switching technology continues inside Marvell's portfolio. The company shipped hardware silicon, not a public developer API — innovium.com now redirects to marvell.com, and there is no developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic API surface to enrich.
i.name: Innovium

i.description: innRoad is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) that bundles PMS, a direct booking engine, and a channel manager (OTA distribution to Expedia, Booking.com, Airbnb, and others) into one platform, built for independent hotels, boutique properties, and small hotel management companies. innRoad also offers 40+ pre-built partner connections - point-of-sale (Lightspeed, Oracle Hospitality, Squirrel, Positouch, Uniwell), door locks (RemoteLock, Saflok, ONITY), guest messaging (Akia), accounting (M3, Inn-Flow), and in-house payment processing (innRoad Payments) - that are toggled on inside the application. innRoad does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no documented WebSocket or webhook API as of this cataloging; every listed integration is a pre-built, partner-gated connection rather than an open surface a third-party developer can register for and call.
i.name: innRoad

i.description: Inofab Health (a Clario company) is a digital respiratory health company headquartered in Ankara, Turkey, building connected spirometry and inhaler devices with cloud software for the home-based and clinical management of chronic respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis. Its product line spans the SpiroHome Personal portable ultrasonic spirometer, the SpiroClinic Pro and SpiroClinic Compact clinical-grade spirometers with EHR integration, the SpiroCloud web dashboard that collects and analyzes data from all connected SpiroHome and SpiroClinic devices, and the SpiroHaler smart inhaler attachments for medication adherence. Inofab was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.
i.name: Inofab

i.description: Inoreader provides a powerful RSS feed reader and content aggregation platform that lets users subscribe to, organize, and share web content. It offers features such as automated tagging, rules for filtering, offline access, and collaborative sharing for teams. The service includes a developer API that enables programmatic access to feed data, article content, and user actions, supporting integration with third‑party applications and custom workflows.
i.name: Inoreader

i.description: Inovalon is a healthcare technology company providing cloud-based data analytics and data-enabled intervention platforms for the healthcare industry. Its Inovalon ONE Platform pairs national-scale primary-source datasets with analytics, workflow, and SaaS applications used by health plans, providers, pharmacies, life-sciences, and specialty organizations for risk adjustment, quality measurement, care-gap closure, and revenue-cycle and claims management (including the ABILITY provider workflow products). Inovalon was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise and auth-gated: the corporate site is WAF-protected and the API host api.inovalon.com requires authentication (HTTP 401); security and compliance posture is published on the public Inovalon Trust Center.
i.name: Inovalon

i.description: Inovia Bio is a TechBio company delivering drug development strategy and evidence generation for biotech and pharmaceutical organizations, aiming to combine big-pharma impact with biotech speed. It pairs purpose-built platforms with advisory services to produce regulatory-grade evidence, covering clinical development planning and trial design, therapeutic product profiles (TPP), development, regulatory and commercial strategy, Integrated Evidence Plans (IEP/IEGP), Real World Evidence (RWE) for regulatory submissions, and clinical program rescue. Its Study Designer platform (diagity.inovia.bio) supports study design workflows. Inovia Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.
i.name: Inovia Bio

i.description: Inphi Corporation (formerly NYSE: IPHI) was a fabless semiconductor company that designed high-speed analog and mixed-signal interconnect components -- SerDes, PAM4 DSPs, optical DSPs, and coherent DSPs -- used to move data across networks and inside data centers, from cloud and telecom infrastructure to long-haul and metro optical transport. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Inphi was acquired by Marvell Technology in April 2021 and folded into Marvell's data-center and connectivity portfolio; its former inphi.com domain now 301-redirects to marvell.com. As a semiconductor hardware company, Inphi did not publish a public developer API, portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company record.
i.name: Inphi

i.description: InPost is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
i.name: InPost

i.description: Input Factory is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Input Factory

i.description: Inquis Medical is a privately funded medical device company founded in 2020 and headquartered at 1530 O'Brien Drive in Menlo Park, California, dedicated to advancing the treatment of venous thromboembolic disease (VTE). Its flagship product, the AVENTUS Precision Thrombectomy System, is a single-catheter mechanical thrombectomy platform that combines a directional intelligent tip with an integrated 5F navigation catheter and dilator, TrueClot proprietary tissue-sensing that gives the operator real-time feedback on what the catheter tip is engaging (wall latch, lollipops, clogs), and in-line filtration with autologous blood reinfusion that reduces blood loss without capital equipment. The AVENTUS Thrombectomy System received FDA 510(k) clearance for peripheral indications and, in June 2025, for the treatment of pulmonary embolism; the company also ships the AVENTUS Introducer Sheath and the AVENTUS Clot Management System. Inquis raised a $40 million Series B in 2024 and a $75 million Series C to scale commercial adoption. Inquis Medical is a clinical hardware company: it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API contract, and its public GitHub organization holds a single empty embedded-firmware repository.
i.name: Inquis Medical

i.description: InRisk Labs is a climate insurtech company building parametric insurance products for climate and disaster risk financing. Its platform pairs an AI-driven pricing engine, real-time geospatial and weather monitoring, and blockchain smart contracts to deliver rapid, data-triggered payouts across 15+ parametric products spanning agriculture (crop, livestock, agri-input), renewable energy (solar, wind), logistics, tourism, energy demand, infrastructure protection, and wage and business-interruption cover. Risk models incorporate global climate drivers such as ENSO and IOD and range from India to global coverage. InRisk exposes an "API on-demand" so insurance partners can integrate customized products, dynamic pricing, and real-time analytics into their own infrastructure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.
i.name: InRisk

i.description: INRIX is a Kirkland, Washington-based transportation analytics company that turns anonymized GPS probe data from connected vehicles, mobile devices and fleets into real-time and historical road intelligence for automakers, cities, departments of transportation, retailers and app developers. Its developer surface is organized around the INRIX IQ platform and documented at docs.inrix.com, spanning Traffic APIs (segment speed, safety alerts/incidents, traffic tiles, routing, drive time polygons, traffic cameras, dangerous slowdowns, fuel stations and TPEG Connect), Parking APIs (INRIX Parking Services 3.0, formerly ParkMe: lots, blocks, occupancy and probability, destinations and reservations), Analytics APIs (trade area trips, trip trends, visits, dangerous roads and Roadway Analytics), Signals intersection analytics, a Data Download Service for map and XD network releases, and data-upload streams for GPS, XFCD and parking events. All access is brokered through the INRIX User Accounts System (UAS), which exchanges an appId and a SHA-1 hashToken for a bearer access token used across every product API.
i.name: INRIX

i.description: Inrupt is the enterprise company founded by Sir Tim Berners-Lee and John Bruce to commercialize Solid, the open decentralized-data specification he created at MIT. Its flagship product is the Enterprise Solid Server (ESS), a Kubernetes-deployed platform of cooperating services that gives each person or organization a Pod — a personal data store with fine-grained access control, auditing, and W3C Verifiable-Credential-based Access Requests and Grants. ESS ships an Access Grant service, an Authorization service using Access Control Policies (ACP), a Pod Storage service implementing the Solid Protocol, a Notification Delivery service that pushes signed webhooks to remote HTTPS endpoints, a Platform Management service with a token-exchange and admin provisioning API, an optional hybrid keyword-plus-semantic Search service, and — since ESS 3.0 — an MCP Resource Service exposing consent-mediated tools to AI agents. Inrupt also runs PodSpaces, a hosted developer-preview deployment of ESS, and publishes first-party JavaScript and Java client SDKs.
i.name: Inrupt

i.description: Insamo is a biotechnology company building membrane-permeable, orally available cyclic peptides that combine the binding affinity of antibodies with the pharmacology of small molecules for drug discovery. Its platform automates the design, synthesis, and testing of peptides at large scale and applies machine learning across vast chemical spaces to identify therapeutic candidates. Founded in February 2024 with $12M from Playground Global, venBio, and MRL Ventures Fund, the company operates from Berkeley, California and Chippendale, New South Wales, Australia. Insamo currently publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Insamo

i.description: Inscinstech (Suzhou Inscinstech Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation manufacturer serving the biopharmaceutical industry. It designs and builds equipment for oligonucleotide and nucleic-acid synthesis, chromatography and protein purification, tangential-flow filtration, bioreactors and cell culture, nanomedicine (LNP) preparation, high-pressure preparative liquid chromatography, peptide synthesis, and analytical instruments (HPLC, capillary electrophoresis, pumps and valves), spanning laboratory, pilot, and production scale. It also delivers end-to-end process solutions for oligonucleotide drugs, mRNA, peptides, and recombinant proteins. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It is a hardware and instruments provider and publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.
i.name: Inscinstech

i.description: Inscope is an AI-powered financial reporting and automation platform for accounting firms and enterprise finance teams. It drafts accurate, GAAP-compliant financial statements, cash flow statements, and audit workpapers in minutes, keeping a human reviewer in the loop to review and sign off. The platform targets the financial close, reporting, and audit workflow, and states SOC 2 Type I and Type II certification with GDPR/CCPA compliance. Inscope is a private SaaS backed by Norwest Venture Partners; it publishes no public product API or developer portal today. Customer sign-in runs on a PropelAuth-hosted OpenID Connect tenant at auth.inscopehq.com.
i.name: Inscope

i.description: Inscribe is an AI-powered document fraud detection platform founded in 2017, serving banks, credit unions, fintechs, and lending institutions. The platform uses agentic AI trained by fraud experts to detect forged, manipulated, and AI-generated documents including bank statements, pay stubs, tax forms, invoices, and identity documents. Inscribe's REST API provides programmatic access to fraud detection, document verification, credit insights, and transaction enrichment workflows at scale. Financial institutions integrate the API to automate underwriting, onboarding, KYC/KYB, and bank account verification decisions, with results delivered via webhook or polling. The platform processes millions of applications annually and serves notable customers including Bluevine, Ramp, Plaid, and BHG Financial.
i.name: Inscribe

i.description: Inscripta, Inc. was a Boulder, Colorado digital genome engineering company founded in 2015 that built the Onyx benchtop platform — an automated CRISPR instrument, consumables, assays and a cloud-based Inscripta Engineering Portal that let scientists design and track millions of precise single-cell genome edits in one experiment. It licensed the MAD7 nuclease, acquired Infinome Biosciences and Sestina Bio in 2023 to pivot toward sustainable biomanufacturing, and merged with Manus (Manus Bio) in April 2025 to form an end-to-end bioalternatives company. Inscripta publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification; its only public developer artifact is BioCantor, an MIT-licensed Python genome-annotation library on PyPI and GitHub. inscripta.com now serves a single merger landing page pointing at manusbio.com.
i.name: Inscripta

i.description: INSEE (Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques) is France's national institute for statistics and economic studies. It provides official statistical data, analyses, and publications covering demographics, economy, society, and geography. The institute offers open data portals, APIs, and documentation for developers to access datasets on population, employment, inflation, and more, supporting research, policy making, and public information.
i.name: INSEE

i.description: Insempra is a biotechnology company that produces sustainable, bio-based ingredients using precision fermentation. It develops alternatives to petrochemical and naturally-extracted ingredients for the beauty and personal care, food and nutrition, and fibers and performance materials industries. Products include a bio-based Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol fragrance ingredient, an Omega-7 biolipid, and Biomelanin (in development), produced from agricultural and forestry waste streams through circular manufacturing. Insempra is a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.
i.name: Insempra

i.description: Insent.ai was a Boston-based, Techstars-backed B2B conversational marketing platform that let marketing and sales teams engage website visitors in real time with human-first chat, visitor identification, routing, and meeting booking. ZoomInfo acquired Insent in July 2021 and rebranded the product as ZoomInfo Chat; the insent.ai domain now serves ZoomInfo Chat. As a standalone company Insent.ai no longer operates its own developer portal, documentation, or public API surface, so the enrichment pipeline found no first-party API artifacts to harvest.
i.name: Insent.ai

i.description: Insert Mobile Technologies is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Insert Mobile Technologies

i.description: InsForge is an open-source (Apache-2.0), agent-native cloud infrastructure platform built so that AI coding agents can provision and operate an entire backend end to end through a CLI and packaged agent skills instead of a human clicking through a dashboard. A single project bundles a Postgres database with schema management and row-level security, authentication (users, sessions, OAuth, JWT), S3-compatible object storage, Deno-based edge functions with cron, a unified AI model gateway, realtime subscriptions and webhooks, long-lived custom compute, frontend hosting via Vercel, transactional email, and payments via Stripe and Razorpay. The REST API is documented as fourteen OpenAPI 3.0 service specifications and is driven by an official TypeScript SDK, CLI, and hosted MCP server. InsForge is a Y Combinator company.
i.name: Insforge

i.description: Provides news from inshorts
i.name: Inshorts News

i.description: Insider (rebranded Insider One; useinsider.com now redirects to insiderone.com) is an AI-native customer engagement and personalization platform used by 2,000+ global brands. It unifies a Customer Data Platform, cross-channel journey orchestration (Architect), personalization, predictive segmentation, product discovery (Eureka) and behavioural analytics across Web, Email, SMS/RCS, WhatsApp, Web Push, Mobile App, Site Search, InStory and conversational CX. Its developer surface is substantial and public: 113 REST operations across 18 hosts, published as a public Postman collection at developers.insiderone.com, covering the Unified Customer Database, consent and subscription management, transactional email/SMS/WhatsApp, web and app push, iOS Live Activities, OTP verification, product catalog, recommendations, Eureka search and campaign and journey analytics. Insider One also ships a first-party remote MCP server at mcp.insiderone.com with 35 OAuth-scoped tools, an llms.txt indexing ~2,800 markdown-retrievable doc pages, and an account-generated Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for Claude Code. It publishes per-endpoint rate limits, a cross-API status-and-error-code reference, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 / CSA STAR attestations — but no OpenAPI, no pricing, no status page and no deprecation policy.
i.name: Insider

i.description: InsiderFilings.info provides a public beta REST API delivering normalized SEC ownership transaction line items from Forms 3, 4, and 5, including amendments. The service aggregates data from the SEC EDGAR system, updates filings roughly every five minutes, and offers free 7‑day trial access with rate limits of 100 requests per day. It aims to cover all SEC filings from 2025 onward, though historical coverage may be incomplete. Users can query recent insider purchases and sales, explore detailed filing data, and integrate this information into compliance, research, or investment workflows.
i.name: insiderfilings.info

i.description: InsideSales — branded XANT from 2019 until Aurea Software (ESW Capital) acquired the company in August 2021 and revived the original name — sells Playbooks, an AI-assisted sales engagement platform that layers cadence, automation, prioritization, scoring and call recording on top of a customer's existing CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP) rather than replacing it. Its only publicly documented programmable surface is the Playbooks Call Recording API, an access-key protected service for downloading call recordings by Call Detail Record (CDR) ID and for starting/pausing recording from third-party applications; the company also publishes a first-party React UI component library on npm and GitHub. The developer surface is materially decayed: the API reference host and the call-recording host named in the company's own documentation no longer resolve in DNS, product release notes stop in July 2021, and the Atlassian status page is titled "Deprecated InsideSales".
i.name: InsideSales (XANT / InsideSales.com)

i.description: Insify is a Dutch insurtech offering fully digital business insurance for freelancers, self-employed professionals (ZZP'ers) and small-to-medium enterprises in the Netherlands. Its online-first product line covers disability/income protection (arbeidsongeschiktheid, AOV), professional liability (beroepsaansprakelijkheid, BAV), business liability (bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, AVB), business inventory and goods, electronics, in-vehicle equipment and auto cover, sold and managed entirely online with no setup, advisory or cancellation fees and daily cancellation. Serving more than 40,000 entrepreneurs across professions from IT and photography to care and construction, Insify pairs instant quoting and fast claims with AI-assisted guidance (SmartGuide). Backed by Accel, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an insurance-tech provider profile; it is a consumer-facing insurer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.
i.name: Insify

i.description: Insight Enterprises is a global Fortune 500 solutions integrator helping organizations transform technology, operations, and customer experiences to drive business outcomes.
i.name: Insight Enterprises

i.description: Insight Health builds AI clinical agents that handle the patient-facing workflows clinical staff spend the most time on: phone answering, fax processing, ambient note-taking, intake, follow-up, referral management, and triage. Built by practicing physicians, the platform is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified, and integrates with the major outpatient EHRs via FHIR R4 and HL7v2. Its voice agent Lumi handled the first known autonomous clinical AI conversation with a patient in October 2023, and the company has since handled more than 4 million patient conversations across 60+ medical specialties. Products include Aura AI Scribe, the Aura Anywhere embedded scribe SDK for EHR vendors, AI FrontDesk, AI Fax Agent, Pre-Visit Intake, Follow-up, Referral Management, and Phone Triage agents.
i.name: Insight Health

i.description: Insight Lifetech (Shenzhen North Star Cardiovascular Medical Technology, 北芯生命科技) is a Chinese medical-technology company developing innovative solutions for the precision diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Its portfolio spans coronary physiology and intravascular imaging (FFR, IVUS) and cardiac electrophysiology, including its InsightPFA pulsed-field ablation platform. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market (688712) in February 2026. This is a medical-device manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.
i.name: Insight Lifetech

i.description: Insight Partners is a global software-focused venture capital and private equity firm founded in 1995 by Jeff Horing and Jerry Murdock and headquartered in New York City, with additional offices in London, Tel Aviv, and Palo Alto. The firm invests in high-growth technology and software ScaleUp companies at every stage from early (Series A) through growth and late-stage pre-IPO, deploying checks that range from roughly $5M up to $500M+ and pairing capital with a dedicated in-house operations team (Insight Onsite) that provides talent, sales, marketing, and product expertise to accelerate scaling. Sector emphasis spans enterprise software broadly, including cybersecurity, fintech, AI/ML, DevOps, data infrastructure, and healthtech. With approximately $90B in regulatory assets under management as of 2025 and more than 875 companies backed worldwide, Insight is one of the largest technology investors in the world, with a portfolio and exit history that includes Twitter, Shopify, DocuSign, Wix, SentinelOne, HelloFresh, N26, Alteryx, and AppDynamics.
i.name: Insight Partners

i.description: Insightec Ltd. is an Israeli medical device company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Tirat Carmel, Israel, that develops and sells MR-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) systems under the Exablate brand. Its Exablate Neuro platform focuses more than a thousand ultrasound beams through the intact skull to ablate a target deep in the brain without an incision, and is approved for essential tremor and Parkinson's disease, including staged bilateral treatment. The Exablate body platform is used for uterine fibroids, palliation of bone metastases, and prostate indications, and the company runs clinical programs in blood-brain-barrier opening and glioblastoma. Insightec publishes a public product documentation portal of operator manuals and handbooks for the Exablate systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or agent surface; its systems integrate with GE and Siemens MR scanners as clinical devices rather than through a public API.
i.name: Insightec

i.description: InsightEra Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok-based marketing technology and data intelligence company that builds ready-to-use online marketing tools from social network data. Its platform spans social research (social listening and competitor analytics), social management (omni-channel management and chatbots), social data and analytics (Customer Data Platform and CRM), and social campaigns (campaign targeting and analytics), alongside a Thai NLP service and a generative enterprise AI platform. InsightEra positions its "Intelligence Model" as an ecosystem that connects external intelligence (market, customers, competitors, society) with internal organizational data so brands can turn insight into interaction and action. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. InsightEra publishes one public developer surface: the NLP Platform API (branded "ELI") at nlp.insightera.co.th, a RESTful Thai natural-language-processing service documented with a live Swagger 2.0 contract covering tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, spell correction, OCR, address and email extraction, clustering and a trainable custom text-classification model service. The commercial SaaS products (DOM social listening, CENT omni-channel management, Alice chatbot, Brian competitor analytics, 1Palette customer analytics and GenA generative enterprise AI) run on customer-only backends with no published contract.
i.name: InsightEra

i.description: Insightful Labs is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Insightful Labs

i.description: Insightly is a CRM and project management platform for small and mid-sized businesses, combining contact and lead management, opportunity pipelines, project delivery, and marketing automation. The Insightly REST API provides programmatic access to contacts, organizations, leads, opportunities, projects, products, price books, quotes, and custom objects for CRM integrations and workflow automation.
i.name: Insightly

i.description: Insightsone is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: unknown. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Insightsone

i.description: Insilico Medicine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company applying generative AI and robotic automation to drug discovery and development. Its Pharma.AI software suite includes PandaOmics (target discovery from multi-omics data), Chemistry42 (generative chemistry with retrosynthesis, property prediction, and ADMET), Generative Biologics, inClinico (clinical trial outcome prediction), Science42 DORA (research assistant), Nach01, and PreciousGPT-family models for life sciences. The company runs its own therapeutic pipeline spanning oncology, fibrosis, and inflammation, with programs targeting TNIK, USP1, QPCTL, PHD, MAT2A, TEAD, ENPP1, KAT6 and others through Phase II. Insilico monetizes through Pharma.AI software licensing, partnerships with major pharmaceutical companies, and progression of its in-house assets. Pharma.AI tools are commercial SaaS products accessed via web UI; the company publishes open-source research code on GitHub (GENTRL, fcd_torch, BiAAE, DD-VAE, DORA) but does not expose a public commercial API.
i.name: Insilico Medicine

i.description: Insito Health provides a comprehensive platform for onsite and virtual mental health services, education, and training for schools, healthcare providers, and families. Their solutions include mental health referral management, suicide screening, bullying prevention, and comprehensive care navigation, supporting both students and adults through integrated digital tools and professional support.
i.name: Insito Health

i.description: insitro is a machine-learning-driven drug discovery and development company founded in 2018 by Daphne Koller and headquartered in South San Francisco, California. It combines large-scale in vitro cellular data generated in its own automated labs with human clinical and genetic data to build predictive models of biology, aiming to bring better drugs faster to the patients most likely to benefit. Its therapeutic focus spans metabolism, oncology, and neuroscience, and its interdisciplinary teams pair life scientists, data scientists, and engineers. insitro operates no public developer API; it maintains open-source research and infrastructure tooling (such as the redun workflow engine) on its GitHub organization. Backed by a16z, GV, and the SoftBank Vision Fund.
i.name: insitro

i.description: Insitu Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company that designs, builds, and operates uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) and related intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance technologies for defense and government customers. Its product line includes the Integrator, ScanEagle, and RQ-21A air vehicles alongside imaging payloads, ground control stations, and mission software such as TacitView, the Media Management Suite, and the Tungsten SDK. Insitu delivers end-to-end capabilities for collecting, processing, and distributing information, with more than 1.6 million operational flight hours across 30-plus international customers. Insitu operates as a defense contractor and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.
i.name: Insitu

i.description: Insmed Incorporated is a NASDAQ-listed (INSM) global biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing therapies for people with serious and rare diseases. Its approved medicines include ARIKAYCE (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension) for refractory Mycobacterium avium complex lung disease and BRINSUPRI (brensocatib) for bronchiectasis. The company advances a pipeline across pulmonary, inflammatory, and rare-disease indications and runs early-innovation science platforms in gene therapy with targeted delivery, protein deimmunization, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue. Insmed operates patient-facing surfaces such as a clinical-trials portal and an investigator-initiated-research program, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security data only.
i.name: Insmed

i.description: Insomnia is an open-source, cross-platform API development platform by Kong for designing, debugging, and testing HTTP, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, SOAP, WebSockets, SSE, and Socket.IO APIs. It includes an Inso CLI for CI/CD integration, cloud-hosted and self-hosted mock servers, OpenAPI spec design tools, and collaborative features with cloud sync, local vault, and Git storage options.
i.name: Insomnia

i.description: InSparq is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: InSparq

i.description: Inspectorio is a supply-chain management software platform that helps brands, retailers, suppliers, and laboratories digitize and optimize production across quality risk management, responsible sourcing & compliance, production management, traceability, and lab-test management. It serves 15,000+ organizations in apparel/footwear, food & beverage, home & furniture, retail, and outdoor/sports. For integrators it exposes REST integration APIs (organization API-key auth via the `apiKey` header) for its Quality Risk Management (Sight), Responsible Sourcing & Compliance (Rise), and File Management domains, plus HMAC-signed outbound webhooks following the Standard Webhooks specification.
i.name: Inspectorio

i.description: Insperity is a professional employer organization (PEO) headquartered in Kingwood, Texas that provides human resources and business performance solutions to small and medium-sized businesses, including payroll processing, employee benefits, workers' compensation, HR compliance and the Insperity Premier HR technology platform. Insperity Premier exposes a REST Public API at https://api.insperity.com/public organized into four categories — Onboarding, Payroll & Tax, HRIS and Core — covering 45 publicly listed operations that let a client's applicant tracking system, HRIS or payroll application send new-hire records, submit employee change events, retrieve post-payroll general ledger data, and read the company-scoped reference code lists those writes must resolve against. Access is not self-service: a key is issued per customer by an Insperity Integration Specialist after an API Terms of Use Agreement is signed, requests must originate from allow-listed IP addresses, and the developer portal's Swagger documents require a Premier account.
i.name: Insperity

i.description: Inspirato is a luxury travel subscription company that gives members access to a curated portfolio of 300+ private branded residences, 200+ five-star hotels, and 170+ destinations worldwide, paired with dedicated concierge care, curated experiences, and signature hotel partnerships. Members book vacations through Inspirato's website and app with predictable, service-first delivery. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and added to the API Evangelist network. Inspirato does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.
i.name: Inspirato

i.description: Inspire (Inspire Clean Energy) is a consumer clean-energy company on a mission to transform the way people access clean energy and accelerate a net-zero carbon future. It gives residential customers access to renewable energy for their home electricity supply through flat-rate subscription plans designed to deliver predictability and reduce exposure to electricity rate volatility. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface — this is a non-API consumer brand.
i.name: Inspire

i.description: INSPIRE HEP is a community-driven portal for high‑energy physics literature, data, and author information. It provides searchable access to millions of records, including papers, authors, conferences, jobs, and datasets, supporting researchers worldwide. The platform offers APIs for programmatic access to its rich metadata, enabling integration with scholarly tools and services.
i.name: INSPIRE HEP

i.description: High Energy Physics info. system
i.name: inspirehep.net

i.description: Inspiren is a healthcare technology company providing an AI-powered ecosystem for senior living communities that combines hardware and software to improve resident safety, care planning, and staff efficiency. Its platform pairs devices such as the AUGi sensor, Sense, Help Button, Resident Pendant, and Staff Beacon with the Inspiren HQ software platform and mobile app to deliver emergency call, real-time fall prevention and safety monitoring, data-driven care insights, and staff workflow coordination. Inspiren reports outcomes including reductions in falls, faster alert response times, and improved occupancy for the communities it serves. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Scale Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Inspiren does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.
i.name: Inspiren

i.description: Inspur Cloud (浪潮云) is the public-cloud arm of the Chinese IT conglomerate Inspur Group, operating from cloud.inspur.com across the cn-north-3 (华北三), cn-south-1 (华南一) and cn-east-1 (华东一) regions. It publishes a broad IaaS/PaaS catalog — 94 products documented in its GitBook help centre — of which at least 16 ship a public HTTP API reference covering elastic compute (ECS), bare metal (CPS), block storage (EBS), backup (CBS), VPC networking, elastic IP, load balancing, IAM, RDS for MySQL, time-series database, container engine, blockchain and an S3-compatible object storage service (OSS). APIs are authenticated with an AK/SK request signature (x-secret-id / x-sign / x-time / x-random headers) or an IAM-issued bearer token. No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or other machine-readable contract is published: the entire surface is hand-written HTML reference documentation in Simplified Chinese.
i.name: Inspur Cloud

i.description: Insta360 (Arashi Vision Co., Ltd) is a consumer and professional imaging company best known for its 360-degree and action cameras (the X, GO, ACE, Link, and Pro/Titan lines). For developers, Insta360 runs a first-party developer program through its Insta360Develop GitHub organization and a VitePress developer-documentation site. Cameras expose on-device HTTP control APIs: consumer models implement Google's Open Spherical Camera (OSC) API over the camera Wi-Fi AP, and the Pro/Titan line adds a JSON-over-HTTP command API (ProCameraApi) for capture, live streaming, and file access. Native SDKs wrap this surface for C++ (camera control and media stitching/editing), Android, and iOS so third-party apps can connect to, configure, capture from, and post-process footage from Insta360 hardware.
i.name: Insta360

i.description: InstaAgent is a Y Combinator-backed AI marketing platform that turns a single campaign brief into hundreds of audience-specific creatives. It generates persona-, trend-, and format-grounded ad variants, distributes them across Meta, TikTok, and niche social accounts built for specific audiences, then tests which personas, hooks, formats, and channels drive performance and scales the winners into the next campaign. The company reports serving 500+ clients across 10+ countries with 10x ad variants and 30%+ ROI improvement. InstaAgent operates a marketing product surface only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.
i.name: InstaAgent

i.description: Instabase is an agentic automation platform that transforms complex, document-heavy workflows using AI. Its AI Hub product uses large language models and packet-aware AI agents to extract, classify, validate, and reason over unstructured document packets (PDFs, images, spreadsheets, emails, scans, and more), turning them into structured, verifiable intelligence. AI Hub exposes a REST API and Python SDK for creating file batches, running automation apps and production deployments, reading and writing workspace files, and managing secrets, with industry solutions for financial services, insurance, healthcare, and the public sector. Instabase is venture-backed (a16z, Greylock, Index Ventures).
i.name: Instabase

i.description: Instabeat is a San Francisco based swimming technology company that builds a heart-rate monitoring device integrated directly into swim goggles, giving swimmers real-time, color-coded effort feedback (heart-rate zones), automatic stroke detection, lap counting, pace, distance and rest-interval tracking without a chest strap or wrist watch. Paired with the Instabeat mobile app and myinstabeat.com, it delivers data-driven training insights so swimmers can adjust workouts in the water rather than after the session. The company sells the device through a Shopify storefront and has tested the product with 250+ swimmers across 56 countries. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer or API surface has been identified.
i.name: Instabeat

i.description: Instabee is a European last-mile logistics technology company formed by the 2022 merger of Instabox and Budbee, operating consumer delivery brands Instabox (Sweden, Denmark, Norway), Budbee (Sweden, Denmark, Finland, the Netherlands, Belgium) and Porterbuddy (Norway). It moves tens of millions of parcels a year across parcel lockers, home delivery and returns for 1,150+ merchant clients through 45+ parcel terminals, serving 10M+ active users. Instabee exposes a public REST developer API under the Budbee brand for creating and managing delivery orders, booking delivery intervals, discovering lockers/boxes and serviceable postal codes, generating shipping labels, booking returns, and subscribing to parcel-status webhooks across its Nordic and Benelux network.
i.name: Instabee

i.description: Instabridge is a global internet connectivity company operated by Degoo Backup AB in Stockholm, Sweden, and backed by Balderton Capital and Creandum. Its mobile apps give users access to a crowdsourced map of roughly 20 million free WiFi hotspots and to prepaid eSIM mobile-data plans covering 190+ countries with no roaming fees. With more than 200 million app downloads, Instabridge combines community-shared WiFi, pay-as-you-go global data, a data-saving browser, VPN, and cloud storage, and runs a distribution-partner program for prepaid top-up resellers.
