Its brands include WebMD and Medscape (health), WebMD Ignite and PulsePoint (health engagement), Henry Schein One and Dentrix (dental SaaS), FindLaw and Avvo (legal), and CarsDirect and Fodor's (auto, home, and travel). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. The holding company does not publish a single unified public developer API; developer surfaces live with its individual operating brands.
i.name: Internet Brands

i.description: The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) is an open, global community of network designers, engineers, researchers, and operators that develops and promotes voluntary technical standards to ensure the smooth operation and evolution of the internet. The IETF publishes freely accessible RFCs (Requests for Comments) that serve as the foundation for internet interoperability. The IETF Datatracker exposes a public read-only REST API over the working group, document, and meeting data managed by the IETF.
i.name: Internet Engineering Task Force

i.description: Internet Security Systems (ISS) was an Atlanta-based network and internet security company, founded in 1994, that provided vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection, and managed security services (Internet Scanner, RealSecure, Proventia, BlackICE). It was acquired by IBM in 2006 for approximately $1.3 billion and folded into IBM as IBM Internet Security Systems (later IBM Security / X-Force); it no longer exists as an independent company. Surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, ISS operates no active, independent public developer or API surface today, so there is nothing live to enrich against.
i.name: Internet Security Systems

i.description: Internet2 is a nonprofit advanced networking consortium that provides a high‑performance, secure network for research and education institutions across the United States. It offers cloud services, identity management, security solutions, and collaborative tools to enable innovative research, teaching, and community initiatives. The organization also supports policy development, network engineering, and a range of services to its member institutions, fostering a robust digital research ecosystem.
i.name: Internet2

i.description: Interos operates an automated supplier-resilience platform that maps and continuously monitors extended, multi-tier supply chains for Fortune 1000 companies and federal agencies. Its cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS uses AI and a large B2B relationship graph to deliver real-time, multi-domain risk scores and alerts. The public Interos API (REST/JSON, OpenAPI 3.0.2) exposes organization search, organization and risk profiles, the supplier relationship graph, organization groups, custom fields, and scenario watchlists, authenticated with x-api-key and x-customer-id headers. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia; backed by Kleiner Perkins.
i.name: Interos

i.description: Interplay Learning is an Austin, Texas edtech company delivering always-on, immersive skilled trades training through online video courses, 3D simulations, and VR for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, facilities maintenance, and solar. Its SkillMill platform has trained more than 500,000 workers to be job-ready, pairing hands-on simulations with custom learning paths, certification prep, and skill assessments. For employers, Interplay exposes an enterprise data-integration API plus SSO and LMS integrations so training data can flow into an organization's own systems; it publishes no public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI. Backed by Sierra Ventures. This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface.
i.name: Interplay Learning

i.description: INTERPOL (International Criminal Police Organization) is an inter-governmental organization with 196 member countries that helps police worldwide work together to make the world a safer place. INTERPOL exposes a public Notices web service that returns Red, Yellow, and UN Notices data. An OpenAPI description of that service is published by the bundesAPI community and mirrored in this repository.
i.name: Interpol

i.description: Access and search Interpol Red Notices
i.name: Interpol Red Notices

i.description: InterPrice Technologies, Inc. was a New York City debt capital markets fintech that gave corporate treasury teams a single web platform for new-issue financing decisions. Founded by Olga Chin and commercially launched in 2020, its treasury capital markets platform aggregated the indicative pricing that banks and financing partners supplied for bonds, commercial paper, loans and hedging, normalized it across currencies and products, and presented it in comparison dashboards so CFOs and treasurers could read funding costs side by side instead of collecting them by email and spreadsheet. The company was WBENC-certified as a woman-owned business, raised roughly $9.8M — a $2.5M seed in March 2021 and a $7.3M Series A in November 2022 co-led by Nasdaq Ventures and DRW Venture Capital with Bowery Capital participating — and named HP Inc., McCormick & Company and Takeda Pharmaceuticals among its corporate treasury customers. In March 2023 it announced bank API connectivity, but that was an inbound integration through which relationship banks delivered pricing indications into the InterPrice platform for its own tenants; no public developer portal, API reference, key issuance, or machine-readable specification was ever published, and none appears anywhere in the 983 archived URLs captured for the domain. The company wound down during 2025 — founder and chief executive Olga Chin left in February 2025 and is now a managing director at Tradeweb, the last Wayback capture of the site is 2025-01-26, and interpricetech.com now has an empty DNS delegation — so this profile is retained as a historical record and there is no API surface to enrich.
i.name: InterPrice Technologies

i.description: The Interpublic Group of Companies (IPG) is one of the world's largest advertising and marketing services holding companies, with networks including McCann Worldgroup, IPG Mediabrands, FCB, MullenLowe Group, and Acxiom. In 2024 Omnicom announced its acquisition of IPG; the combined brand operations now run under omc.com, and www.interpublic.com 301-redirects there. IPG publishes no unified public developer portal and no product REST API at the holding-company level - technology surfaces are delivered through agency-network products such as Acxiom data services and Mediabrands' identity and measurement platforms, all partner-gated. The one live, machine-readable HTTP contract on IPG's own host is the WordPress REST API still served from the apex interpublic.com origin, which carries the corporate newsroom (346 posts) and advertises 254 routes across 17 namespaces through its self-describing route-discovery document.
i.name: Interpublic Group

i.description: Fortune 1000 company Interpublic Group. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Interpublic Group

i.description: Intersect ENT was a medical device company based in Menlo Park, California that developed drug-eluting, bioresorbable sinus implants for patients with chronic rhinosinusitis. Its PROPEL family of steroid-eluting implants maintains sinus patency and delivers localized mometasone furoate to the sinus mucosa following endoscopic sinus surgery, while its SINUVA implant treats recurrent nasal polyps in an in-office setting. Formerly publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker XENT, Intersect ENT was acquired by Medtronic in May 2022 and its PROPEL and SINUVA product lines are now sold as part of Medtronic's ear, nose, and throat (ENT) portfolio. The company is a physical medical-device manufacturer and operates no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.
i.name: Intersect ENT

i.description: Intersection is a New York-based, experience-driven out-of-home (OOH) media and technology company formed from the merger of Titan, a municipal out-of-home advertising operator, and Control Group, a technology and design studio. It operates street-level, transit, airport, bikeshare and place-based advertising networks across 13 major U.S. markets - including LinkNYC, the largest street-level digital network in New York City - and it builds the software behind them: the IxNConnect display-management and communications platform used by cities, transit agencies and airports, and an AI-powered Order Management System (OMS) that exposes inventory discovery, availability, pricing and campaign reservation to AI agents through an MCP server built on the IAB Tech Lab OpenDirect 2.0 specification.
i.name: Intersection

i.description: Interswitch is Nigeria's foundational digital payments and transaction-switching company, founded in 2002 and regulated by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It owns the Verve card scheme (Africa's first domestic EMV chip-and-PIN brand), the Quickteller consumer and business payments platform, the Webpay / Web Checkout gateway, the Paycode cardless service, and the underlying transaction switch that connects Nigerian banks, fintechs, billers, and merchants. The Interswitch developer platform exposes REST APIs for accepting payments, sending transfers, paying bills, recharging airtime, generating cardless tokens, issuing Verve cards (Card 360), originating loans, accessing customer insights, and searching transactions — all under OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication via the Passport token service and HMAC-SHA512-signed webhooks. The company is expanding from Nigeria into Ghana, Kenya, Uganda, and other African markets.
i.name: Interswitch

i.description: InterSystems is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: gartner-mq) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
i.name: InterSystems

i.description: InterVenn Biosciences is a digital-biology company applying artificial intelligence and mass spectrometry to glycoproteomics, the large-scale study of glycosylated proteins, to discover novel biomarkers for precision medicine. Its proprietary platform integrates liquid chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS) with AI-driven analysis (including the OpenPIP software) to identify and quantify glycopeptides and glycan structures across complex diseases such as cancer. Surfaced as a portfolio company of amplify-partners and softbank-vision-fund and added to the API Evangelist network. InterVenn publishes no public developer API, portal, or specifications as of this enrichment pass; this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture only.
i.name: InterVenn

i.description: Interwoven, Inc. (NASDAQ: IWOV) was an enterprise content management software company founded in 1995 whose flagship products were TeamSite web content management and WorkSite document management, with a strong presence in the legal sector. Accel backed the company circa 1998; it IPO'd, and was acquired by Autonomy Corporation in 2009 (Autonomy in turn acquired by HP in 2011; TeamSite and related products later went to OpenText in 2016). The company is DEFUNCT: interwoven.com no longer serves HTTP/HTTPS and there is no live API, developer portal, or documentation surface to enrich. This entry is a false-positive lead from harvesting Accel's historic portfolio and should be skipped by the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Interwoven

i.description: Intezer operates a Forensic AI SOC platform that autonomously triages, investigates and helps respond to every security alert flowing from an organization's EDR, NDR, SIEM, identity, cloud and email-security tooling. Its investigation engine combines Genetic Malware Analysis (code-reuse mapping against a large genome of trusted and malicious software), dynamic and static analysis, memory forensics, sandboxing and agentic AI reasoning to reach a verdict on alerts in under two minutes. The Intezer Platform API 2.0 exposes this analysis surface programmatically — submitting files, URLs, hashes and endpoint scans for analysis, retrieving verdicts and code-reuse results, and querying IOCs — and is offered alongside an official Python SDK, a CLI, and an MCP server that connects AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and Codex to case histories and investigation context.
i.name: Intezer

i.description: Inth is a San Francisco, Y Combinator-backed company building enterprise privacy governance for teams that ship fast, making consent programmable, observable, and compliant by default. Its foundation is c15t (github.com/c15t), an open-source, developer-first consent management platform with 3M+ npm downloads used by teams like Zed, Expo, Infisical, and Unkey. c15t provides a headless, composable cookie banner, consent manager, and preference center for JavaScript, React, and Next.js, plus a self-hostable consent backend and REST API (@c15t/backend) that also runs as the inth.com managed service. It supports GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, IAB TCF 2.3, Google Consent Mode v2, and Global Privacy Control, with regional policy packs, audit-ready consent records, script and iframe gating, and first-party SDKs and CLI.
i.name: Inth

i.description: Inthegame (Synced Apps Technologies Ltd.) is a viewer-interaction and CTV/OTT engagement platform. Its patented no-code layer injects interactive in-stream overlays — polls, trivia, ratings, wikis, offers and a points shop — into live and recorded video across smart TVs and mobile devices, driving engagement and monetization for streaming platforms and broadcasters. The API exposes two surfaces: an adminApi for broadcasters to manage streamers/channels and inject engagements, and a userApi for end-viewers to register, play, answer, chat, buy and climb real-time leaderboards, with a Socket.IO channel pushing live engagement events.
i.name: Inthegame

i.description: INTL FCStone Inc. (rebranded as StoneX Group in 2020) is a Fortune 100 financial services organization providing execution, risk management, advisory services, market intelligence, and post-trade services across asset classes and global markets including commodities, equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and securities.
i.name: INTL FCStone

i.description: Intlayer is an internationalisation (i18n) framework for modern web applications, providing one way to manage multilingual content across React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Nuxt and Astro. Beyond the open-source (Apache-2.0) framework it operates a hosted CMS API at back.intlayer.org secured with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, publishes an RFC 9727 API catalog, a machine-readable agent authentication guide (auth.md), and ships an official MCP server both hosted (mcp.intlayer.org) and as a stdio package (@intlayer/mcp), alongside extensive documentation written for agents as well as humans.
i.name: Intlayer

i.description: Intralinks is a cloud-based virtual data room and secure file sharing platform used for M&A transactions, due diligence, and confidential business collaboration. The platform provides APIs for programmatic access to workspaces, documents, folders, groups, users, and permissions, enabling integration with enterprise document management and deal workflow systems.
i.name: Intralinks

i.description: Intraware, Inc. was a software delivery and entitlement-management company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Orinda, California. Its flagship SubscribeNet service gave enterprise software publishers a web-based electronic software delivery (ESD) and license-management platform, delivering applications through an encryption, compression, and multi-server distribution engine while giving corporate IT subscribers account-specific entitlement, update, and download information. Intraware went public on NASDAQ under the ticker ITRA in 1999 during the dot-com boom, was backed by investors including Canaan Partners, and was acquired in 2009 by Acresso Software (later Flexera Software). Its SubscribeNet software-monetization capabilities live on today as part of Revenera; there is no independent Intraware developer program, public API, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Canaan Partners portfolio company and is retained as a historical VC-portfolio lead.
i.name: Intraware

i.description: Intrepida Bio, Inc. is a preclinical biotechnology company (founded 2019, headquartered in Encinitas / San Diego, CA) developing medicines that modulate the innate immune system to fight cancer and other diseases. Working with Biouniversa s.r.l., the company holds worldwide rights to develop proprietary monoclonal antibodies against the novel targets BAG3 and its receptor IFITM-2 — a signaling axis tumors hijack to build a growth-promoting, immune-evasive microenvironment (notably in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC). Intrepida raised roughly $9.5M from Canaan, Sofinnova, Indaco Venture Partners and Vertis to fund IND-enabling studies of its lead oncology program. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. NOTE: this is a therapeutics/drug-discovery company with no public API, developer portal, or software product surface; its website (intrepidabio.com) no longer resolves and the entity appears dormant/defunct, so no API artifacts apply.
i.name: Intrepida Bio

i.description: Intricately is a cloud and technology spend intelligence platform that tracks the adoption, usage, and spend of more than 15,000 cloud products across millions of companies worldwide, giving sales and marketing teams the signals they need to find accounts, spot active sales cycles, and predict churn. Founded in 2014 in San Francisco and backed by Bloomberg Beta, GitHub, Susa Ventures, and Singtel Innov8, Intricately was acquired by HG Insights in March 2022 and its data product is now delivered as the Cloud Dynamics API. The REST API (https://api.intricately.com/api/v2) authenticates with an X-API-KEY header and centers on asynchronous Bulk Jobs that enrich lists of domains with cloud adoption, product signatures, revenue, and digital-relationship data. API access is available on Enterprise plans.
i.name: Intricately

i.description: Intrinio is a financial data platform delivering real-time, delayed, and historical US stock prices, options data with Greeks and implied volatility, standardized and as-reported company fundamentals, analyst estimates, ETF and mutual fund holdings, indices, corporate actions, and ESG data through a REST API, WebSocket streaming feeds, bulk files, Snowflake and S3 delivery, and an official hosted MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI assistants directly to its data catalog.
i.name: Intrinio

i.description: Intrinsic is a unified Trust & Safety platform that gives safety teams a single API and dashboard to detect, investigate, and enforce against abuse across user- and AI-generated content, fraud, and marketplace abuse. The platform surfaces machine-learning classifiers (for example text toxicity and IP trust scoring), account graph lineage for linkage analysis, geo enrichers, and global intelligence signals through a synchronous API, and lets teams author, version, deploy, and monitor real-time anti-abuse rules from a hosted dashboard. Founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Karine Mellata and Michael Lin (previously on Trust & Safety ML and data-engineering infrastructure at Apple and Discord), Intrinsic has since rebranded to Variance (variance.co); the Intrinsic-branded developer surfaces at docs.intrinsicapi.com and api.intrinsicapi.com remain in service.
i.name: Intrinsic

i.description: Intrinsic is a Mountain View, California industrial robotics software company spun out of Alphabet's X "moonshot factory" and led by CEO Wendy Tan White. Its mission is to make industrial robots radically easier to program, use, and innovate with so that automation is accessible to a much broader range of businesses. Intrinsic's flagship product is Intrinsic Flowstate, an all-in-one web-based developer environment for designing, building, simulating, and deploying production-grade robotics solutions, paired with Intrinsic Intelligence — a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities including pose estimation, motion planning, grasp planning, and sensor-guided control — and IntrinsicOS, a robot operating system that spans cloud to edge. Developers extend Flowstate by writing Skills and Services in Python and C++ via the open-source Intrinsic SDK (Apache-2.0), or compose them visually via behavior trees in the Flowstate Process Editor. The platform integrates deeply with ROS through Intrinsic's 2022 acquisition of Open Source Robotics Corporation (OSRC) — the commercial arm of Open Robotics — while ROS, Gazebo, and Open-RMF stewardship remain with the independent OSRF non-profit. Flowstate is currently in a gated beta / trusted-tester program; production access is granted to enterprise customers, systems integrators, and participants in programs such as the AI for Industry Challenge. Pricing is not publicly disclosed and there is no self-service developer signup.
i.name: Intrinsic

i.description: Intro is a consumer marketplace, founded in 2020 by Raad Mobrem and headquartered in Los Angeles, that connects people with vetted, in-demand experts for one-on-one advice over scheduled video calls. Experts span career and business, interior design and home decor, style and beauty, health and wellness, fitness and nutrition, astrology, and more, with per-session pricing set by each expert. Intro also lets creators and professionals monetize their audience by publishing a bookable profile. The company raised a $10M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) with participation from Seven Seven Six. Intro operates as a consumer web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.
i.name: Intro

i.description: Introhive is a relationship intelligence and CRM data automation platform used primarily by professional services firms — law, accounting, consulting and the built environment — to remove manual CRM data entry. It passively mines employee email and calendar systems to build a firm-wide relationship graph of who knows whom and how strong each relationship is, then cleans, de-duplicates and enriches contact, company and activity records before writing them back into the system of record. Introhive integrates with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, HubSpot and legal/accounting practice systems, and surfaces the resulting intelligence through a relationship portal, digest emails and CRM-embedded apps. The company is headquartered in Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada, and operates regional platform instances for the US, Canada and the UK.
i.name: Introhive

i.description: Intrro is an employee referral recruiting platform that turns a company's collective network into a warm-introduction hiring engine. Its AI-assisted software analyzes employees' LinkedIn and email connections to surface candidates likely to be known across the team, then automates referral requests, gamified engagement, referral-bonus tracking, approvals and payouts from a single dashboard. Intrro integrates with major applicant tracking systems and collaboration tools including Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, iCIMS, Jobvite, Glassdoor, Slack and Microsoft Teams, and exposes API keys through an in-app Dev Center for those integrations. Founded in 2020 and backed by 500 Global, the company operates via Ehalah FZ-LLC and hosts its platform on AWS under GDPR-aligned data practices.
i.name: Intrro

i.description: IntruVert Networks was a network intrusion-prevention company founded in 2000 in San Jose, California, and backed by Trinity Ventures. Its IntruShield product line combined purpose-built inline intrusion-prevention appliances with the IntruShield Manager to detect and block network attacks in real time. McAfee (then Network Associates) acquired IntruVert in May 2003 for approximately $103 million, folding the technology into its intrusion-prevention portfolio. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no live developer or API surface; this record is retained for historical/portfolio-graph purposes only.
i.name: IntruVert Networks

i.description: Intucell was an Israeli self-optimizing network (SON) software company headquartered in Ra'anana, Israel, whose platform let mobile carriers automatically plan, configure, manage, optimize and heal cellular radio access networks in real time as network demand changed. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners on roughly $6M raised, Intucell was acquired by Cisco Systems for approximately $475M in a deal completed February 25, 2013, and its SON technology was folded into Cisco's mobility and service-provider portfolio (later divested to HCL). The company operates no standalone public developer program or API today; this profile is retained as an acquired-company / VC-portfolio record in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Intucell

i.description: Collection of APIs offered by Intuit for financial and business management services.
i.name: Intuit

i.description: Intuition Robotics is a Tel Aviv-based AI company (with offices in the United States, Japan, and Greece) building social companion technology for older adults. Its flagship product, ElliQ, is an AI care companion robot that proactively engages users through natural conversation, body language, lights, and sound, powered by a proprietary "Relationship Orchestrator" cognitive-AI platform and multiple large language models to support health, wellness, cognitive engagement, and reducing loneliness. Intuition Robotics publishes no first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the ElliQ product store (elliq.com, on Shopify) does expose an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), including a published llms.txt and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search and checkout. Backed by Bloomberg Beta among other investors.
i.name: Intuition Robotics

i.description: Intuitive Surgical is the global leader in robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery, developing and marketing the da Vinci surgical system, Ion endoluminal system, and the Intuitive Hub for case management, streaming, and integration in operating rooms worldwide.
i.name: Intuitive Surgical

i.description: IntusCare (Intus Care, Inc.) is a Providence, Rhode Island health technology company building an end-to-end software and services ecosystem for PACE — Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. Founded in 2019 by Brown University students Robbie Felton, Evan Jackson and Alex Rothberg, it launched population health analytics at PACE of Rhode Island in 2020 and now serves 70+ PACE organizations. Its products are CareHub, a PACE-native ONC-certified EMR and care-management platform; IRIS, a risk-adjustment and coding system for PACE and value-based care organizations; and a Population Health & Utilization Management suite delivered with fractionally-staffed Integrated Care Services clinicians. IntusCare markets interoperability and out-of-the-box third-party administrator (TPA) integrations, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract — customer-facing surfaces are the authenticated CareHub and analytics applications.
i.name: Intus Care

i.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.
i.name: INURU

i.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.
i.name: Invaluable

i.description: Invendor is a smart industrial vending and vendor-managed inventory (VMI) platform for industrial distributors and manufacturers, combining weight-sensing (Gravity) and scan-based (Capture) smart cabinets, a Storeroom mobile app, and cloud warehouse software to automate tool and consumable replenishment across customer locations. Invendor (formerly Scanbro, a Techstars company based in Tallinn, Estonia) exposes two public OAS3 REST APIs - a Common API for managing accounts, items, locations, operations, orders, users, and devices, and a Reporting API for scans, consumption, replenishment, and unique-item status data - both secured with OAuth2 (authorization code) through the identity.scanbro.com identity server.
i.name: Invendor

i.description: Inventa is a Brazilian B2B commerce platform — a "B2B commerce cloud" — that integrates technology, credit, and logistics on a single platform so brands and distributors can scale wholesale sales in Brazil. Its products include a sales platform that syncs catalogs, orders, inventory, and prices across B2B e-commerce sites and marketplaces via ERP integrations; a field-sales mobile app for sellers; automated credit analysis and approval; shared distribution-center logistics (OMS/WMS/TMS) with fulfillment and 72-hour delivery in the São Paulo region; multichannel customer support; and business-intelligence dashboards. Solution packages span Fulfillment, Response, FullService, and a pay-per-use OnDemand model. The company is headquartered in São Paulo. Inventa configures the API and connector integrations for its customers rather than publishing a public developer portal, so it has no public API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.
i.name: Inventa

i.description: InventisBio Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market: 688382) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, China, with operations in New Jersey, United States. Built on independent R&D capabilities, InventisBio discovers and develops innovative small-molecule and targeted therapies for oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases to address unmet medical needs. The company has advanced multiple drug candidates into clinical trials, including late-stage Phase III programs in non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer, alongside earlier-stage assets targeting KRAS G12C, synthetic-lethal pathways, hyperuricemia/gout, and plaque psoriasis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. InventisBio is a research-driven pharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.
i.name: InventisBio

i.description: Inventive AI is an AI-powered platform that automates responses to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, and security questionnaires, helping proposal and sales teams respond up to 90% faster with higher win rates. It unifies knowledge from sources like Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, and Confluence into a single searchable content hub, generates context-aware first drafts grounded in verified content, flags gaps rather than fabricating answers, and applies AI agents for competitive research, content management, and response refinement. Inventive is a Y Combinator company backed by Sierra Ventures and Wing Venture Capital. The product is delivered as a closed SaaS application with SSO and integrations; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.
i.name: Inventive

i.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.
i.name: InventoryQuant

i.description: Invera is a Cordoba, Argentina fintech founded in 2016 that provides embedded investment and brokerage infrastructure to banks, fintechs, and financial institutions across Latin America. Originally a B2C robo-advisor, it pivoted into a B2B technology provider whose proprietary investment core (200,000+ development hours) powers three products - InvWallet (embedded investing that turns any monetary account into an investment account), Rocket (an investment-management platform that integrates with core banking systems and automates operations), and InvBroker (a portfolio-management and trading platform for clients and investment advisors). Invera exposes its capabilities through APIs and institution-agnostic infrastructure, with a stated mission of turning 10 million Latin Americans into investors. It is backed by 500 Global (500 LatAm B18).
i.name: Invera

i.description: Inversion is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Austin Briggs and Justin Fiaschetti, building a new class of highly maneuverable reentry vehicles. Its flagship Arc is an autonomous, reusable, low-cost space-based delivery vehicle designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver it with precision to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, descending under parachutes using non-toxic propellants so crews can approach it immediately on landing. The company also develops hypersonics and space-based interceptor technology and flew its first reentry capsule, Ray, as an early technical demonstrator. Inversion has raised roughly $54M to date, including a $44M Series A led by Spark Capital and Adjacent with participation from Lockheed Martin Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Y Combinator. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Inversion

i.description: Inversion of Control (IoC) is a software design principle where the control flow of a program is inverted compared to traditional programming. Instead of application code calling frameworks, frameworks call application code. Common implementations include Dependency Injection and event-driven programming.
i.name: Inversion of Control

i.description: Invesco Ltd. (NYSE: IVZ) is a global independent investment management firm headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with approximately $1.95 trillion in assets under management. The firm operates a broad set of ETF, mutual fund, and institutional strategies, anchored by the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) tracking the Nasdaq-100, the Invesco Solar ETF (TAN), and the Invesco BulletShares defined-maturity bond ETF suite. Invesco has recently extended its thematic ETF lineup into AI infrastructure and divested its remaining MassMutual stake. No public developer APIs are documented at this time; fund, ETF, and performance data are distributed through institutional market-data channels (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, NYSE) rather than a developer portal.
i.name: Invesco

i.description: Invesdor is a pan-European crowdinvesting and digital investment platform that connects private and professional investors with companies raising capital through equity, subordinated loans, and bonds, with minimum tickets starting around EUR 250. Founded in Finland in 2012 and expanded through mergers with Finnest, Kapilendo, and Oneplanetcrowd, Invesdor now serves more than 180,000 investors across Europe and has channeled over EUR 600 million into more than 1,000 renewable-energy, scale-up, and SME financing rounds. It operates as a regulated investment firm under the EU Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP) regime. Invesdor does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, investor, and legal surface in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Invesdor

i.description: InvestaX is a Singapore-based, MAS-licensed tokenization platform for real-world assets (RWAs), operated by IC SG Pte. Ltd. under a Capital Markets Services license (CMS100635) and a Recognised Market Operator license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. The platform provides end-to-end infrastructure for the issuance, distribution, secondary trading, and custody of security tokens and tokenized securities, plus a Tokenization SaaS product for institutional issuers and RWA investment products such as tokenized money market funds and private credit. It supports multiple blockchain protocols including Ethereum, Polygon, BASE, Algorand, Tezos, and Hedera. Backed by 500 Global.
i.name: InvestaX

i.description: InvestCloud is a wealth-management technology company that provides an AI-driven digital wealth platform connecting advisors, financial institutions, asset managers, TAMPs, RIAs and investors across the full investment lifecycle. Its product surface spans front-office advisor and client solutions, a wealth data platform ("Digital Warehouse") that aggregates custodial, market and portfolio data, managed account solutions including the Advisor Programs List (APL) and Private Markets Account, post-trade processing and settlement, revenue management, and the NaviPlan and RetireUp financial planning products acquired with Advicent. InvestCloud markets a developer platform — branded "Wealthsqope Digital Developer" — offering web-service APIs, embeddable widgets, code recipes, client libraries and application API keys, but that platform and its reference documentation sit entirely behind a portal login, and no machine-readable API contract is published publicly.
i.name: InvestCloud

i.description: Investec is an international specialist bank and wealth manager, dual-listed on the London Stock Exchange and Johannesburg Stock Exchange and operating through Investec plc (UK) and Investec Limited (South Africa). In the United Kingdom, Investec Bank plc is authorised by the PRA and regulated by the FCA and PRA and is an FCA-registered Account Servicing Payment Service Provider (ASPSP) under UK Open Banking, exposing Account and Transaction Information (AIS), Payment Initiation (PIS), and Confirmation of Funds (CBPII) interfaces built to the Open Banking Implementation Entity (OBIE) Read/Write API Standard (v3.1), secured with FAPI-grade OAuth2/OIDC, PSD2 strong customer authentication, and mutual-TLS using OBIE/eIDAS certificates. Investec is a specialist private bank and wealth manager rather than a mass-market retail bank, so it is not one of the CMA9 and does not operate a branch or ATM network. Alongside Open Banking, Investec runs a first-party Programmable Banking / Open API developer platform at openapi.investec.com offering Private Bank, Business & Commercial Banking, Intermediaries, Intermediaries Forex, and Card APIs secured with OAuth2 client credentials, published through the Investec Developer Portal at developer.investec.com.
i.name: Investec

i.description: Investly is a European fintech invoice-financing marketplace that helps growing small and medium-sized businesses unlock working capital by financing their outstanding 30-180 day invoices. Businesses sell their approved invoices through a reverse-auction marketplace where investors bid to fund them, giving merchants the best available price from multiple funding providers and access to cash in 1-3 working days rather than waiting on customer payment terms. Founded by Siim Maivel and operating across Estonia and the United Kingdom, Investly is backed by Speedinvest, Startup Wise Guys, and Founders Capital. The platform serves established businesses across manufacturing, wholesale, construction, logistics, and business-services sectors and has funded invoices worth tens of millions of pounds to date. Investly runs a production HAL/HATEOAS backend API at api.investly.co, though it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference documentation.
i.name: Investly

i.description: Investor AB is a Swedish investment firm that provides capital and strategic support to technology startups and growth-stage companies. The company focuses on fostering innovation across sectors such as fintech, healthtech, and clean energy, offering both financial resources and operational expertise. While currently a stub in the API Evangelist network, Investor AB aims to develop robust API services to enable partners and developers to integrate with its investment platforms, access portfolio data, and automate reporting processes.
i.name: Investor AB

i.description: Invetx was a Boston-based veterinary biotechnology company developing protein-based therapeutics — species-specific, half-life-extended monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) — for chronic conditions in companion animals (dogs and cats). Its integrated platform spanned antibody discovery, optimization, Fc-variant half-life extension, development and manufacturing, with lead program IVX-01. Backed by GV, F-Prime Capital, Novo Holdings, Eight Roads, Anterra Capital, Casdin Capital and Tekla, Invetx was acquired by Dechra Pharmaceuticals in July 2024 for up to $520M. It exposes no public API, developer, or documentation surface, and its standalone website (invetx.com) has been decommissioned since the acquisition; this profile is retained as a network lead / portfolio record.
i.name: Invetx *

i.description: Invicti is an enterprise web application security solution providing automated vulnerability scanning, DAST, and API security testing. The Invicti platform includes API Discovery capabilities that help build a complete inventory of an organization's internal and external API assets.
i.name: Invicti

i.description: Invidica is an Oakland-based B2B wholesale ecommerce marketplace (founded 2019) that upgrades the wholesaler-retailer relationship for the reseller economy. It pairs a marketplace where resellers order wholesale products directly from brands with AI-driven analytics that combine Amazon sales data to predict an item's profitability, sales velocity, and competition, helping small sellers find the most profitable products to resell. Founded by CEO Sean Bovell and backed by 500 Global and 1517 Fund (pre-seed, 2021). The company appears to be pivoting under the Reroute Retail brand (rerouteretail.com, "launching soon"); its original invidica.com domain no longer resolves. No public API or developer surface is currently published.
i.name: Invidica

i.description: invinoveritas, published by Baby Blue Viper, is a verification layer for autonomous agents: a neutral, model-agnostic verdict before an irreversible action (POST /review), a schnorr-signed portable proof after (POST /prove), and a public, Nostr- and Bitcoin-anchored track record (GET /ledger) that anyone can recompute against the published key. It is exposed as a REST API (OpenAPI 3.1, 187 operations on api.babyblueviper.com), a remote MCP server with 31 tools at /mcp (OAuth 2.1 metadata, anonymous tools/list), and an A2A agent with a conformant 0.3.0 agent card. Paid calls settle per call in Bitcoin Lightning sats (Bearer credits or L402), USDC via x402 on Base, or by card through Stripe governance subscriptions; /verify-proof and /ledger are free.
i.name: invinoveritas

i.description: Inviscid AI is a San Francisco-based startup (Y Combinator W2026) building physics-informed AI for real-time cooling and airflow simulation of buildings and industrial facilities. Its platform combines computational fluid dynamics (CFD) with physics-informed neural networks to run thermal digital twins up to 1000x faster than traditional CFD, ingesting live data from building management systems, meters, and IoT sensors to autonomously recommend HVAC setpoints and optimize airflow. Target facilities include data centers, offices, hospitals, and cold storage, where the company claims 30%+ energy savings and sub-90-day ROI. As of mid-2026 Inviscid AI is a pre-product-launch company with no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network lead pending an external API.
i.name: Inviscid AI

i.description: Invisible AI is a next-generation computer vision company delivering a Vision Execution System (VES) for manufacturing. NVIDIA Jetson-powered edge devices with Intel RealSense 3D depth cameras and on-device SSD storage mount to existing factory infrastructure and, within hours, encode and segment the production floor in real time. The no-code, edge-based platform captures 100% of production cycles across every station without wearables, operator disruption, or cloud integration, then analyzes human motion and objects to surface cycle-time variability, process drift, quality escapes, and safety/ergonomics risk. Founded in 2018 by autonomous-vehicle veterans and backed by Sierra Ventures, it serves automotive and aerospace OEMs including Toyota, Ford, General Motors, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Nissan. Invisible AI publishes no public API or developer platform today; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Invisible AI

i.description: Invisible Universe is a consumer entertainment company building AI-powered animated intellectual property for social platforms — described by FastCompany as "building the Pixar of the internet one TikTok at a time." It has launched multiple animated franchises reaching millions of followers and billions of views across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, and created Invisible Studio, a proprietary AI engine that compresses short-form animated content production from weeks to hours. Backed by Initialized Capital, it operates in the consumer/media sector. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; as of this pass the company publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface.
i.name: Invisible Universe

i.description: InVision was a digital product design platform used by teams to build the world's best customer experiences. It provided REST APIs for managing prototypes, design documents, boards, comments, workflows, and design system components including design tokens and icons via the Design System Manager (DSM). InVision shut down all services on January 1, 2025, with its domain now redirecting to Miro.
i.name: InVision

i.description: InVision (InVisionApp, Inc.) was a digital product design collaboration platform founded in 2011 by Clark Valberg and Ben Nadel. It built a suite of tools for prototyping, design handoff, and real-time collaboration — including interactive prototypes, Inspect/Specs for developer handoff, DSM (Design System Manager), Boards, and the Freehand online whiteboard. At its peak InVision was valued near two billion dollars and backed by Battery Ventures, Accel, Tiger Global, and others, serving product design teams as a challenger to Adobe. As Figma surged, InVision's business declined: it sold the Freehand whiteboard product to Miro in 2023, and wound down all remaining services on December 31, 2024, after which customer content was permanently deleted. The invisionapp.com domain now redirects to Miro. InVision historically exposed a public REST API with OAuth and webhooks for its design platform, but that developer surface has been retired along with the product.
i.name: InVisionApp

i.description: Invitae — operated as Labcorp Invitae / Labcorp Genetics since Labcorp acquired select Invitae assets out of the company's 2024 Chapter 11 — is a United States medical genetics and healthcare-technology company providing clinical-grade hereditary and somatic genetic testing across oncology, women's health, cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, and rare disease. Its laboratory is CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited, and it publishes a HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices and state laboratory licensure. Clinicians order tests and receive results through a web portal with licensed genetic counseling and the Gia digital assistant. Invitae publishes no API: contract discovery across every Invitae host found no developer portal, no OpenAPI, no GraphQL endpoint, no MCP server, no A2A agent card, no FHIR CapabilityStatement, no SMART-on-FHIR configuration, no webhooks, no client SDK and no /.well-known document. api.invitae.com resolves but returns a blanket nginx 403 for every path, and the developer, docs and fhir subdomains do not resolve at all. The company's public GitHub organization is genuine but consists of forks of upstream bioinformatics projects, not first-party specifications or libraries.
i.name: Invitae

i.description: Invoca is an AI-powered revenue execution platform that connects marketing and sales teams by tracking and analyzing inbound phone calls across the buying journey. Its call tracking, conversation intelligence, and signal analytics attribute phone conversations back to the paid media, campaigns, and digital touchpoints that drove them, so revenue teams can optimize ad spend and improve buyer experiences. For developers, Invoca publishes a REST developer platform (developers.invoca.net) with date-versioned APIs covering call transactions, signals, call ingestion, RingPool number allocation, network integration, and pre-call insight, authenticated with self-serve Invoca API tokens or HTTP Basic.
i.name: Invoca

i.description: Invoice Ninja is an open-source invoicing, billing, payments, and expense tracking platform for freelancers and small businesses, available both as a self-hosted application and a managed SaaS at invoicing.co. The Invoice Ninja v5 REST API exposes full CRUD access to clients, invoices, quotes, payments, products, recurring invoices, expenses, projects, and tasks, authenticated with an API token (plus an optional secret) passed via HTTP headers.
i.name: Invoice Ninja

i.description: Invoice2go (part of BILL) is a mobile-first invoicing and small-business management platform for freelancers, contractors, and self-employed professionals. It lets users create and send professional invoices and estimates, accept online payments via bank transfer, credit and debit card, and PayPal, track expenses and billable time, capture customer reviews, and view business reports across web, iOS, and Android. Serving roughly 225,000 small-business users, Invoice2go focuses on getting paid faster and simplifying back-office admin. It was acquired by BILL in 2021. There is no live public developer API; third-party integrations are delivered through an Apideck-powered integrations marketplace (QuickBooks, Xero, MYOB, HubSpot, Shopify, Zapier, and more).
i.name: Invoice2go

i.description: InvoiceCraftly provides a free, no‑signup invoice generator and related tools. Users can create, edit, and export professional invoices, quotes, estimates, receipts, and credit notes in PDF, PNG, SVG, and CSV formats. The platform offers templates, company lookup, QR‑code payment integration, and multilingual support, targeting freelancers, small businesses, and enterprises seeking a simple invoicing solution without account requirements.
i.name: InvoiceCraftly Developer Document API

i.description: Invoiced is an accounts-receivable and billing automation platform that helps B2B finance teams get paid faster. Its REST API exposes customers, invoices, estimates, credit notes, payments, subscriptions, plans, items, events, and webhooks for automating A/R, payment collection, and subscription billing. Invoiced was acquired by Flywire in 2024.
i.name: Invoiced

i.description: Invokely provides official statistics on population, GDP, inflation, employment, income, housing, AI adoption and related indicators for every country, U.S. state and county, EU region and other jurisdictions. The data are sourced from national statistics offices, central banks, Eurostat and the World Bank and are available for readers, AI assistants and anyone needing to cite official figures. Access is offered through a web interface, an MCP connector for Claude or ChatGPT, and a REST API.
i.name: Invokely

i.description: Involve Asia (Involve Asia Technologies Sdn. Bhd.) is a leading affiliate and partnership-marketing network across Southeast Asia and Taiwan, connecting advertisers with publishers and creators to grow revenue through performance marketing. Its public Publisher API lets publishers programmatically pull conversion (commission) data, browse offers and campaigns, generate trackable affiliate deeplinks, and access Shopee Commission Xtra boosted-payout brands — without logging into the dashboard. The API is REST over HTTPS with bearer-JWT auth (2-hour token TTL), form-urlencoded requests, page-number pagination, a 60 requests/minute throttle, and a 1,000-link rolling 30-day deeplink cap. Involve Asia publishes first-party machine-readable artifacts: an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a Claude Skill, an llms.txt, and a Postman collection.
i.name: Involve Asia

i.description: Involve Space is an Italian stratospheric aerospace company building real-time Earth intelligence. It operates autonomous high-altitude balloon platforms (Stratostats) that loiter around 20 kilometers for hours, days, or weeks to deliver continuous, high-resolution Earth observation, bridging the gap between satellites, drones, and ground sensors. Its Neurostar AI flight software autonomously controls individual balloons and networks of them (LoonHive), while the CLEAR GeoAI platform turns captured imagery into geospatial insights for disaster response, infrastructure and environmental monitoring, security, and in-orbit-demonstration / payload validation. A certified B Corporation headquartered in Italy with U.S. operations at the Houston Spaceport, Involve Space is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital, CDP Venture Capital, and an EIC Accelerator grant.
i.name: Involve Space

i.description: Involve.AI was an AI-driven customer intelligence platform for customer success and revenue teams. It unified data from CRM, support, product-usage, and billing systems to calculate customer health scores and power an Early Warning System that predicted churn and surfaced renewal and upsell opportunities, with a 9Factor model scoring qualitative and quantitative signals. Founded as a Techstars-backed startup, Involve.AI was renamed into Jeeva.ai rather than shut down — the GitHub organization login is still Involve-AI while its display name is now Jeeva AI, and involve.ai redirects to jeeva.ai. The product surface is retired: app.involve.ai no longer resolves, the involve.ai web origin answers Cloudflare 522 on every path but the root redirect, and api.involve.ai answers 530 with no origin behind it. Only the customer knowledge base at city.involve.ai survives. Involve.AI never published a developer API — it took admin-granted read access into a customer's source systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Pendo) through a no-code Data Mapping tool and returned health scores through configured write-backs into the system of action — so this profile documents company identity and a retirement record rather than an API surface.
i.name: Involve.AI

i.description: involve.me is an AI quiz, form and funnel builder with built-in email automation and a lightweight CRM, operated by stereosense GmbH and used by marketing teams to capture, qualify and follow up on leads. Customers build quizzes, assessments, calculators, product finders, landing pages, surveys and payment pages in a no-code editor, publish them as a hosted page or an embedded widget, and route submissions into 55+ native CRM and email destinations. Its programmable surface is deliberately narrow: there is no public REST API and no OpenAPI, and the only machine-addressable paths are an outbound webhook that fires when a participant completes a funnel (Scale plan and above), a copy-paste JavaScript embed loader, Zapier and Make connectors, and an OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol server that exposes the marketing website's Statamic CMS rather than the product itself.
i.name: involve.me

i.description: Invygo is a car subscription and flexible rental platform founded in 2018 in Dubai, offering an alternative to traditional car ownership across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers subscribe to a car on a weekly or monthly basis, or enroll in a 36-month, Sharia-compliant "Subscribe to Own" plan, with insurance, maintenance, registration, and roadside assistance bundled into an all-inclusive fee and no deposit, salary certificate, or bank loan required. Invygo reports 20,000+ active subscriptions across 15+ cities in the GCC. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its public web, legal, and security surface.
i.name: Invygo

i.description: Inworld AI provides voice and conversational AI building blocks for games and interactive media. Public APIs cover Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text, a Realtime speech-to-speech API, and an LLM Router that fronts 220+ third-party models with unified billing.
i.name: Inworld AI

i.description: Inxeption was a B2B "industrial commerce" software company founded in 2017 by serial entrepreneur Farzad Dibachi and headquartered in Silicon Valley (San Jose / Cupertino, California). It sold a cloud commerce platform that let manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers stand up a branded online storefront and digital product catalog, then manage quoting, contract-specific pricing, purchase orders, bulk and multimodal orders, freight and logistics, returns, payments and sales analytics from one place — a category it marketed as the "Industrial Commerce SuperApp". Its best-known product was Inxeption Zippy, launched in March 2019 with UPS after an equity investment from the UPS Strategic Enterprise Fund, which bundled UPS as the shipper of choice into the storefront. The company raised roughly $186M across its rounds, including a $125M Series E in January 2022. Inxeption shut down on 2024-08-15. It never operated a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK or package was ever published, and its integration story was bespoke customer and EDI connections delivered under contract. Today only the apex domain resolves, and it no longer belongs to the company — it is listed for sale on the serp.domains domain marketplace. This profile is retained as a historical company record.
i.name: Inxeption

i.description: Inyad is an all-in-one business management and payments platform for small and medium businesses across Morocco, the Middle East, and Africa. Its mobile-first apps let merchants sell, get paid, and run their operations from one place — including a smart point-of-sale (POS Mahaal), automatic invoicing, an online store builder, employee attendance and payroll (Staff), a digital credit book (Konnash), in-store card terminals and terminal-free digital collection (Collect), professional business accounts, and money-transfer services. The company reports 250,000+ professionals on the platform and is backed by investors including Partech, Al Mada Ventures, CDG Invest, and FJ Labs. Inyad exposes an internal application backend (api.inyad.com) but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.
i.name: Inyad

i.description: INZMO is a European insurtech, founded in 2017, delivering 100% digital, embedded insurance for consumer goods and rental deposits. Its products cover mobile phones, laptops and tablets, bicycles, e-scooters, and rental deposit warranties, sold direct-to-consumer and embedded into partner checkout flows. INZMO offers partners an embedded-insurance API that adds insurance to the customer journey with real-time policy issuance, payment, and delivery of policy documents, and applies AI and large language models to streamline fraud prevention and claims handling. INZMO is a portfolio company of 500 Global.
i.name: INZMO

i.description: Io Turbine is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: Io Turbine

i.description: io.net is a decentralized GPU network for AI compute, built on Solana, that aggregates idle consumer and data-center GPUs (NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, and Blackwell-class) into on-demand, geo-distributed compute clusters orchestrated with the Ray framework. The platform exposes a Web3-native alternative to hyperscaler GPU cloud through several developer-facing surfaces: IO Intelligence (an OpenAI-compatible inference API for 15+ open-source models including Llama 3.3 70B), IO Cloud (Container-as-a-Service and VM-as-a-Service APIs for deploying GPU containers, Ray clusters, Kubernetes clusters, and bare-metal instances), IO Agents (agent and agentic-workflow APIs), IO Explorer (a network analytics API for devices, clusters, and block rewards), IO Worker (the supplier-side onboarding stack), IO ID (the account/wallet hub), and IO Staking. Confidential Compute on Intel TDX-enabled H100/H200/B200 GPUs and a remote attestation service for Intel TDX and NVIDIA H200 confidential VMs round out the security surface. The IO token is an SPL token on Solana used for settlement, staking, and rewards; fiat and USDC payments are accepted and converted to IO. io.net also publishes an MCP server at mcp.io.solutions for agent-driven cluster provisioning. The platform's tagline is "the open-source AI infrastructure platform" and its commercial pitch is AI compute at 50–70% below comparable hyperscaler rates.
i.name: io.net

i.description: Iodine Software is a healthcare AI company whose AwareCDI suite applies clinical machine learning to the mid-revenue cycle, surfacing clinical documentation integrity (CDI) gaps, prioritizing high-impact cases, and automating physician queries so hospitals and health systems capture the complete patient story for more accurate coding, quality metrics, and revenue capture. Its Concurrent, Retrospective, and Interact modules integrate directly into existing EHR and coding workflows rather than exposing a public developer API. Founded in Austin, Texas, Iodine was acquired by revenue-cycle technology company Waystar in October 2025, and its products, blog, newsroom, and legal pages now live under waystar.com and its AltitudeAI platform. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Bain Capital Ventures portfolio company in the healthcare sector.
i.name: Iodine Software (Waystar)

i.description: Iolyx Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Burlingame, California, working at what it calls the intersection of immunology and ophthalmology — "immuno-ophthalmology". The company develops immunomodulatory therapeutics that target ocular inflammation at its source, using what it describes as innovative pathways and tailored formulations for precise delivery to the relevant ocular tissues, positioned as an alternative to conventional steroids and broad immunosuppressants. Its lead asset, ILYX-002, is in trials for autoimmune-associated dry eye disease; the company announced Phase 2 results in May 2025 and, in December 2025, a strategic agreement with Laboratoires Théa to develop and commercialize ILYX-002 alongside Series B funding for its retinal pipeline. The stated pipeline spans front-of-eye indications (dry eye, ocular allergy, rosacea, uveitis) and back-of-eye indications (age-related macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, posterior uveitis). Iolyx is a drug developer rather than a software vendor: it operates a six-page WordPress marketing site at iolyx.com and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.
i.name: Iolyx Therapeutics

i.description: IOMED is a Barcelona-based health-tech company operating a Data Space Platform that gives hospitals and life-science companies secure, GDPR-compliant access to real-world clinical data for secondary use and research. Using AI and natural language processing, IOMED transforms free-text electronic health records into structured, coded data standardized on the OMOP Common Data Model, then exposes it through a federated EU network of hospital partners. Platform capabilities include feasibility patient counts, aggregated patient characterization, patient-level data extraction, and a patient finder for clinical-trial recruitment. IOMED is ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27701:2019, and ISO 9001:2015 certified, and is backed by Speedinvest, Adara Ventures, XTX Markets, and Philips Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; IOMED does not currently publish a public developer API.
i.name: Iomed

i.description: Iomob (The Internet of Mobility) was a Barcelona-based Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) technology company founded in 2017. Its platform let cities, transport operators, and corporations orchestrate multimodal, door-to-door journeys — combining public transit, ride-hailing, taxis, micromobility, parking, and demand-responsive transport — through unified journey-planning APIs, native iOS/Android SDKs, and customizable white-label apps. Iomob's MaaS platform and SDK were acquired by Busup in January 2025 to build a corporate mobility platform; the Iomob UK entity was dissolved in September 2025 and the public website (iomob.net) is currently offline (Cloudflare 526 origin error). No public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK packages, or GitHub organization could be verified during enrichment — Iomob's APIs and SDKs were delivered under B2B/partner agreements.
i.name: Iomob

i.description: ION Group is a visionary innovator delivering mission-critical trading and workflow automation software to financial institutions, corporations, central banks, and governments. ION helps customers improve decision-making, simplify complex processes, and empower people through automation.
i.name: Ion Group

i.description: ION Mobility is a Singapore-headquartered technology and automotive company that designs and builds affordable, zero-emission smart electric motorcycles for riders across Southeast Asia, with its flagship M1-S model and a companion rider mobile app. The company combines advanced hardware and software with human-centred design, spanning electric two-wheelers and energy charging and storage solutions, with additional offices in Jakarta and Shenzhen and backing from investors including 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and identity surface; ION Mobility currently publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification, operating a consumer waitlist/test-ride site and an internal open-source tooling estate on GitHub.
i.name: Ion Mobility

i.description: IONA (IONA Drones) is a UK-based autonomous drone delivery company building the full technology stack for logistics operators. Its tilt-rotor Sonnet aircraft performs VTOL from compact sites and carries up to 20 parcels up to 200 km per autonomous flight. IONA pairs the aircraft with an onboard autonomy operating system, GPS/LiDAR sensor-fusion precision landing, a SORA-aligned BVLOS compliance engine, an operations centre for real-time fleet monitoring and analytics, and a digital twin for simulation and predictive maintenance. The platform integrates with existing TMS/WMS logistics systems and targets healthcare, rural/remote, express e-commerce, industrial, and maritime delivery. Backed by Techstars.
i.name: IONA

i.description: Ionetix (IONETIX Corporation) is a Lansing, Michigan radiopharmaceutical and cyclotron company founded in 2009 out of technology developed at the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center. It built the first commercial compact superconducting cyclotron, the ION-12SC, and operates a distributed network of those cyclotrons installed on or near the campuses of hospital PET programs to produce N-13 Ammonia, a short-half-life PET tracer used for cardiac perfusion imaging and the detection of coronary artery disease, sold to providers on a pay-by-the-dose basis. Alongside the cardiac PET network the company runs an alpha isotope manufacturing facility in Lansing built around a 30 MeV cyclotron for commercial-scale production of Actinium-225 and Astatine-211 for targeted alpha therapy, has an approved ANDA for Gallium Ga-68 Gozetotide (PSMA-11), and supply and development partnerships with AlfaRim Medical and Cellectar Biosciences. Ionetix completed a $30M+ financing and go-public transaction in April 2026. Ionetix publishes no developer platform, no API documentation, no SDK and no developer portal; the only machine-readable surface on ionetix.com is the WordPress REST API at /wp-json/, whose wp/v2 namespace is anonymously readable and serves the company newsroom, careers postings, conference and case-study archives, product pages, leadership profiles, the media library (including the ION-12SC cyclotron data sheet PDFs) and a site-wide search endpoint as JSON. The WordPress Abilities API namespace (wp-abilities/v1) is registered on the site but returns HTTP 401 to anonymous callers, and no MCP namespace is registered.
i.name: Ionetix

i.description: Ionic is a platform for building and deploying modern mobile applications and micro frontend experiences. Ionic provides tools, guides, and APIs to help developers build and ship incredible apps faster, including cross-platform mobile development capabilities.
i.name: Ionic

i.description: Ionic Security was an Atlanta, Georgia data-protection and dynamic-authorization company whose Machina platform let developers add data access, control, and protection to any application with a small amount of code. Machina provided an API-driven service layer for just-in-time enforcement of data-access policies — evaluating user, device, service, environment, and data attributes to allow or deny each request — backed by client SDKs for Java, C, C++, C#, Objective-C, Python, and JavaScript, a Machina CLI, and cloud-storage integrations for AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Storage. Ionic was venture-backed (GV, Kleiner Perkins, Ten Eleven Ventures) and was acquired by Twilio in April 2021 for roughly $30.2 million to accelerate Twilio's data-security capabilities. The company's developer domains (ionic.com, dev.ionic.com, api.ionic.com) are no longer live, but the first-party SDKs and CLI remain published on Maven Central, PyPI, and the IonicDev GitHub organization.
i.name: Ionic Security

i.description: Ionis Pharmaceuticals is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ionis Pharmaceuticals API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
i.name: Ionis Pharmaceuticals

i.description: IONITY operates a high-power electric vehicle (EV) charging network across Europe, offering fast, reliable charging stations in 24 countries. The company focuses on seamless mobility, providing drivers with subscription plans, fleet solutions, and a mobile app to locate and pay for charging. IONITY aims to accelerate the transition to electric transportation by expanding its infrastructure and delivering transparent pricing.
i.name: IONITY

i.description: IONOS is a global cloud provider offering web hosting, domain registration, cloud servers, and AI-driven services. It serves businesses of all sizes with scalable infrastructure, managed services, and a suite of tools for website creation, e‑commerce, and digital transformation. IONOS emphasizes security, performance, and customer support, providing solutions ranging from shared hosting to dedicated servers and GPU‑accelerated cloud instances.
i.name: IONOS

i.description: IonQ (NYSE IONQ) is a College Park, Maryland-based public trapped-ion quantum computing company. IonQ designs, manufactures, and operates trapped-ion quantum computers (Aria, Forte, Forte Enterprise, Tempo, Harmony) and delivers them through the IonQ Quantum Cloud REST API, on-premises Forte Enterprise systems, and partner clouds (AWS Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, Google Cloud). The platform supports submission of QIS and native-gate circuits, multi-circuit and Quantum Function jobs, reserved Sessions, error mitigation, and organization-level usage and cost reporting. IonQ's quantum networking, security (QKD), sensing, and space-infrastructure businesses extend the trapped-ion core into a broader quantum systems portfolio.
i.name: IonQ

i.description: Iontra Inc. is a Denver, Colorado battery technology company that develops proprietary Charge-Control technology for rechargeable lithium batteries. Founded in 2013 and publicly launched in 2022, Iontra applies electrodynamic sensing and signal processing during charging to suppress lithium plating, dendrite growth and SEI-layer expansion, claiming up to 4x cycle life, 2x faster charging, improved cold-weather charging and better safety without changing cell chemistry. The technology is chemistry agnostic across Li-ion, Li-metal, Li-S, solid-state and Na-ion cells, and is delivered to OEMs as custom charging algorithm "recipes" flashed onto an application-specific microcontroller, or as a software-only library. Iontra closed a $45M Series C led by Volta Energy Technologies to launch an integrated RISC-V charge-control and fuel-gauge MCU. Iontra is an embedded/silicon company: it publishes no public web API, no OpenAPI, and no public SDK packages — its SDK is firmware delivered to OEM customers through a login-gated Document Portal under commercial engagement.
i.name: Iontra

i.description: iOS is Apple's mobile operating system and the developer platform behind iPhone apps. While the bulk of the iOS SDK is delivered as Swift / Objective-C client frameworks (UIKit, SwiftUI, MapKit, HealthKit, HomeKit, SiriKit, StoreKit, AppIntents, PassKit, WidgetKit, ActivityKit), Apple also exposes a substantial set of server-side HTTPS APIs that iOS developers, publishers, and back-end systems consume directly. This repository indexes that server-side surface — App Store Connect API, App Store Server API, App Store Server Notifications, Apple Push Notification service (APNs), DeviceCheck / App Attest, Sign in with Apple, Apple Music API, the Wallet / PassKit Web Service contract, and related developer infrastructure — and points to the matching OpenAPI artifacts where Apple publishes them.
i.name: iOS

i.description: IOTA is an open-source distributed ledger technology built to bring real-world applications on-chain. It is the first internet-scale programmable blockchain platform powered by the Move programming language with horizontal scaling, feeless transactions, and a unique parallel transaction processing model. IOTA exposes a JSON-RPC 2.0 API over HTTP and a GraphQL RPC for querying objects, checkpoints, transactions, coins, events, and on-chain state on Mainnet, Testnet, and Devnet networks. The platform targets trade and supply chains, decentralized finance, digital identity, real-world asset tokenization, and product lifecycle management.
i.name: IOTA

i.description: iovation is a device-intelligence and online fraud-prevention service acquired by TransUnion in 2018 and now delivered as TransUnion TruValidate Device Risk (the SDK was formerly branded "FraudForce"). It fingerprints web and mobile devices into an encrypted "blackbox," evaluates it against a shared reputation database of billions of devices plus configurable rulesets, and returns a transaction risk assessment. Device data is collected client-side with first-party JavaScript and native iOS/Android SDKs; server-side integration is a SOAP CheckTransactionDetails call over HTTPS. iovation is used for account takeover, new-account fraud, payment fraud, and bot detection.
i.name: iovation

Operated by Everapi GmbH, the API serves businesses needing programmatic IP address intelligence for fraud detection, content localization, and data-driven decisions.
