i.description: InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) is a peer-to-peer hypermedia protocol and distributed content-addressed storage system. The Kubo implementation exposes an HTTP RPC API (/api/v0/) for adding, pinning, and retrieving content-addressed files, managing DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) nodes, key management, and network peer operations. The HTTP Gateway API provides read-only access to IPFS and IPNS content over standard HTTP. The Delegated Routing V1 HTTP API enables clients to discover content providers and resolve peer records without running a full DHT node.
i.name: IPFS

i.description: Unlimited free IP Address API with useful information
i.name: IPGEO

i.description: IPGeolocation.io is a multi-product IP intelligence platform offering IP geolocation, IP security/threat intelligence, ASN lookup, abuse contact, timezone, astronomy (sunrise, sunset, moon phase, celestial position), and user-agent parsing APIs. All endpoints are served under https://api.ipgeolocation.io with API-key authentication. The free plan offers 1,000 credits/day; paid plans (Starter through Premium) scale from 150K to 5M requests/month, with custom Enterprise pricing on top.
i.name: IPGeolocation.io

i.description: iPiD (International Payments Identity) is a fintech providing real-time Know Your Payee (KYP) verification for cross-border and domestic payments. Its single, payment-rail-agnostic API lets banks, PSPs, and corporates validate bank account ownership and match payee names before funds move, reducing authorized push payment (APP) fraud, business email compromise losses, and failed transactions. Products include iPiD Validate (global payee / bank account verification with name-matching), iPiD Node (a scheme-compliance layer for EU Verification of Payee, UK Confirmation of Payee, FATF Recommendation 16, and US Nacha), and a Payment Agent agentic verification layer. Founded in 2021, iPiD is backed by QED Investors, Monk's Hill Ventures, Quona Capital, Jungle Ventures, Saison Capital, and others. Public API access is gated behind a sales/demo process; no machine-readable specification is published publicly.
i.name: Ipid

i.description: iPierian * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv, kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: iPierian *

i.description: ipify operates two complementary IP APIs. The free Public IP Address API (api.ipify.org, api6.ipify.org, api64.ipify.org) returns the caller's public IPv4, IPv6, or dual-stack address as plain text, JSON, or JSONP — with no authentication, no rate limit, and no logging. The paid IP Geolocation API (geo.ipify.org), operated by WhoisXML API, resolves an IP, domain, or email to a country/region/city, ISP, and Autonomous System (ASN) profile using credit-metered subscription plans.
i.name: ipify

i.description: IPinfo is an IP address data and intelligence platform that provides geolocation (country, region, city, coordinates, postal, timezone), ASN data, company association, mobile carrier identification, hosted domains lookup, privacy detection (VPN, proxy, Tor, relay, hosting), residential proxy detection, WHOIS, IP ranges, abuse contacts, and an IP-to-Places product. Data is available via a unified REST API (Lite, Core, Plus, Max, Enterprise tiers), a Batch Enrichment endpoint, and downloadable databases (CSV, MMDB, JSON, Parquet). Authentication uses access tokens via Basic Auth, Bearer Token, or query parameter; dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 endpoints are available.
i.name: IPinfo

i.description: Free Geolocation tools and APIs for country, region, city and time zone lookup by IP address
i.name: IPInfoDB

i.description: Free VPN, proxy, Tor and datacenter IP detection. 13 sources, active probing.
i.name: IPLogs

i.description: Portuguese weather and climate data
i.name: IPMA

i.description: IPQualityScore (IPQS) provides real-time fraud prevention and threat intelligence APIs covering proxy/VPN/Tor and IP reputation scoring, email and phone validation, malicious URL and domain scanning, device fingerprinting, transaction risk scoring, and dark-web leaked-data checks. All endpoints are delivered as a simple REST/JSON interface with the API key passed in the request path.
i.name: IPQualityScore

i.description: IPregistry provides a fast, reliable IP geolocation and threat intelligence REST API for looking up information associated with IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and Autonomous Systems (AS). The API returns location data, connection details, company and carrier information, time zone, currency, and comprehensive security threat assessments from over 220 OSINT threat feeds. It supports single and batch IP lookups, user-agent parsing, ASN queries, and optional EU-region routing for data residency compliance. All lookups are authenticated via API key and billed against prepaid credits that never expire.
i.name: IPregistry

i.description: iPrice Group is a Southeast Asian e-commerce aggregator and price-comparison platform headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It aggregates billions of live product offers and thousands of coupons from more than a thousand retail partners, letting shoppers compare prices, discover deals, and make more informed purchases across seven markets: Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Hong Kong. Backed by 500 Global as part of the Asia Venture Group portfolio, iPrice serves tens of millions of monthly visitors and is known for its large SEA e-commerce dataset. As of this profile, iPrice does not publish a public consumer or partner API, developer portal, or OpenAPI; this record is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: iPrice

i.description: iPrint.com was an early online print shop, launched in 1996 out of Larkspur, California, that let consumers and small businesses design and order customizable printed products (business cards, stationery, invitations, promotional items) over the web. Backed by Canaan Partners, the company went public on the NASDAQ under the symbol IPRT in March 2000, merged with promotional-products firm Wood Associates in 2001, was delisted in 2002, and its assets were ultimately acquired by Harland Clarke in 2009. The iprint.com domain today hosts a live consumer print e-commerce storefront operated out of Richmond Hill, Ontario, offering business cards, marketing materials, signs, banners, stickers, and design services. The company exposes no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is identity-only and carries no API artifacts.
i.name: Iprint

i.description: Face and License Plate Anonymization
i.name: IPS Online

i.description: IPstack is an IP geolocation API from APILayer, an Idera, Inc. brand. A single GET request against api.ipstack.com resolves an IPv4 or IPv6 address into more than 100 fields — country, region and city, latitude and longitude, time zone, local currency, ISP, ASN and connection type — plus an optional security module that flags proxies, VPNs, Tor exit nodes and known threat actors. Standard, bulk (up to 50 addresses) and requester lookups are offered in JSON, XML and JSONP. The same data is exposed to agents through APILayer's hosted MCP server at mcp.apilayer.com, which publishes RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata and an OAuth authorization server at auth.apilayer.com.
i.name: IPstack

i.description: IPSY is a personalized beauty subscription company founded in 2011 by Michelle Phan, Marcelo Camberos, and Jennifer Goldfarb. Members take a detailed beauty quiz and receive monthly curated "Glam Bag" drops of deluxe samples and full-size makeup, skincare, hair, and fragrance products across tiers (Original, Boxycharm, and Ultimate). IPSY operates as a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership platform under the BFA Industries umbrella; it exposes no public developer API, running on internal GraphQL and REST services with Auth0-based consumer identity. This API Evangelist profile tracks IPSY's public web, security, and identity surface rather than a documented developer program.
i.name: Ipsy

i.description: IPtronics A/S was a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2003 in Copenhagen, Denmark, designing integrated circuits (laser drivers, transimpedance amplifiers, and CMOS ICs) for parallel optical interconnects used in high-speed computing, storage, and datacenter communications. Backed by Creandum, Sunstone, and 10i10, the company was acquired by Mellanox Technologies in 2013 (now part of NVIDIA) and no longer operates as an independent entity. It is a hardware chip vendor with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or programmatic surface; the former iptronics.com domain now redirects to NVIDIA Networking. Retained in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio identity record only.
i.name: IPtronics

i.description: Air quality and weather data
i.name: IQAir

i.description: IQAir AirVisual provides a real-time air quality REST API delivering PM2.5, PM10, AQI, weather data, and pollution forecasts for cities and GPS coordinates worldwide. The API aggregates data from over 80,000 ground-based sensors, satellite sources, and regulatory monitors, validated with AI-driven machine learning.
i.name: IQAir AirVisual

i.description: IQI Inc, operating as Beijing AIQI Technology Co., Ltd. (北京爱其科技有限公司), is a mobile-internet company founded in April 2013 that develops smart hardware and robotics products under a "Create more & More fun" philosophy. It is best known for its ONEBOT building-block robots and construction sets — including the Mi Tu (米兔) block robots in the Xiaomi ecosystem and heritage-architecture sets such as the Millennium Mortise-and-Tenon (千年榫), Qinian Hall (祈年殿) and Forbidden City Corner Tower kits. The company sells through its own store, Tmall (ONEBOT flagship) and JD.com. It is a consumer smart-hardware/toy brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK or documentation surface.
i.name: IQI Inc (Beijing AIQI Technology)

i.description: iQIYI is one of China's largest online video streaming and entertainment platforms, delivering movies, TV dramas, variety shows, animation, documentaries, and original content across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and OTT/smart-TV devices. Beyond its consumer service, iQIYI runs a SaaS / OTT developer platform that lets partners launch their own branded streaming service with a RESTful API covering Video, Channel, Album, Search, and Player resources, plus AVOD/SVOD/TVOD monetization, analytics, audience management, and DRM. iQIYI also operates the QIYU XR developer platform for VR/AR device applications and maintains an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Hongshan and has been enriched from iQIYI's public developer surface.
i.name: iQIYI

i.description: IQM Quantum Computers (IQM Finland Oy) builds superconducting quantum computers and sells access to them, both as on-premises systems and as a cloud service. Its developer surface is IQM Resonance, a quantum cloud platform at resonance.iqm.tech whose REST API accepts circuits, queues them against a named QPU, and returns measurement results — billed in QPU seconds rather than API calls. Access is through a bearer API token generated from the Resonance dashboard, and the practical client contract is IQM's Apache-2.0 Python stack (iqm-client, with Qiskit, Cirq and Qrisp adapters) rather than a published OpenAPI, which IQM does not ship. IQM does publish 14 first-party Protobuf message contracts defining the Station Control wire format, a dated changelog with explicit breaking-change notices, and a free Starter tier with a monthly credit allowance.
i.name: IQM Quantum Computers

i.description: IQVIA empowers life sciences organizations to accelerate innovation, improve patient outcomes, and bring treatments to market faster through advanced analytics and technology. IQVIA is a Fortune 500 company offering data, analytics, clinical research, and connected intelligence services.
i.name: IQVIA

i.description: IRALOGIX is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania fintech that operates a cloud-native, white-label IRA (Individual Retirement Account) recordkeeping and administration platform for financial institutions — banks, wealth managers, brokerages, recordkeepers and advisors — who use it to offer digital IRA programs under their own brand. The platform covers onboarding, contributions, trading, distributions, rollovers, compliance monitoring and administration end to end, and the company markets "API-driven connectivity and real-time data flows" that integrate with existing custodial and recordkeeping infrastructure rather than replacing it. The developer surface is partner-gated: documentation at docs.iralogix.com sits behind Okta visitor authentication and the partner console at partner.iralogix.com behind an Auth0 tenant, so no public OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or SDK is published. The company states SSAE SOC 2 Type 1 and SSAE SOC 1 Type 2 attestation.
i.name: IRALOGIX

i.description: Ireland Open Data Catalogue is a national government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 1,467 datasets.
i.name: Ireland Open Data Catalogue

i.description: Iress is a technology company providing software for financial markets, wealth management, and trading. Iress QuantFeed is a signature end-to-end ultra-low latency market data API that connects over 240 normalized market data feeds from 80+ sources.
i.name: Iress

i.description: iRhythm Technologies is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: IRTC) digital healthcare company specializing in ambulatory cardiac monitoring for the detection and management of heart arrhythmias. Its Zio service pairs a wearable single-lead ECG biosensor patch (Zio monitor and Zio AT) with FDA-cleared AI/deep-learning algorithms, qualified cardiac technician verification, and cloud-based data analytics to produce end-of-wear diagnostic reports for clinicians. The platform includes the ZioSuite clinician portal for report interpretation and patient management, the MyZio patient app for symptom logging and education, EHR integration, and telehealth workflows. iRhythm was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; enrichment is limited to public identity, trust, and domain-security signals.
i.name: Irhythmtech

i.description: Iridium Communications Inc. (NASDAQ: IRDM) is a McLean, Virginia satellite communications company operating a constellation of 66 cross-linked Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites that deliver truly global L-band voice, data, IoT, and positioning/navigation/timing (PNT) services across every region of the Earth, including the polar oceans. Iridium sells satellite phones (Iridium Extreme), satellite messengers, satellite IoT modules and modems (Iridium 9602/9603, Iridium Certus 9770/9810/9704, Iridium Edge, Iridium Edge Pro, Iridium Edge Solar), Short Burst Data (SBD) messaging, broadband Certus terminals, and next-generation Iridium NTN Direct 5G Non-Terrestrial Network services built on 3GPP NB-IoT for direct-to-device smartphone and IoT connectivity. Iridium CloudConnect — co-developed with Amazon Web Services — pipes satellite IoT data as JSON into customer-owned Amazon SQS queues inside their own AWS VPC over a dedicated private Iridium-AWS interconnect, making Iridium the first global cloud-native satellite IoT backhaul. The company serves aviation, maritime, government/defense, land-mobile, autonomous systems, and IoT markets through a partner ecosystem of more than 500 service providers, value-added resellers, and hardware OEMs, and in May 2026 announced a planned acquisition of Aireon, operator of the world's only space-based air traffic surveillance network. Iridium's business model is airtime/subscription revenue plus hardware module licensing and engineering services; there is no public, self-service developer API or OpenAPI — network access is mediated through Iridium-authorized service providers, the Iridium CloudConnect AWS integration, and hardware-level AT-command and SBD interfaces on Iridium modems.
i.name: Iridium

i.description: Iris Automation was a Reno, Nevada deep-tech company that built Casia, a computer-vision detect-and-avoid (DAA) system enabling beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) drone operations. Its onboard products (Casia, Casia X) and the ground-based Casia G used industrial cameras and machine-learning to detect non-cooperative intruder aircraft and prevent near mid-air collisions, integrating with MavLink-based autopilots and UAS ground control systems. Iris Automation was acquired by uAvionix in late 2023; the irisonboard.com domain now 301-redirects to uAvionix and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or well-known surface of its own.
i.name: Iris Automation

i.description: Iris Telehealth is an Austin, Texas telepsychiatry company, founded in 2013, that delivers virtual behavioral health care to healthcare organizations rather than direct to consumers. It contracts psychiatrists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, LCSWs and LPCs to hospitals and health systems, community mental health centers, community health centers and FQHCs, and Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics, covering pediatric through geriatric populations and low-acuity therapy through high-acuity psychiatry. Its service lines are Virtual Clinic (comprehensive care and behavioral health integration), On-Demand Services (24/7 emergency department psychiatry support), Scheduled Services (matched provider staffing), Bridge Clinic, and Iris Insights, an AI-enabled behavioral health analytics platform covering risk optimization, capacity management, a behavioral health command center and revenue cycle analytics. The company reports over 430 clinicians and over 210 partner organizations, and has been accredited by the Joint Commission for behavioral health care since 2019, earning recertification since. Its delivery model is deliberately technology-agnostic: Iris clinicians work inside each partner's existing EMR/EHR and e-prescribing tools over HIPAA-compliant video, so the integration burden sits with the partner's systems. Iris Telehealth publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract, and operates no public GitHub organization.
i.name: Iris Telehealth

i.description: Iris.ai is a Norwegian AI company providing an AI knowledge foundation for regulated enterprises, turning complex enterprise and scientific data into trustworthy, compliant AI. Its platform spans three products — Axion (data organization for AI-ready intelligence), Neuralith (enterprise knowledge integration into AI engines), and RSpace, the Researcher Workspace that lets R&D teams, librarians, and academics search, filter, analyze, extract, summarize, and report across scientific literature. Iris.ai is backed by 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture pending any future developer surface.
i.name: Iris.ai

i.description: Irish Agriculture Open Data is a federal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 56 datasets.
i.name: Irish Agriculture Open Data

i.description: Irish Housing Open Data is a federal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 461 datasets.
i.name: Irish Housing Open Data

i.description: Realtime content moderation API that blocks or blurs unwanted images in real-time
i.name: Irisnet

i.description: IrisVR is a virtual-reality software company for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, best known for its two products: Prospect, a desktop application that converts Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Navisworks and other 3D/BIM models into immersive VR walkthroughs in one click, and Scope, a mobile app for viewing and sharing 360-degree panoramas on standalone and phone-based VR headsets. Founded in New York, IrisVR was acquired by The Wild in 2021, and The Wild (together with IrisVR) was subsequently acquired by Autodesk in 2022. The products and support site remain available. IrisVR does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, packages, and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: IrisVR

i.description: IRIZ Platform is the multi-brand, agent-first fashion storefront platform behind fashionbyu.com (brands such as BWET Swimwear, Me+Em, Kitri Studio, Lisou London and Réalisation Par are hosted as /brand/<slug> storefronts). It publishes a first-party OpenAPI 3.0.0 ("IRIZ Platform API", 108 operations, canonical base path /iriz/v1/) at https://mirror.fashionbyu.com/iriz/v1/docs/spec.json with a Swagger UI at /iriz/docs, a live hosted MCP server (iriz-agent-commerce, protocol 2025-06-18, nine tools: search_catalog, get_product_feed, get_policies, create_cart, mutate_cart, get_cart, quote_cart, confirm_checkout, get_order) whose tools/list answers unauthenticated, two A2A agent cards (a Storefront Commerce card at the canonical /.well-known/agent-card.json and a Platform Interop card at the legacy /.well-known/agent.json, both flavored: protocolVersions[] instead of protocolVersion), an llms.txt and an agent-welcoming robots.txt, and per-brand OpenAI/ACP-compatible product feeds (/brand/<slug>/feed.json) with schema.org Product JSON-LD. The platform runs on Cloudflare Workers (D1/KV/R2/queues/Durable Objects per /iriz/health); HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare managed challenge while the JSON surfaces answer directly. The registrable domain fashionbyu.com serves the interop card, llms.txt and the brand feeds but 404s the MCP and REST routes, which live on mirror.fashionbyu.com; every link inside the provider's own llms.txt and robots.txt points at www.fashionbyu.com, which does not resolve (NXDOMAIN on 2026-09-19).
i.name: IRIZ Platform

i.description: IRL (legal name Get Together, Inc.) was a San Francisco social calendar and group-messaging app that let people share and sync calendars with friends and follow venues, organizations and notable figures. It raised more than $200 million in venture capital, including a $170 million Series C led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 in 2021 that valued the company at $1.17 billion. In June 2023 a special committee of the board reported that roughly 95 percent of the app's claimed users were automated or bot accounts, and the board voted to dissolve the company; the SEC charged founder and former CEO Abraham Shafi with fraud on July 31, 2024. The company is defunct: irl.com now serves only an asset-inquiry notice, the marketing and app hosts are abandoned Netlify shells, docs.irl.com (Postman-hosted developer docs) returns 404, and api.irl.com is a dangling CNAME to a deleted AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment. No public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer program remains.
i.name: IRL

i.description: iRobot Corporation is a Bedford, Massachusetts consumer robotics company best known for the Roomba robot vacuum and the Braava and Braava jet robot mop product lines. Founded in 1990 by MIT roboticists, iRobot pioneered the home cleaning robot category and has sold tens of millions of units worldwide. Its current portfolio includes the Roomba Max, Roomba Plus, and Roomba 100/200 series vacuums and combo (vacuum + mop) models, along with AutoWash and AutoEmpty docks, the iRobot Home App for scheduling and mapping, and a cleaning accessories and trade-in program. The proposed acquisition by Amazon was abandoned in January 2024 after regulatory pushback from the European Commission, after which iRobot underwent a major restructuring and layoffs. iRobot's revenue model is direct robot and accessory sales plus recurring consumables; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI specification, and its homesupport documentation explicitly notes that Wi-Fi connected Roombas do not have an open API. A community of unofficial reverse-engineered libraries (dorita980, rest980, pyirobot) exists but is not endorsed by iRobot.
i.name: iRobot

i.description: Iron Fish is a zero-knowledge Layer 1 blockchain that brings optional, best-in-class privacy to cryptocurrency. Built on zk-SNARK cryptography, it lets anyone send, receive, and bridge assets privately across 20+ EVM-compatible chains while running their own node. For developers, Iron Fish exposes a self-hosted node RPC server (over TCP, IPC, and HTTP with JSON and streaming responses) organized into chain, wallet, node, peer, miner, config, event, mempool, and worker namespaces, plus a hosted public REST API at api.ironfish.network powering the block explorer and faucet. Integration is supported by a first-party JavaScript SDK (@ironfish/sdk), Rust/Node bindings, and the ironfish CLI for node operation, wallet management, mining, and multisig. Backed by a16z and Electric Capital.
i.name: Iron Fish

i.description: Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services, providing records management, data centers, secure shredding, digital transformation, and asset lifecycle management for organizations worldwide. Iron Mountain helps customers protect and unlock value from their physical and digital information assets.
i.name: Iron Mountain

i.description: Iron Ox (legally Inevitable Tech, Inc.) was a San Carlos, California robotics company that built autonomous indoor farms — hydroponic greenhouses worked by mobile transport robots and a robotic arm that seeded, moved, imaged and harvested leafy greens and herbs, with machine learning used to spot pests and disease plant by plant. Founded in 2015 by Brandon Alexander and Jon Binney, it went through Y Combinator (W16), raised roughly $98 million in total including a $53 million Series C led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures in September 2021, and ran greenhouses in Gilroy, California and Lockhart, Texas. It cut about half its staff — roughly 50 people — in November 2022 and ceased operations in mid-2023. Iron Ox never ran a developer program: it sold produce, not software, and the only public code it ever shipped was internal ROS robotics tooling on GitHub. Its site, ironox.com, is now a GoDaddy parking lander and every developer subdomain has been removed from DNS, so there is no API, specification, SDK or documentation surface left to profile.
i.name: Iron Ox

i.description: Iron.io provides hosted serverless infrastructure for background processing and asynchronous messaging. Its flagship products are IronMQ, a high-performance hosted message queue for passing messages and events between processes and systems with support for push queues, subscribers, and long-polling; IronWorker, a container-based, multi-language, work-on-demand platform for running background jobs and scheduled tasks at scale; and IronCache, a hosted key/value store. All services share a single REST/HTTP API authenticated with per-project OAuth tokens obtained from the Iron.io HUD, and a broad set of official client libraries across Go, Ruby, Python, PHP, Java, Node.js, .NET, and Rust.
i.name: Iron.io

i.description: Ironclad is the enterprise contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform used by legal, sales, procurement, and finance teams to draft, negotiate, approve, sign, store, and analyze contracts at scale. The platform combines a no-code Workflow Designer, AI-powered Jurist agentic assistant (contract review, redlining, drafting, repository search), a Records repository with smart import and metadata extraction, Clickwrap for online acceptance, and deep integrations with Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Slack, Workday, ServiceNow, Jira, HubSpot, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, and Power Automate. Ironclad publishes three first-party OpenAPI 3.1 specifications (Public API, OAuth 2.0, SCIM 2.0) plus the Clickwrap REST/JS surface, supports regional NA1/EU1 hosting, OAuth 2.0 with scoped tokens, SCIM-based provisioning, and event-driven webhooks. Ironclad reported surpassing $200M in ARR in February 2026.
i.name: Ironclad

i.description: Ironclad Clickwrap is a developer-friendly platform for implementing clickwrap agreements, terms of service, and contract acceptance workflows. The Ironclad Clickwrap API enables developers to programmatically manage clickwrap agreements, record user acceptance, and generate audit trails.
i.name: Ironclad Clickwrap

i.description: IronCore Labs builds application-layer encryption tools that keep sensitive data private while it stays usable. Its products include SaaS Shield (tenant-controlled envelope encryption with customer-managed keys / BYOK for multi-tenant SaaS), Cloaked Search (a transparent encrypting proxy for Elasticsearch and OpenSearch), Cloaked AI (encryption of vector embeddings for AI/RAG workloads while preserving similarity search), the Data Control Platform (end-to-end encryption SDKs where the end user holds the key), and an S3 Proxy for per-tenant object encryption. Developers integrate through the unified IronCore Alloy SDK (Rust, Python, Java, Kotlin), the legacy Tenant Security Client (Node.js, Go, PHP), and the self-hosted Vendor API Bridge REST API for programmatic tenant and KMS configuration management.
i.name: IronCore Labs

i.description: Ironfang Render is the rendering API from Ironfang Ltd, a UK software company that builds and operates self-service developer APIs. It turns a URL or a block of raw HTML into screenshots, PDFs, templated images, QR codes, captioned video clips and scrolling site previews over plain HTTPS and JSON, with no browser fleet for the customer to run. The v1 REST API is described by a published OpenAPI 3.1 contract covering 33 operations across synchronous rendering, reusable HTML templates, signed render URLs, durable asynchronous jobs, batches of up to 100, and webhook or S3-compatible delivery destinations. A remote MCP server at mcp.ironfang.com exposes the same core to AI assistants over OAuth 2.1 with a per-connection credit budget, and an llms.txt, a TypeScript and Python SDK, a CLI and an n8n node round out the surface. Plans are hard-capped rather than metered into overage, cache hits are free, and failed renders are refunded. Ironfang's own apis.json lists five more product APIs on the same account, portal and key format, each with its own published OpenAPI 3.1 contract under api.ironfang.com, for Audit (website evidence), Finance (e-invoice validation and generation, v1 and v2), Rig (disposable integration test environments), Analytics (session replay) and Security (external security checks).
i.name: Ironfang

i.description: IronPlanet is an online marketplace for buying and selling used heavy construction equipment and trucks across categories including construction, trucks, agriculture, mining, forestry, and oil and gas. The platform offers online auctions, buy-now listings, make-an-offer, sealed auctions, and on-site auctions, with detailed third-party inspection reports backed by its IronClad Assurance certification program. IronPlanet operates regional marketplaces for North America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia-Pacific and is part of the Ritchie Bros. (RB Global) family of businesses. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.
i.name: IronPlanet

i.description: IronPort Systems was an email and web security gateway company founded in 2000 in San Bruno, California, known for its anti-spam, anti-virus, anti-phishing, and URL-filtering appliances and its SenderBase email reputation service. Cisco Systems acquired IronPort in 2007 for approximately $830 million; the products were rebranded as Cisco Email Security and Cisco Web Security and the standalone IronPort brand and pricelist were fully retired by late 2012. IronPort no longer operates an independent public website, developer portal, or API surface — its domain now resolves into Cisco — so this profile is retained as a historical Menlo Ventures portfolio company rather than an active API provider awaiting enrichment.
i.name: Ironport

i.description: IRONSCALES is an AI-powered, API-based email security platform protecting organizations against phishing, business email compromise (BEC), account takeover (ATO), VIP impersonation, QR-code phishing, malicious URLs and attachments, and deepfake-assisted social engineering. Rather than sitting inline as a secure email gateway, IRONSCALES connects to Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace through their APIs and operates at the mailbox level — no MX record changes — combining adaptive AI detection, computer-vision analysis, automated multi-mailbox remediation, a crowdsourced threat-intelligence network, phishing simulation testing, and security awareness training in one platform. The public IRONSCALES Management API (appapi.ironscales.com) exposes incidents, mitigation statistics, escalated emails, mailbox management, deepfake SIEM events, phishing-simulation campaigns, SAT training campaigns, and tenant security settings, and is the surface behind the company's SIEM/SOAR/XDR integrations. IRONSCALES also operates an OAuth-protected remote MCP server for agent-based access.
i.name: IRONSCALES

i.description: ironSource is a Tel Aviv-based mobile game growth platform, acquired by Unity Technologies in a $4.4B all-stock deal that closed in November 2022 and is now operated as part of Unity's Grow Solutions group. The company builds an end-to-end suite for mobile game developers spanning ad monetization, user acquisition, and ad operations. Its flagship product LevelPlay is a unified in-app bidding and ad mediation platform that brokers Rewarded Video, Interstitial, and Banner ad demand across the ironSource Ads network, AdMob, AppLovin, Meta Audience Network, Pangle, Mintegral, Unity Ads, Vungle, and dozens of other ad sources. ironSource Ads is its self-serve ad network and user-acquisition platform offering CPI, CPE, ROAS-optimized, and SKAdNetwork-aware campaign management. Adjacent products include Aura (an on-device content marketplace for carriers and OEMs that originated from the 2021 Bigabid/Soomla portfolio and earlier hardware OEM deals), Tapjoy Offerwall (acquired 2022) for rewarded engagement, and Ad Quality for ad-content monitoring. Developer access is via a REST surface hosted at platform.ironsrc.com — including the Monetization Reporting API (v5/v4), ironSource Ads Reporting API, Application API (v6), Campaign API suite (Campaigns, Audiences, Country Groups, Bidding, Assets, Creatives), SKAN Reporting API, and Cost API — authenticated with Bearer tokens issued from the platform dashboard. Real client integration is delivered via native SDKs (iOS, Android, Unity, Flutter, React Native, Adobe AIR, Xamarin) plus the LevelPlay mediation adapter ecosystem published on github.com/ironsource-mobile. As of 2026 the developers.is.com knowledge center 301-redirects to docs.unity.com, consolidating ironSource documentation inside Unity Grow alongside Unity Ads. No public OpenAPI, Postman collection, or JSON Schema bundle is published by ironSource for the REST surface; documentation is human-readable HTML on docs.unity.com/en-us/grow.
i.name: ironSource

i.description: IronSpread is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: IronSpread

i.description: Irreducible is a cryptography company accelerating the zero-knowledge (ZK) revolution by turning advanced proof systems into cost-efficient, production infrastructure. The company invented and leads Binius, a state-of-the-art zero-knowledge SNARK built on towers of binary fields that natively handles bitwise operations to deliver order-of-magnitude speedups over prime-field systems on ordinary CPUs, GPUs, mobile devices, and custom FPGA hardware. Irreducible operates its own FPGA-based proof-generation service and publishes Binius as open-source Rust crates. Target applications include self-sovereign identity, on-chain privacy, content provenance for AI-generated media, and verifiable supercomputing. Irreducible was backed by a Series A co-led by Paradigm and Bain Capital Crypto. This profile was seeded as a Paradigm portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes an open-source developer surface (crates + docs) rather than a public REST API.
i.name: Irreducible

i.description: Irregular (formerly Pattern Labs) is a frontier AI security lab founded in 2023 by Dan Lahav and Eli David with the mission of protecting the world as AI systems become increasingly capable and sophisticated. The company runs security assessments and red-team evaluations against advanced frontier AI models, works to set security standards for the frontier AI industry, and is trusted by major AI labs to evaluate model risk. Irregular raised $80M co-led by Sequoia Capital and Redpoint Ventures at a $450M valuation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company; Irregular publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal at this time, so this record captures company identity and domain-security posture only.
i.name: Irregular

i.description: Irreverent Labs is a Bellevue, Washington startup founded in 2021 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Samsung Next, and Michael Ovitz. The company began by building MechaFightClub, a web3 gaming property, then pivoted to generative AI, developing video foundation models intended to let creators, game studios, and developers produce short-form video from natural-language prompts. Its current public product is Supermodel (supermodel.ai), an autonomous on-chain trading agent that watches top Hyperliquid wallets, scores their track records, and fuses crowd, technical, and prediction-market signals into trades. The company has publicly signaled intent to ship a developer API for its video generation models, but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK has been released as of this profile.
i.name: Irreverent Labs

i.description: The US Internal Revenue Service (IRS) provides REST APIs and Application-to-Application (A2A) interfaces for tax information access, identity verification, income verification, information return filing, and taxpayer account data. Authorized applications can integrate with IRS e-Services for TIN matching, the Transcript Delivery System (TDS), the Income Verification Express Service (IVES), the Information Return Intake System (IRIS) for 1099 series filings, and the Modernized e-File (MeF) system for electronic tax return submission. Access requires enrollment in IRS e-Services and obtaining an API client ID.
i.name: IRS

i.description: Irth Solutions is a SaaS platform provider for critical-infrastructure damage prevention, asset (pipeline) integrity, and stakeholder land management, trusted by energy, utility, and telecom operators across the U.S. and Canada since 1995. Its products include 811 ticket management (UtiliSphere, Exactix, and 811spotter for contractors), one-call center notification, intelligent forms and workflows, inline-inspection and corrosion/crack asset-integrity analytics, and lease, royalty, and right-of-way land management, powered by business intelligence, analytics, and geospatial data. Irth exposes a RESTful Integration API (Irthnet / UtiliSphere) secured with a per-integration API key for creating and modifying users, map layers, and work items in real time.
i.name: Irth Solutions

i.description: Iru (formerly Kandji) is a San Francisco based endpoint management and security company whose AI-powered platform unifies workforce identity and access, cross-platform endpoint management for macOS, iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, Windows and Android, endpoint detection and response, vulnerability management, compliance automation and a customer-facing trust center behind a single agent. The company rebranded from Kandji to Iru on 22 October 2025; the product surface, the developer documentation and the API hostnames still carry the kandji.io domain. The Iru Endpoint Management API is a tenant-scoped REST API published as OpenAPI 3.0.0 and as a public Postman collection, covering devices and device actions, Blueprints, Library Items, Prism inventory reporting, Automated Device Enrollment, tags, users, threats and vulnerabilities, and it also backs a hosted, tenant-scoped Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants.
i.name: Iru

i.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.
i.name: ISAAC Instruments

i.description: Isar Aerospace is a European space launch service provider founded in 2018 and headquartered in Ottobrunn near Munich, Germany. The company designs and manufactures Spectrum, a two-stage orbital small-lift launch vehicle capable of carrying up to 1,000 kg to low Earth orbit or up to 700 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit, using liquid oxygen and propane propulsion. Spectrum is fully developed and produced in-house with automated, scalable manufacturing including additive manufacturing and carbon-composite structures. Isar Aerospace offers dedicated, lead, and rideshare launch services for small and medium satellites and constellations. Backed by more than EUR 500 million in private capital from investors including Earlybird and HV Capital, the company employs over 400 people from nearly 50 nations and conducted the inaugural Spectrum test flight from Andoya Spaceport, Norway, on 30 March 2025.
i.name: Isar Aerospace

i.description: ISBNdb is the world's largest book database REST API providing access to metadata for over 110 million books and publications. Search by ISBN (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13), title, author, publisher, or subject to retrieve up to 19 data points per book including cover images, publication dates, descriptions, and real-time pricing. The API supports bulk lookups of up to 1,000 ISBNs per request on eligible plans.
i.name: ISBNdb

i.description: isBusinessEmail provides a free API to determine whether an email address or domain belongs to a business, detecting Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 usage. The service offers up to 100 free checks per day, stores no email data, and is EU‑hosted, making it suitable for privacy‑focused applications. Users can obtain an API key instantly without a credit card, and the platform includes tools, lists, and integrations for developers.
i.name: isBusinessEmail

i.description: Isembard is a UK- and US-based advanced manufacturing company building a distributed network of software-powered precision factories for critical industries including aerospace, defence, space, satellites, drones, nuclear energy, and motorsport. Founded in 2024 by Alexander Fitzgerald and named after engineer Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the company runs its factories on MasonOS, a proprietary AI-powered operating system that manages quoting, scheduling, production, and quality control across its factory network. Its model reshores high-precision component manufacturing closer to home to address supply-chain vulnerabilities in the Western industrial base, scaling from prototypes to production and offering factory franchise opportunities. Isembard has raised a Series A led by Union Square Ventures and operates factories across the UK, US, France, and Germany. There is no public developer API; MasonOS is an internal software platform, so this profile captures the company's identity and web surface rather than an API.
i.name: Isembard

i.description: Isengard Industries builds sovereign production capability for defense: the means for allied nations to manufacture precision-strike and counter-drone (counter-UAS) systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what traditional prime contractors charge. The company describes its approach as "Weapons of Mass Production." Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, it is led by Francisco Serra-Martins (previously co-founder/CEO of Terminal Autonomy) and James Tennant (former Australian Army officer), and is headquartered in San Francisco. As a hardware and defense-manufacturing company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security surface for the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Isengard Industries

i.description: Check if a number is even
i.name: isEven (humor)

i.description: ISHOB (Intelligent Service Hub for Autonomous Bots) offers a marketplace of 43 micro‑utility APIs (x402) that agents can call without API keys. Services span crypto risk, web extraction, screenshots, weather, company data, and more, with pay‑per‑call pricing in USDC on Base. The platform provides an MCP endpoint (api.ishob.com/mcp) and a public OpenAPI spec (api.ishob.com/openapi.json). It targets autonomous AI agents needing on‑chain, stateless tool access.
i.name: ISHOB

i.description: Isidor is a frontier enterprise-AI company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco with a London presence, building secure, vertically-integrated data pipelines that transform unstructured proprietary enterprise data into training- and evaluation-ready material for foundation models. Its platform spans five capabilities it describes as evaluation (industry-specific and agentic benchmarks), verifiers for generative-AI outputs in critical workflows, reasoning-trace data capture, foundation-model post-training (fine-tuning and alignment on proprietary data), and enterprise-grade security and privacy. Isidor raised an oversubscribed $3.6M pre-seed led by Gradient Ventures, futurepresent, and Seedcamp, with angels from Google DeepMind, Perplexity, and others. The company has no public API or developer surface yet; this profile tracks it as an enrichment lead in the API Evangelist network.
i.name: Isidor

i.description: iSIGHT Security is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: cybersecurity. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: iSIGHT Security

i.description: Check if websites and online services are currently down
i.name: isitdownstatus

i.description: Island is the developer of the Enterprise Browser, a Chromium-based browser purpose-built for the enterprise that embeds security, data protection, and governance directly into the last mile of work. The platform unifies an Enterprise Browser, Enterprise AI, and an Enterprise Network (SASE) so organizations can control how users interact with SaaS and internal applications, enforcing data-loss prevention, privileged access, insider-risk controls, and zero-trust policy at the browser layer, and replacing VDI/DaaS for many contractor and BYOD scenarios. Island is a private cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and other investors. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published; administration is via the management console at management.island.io.
i.name: Island

i.description: island.is (Stafrænt Ísland / Digital Iceland) is Iceland's national digital-services and government API platform, operated by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs / Digital Iceland. It provides a GraphQL gateway at api.island.is (authentication-gated) that fronts internal REST microservices, with business/government-to-government REST services described using OpenAPI 3.0 and registered in the X-Road "Straumurinn" API Catalogue. The developer handbook is published at docs.devland.is. Iceland's former CKAN open-data portal (opingogn.is) has been decommissioned and now redirects to island.is.
i.name: island.is (Digital Iceland)

i.description: ISN Software Corporation, which trades as ISN, is a Dallas, Texas based contractor and supplier information management company founded in 2001. Its subscription platform ISNetworld collects, verifies and continuously monitors health and safety, quality, insurance, training, cybersecurity and sustainability data on contractors and suppliers, then connects that record to the hiring clients who engage them across energy, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, utilities, construction, food and beverage, and telecom. ISN operates in more than 85 countries from offices in Dallas, Midland, Calgary, Montreal, Toronto, Mexico City, London, Perth, Sydney, Auckland, Dubai and Paris, and also ships ISN Empower, a worker-facing mobile app and learning management tool. The company is employee owned; Blackstone took a significant minority stake in December 2020 at a valuation above USD 2 billion. ISN runs a production REST API at api.isnetworld.com that lets subscribers pull their own ISNetworld data into internal systems, but the API is documented only to customers and there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or SDK.
i.name: ISN

i.description: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) develops and publishes international standards covering technology, manufacturing, food safety, and many other industries. ISO standards provide globally recognized frameworks that help organizations ensure quality, safety, interoperability, and consistency in their products and processes.
i.name: ISO

i.description: ISO 20022 is the international financial messaging standard published by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) that provides a common language and model for financial data. It defines business processes, data elements, and message definitions used by banks, payment systems, securities settlement systems, and other financial institutions worldwide for payment messages, securities messages, trade finance, and foreign exchange. SWIFT serves as the ISO 20022 Registration Authority, maintaining the message repository and e-Repository. As of 2025 ISO 20022 became the exclusive format for cross-border payments on the SWIFT network, with more than 60 central banks worldwide either completed or underway with migration.
i.name: ISO 20022

i.description: ISO New England Inc. is the independent, nonprofit regional transmission organization authorized by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to operate the high-voltage power system, administer the wholesale electricity markets, and plan the power system for Connecticut, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Vermont, New Hampshire, and most of Maine. Home market is the United States. It sits at the wholesale layer of the value chain, between generators, transmission owners, interconnections with New York and Canada, and the load-serving entities that resell power to retail customers - and it states on its own site that handling retail electricity is something it does not do. Its API posture is the sector's classic split, read from the wholesale end. Market and system data is genuinely open, so open that the ISO Express portal serves full nodal day-ahead LMP files as anonymous CSV and the public dashboards are backed by an anonymous JSON feed. Consumer data does not exist here at all, and cannot, because ISO New England holds no retail customer relationships and no Green Button, ESPI, or consumer data-portability mandate reaches it. The one documented programmatic contract, the Web Services API v1.1, is a real, richly documented RESTful surface of 477 path templates across 90 market and operations resources, but it answers 401 to anonymous callers - a developer must first create a free, self-serve ISO Express account, which the ISO says automatically grants access to the data feeds, and then authenticate with HTTP Basic over SSL.
i.name: ISO New England

i.description: isocket is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of uncork-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
i.name: isocket

i.description: Isometric is a London- and New York-based certifier of climate solutions building an AI-native, science-led registry and verification platform for the industrial economy. Founded in 2022 by Eamon Jubbawy (Onfido), Isometric certifies durable carbon dioxide removal (CDR), superpollutant abatement, and related environmental attributes against the public Isometric Standard, a library of peer-reviewed protocols spanning biochar, enhanced weathering, mineralization, direct air capture, marine CDR, biosphere pathways (such as reforestation, mangroves, agroforestry, and improved forest management), and superpollutant abatement (HFC/ODS recovery, landfill methane, rice methane). Buyers, suppliers, and integrators interact with Isometric through three primary platforms — Certify (project design, MRV data ingestion, LCA, GHG statements, validation), Registry (issuances, credit batches, deliveries, transfers, retirements, buffer pools), and Protocols (operationalized scientific methodology) — exposed via the Registry API and the Certify (MRV) Data Ingestion API. Both APIs are versioned at /v0, share a unified two-credential model (X-Client-Secret + Bearer JWT), run on sandbox and production hosts, and are accompanied by a hosted MCP server at api.isometric.com/mcp that exposes the Isometric Standard, protocols, modules, and platform documentation to AI clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code Copilot. Customers include Google, Microsoft, Shopify, Frontier-aligned buyers, and Anglo American, and the registry powers credit lifecycle operations for marketplaces, intermediaries, and carbon intelligence platforms.
i.name: Isometric

i.description: Isomorphic Labs is a London-based AI-first drug discovery company spun out of Google DeepMind in 2021 and operating as an Alphabet subsidiary. Founded and led by Sir Demis Hassabis, the company applies frontier AI — including derivatives of the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system and its proprietary Unified Drug Design Engine — to accelerate the design of small-molecule and biologic therapeutics across oncology, immunology, and other therapeutic areas. The Drug Design Engine is positioned as a target- and disease-agnostic, multi-modality platform that combines predictive and generative models with a curated proprietary life-science "Dataverse" and large-scale GPU infrastructure. Isomorphic Labs monetises through strategic pharmaceutical research collaborations — disclosed deals include Novartis (January 2024, expanded February 2025), Eli Lilly, and Johnson & Johnson (January 2026) — and through its own internal therapeutic pipeline. The company closed a $600M external Series B investment round in March 2025. Isomorphic Labs does not operate a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of its Drug Design Engine; external researcher access to AlphaFold-family models is provided separately by Google DeepMind via the free AlphaFold Server (alphafoldserver.com) for non-commercial use, and via the open-source AlphaFold 3 inference code released by DeepMind. The Isomorphic Labs GitHub organisation hosts only a small number of forks of internal Kubernetes and configuration-management tooling.
i.name: Isomorphic Labs

i.description: iSono Health is a Sunnyvale, California medical device company behind ATUSA, described as the first AI-driven portable and automated 3D breast ultrasound scanner. ATUSA performs fully automated whole-breast imaging in about two minutes per breast without a trained sonographer, pairing a 3D ultrasound scanner and wearable accessory with a Windows desktop/tablet application and HIPAA-compliant cloud storage for real-time 2D and 3D visualization, lesion localization, and remote monitoring. The system is FDA 510(k) cleared and targets more accessible point-of-care breast cancer screening and monitoring. iSono Health is a Y Combinator-backed company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published.
i.name: Isono Health

i.description: Isovalent is the company founded in 2017 by the creators of Cilium, the eBPF-based networking, security, and observability platform for Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure. Isovalent builds and maintains the open source Cilium project (a CNCF graduated project), the Hubble observability layer, and the Tetragon runtime security engine, and offers commercial Isovalent Enterprise for Cilium and Isovalent Enterprise for Tetragon distributions with hardened builds, support, and advanced features. Cilium replaces kube-proxy and traditional CNI plugins with identity-aware, eBPF-powered dataplane networking, network policy, service mesh, multi-cluster mesh, and deep flow-level observability. The developer surface spans the JSON REST API served by the cilium-agent, the cilium-health connectivity API, the gRPC Hubble Observer/Relay flow APIs, first-party Go client packages, and the cilium and hubble command-line tools. Isovalent was acquired by Cisco in 2024 and its technology now underpins Cisco's cloud-native security portfolio.
i.name: Isovalent

i.description: iSports API is a sports-data provider selling key-authenticated REST/HTTP feeds for football (soccer) and basketball to sportsbooks, media sites and app developers. The catalogue covers 2,000+ football leagues and cups and 800+ basketball leagues and cups across 113 documented GET endpoints: livescores and delta feeds, schedules and results, match events and shooting data, lineups, live text commentary, team, player and referee profiles, transfers, league and cup standings, player and match statistics, FIFA rankings, multi-language name packs, and pre-match, in-play, future and historical odds from 200+ bookmakers. It also ships iframe-embeddable live-animation and livescore widgets. Every response uses the same {code, message, data} envelope returned over HTTP 200, authenticated with an api_key query parameter, and is sold as per-product monthly, quarterly or yearly subscriptions with a 15-day free trial.
i.name: iSports API

i.description: iSpot.tv is a TV and video advertising measurement company that provides end-to-end measurement unifying creative assessment, audience measurement, and outcome attribution across linear TV and streaming. Its platform draws on data from tens of millions of smart TVs and set-top boxes to track ad occurrences, impressions, share of voice, creative effectiveness, and return on ad spend for advertisers, agencies, and networks. iSpot exposes its data programmatically through the iSpot REST API (v4), documented at a dedicated developer portal with quickstarts, an API reference, a Python sample, an interactive API demo tool, and release notes. iSpot.tv is backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio.
i.name: iSpot.tv

i.description: iSpring Learn is an eLearning platform and LMS that provides a REST API for managing courses, users, groups, departments, enrollments, learning paths, and accessing detailed learner progress reports. The API supports content management, assignment grading, 360-degree performance reviews, on-the-job training, and event-driven webhooks. API access requires a Business subscription.
i.name: iSpring Learn

i.description: Open Notify is a free, open-source project by Nathan Bergey that exposes real-time NASA and ISS data as simple REST endpoints. The service provides the current latitude and longitude of the International Space Station (updated every five seconds as the ISS travels at roughly 28,000 km/h), a count and roster of all humans currently in space across all spacecraft, and historical ISS pass-time predictions for any point on Earth. All endpoints are unauthenticated, return JSON, and are free to use without registration. The ISS pass-time prediction endpoint has been retired; the location and astronaut endpoints remain live and operational.
i.name: ISS Location API (Open Notify)

i.description: Issa Compass is a software platform that simplifies Thailand visa applications, operated by Issara Platforms Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) and Issa Systems Co, Ltd. (Bangkok). The platform helps users identify which Thai visa they qualify for and manages the end-to-end application process: a two-minute eligibility questionnaire, document verification and pre-qualification checks, real-time tracking of requirements against thousands of criteria, and a money-back guarantee if a pre-qualified application is rejected. Supported visa types include the Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), Long-Term Resident (LTR), Retirement, Spouse, and Student visas. Issa is a portfolio company of 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface at this time.
i.name: Issa

i.description: Istante is an Italian technology company (VAT IT03635230547, based in the Perugia area) that develops and operates Athena, a business-process-automation platform built around a team of specialized AI assistants. Athena covers assistants for communication routing and email classification, credit management and collections, a 24/7 voice/phone assistant, quote and order processing, automated tender monitoring and scoring, outbound lead engagement, contract and legal analysis, and HR and onboarding. It is positioned to collaborate with staff rather than replace them, keeping critical decisions under human oversight, and is offered on a fixed-cost "Digital Working Units" (DWU) pricing model rather than variable token pricing. The platform integrates across email, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is presented as GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. Istante was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.
i.name: Istante

i.description: Istio is an open-source service mesh platform that provides a comprehensive solution for managing, securing, and monitoring microservices in a distributed system. It acts as a middle layer between services, handling communication, routing, and load balancing, as well as providing visibility into the traffic flowing between services. Istio also offers advanced security features such as access control, authentication, and encryption to ensure that communication between services is secure.
i.name: Istio

i.description: iStock is Getty Images' royalty-free stock media brand for affordable, subscription-based image, video, illustration, and audio licensing. iStock shares Getty's underlying API platform; partner API access is gated and tied to a commercial licensing agreement.
i.name: iStock

i.description: Istra Research (Istra LLC) is a quantitative proprietary trading firm that develops data-centric algorithms and low-latency technology to participate in global financial markets. The firm employs researchers and engineers who build automated trading strategies grounded in advanced mathematics, statistics, and large-scale data analysis, spanning quantitative research, algorithm development, and custom hardware/VLSI and software engineering. Istra is a proprietary trading operation rather than an API-first technology vendor: it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or developer documentation, and its technology is used internally. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.
i.name: Istra Research

i.description: iStreamPlanet was a Las Vegas-based live video streaming company, founded in 2000, whose cloud-based Aventus live video workflow platform delivered live events and linear channels over the internet to multiple platforms and devices. Turner Broadcasting took a majority stake in 2015; the company later sat under WarnerMedia and then Warner Bros. Discovery, which shut it down in August 2023. Its open-source arm, iStreamPlanet Labs (github.com/istreamlabs), publishes Apache 2.0 projects including the rest-api-lint Spectral ruleset.
i.name: iStreamPlanet

i.description: IT Standards are technical standards developed by standards organizations to ensure interoperability, security, and quality in information technology systems and processes. These include standards from organizations such as ISO, IEEE, NIST, and W3C covering areas like networking, security, software development, and data management.
i.name: IT Standards

i.description: ITA Software is a travel technology company, now part of Google, that builds airfare pricing, shopping, and availability software for airlines, online travel agencies, and travel management companies. Founded in 1996 in Cambridge, Massachusetts by MIT computer scientists (notably Jeremy Wertheimer) and backed early by Battery Ventures, General Catalyst, and Sequoia Capital, the company was acquired by Google in 2011. Its flagship QPX engine powers pricing, revenue shopping, ticket rebooking, award-flight search, ancillary merchandising, and flight schedule/seat availability for carriers including Air Canada, American Airlines, Delta, United, and Virgin Atlantic, and its technology underpins Google Flights. ITA Software also operates the consumer ITA Matrix flight-search tool at matrix.itasoftware.com. The former public QPX Express REST API was retired by Google in April 2018; today ITA Software's QPX solutions are delivered as an enterprise engagement through Google account teams, with no public self-service developer program, portal, or SDKs.
i.name: ITA Software

i.description: iTAC Software AG is an independent company of the Duerr Group and a leading provider of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software for discrete manufacturing. Its iTAC.MOM.Suite delivers production control, end-to-end traceability, quality management, and AI-supported analytics that help automotive, electronics, and medical-technology manufacturers implement Industry 4.0 and smart-factory operations. iTAC does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; system integration is delivered through the MOM platform's IoT and connectivity layers as part of a project engagement.
i.name: iTAC Software

i.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.
i.name: Italic

i.description: Italist is a luxury fashion e-commerce marketplace that ships designer apparel, shoes, bags, and accessories from Italy directly to shoppers worldwide, offering boutique inventory at Italian retail prices with duties and taxes handled at checkout. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, italist.com now runs as a Shopify-hosted storefront that exposes a modern agent-native commerce surface: a published Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, provider-published agents.md / llms.txt agent instructions, and Shopify Customer Account API authentication over OpenID Connect. This profile was enriched by the pipeline from live probes of the storefront's public agent surface.
i.name: Italist

i.description: Itch is a UK direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand, backed by Seedcamp, offering a subscription service that delivers vet-approved flea, tick and worm treatments to pet owners on a recurring schedule, alongside pet health guidance and related care products. It was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be found; the consumer website sits behind bot protection, so this profile carries provider identity plus a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.
i.name: Itch

i.description: Itch.io is an indie game marketplace and community platform where developers can publish, sell, and distribute games, assets, and creative tools. Its REST API provides authenticated access to game metadata, developer profile information, bundle and download key management, purchase verification, community ratings, and game distribution data. The API supports OAuth 2.0 implicit flow and API key authentication to enable integrations with developer tools, game launchers, and third-party services.
i.name: Itch.io

i.description: Item is an AI-native customer relationship management (CRM) platform, part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch. It replaces the traditional CRM with an AI Assistant that handles daily work in plain language and customizable Agents that autonomously execute business processes across sales, support, and account management. Item connects to 100+ customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, discovers leads that match an ideal customer profile, and becomes a company's single source of truth for people, companies, and deals.
i.name: Item

i.description: Itemfield was an enterprise data-integration software company known for its Complex Data Exchange (CDE) and B2B data-transformation technology, which parsed, mapped, and transformed complex, unstructured, and industry-standard message formats into structured data. Itemfield was acquired by Informatica in 2006, and its technology was absorbed into Informatica's B2B Data Transformation product line. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment found no surviving independent Itemfield developer surface: the itemfield.com domain now resolves under Informatica-managed DNS and serves no HTTP content, so there is no live API, documentation, portal, or specification to harvest.
i.name: Itemfield

i.description: Iterable is an AI customer engagement platform that powers unified cross-channel marketing experiences and empowers marketers to create, optimize, and measure relevant interactions across email, push, SMS, in-app, and web channels. Their developer platform provides REST APIs, export APIs, AsyncAPI webhooks, and native SDKs for web, iOS, Android, and React Native.
i.name: Iterable

i.description: Iterative Health is a Boston-based clinical research and healthcare technology company operating a global network of community-based clinical research sites that connect trial sponsors with providers to accelerate enrollment and expand patient access to investigational therapies. Its therapeutic focus spans gastroenterology, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology, and its SKOUT AI tooling (rooted in the company's computer-vision work in GI endoscopy) helps sites and sponsors run research more efficiently. Backed by GV and Obvious Ventures and funded through a $77M Series C, the company partners with provider networks including GI Alliance, One GI, and US Heart & Vascular. As of this enrichment pass Iterative Health publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company identity and domain-security posture only.
i.name: Iterative Health

i.description: Iterum Therapeutics plc is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, focused on developing novel anti-infective medications to treat multi-drug resistant (MDR) bacterial infections. Its lead product, ORLYNVAH (sulopenem), is described as the first oral and IV penem antibiotic targeting gram-negative resistant infections. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Iterum Therapeutics is a pharmaceutical/biotech company and does not operate a public developer API; as of March 2026 the company entered liquidation following a High Court order in Ireland.
i.name: Iterum Therapeutics

i.description: Ithaca is a crypto-infrastructure company (backed by Paradigm) building open-source developer tooling to accelerate the crypto frontier. Its flagship product, Porto, is a TypeScript SDK for passwordless authentication and payments on the web — letting applications and wallets create, manage, and interact with next-generation Ethereum accounts (keychains with passkeys, permissions, subscriptions, and native cross-chain interoperability) without passwords, extensions, seed phrases, or API keys. The stack also includes the Account smart contracts (Solidity), the Relay cross-chain transaction router and RPC server (Rust) for EIP-7702 accounts, and Odyssey, an experimental open-source Layer 2 testnet. The Ithaca team has since joined Tempo (tempo.xyz), and the Porto product is sunsetting on 2026-07-24 with users moving to porto.sh.

i.description: Itron, Inc. (NASDAQ: ITRI) is a Liberty Lake, Washington–based industrial technology company providing smart-meter, grid-edge, and IoT infrastructure to electric, gas, and water utilities and cities. Itron's self-described mission is "Creating a more resourceful world" and the company reports 7,700+ customers in 100+ countries with 310M+ communicating endpoints delivered and 112M+ endpoints under management. The Itron developer surface is partner-gated rather than self-serve, centered on three platform families: (1) Distributed Intelligence (DI) — purpose-built apps that run at the grid edge on Itron smart meters; (2) Intelligent Connectivity (IC) — an IPv6/RF-mesh network platform (Itron Networks, formerly Cisco IoT FAN); and (3) the Starfish / Itron Networked Solutions Data Platform — a REST API + JavaScript SDK for device management and observation data, inherited from the Silver Spring Networks acquisition. A separate Data Warehouse OData API serves the Itron Analytics product, a Third-Party Gateway REST API bridges utility customer portals into DI enrollment, and legacy IEE web services (WCF/SOAP) and Consumer Energy Stream (CES) APIs document the Itron Enterprise Edition stack. Public OpenAPI/AsyncAPI artifacts are not published — access to specs, SDKs, and sandboxes is brokered through partner.itron.com after program acceptance. The developer.itron.com hostname now redirects to na.itron.com/developers/.
i.name: Itron

i.description: iTrustCapital (legal entity ITC2.0, Inc.) is a US fintech software platform for alternative assets, offering 24/7 self-directed access to dozens of cryptocurrencies and physical precious metals through three account types: tax-advantaged self-directed Crypto IRAs for retirement savings, Premium Custody Accounts (PCA) for everyday non-retirement investing, and Treasury Accounts for businesses, trusts, non-profits and other entities. The platform charges a 1% cryptocurrency transaction fee with no monthly, annual, startup, exit, storage or transfer fees, and runs a closed-loop system backed by third-party US banks, custodians (iTrust Custodial Services, Fortis Bank) and institutional storage providers. iTrustCapital is not an exchange, custodian, trust company, broker-dealer or investment adviser; all transactions on the platform are self-directed. As of this profiling pass the company publishes NO public developer API — its own help center states that it "does not offer any API integration to any third-party applications, including self-trading bots and coin trackers." Access is via the web app and the iOS/Android mobile apps only.
i.name: iTrustCapital

i.description: It's Good is a social dining recommendation app that reimagines how people discover restaurants and bars by surfacing recommendations from trusted friends rather than crowdsourced reviews from strangers. Founded in 2023 and co-founded by Mike Rosenthal (CEO) and musician John Legend, the iOS app lets people save the places they love, organize their lists, and share personalized recommendations within a curated community of people they know and admire. The company is backed by a seed investment from Lightspeed Venture Partners. It's Good is a consumer mobile product and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.
i.name: Its Good

i.description: ItsaCheckmate (Checkmate) is restaurant middleware that connects point-of-sale systems to delivery marketplaces and ordering channels, providing two-way integration, menu management, and consolidated reporting across 50+ POS systems and 100+ ordering platforms for tens of thousands of restaurant locations. Through its Marketplace for Developers, Checkmate offers a self-service open REST API that lets technology partners build a single integration to read and write menus, orders, and locations across many POS systems. The API uses OAuth-style token authentication with short-lived, scoped access and refresh tokens, ready-to-use Postman collections, and an llms.txt index for AI agents.
i.name: ItsaCheckmate

i.description: itslearning is a Norwegian learning management system (LMS) founded in 1999 and headquartered in Bergen, Norway, now part of the Sanoma Learning group. Its cloud platform serves primary, secondary, vocational, higher education, lifelong-learning and international schools across Europe and beyond, giving teachers lesson planning ("Plans"), assessment and quizzing, communication, an AI Toolkit, administration and reporting in one place. For integrators itslearning exposes an Organisation API (SOAP web services for courses, content, files and assessments), a Data Warehouse OData reporting API, IMS Enterprise Services and SFTP imports for user/course provisioning, and standards-based Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI 1.3 Core and LTI Advantage, with LTI 1.0/1.1 deprecated since June 2022) for third-party tool and content integration into the itslearning Library.
