Its products include shoppable video embedded on product and collection pages, user-generated content (UGC) activation from social media, video analytics with A/B testing, an AI Studio that generates video and images from product data, and interactive web stories. Deployment is a single embed snippet with native integrations for Shopify, PrestaShop, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce, and headless storefronts. The company is backed by Canaan Partners and Seedcamp.
j.name: Join

j.description: The Joint Fire Science Program (JFSP) funds scientific research on wildland fires and distributes results to help policymakers, fire managers and practitioners make sound decisions. Operated jointly by the U.S. Departments of the Interior and Agriculture, JFSP coordinates the Fire Science Exchange Network across regional knowledge nodes. JFSP does not publish a self-service developer portal or OpenAPI; research outputs are surfaced through the firescience.gov website.
j.name: Joint Fire Science Program

j.description: JokeAPI is a free, open source REST API that delivers consistently formatted jokes in JSON, XML, YAML, or plain text. It exposes seven joke categories (Any, Misc, Programming, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas), six blacklist content flags (nsfw, religious, political, racist, sexist, explicit), and filters for language, joke type, ID range, contains-text search, amount, and safe-mode. No sign-up is required and CORS is enabled. The service is rate-limited at 120 requests per minute per IP (5 per minute on submissions) and is maintained by Sv443 under the MIT license. The canonical source lives on Sv443's own Git server, with this GitHub repo kept open for issues and the community wrapper-library index.
j.name: JokeAPI

j.description: Joke of the day and large category of jokes accessible via REST API
j.name: Jokes One

j.description: Joko is a French fintech company operating a consumer cashback, rewards, and savings application that connects shoppers with more than 3,500 partner brands online and in physical stores. Users earn cashback and automatically apply promo codes through the Joko iOS and Android apps and browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), while also managing budgets, loyalty cards, gift cards, and split (3x installment) payments. Joko also runs a business solution offering brand partnerships and consumer market research. Backed by Partech, Joko is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.
j.name: Joko

j.description: JOKR is an instant grocery and convenience delivery company headquartered in Luxembourg (JOKR S.a.r.L) that operates an online supermarket delivering fresh products and local brands to consumers within minutes or on a scheduled window through its mobile app. The service offers more than 10,000 products with AI-powered personalized recommendations and competitive supermarket pricing, and reports roughly 3 million app downloads and 5 million users. In Brazil it operates under the DAKI brand (soudaki.com), the leading online supermarket in cities including Sao Paulo and Belo Horizonte. JOKR is a consumer-facing quick-commerce business with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Balderton Capital, GGV Capital, and HV Capital.
j.name: jokr

j.description: Jolly is an AI-powered workforce engagement platform that uses a points-based rewards system, gamification, and performance-based incentives to drive engagement, utilization, compliance, and recruitment for frontline and part-time workforces. Employees earn points by completing work-related missions (taking shifts, arriving on time, hitting productivity goals) and redeem them for real-world rewards from partners such as Walmart, Amazon, and Visa. Employers use an AI campaign builder, programmatic employee referrals, an internal social recognition platform, real-time analytics (flight-risk detection, employee NPS, engagement metrics via ERP/EMR integrations), and white-label branding. Jolly serves healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, staffing, farming, retail, warehousing, construction, and military employers. Based at Cornell Tech in New York City, the company raised a $16.5M Series A and is backed by Bullpen Capital along with executives from Tesla, Coinbase, Stripe, PayPal, and Discord. Jolly does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.
j.name: Jolly

j.description: jolt is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
j.name: jolt

j.description: JOLT is a Sydney-headquartered electric vehicle charging network operator that builds and runs free-to-start kerbside DC fast chargers across Australia, and has since extended the same model into New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States. Its charge points deliver the first 7kWh of each day's charging at no cost — around 45km of range in roughly 15 minutes over CCS2 or CHAdeMO — funded not by the driver but by the digital out-of-home advertising screens mounted on the charger itself, which makes JOLT simultaneously a charge point operator and a media network selling audience reach to advertisers. It sits in the energy value chain as a downstream infrastructure and demand-side player: it buys electricity (claiming 100% GreenPower green-certified wind and solar), owns and operates the charging assets on public and retail land in partnership with governments and hosts such as Transport for NSW, Ausgrid and major grocery retailers, and monetises the dwell time rather than the kilowatt-hour. Its API posture is honestly closed. JOLT publishes no developer programme, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no open data feed; the only public HTTP surfaces on its domains are a marketing WordPress install (whose custom jolt/v1 REST namespace exposes a single VAT form endpoint) and an api.joltcharge.com host that serves a static redirect to the mobile app rather than any API. It is not a designated data holder under the Australian Consumer Data Right for energy — it does not appear in the CDR Register's energy data holder brands — so the CDR energy mandate that compels Australian electricity retailers to expose standardised usage and tariff data does not reach it, and no OCPP, OCPI, ISO 15118 or Green Button/ESPI conformance is published. All customer charging data, session history and audience analytics are reachable only through the JOLT consumer app or a sales conversation.
j.name: JOLT

j.description: Joltsynsor is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
j.name: Joltsynsor

j.description: JOLYN is an athletic swimwear and apparel brand for competitive and team swimming, water polo, and aquatics, known for durable, functional practice and racing suits, team uniforms, and active lifestyle apparel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, JOLYN publishes no first-party developer API — its direct-to-consumer storefront at jolyn.com (jolynclothing.com redirects here) is Shopify-hosted. That platform exposes a genuine agent-native commerce surface: a published /llms.txt with agent instructions, OpenID Connect discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for buyer-approved, agent-driven shopping and checkout.
j.name: JOLYN

j.description: Jome is a real estate technology marketplace for buying new construction homes, describing itself as the most joyful way to buy a new home in the age of AI. Buyers can search and compare thousands of new-construction homes and communities from multiple builders, view pricing and builder incentives, instantly book and confirm home tours, and receive AI-powered personalized recommendations, with new-home experts guiding them from contract to closing. Jome operates as a licensed real estate brokerage across 18+ U.S. metros, primarily in Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Arizona, Georgia, Colorado, South Carolina, and Tennessee, and runs dedicated portals for builders and agents. Backed by Techstars. Jome publishes no public API or developer program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence.
j.name: Jome

j.description: Jones is a full-service SaaS platform purpose-built for insurance compliance in construction and commercial real estate, unifying Certificate of Insurance (COI) collection, deep insurance auditing, workflow automation, and a licensed brokerage in one platform. It pairs hundreds of insurance specialists with AI agents to review COIs and policies at enterprise scale, and is used by general contractors, construction managers, owner-operators, REITs, property management teams, and insurance brokers to manage compliance across large portfolios of subcontractors, vendors, and tenants. Jones offers two engagement models: Jones Software (self-managed) and Jones Operator (an AI-driven concierge that runs day-to-day insurance tasks). Reported scale: 40,000+ projects, 3 billion+ square feet, and 50 million+ insurance documents processed for 300+ industry leaders. Headquartered in New York, NY, Jones was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Foundry Group.
j.name: Jones

j.description: The Jones Financial Companies is the parent company of Edward Jones, a financial services firm that serves individual investors through a network of branch offices. The firm does not currently publish a public developer program or APIs.
j.name: Jones Financial Companies

j.description: Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated (JLL) is a global commercial real estate services company offering investment management, property management, and facility services. Through JLL Technologies (JLLT), the company delivers technology solutions including the Corrigo Enterprise platform for facility management with a REST API enabling integration with work order management, asset tracking, procurement, billing, and vendor management systems.
j.name: Jones Lang LaSalle

j.description: Job search engine
j.name: Jooble

j.description: Joomla is a free and open-source content management system (CMS) built in PHP that includes a built-in REST API for managing core content types. The Web Services API provides JSON endpoints for articles, categories, contacts, banners, menus, modules, tags, fields, and user accounts. Authentication is handled via Bearer tokens with optional HMAC security, and every endpoint requires authentication unless explicitly marked public. Joomla is maintained entirely by volunteers and released under the GNU General Public License.
j.name: Joomla

j.description: joonko is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of the 2026-07-20 enrichment pass its public web presence is offline: the joonko.co apex resolves no A record (AWS nameservers, domain registered through 2027) and the app.joonko.co CloudFront distribution is dead, while joonko.com is parked and listed for sale on Afternic. Email infrastructure (Google Workspace MX, SPF, DMARC p=none) remains active, but there is no reachable website, developer portal, documentation, or API surface to enroll. No API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer artifacts could be discovered. The profile remains a dormant lead.
j.name: joonko

j.description: Joopiter (stylized JOOPITER) is a digital-first auction house and marketplace founded by Pharrell Williams for rare objects and culturally significant collectibles. The platform hosts timed online auctions, a curated marketplace, and private sales spanning watches, sneakers, streetwear, art, jewelry, and memorabilia, pairing commerce with editorial storytelling about each object and its provenance. Joopiter offers consignment and "sell with Joopiter" services connecting collectors and creators globally. It is a consumer-facing luxury commerce brand; as of this writing it publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation surface, so this API Evangelist profile is an identity record rather than a technical/API catalog entry.
j.name: Joopiter

j.description: JOOR is a New York-based SaaS company (founded 2010) operating a leading B2B wholesale fashion commerce platform and digital marketplace that connects fashion brands with retailers to run their wholesale business end to end. The platform digitizes wholesale buying with online linesheets, lookbooks, virtual showrooms, order management, and the JOOR Marketplace, alongside products such as JOOR Pay (wholesale payments), JOOR Passport (virtual trade shows), and Retail data/analytics. JOOR connects thousands of brands with hundreds of thousands of retail doors globally. Its production platform is fronted by a Kong API gateway and secured with Keycloak-based OpenID Connect authentication; API access is partner/integration-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was enriched from JOOR's live public surface (OIDC discovery, GitHub organization, and status page).
j.name: Joor

j.description: Jopwell was a career advancement and diversity-recruiting platform that connected Black, Latinx, and Native American students and professionals with employers for jobs, internships, and career resources. Founded in 2015 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and other investors, it was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of an enrichment probe on 2026-07-19, the jopwell.com domain returns an HTTP 301 redirect to trueplatform.com (True, an executive search and talent-management firm), indicating the standalone Jopwell product is no longer operating. No public developer program, API, OpenAPI specification, documentation, or /.well-known/security.txt surface was found, so no API artifacts could be produced.
j.name: Jopwell

j.description: Josh Wood Colour is a UK-based at-home hair colour brand founded by celebrity colourist Josh Wood, selling permanent and semi-permanent hair dye, root touch-up, gloss, toners, blonde and grey-blending products, and haircare direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at joshwoodcolour.com. The brand pairs its retail catalogue with a free personalised colour-matching consultation service and editorial hair-care advice. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail e-commerce brand it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and customer-facing properties.
j.name: Josh Wood Colour

j.description: People groups of the world with the fewest followers of Christ
j.name: Joshua Project

j.description: Josys is a SaaS and IT asset management platform providing automated provisioning, license optimization, and device management. Josys publishes a developer API for programmatic access to the platform.
j.name: Josys

j.description: Jotform is an online form builder with strong workflow, payments and data collection capabilities. The Jotform API exposes forms, submissions, reports, folders, users, files and webhooks across three regional/compliance endpoints (US standard, EU, HIPAA). API-key authentication via header or query string.
j.name: Jotform

j.description: Journera is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
j.name: Journera

j.description: Journey Clinical is a telehealth platform for ketamine-assisted psychotherapy (KAP). It pairs licensed medical prescribers who manage patient eligibility, prescribing, and clinical monitoring with a member network of independent licensed psychotherapists who deliver the preparation, dosing, and integration therapy sessions. Alongside KAP the company offers standalone medication management and Spravato (esketamine) treatment, operates across 25+ US states, and accepts major insurance plans as well as HSA/FSA payment. Journey Clinical is a HIPAA-covered telehealth provider (publishing a Notice of Privacy Practices) and, as surfaced through the API Evangelist network, does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. This profile captures its public identity, compliance posture, and domain security as a company record.
j.name: Journey Clinical

j.description: Journey (Journey Meditation) is a workplace mental health platform that delivers preventive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services to enterprise organizations. Rather than the reactive model of traditional EAPs, Journey uses AI-powered risk detection (Journey Signal) to identify emerging mental health issues before they escalate and connects employees to clinicians across 190+ countries in 100+ languages. Its offerings include Journey Proactive EAP, the Journey LIVE guided-meditation and wellbeing experience, and a Mental Health Certification training program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer or API surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company lead and refreshed by the enrichment pipeline.
j.name: Journey Medidtation

j.description: Jow is a consumer meal-planning and grocery-shopping application that turns personalized menu selection into an automated shopping list. From a catalog of thousands of recipes tailored to household size, dietary preferences and goals (keto, vegetarian, high-protein, gluten-free, kid-friendly, low-calorie), Jow builds a weekly menu and generates the matching grocery order, which users check out through integrated grocery-retail partnerships at optimized prices. Founded in France and available as iOS and Android mobile apps, Jow serves millions of active users. It is a portfolio company of Northzone. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.
j.name: Jow

j.description: Joy (withjoy.com) is a consumer wedding and event planning platform that gives couples a free personalized wedding website, an all-in-one universal registry, guest list management, digital and printed save-the-dates and invitations, smart RSVP tools, hotel room blocks, and a companion mobile app. The company has since expanded into baby planning with Joy Baby. Joy is a business-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification; this profile therefore carries identity and link-property metadata and live security probes rather than machine-readable API artifacts.
j.name: Joy

j.description: Joy is a French SaaS platform for bars, restaurants and venues that turns group and event enquiries into confirmed bookings. Founded in 2014 as Privateaser, the company now runs a two-sided business: privateaser.com, the group-venue marketplace that captures demand, and Joy, the manager-facing application (web plus iOS/Android) where an establishment centralises requests from Google, Instagram, its own website, WhatsApp and Privateaser, then works them through a unified calendar and messaging inbox, an SEO/GEO-optimised event showcase page, a virtual phone assistant, quotes, French-compliant invoicing, and Stripe-backed deposits and prepayments. Joy reports more than 3,000 partner establishments and over EUR100M in bookings managed in 2025. It publishes no public API, SDK, webhook catalogue or developer portal; the only integration surfaces it documents for customers are an embeddable iframe booking form, Reserve-with-Google, and a one-click reservation copy into Zenchef.
j.name: Joy (ex-Privateaser)

j.description: Joy Global was a worldwide leader in manufacturing, servicing, and distributing equipment for surface mining, underground mining, and rock excavation before being acquired by Komatsu and rebranded as Komatsu Mining. There is no public developer program or APIs published for Joy Global / Komatsu Mining at this time.
j.name: Joy Global (Komatsu Mining)

j.description: Joya Communications Inc. is the consumer software company behind Marco Polo, a video chat application for asynchronous, personal video messaging with the people who matter most. Marco Polo positions itself as a privacy-first alternative to social media, with no ads, no public feeds, and no social engagement metrics, and offers a Marco Polo Plus subscription with premium features. Joya Communications is venture-backed (Battery Ventures) and, as a consumer mobile app company, does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation surface.
j.name: Joya Communications

j.description: Joyful Health provides AI-assisted revenue recovery for healthcare organizations, combining automated claim investigation with expert billing teams to recover unpaid and denied insurance claims. Its platform runs inside an organization's existing revenue-cycle-management (RCM) systems rather than replacing them, covering denial investigation and root-cause analysis, claims recovery and appeals management, historical accounts-receivable (A/R) assessment, payer follow-up, documentation review, and financial insight to prevent future denials. The company operates a customer application at app.joyfulhealth.io and maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center. Joyful is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; Joyful does not currently publish a public API or developer program.
j.name: Joyful

j.description: Joyride was a mobile audio service that made driving more fun and more interesting, offering an in-car audio/entertainment experience for drivers and passengers. Founded by Jeff Chen (co-founder & CEO) and James Zhang (co-founder & CTO), the company raised a seed round from Cowboy Ventures and was subsequently acquired by Google, marking a successful exit. As a consumer mobile application it exposed no public developer API surface, and the product is no longer independently operated following the acquisition. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph completeness rather than as an active API provider.
j.name: Joyride

j.description: JoySpace Technologies, Inc. (Joyspace) operates an enterprise AI video transformation platform that turns long-form video into viral short clips, captions in 99+ languages, and repurposed content at scale for B2B marketing, sales, podcast, agency, and executive-branding teams. It combines AI clip generation, agentic video-processing workflows, and multimodal semantic search across large video archives, processing 10,000+ videos monthly on enterprise-grade infrastructure. Joyspace exposes a REST API (POST /api/v1/videos/process) secured with Bearer API keys, signed webhooks with automatic retry, and cloud-storage connectors for AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, Cloudflare R2, and Dropbox Business. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company.
j.name: JoySpace Technologies

j.description: Jakarta Persistence (formerly Java Persistence API / JPA) defines a Java specification and binding layer for the management of persistence and object-relational mapping in Java environments. It provides a standardized ORM framework that enables developers to map Java objects to database tables and interact with relational data using Java rather than SQL. Jakarta Persistence 3.2 is the current stable release with Jakarta EE 11, while version 4.0 is under development for Jakarta EE 12.
j.name: JPA

j.description: JPMorgan Chase is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States, with operations across investment banking, financial services, asset management, and private equity. Its J.P. Morgan Payments Developer Portal publishes 26 API definitions covering 194 operations across payments, treasury, onboarding, tokenization, disputes, reporting and blockchain deposit accounts, with OAuth 2.0, mTLS and digital-signature authentication and a Mock environment for client testing.
j.name: JPMorgan Chase

j.description: JPX (Japan Exchange Group) operates the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Osaka Exchange, and Tokyo Commodity Exchange, and sells Japanese market data through its JPX Market Innovation & Research arm. Its developer-facing product is the J-Quants API - a self-serve, subscription REST API (Free/Light/Standard/Premium plans, x-api-key auth, base https://api.jquants.com/v2) delivering historical equities OHLCV/minute/tick bars, indices, derivatives, financial statements, short-selling and margin data, EDINET filings, and TDnet disclosures, plus bulk CSV download, an MCP server, and a CLI - licensed to individual investors only. Institutional real-time data (FLEX Standard and FLEX MBO order-book feeds) and corporate historical data (J-Quants Pro via API/SFTP/Snowflake, J-Quants DataCube) are sales-gated services.
j.name: JPX (Japan Exchange Group)

j.description: jQuery is a fast, small, and feature-rich JavaScript library that makes HTML document traversal and manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax much simpler with an easy-to-use API that works across a multitude of browsers. Only about 30kB minified and gzipped, available as an AMD module, and CSS3 compliant. jQuery 4.0 is the current release; jQuery 3.x receives critical updates only.
j.name: jQuery

j.description: Package info and download stats on jsDelivr CDN
j.name: jsDelivr

j.description: jService is an open source Ruby on Rails trivia API that serves approximately 200,000 Jeopardy! questions, answers, and categories scraped from the J! Archive fan site. The original public deployment at jservice.io is no longer operational, but the project (sottenad/jService, MIT licensed) remains available for self-hosting against PostgreSQL. The API exposes random clues, final Jeopardy clues, filtered clue queries, category listings, single-category lookup, and invalid-clue reporting under /api/*.
j.name: jService

j.description: Jakarta Faces (formerly JavaServer Faces / JSF) is an MVC framework for building component-based user interfaces for Java web applications. It simplifies the development of web UIs through a component-driven approach with managed beans, an event-driven programming model, page navigation, state management, input validation, and built-in support for internationalization and accessibility. Jakarta Faces 4.1 is the current stable release with Jakarta EE 11, with 5.0 in development for Jakarta EE 12.
j.name: JSF

j.description: Jiangsu Gaiya Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. (江苏盖亚环境工程有限公司) is a Suzhou-based environmental engineering and technology company, described on its site as the region's first firm specializing in contaminated-soil remediation, with offices at the Nanjing University Suzhou High-Tech Research Institute. Its business covers environmental engineering design and construction, environmental testing and risk assessment, R&D and sale of environmental-protection equipment, product distribution, and environmental technology consulting. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network. Enrichment probes found a static Chinese-language marketing website (IIS, GB2312) and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface.
j.name: jsgaiya

j.description: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight, text-based, language-independent data interchange format that uses human-readable text to represent structured data as key-value pairs and arrays. JSON is standardized by RFC 8259 (December 2017), which obsoletes RFC 7159 (2014) and RFC 4627 (2006). It has become the de facto standard for data exchange in web APIs, configuration files, and NoSQL databases due to its simplicity and broad language support.
j.name: JSON

j.description: Convert JSON to JSONP (on-the-fly) for easy cross-domain data requests using client-side JavaScript
j.name: JSON 2 JSONP

j.description: Jakarta JSON Binding (JSON-B) defines a standard binding layer for converting Java objects to and from JSON documents. It specifies a default mapping algorithm for serializing and deserializing existing Java classes to and from JSON, while enabling developers to customize the mapping process through a Java API. JSON-B 3.0 is the stable release shipped with Jakarta EE 10, with version 3.1 under development for Jakarta EE 12.
j.name: JSON Binding

j.description: JSON Processing (JSON-P) is a Java API for parsing, generating, transforming, and querying JSON messages. Standardized as Jakarta JSON Processing, it provides both an object model API and a streaming API for working with JSON data in Java applications. The current stable release is Jakarta JSON Processing 2.1 (Jakarta EE 10), with version 2.2 under development for Jakarta EE 12.
j.name: JSON Processing

j.description: JSON Schema is a vocabulary for annotating and validating JSON documents, widely used for defining API request and response shapes across REST APIs. The current stable specification is Draft 2020-12. JSON Schema differentiates between the instance being validated and the schema document containing the validation rules, and supports URI-based references for recursive and cross-document definitions.
j.name: JSON Schema

j.description: Create and edit videos programmatically: watermarks,resizing,slideshows,voice-over,text animations
j.name: JSON2Video

j.description: Free JSON storage service. Ideal for small scale Web apps, Websites and Mobile apps
j.name: JSONbin.io

j.description: JSONPlaceholder is a free, no-auth fake REST API for prototyping, tutorials, and testing. It exposes six relational resources — posts, comments, albums, photos, todos, and users — over six standard REST routes per resource. All write operations (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) are accepted and respond as if successful, but no changes are persisted. The service is built on the open-source json-server engine (also by typicode) and serves billions of requests per month with no rate limits or authentication.
j.name: JSONPlaceholder

j.description: JSR-303 (Bean Validation) is a Java specification that defines a metadata model and API for JavaBean validation. It provides a standard way to define validation constraints on Java objects using annotations, enabling developers to enforce business rules and data integrity at the object level. Now standardized as Jakarta Validation, with version 3.1 released for Jakarta EE 11 and version 4.0 under development for Jakarta EE 12.
j.name: JSR-303

j.description: JSW One Platforms is the digital B2B arm of India's JSW Group, operating a full-stack e-commerce and services platform for the country's manufacturing and construction MSMEs. It runs four connected businesses on one technology stack: JSW One Commerce (jswonemsme.com), a multi-brand marketplace for TMT bars, mild/hot-rolled/cold-rolled and structural steel, coated steel, wire rods, cement and bitumen sourced from certified mills; JSW One Homes (jswonehomes.com), a turnkey home-construction service with digital project tracking across fifteen Indian cities; JSW One Finance, the NBFC arm providing digital credit lines, channel financing and invoice factoring to MSMEs and retailers; and private brands JSW One TMT and One Helix. The platform reported FY25 gross merchandise value of INR 12,567 crore across more than 84,000 registered MSMEs, and raised INR 575 crore in a 2025 round led by the State Bank of India. JSW One publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its customer-facing surfaces are the web marketplace and the JSW One MSME mobile apps. It does publish a maintained llms.txt on both of its consumer properties, plus an explicit AI/LLM bot-access policy on JSW One Homes.
j.name: JSW One

j.description: Jubilee Inc (Jubilee Media) is a Los Angeles-based digital media production company that creates discussion-based and dating video shows designed to provoke thoughtful conversation and foster human connection across social and ideological divides. Its flagship YouTube programs include Middle Ground, Odd One Out, and Ranking, alongside sister dating channels such as Love Comma Nectar (Versus 1) and the reaction and behind-the-scenes brand TwoBilee. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API or developer platform at this time, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal only.
j.name: Jubilee

j.description: JubileeTV (by Caavo) is a US consumer remote-caregiving system that turns an aging loved one's existing television into a family connection and monitoring hub. A caregiver uses their phone to control the senior's TV remotely, host multi-way video calls on the big screen, run one-way wellness check-ins, send photos and reminders, and get alerts when TV routines or room activity look off. Hardware plus a subscription membership; no learning curve for the senior. The company publishes no bespoke developer API, but its getjubileetv.com storefront exposes a real agentic-commerce surface on Shopify: an OIDC/OAuth Customer Accounts authorization server, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a shopping MCP endpoint, and published /llms.txt and /agents.md agent instructions.
j.name: Jubilee TV

j.description: Judge.me is a product reviews platform for Shopify and other e-commerce storefronts, collecting photo and video reviews, star ratings, site reviews, and Q&A. The Judge.me REST API at https://judge.me/api/v1 lets developers list and import reviews, fetch ready-to-render widget HTML, resolve products, send review requests, and build OAuth apps authenticated with a shop_domain plus public or private api_token.
j.name: Judge.me

j.description: Online code execution system
j.name: Judge0 CE

j.description: Judgment Labs builds the continuous-improvement stack for AI agents: tooling to trace, evaluate, monitor, and improve agent behavior in production. Its open-source Judgeval SDK (Python and TypeScript, with Go and Java clients) instruments agent frameworks and model providers to capture traces, spans, and tool calls; Agent Judges and Code Judges score behavior against natural-language rubrics and deterministic checks; and Agent Behavior Monitoring plus automations and alerts surface regressions and failure modes. The platform is accessed through the Judgeval SDKs, the judgment CLI, and a hosted MCP server, and integrates with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit, Pipecat, and OpenTelemetry / OpenInference tracing pipelines. The company is backed by Lightspeed with a $32M round.
j.name: Judgment Labs

j.description: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx) is a healthcare technology company delivering unified pharmacy and medical benefit administration. Its platform, Judi, is a modern claims and benefits processing system (a Core Administrative Processing System / CAPS) that self-funded employers, unions, health plans, third-party administrators (TPAs), brokers, and health systems use to run transparent, pass-through pharmacy benefit management (Judi Rx), integrated health benefit administration (Judi Care), care navigation, level-funded pharmacy benefits, a Medicare prescription payment plan, and white-label discount cards. Judi Cloud licenses the underlying platform to other administrators. In 2026 the company rebranded from Capital Rx to Judi Health following a $400M funding round to accelerate its AI-powered health benefits platform, and its PBM business surpassed five million contracted lives. Judi Health does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference; this profile captures the company identity, web properties, and security/trust posture.
j.name: Judi Health

j.description: Judo Bank (Judo Capital Holdings Ltd) is an Australian challenger bank founded in 2016 and headquartered in Melbourne, purpose-built to serve small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with relationship-led business lending alongside personal and business term deposits. It was the first new domestically-owned bank in decades to be granted a full, unrestricted authorised deposit-taking institution (ADI) licence by APRA, in April 2019, and has been publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ticker ASX JDO) since November 2021 - it is a for-profit, shareholder-owned bank, not a customer-owned mutual. As a designated ADI and data holder under Australia's Consumer Data Right (CDR / Open Banking) regime, Judo Bank exposes a public, unauthenticated Product Reference Data (PRD) API conforming to the Data Standards Body (DSB) Consumer Data Standards, while authenticated consumer-data sharing is governed by the accredited data recipient (ADR) model rather than an open self-serve developer program.
j.name: Judo Bank

j.description: Job search engine
j.name: Juju

j.description: Juke is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of multicoin-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto-web3. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
j.name: Juke

j.description: Julaya is a West African B2B fintech, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, that digitizes corporate financial operations across the UEMOA zone (Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Benin and Togo). Its pro account lets businesses send mobile money and bank transfers, collect cash and mobile-money deposits, pay suppliers and run payroll, and receive UEMOA-wide transfers via a Julaya IBAN, with multi-company sub-wallets, approval and signature workflows, real-time transaction tracking and accounting exports. Julaya is licensed as a payment establishment in Cote d'Ivoire and connects businesses to mobile-money rails including Orange Money, Wave, MTN MoMo, Moov and Wizall. A partner integration API (api.julaya.co) exposes disbursement and collection programmatically for enterprise customers.
j.name: Julaya

j.description: Juleb is a Saudi Arabia-based pharma-tech and retail software company providing an integrated cloud platform for the health, retail, and distribution sectors. Its suite spans accounting and financial management, inventory and warehouse management, sales force automation (SFA), point of sale (POS), Rx e-prescription, e-commerce, and DSCSA regulatory compliance. Juleb connects to Saudi compliance systems (ZATCA/Fatoora, RSD, GS1, Wasfaty), e-commerce channels (Salla, Shopify, HungerStation), payment providers (Geidea, Alhamrani), and ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics). Founded by Yousuf Jamjoom and backed by 500 Global, Juleb exposes a REST API (documented at docs.juleb.com) covering inventory, point of sale, prescriptions, and partner/company resources.
j.name: Juleb

j.description: Julep is an open-source platform for building stateful AI agents that remember past interactions and execute long-running, multi-step tasks. Its cloud API and self-hostable server expose agents, sessions, tasks, executions, documents (RAG), tools, users, projects, secrets, and files, along with a task-workflow engine that supports decisions, loops, parallel branches, and integrations to external tools and APIs. Official Python and TypeScript SDKs and a command-line interface wrap the REST API; authentication is via API key. Julep is Apache-2.0 licensed and backed by Version One Ventures.
j.name: Julep

j.description: Julep is a direct-to-consumer beauty brand selling makeup, skincare, nail polish, and value sets, founded in Seattle by Jane Park and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Maveron, and others before its 2016 acquisition. The brand positions itself around effortless, low-effort beauty for women who "do a lot but don't want to spend a lot of time doing their makeup," with skincare inspired by its founder's Korean heritage. Julep runs its storefront on Shopify at www.julep.com and also sells through Amazon and Target. It is not an API platform and publishes no developer program, but the storefront carries a substantive agent-facing surface: published agent instructions at /agents.md and /llms.txt, a Universal Commerce Protocol merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a live MCP commerce endpoint, OpenID Connect discovery for customer accounts, and a public read-only catalog JSON API.
j.name: Julep Beauty

j.description: Jules is Google's autonomous, asynchronous AI coding agent, developed inside Google Labs and powered by the Gemini family of models (currently Gemini 2.5 Pro on the free tier and Gemini 3 Pro on paid tiers). Jules connects to a user's GitHub repositories, clones the target repo into a sandboxed Google Cloud VM, generates a multi-step plan, and then executes coding tasks such as bug fixes, refactors, dependency bumps, test authoring, and small feature builds, ultimately opening a pull request for human review. Jules ships three surfaces beyond the web app at jules.google.com: a documented REST API in alpha at jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha (Sources, Sessions, Activities) authenticated via X-Goog-Api-Key, a lightweight CLI called Jules Tools installable via npm, and a Gemini CLI extension that exposes Jules as a /jules slash command. Access is gated to Google account holders and the API is experimental. Jules is sold as part of the Google AI subscription bundles, with a free introductory plan (15 tasks/day, 3 concurrent), Google AI Pro at $19.99/month (100 tasks/day, 15 concurrent, Gemini 3 Pro), and Google AI Ultra at $124.99/month (300 tasks/day, 60 concurrent, priority Gemini 3 Pro access).
j.name: Jules

j.description: JULES.md is a configuration file format for the Google Jules AI coding agent, providing project-specific instructions, architecture context, and coding standards to guide AI-assisted development workflows. Similar in spirit to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and other agent-context files, JULES.md scopes Jules behavior to a repository.
j.name: JULES.md

j.description: Juli is a US-based (Hull, Massachusetts) digital-health company building an AI-powered mobile platform that helps people manage complex, hard-to-treat chronic conditions — including asthma, migraine, depression, and bipolar disorder. The app combines patient-reported symptoms, wearable and phone sensor data, and environmental context (weather, air quality, pollen) to surface the micro-behavioral triggers that worsen or improve a person's condition, then nudges small, sustainable changes through daily check-ins, reminders, and gamified "daily dares." Juli's efficacy has been evaluated in two randomized controlled trials (asthma and depression), published in JMIR and a SAGE journal, and the company reports retention far above consumer-health norms. Founded by Bettina Duehrkoop, Juli raised a $3.8M seed round in March 2022 co-led by Speedinvest and Norrsken VC. It serves consumers directly plus provider, employer, education (juli.education), pharma, and research (juli.science) channels. Juli is a consumer/clinical app with a HIPAA / SOC 2 / GDPR compliance posture; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.
j.name: Juli

j.description: JuliaHub, Inc. (founded in 2015 as Julia Computing by the creators of the Julia programming language) develops the open-source Julia language and operates JuliaHub, a cloud platform for scientific and technical computing. JuliaHub provides hosted Julia compute, package hosting and the Julia package registry, notebooks, and large-scale batch/job execution. Its product portfolio includes JuliaHub (cloud compute), Dyad (equation-based modeling and simulation), Pumas (pharmaceutical modeling and simulation), and the Julia language itself, serving aerospace, pharma, industrials, government, and utilities. Programmatic access is provided through the first-party JuliaHub.jl Julia client and OpenID Connect (Dex) authentication.
j.name: Julia Computing

j.description: JuliaHub is the company behind the Julia programming language, offering a cloud platform for large-scale, reproducible Julia computing — batch jobs, dataset management, application hosting, and a private package server — alongside modeling and simulation products (Dyad / JuliaSim) and pharmaceutical modeling (Pumas). The JuliaHub platform is accessed programmatically via the official JuliaHub.jl Julia client and the `jh` command-line interface, authenticated with OpenID Connect / OAuth2 (device flow) through a Dex identity provider.
j.name: Juliahub

j.description: JULIENNE BRUNO is a London-based food company that creates, develops and produces naturally plant-based fresh cheeses. Its Collection 01 comprises Burrella, Superstraccia and Crematta - dairy-free, fermented products positioned as original foods in their own category rather than vegan imitations. Products are sold direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and stocked at Ocado, Whole Foods, Planet Organic, Harrods and Selfridges, and featured on the menus of 800+ restaurants, pubs and cafes. Founded in 2020 and backed by Seedcamp, the brand and assets were later acquired by Harvey & Brockless (The Compleat Food Group). This is a consumer packaged goods company; it publishes no developer API - the profile is enriched from its public web surface.
j.name: Julienne Bruno

j.description: Julu Mobile was a Shanghai, China based mobile advertising network that served targeted, personalized ads to Chinese mobile users by analyzing mobile interactions to profile user interests. Backed by 500 Global, the company was acquired by Zhubajie on November 1, 2012 and no longer operates an independent product or developer platform. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, documentation, MCP server, or developer surface, and julumobile.com resolves to a Cloudflare block page.
j.name: Julu Mobile

j.description: Jumba is a Nairobi-based construction technology company founded in 2022 that digitizes the sourcing and financing of construction materials across Africa. Its B2B marketplace connects hardware retail stores and construction sites to manufacturers and suppliers of materials such as cement, steel, tiles, plumbing, electrical, paint and finishes, offering real-time price comparison and online ordering. Jumba OS is a management application for tracking sales, inventory and creditor accounts, while Jengwa provides buy-now-pay-later inventory financing. The company operates a consumer mobile app and reports processing over 12.6 million cement bags through more than 1,350 hardware stores, and is backed by Speedinvest. Jumba does not publish a public API; its developer presence is limited to open-source tooling on its GitHub organization.
j.name: Jumba

j.description: Jumbo (Jumbo Privacy) was a mobile-first consumer privacy and security assistant founded in 2019 by Pierre Valade, the co-founder of the Sunrise calendar app acquired by Microsoft. The iPhone/Android app helped everyday users take control of their online privacy by automatically hardening privacy settings across services like Google, Facebook, Twitter/X, Amazon, and LinkedIn, cleaning up old social posts, monitoring data breaches, and bundling identity-theft insurance. It was explicitly designed to process user data locally on-device with no server-side processing, so it never exposed a public developer API, SDK, or documented integration surface. Jumbo was backed by investors including Balderton Capital and Thrive Capital before being acqui-hired by cyber-insurer Coalition in 2023; the standalone consumer app was wound down and fully discontinued by 2024. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record - there is no active API to enrich.
j.name: Jumbo Privacy

j.description: Jumia is a pan-African e-commerce company often described as the "Amazon of Africa." Headquartered in Berlin and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker JMIA since its 2019 IPO, Jumia Technologies AG operates a third-party marketplace, a logistics network (Jumia Logistics), and a digital payments arm (JumiaPay) across eight African markets as of 2026: Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria, Senegal, and Uganda. The company exited Algeria in February 2026 and previously wound down Cameroon, Gabon, Rwanda, and Tunisia as part of a multi-year restructuring program targeting full-year profitability in 2027. Jumia's commerce platform connects more than 100,000 sellers with consumers across diverse categories including phones and electronics, fashion, home and living, beauty, FMCG, and groceries. Its developer surface is non-trivial: the Jumia Vendor API (vendor center, OAuth 2.0) supports order, inventory, product, and shipment integration for marketplace sellers, while the legacy SellerCenter API (a SellerCenter / Rocket Internet lineage shared with Lazada and Daraz) remains documented with PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node SDKs. JumiaPay exposes a Merchant API for payment creation, verification, refund, recurring-payment agreements, and callback-based webhooks, plus official WooCommerce and Magento payment-gateway plugins. The Jumia GitHub organization is sparse (an open-source playbook, Jumia Tech Blog, and Tech in Porto event site) while the JumiaPay AIG GitHub org hosts the WooCommerce and Magento gateway plugins under Apache 2.0.
j.name: Jumia

j.description: Jumio operates the KYX Platform, an end-to-end AI-driven identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance suite. Backend APIs orchestrate ID verification, document verification, biometric authentication, AML and watchlist screening, risk signals, and reusable identity (selfie.DONE). Web client and native iOS / Android / React Native / Flutter / Cordova SDKs front the platform; backend Java and .NET SDKs wrap the REST API for server-side flows.
j.name: Jumio

j.description: JUMO is a Cape Town-based banking-as-a-service (BaaS) platform, founded in 2015, that uses artificial intelligence to power digital credit and savings products for banks, mobile network operators, and payments providers across emerging markets in Africa. Its infrastructure has two foundational capabilities: Core, an end-to-end next-generation banking platform that replaces legacy core banking with no build cost, and Unify, an AI processor that transforms alternative data (such as GSM records and mobile wallet transactions) to reduce the cost and risk of lending. JUMO delivers financial services through partners including Airtel, MTN Group, Orange Money Group, and Mukuru, and has disbursed over USD 8 billion to more than 31 million people across Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Uganda, Cote d'Ivoire, South Africa, Benin, and Cameroon. It is a certified B Corporation backed by investors including Anthemis, LeapFrog Investments, Fidelity Management, and Visa. JUMO's APIs and integrations are provided privately to regulated financial-institution partners rather than through a public developer portal.
j.name: Jumo

j.description: Jump is a unified fan experience and ticketing platform built exclusively for professional sports teams. It combines primary and resale ticketing, team-branded mobile apps and websites, marketing and messaging, loyalty, fan identity and wallet, point-of-sale and scanning, dynamic pricing, and a unified fan-data foundation into a single system that teams own and control. Jump also embeds agentic AI agents to automate pricing, inventory, and revenue operations. It serves teams across the NBA, MLB, WNBA, NWSL, USL, and NCAA and is backed by Battery Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, Index Ventures, and Menlo Ventures. Jump connects to the tools teams already use through integration APIs, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation.
j.name: Jump

j.description: Jump Ramp Games was a New York City casual mobile gaming company best known for Lucktastic, a free scratch-card, rewards, and instant-win app that launched on Android in 2014 and grew to roughly 10 million US installs across Android and iOS, consistently ranking near the top of the lifestyle category. Founded by Alex Betancur and Tony Vartanian and backed by Bullpen Capital, the company paired free-to-play casual gaming with performance-marketing and rewards technology. Jump Ramp Games was acquired by MobilityWare in September 2019, which took over the Lucktastic franchise; the jumprampgames.com domain now redirects to mobilityware.com. The company exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface, so this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API provider.
j.name: Jump Ramp Games

j.description: Jump is an AI operating system for financial advisors, used by 35,000+ advisors and ranked #1 across T3, Kitces, and The Oasis Group reports. It organizes its capabilities into three products — Meet (AI notetaker, pre-meeting prep, agendas, automatic follow-ups, and scheduling), Grow (opportunity signals, playbooks, scorecards, surveys, and dashboards), and Operate (AI Associate, unified client profiles, and email assistance) — built on a unified data, integration, and agentic AI orchestration foundation. Jump is integration-led rather than a public-API provider: it ships 39+ two-way integrations with CRMs (Salesforce, Wealthbox, Redtail, HubSpot, AdvisorEngine), financial planning tools (eMoney, RightCapital, Asset-Map), portfolio management (Orion, Black Diamond), custodians (Charles Schwab), and meeting/VoIP platforms (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, RingCentral), pushing compliance-ready records straight into advisors' systems of record. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API or portal is published as of this profile.
j.name: Jump – Advisor AI

j.description: JumpCam was a consumer mobile video startup (San Francisco, founded 2013 by former Yammer/YouTube product leader David Stewart) that let groups of friends collaboratively shoot and edit a single video from up to thirty short clips. It raised $2.7M led by Google Ventures (GV) and shipped an iOS app. The company is no longer active and jumpcam.com is now a parked domain listed for sale (Afternic); no developer portal, API, documentation, or other public API surface exists. Surfaced as a GV portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment confirmed there is no live API to profile.
j.name: JumpCam

j.description: JumpCloud is an open directory platform that unifies identity, access, and device management across users, devices, networks, and SaaS applications. Its cloud directory supports SSO, MFA, device management (MDM), conditional access policies, RADIUS, LDAP, and HR system integration. JumpCloud's REST APIs (V1 and V2) provide programmatic access to users, groups, systems, policies, applications, and directory insights for IT automation.
j.name: JumpCloud

j.description: Jumpcut (Jumpcut, Inc.) is a Y Combinator-backed, remote-first digital-media company founded in 2014 in Los Angeles that produces online courses about entrepreneurship and content creation — teaching viral YouTube growth, audience building, and launching digital products with marketing automation. It reached the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Canaan Partners. Jumpcut is a consumer education/creator business, not an API producer: it publishes no developer platform, API reference, or machine-readable API specification, so there is no API surface to onboard here. As of this profile its primary domain jumpcut.com does not resolve (registered via Namecheap through 2032 but serving no DNS/website), and customers reported losing account access in late 2025, indicating the product has wound down. Retained as an identity-only network stub.
j.name: Jumpcut

j.description: Jumprope was a how-to video creation app backed by lightspeed-venture-partners that let creators produce and share step-by-step, swipeable instructional videos. The company (formerly at getjumprope.com) was acquired by Snap Inc. in early 2021 and the standalone product was subsequently wound down. As of this enrichment pass it operates no independent website, developer portal, or public API surface — the getjumprope.com and jumprope.co domains no longer resolve, and the unrelated jumprope.com domain is a physical jump-rope retailer on Shopify (not this company). No API artifacts could be discovered or derived; this profile is retained as a portfolio-lead record only.
j.name: Jumprope

j.description: Jumptap was a mobile advertising and audience-targeting platform founded in 2005 and based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It matched ads to signals such as time of day, carrier network, site content, and device type, helping app developers acquire users and helping developers and publishers maximize ad revenue. In August 2013 Jumptap was acquired by Millennial Media (valued at roughly $210-232M in stock); Millennial Media was subsequently acquired by AOL/Verizon and folded into what is now Yahoo. Jumptap no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no developer portal, documentation, or public API.
j.name: Jumptap

j.description: Juna.ai is a Berlin-based industrial AI company building an Agentic Factory OS — a platform of autonomous AI agents that plan, steer, and continuously improve complex industrial production processes. Its agents ingest live plant data through integrations with existing IT/OT systems (SAP, Siemens, AVEVA, PI Server, Snowflake), model assets and processes into a Factory Graph and Knowledge Graph, detect anomalies, run root-cause analysis, generate reports, and recommend or execute control actions 24/7 with human-in-the-loop oversight and full traceability. Juna targets heavy and process industries including chemicals, cement, pulp & paper, glass, food & beverage, pharma, consumer goods, and industrial manufacturing, focused on maximizing output, quality, energy efficiency, and sustainability. The company is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Norrsken VC, and John Doerr. Juna delivers integration through enterprise engagements and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.
j.name: Juna.ai

j.description: June is a product analytics platform purpose-built for B2B SaaS companies, providing company-level and user-level analytics focused on key SaaS metrics such as activation, retention, and feature adoption. The platform offers a REST-based Tracking API compatible with the Segment protocol, enabling teams to identify users, track events, group users into companies, and record page views. June also provides server-side SDKs for Node.js, Python, and Ruby, as well as client-side JavaScript and React/Next.js libraries. An Embed API (available as a Pro Plan add-on) allows embedding June dashboards directly into customer-facing products, and a Data Deletions API supports GDPR compliance by enabling deletion of user and workspace data.
j.name: June

j.description: Jungla, Inc. was a San Francisco precision-medicine informatics startup founded in 2016 by Alexander Colavin and Carlos Araya. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and IndieBio, it built a cloud-based Functional Modeling Platform (FMP), also described as a Molecular Evidence Platform, that combined functional genomics, computational biophysics, cellular engineering, and machine learning to produce auditable predictive models for clinical genetic and genomic variant interpretation. Jungla emerged from stealth in 2018 and was acquired by Invitae Corporation in July 2019 (approximately $59M), where its technology augmented Invitae's Sherloc variant-classification approach. The company is now defunct; its original developer surface (jungla.io) is offline and no public API, documentation, or SDKs survive. This profile is a historical record surfaced from the a16z portfolio; it carries no live developer artifacts.
j.name: Jungla

j.description: Junglee Games is a skill-based online gaming company founded in 2012 by Ankush Gera, operating as an independent subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, which acquired a majority stake in 2021 in a deal valuing the company at more than $440 million. Headquartered in Gurugram with a studio in Bengaluru, the company builds and operates consumer real-money and casual gaming apps for a base of over 150 million users, with flagship titles including Junglee Rummy, the Howzat fantasy cricket and football platform, Carrom Stars, and Junglee Poker. The company positions trust, safety, and fairness as engineering priorities. Junglee Games is a consumer gaming provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed security posture for the API Evangelist network. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.
j.name: Junglee Games

j.description: Juni is a Swedish fintech (headquartered in Göteborg, founded 2020) that provides a financial platform for ecommerce and digital businesses: business banking with multi-currency accounts, corporate and virtual cards, local and global payments, spend management, working-capital financing, and AI-driven accounting with integrations such as Fortnox. Juni is a licensed payment institution under the oversight of the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (SFSA) and is backed by EQT Ventures. It exposes a regulatory PSD2 / Open Banking (ASPSP) API surface for third-party providers, but publishes no public product API, SDKs, or developer portal. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.
j.name: Juni

j.description: Juniper Behavioral Health (now operating as Camber, camber.health) is a healthcare revenue-cycle-management (RCM) software company for specialty and behavioral health providers. Founded in 2021 and backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and Craft Ventures, the company automates medical billing, claims processing, denial management, and payment analytics so behavioral and specialty clinicians (ABA, PT, ENT, allergy) can collect more from insurance and spend less time on administrative overhead. Their platform is built on AI systems trained on more than $2.5B in claims data. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from the public Camber website; the company exposes a customer web application (app.camber.health) and a published responsible-disclosure policy but no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.
j.name: Juniper Behavioral Health

j.description: Juniper Mist AI is the AI-driven enterprise networking platform that powers Juniper Networks' AI-Native Networking portfolio. Acquired by Juniper Networks in 2019, Mist pioneered cloud-native, microservices Wi-Fi and extended its AIOps approach across Wired Assurance (EX/QFX switches), WAN Assurance (SSR/SRX gateways), and Access Assurance (cloud NAC). The platform is anchored by Marvis — a conversational virtual network assistant — and the Mist Cloud API, an OpenAPI 3.1 surface of 736 paths and 2832 schemas served across 13 regional clouds (Global, EMEA, APAC, Federal). Real-time event flow ships over WebSocket subscriptions and outbound Webhooks; infrastructure-as-code is supported by an official Terraform provider; and indoor location is delivered through Virtual BLE with native iOS and Android SDKs.
j.name: Juniper Mist AI

j.description: Juniper Networks (an HPE company since 2025) builds AI-native networking, routing, switching and security for service providers, enterprises and public-sector organizations. Its programmable surface spans the Mist cloud API (1,059 REST operations), Apstra data-center automation, Junos device automation over NETCONF/YANG, Junos Telemetry Interface gRPC streaming, and three first-party MCP servers.
j.name: Juniper Networks

j.description: Juniper Square is a fund operating system for the private markets, used by 2,300+ general partners across private equity, venture capital, commercial real estate, and private credit to raise capital, run fund administration and fund accounting, and manage the LP experience. Its GPX platform unifies investor data, fund accounting, payments, compliance, and reporting, and exposes them through a developer API (broad read/write coverage delivered as a developer-led engagement), pre-built connectors (HubSpot, Preqin, Outlook, DocuSign, Yardi IM/Voyager, Lob), and Headless GPX — an MCP server that brings the platform to any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini) with authentication, permissions, and audit inherited from the customer's existing configuration.
j.name: Juniper Square

j.description: JUnit is a programmer-friendly testing framework for Java and the JVM. JUnit 5 is the next generation of JUnit, composed of three modules: JUnit Platform, JUnit Jupiter, and JUnit Vintage.
j.name: JUnit

j.description: Junk King is a professional junk removal and hauling franchise operating across the United States and Canada as part of the Neighborly family of home service brands. Through locally owned and operated locations, Junk King provides full-service junk removal, self-service dumpster rental, and dumpster bag pickup for residential and commercial customers, handling appliance and furniture removal, estate and property cleanouts, construction debris, yard waste, and e-waste. The company emphasizes eco-friendly disposal, recycling, donating, and reusing as much collected material as possible. Junk King offers free estimates, same-day service in many markets, and online, phone, and text-based booking. It is a portfolio company associated with Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Junk King publishes no public API or developer platform.
j.name: Junk King

j.description: Junlebao Dairy Group (Shijiazhuang Junlebao Dairy Co., Ltd., 君乐宝乳业) is one of China's largest dairy processors, founded in 1995 and headquartered in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province. Its business spans the full dairy value chain: infant and toddler formula, low-temperature (chilled) yogurt, room-temperature liquid milk, fresh milk, cheese and dairy-farming/animal-husbandry operations. Junlebao is the largest dairy company in Hebei and ranks among China's top dairy producers, leading domestic infant-formula sales volume and holding a top position in low-temperature yogurt. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HSG). As a consumer packaged-goods / food manufacturer it publishes no public developer program, API, or open-data surface; this profile tracks its corporate web presence and company identity.
j.name: Junlebao

j.description: Juno (juno.co), operated by Juno Technology, Inc., is a San Francisco-based owner's representation, development-consulting and construction-management firm for prefabricated, modular and mass-timber multifamily development, working with developers from site feasibility and entitlement through delivery across North America. Juno owns the rights to the Juno Mass Timber System, a field-tested kit-of-parts building system of roughly 33 components configurable into 25+ unit types, proven on the 24-unit Juno East Austin project at 400 Comal St, Austin TX. The current company is the 2024 relaunch ("Juno 2.0") of the venture-funded Juno / Juno Residential founded in 2019 by Jonathan Scherr, BJ Siegel and Chester Chipperfield, which raised roughly $32M from Comcast Ventures, Khosla Ventures and RET Ventures before running out of money; the relaunched firm is led by co-founders Emily Mills Marineau and Jen Canchola. Juno sells professional services and a physical building system, not software: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site, a mass-timber system page, a contact form, a newsletter signup, terms of service and a privacy policy, and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind.
j.name: Juno

j.description: Juno is a Brazilian B2B payments fintech, acquired by EBANX in October 2021, that provides a complete billing and payments platform for Brazilian companies. Founded in 2014 in Maringá, Paraná, Juno powers more than 35,000 small and medium businesses with online sales and collections via Pix, boleto bancário, boleto_pix, and credit cards, plus marketplace payment split, recurring subscriptions, and a digital business account (Conta Juno) with Banking-as-a-Service capabilities. Juno is a participant of the Brazilian Interbank Payments Chamber (CIP). The company exposes a public REST API v2 through the Juno Developer Academy at integracao.juno.com.br, secured with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, plus HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and native mobile Direct Checkout SDKs for Android and iOS for PCI-safe card data encryption.
j.name: Juno

j.description: Juno (junocompanion.com), operated by SharedGenes, Inc., is a Y Combinator-backed (P26) consumer digital-health startup building an AI personal health assistant for the 1B+ people living with chronic illness. The Juno mobile app (iOS and Android) builds a longitudinal health profile through conversation, biometrics, and medical history to deliver personalized symptom guidance, automated symptom tracking by text or voice, trigger-pattern identification, and appointment-ready reports for clinicians. It supports conditions including fibromyalgia, long COVID, POTS, ME/CFS, EDS, endometriosis, lupus, and MS, and is informed by research from Oxford and UCL plus 1,000+ patient interviews. Founded in 2025 by Marshall Gould (CEO) and Isaac Tolley (CTO); HIPAA-aligned infrastructure with no health data sold. Juno also publishes Juno Open Health Tools, an MIT-licensed remote MCP server at https://juno-health-tools.vercel.app/api/mcp with five read-only, consent-gated tools that turn a user's non-identifying health notes into non-diagnostic appointment-preparation material; it is listed in the official MCP Registry and archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21730086). Juno publishes no REST API or SDK.
j.name: Juno Chat

j.description: Juno Journey is an AI-powered Learning & Development (L&D) platform that unifies employee training, personalized development planning, skills analytics, and performance management into a single "HumAIn Workforce Platform." Its Juno Agents automate course authoring, build adaptive personal development plans, deliver real-time in-context knowledge assistance, and surface live capability analytics, while a built-in LMS aggregates 150+ external content providers. The product connects to HRIS, identity, messaging, calendar, and performance systems through pre-built integrations (Slack, Okta, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, Personio, Cornerstone, Google Drive, Microsoft Azure). Juno Journey is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site, pricing, a knowledge hub, a blog, a status page, and a public trust center (ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.
j.name: Juno Journey

j.description: Junomedical (now Qunomedical) is a Berlin-based digital health company founded in 2015 by Dr. Sophie Chung that connects patients with professionally-vetted doctors and clinics for high-quality medical treatments at home and abroad. The consumer platform (qunomedical.com) offers free assessments, price matching, 24/7 patient support, and personalized treatment matching across specialties including plastic surgery, hair transplants, dentistry, oncology, orthopedics, reproductive medicine, and weight-loss surgery, serving roughly 10,000 patients a month. The company also builds Qunosuite, a patient-relationship-management (PRM) SaaS for healthcare providers. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a consumer marketplace and a provider SaaS but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.
j.name: Junomedical

j.description: Junto is a Berlin-based leadership-development company and a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. Junto delivers cohort-based, live and interactive online training led by certified coaches who previously held senior leadership roles at leading technology companies. Its programs combine the accountability and personal interaction of offline training with the scalability of online learning, and cover first-time managers, high-performance teams, and custom leadership tracks. Junto sells directly to organizations, who nominate high-potential employees for the programs. Junto operates a marketing site at junto.eu and a customer learning application at app.junto.eu. As of this profile, Junto publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.
j.name: Junto Education

j.description: Jupiter is the liquidity infrastructure powering the majority of DeFi on Solana. It aggregates spot DEXes, runs leveraged perpetuals, supports limit orders, dollar cost averaging, lending and flash loans, prediction markets, and a token launchpad. Developers integrate via production-grade REST APIs at api.jup.ag (and the rate- limited lite-api.jup.ag) covering Swap, Tokens, Price, Lend, Trigger (limit orders), Recurring (DCA), Perps, and Prediction, all behind a single API key. Open-source SDKs and the Jupiter Terminal embed widget extend the platform to wallets, exchanges, and apps.
j.name: Jupiter

j.description: Jupiter Endovascular, Inc. is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, developing Endoportal Control, a platform technology that fixes a flexibly navigated endoportal device into a stable state inside the vasculature so a catheter-based intervention can be delivered with the precision and control of direct surgical access. Its lead product is the Vertex Pulmonary Embolectomy System for acute pulmonary embolism, evaluated in the SPIRARE I first-in-human study (NCT06571760) and the FDA-approved SPIRARE II U.S. pivotal study. The company exited stealth with $21M and later closed an oversubscribed Series B surpassing its $40M target, led by Sonder Capital. Jupiter Endovascular is a pre-commercial clinical-stage device manufacturer and publishes no developer program, no API, and no machine-readable interface of any kind.
j.name: Jupiter Endovascular

j.description: Jupiter Intelligence is a climate risk analytics company founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Mateo, California. Built by climate scientists, Jupiter delivers decision-grade physical and extreme-weather risk intelligence to banks, insurers, asset managers, corporates, and public-sector institutions. Its flagship platform, ClimateScore Global, translates physical climate exposure across multiple perils, scenarios, and time horizons out to 2100 into finance-linked, audit-ready metrics that support underwriting, capital planning, portfolio management, and regulatory disclosure. Products include ClimateScore Global, RiskSignal, Adaptation Hub, Entity Modeling, MetricEngine, Compliance Hub, and the MRM Accelerator. Jupiter is delivered as a SaaS application, an enterprise API, and tailored analytics support. It is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and backed by investors including DCVC.
j.name: Jupiter Intelligence

j.description: Jupiter Money is a Bengaluru-based Indian digital banking app (neobank) operated by Amica Financial Technologies Private Limited. Founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta, Jupiter delivers a consumer "money app" experience that bundles savings and salary accounts, UPI payments, co-branded credit cards, personal loans, mutual funds, digital gold, fixed and recurring deposits, insurance, and a Jewels rewards program into a single mobile application. Jupiter is itself not a bank — it operates as a fintech marketplace and Loan Service Provider on top of regulated partners. Federal Bank is the primary banking partner for savings, salary, and deposit products, with CSB Bank powering the Edge+ and Edge RuPay credit cards and Federal Bank the Edge Federal VISA card. Lending is provided through partners including Amica Finance Private Limited and Kisetsu Saison Finance, with mutual funds through AIAPL and digital gold through MMTC-PAMP. The product is consumer facing and distributed via the Android and iOS apps; Jupiter does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. All integrations with banks, NBFCs, NPCI/UPI rails, card networks, and depositories are private business-to-business arrangements rather than an open API program.
j.name: Jupiter Money

j.description: JupiterOne is a cyber asset attack surface management (CAASM) and security asset intelligence platform that maps an organization's entire digital environment — cloud resources, devices, users, code repositories, findings, and the relationships between them — into a single queryable graph. Its public GraphQL API and the J1QL query language let teams query the graph, create and mutate entities and relationships, ingest data through sync jobs, run alert rules with webhook/SNS/SQS/Slack/Jira actions, manage IAM and questions, and automate compliance evidence collection. JupiterOne was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina.
j.name: JupiterOne

j.description: Project Jupyter is an open-source initiative that develops the software, open standards, and services for interactive computing across dozens of programming languages. The Jupyter ecosystem includes Jupyter Notebook, JupyterLab, Jupyter Server, JupyterHub, the Jupyter messaging protocol, and supporting client libraries.
j.name: Jupyter

j.description: Jupyter Notebook is the original open-source web application for creating and sharing computational documents that contain live code, equations, visualizations, and narrative text. The Jupyter Notebook server exposes a REST API for managing notebooks, files, kernels, sessions, and terminals, and uses the WebSocket-based Jupyter messaging protocol to communicate with kernels.
j.name: Jupyter Notebook

j.description: Jupyter Server is the backend that powers Jupyter Notebook, JupyterLab, and other Jupyter web applications. It provides the core REST API for managing kernels, sessions, contents, terminals, and configuration, and it hosts the WebSocket endpoints used to communicate with kernels via the Jupyter messaging protocol.
j.name: Jupyter Server

j.description: JupyterHub is a multi-user server for Jupyter notebooks. It manages authentication, spawns and proxies multiple instances of the single-user Jupyter notebook server, and exposes a REST API for managing users, groups, services, tokens, and the proxy.
j.name: JupyterHub

j.description: JupyterLab is the next-generation web-based interactive development environment for notebooks, code, and data. It is served by Jupyter Server and ships with JupyterLab Server, which provides REST APIs for user-defined settings, workspaces, themes, translations, and license reports, alongside the JavaScript and TypeScript extension API used to build JupyterLab plugins.
j.name: JupyterLab

j.description: Juren (巨人教育 / Juren Education) is a Chinese comprehensive basic-education training institution founded in 1994 and headquartered in Beijing (Zhongguancun, Haidian District).
