The company publishes no independent API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface — this profile is retained as a network record of a defunct/acquired provider with no API surface to enrich.
m.name: Motion Math

m.description: Motional is a Boston-headquartered autonomous-vehicle company formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv. Its core product is an all-electric IONIQ 5 robotaxi built on a Hyundai E-GMP platform with Motional's full Level 4 autonomous driving stack and a sensor suite including lidar, radar, and cameras. Motional operates commercial robotaxi service in Las Vegas in partnership with Uber, Uber Eats, and Lyft, with additional operations in Boston, Pittsburgh, Santa Monica, Singapore, and Seoul. The company's most influential developer artifact is nuScenes, the open large-scale multimodal autonomous-driving dataset originally released by nuTonomy (a Motional predecessor), now a de facto benchmark for 3D perception research. Motional also publishes the nuscenes-devkit Python library and AVCDL cybersecurity development lifecycle materials on GitHub. Motional does not publish a traditional public developer API; the developer surface is research-dataset access plus open-source devkits.
m.name: Motional

m.description: Motiva AI is an artificial-intelligence layer for enterprise email marketing that plugs into Oracle Eloqua and other marketing-automation platforms to automate campaign decision-making. It runs multivariate (A/B/n) message testing, patented per-contact send-time optimization, frequency management, list and dark-pool cleanup via Smart Suppress, audience discovery, and generative-AI email content through Motiva Generator (including private-label custom LLMs). Motiva is delivered as an installed connector rather than a public developer API, is trusted by enterprises such as Cisco and Thermo Fisher, and maintains SOC 1/2/3 and ISO 27001 compliance with GDPR and HIPAA support.
m.name: Motiva

m.description: Random Motivational Quotes
m.name: Motivational Quotes

m.description: Motive (formerly KeepTruckin) is a fleet management platform serving more than 120,000 businesses across trucking, logistics, construction, agriculture, and field service industries. The Motive REST API provides programmatic access to driver management, vehicle tracking, Hours of Service (HOS) compliance, IFTA reporting, dashcam events, dispatch workflows, geofencing, and real-time location data. Developers authenticate via OAuth 2.0 with scoped access tokens and can reach endpoints at api.gomotive.com (or the legacy api.keeptruckin.com base URL). The self-serve Developer Portal allows partners to build and publish apps to the Motive App Marketplace, and Postman collections are available alongside interactive API reference documentation.
m.name: Motive

m.description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations. It connects pre-licensed and post-graduate mental health professionals with 1,500+ vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states, enabling organizations to expand their workforce, reduce burnout, and meet licensure requirements. The fully-managed platform handles supervisor vetting, compliance and documentation, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video sessions, and payment processing, and includes group supervision, peer consultation, webinars, and workforce-development resources. Motivo serves behavioral health centers, treatment facilities, health plans, and digital health companies. As of this profile Motivo publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its platform is delivered as a managed SaaS product and it consumes third-party APIs (e.g. Google Calendar) internally.
m.name: Motivo

m.description: Motley is a Zurich-based company building a governed semantic layer for AI agents and business intelligence. Its open-core product, SLayer (motley-slayer), is a lightweight, agent-first semantic layer and query engine: teams model measures, dimensions, and filters once, and SLayer generates and executes correct SQL across Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB and more — exposed over MCP, a REST API, a CLI, a Python client, Apache Arrow Flight SQL, and a Postgres facade for BI tools. Motley Cloud adds the managed production layer on top: hosting, OAuth-based access control, row-level security, versioning, and a governed reporting engine that turns agent queries into reports, charts, documents, and presentations. Founded by Egor Kraev (ex-Head of AI at Wise), Artemy Belousov, and Yann Ranchere; backed by Seedcamp.
m.name: Motley

m.description: A car-manufacturer logo API and image CDN delivering badge, wordmark, and full-logo assets plus structured brand data for 420+ automotive brands. Offers a REST/JSON API, a token-authenticated image CDN, a hosted MCP server, an llms.txt, and published agent skills.
m.name: Motomarks

m.description: MotorMia is an AI-powered automotive platform for car enthusiasts, built around Mia, an AI modding partner, build advisor, and performance analyst. Users add their vehicles, set build and performance goals, and Mia returns personalized upgrade recommendations across engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, cooling, and exhaust systems, tuned to the user's level of mechanical experience. The platform is backed by a proprietary automotive intelligence dataset combining over 5 million aftermarket parts, more than 50 million fitment records, and real-world enthusiast build behavior from 1M+ community projects, and ships as iOS and Android mobile apps plus a web store. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, MotorMia raised $8M led by investors including Lerer Hippeau and Seedcamp. As of this profile MotorMia is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface.
m.name: MotorMia

m.description: Motorola (motorola.com) is the consumer mobile-device brand operated by Motorola Mobility, a Lenovo company, producing Android smartphones (moto g, moto edge, and razr foldable lines), tablets, and accessories sold worldwide. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub. On review, the consumer brand publishes no open public REST/HTTP API developer portal: the historical developer.motorola.com Moto Mods hardware SDK (for the modular Moto Z) is no longer reachable, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found. Enterprise and public-safety APIs are offered separately by Motorola Solutions, Inc. (docs.motorolasolutions.com), a distinct company, under a gated partner Application Developer Program.
m.name: Motorola

m.description: Motorola Solutions is a Fortune 500 company that provides developer APIs and integration capabilities through its developer platform. Motorola Solutions provides APIs for public safety communications, command center software, and video security integration. The platform enables partners to build on Motorola's public safety infrastructure.
m.name: Motorola Solutions

m.description: Motorq is a connected vehicle intelligence platform that taps native OEM connectivity to deliver AI-powered insights across the automotive ecosystem. It aggregates and normalizes vehicle telematics data from 25+ automotive brands and third-party sources without plug-in hardware or dongles, so fleets, fleet management companies, dealerships, lenders, insuretechs, and mobility companies can drive maintenance, safety, utilization, and EV use cases. Motorq offers access through a cloud fleet management portal, bi-directional APIs and data streams (Get Location, Create Geofence, and more), and a Snowflake data lake integration. Its Motorq Fuse AI layer surfaces prioritized recommendations ranked by severity and cost impact. API access is gated to enterprise and OEM partners; there is no public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI definition. Backed by Insight Partners.
m.name: Motorq

m.description: Motorway is the UK's fastest-growing used car marketplace, connecting private sellers with a network of more than 8,000 verified car dealers through a daily online auction. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London and Brighton, the platform provides instant AI-assisted vehicle valuations, a mobile app that builds a sale-ready car profile, nationwide home collection, same-day payment (Motorway Pay), transport (Motorway Move), and outstanding-finance handling. Over one million people have used Motorway to sell a car. It is a consumer and dealer (B2C/B2B) marketplace rather than a public API provider: no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface is published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Index Ventures, ICONIQ Growth, BMW i Ventures and LocalGlobe.
m.name: Motorway

m.description: Mottu is the leading motorcycle-rental ecosystem in Latin America, founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, Brazil by Rubens Zanelatto. It rents motorcycles to gig and delivery couriers who lack access to traditional credit, bundling insurance, maintenance, 24-hour support and financial services (Mottu Pay) so workers can earn income through food delivery, e-commerce and last-mile logistics. Mottu has verticalized the value chain, running its own assembly line, parts and service network, and fleet-management software, and offers white-labeled last-mile delivery (Mottu Entregas) to more than 1,000 retailers across 100+ cities in Brazil and Mexico. Backed by QED Investors, Mottu has raised over US$150M. It operates as a consumer and B2B mobility/fintech app and does not publish a public developer API.
m.name: Mottu

m.description: Mount is a Y Combinator-backed (P26) AI-native insurance carrier built specifically for companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. Its first product, an AI liability policy marketed as ActiveCover, pairs continuous vulnerability scanning and red-teaming of AI deployments with purpose-built liability coverage across AI-specific risk categories. Mount secures the agent workflow, quantifies the residual operational risk, helps fix vulnerabilities, and transfers the remaining risk through insurance, advertising fast activation and dynamic, usage-based pricing. Founded in 2026 by Fabian Amherd and John Bachmann and based in San Francisco, Mount aims to rebuild the commercial-insurance carrier stack from the ground up with AI at its core. As of this profile Mount publishes a marketing site and blog but no public developer, API, or SDK surface.
m.name: Mount

m.description: Mountain America Credit Union (MACU) is a federally chartered, member-owned not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Sandy, Utah, founded in 1936 and regulated and insured by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). It is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with roughly $21.9 billion in assets, more than 1.4 million members, and over 100 branches serving Utah, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, and Arizona, offering consumer and business checking, savings, mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, and wealth services. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, Mountain America exposes no public first-party developer API or developer portal: there is no developer.macu.com or api.macu.com host, and every path under macu.com returns the same client-rendered application shell. Consumer-permissioned data access is intermediated through its core banking provider and data aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a directly published API. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and no public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented for this institution at the time of review.
m.name: Mountain America Credit Union

m.description: Mountain Protocol is the issuer of USDM, a regulated, institutional-grade yield-bearing stablecoin backed by short-term US Treasury securities that pays daily rewards to holders through an ERC20 rebasing token. The company operated a Primary-User account platform with a private REST API for depositing and withdrawing USDM and USDC, querying account balances, and checking USDC liquidity, alongside on-chain proof-of-reserves and a smart-contract security program audited by OpenZeppelin with an Immunefi bug bounty. As of 2025 the protocol entered an orderly wind-down: the primary market closed on August 22, 2025, redemptions moved to secondary markets, and Phase 3 provides on-chain proof-of-reserves so holders can independently verify USDM backing. Backed by Multicoin Capital.
m.name: Mountain Protocol

m.description: Mountaintop (Mountaintop.gg) was a remote-first independent video game studio founded in 2020 by veterans of Blizzard, Respawn, Riot, and Bungie, led by Oculus co-founder Nate Mitchell. Backed by a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the studio built Spectre Divide, a free-to-play 3v3 tactical PvP shooter featuring its signature "Duality" two-body mechanic. The game launched in 2024, but the studio wound down and Spectre Divide's online services were shut down in 2025. Mountaintop is a consumer game studio, not an API provider, and publishes no developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, and its public web and support surfaces are now offline. It remains cataloged in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company with no active API surface.
m.name: Mountaintop.gg

m.description: MouseCat is an agentic AI infrastructure company for risk operations, founded in 2026 and a graduate of the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch. The platform runs human-quality fraud investigations to help risk teams automatically detect, investigate, and mitigate emerging fraud, scale investigations, build better models, and make faster decisions. MouseCat deploys entirely within customer-owned cloud environments, integrating with the data, vendors, and APIs a risk team already relies on so companies retain complete control of sensitive data. The company was founded by Nicholas Aldridge (CEO) and Joseph McAllister (CTO) and is backed by Y Combinator, Imagination Capital, and SurgePoint Capital. As of this profile MouseCat is an early-stage startup with a public marketing site and a private application; it publishes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or MCP server yet.
m.name: MouseCat

m.description: Mouser Electronics is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
m.name: Mouser Electronics

m.description: Movable Ink is a New York-headquartered marketing technology company that turns customer data into personalized content across email, mobile and web. Its two products are Studio, which generates composite images and interactive content at the moment a message is opened, and Da Vinci, an AI decisioning layer that chooses what content each customer sees. The integration surface is a write-only Customer Data API that streams behavioral events into Studio, a family of native and wrapper mobile SDKs (iOS, Android, React Native, Cordova, Flutter, Expo), a Studio app toolchain built around the `movable` CLI and the cropduster library, and dozens of ESP/CDP connectors. API reference material is customer-gated; no OpenAPI is published.
m.name: Movable Ink

m.description: Movandi is an RF semiconductor company founded by former Broadcom executives (CEO Maryam Rofougaran and CTO Reza Rofougaran) that designs 5G mmWave chipsets, RF front ends, phased-array antenna modules, 5G smart repeaters, and beamforming software for terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. Based in Irvine, California and backed by Sierra Ventures, the company holds 130+ patents covering millimeter wave semiconductor, system, and software technologies spanning 5G, fixed wireless, and satellite connectivity. Movandi is a hardware/semiconductor vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.
m.name: Movandi

m.description: MOVE Bank is a 100% customer-owned Australian mutual bank operated by MoveBank Ltd (ABN 91 087 651 090, AFSL/Australian credit licence 234 536), headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. Founded in 1968 as Railways Credit Union to serve railway workers and their families, it rebranded to MOVE Bank in 2018 to serve the broader transport and logistics community nationally, and today manages more than $750 million in assets across transaction and savings accounts, term deposits, home and personal loans, and insurance. As an authorised deposit-taking institution, MOVE Bank participates in Australia's Consumer Data Right (CDR / Open Banking) as a data holder, exposing a public, unauthenticated Product Reference Data (PRD) API conforming to the Data Standards Body's Consumer Data Standards, alongside the accredited, consent-based consumer data sharing surface governed by the CDR security profile.
m.name: MOVE Bank

m.description: Move Home Organisation CIC (Companies House 17202438, incorporated 6 May 2026, Poole, England) is an asset-locked UK Community Interest Company that runs MoveHome.org, a free, not-for-profit property listing aggregator built as the open-source reference consumer of the RAIA Protocol — the Real Estate AI Agent standard whose charter names the same CIC as its governing body — with listings federated from estate agencies and the transaction side handled by the separate commercial company EstateAigents.com Ltd. Its machine surface is agent-native and anonymous: an A2A 0.3.0 agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json (graded conformant) with search_properties, get_property and create_enquiry skills over JSON-RPC at https://movehome.org/api/a2a; a read-only MCP server at https://movehome.org/mcp and a second MCP server over its public registry of real-estate A2A agents; an unauthenticated registry REST API under /api/registry/v1; and, for CRMs pushing listings in, an OAuth2 client-credentials implementation of the RAIA Portal Feed API (OpenAPI 3.1.0, 13 operations, RFC 9457 problem details) at https://movehome.org/api/raia/portal/v1. The site publishes an llms.txt/skills.md for agents but no privacy policy, terms, status page, changelog, SDK or pricing page.
m.name: Move Home Organisation CIC

m.description: Moveha is a student-housing and long-term rental platform for the United States, built to help college students and relocating professionals find, reserve, and secure off-campus housing before they arrive in the country. Founded by former international students and backed by 500 Global, Moveha positions itself as an "Airbnb for long-term rentals" — a faster, more transparent way to browse verified properties, reserve remotely, share rooms, or list a property for lease, with identity-verified users. As of this enrichment pass Moveha publishes no public API or developer surface.
m.name: Moveha

m.description: MoveInSync is an enterprise employee-commute and workplace-management SaaS platform. It automates end-to-end corporate transportation — fixed-route shuttles, flexi rideshare, on-demand campus rides, corporate carpool, parking management, and the WorkInSync hybrid-workplace suite — with smart routing, live tracking, safety workflows, and billing. The platform serves more than 1M commuters across 100,000+ vehicles in 39 countries for 400+ enterprises, including 112+ Fortune 500 companies. MoveInSync exposes a JWT-authenticated REST and webhook integration API at api.moveinsync.com, including the Rentlz booking-management APIs used by external transport vendors. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.
m.name: MoveInSync

m.description: MoveitPro (MoveitPro+) is web-based moving company management software built by professional movers, covering the full operation of a moving and storage company - CRM and lead capture, estimating and quoting, a smart dispatch board with drag-and-drop scheduling and crew assignment, fleet and maintenance management, digital bills of lading and e-signatures, itemized inventory, storage and warehouse tracking, invoicing and credit-card payments, commission tracking, and AI call transcription and QA. MoveitPro advertises "Open API & Custom Integrations" and ships native integrations (QuickBooks, Twilio, Mailchimp, Google Maps/Calendar), but does not publish a self-serve public developer API, reference documentation, or OpenAPI. Its only publicly documented programmatic surface is a Zapier integration exposing Clients, Leads, Jobs, and Estimates. The APIs listed below are logical resources modeled from that documented Zapier integration; MoveitPro does not publish HTTP endpoints, base URLs, or authentication details.
m.name: MoveitPro

m.description: Movel AI is a Singapore-based robotics deployment software company, founded in 2016, that makes it faster and cheaper to get autonomous mobile robots up and running in real-world environments. Its platform pairs deep learning, sensor fusion, and probabilistic planning so robots can perceive their surroundings and plan tasks on their own. Core products are the Movel Fleet Management System (FMS) for real-time monitoring and control of multi-robot fleets and Movel RNS (Robotic Navigation System) for precise single-robot navigation of complex spaces, applied across logistics, manufacturing, construction, and healthcare. The company is backed by Silicon Solution Ventures, 500 Global, AviTech, SGInnovate, Seeds Capital, and Enterprise Singapore. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Movel AI publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.
m.name: Movel AI

m.description: Moven (Movencorp Newco Inc.) is a New York City fintech founded in 2011 by Brett King and Alex Sion. Originally a direct-to-consumer mobile banking and financial-wellness app, the company pivoted in 2020 to a business-to-business model, licensing its spending-analytics and financial-wellness technology to banks, credit unions, and other fintechs through open APIs and SDKs. Its data-driven engagement modules power companion and challenger-bank experiences such as TD Bank's MySpend and Westpac's CashNav. Moven's API and SDK surface is partner-gated behind a demo/sandbox request rather than a self-serve public developer portal, so no public OpenAPI, reference documentation, or GitHub organization is available for catalog harvesting.
m.name: Moven

m.description: Moveworks is an enterprise agentic AI assistant platform that lets employees search and act across 100+ business applications (Slack, ServiceNow, Workday, Jira, Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft) through conversational AI agents. Its "Build with Moveworks" developer platform and Agent Studio expose REST APIs to send events and proactive messages, drive AI Assistant conversations (including streaming), export analytics data, and receive inbound webhooks, plus a set of customer-hosted gateways (Content, Identity, Knowledge, Forms) that feed enterprise data to the AI. All APIs use HTTP Bearer authentication with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials issuing short-lived access tokens, are published as OpenAPI 3.1 with a discoverable /.well-known/api-catalog, and are deployed across US, EU, Canada, GovCloud (FedRAMP), Japan and UK regions.
m.name: Moveworks

m.description: Moveworks is an enterprise AI assistant / agentic automation platform (acquired by ServiceNow) that lets employees resolve IT, HR, and other requests in natural language across Slack, Microsoft Teams, and 100+ enterprise systems. Its developer platform — Agent Studio, Creator Studio, and the AI Agent Marketplace — lets teams build and deploy plugins with triggers, slots, and actions, and connect to systems such as ServiceNow, Jira, Workday, and Salesforce. Moveworks exposes Bearer-authenticated REST APIs including a read-only OData Data API for exporting conversation and interaction data, an Events API, a Conversations API, webhook listeners, and customer-hosted gateways, plus an official hosted MCP server for its documentation. Surfaced originally as a Bain Capital Ventures portfolio company and enriched from Moveworks' public developer documentation.
m.name: Moveworks (ServiceNow)

m.description: Our scaled based platform meets all your business requirements in the fields of mobility and energy. Explore the powerful solutions or consult one of our experts for advice. Together, we are building a sustainable future for your organization.
m.name: MoveYou

m.description: Moviation, Inc. is a Seoul-based advanced air mobility and premium travel company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. It operates Vonaer, an AI-powered luxury mobility platform that orchestrates on-demand travel across private aviation (jets and helicopters), luxury ground transportation (limousines), super yachts, and curated experiences, with planned expansion into electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) urban air mobility (UAM). Moviation currently runs air-taxi service with conventional helicopters and has partnered with hybrid-eVTOL developer Plana to build out an advanced air mobility (AAM) ecosystem in South Korea. The company reaches customers through the consumer Vonaer app and a concierge membership program; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.
m.name: Moviation

m.description: Random Movie and Series Quotes
m.name: Movie Quote

m.description: MovieLaLa Inc was a San Francisco movie-discovery and social-video startup (500 Global portfolio, founded 2012) best known for its GIF maker and a MovieLaLa Video Player. The only developer surface it ever published was a client-side JavaScript embed API for that player (a drop-in replacement for the YouTube IFrame API, loaded from assets-embed.movielala.com), documented in the github.com/movielala GitHub org. The company is now defunct — its last public code activity was 2016 and the gif-maker repo redirects to gifmaker.io. The movielala.com domain has lapsed and is currently repurposed by an unrelated third party (an Indonesian gambling site), so it no longer represents the company and is not wired as a website here. No REST/OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or hosted API surface exists to enrich.
m.name: Movielala

m.description: MoviePass is a consumer movie-theater subscription service that lets members see films in theaters nationwide for a low monthly fee. The relaunched service (led by co-founder Stacy Spikes after reacquiring the brand) uses a credit-based system: members choose a monthly plan, earn credits, and redeem them for showtimes at over 4,000 participating US theaters, including major chains and independent cinemas, with plans starting around $10/month and no long-term commitment. Members browse showtimes and book through the MoviePass iOS and Android apps. MoviePass was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it is a direct-to-consumer app business and does not publish a traditional public developer API. Its marketing site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP server plus an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.
m.name: Moviepass

m.description: Movius is a secure enterprise mobile communications company whose flagship product, MultiLine, gives employees a separate, compliant business identity (voice, SMS, MMS, and social messaging across WhatsApp, WeChat, Line, and Microsoft Teams) on their personal phones. Marketed as SCaaS (Secure Communication as a Service), the platform is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, and government, capturing and archiving all communications for FINRA, SEC, MiFID II, FCA COBS, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance. Movius exposes an admin/management REST API through its Management Portal that lets external applications provision and manage API users, assign and reassign numbers, configure compliance policies, and pull reports and communication records into cloud archival systems, alongside packaged integrations for Salesforce and Microsoft Teams.
m.name: Movius

m.description: Movivo was a London-based mobile rewards startup (500 Startups / Distro Dojo, HQ London) whose consumer app let users cover the cost of their mobile airtime and data by completing surveys, crowdsourced micro-tasks, and app installs, working with mobile operators across emerging markets. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass the company appears defunct — movivo.com resolves to a parked GoDaddy for-sale domain, and no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or GitHub organization could be found. This profile is retained as a network record with no API surface to enrich.
m.name: Movivo

m.description: Movopack is a Milan-based sustainability startup, founded in 2021 and backed by Techstars, 360 Capital, and Greiner Innoventures, that provides reusable, customizable packaging for e-commerce, retail, and B2B logistics. Its circular system pairs branded reusable mailers with pre-paid return labels and QR-code drop-off points, then handles quality checks, cleaning, and redistribution — cutting packaging waste by up to 98% and CO2 emissions by 84% after repeated reuse cycles. Movopack is a physical-product and reverse-logistics company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.
m.name: Movopack

m.description: Moxe Health is a United States healthcare data interoperability company, headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, that operates the Clinical Data Clearinghouse for secure clinical data exchange between health plans (payers) and health systems (providers). Moxe's API-first platform ingests release-of-information (ROI) requests, searches connected electronic health records (EHRs) to extract the minimum-necessary contextual clinical data for a specified patient and date range, and securely delivers that data to the partner's system. Its Chart Retrieval API supports risk adjustment, quality improvement, claim management, payment integrity, care management, and forecasting use cases. The public developer portal documents a REST (OpenAPI 3.0.1) Chart Retrieval API secured with OAuth2 client-credentials plus an x-api-key header; retrieved charts are returned to a predetermined location via SFTP. Moxe is HIPAA and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and was named number 1 Best in KLAS for Payer-Provider Data Exchange. The documented API is REST/JSON rather than HL7 FHIR, and full access is granted through a partner onboarding agreement.
m.name: Moxe Health

m.description: Moxion Power Co is a mobile energy storage company (a Y Combinator alum) that builds trailer-mounted, zero-emission Mobile Power Units (MPUs) used as quiet, clean replacements for diesel generators on construction sites, film productions, events, and grid-support jobs. Moxion operated a REST Developer API that let fleet operators fetch device metadata, real-time GPS location, and time-series telemetry (state of charge, pack voltage, net/output power, energy available/capacity, cellular signal) for their Mobile Power Units, along with active fault codes. The API additionally exposed AEMP 2.0 (ISO 15143-3 v.20190501) compliant fleet-snapshot endpoints so telematics platforms could ingest Moxion equipment alongside other heavy-equipment fleets. Authentication used bearer tokens issued to Service Accounts. Note the company filed for bankruptcy in August 2024; the developer documentation remains online but the API host may no longer be operational.
m.name: Moxion Power Co

m.description: Moxtra (now operating as Moxo) is a contextual collaboration and customer engagement platform that lets businesses embed chat, video meetings, voice calls, file sharing, e-signature, digital workflows, and binder-based collaboration into their own mobile and web applications via SDKs and REST APIs. The Moxtra Developer Portal exposes 200+ REST API endpoints for managing users, binders (workspaces), messages, files, meetings, todos, and notifications. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 access tokens issued against the Moxtra (or self-branded GroupHour) authorization server.
m.name: Moxtra

m.description: Moxxie Ventures is an early-stage (pre-seed and seed) venture capital firm founded in 2019 by Katie Jacobs Stanton, backing exceptional, technical founders building a better future. The firm writes $500K-$2M checks (typically ~$1.5M for roughly 10% ownership) across enterprise software, climate, consumer, fintech, healthcare, infrastructure (dev platforms, robotics, autonomy) and vertical AI, and has raised three funds including a $95M third fund in 2024. Its 100+ portfolio companies include Airtable, Calm, Carta, Coinbase, Lime, Opendoor and Tipalti. Moxxie publishes no public API or developer surface.
m.name: Moxxie Ventures

m.description: Moyasar is a Saudi Arabian payment gateway that lets businesses accept online payments across mada, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, and STC Pay. Its REST API (base https://api.moyasar.com/v1) covers payments (create, fetch, list, refund, capture, void), hosted invoices, card tokenization, webhooks, and payouts / disbursements. Authentication is HTTP Basic with a publishable or secret API key as the username and an empty password, in separate test and live modes.
m.name: Moyasar

m.description: Moz is a Seattle-based search-marketing software company, founded in 2004 as SEOmoz and part of Ziff Davis since 2021, whose products include Moz Pro, Moz Local, STAT and Moz Data. Its developer surface is the Moz API, a JSON-RPC 2.0 API served from a single universal endpoint at https://api.moz.com/jsonrpc, exposing 62 public methods across five namespaces: site metrics (Domain Authority, Page Authority, Brand Authority, Spam Score), the Moz Link Index (links, linking root domains, anchor text, link intersect, link status, final redirect), keyword metrics (volume, difficulty, opportunity, priority, search intent, related keywords), ranking and top-page data, and Moz Local location, group, account, listing-network and Google Business Profile insight management. Requests are authenticated with a Moz API token in an x-moz-token header, billed against a row-based monthly quota, and Moz additionally runs two beta remote MCP servers - Moz Data and Moz Local - at https://api.moz.com/mcp/v1/data and https://api.moz.com/mcp/v1/local, protected by OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata.
m.name: Moz

m.description: Mozart AI is a generative audio workstation and AI music-creation platform (mozartai.com) that lets musicians compose, produce, and distribute songs using AI-assisted and agentic tools. Rather than generating finished tracks from a single prompt, it operates as a full digital audio workstation built around context-aware stem generation, real-time MIDI suggestions, synth and effects generation, and automated production tasks such as quantization and time-stretching, letting users work at the level of stems, instruments, or individual notes. Founded in 2025 and based in London, the company raised a $6M seed round led by Balderton Capital in February 2026 and reports more than 100,000 artists and over 1 million songs created. The product is delivered as a consumer web and mobile app (built on the ElevenLabs Eleven Music API) and does not currently publish a public developer API.
m.name: Mozart AI

m.description: Mozart Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Seattle, Washington, founded in 2020 to develop disease-modifying therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory disease. Its platform is built on the regulatory CD8 T cell (CD8 Treg) network — an upstream immune checkpoint that normally recognizes and eliminates the pathogenic immune cells that attack healthy tissue, and that becomes dysfunctional in autoimmune disease when inhibitory killer immunoglobulin-like receptors (KIR) block CD8 Treg activation. Rather than suppressing downstream inflammation, Mozart engineers bispecific CD8 Treg modulators intended to restore that checkpoint and re-establish long-term immune balance. Its pipeline comprises MTX-101, a KIR x CD8 bispecific antibody in Phase 1b study for type 1 diabetes, and MTX-201, a KIR x ICOS bispecific in preclinical development for inflammatory bowel disease. The company launched with a $55M Series A led by ARCH Venture Partners and Sofinnova Partners with participation from Eli Lilly, MRL Ventures Fund, Leaps by Bayer, Altitude Life Science Ventures and Alexandria Venture Investments, and later added a $25M extension including Pfizer Ventures, AbbVie Ventures, Ono Venture Investment and UPMC Enterprises. Mozart Therapeutics sells therapeutics, not software: it runs no developer program, publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization.
m.name: Mozart Therapeutics

m.description: Mozi is a private social network mobile app founded by Twitter and Medium co-founder Ev Williams and Molly DeWolf Swenson, and backed by Obvious Ventures. Rather than public profiles or follower counts, Mozi privately matches your phone contacts so you learn when friends are in the same city, attending the same events, or checking in nearby — designed to spark in-person "social serendipity" and get people off their screens. Launched in December 2024 and available in 135+ countries, Mozi is a consumer iOS/Android application with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time.
m.name: Mozi

m.description: mParticle is a customer data platform (CDP) that helps brands collect, unify, and activate customer data across mobile, web, OTT, and server sources, then forward it in real time to hundreds of analytics, marketing, and warehouse destinations. The mParticle developer platform exposes server Events, IDSync, Profile, Warehouse Sync, Calculated Attributes, Data Planning and Platform APIs that let teams ingest events, resolve identity, manage configurations, and orchestrate audiences using HTTP Basic, an HMAC request digest, and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials bearer tokens. mParticle was acquired by Rokt.
m.name: mParticle

m.description: MPIRIQ (MPiriQ Science Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based healthcare software company that automates clinical documentation for medical practices and study centers. Its AI platform structures patient data directly inside existing EMR/PMS systems, runs quality and billing validation checks in the background, and connects real-world care data to clinical research through decentralized, GDPR-compliant pseudonymization. The platform helps practices participate in clinical trials via automated indication screening and patient recruitment, giving physicians time back while opening a research revenue stream. Founded in 2024 and backed by HV Capital and Speedinvest.
m.name: MPIRIQ

m.description: Mporium (Mporium Group plc, formerly MoPowered) was a London-based, "mobile first" data-driven marketing and advertising-technology company founded in 2012. Its proprietary IMPACT platform delivered software-as-a-service that helped agencies and advertisers identify and act on consumer "micro-moments" across search, social, and display media, reacting to real-time signals from TV, news feeds, sports, financial data, and social media to optimise ad pricing, timing, and selection. The group also acquired the digital agency Fast Web Media. Mporium was a portfolio company of the fintech venture firm Anthemis and was previously listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company is now defunct: it has been delisted, publishes no developer portal or public API, and its primary domain (mporium.com) is parked and listed for sale. This profile is retained as a historical company record in the API Evangelist network; there is no live API surface to enrich.
m.name: Mporium

m.description: mPower Social Enterprises Ltd. is a Dhaka, Bangladesh technology-for-development company founded in 2008 by Harvard and MIT graduate students as ClickDiagnostics — winner of the MIT $100K competition — and renamed after moving its center of gravity to Bangladesh in 2010. mPower designs, builds and operates information systems for governments, UN agencies, donor organizations and international NGOs across health and nutrition, water and sanitation, agriculture and livestock, education, governance and rights, livelihood and poverty alleviation, climate and environment, and humanitarian response, and states it has deployed more than 300 ICT solutions across 17 countries in the Global South. Its engineering practice is built on open-source digital public goods — DHIS2, OpenMRS, OpenSRP / FHIR Core, Bahmni and Moodle — which it customizes, integrates and supports for national health management information systems, electronic medical records and shared health records, rather than shipping a hosted product of its own. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified. mPower publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract; its public software surface is a GitHub organization made up largely of downstream forks of the open-source health platforms it implements, plus a set of first-party Android apps on Google Play.
m.name: mPower Social

m.description: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) is an OASIS-standard, lightweight publish/subscribe messaging transport protocol designed for constrained devices and low-bandwidth, high-latency, or unreliable networks, making it the de-facto messaging protocol for IoT and machine-to-machine (M2M) communication. MQTT is a protocol specification rather than a hosted API: clients connect over TCP/TLS (typically port 1883 or 8883) or WebSocket (8080/8081) to an MQTT broker (such as Mosquitto, HiveMQ, EMQX, or AWS IoT Core) and exchange CONNECT, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE, and other control packets defined by the standard. The current standard is MQTT Version 5.0 (OASIS Standard, 7 March 2019); MQTT 3.1.1 remains widely deployed.
m.name: MQTT

m.description: Mr. Cooper Group (formerly Nationstar Mortgage, NASDAQ: COOP) was a Coppell, Texas-based mortgage servicer with roughly $1.5T in unpaid principal balance under servicing and more than 4 million customers. It was acquired by Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT) in an all-stock transaction announced March 31, 2025 (initial value $9.4B) and closed October 1, 2025 (final value approximately $14.2B). Mr. Cooper now operates as a Rocket Companies subsidiary; the corporate site mrcoopergroup.com redirects to rocketcompanies.com and the COOP ticker has been delisted. The consumer brand Mr. Cooper continues at mrcooper.com as one of seven Rocket Companies operating businesses (Rocket Mortgage, Redfin, Mr. Cooper, Rocket Homes, Rocket Close, Rocket Money, Rocket Loans). Mr. Cooper does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.
m.name: Mr. Cooper Group

m.description: MRI Software is a real estate technology platform serving over 45,000 clients across 170+ countries. It provides REST APIs and an open integration ecosystem for property management, investment management, lease accounting, facilities management, visitor and contractor management, and commercial real estate analytics. The MRI Information Exchange (MIX) hosts over 1,000 vetted APIs for data exchange between MRI's core platform and third-party or custom applications.
m.name: MRI Software

m.description: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform: a Scraper API (Web Renderer fetch, Scrape JSON/Markdown, screenshots, listing pages and sitemaps on api.mrscraper.com), a Platform API for creating, rerunning and managing scrapers and results (api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1), Google SERP, residential proxies, a hosted OAuth 2.1 MCP server (mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp), a CLI with agent skills, Node, Python, LangChain and n8n SDKs, and webhooks.
m.name: MrScraper

m.description: MRU Holdings, Inc. (operating as MyRichUncle) was a specialty education-finance company founded in 2001 and headquartered in New York that became one of the largest private student-loan providers in the United States. It ceased offering student-loan products in September 2008 and filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in February 2009. Battery Ventures participated in the company's 2005 PIPE financing. The company is defunct and publishes no live website, public API, or developer surface.
m.name: MRU

m.description: MSC Industrial Direct is one of the largest industrial product distributors in North America, providing metalworking, maintenance, repair, and operations products and services to manufacturers.
m.name: MSC Industrial Direct

m.description: MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) is a privately-held, family-owned global container shipping and logistics group headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, founded in 1970 by Gianluigi Aponte and now led by CEO Soren Toft under the Aponte-Diamant family. MSC is the world's largest container shipping line by fleet size and capacity, operating roughly 900 cargo vessels with a combined intake of about 7 million TEU and controlling more than a fifth of global container capacity as of late 2025. The carrier offers a portfolio of digital shipment-management products through its myMSC e-business platform — including Instant Quote for online rate generation, online booking, electronic Bill of Lading and Sea Waybill issuance via eDocs, container Track & Trace, and the myMSC mobile app — and exposes a Direct Integrations program for shippers, freight forwarders, and NVOCCs that combines REST APIs and EDI message exchange. The MSC Developer Portal (developerportal.msc.com), hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management, publishes documentation and EDI message implementation guides for products such as the DCSA-aligned Track & Trace API (v1.2 and v2.2), Booking, Booking Confirmation (X12 301 / EDIFACT IFTMIN), and Shipping Instructions, alongside ANSI X12 and EDIFACT IFTMIN / IFTMBC / COPRAR reference documents. MSC also runs direct-integration partnerships with INTTRA, Infor Nexus, and CargoSmart. API and EDI access is not self-service: prospective integrators must submit a Direct Integration request, and fees may apply.
m.name: MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company

m.description: MSCHF Product Studio, Inc. (pronounced "mischief") is a Brooklyn, New York-based art collective and product studio founded in 2016 by Gabriel Whaley. It is known for viral, limited-edition "drops" released roughly every two weeks — from the Big Red Boots to Satan Shoes, The Persistence of Chaos, and Tax Heaven 3000 — and operates primarily through its own website and brand partnerships. In 2025 it launched Applied MSCHF, an advertising agency. MSCHF is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; this remains a company/identity profile.
m.name: Mschf Product Studio

m.description: MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community, publishing indexes, ESG and climate ratings, risk analytics, and real estate and private asset data. The MSCI Developer Community at developer.msci.com catalogs thirty-plus REST APIs spanning index performance and constituents, ESG data and reports, sustainability and climate on-demand data, risk and instrument analytics, portfolio optimization, real estate performance, and private capital metrics, alongside an official Python SDK and the MSCI Connector, a Model Context Protocol server listed in the Claude connector directory.
m.name: MSCI

m.description: MSG91 provides a comprehensive cloud communications platform offering SMS, voice, email, WhatsApp, RCS, and OTP services. It enables businesses to engage customers across multiple channels via robust APIs, supporting dynamic messaging, campaign automation, and contact management. With global reach and high volume handling, MSG91 serves over 30,000 businesses worldwide, delivering reliable, scalable communication solutions for enterprises of all sizes.
m.name: MSG91

m.description: mSpot was a mobile cloud-based content service provider founded in 2004 by Daren Tsui (CEO) and Ed Ho (CTO) and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company offered a cloud music locker that let users upload their music library and stream it from PCs, Macs, iPhone, iPad and Android devices, alongside a full-length movie rental service with content deals across Sony, Disney, Paramount, NBC/Universal, Lionsgate, Warner and others. mSpot raised roughly $2.3M in venture funding from Trinity Ventures and was acquired by Samsung Electronics in May 2012 (reported ~$8.8M) to power the Samsung Music Hub. The standalone mSpot product and brand were subsequently wound down and folded into Samsung; there is no active mSpot developer portal, API, or product surface today. This profile is retained as a historical network record.
m.name: mSpot

m.description: MTailor is a Y Combinator-backed custom-clothing company that measures your body with your phone's camera and manufactures made-to-order apparel on demand. Its mobile apps capture a short video or 360-degree turn and use machine-learning models to compute roughly 60 body measurements, which the company claims are about 20 percent more accurate than a professional tailor. MTailor produces custom shirts, polos, tees, pants, jeans, blazers and suits for men and jeans for women, each cut to the customer's unique measurement pattern. The business is a direct-to-consumer mobile app and e-commerce brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK. This APIs.json profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.
m.name: Mtailor

m.description: MTech Systems provides full supply chain data management with artificial intelligence and business intelligence functionality for poultry and animal protein producers, including the Amino, Sonar, Proline, and Axis products.
m.name: MTech Systems

m.description: mth Sense (Mth Sense Inc.), operating as RevSense, is a mobile ad-technology company founded in 2011 by Mandar Agte and Mohan Balachandran and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2012). It began as a mobile on-device profiling and ad-serving platform that inferred demographic and psychographic audience profiles from app-usage data, and has evolved into a programmatic yield and revenue-optimization platform for digital publishers. The RevSense product suite provides machine-learning yield optimization (real-time price floors, frequency caps, geo controls), automated header-bidding tag management, a unified reporting and data platform aggregating ad-server and demand-partner data, and one-click demand/buyer integration. mth Sense markets to publishers, agencies, SSPs, ad networks, and advertisers, and will build private exchanges with an RTB engine and common reporting dashboards. As of this profile the company publishes a static marketing website with no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.
m.name: mth Sense

m.description: MTN Group is Africa's largest mobile network operator, headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa, serving roughly 290 million subscribers across around 16 markets in Africa. Beyond mobile voice, data and enterprise connectivity it runs MoMo, one of the continent's largest mobile-money platforms. Unusually for a carrier, MTN publishes a genuinely open developer surface: the MTN Developer Platform (MADAPI) at developers.mtn.com lists 221 API products across 15 African markets and lets anyone download the OpenAPI/Swagger definition for a product without an account, and momodeveloper.mtn.com is a self-serve Azure API Management portal with a sandbox for the MoMo Collection, Disbursements and Remittance APIs. Its catalogue is heavily TM Forum Open API shaped (TMF620, TMF621, TMF622, TMF629, TMF632, TMF633, TMF635, TMF637, TMF639, TMF652, TMF654, TMF658, TMF666, TMF667, TMF676, TMF677, TMF678, TMF681, TMF683, TMF685, TMF688, TMF720). MTN South Africa is a GSMA Open Gateway participant — it announced Number Verification and SIM Swap with Cell C and Telkom in February 2024 — but nothing in its published catalogue is CAMARA-shaped: its SIM Swap and Device Swap APIs are MTN-proprietary designs secured with OAuth2 client-credentials rather than the CAMARA OIDC/CIBA profile, and no CAMARA API is callable from either portal. MTN is not an Aduna shareholder. Sandbox access is self-serve; production access is vetted and commercially negotiated.
m.name: MTN Group

m.description: MTN OPS is an American-owned outdoor performance nutrition and lifestyle brand founded in 2014 and headquartered in Fruit Heights, Utah. The company develops, manufactures, and sells energy and nutrition supplements (pre-workout, protein, hydration, creatine, and energy bars) alongside apparel and gear for hunters, tactical professionals, military, and outdoor athletes, running a "Conquer Hunger" program that donates one meal for every order placed. MTN OPS is a direct-to-consumer, internet-first retailer operating on the Shopify platform and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes no bespoke developer API; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify New Customer Accounts OIDC discovery documents and a Shopify-generated agent-commerce llms.txt. This profile was surfaced as a Norwest portfolio lead and enriched from the provider's live public surface.
m.name: MTN OPS

m.description: Mu Sigma is a decision sciences and AI services company founded in 2004, headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois with its principal delivery centre in Bangalore, India, working with 140+ Fortune 500 clients across retail, pharma, financial services, manufacturing, energy, technology and logistics. Its work is delivered as engagements and platforms rather than as a public developer product: the Art of Problem Solving System (muAoPS), the Akashic Architecture enterprise intelligence foundation, the muTalos agentic-AI ecosystem, Enablers of Confidence, and a Continuous Service-as-a-Software operating model. Mu Sigma publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract; its only public machine-readable engineering output is a set of open-source R packages for decision science (HVT, muHVT, analysisPipelines, RImpala, Rdrools) released to CRAN from the github.com/Mu-Sigma organization.
m.name: Mu Sigma

m.description: Mubert is a generative AI music platform that composes royalty-free, DMCA-free music in real time from millions of artist-contributed loops, samples, and stems. The B2B Mubert AI Music API (v3) powers track generation, continuous HTTP / WebRTC streaming, browse access to a pre-generated music library, and service-tier customer + license + Stripe subscription administration. Mubert is used by apps, games, video tools, health and fitness products, and AI-content pipelines (including integrations with Picsart, Canva, and Restream) to embed adaptive generative music inside their experiences.
m.name: Mubert

m.description: MUBI is a London-headquartered global streaming service, film distributor and production company founded in 2007 by Efe Cakarel (originally as The Auteurs, rebranded MUBI in 2010). It operates a curated subscription video-on-demand service for arthouse, independent, documentary and world cinema across more than 190 countries, alongside MUBI GO (weekly cinema tickets), the Notebook film-criticism publication and print magazine, MUBI Editions, a merchandise shop, and theatrical distribution and sales arms including The Match Factory and Cineart. MUBI publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification; the api.mubi.com host serves its own first-party web, mobile and TV clients only.
m.name: MUBI

m.description: Mubit is a temporary storage and logistics service based in Guadalajara, Mexico, offering on-demand collection, climate-controlled warehousing, digital photo inventory, and delivery for both individuals and businesses. Customers pay only for the space they use, with free pickup and drop-off, optional professional packing, and 24/7 CCTV-monitored facilities across three warehouses (Colli, Tijera, and Casuarina). Backed by 500 Global and Techstars, the company reports 4,000+ customers and a 4.9-star Google rating, and operates a mobile/web customer portal at clientes.mubit.co for scheduling pickups and deliveries and viewing stored items. Mubit publishes no public developer API.
m.name: Mubit

m.description: Much Better Adventures is a B Corp certified adventure travel company that runs 250+ solo-friendly, expert-led outdoor group trips across the world's trails, rivers, coasts and mountains, matching travellers with certified local guides and hosts. It is a consumer-facing booking platform with financial protection via ABTOT/ABTA/ATOL and contributes 5% of every booking to its foundation for conservation. Surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.
m.name: Much Better Adventures

m.description: Mucho (Mucho Indonesia) was an Indonesian social-commerce startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in South Jakarta, positioned as Indonesia's first social online shopping application and often described as an aspiring "Pinduoduo for Indonesia." Its mobile app let users buy together with friends to unlock group-buying discounts, cutting distribution layers by working directly with brand owners and pairing frictionless payment with logistics support. The company raised early / seed funding with participation from Qiming Venture Partners. Mucho has since shut down; its app is no longer distributed and the mucho.asia domain now resolves to a parked placeholder page with no product, API, or developer surface. This profile is retained as a defunct-company record surfaced through the Qiming portfolio graph.
m.name: mucho

m.description: Muck Rack is a public relations and earned-media software platform that combines a journalist and media-outlet database, media monitoring across news, print, broadcast, social and generative AI engines, pitching and press-release distribution, and executive-ready earned-media reporting. The Muck Rack API is a paid add-on for Premier-tier customers that provides programmatic access to the article data behind a Saved Search, so communications teams can pipe earned coverage into internal systems such as Snowflake or business-intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau. API keys are issued by an account Admin under Organization Settings, and the API reference itself is published only to authenticated customers.
m.name: Muck Rack

m.description: MUD\WTR is a certified-organic coffee alternative built on adaptogenic mushrooms and botanicals, sold direct-to-consumer from mudwtr.com. It publishes no traditional developer program, but its Shopify-hosted storefront exposes a substantial, entirely anonymous machine surface on its own domain: an agents.md/llms.txt agent contract, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, two live Model Context Protocol servers (a 13-tool UCP commerce server and a 5-tool Storefront MCP server), an anonymously introspectable Storefront GraphQL API, and the storefront JSON endpoints for products, collections and cart.
m.name: Mud\Wtr

m.description: Mudflap is a fintech company operating a diesel fuel-discount network for truckers, owner-operators, and fleets. Its mobile app delivers instant cost-plus diesel discounts (up to $1.00/gallon) at 3,600+ truck stops using a driver's existing debit or credit card, and its Mudflap Fuel Card extends fleet credit terms, driver spend controls, and fraud protection across 70,000+ fuel stops nationwide, managed through a fleet dashboard. Mudflap reports $1B+ saved by 515,000+ active drivers and is recommended by 94% of owner-operators and fleets. It also runs a truck-stop merchant program and a Geotab telematics integration. Mudflap is backed by Matrix Partners. The company exposes an OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authorization server at api.mudflapinc.com for its partner, fleet, and merchant surfaces; no public developer OpenAPI is published.
m.name: Mudflap

m.description: Mudrex is a US-headquartered, Bengaluru-based crypto investment and trading platform founded in 2018 and registered with India's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND). It serves retail and pro traders with spot trading, curated Coin Sets, and USDT- and INR-margined perpetual futures. Its developer surface is the Mudrex Futures API — a REST trading API under https://trade.mudrex.com/fapi/v1 covering wallet transfers, asset discovery, leverage and margin type, order create/amend/cancel, position management with stop-loss/take-profit, liquidation pricing and fee history — plus a public, unauthenticated market-data surface (historical price and mark-price klines over REST, live kline/mark-kline/ticker streams over WebSocket) and an officially hosted MCP server at https://mudrex.com/mcp that exposes 20 trading tools to AI agents. Authentication is a single X-Authentication API-key header issued after KYC and TOTP two-factor enrollment. An official Python SDK ships on PyPI as mudrex-sdk.
m.name: Mudrex

m.description: Mueller Industries is a leading manufacturer of copper, brass, aluminum, and plastic products serving the plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, industrial, automotive, and other markets.
m.name: Mueller Industries

m.description: muffintech is a Berlin-based InsurTech building generative AI purpose-trained for the insurance industry. Its conversational assistant, muffinGPT, is pre-trained on 30,000+ insurance conversations and passed the German 34D broker certification exam, supporting insurers, brokers, and broker pools across sales enablement, lead generation and direct sales, and after-sales service (contract inquiries, claims reporting, cross-selling). The platform is modular and customizable, with a privacy-first architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure in Frankfurt, Germany, and is ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant. muffintech raised EUR 3.5M in 2025 to scale its AI-driven insurance solutions. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; muffintech does not currently publish a public developer API surface (no docs, OpenAPI, or SDKs found as of this enrichment pass).
m.name: muffintech

m.description: Muir Test Systems is a company in the Battery Ventures portfolio, operating in the test-and-measurement space. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 searched the web, npm/PyPI/Maven/other package registries, and probed for a developer/API surface and found no publicly discoverable developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or hosted MCP server. No production website domain for the company resolved during probing, so domain, well-known, and security probes could not be run. This profile remains a company-only lead with no API artifacts.
m.name: Muir Test Systems

m.description: MUJ428 LLC operates the MUJ428 Trust Layer ("VERIFY BEFORE ACT"), a machine-native trust preflight service for autonomous agents: an agent POSTs the consequential action it is about to take (PAY, BUY, DELEGATE, TRUST, ACCEPT, APPROVE, WRITE, RELEASE, COMMIT, PROPOSE) and receives an ALLOW / VERIFY / REQUIRE_VERIFICATION / DENY decision plus a portable Trust Receipt v1.3, while the caller keeps execution authority and MUJ428 never moves funds. The first 1,000 qualifying decisions per caller_ref are free with no account, key or wallet; paid continuation and the evidence-signal, reputation-check, milestone-attestation, trust-report and transaction-assurance services are settled in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) through x402. The same surface is published as a 24-operation OpenAPI 3.1 REST facade hosted on Supabase edge functions, a remote Streamable-HTTP MCP server listed in the official MCP registry, an A2A agent card with a Trust Reflex extension, an RFC 9727 api-catalog, an llms.txt, AGENTS.md and a tarball-distributed JavaScript client, all discoverable from agents.muj428.com.
m.name: MUJ428

m.description: Mujer Financiera is a Latin American financial-education platform founded in 2018 in Buenos Aires, Argentina by Sabrina Castelli, focused on closing the gender gap in financial inclusion. It delivers courses, packs, and multi-month programs (MF Platinum) on budgeting, saving, and investing, alongside a mobile app for tracking personal finances, a supportive community, a newsletter, and corporate financial-education services for companies. The platform reports hundreds of thousands of women served across 12+ countries and is backed by 500 Global. It is a business-to-consumer fintech/edtech offering and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.
m.name: Mujer Financiera

m.description: Mukuru is a Cape Town-headquartered, pan-African fintech and one of the continent's largest formal remittance providers, serving over 16 million customers across Southern, Eastern and Western Africa, the United Kingdom, and the European Union. Founded in 2004 to make sending money home faster and more affordable for the African diaspora, Mukuru now operates a broader financial services platform spanning international and domestic money transfers, the Mukuru Card (a prepaid card product), Mukuru Wallet (a mobile money wallet available in markets such as Botswana for airtime, electricity, and bill payments), Mukuru Pay (cash-based online checkout at retail partners), and Mukuru Funeral Cover (life insurance with cross-border repatriation benefits underwritten by Guardrisk Life). The company is licensed as a South African Financial Services Provider (FSP 45517) and registered Credit Provider (NCRCP9244), and reaches customers through a hybrid network of branches, retail booths, USSD, WhatsApp, web, and native Android, iOS, and Huawei AppGallery apps, supported by more than 320,000 pay-in and pay-out locations. An enterprise arm — branded under the Mukuru Enterprise / MukuruPay umbrella — offers collections and disbursements rails to businesses sending funds into or paying out across Africa. Mukuru does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client; its Mukuru GitHub organization contains only archived forks of upstream infrastructure tooling (Drone, Helm, Puppet, PHP Docker images) and no Mukuru-authored libraries. Integrations with the Mukuru Enterprise platform are arranged through direct commercial engagement rather than a self-service developer program.
m.name: Mukuru

m.description: MuleSoft Anypoint Platform is an enterprise integration and API management platform offering an API gateway, design center, exchange marketplace, and monitoring for hybrid deployments connecting applications and data.
m.name: MuleSoft

m.description: Multi (originally launched as Remotion in 2019) was a macOS-native multiplayer collaboration application for software teams, offering multi-person screensharing for up to ten participants, shared cursor and keyboard control with sub-100ms latency, session recording, and AI-generated summaries and action items. Backed by Greylock and First Round Capital, the company was acqui-hired by OpenAI in June 2024; the product was shut down and user data deleted, with the founding team joining OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop group. The multi.app site remains live as a static marketing page but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.
m.name: Multi

m.description: A software architecture pattern that separates an application into logical layers or tiers, typically presentation, business logic, and data access layers, to improve modularity, scalability, and maintainability.
m.name: Multi-Tier Architecture

m.description: Multicoin Capital is a thesis-driven crypto investment firm founded in 2017 by Kyle Samani and Tushar Jain, investing in cryptocurrencies, tokens, and blockchain companies and protocols believed to be reshaping trillion-dollar markets. The firm runs a hybrid structure of a hedge fund (its multi-billion dollar Master Fund, investing in public markets, direct positions, and strategic sales) alongside several venture funds that back early-stage companies, with venture checks ranging from roughly $1M to $50M. Its Venture Fund III closed at $422 million in January 2022. Multicoin invests across open and decentralized finance (DeFi), blockchain infrastructure and Layer 1/Layer 2 protocols, decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN), stablecoins and payments, real-world asset tokenization, wallets, identity, gaming, and crypto-native consumer applications, with a well-known concentration around the Solana ecosystem. The firm's phoenix logo symbolizes a new financial system rising from the ashes of the old one, reflecting its long-term, high-conviction approach to absolute returns across market cycles. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Multicoin manages capital on behalf of family offices, foundations, endowments, and institutional investors. In February 2026 co-founder Kyle Samani stepped back from day-to-day management, with operations continuing under co-founder Tushar Jain and partner Brian Smith.
m.name: Multicoin Capital

m.description: MultiLynq is a fixed income trading technology company founded in 2018 by Patrick Scheideler and Scott Collins and based in Shrewsbury, New Jersey. It sells market integration as a service: a single high-performance API that normalizes the messaging and trading protocols of every major and emerging electronic U.S. fixed income trading venue — including MarketAxess, Tradeweb, Trumid, Bloomberg, ICE Bonds, LTX by Broadridge, Liquidnet, Octaura, TMC Bonds and Bonds.com — into one interface for credit, municipal bond and loan trading. The platform covers pre- and post-trade workflows including price dissemination, market data aggregation, RFQ negotiation, portfolio trading, auction mechanisms, quoting conventions, smart order routing, and post-trade reporting and reconciliation, delivered as a fully hosted solution in which clients establish a single physical connection to a MultiLynq data center while MultiLynq maintains all upstream venue connectivity. The company has raised funding from Citadel Securities and Jane Street. The API is the entire product, but it is sold and onboarded through a sales conversation: MultiLynq publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification, SDK or pricing.
m.name: MultiLynq

m.description: MultiOn is a technology company focused on providing advanced AI-driven automation solutions for enterprise workflows. It offers a platform that integrates private action AI agents into phone and device interfaces, enabling hands-free task execution, intelligent assistance, and customizable automation. The company emphasizes privacy, security, and high task success rates, targeting businesses seeking to streamline operations through AI-powered agents.
m.name: MultiOn

m.description: Multipli is a decentralized yield-infrastructure protocol that lets users and institutions generate returns on tokenized real-world assets — gold, stocks, commodities and stablecoins — without selling their holdings. Its native rwaUSD token consolidates 100+ Treasury-backed stablecoins and 10+ tokenized gold assets into a single, standardized collateral primitive that can move freely across DeFi, earning yield through delta-neutral arbitrage (contango and funding-rate) strategies. Integration is smart-contract-based across multiple EVM chains via a suite of on-chain view functions (Ledger, RiskRegistry, PriceRouter); there is no public REST API, SDK or OpenAPI. Multipli is backed by Pantera Capital.
m.name: Multipli

m.description: Multiplier (usemultiplier.com) is a global employment platform offering Employer of Record (EOR), Contractor management, and Global Payroll across 150+ countries. Its API surface is integration-oriented - token-authenticated connections used to sync members (employees and contractors), employment contracts, payroll, payments, time off, and invoices between Multiplier and external HRIS systems such as Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, and Personio. Multiplier does not publish an open, self-serve public REST/GraphQL API reference; API access is provisioned per account via Service User tokens. Not to be confused with unrelated companies named "Multiplier".
m.name: Multiplier

m.description: Multiply is an AI-native media agency built specifically for B2B companies, pairing human paid-media strategists with a fleet of 25+ specialized AI agents to run and continuously optimize LinkedIn and Google Search advertising. Its "Self-Learning Advertising" platform plugs into a company's own data — sales call recordings (e.g. Gong), CRM closed-won outcomes, case studies, website content, competitive kill sheets and product documentation — and runs hundreds of structured ad experiments that refine audiences, copy and creative from real revenue signals. Multiply is a managed service (not a self-serve API product), founded by Matt Jayson (ex-Google, ex-Brex) and Ashish Warty (ex-HackerOne SVP Engineering, ex-Dropbox), and raised $9.5M led by Mayfield in March 2026. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Mayfield portfolio company; two enrichment passes confirmed it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. It does publish an llms.txt and three named service tiers — Growth (from $6K/mo), Scale (from $12K/mo) and Enterprise — priced against monthly ad spend rather than API usage.
m.name: Multiply

m.description: Multiverse is a British education-technology company (founded 2016 by Euan Blair and Sophie Adelman, headquartered in London) that operates an AI-adoption and workforce-upskilling platform. It delivers apprenticeships and training programmes in AI, data, software engineering, and digital skills, pairing on-the-job learning with expert coaching so employers can close skills gaps and build future-ready teams. Backed by investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and StepStone Group, Multiverse serves enterprise clients across the UK and US. The company exposes no public developer API; its digital surface is a marketing site, a learner/employer login, a help centre, a community hub, a blog, a service status page, and a trust centre.
m.name: Multiverse

m.description: Multiverse Computing, S.L. is a Donostia-San Sebastian (Spain) quantum- and AI-software company whose commercial developer surface is the CompactifAI API — an OpenAI-compatible LLM inference service serving tensor-network-compressed versions of frontier open models (Hypernova 60B, Carina 60B, Mistral Small 3.1 Slim, Whisper Large V3 Turbo Slim) alongside uncompressed third-party models (GPT-OSS 120B, GLM 5.1/5.2, Quasar 438B, Qwen 3.6 27B, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni). The API is published at api.compactif.ai with regional EU and US endpoints, documented at docs.compactif.ai, billed pay-as-you-go per million tokens, and also sold through the AWS Marketplace. The company additionally sells Singularity, a quantum and quantum-inspired optimization product for finance, energy and manufacturing, which has no public developer documentation.
m.name: Multiverse Computing

m.description: Multus CNI is a container network interface plugin for Kubernetes that enables attaching multiple network interfaces to pods. It acts as a meta-plugin that can call multiple other CNI plugins, allowing pods to have connectivity to multiple networks simultaneously.
m.name: Multus CNI

m.description: Mundi is a digital cross-border trade finance platform for exporters, primarily connecting Mexican exporters with US importers. It provides non-recourse international factoring (invoice advances up to $10M USD / $200M MXN with rates from 0.9% per month), foreign-exchange spot and hedging across 100+ currencies, purchase-order and revolving-line financing, multi-currency virtual US accounts and international payments/collections, and digital cargo insurance. Backed by Speedinvest and Union Square Ventures, Mundi operates a customer web application but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.
m.name: Mundi

m.description: Muni was a Latin American social-commerce and community group-buying platform founded in 2019 in Bogota, Colombia by Maria Echeverri Gomez, aiming to transform e-commerce across LATAM by letting community leaders aggregate neighborhood demand and buy everyday grocery and household items at prices up to 40 percent below competitors, with no added shipping or service fees. It raised a Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2021 and at its peak served over 15,000 communities across Colombia, Brazil, and Mexico. As of this enrichment pass the company's primary domain (munitienda.com) resolves to a parked GoDaddy lander with no active product, developer portal, or public API surface, so the profile remains a consumer-app portfolio lead with no discoverable API.
m.name: Muni

m.description: Muon Space is a Mountain View, California-based end-to-end space systems company that designs, builds, and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations to deliver Earth Intelligence and enable real-time compute and decision-making in space. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Skybox, NASA, and SpaceX, the company's core product is Muon Halo, an integrated technology stack composed of MuSim (constellation simulation and digital twin), MuOS (IP-based software-defined network middleware connecting space, ground, and cloud), MuCore (software-configurable instrument core), Condor (modular Condor-M and Condor-XL spacecraft platforms), and MuDash (cloud-based tasking, scheduling, and operations dashboard). Muon Space's flagship public mission is FireSat, a purpose-built wildfire detection and monitoring constellation developed with the Earth Fire Alliance, Google Research, and the Gordon & Betty Moore Foundation; FireSat carries a high-dynamic-range multispectral IR instrument capable of detecting 5x5 meter fires across a 1,500 km swath with a 50 m nadir ground sample distance, with revisit times targeted to twenty minutes once the full constellation is operational. The Protoflight satellite produced its first-light imagery in June 2025, with the first block of three additional satellites launching in 2026 and full operational capacity targeted for 2030. Other Muon Space missions support the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Space Force for next-generation weather monitoring, Hydrosat for thermal geospatial intelligence in climate and agriculture, and global security applications including missile-defense architecture. Muon Space's revenue model is mission contracting, spacecraft and constellation delivery, and hosted data services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of the Halo platform or FireSat data feed.
m.name: Muon Space

m.description: Mural is a visual collaboration platform. It exposes both a Mural API and a Mural Enterprise API with OAuth 2.0 authentication, scope-based permissions, rate limiting, pagination, and a published OpenAPI specification. Postman workspace and Zapier integration are also available.
m.name: Mural

m.description: Mural Health is a clinical research technology company whose Mural Link platform manages the clinical trial participant experience end to end.
