PickTrace exposes a RESTful API that lets customers and third-party developers create, update, and extract objects from all PickTrace tools and bi-directionally sync labor data into and out of the platform for automation, payroll efficiency, and audit-ready compliance.
p.name: PickTrace

p.description: PiCloud was a cloud-computing startup founded in 2009 that offered a pay-as-you-go, serverless platform for running Python workloads across public (AWS) and private clouds without provisioning, configuring, or managing virtual servers — popular for batch processing, high-performance computing, and scientific computing. It raised a seed round from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Kleiner Perkins, Plug and Play, and Greylock. The team was acquired by Dropbox in November 2013 and the PiCloud service was shut down on February 25, 2014 (its platform lived on briefly as the open-source Multyvac project). The picloud.com domain is now parked, and there is no live API, developer portal, or documentation to enrich.
p.name: PiCloud

p.description: Picnic is a London-based, privacy-first photo-organization app for iOS that helps people declutter and organize their camera roll through a swipe-based, gamified experience — sorting photos into albums, comparing and removing duplicate shots, building streaks, and resurfacing "on this day" memories. All processing happens on-device, so photos never leave the user's phone: no cloud upload, no ads, and no tracking or selling of user data. Founded in 2019 and a certified B Corporation, Picnic grew to more than 1.5 million users and roughly €4M ARR before being acquired by Paris-based mobile app publisher MWM in April 2026. Picnic is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.
p.name: Picnic

p.description: PicnicHealth (PicnicAI; legally Mission Health Labs, Inc.) is a San Francisco health-data company and Y Combinator alum (S14, founded 2014) that turns patients' fragmented medical records into structured, research-ready real-world datasets. Its consumer product gives patients a unified timeline of care across every provider, while PicnicResearch supplies de-identified, ontology-mapped (RxNorm, SNOMED, LOINC, ICD) real-world data to biopharma via AI extraction plus human clinical curation. The primary developer surface is a first-party R package distributed through PicnicHealth's own Posit/RStudio Package Manager for importing and visualizing research cohorts.
p.name: Picnicai

p.description: PicnicHealth is a patient-first digital health platform, founded in 2014, that gathers a person's complete medical history from every point of care into one organized timeline, layers on an AI health assistant (PicnicAI) and a virtual clinical team to help members understand and act on their care, and — with patient consent — turns de-identified records into OMOP-compliant real-world data for life-science and HEOR research. Records are encrypted, patient-owned, and never shared without permission. PicnicHealth does not publish a public REST/OpenAPI developer API; its programmatic surface is a first-party R package that analyzes delivered research datasets mapped to RxNorm/SNOMED/LOINC. Backed by Amplify Partners, Felicis, Lux Capital, and Slow Ventures.
p.name: PicnicHealth

p.description: Pico was a creator-monetization and CRM platform for online creators, publishers, and media companies, built in New York and backed by Bloomberg Beta. It combined an audience CRM with email capture, landing pages, paywalls, memberships, and subscription payments in a single tool so creators could identify their audience, gate premium content, and convert readers into paying members. Pico raised a $6.5M round in 2021 ("Pico 2.0") and a $10M Series A in 2023, when it rebranded to Hype (hype.co) and refocused on link-in-bio, lead generation, and growth tools for creators, gyms, coaches, and athletes. In February 2026 Hype was acquired by MMA.inc and the product was wound down. The developer API — authenticated with an X-Api-Key header and documented at docs.trypico.com — is retired: the API host api.trypico.com no longer resolves, the reference bucket has been deleted, and hype.co now serves only an acquisition notice directing users to support@hype.co.
p.name: Pico

p.description: Pico (pico.net) is a trading-infrastructure and financial market data company - not the creator-CRM company of the same name - providing global exchange connectivity, colocation and managed infrastructure in 55+ data centers, Redline trading software (InRush ticker plant feed handlers and Execution Gateway, acquired 2021), RedlineFeed normalized market data from 230+ venues, and Corvil network and trading analytics (acquired 2019). Market data is delivered to entitled customers via multicast feeds and an embedded InRush software API rather than public HTTP endpoints, and Corvil exposes analytics via a REST API, SDK, and streaming to Kafka, Splunk, and Elastic. Privately held; everything is sales-gated - there is no public developer portal, no self-serve signup, and no public API reference, with product documentation and the Corvil API docs behind the login-gated customer portal at portal.pico.net.
p.name: Pico

p.description: Picogrid is an El Segundo, California defense and public-safety technology company whose Legion platform is an API-first systems-integration layer that unifies fragmented sensors, unmanned systems, and mission assets across land, sea, air, and space into a single decision-ready picture. The Legion Platform API (v3, OpenAPI 3.1, OAuth 2.0 via Keycloak) lets operators and AI agents not only observe but command physical systems: registering entities, streaming and searching feed data, dispatching tasking commands over MQTT, managing tracks, video streams and WebRTC, fine-grained authorization, event subscriptions and notifications, and cross-Legion federation. Applications include base security, satellite operations, air defense, SIGINT interoperability, wildfire detection, and human-machine teaming. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Initialized Capital.
p.name: Picogrid

p.description: PicoJool is an optical connectivity company building Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers (VCSELs) and optical engines for AI and cloud data-center infrastructure. Its 50G NRZ, 100G PAM4, and 200G PAM4 VCSEL arrays target 800G and 1.6T transceivers for PCIe, Ethernet, and InfiniBand, aiming to raise bandwidth density and cut the power cost of moving data across hyperscale AI clusters. Founded in 2024 and based in Palo Alto, California, PicoJool emerged from stealth in November 2025 with $12M led by Playground Global. It is a semiconductor/photonics hardware company with no public API or developer platform; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market tracking.
p.name: PicoJool

p.description: Picomes provides a modular Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform that digitizes work instructions, connects IoT tools, and error‑proofs assembly lines for mid‑sized manufacturers. Their cloud‑based solution enables real‑time monitoring, data collection, and continuous improvement, helping factories reduce errors, increase efficiency, and achieve higher quality production outcomes.
p.name: Picomes

p.description: PicPay is a Brazilian fintech super-app and digital bank serving over 67 million users with a digital wallet, payment account, credit and debit cards, personal loans, investments (Cofrinho / fixed income), insurance, and PIX-based money movement. Founded in 2012 and acquired by J&F Investimentos (the holding company behind JBS) in 2015, PicPay is controlled today by J&F Participações and in 2024 incorporated the retail customer base of Banco Original to consolidate the group's consumer banking strategy. For developers and merchants, PicPay Business exposes a set of REST APIs that let online stores accept the PicPay wallet, credit/debit cards, PIX, and payment links as payment methods. The historical Ecommerce Public API on appws.picpay.com is authenticated with the x-picpay-token / x-seller-token headers and remains in use for direct wallet checkout. A newer unified business developer portal at developers-business.picpay.com publishes the Gateway PicPay Checkout API, Carteira PicPay Wallet API, PIX API, and Payment Link API, all of which now use OAuth 2.0 client_credentials bearer JWTs minted at api.picpay.com/oauth2/token (5-minute TTL) and webhook callbacks for payment status notifications. PicPay also publishes GitHub repos for Magento, Shopify, and Wake ecommerce integrations, plus its open developer documentation for the wallet and PIX APIs under picpay.github.io. PicPay reported a return to profitability in 2023 and is reportedly working with Citigroup on a U.S. IPO.
p.name: PicPay

p.description: PicPurify provides image and video moderation services including gun and knife weapon detection, nudity, drug, gore, hate sign, age, gender, and other content moderation tasks. Pictures showing someone posing with a firearm or holding a knife can offend visitors, shock young minds and displease advertisers - PicPurify detects these images so they can be filtered before publication.
p.name: PicPurify

p.description: Picsart is a creative-technology company whose Picsart Enterprise / Creative APIs let developers add photo editing, video editing, and generative AI to their own products. The platform spans Programmable Image APIs (remove background, upscale, ultra enhance, face enhance, effects, adjust, blend, vectorize), Programmable Video APIs (FPS upscale, remove background, effects, trim, crop, concat, transcribe), GenAI APIs (text2image, text2sticker, logo, inpaint, outpaint, expand, text2video, image2video, text2speech, text2sound) via an AI Hub of 140+ models across 28 providers, and Variable Data Content APIs. All APIs are REST, authenticated with an X-Picsart-API-Key header, and are also reachable through first-party TypeScript/Python/Java SDKs, a gen-ai CLI, and an official hosted MCP server. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched into the API Evangelist network.
p.name: Picsart

p.description: Picsart (Socialin Inc.) is a digital creation and photo/video editing company whose Picsart Enterprise "Creative APIs" give developers programmable access to image editing, video editing, generative AI, and variable-data content generation. The REST APIs cover remove-background, upscaling, enhancement, effects, masking, watermarking, and vectorization for images; trimming, cropping, concatenation, transcription, and CTV encoding for video; text-to-image, text-to-sticker, logo generation, inpainting/outpainting, and text-to-video for GenAI; plus a variable-data content export pipeline. All services authenticate with an X-Picsart-API-Key header, are described with OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, ship official TypeScript, Java, and Python SDKs, a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, a Postman workspace, and an embeddable Photo and Video Editor SDK.
p.name: PicsArt (Socialin)

p.description: PICT was a San Francisco startup (founded 2012 by Brent Locks, Kele Dobrinski, and Gregory Nicholas) that built a platform to make images shoppable, letting publishers tag and monetize products within photos. It raised a $1.4M seed round in 2013 backed by 500 Global, Opus Capital, Lowercase Capital, and Forerunner Ventures, and was acquired by PopSugar in January 2014. The pict.com domain no longer resolves and the company exposes no public API surface.
p.name: PICT

p.description: Pictomancer.ai is a Spain-registered image-optimization API built for agents: resize, compress, convert, crop, optimize-for-vision and one-call optimization of AI-generated images, processed in under 50 ms and priced per request ($0.001-$0.03, analyze free). The same ten operations are published three ways — an OpenAPI 3.1 REST API, a hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP, listed in the official MCP Registry) and an A2A agent card — and are paid for anonymously with USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 -> pay -> retry), with an API key, or free for the first 50 requests per identity. Results return inline, PUT to the caller's own bucket, or POST to a callback endpoint. First-party SDKs ship for Python, Node, PHP and Go plus an n8n node and a WordPress plugin.
p.name: Pictomancer.ai

p.description: Pictor Labs develops AI-powered virtual staining technology for histopathology and digital pathology laboratories. Its platform generates diagnostic-quality tissue stains computationally in minutes rather than the hours or days required by traditional chemical staining, preserving precious tissue samples for additional downstream testing. Products include ClearStain for direct virtual H&E sequencing and DeepStain and ReStain for flexible, repeatable multi-stain tissue analysis. The technology integrates with existing whole-slide scanner platforms (partners include Hamamatsu and Proscia) and offers cloud or on-premise deployment. Virtual stains are currently labeled For Research Use Only. Pictor Labs is a venture-backed company in the Insight Partners portfolio. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.
p.name: PictorLabs.ai

p.description: PictureTel is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
p.name: PictureTel

p.description: PictureWorks (PictureWorks Technology) was a digital imaging technology company based in Danville, California that built imaging tools and services for the real estate and e-commerce industries, enabling online visual presentation of products and properties. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. The company was acquired by Internet Pictures Corporation (IPIX) in 2000. No public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or SDK surface could be located for this entity during enrichment; the active pictureworks.com (Pictureworks Group, Singapore theme-park imaging) is a separate, unrelated company and is not linked here to avoid mis-attribution.
p.name: PictureWorks

p.description: Picus Security is a cybersecurity company that pioneered Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS) in 2013 and now ships the Picus Security Validation Platform for Adversarial Exposure Validation (AEV) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The platform continuously simulates real-world adversary techniques against network, endpoint, email and cloud controls, scores prevention and detection effectiveness, maps results to MITRE ATT&CK and the Unified Kill Chain, and returns vendor-specific mitigation signatures and validated detection rules from the Picus Mitigation Library. The Picus Customer API is a public REST API documented at apidocs.picussecurity.com and served from api.picussecurity.com, exposing simulations, simulation run results, the threat library, threat templates, agents, integrations, mitigation and detection content, exposure instance scores, users and roles, and activity logs, authorized with OAuth2-issued refresh and access tokens.
p.name: Picus Security

p.description: Pie Insurance is a Washington, DC and Denver-based insurtech founded in May 2017 that makes commercial insurance for small businesses, with workers' compensation as its flagship line. Pie underwrites its own workers' comp through The Pie Insurance Company (NAIC 21857) — the carrier formerly known as Pie Casualty Insurance Company, which Pie acquired as Western Select Insurance Company in 2021 and took full-stack in February 2023 with an A- (Excellent) rating from AM Best. In addition to workers' comp, Pie offers business owners policy (BOP), commercial auto, general liability, professional liability, and errors and omissions through partner carriers. The product is sold both direct-to-business and through a partner network of 4,000+ independent insurance agencies, who quote, bind, and service policies via the Pie agency portal and the Pie Partner API. The Partner API (api.post-prod.pieinsurance.com, REST/JSON, documented with OpenAPI 3.0.4) exposes class-code search, eligibility questions, appetite checks, price indications, full bindable quotes, quote documents, and quote PDF retrieval so agency management systems and partner platforms can embed the Pie workers' comp experience without redirecting users off-platform. Coverage is available in 39 states plus DC; 73% of submissions are auto-decided and average quote time is roughly three minutes. The company has raised approximately $621M across Seed through Series D from investors including Allianz X, SVB Capital, Greycroft, Aspect Ventures, and Elefund. CEO and co-founder is John Swigart. The Pie Partner API is the public developer surface; there is no broader open-source SDK or GitHub organization.
p.name: Pie Insurance

p.description: Pieces is an on-device AI developer assistant and long-term memory tool. Pieces OS runs locally on the developer's machine and exposes a documented local REST API at http://localhost:1000 covering saved snippets (assets), the Pieces Copilot (QGPT) question/stream endpoints, local and cloud models, formats, applications, conversations, and workspace context. The same on-device API powers official OpenAPI-generated SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Dart, Kotlin, and C#.
p.name: Pieces

p.description: Pienso is an interactive no-code AI and machine learning platform, founded in 2016 out of MIT by Karthik Dinakar and Birago Jones and headquartered in the Washington, DC / Arlington, VA area. It lets subject-matter experts explore, train, fingerprint, annotate, and deploy deep-learning and large language models over unstructured text — customer calls, emails, documents, and social content — through a point-and-click interface with no coding required. Product capabilities include Ingest, Train & Fingerprint, Annotate, Dataset Analysis, and PromptFactory, applied to use cases such as customer insight, content moderation, document intelligence, and risk detection. Pienso is deployed into the customer's own environment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Gcore, or on-premises — so data never leaves the customer's control, and the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; integration is sales-led and the platform runs as a self-contained system. Backed by Uncork Capital.
p.name: Pienso

p.description: Pienza is a Seattle-based B2B software startup studio and early-stage venture fund founded in 2020 by Aaron Bird (founder of Bizible, later sold to Marketo). Pienza partners with entrepreneurs to ideate, fund, and build category-defining SaaS companies, and later operated a Pienza Ventures accelerator focused on helping Indian SaaS and AI startups scale into the U.S. market. It raised $5.1M from MHS Capital, Version One Ventures, and Vulcan Capital plus angel investors. Pienza is a company-building and investment firm rather than an API provider; enrichment found no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal, and the primary pienza.com domain no longer serves an active site.
p.name: Pienza

p.description: PierSight Space is an India-based space technology company building a constellation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Automatic Identification System (AIS) satellites for persistent, all-weather maritime surveillance of the world's oceans. Founded by former ISRO engineer Gaurav Seth, PierSight delivers near-real-time ocean monitoring (targeting ~30-minute data latency and 100% ocean coverage) to detect illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing, monitor oil spills, protect Exclusive Economic Zones, support maritime insurance risk assessment, and improve shipping operations. The company has raised roughly $8M from investors including Alpha Wave Ventures, Elevation Capital, and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass PierSight sells data solutions to enterprise and government clients and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.
p.name: PierSight Space

p.description: Piestro was a Los Angeles-area food-robotics company that built a fully enclosed, automated pizza-making vending machine — an unattended kiosk that pressed, sauced, topped, baked, cut and boxed an artisanal pizza in roughly three minutes, sold both as direct-to-consumer placements and as a white-label unit for existing pizza brands. Founded by Massimo Noja De Marco and incubated by Wavemaker Labs (since rebranded Vebu Labs), it raised roughly $11.7M from equity-crowdfunding investors, largely via StartEngine, and piloted units with partners including Capriotti's and 800 Degrees Go. Piestro shut down in January 2025 without shipping a production unit. It is a hardware and food-service company, not a software vendor: it never ran a developer program, and no public API, SDK, webhook, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind was ever published. This profile records that absence rather than inventing a surface.
p.name: Piestro

p.description: Pietra is an AI-powered commerce platform for fast-growing consumer brands and creators. It unifies sourcing, production, fulfillment, logistics, marketing, and operations in a single platform — giving brands access to a network of 40,000+ global suppliers and factories, integrated third-party (3PL) fulfillment infrastructure, AI assistants that automate content creation and affiliate/influencer campaigns, competitive intelligence and social listening, and e-commerce software to run a direct-to-consumer business. Founded in 2019 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile, Pietra does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.
p.name: Pietra

p.description: Pig Latin is a language game in which English words are altered according to a simple set of rules (typically moving the first consonant cluster to the end of the word and appending "ay"). This repository indexes Pig Latin as a topic; no authoritative public REST API or OpenAPI specification has been identified, so no machine-readable contract is published here.
p.name: Pig Latin

p.description: Pigeonly is an inmate-communication service that helps families and friends stay connected with incarcerated loved ones across more than 4,000 correctional facilities in the United States. Through its website and mobile apps, users can send photos, letters, postcards, greeting cards, and printed articles, and set up more affordable prison phone calls, all in a few clicks. Backed by 500 Global, Pigeonly is a consumer-facing platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, developer documentation, OAuth surface, or machine-readable specifications, so this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.
p.name: Pigeonly

p.description: PiggyVest is a Lagos-based Nigerian fintech (operated by Piggytech Global Limited, RC 1405222) running the country's largest online savings and investment platform, with 6M+ registered users as of 2026. Founded in January 2016 by Somto Ifezue, Odunayo Eweniyi, and Joshua Chibueze as Piggybank.ng and rebranded to PiggyVest in April 2019, the company digitizes the traditional Nigerian "kolo" piggy-bank, layering automated savings, fixed-term safe-locks, naira and dollar wallets, and curated investments on top of licensed banking partners (originally United Bank for Africa) and a PCI-DSS-compliant payment stack. The consumer product family includes Piggybank (automated daily/weekly/monthly savings), SafeLock (fixed-tenor savings with up-front interest), Target Savings (goal-based saving, solo or group), Flex Naira (flexible wallet with free transfers), Flex Dollar / SafeLock Dollar (USD savings), HouseMoney (rent wallet), Investify (curated investment opportunities), GetIT (lifestyle purchase plans), Piggy Points (rewards), and an Accountability Partner feature, all delivered through iOS, Android, and web apps published by Piggytech Global. On the developer side, PiggyVest operates a separate B2B brand — PiggyVest Business — at piggyvest.business and exposes the PiggyVest Business API at api.piggyvest.business, documented at www.piggyvestbusiness.com/docs. The Business API is a Bearer-token authenticated REST API (secret key in Authorization header) covering customer creation and retrieval, customer wallets (create / retrieve / list, accrued-interest tracking, reserved account numbers, funding accounts), wallet-to-wallet and bank transfers (with name inquiry and bank lookup), transactions (status, history, T+1 settlement), scheduled payments (create / cancel / reactivate), webhooks for real-time event notifications, and a "Pay with Pocket" SDK / hosted-checkout integration that lets merchants accept payments funded from a Piggyvest user's Pocket balance. Default rate limits are approximately 100 requests per minute. No public OpenAPI specification, official SDK packages, or open-source client libraries are currently published; access is gated by signing up for a PiggyVest Business dashboard account. Alongside the API, PiggyVest Business offers Invoicing, Customizable Accounts, Business Safelock, Investify for Business, and business savings earning up to 18% per annum. Public engineering presence is limited — the Piggytech Global GitHub org (github.com/PiggyTech) hosts a small set of community wrappers (react-paystack, Smile Identity Node.js and React Native wrappers) and the consumer brand maintains a static piggyvest.github.io site, but there is no developer org publishing official Piggyvest Business SDKs.
p.name: PiggyVest

p.description: Pigment is an enterprise business planning platform (FP&A, workforce, sales, and supply-chain planning, and financial consolidation) that exposes a public REST API. The Pigment External API (OpenAPI 3.0.4, v1-external) covers CSV and Looker imports, CSV exports of Metric/List/Table Views, application/block/view metadata, import triggering and status, plus a SCIM 2.0 user-management API and an Enterprise Audit Logs API. Pigment also operates an official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI clients and publishes domain-knowledge Agent Skills. Authentication is via Bearer API keys (typed Import/Export/Metadata/SCIM/Audit) with IP allow lists.
p.name: Pigment

p.description: PiinPoint is an AI-powered location intelligence and site selection platform for retailers, restaurants, brokers, and commercial real estate teams. The software combines demographic, mobile-location, traffic, and competitive data to help teams validate sites, forecast sales, model cannibalization, run network simulations, and plan expansion. Delivered as a B2B SaaS web application (app.piinpoint.com), PiinPoint does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.
p.name: Piinpoint

p.description: Pika Labs is an AI video generation platform offering text-to-video, image-to-video, and video editing capabilities. As of May 2026 Pika does not publish a first-party REST API on its main domain; production API access is provided through partner aggregators (notably fal.ai) which host hosted endpoints for Pika models.
p.name: Pika Labs

p.description: Piknik (piknik.spot) is a local food system platform based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, Canada that maps farms, processors, markets, shops, restaurants, community gardens and food hubs, the supply links between them, marketplace listings, community events, jobs and volunteer posts, recipes, and a Local Food Score for any address. It is built agent-first: a REST API under https://piknik.spot/api described by a 683-operation OpenAPI 3.0.3 document, a hosted Model Context Protocol server at https://piknik.spot/api/mcp exposing 62 tools (public discovery tools anonymously, write tools behind OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and dynamic client registration or pik_pat_ personal access tokens), an A2A 1.0 agent card served at /.well-known/agent-card.json with a JSON-RPC endpoint at /api/a2a, an llms.txt, provider-published Agent Skills, and a published Agent Ethics policy that permits only immediate-use access and forbids bulk extraction, retention and model training.
p.name: Piknik.Spot

p.description: Pile is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
p.name: Pile

p.description: Pillar is an Italian construction-technology company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Milan, building what it calls the operating system for the construction industry (il sistema operativo per l'edilizia). Its cloud platform unifies the back office of building firms (imprese edili) — invoicing (fatturazione), cash-flow management (flussi di cassa), bank reconciliation, quotes and estimates (preventivi), procurement, job and project cost control (gestione commessa), and delivery notes and site work reports (DDT e rapportini) — alongside on-site safety (Pillar Sicurezza) and an AI layer (Pillar AI) that automates data entry in real time, including inputs captured from the job site over WhatsApp. Pillar is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital and today reaches customers through a book-a-demo model rather than a public self-serve signup or a developer-facing API; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.
p.name: Pillar

p.description: Pillar Biosciences is a Natick, Massachusetts molecular diagnostics company, founded in 2014, that develops targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) solutions for precision oncology. Its proprietary SLIMamp (Stem-Loop Inhibition Mediated amplification) chemistry enables highly multiplexed, single-tube PCR library preparation from as little as 2.5 ng of DNA, and its oncoReveal panel portfolio covers solid tumour tissue, liquid biopsy, haematologic malignancy, BRCA/HRD/methylation and inherited disease testing, alongside an InheritReveal line and a VersaTile machine-learning panel-design platform. Sequencing data is processed by PiVAT (Pillar Variant Analysis Toolkit), a secondary-analysis pipeline available as a local install or a HIPAA-scoped cloud deployment, with optional OncoKB-powered tertiary reporting. Pillar ships both research-use-only kits and an IVD product line, and raised a $34.5M round led by Illumina in 2025. Pillar publishes no public API, SDK or developer program; PiVAT's integration surface is bioinformatics file formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF, PDF) behind a customer login.
p.name: Pillar Biosciences

p.description: Pillar Technologies provides construction jobsite risk management through environmental monitoring and data analytics. Its wireless, rugged "Pod" sensors measure eight environmental metrics on the jobsite (temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, VOCs, particulates, noise, light, and pressure) with cellular connectivity and a one-year battery life, feeding a real-time software platform with customizable dashboards, floorplan integration, and drill-down reporting by site, floor, or sensor. A configurable alert system notifies teams via text, email, or phone. Pillar serves data centers, hospitality and multi-family housing, and science and healthcare construction projects to improve safety and protect schedules and budgets. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found as of this enrichment pass.
p.name: Pillar Technologies

p.description: Pilleve is a medication-compliance and controlled-substance monitoring company in the digital health space. Its Amethyst System pairs a smart pill-dispensing device that releases one pill at a time and detects tampering with a patient mobile app and a clinician portal for real-time monitoring, adherence tracking, diversion prevention, compliance documentation, and medication disposal. Pilleve serves hospital systems, pain clinics, and pharmacies, and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this enrichment pass Pilleve publishes a marketing website and a clinician login but exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation.
p.name: Pilleve

p.description: pillow is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of slow-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
p.name: pillow

p.description: PillPack is a full-service mail-order pharmacy that sorts each customer's medications by date and time, packages them into clearly labeled dose packets, and delivers them monthly with automatic refill management. The service coordinates directly with prescribing doctors and insurance providers, charges no service fee (customers pay only for their medications), and holds URAC Mail Service Pharmacy accreditation with NCPDP E-Scribe capabilities out of Manchester, NH. Founded in 2013 and acquired by Amazon in 2018, PillPack is now operated by the same team of licensed pharmacists behind Amazon Pharmacy, which the site increasingly directs customers toward for same-day delivery and additional savings. PillPack is a consumer-facing pharmacy service with no public developer or API surface.
p.name: PillPack

p.description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for startups and small businesses, pairing purpose-built financial software with a team of finance experts and former operators. Its offerings include monthly bookkeeping, corporate tax preparation and filing, R&D tax credit studies, fractional CFO and COO support, and stock administration. Pilot serves venture-backed startups and growing SMBs, integrating with accounting and payroll tools to deliver accurate books and financial reporting. Pilot is backed by CRV, Foundry Group, Index Ventures, SV Angel, Techstars, and Union Square Ventures. As of this profile Pilot does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its product is delivered as a managed service through its web application.
p.name: Pilot

p.description: Pilota is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
p.name: Pilota

p.description: Pilotly is a media and content audience-testing research platform used by studios, streamers, and brands to test films, trailers, series, and advertising with targeted audiences before release. Its managed service pairs clients with expert research managers who handle survey design, audience targeting, and insights synthesis, while a Study Tracker guides each project through five stages (Requested, Setting up, Fielding, Analysis, Complete). Content is fielded through a secure, DRM-protected and watermarked video player across desktop, mobile, and smart TV. Pilotly is a managed-service SaaS with no public developer API surface; clients named on the site include Netflix, Amazon, Sony, Paramount, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Audible. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.
p.name: Pilotly

p.description: Pimento is an AI ad-creative platform that helps marketing and advertising teams generate, analyze, and benchmark advertising creatives at scale. Its published product surface spans creative generation (Create), performance analysis (Analyze), competitive benchmarking (Benchmark), reusable brand kits, a Meta Score for predicting ad performance, multiformat output, and Meta Advantage+ support. Pimento is a venture-backed company in Partech's portfolio. It ships an end-user SaaS application at app.pimento.design backed by a private REST API and an Auth0 tenant, but that API is first-party only: it is undocumented, returns 401 to anonymous callers, and is not offered to developers. No developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, SDK, package, webhook catalog, CLI, changelog, status page, public pricing page, or MCP/A2A agent surface is published anywhere on a Pimento-controlled host.
p.name: Pimento

p.description: Pimjo, operating under the brand Aymo AI, offers an all‑in‑one AI platform for teams, providing access to leading large language models such as Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Seedream. The platform includes tools for text summarization, paraphrasing, paragraph generation, SEO title creation, YouTube hashtag generation, speech writing, song lyric composition, and more. It features a private, secure workspace for collaborative AI‑assisted brainstorming, model comparison, and result sharing, targeting teams seeking integrated AI capabilities across multiple use‑cases.
p.name: Pimjo

p.description: Pimlico is the world's most popular ERC-4337 account abstraction infrastructure platform, providing production bundler and paymaster APIs plus a platform management API for building, deploying, and operating smart accounts on Ethereum and 100+ EVM-compatible chains. Its verifying paymaster sponsors gas for gasless transactions, its ERC-20 paymaster lets users pay gas in stablecoins and other tokens, and its bundler submits, estimates, and tracks ERC-4337 user operations. Developers integrate through the permissionless.js TypeScript SDK (built on viem) against a single JSON-RPC endpoint keyed by chain, and manage sponsorship policies, API keys, and billing through the Pimlico dashboard.
p.name: Pimlico

p.description: Pimloc is a UK-based AI company whose Secure Redact platform automates the redaction and anonymization of personally identifiable information (PII) in video, audio, images and documents — blurring faces, license plates, screens, on-screen text and full bodies with high accuracy. Used across law enforcement, local government, transport, insurance, healthcare, education and retail to meet GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, FOIA and DSAR obligations, Secure Redact offers a browser SaaS and a v3 REST API. The API supports a fully automated Standard Flow (upload by URL, process, download) and an Enterprise Flow (review and edit in the UI, with projects, users and audit/chain-of-custody trails), plus audio transcription, video search and webhook callbacks. Pimloc is backed by Speedinvest.
p.name: Pimloc

p.description: PIN (getpin.xyz) is a fintech platform that makes it easy to launch and operate an investment club or syndicate, handling the administrative, legal, and tax work for group startup investments so a community can pool capital and invest in VC-backed startups together. Members onboard in a few simple steps, commit to deals, vote, and PIN manages the tax filings and portfolio support for the lifecycle of the club. PIN is venture-backed by Initialized, NEA, Industry Ventures and others. As of this enrichment pass PIN publishes only a marketing site and a member web app (app.getpin.xyz); no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found.
p.name: PIN

p.description: A complete payments solution, built for speed and simplicity around your unique business needs. The Pin Payments API enables developers to charge cards, manage customers, store payment sources, issue refunds, and run subscriptions through a RESTful JSON interface secured with HTTP Basic authentication.
p.name: Pin Payments

p.description: Pinata is an IPFS pinning and dedicated-gateway provider with a Files API, IPFS Pinning Service API, dedicated Gateways, Groups, and Workspaces. Built around IPFS CIDs with JWT-authenticated REST APIs and an SDK.
p.name: Pinata

p.description: A crowdsourced map of public pinball machines
p.name: Pinball Map

p.description: Pinch provides an at‑home medical spa experience combined with a payments platform that enables businesses to accept online payments for aesthetic treatments. The company offers a suite of APIs for managing customers, processing credit‑card and direct‑debit transactions, handling subscriptions, and integrating with third‑party services. Documentation includes guides, reference API specs, and SDKs for multiple languages, supporting developers to build seamless checkout flows for health‑and‑beauty services.
p.name: Pinch

p.description: Pinch Payments is an Australian, Brisbane-based payment orchestration and payment-facilitator platform that automates invoice collection and receivables for service businesses, bookkeepers, and software platforms across Australia and New Zealand. Marketing itself as "Aussie-Made Payments Infrastructure," Pinch lets merchants accept direct debit (bank account) and card payments (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), build payment plans and subscriptions, tokenise payment sources client-side with its CaptureJS library, and reconcile settlements back into Xero, QuickBooks, and MYOB. Its Glassbox / Managed Merchants offering is a Payfac-as-a-Service seam with KYC, compliance, and sub-merchant onboarding for platforms acting as aggregators or marketplaces. Pinch is genuinely API-first: it ships a fully documented REST API (JSON, OAuth2 client-credentials auth), a ReadMe-hosted developer portal with a live API explorer, per-product OpenAPI 3.1 definitions, a published Postman collection, an official .NET SDK, Zapier/n8n/viaSocket no-code connectors, webhooks for real-time events, and an llms.txt + docs MCP server for AI-assisted integration.
p.name: Pinch Payments

p.description: Pindrop is an Atlanta-based voice security and identity company founded in 2011 by Georgia Tech researchers. Its "Real Human + Right Human" platform detects deepfakes, prevents fraud, and authenticates callers across voice, video, and digital channels for contact centers and virtual meetings. Core products are Pindrop Pulse (deepfake and synthetic-voice detection), Pindrop Protect (near real-time fraud risk assessment), and Pindrop Passport (multifactor voice, device, and behavioral authentication, including VeriCall technology). Pindrop holds 300+ patents and integrates with contact-center and meeting platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Cisco Webex, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. The company is an enterprise, sales-led vendor and does not publish a self-serve public developer portal or open API.
p.name: Pindrop Security

p.description: Pinduoduo is a China-focused social commerce and agriculture-first e-commerce marketplace operated by PDD Holdings (Nasdaq: PDD), the multinational commerce group that also runs the cross-border marketplace Temu. Pinduoduo pioneered the "team purchase" (group-buy) model, connecting hundreds of millions of consumers directly with farmers, manufacturers, and merchants at scale. For developers, Pinduoduo runs a merchant-facing Open Platform (open.pinduoduo.com) that exposes gateway-style APIs for goods, orders, logistics, promotions, and store management to ISVs and merchant tools; that platform is geo-restricted to mainland China and was not directly reachable for artifact capture in this pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and enriched with verifiable corporate identity and domain security posture.
p.name: Pinduoduo

p.description: Pine is a Canadian digital-first mortgage lender and real estate brokerage (Pine Canada Financial Corporation / Pine Real Estate Brokerage) that makes home buying more accessible for Canadians through an online platform offering low interest rates, fast pre-approvals, and zero hidden fees. Backed by Greylock, Pine pairs mortgage origination with a REALTOR-affiliated brokerage licensed across multiple provinces (ON, AB, SK, NS, NB, NL), and reports more than $2B in mortgages funded and 100,000+ clients served. Pine is a consumer fintech product with no public developer API; its backend at api.pine.ca is a private, authenticated service.
p.name: Pine

p.description: Pine Medical was a telehealth provider that offered a medication-supported weight-loss program pairing licensed clinicians with prescription therapies and ongoing patient coaching. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment probe on 2026-07-20 found the public website (pinemedical.com) announcing that Pine Medical wound down its medication-supported weight-loss program effective March 30, 2024, and redirects former patients to alternative providers and insurance-covered options. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found.
p.name: Pine Medical

p.description: Pine Street Labs is a crypto / blockchain infrastructure company surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: infrastructure. Enrichment probes of pinestreetlabs.com found no live developer or API surface: the domain currently serves unrelated content and publishes no OpenAPI, SDKs, docs, or security programs. This profile is retained as a lead pending a verified developer surface.
p.name: Pine Street Labs

p.description: With its vector database at the core, Pinecone is the leading knowledge platform for building accurate, secure, and scalable AI applications. The Pinecone APIs cover Database (vector storage and search), Inference (embeddings and reranking), Assistant (RAG over documents), and Admin (organization and project management).
p.name: Pinecone

p.description: Pinetree Therapeutics, Inc. is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at West Cambridge Scientific Park, 767C Concord Ave, Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing next-generation targeted protein degraders (TPDs) built on its proprietary AbReptor platform. AbReptor degrades membrane-bound and extracellular proteins through target co-engagement, induced endocytosis, endolysosome formation and lysosomal degradation, aiming to overcome drug resistance and tumor recurrence in oncology, with additional application in inflammation and immunology. The company is advancing trispecific degraders and ADC-integrated programs, closed a $17M Series A in July 2024, and has entered a licensing partnership with AstraZeneca. It is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.
p.name: PineTree Therapeutics

p.description: Ping An Good Doctor (Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited, since rebranded Ping An Health, HKEX: 1833) is the online-healthcare arm of China's Ping An Insurance Group and one of the country's largest one-stop online healthcare platforms. Through its consumer app it offers online medical consultations delivered by an in-house medical team and AI triage, family-doctor memberships, a health mall for pharmaceutical and wellness e-commerce, and health-management and chronic-disease services. The platform serves individual consumers as well as enterprise and financial channels across China. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network it is a consumer/enterprise app business with no public developer API program: enrichment found no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or open-platform documentation, and the historical corporate domain (pahtg.com) now resolves to a parked landing page.
p.name: Ping An Good Doctor

p.description: Ping An HealthKonnect (Ping An Healthcare Technology), founded in September 2016 and headquartered in Shanghai, is a technology-driven managed care platform in China. As an AI-powered big data platform it brings together patients with providers of health insurance and medical services, offering budget planning, precision healthcare, medical health-care accounts, medical resources management, health records, and fraud/abuse detection to optimize healthcare spending. The platform covers roughly 70% of Chinese cities and a market of some 800 million people, and has raised about USD 1.15 billion backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, IDG Capital, and others. It is a B2B and government-facing enterprise platform with no public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.
p.name: Ping An HealthKonnect

p.description: Identity for enterprises - flawless user experience with fortified enterprise protection. Ping Identity's PingOne platform provides cloud-based identity and access management with REST APIs covering authentication, authorization, user and population management, applications, MFA, risk, verification, and more.
p.name: Ping Identity

p.description: Ping++ (品牌运营方为上海简米网络科技有限公司 / Shanghai Jianmi Network Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese aggregated-payment ("聚合支付") platform that gives merchants a single REST API and multi-platform SDKs to accept payments across WeChat Pay, Alipay, UnionPay, bank cards and other channels, plus compliant profit-sharing / split-settlement (分账), enterprise payouts (企业付款 / Transfers), red envelopes, member account systems and multi-tier merchant systems. The Stripe-inspired API is REST, JSON, HTTP Basic authenticated with an API Key, and organised around Charge, Refund, Transfer, Order, User, Recharge, Withdrawal, Coupon and Royalty objects, with cursor pagination, metadata, webhooks and a dated changelog. This profile was seeded as a venture-portfolio lead (General Catalyst, Ribbit Capital) and enriched from Ping++'s public developer surface.
p.name: Ping++

p.description: PingCAP is the company behind TiDB, an open-source, MySQL-compatible distributed SQL database built for hybrid transactional and analytical processing (HTAP), horizontal scale-out, Raft-based strong consistency, and vector search for AI workloads. PingCAP operates TiDB Cloud, the fully managed DBaaS delivered in Starter, Essential, Premium, Dedicated, BYOC and Lake tiers across AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and Alibaba Cloud. Developers manage the platform programmatically through the TiDB Cloud REST API family (cluster, branch, import, export, changefeed, IAM, billing and Data Service surfaces), the `ticloud` CLI, a Terraform provider, the TiDB Cloud Serverless JavaScript driver, the PyTiDB Python SDK, and an official TiDB MCP Server for agents. PingCAP also publishes OpenAPI for the TiDB Data Migration (DM) control plane and the OSS Insight public API.
p.name: PingCAP

p.description: Pingdom is a website uptime and performance monitoring service from SolarWinds that tracks availability, response time, transactions, real user monitoring, and page speed from a global network of probe servers. It alerts teams via email, SMS, webhooks, and integrations when websites, APIs, or critical user journeys experience downtime or degraded performance. The Pingdom Public REST API (v3.1) provides programmatic access to checks, results, alerts, contacts, maintenance windows, and reports using Bearer token authentication.
p.name: Pingdom

p.description: Pinger, Inc. is a San Jose, California mobile communications company founded in 2005 by former Palm managers Greg Woock and Joe Sipher. It builds consumer and small-business calling and texting apps rather than developer infrastructure: TextFree (launched 2009, the original free texting and calling app with a free US phone number), Sideline (a second phone number for work and privacy, with team number sharing, spam filtering, auto-reply and voicemail transcription) and Index (a dedicated business line with auto-reply, scheduling, broadcast messaging and payment collection). Sideline and TextFree have together been used by more than 100 million people. Pinger publishes no public developer program, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDK — its integrations run the other way, with Index consuming third-party calendar (Google, iCloud, Outlook) and payment (PayPal, Venmo, Square) services. The one machine-readable artifact it publishes is an llms.txt information sheet on the Sideline domain.
p.name: Pinger

p.description: Pingo AI, Inc. is a consumer language-learning application that uses conversational AI to help learners practice speaking across 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic. Learners hold real-time voice conversations with an adaptive AI tutor and get a transcript and vocabulary list for every session, following personalized learning paths. Pingo is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by Matrix Partners.
p.name: Pingo AI

p.description: PingOne is Ping Identity's cloud-based identity and access management platform providing authentication, authorization, single sign-on, MFA, identity verification, risk evaluation, and user lifecycle management for workforce and customer identities. The platform unifies Ping Identity capabilities into a multi-region cloud service across the US, EU, Canada, and Asia-Pacific. PingOne exposes a comprehensive REST Platform API secured with OAuth 2.0 access tokens issued by its authentication service.
p.name: PingOne

p.description: Pinhome is an Indonesian proptech real estate marketplace for smart buying, selling, and renting of houses, apartments, offices, and shop-houses (Pintar Jual Beli Sewa Rumah). The platform spans property listings and search, mortgage (KPR) and loan-takeover facilitation with partner banks, an automated property valuation tool (Pinvalue), and a marketplace of household and property services. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Pinhome operates a consumer-facing web and mobile product and does not publish a public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.
p.name: Pinhome

p.description: Pinkfish is an enterprise agentic AI and business orchestration platform that runs multi-step workflows across an organization's stack, combining AI agents with real system integrations, permissions, and auditability for critical operations. The platform pairs a natural-language "Coworker" and visual agentic workflow editor with domain-specific Agents, a Guardian monitoring and self-healing layer, and a library of 1,500+ ready-to-deploy MCP tools spanning 500+ enterprise integrations (Salesforce, Slack, Stripe, Zendesk, Jira, and more). Published workflows are exposed programmatically through the Triggers API (an API-key authenticated HTTP surface supporting synchronous and asynchronous execution, webhook triggers, and run polling) and through the embedded Pinkfish Sidekick MCP server. Pinkfish was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and was acquired by Genesys.
p.name: Pinkfish

p.description: Pinnacle Entertainment was an owner and operator of regional gaming, hospitality, and entertainment properties before being acquired by Penn National Gaming.
p.name: Pinnacle Entertainment

p.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: PNFP) is a Nashville, Tennessee based regional bank holding company whose principal subsidiary, Pinnacle Bank, is a Tennessee state-chartered, FDIC-insured commercial bank (FDIC Cert #35583) originally founded in 2000 as Pinnacle National Bank and renamed in 2012. Pinnacle operates across the Southeast — Tennessee, the Carolinas, Virginia, Georgia and Alabama — serving consumer, small-business, commercial and wealth clients. On the open-finance side Pinnacle runs NO public first-party developer API portal; its consumer digital and mobile banking is delivered on a third-party core/digital platform (Apiture), and consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available to fintechs only through data aggregators (Plaid and Finicity/Mastercard) rather than through a documented bank-operated API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture was found; open-finance participation is aggregator-mediated.
p.name: Pinnacle Financial

p.description: Pinnacle Foods was an American producer of branded packaged foods, including Birds Eye, Duncan Hines, Vlasic, Mrs. Paul's, and Hungry-Man, before being acquired by Conagra Brands in 2018.
p.name: Pinnacle Foods

p.description: Pinnacle is an online gaming website that was founded in 1998. Since its inception, Pinnacle has become a medium-sized, fully licensed, online sportsbook.
p.name: Pinnacle Sports Betting

p.description: Pinnacle West Capital is a holding company whose principal subsidiary is Arizona Public Service, the largest electricity utility in Arizona.
p.name: Pinnacle West Capital

p.description: Pinoffer is the API Evangelist network profile for Convertedin (converted.in / convertedin.com), the MENA-focused marketing operating system for e-commerce founded in Cairo in 2019 by Mohamed Fergany, Mohamed Atef and Mustafa Raslan. "PinOffer" is the company's former name and is still the identifier used by 500 Global, Crunchbase, MAGNiTT and LinkedIn, which is why the network entry carries it. Backed by Merak Capital, 500 Global and MSAS, Convertedin operates across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Brazil, and sells a unified growth platform covering store analytics, a commerce pixel, segmentation, SMS and email automation, and multi-channel ad buying on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google — plus the Converted Pay, Flyerz, Leads and Orders products. Convertedin DOES run a public developer program at developer.converted.in, contrary to the earlier enrichment pass on this repo: it publishes an llms.txt-indexed documentation set covering a live webhook ingest API at app.converted.in, two merchant-implemented data-sync contracts (Store Connector and Loyalty/POS), a browser pixel SDK, first-party Android and iOS SDKs, and a Flyerz DSP iframe embed. What it does not publish is any machine-readable contract — no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, MCP server or agent card exists on any Convertedin host.
p.name: Pinoffer

p.description: Pinokio is an open-source desktop application — self-described as an "AI Browser" — that acts as a 1-click launcher for any open-source AI project. Built by independent developer Cocktail Peanut (cocktailpeanut), Pinokio packages a terminal, package managers (Conda, Homebrew, Pip, NPM), and a graphical UI into a single MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with NVIDIA, AMD, and Apple Silicon GPU support. Users install AI apps with one click from a curated "Discover" directory of 160+ vetted scripts spanning image generation, video generation, text-to-speech and voice cloning, large language models, 3D generation, music and audio generation, and face swap. Pinokio is driven by a JSON-based scripting language designed to be both human and machine readable, with primitives like shell.run, fs, input, log, jump, hf (Hugging Face), notify, browser, and json that let publishers describe install and launch flows declaratively. Each script is sandboxed under ~/pinokio with isolated paths and Python virtual environments, and featured scripts must transfer ownership to the Pinokio Factory GitHub organization for admin review. Pinokio is purely client-side open source — there is no public REST API, no hosted commercial offering, and no developer SDK beyond the local script syntax and the desktop app itself.
p.name: Pinokio

p.description: Pinpoint is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruitment platform for in-house talent teams. Its REST API follows the JSON:API specification and is served per-tenant at https://{subdomain}.pinpointhq.com/api/v1, exposing jobs, applications, candidates, comments, files, and webhooks for building recruitment integrations. Not to be confused with AWS Pinpoint (customer engagement) or Pinpoint (signal/data intelligence).
p.name: Pinpoint

p.description: Pinscreen is an American AI and VFX production company founded in 2015 by Hao Li (MIT TR35 winner and professor of computer vision at MBZUAI), headquartered in Los Angeles with a branch in Abu Dhabi (UAE). It builds advanced generative AI for film production and interactive experiences, including AI lip sync, face reenactment, face swaps, de-aging, voice cloning, and photoreal 3D avatar digitization, and is known for developing the world's first real-time deepfake technology. Its Avatar Neo product generates a photoreal, riggable 3D avatar from a single photo (exportable as GLB/FBX with animation rigs) and is offered to developers as the Avatar Neo SDK: Unreal and Unity engine plugins backed by an avatar-generation API that can be deployed anywhere. Customers include Netflix, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros, Miramax, Apple, Google, Adobe, and DARPA. Backed by Lux Capital and Middle East investors.
p.name: Pinscreen

p.description: Pinshape is an online marketplace and community for 3D-printable designs, where makers, designers, and hobbyists browse, download, and sell STL and other printable model files for use on desktop 3D printers. The platform hosts both free and premium designs across categories such as toys, gadgets, art, jewelry, and functional parts, and was acquired by desktop 3D-printing manufacturer Formlabs. This profile was surfaced as a venture portfolio lead and enriched through the API Evangelist network; Pinshape publishes no public developer API.
p.name: Pinshape

p.description: Pintarnya is an Indonesian technology startup, launched in May 2022, that operates an employment and financial-services super-app for the country's blue-collar and entry-level workforce (education levels from elementary school through bachelor's degree, "SD-S1"). The platform aggregates tens of thousands of daily-updated job listings across 300+ Indonesian cities and pairs job search with Cari Cuan side-income tasks, Siap Kerja skill-building video courses, a CV builder, and an employer/recruiter posting product used by tens of thousands of companies. Pintarnya reports more than 10 million registered job seekers and is registered with Indonesia's Ministry of Labor (KEMNAKER). It is a consumer web and mobile product; no public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal is published as of this profile.
p.name: Pintarnya

p.description: Pinterest is an American image sharing and social media service designed to enable saving and discovery of information like recipes, home, style, motivation, and inspiration on the internet using images and, on a smaller scale, animated GIFs and videos, in the form of pinboards.
p.name: Pinterest

p.description: Pintu (PT Pintu Kemana Saja) is an Indonesian cryptocurrency exchange and investment app founded in April 2020 and headquartered in Jakarta. Licensed as a Physical Crypto Asset Trader (PFAK) under Bappebti and now supervised by the OJK, Pintu serves more than four million retail users with spot trading, crypto futures, staking/Earn, and a self-custody Web3 wallet connecting to DeFi and NFT dApps. Beyond the consumer app, Pintu operates Pintu Pro, an institutional and partner trading platform whose HMAC-signed WebSocket + HTTP API (docs.pintu.pro) lets market makers and partners place and cancel orders and stream execution reports and trades against production and sandbox environments. Pintu has raised over 150M USD across a Lightspeed-led 35M Series A+ (2021) and a 113M Series B (2022) with Intudo, Pantera Capital, and Northstar.
p.name: Pintu

p.description: Pinwheel is the leading payroll connectivity platform providing a REST API for direct deposit switching, income verification, employment history, and tax form retrieval from 1,800+ payroll providers and 40+ time-and-attendance systems. Financial institutions and fintechs use Pinwheel to activate customer accounts, verify income and employment, automate bill switching, and build primary banking relationships through a single, SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified integration.
p.name: Pinwheel

p.description: Pioneer Natural Resources was a large independent oil and gas exploration and production company with operations focused in the Permian Basin of Texas before being acquired by ExxonMobil. No public APIs or developer resources were published; this entry tracks the company as a non-API operator within the energy sector.
p.name: Pioneer Natural Resources

p.description: Pioneer Square Labs (PSL) is a Seattle-based startup studio and venture capital firm that partners with founders to build and fund early-stage technology companies. It operates two programs: PSL Studio, which co-creates companies from scratch alongside founders, and PSL Ventures, which invests seed capital in early-stage startups. PSL has spun out and backed companies including Arrived, Boundless, Recurrent, Dropzone, and SingleFile, and is currently focused on AI and agent-driven ventures (including its own "Lev" AI co-founder). This is a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; PSL publishes no public developer API surface.
p.name: Pioneer Square Labs

p.description: Pipe is an embedded financial OS that lets platforms — vertical SaaS, payment facilitators, and marketplaces — offer capital and cash-flow tools to the small and medium-sized businesses on their platform without those businesses ever leaving it. Its marquee product, Capital, delivers pre-approved funding offers priced from a business's transaction data, with repayment tied to sales performance rather than fixed monthly payments. Partners integrate via prebuilt embedded UI components, a zero-code Pipe-hosted flow, or a customizable REST API, while Pipe handles the banking partnerships and compliance. Backed by Anthemis and Creandum. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Pipe's public pages; the full API reference lives behind password-gated partner docs at docs.pipe.com.
p.name: Pipe

p.description: Pipe Network is a decentralized storage and content-delivery network built on Solana, marketed as "Firestarter" storage. It offers content-addressed (Blake3) object storage with client-side AES-256-GCM and post-quantum (Kyber-1024 / Dilithium5) encryption, deterministic public URLs of the form /{account}/{hash}, prepaid-USDC billing funded via Solana Pay, and first-party TypeScript / Python / Rust SDKs plus a Rust CLI. The SDKs ship native agent- framework tool adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, Cloudflare AI Workflows, AutoGen, CrewAI) and x402 machine-to-machine payment support. Backed by Multicoin Capital.
p.name: Pipe Network

p.description: Pipecat is an open-source Python framework (created by Daily) for building realtime voice and multimodal AI agents. It orchestrates pipelines of frames through pluggable services (STT, LLM, TTS, vision) and transports (Daily WebRTC, WebSocket, SmallWebRTC, telephony). Pipecat Cloud adds a hosted platform with a REST control API for deploying agents and starting/stopping agent sessions at scale.
p.name: Pipecat

p.description: Pipedream is a developer-centric integration platform providing three product lines: Workflows (code-level event-driven automation in Node.js/Python/Go/Bash), Connect (an embedded integration toolkit for adding customer-facing integrations and AI agents to applications, with managed OAuth for 3,000+ APIs), and a hosted MCP server exposing 10,000+ tools over JSON-RPC for AI agents. Pipedream announced an acquisition agreement with Workday on 2025-11-19.
p.name: Pipedream

p.description: Pipedrive is a sales CRM and pipeline management tool focused on small and mid-market teams. The Pipedrive REST API exposes deals, persons, organizations, activities, leads, products, pipelines, stages, mail, calls, files, notes, users, permissions, filters, goals, subscriptions, and webhooks.
p.name: Pipedrive

p.description: Pipefy is a no-code business process and workflow automation platform that lets teams build, run, and orchestrate processes such as procurement, HR onboarding, customer onboarding, and IT service requests using customizable pipes, forms, and AI agents. The platform exposes a GraphQL API at api.pipefy.com/graphql for managing pipes, cards, phases, fields, users, organizations, webhooks, and AI-driven workflow integrations, with OAuth2 Bearer token authentication via Personal Access Tokens or Service Accounts.
p.name: Pipefy

p.description: Pipeline Equity is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
p.name: Pipeline Equity

p.description: PipelineDB was a high-performance PostgreSQL extension for continuous, incremental aggregation of time-series data using continuous SQL views, avoiding the need to store raw event data. It also offered Stride, a hosted streaming-analytics API with first-party Python, JavaScript, and Go client SDKs, plus extensions for Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis ingestion. The company joined Confluent in 2019; the open-source extension reached a final 1.0.0 release (Apache-2.0) and is now archived, while the pipelinedb.com website and the hosted Stride service have been retired. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCVC.
p.name: Pipelinedb

p.description: Pipeliner CRM provides a visual sales pipeline and customer relationship management platform that helps businesses track leads, manage contacts, and automate sales processes. The solution offers customizable pipelines, activity tracking, reporting, and integration capabilities, enabling teams to improve productivity and close deals more efficiently. It serves a range of industries with a focus on sales automation and pipeline visibility, delivering a cloud‑based CRM experience.
p.name: Pipeliner CRM

p.description: Piper (Piper Learning, Inc. / Piper LLC) is an educational-technology company that makes hands-on STEM learning kits — most notably the Piper Computer Kit, a buildable wooden computer that teaches circuitry and coding through Minecraft, and Piper Make, a browser-based platform for exploring electronics and Python. Its consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with an MCP endpoint plus Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect, letting AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and check out with explicit buyer approval. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its live public agent/discovery surface.
p.name: Piper

p.description: Piper Sandler Companies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Piper Sandler Companies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
p.name: Piper Sandler Companies

p.description: PipesHub is an open-source, enterprise-ready workplace AI platform positioned as an open-source alternative to Glean. It unifies scattered business data by connecting to business and enterprise apps, provides explainable, permission-aware enterprise search across them, and powers AI agents that get work done. It can be self-hosted from its public GitHub repository (pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai) or used as a hosted app, and documents a developer API reference for building on its enterprise context layer.
p.name: PipesHub

p.description: Pipy is a high-performance, programmable network proxy designed for cloud, edge, and IoT environments. Written in C++ with an embedded JavaScript engine (PipyJS), it provides a small footprint, broad CPU architecture support, and a modular filter-based architecture for protocol conversion, traffic recording, message signing, and other networking tasks. Pipy is developed by Flomesh.
p.name: Pipy

p.description: Free weather API with forecast data similar to Dark Sky
p.name: Pirate Weather

p.description: Piris Labs is a Y Combinator (W2026) deep-tech startup building the networking layer for AI. The company develops proprietary photonic interconnect technology paired with a vertically optimized software stack that moves data between AI accelerators at ultra-low latency, targeting the bottleneck where up to 80% of advanced AI compute sits idle waiting on slow networking. Piris Labs couples this optical fabric with a full-stack, low-latency inference offering and has reported some of the fastest inference speeds for large frontier models. Founded in San Francisco by Ali Khalatpour (CEO) and Keyvan Moghadam (President), the company currently exposes no public, documented developer API or SDK — its product is delivered as hardware plus a hosted inference stack behind an early-access waitlist. This profile tracks Piris Labs' identity in the API Evangelist network and any future API surface it publishes.
p.name: Piris Labs

p.description: Pirsch is a privacy-first website analytics platform built and hosted in Germany. GDPR, CCPA, PECR, and Schrems II compliant, it tracks page views, sessions, custom events, conversion goals, funnels, and traffic sources without cookies or personal data storage. Developers access all data via a RESTful API with OAuth and access-key authentication, supported by official Go, JavaScript, and PHP SDKs.
p.name: Pirsch

p.description: Here we offer an API (Application Programming Interface) to assist users in integrating piscesCSM into their research pipelines.In summary, all jobs submitted to our server are labelled with a unique ID which is used to query the status of the job.
p.name: piscesCSM

p.description: Pismo is a cloud-native issuer-processing and core-banking platform exposing REST APIs for accounts, customers, cards, authorizations, transactions, statements, and programs, plus an event stream (Kafka-backed, delivered via webhooks and cloud event buses). Acquired by Visa in January 2024, Pismo powers card issuing and digital banking for financial institutions across the Americas, Europe, and APAC.
p.name: Pismo

p.description: Piston Cloud Computing Inc was an enterprise OpenStack infrastructure company surfaced as a portfolio company of dcvc and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. During a 2026-07-20 enrichment pass its historical domain (pistoncloud.com) was probed and now resolves to Cisco-owned infrastructure (72.163.4.154) returning HTTP 503 with no active developer portal, API reference, documentation, or machine-readable API surface. The company appears defunct/absorbed, so no provider artifacts (OpenAPI, packages, well-known, MCP, security, etc.) could be searched, generated, or derived. This profile remains a lead with no live API surface to enrich.
p.name: Piston Cloud Computing Inc

p.description: Pitch is a collaborative presentation software company (pitch.com) that builds a fast, web-based tool for teams to create, share, and present decks together in real time, with templates, brand controls, live collaboration, analytics, and in-product integrations. Backed by Index Ventures and tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this profile Pitch publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server; enrichment here captured its published security and identity surface.
p.name: Pitch

p.description: Pitch Aeronautics provides AI-powered weather intelligence and drone-deployable line solutions for electric utilities, helping them boost grid capacity, increase reliability, and reduce wildfire risk. The company pairs aerial hardware that installs and inspects power-line equipment with software that turns real-time atmospheric and grid data into dynamic line-rating and operational intelligence. Pitch Aeronautics is a Techstars-backed company; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public website. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment (July 2026).
p.name: Pitch Aeronautics

p.description: PitchBook provides comprehensive data and analysis on private market companies, investors, and deals. It offers a platform for market intelligence, deal sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management, helping users explore use cases such as market intelligence, deal sourcing, fundraising, and benchmarking. The service includes products like PitchBook Data, Platform, and Luminary, and supports free trials and login for deeper insights.
p.name: PitchBook

p.description: PitchMe is a recruitment data intelligence platform that enriches, verifies, and deduplicates candidate records to turn an existing ATS or CRM database into an activated talent pool. It cleans and appends verified contact details, employment history, and skills data, then surfaces career-intelligence signals that power AI-driven sourcing and outreach. PitchMe connects to applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Salesforce, Lever, JobDiva, Vincere, Avionte, Jobvite, and Ashby via native and certified integrations, plus a custom API for connecting any ATS or recruitment platform. Backed by Techstars.
p.name: PitchMe

p.description: Pitney Bowes is a global technology company that specializes in providing innovative shipping and mailing solutions. They offer a range of products and services, including postage meters, shipping software, and mail sorting equipment, to help businesses streamline their shipping and mailing processes. With a focus on efficiency and productivity, Pitney Bowes aims to help companies save time and money on their shipping and mailing operations.
p.name: Pitney Bowes

p.description: PitPro Automation is a fleet-maintenance technology company building automated tire-service systems that perform full tire changes and rotations on commercial fleet vehicles in under fifteen minutes. Targeting Class 2 and smaller vehicles, the company serves last-mile delivery, rideshare, utility, telecom, moving, and government fleets with in-bay automation, 24/7 monitoring, and field support. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, PitPro is a hardware-and-software provider focused on reducing fleet downtime; it currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.
p.name: PitPro Automation

p.description: Pitzi is a Brazilian insurtech (founded around 2013) that sells mobile phone protection insurance, covering devices against theft, robbery, cracked screens, and accidental damage. Customers subscribe to monthly device-protection plans and file claims through an online customer portal to get their phone repaired or replaced, with support offered via a help center, email, and WhatsApp. Pitzi also distributes through a partner program and is backed by DCM Ventures and QED Investors. It operates as a direct-to-consumer and partner-distributed fintech/insurtech in Brazil. No public API or developer portal is currently published.
p.name: Pitzi

p.description: Pivot Bio is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Berkeley, California with additional operations in St. Louis, Missouri. The company engineers naturally occurring soil microbes to fix atmospheric nitrogen on crop root systems, providing a biological alternative to synthetic nitrogen fertilizer that reduces nitrous-oxide emissions, nitrate runoff, and exposure to volatile fertilizer prices. Pivot Bio's product line includes PROVEN 40 and PROVEN G3 (corn and corn silage), RETURN (wheat and small grains), CERT-N (cotton), and RETAIN (sorghum). The company also operates N-OVATOR, an outcomes-based program that pays farmers for verified emissions reductions; the program reports having paid out more than $6M to growers since 2022 and contributing to over 1,050,000 metric tons of CO2e avoided. Pivot Bio was founded by Karsten Temme (CEO) and Alvin Tamsir. Investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Temasek, DCVC, Generation Investment Management, Pavilion Capital, G2 Venture Partners, Bond, and others. Pivot Bio's product is the microbe, not an API; the company operates a farmer-facing Salesforce-based portal but does not publish a public developer API or SDK.
p.name: Pivot Bio
