Roblox also publishes deep documentation for the Engine API at create.roblox.com/docs and the legacy ROBLOX Web APIs that power the website (subdomains such as users.roblox.com, groups.roblox.com, inventory.roblox.com), which remain undocumented for third parties.
r.name: Roblox

r.description: Roblox provides a suite of developer APIs for building experiences on the Roblox platform. The Engine API documents all classes, data types, enumerations, functions, events, callbacks, and properties for in-experience scripting in Luau. The Open Cloud REST API provides external programmatic access to Roblox platform resources including experiences, places, data stores, users, groups, assets, messaging, and more. In March 2026 Roblox launched new unified Open Cloud reference documentation.
r.name: Roblox Engine API

r.description: Robocorp is an open source RPA and workflow automation platform for building Python-based automation bots. The platform provides the Control Room API for managing workspaces, workers, processes, work items, assets, vaults, webhooks, and task packages. Robocorp also provides the RPA Framework, an open-source collection of Python libraries for robotic process automation including browser, desktop, email, Excel, PDF, and cloud service automation. The platform has evolved toward Sema4 AI for AI-powered automation actions.
r.name: Robocorp

r.description: Robocurve is a San Francisco Public Benefit Corporation (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building open-source tools and independent benchmarks to help society understand what AI and robots can actually do in the physical world. Its flagship framework, Inspect Robots ("the Inspect AI for robotics"), runs any vision-language-action policy on any embodiment against any benchmark with full trace logs and live Rerun visualization, and integrates with ROS, Isaac Lab, and LeRobot. World Evals is its curated catalog of physical-world benchmarks (KitchenBench, DataCenterBench). Everything ships MIT-licensed as Python packages with a command-line interface rather than a hosted REST API.
r.name: Robocurve

r.description: RoboDock is an autonomous robotics company (Y Combinator W2026) building the robotics layer that powers autonomous EV and AV depots, starting with charging and inspections. Its robots automate depot operations for electric and autonomous vehicle fleets, handling vision-guided plug insertion with verified connection, automated post-trip vehicle inspection, and closed-loop learning that improves efficiency with each charge event. The company targets live EV and AV depots, ports, and logistics yards where charging and core depot operations are still performed manually multiple times per day across mixed fleets. RoboDock is a hardware and robotics business rather than an API provider; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation. Founded by Zinny Weli (CEO, ex-Zipline and Amazon robotics) and Celine Wang (CTO, ex-Plus autonomous systems).
r.name: RoboDock

r.description: Roboflow is a computer vision platform used by over one million engineers to annotate images, train custom models, and deploy them to production from the cloud to the edge. The platform spans dataset management and AI-assisted labeling, model training (RF-DETR, YOLO and NAS architectures), evaluation with mAP and confusion-matrix analysis, and low-code Workflows that compose models with logic and visualization into deployable pipelines. Deployment options include a serverless hosted inference API, dedicated deployments, batch processing, self-hosted Docker inference servers, in-browser inference, and managed edge devices. Roboflow Universe publishes a large open library of community datasets and models. Developers reach the platform through a REST API, a Python SDK and CLI, an OpenAPI-described inference server, and a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server paired with first-party Agent Skills.
r.name: Roboflow

r.description: Pre-trained computer vision models
r.name: Roboflow Universe

r.description: Generate random robot/alien avatars
r.name: RoboHash

r.description: Roborock is a global consumer robotics company best known for its robot vacuum and mop cleaners, wet/dry wash-and-fill floor washers, and connected home-cleaning appliances controlled through the Roborock mobile app. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Beijing, the company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Roborock operates a private cloud that backs its consumer mobile app but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program. It does operate a public Trust Center documenting the security and privacy design of its IoT products, including TÜV Rheinland EN 303 645 and UL Diamond IoT Security certifications.
r.name: Roborock

r.description: Robotiq designs and manufactures collaborative robotics hardware and software — adaptive grippers, vacuum grippers, force-torque sensors, wrist cameras, and pre-engineered workcells for palletizing, machine tending, screwdriving, and assembly. Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Lévis, Quebec, Canada, the company helps manufacturers automate repetitive tasks by embedding task intelligence ("Intelligence Made Physical") directly into end-of-arm tooling for platforms such as Universal Robots, FANUC CRX, and Omron/Techman. Robotiq publishes open-source ROS drivers and a C++ gripper SDK through its GitHub organization, but it does not operate a public web/REST API — this profile captures its developer-facing identity, open-source SDKs, and domain security posture rather than a hosted API surface.
r.name: Robotiq

r.description: Roboto Games is an independent video game development studio building Stormforge, an open-world survival crafting game where players craft, build, fight, and harness epic storms to survive in a magical fantasy world. The studio was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a consumer game studio, Roboto Games publishes a marketing website, a careers page, and a studio blog, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface — its player-facing experience is delivered through native game clients (Steam) and community channels (Discord, YouTube, Twitch) rather than an HTTP API. This profile captures the studio's public identity and web properties; no API artifacts are produced because none are published.
r.name: Roboto Games

r.description: RobotTraining.jobs is a job board focused on robot‑training and robot‑operator positions. It aggregates listings from robotics companies, providing details on pay, job type, and employer. Users can browse, compare, and apply to roles across various platforms, with tools to estimate earnings and match opportunities to their skills.
r.name: RobotTraining.jobs

r.description: Robust Intelligence is an AI security company founded in 2019 to defend ML and GenAI systems against adversarial attacks, data poisoning, prompt injection, and unsafe outputs. Its platform combined automated red teaming (Algorithmic AI Red Teaming) with runtime protection (AI Firewall) for LLM and traditional ML applications. Cisco announced the acquisition of Robust Intelligence in August 2024 and the technology now powers the Cisco AI Defense product line, with Robust Intelligence's capabilities integrated into Cisco's broader security portfolio.
r.name: Robust Intelligence

r.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.
r.name: Robust.AI

r.description: Roby (Imageous, Inc.) is a Seattle-based building-management software company whose HVAC automation product connects room and space calendars with a building's BMS (building management system) to automatically switch HVAC to an unoccupied/energy-saving mode when spaces are not in use, delivering measured energy savings and extended equipment lifetime for K-12, higher-education, and office facilities without added staff effort. Roby is deployed through building system integrators (ATS, Climatec, Syserco, ABM Systems, Oprizon, NSF-E) and also offers Receptionist and Helpdesk workplace applications. The product uses Auth0-managed authentication with token-based, SSL-only API access, but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.
r.name: Roby

r.description: Enterprise AI customer-support platform spanning voice, WhatsApp, chat, email, social media and ticketing. The platform runs AI agents against a customer knowledge base with configurable personas, model selection, human-agent handover and assignment logic, and its APIs let external systems interact with Robylon and trigger workflows including voice and outbound automation. Documentation is public and extensive and the docs host serves both an llms.txt index and an unauthenticated MCP server; what is not published is a machine-readable contract for the product API itself.
r.name: Robylon AI

r.description: Rocana (formerly ScalingData) was an IT operations analytics company founded in 2014 in San Francisco and backed by GV. Its product captured and analyzed all machine data from all sources across data-center infrastructure, keeping it online and queryable for years so operations teams could perform root-cause analysis and surface emerging IT problems before they caused outages. The company raised roughly $19.4M before being acquired by Splunk in 2017, after which the independent Rocana product and brand were wound down. It was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment on 2026-07-21 confirmed there is no live public website (rocana.com no longer resolves), no developer portal, no API, and no client packages — the company no longer operates independently.
r.name: Rocana

r.description: F. Hoffmann-La Roche is a Swiss multinational healthcare company with two divisions: Roche Pharma and Roche Diagnostics. Roche does not publish a general public developer API but exposes interoperability through the navify diagnostics platform, the cobas infinity laboratory software, and an open-source GitHub presence focused on data-science tooling such as pyreadstat, foxops, and OligoGym.
r.name: Roche

r.description: Rock The Bells is the hip-hop culture brand and direct-to-consumer merchandise retailer founded by LL COOL J, describing itself on its own storefront as "The Home For All Things Classic and Timeless Hip-Hop". It sells apparel and accessories and publishes editorial across five blogs (features, artists, videos, From Jamaica to the Bronx, and COHH). It ships no developer program and no OpenAPI, but it does serve a live, anonymously callable agent commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 2026-04-08) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a 13-tool Model Context Protocol server at /api/ucp/mcp, a fully introspectable Storefront GraphQL API, and an agent instruction document at /llms.txt and /agents.md that its robots.txt and a purpose-built sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml both point at. Discovery is open; payment is gated by a stated human-approval invariant rather than by a credential.
r.name: Rock The Bells

r.description: Rockbot is a unified in-location media platform for businesses, giving multi-location operators one system to control background music, audio messaging, digital signage, Rockbot TV, music videos, and retail-media advertising across their venues. Its v5 REST API lets customers programmatically manage that estate: control music playback and playlist overrides per zone, run audio-messaging and signage campaigns by group or zone, upload and attach assets, check device status / screenshots and reboot players remotely, and pull or export music, messaging, and signage playback history. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 client-credentials issuing 24-hour bearer tokens, with a documented default rate limit of one request per second. Rockbot is a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the consumer sector.
r.name: Rockbot

r.description: Rocker is a Swedish fintech company offering a peer‑to‑peer marketplace for buying and selling second‑hand goods, backed by a robust payment solution. The platform provides users with secure transactions, real‑time updates, and integrated banking features such as savings accounts and personal loans. Rocker aims to improve financial health by simplifying payments and offering tools for budgeting and financial planning, serving over 400 000 users across Scandinavia.
r.name: Rocker

r.description: Rockerbox is a New York-based unified marketing measurement platform that combines multi-touch attribution (MTA), marketing mix modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing on a single first-party data foundation spanning 100+ advertising integrations. Its developer surface is deliberately narrow and unusual: there is no public REST API and no OpenAPI. Data goes IN through a documented server-side conversion webhook, onsite tracking pixels, and batch files; results come OUT as warehouse shares into Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift against published schemas, plus scheduled and ad hoc exports. Rockerbox does, however, run a genuinely modern agent surface on its Data Foundation documentation host — an anonymous remote MCP server, an A2A agent card, a provider-published Agent Skill, an llms.txt, and an explicit robots.txt Content-Signal grant.
r.name: Rockerbox

r.description: Rocket (rocket.new) is an AI "vibe solutioning" platform for builders and founders that combines three products: Solve for market research and business analysis, Build for turning natural-language prompts or Figma designs into production-ready React, Next.js, and Flutter web and mobile apps, and Intelligence for tracking competitors across product, hiring, and funding signals. Build ships apps with one-click deploy to Netlify, custom domains, APK/App Store packaging, GitHub two-way code sync, and 26+ connectors (Stripe, Supabase, OpenAI, Anthropic, Twilio, HubSpot, and more) wired into the generated app from chat. Rocket is a no-code/AI app-builder product surface: it consumes external APIs (imported via Postman, cURL, or Swagger) rather than publishing its own public REST API, SDK, CLI, or MCP server. Backed by Accel, Electric Capital, and Sierra Ventures.
r.name: Rocket

r.description: Rocket Companies is a Detroit-based financial services firm that provides digital solutions for homeownership and personal finance. Its portfolio includes Rocket Mortgage for home loans, Rocket Homes for real estate search, and Rocket Money for personal finance management. Rocket Companies does not publish a public corporate developer API portal at the holding-company level.
r.name: Rocket Companies

r.description: Rocket Internet SE is a Berlin-based internet company builder and technology investment firm founded by the Samwer brothers. It incubates and scales internet and technology ventures globally and invests through its venture arm, having built and backed more than 200 companies across six continents in e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, food delivery, and consumer internet. Rocket Internet operates as a holding and operational-support platform rather than a product or API provider, so it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.
r.name: Rocket Internet

r.description: Rocket Lab Corporation (Nasdaq RKLB) is an end-to-end space company providing launch services, spacecraft, satellite components, and on-orbit services. Its Electron rocket is the world's most frequently launched orbital small launch vehicle; the medium-lift Neutron rocket is in development. Rocket Lab Space Systems supplies Photon spacecraft, reaction wheels, star trackers, solar arrays, propulsion, separation systems, and composite structures to civil, national security, and commercial customers. Rocket Lab does not currently offer a public developer API.
r.name: Rocket Lab

r.description: Rocket Lab (Rocket Lab Corporation, formerly Rocket Lab USA; Nasdaq RKLB) is an American aerospace manufacturer and end-to-end space company founded in 2006 by Peter Beck. It designs and launches the Electron small-lift orbital rocket, is developing the reusable Neutron medium-lift vehicle, and builds the Photon spacecraft platform along with satellites, spacecraft components, solar cells, reaction wheels, star trackers, separation systems and other space systems. Rocket Lab operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and at Wallops Island, Virginia, providing dedicated and rideshare launch services plus on-orbit management for commercial, civil and national-security customers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures; this profile is enriched from public identity and live domain probes only, as Rocket Lab publishes no public developer API surface.
r.name: Rocket Lab

r.description: Rocket Lawyer is a San Francisco, California online legal technology company that has helped over 20 million businesses and individuals get online legal help. Founded in 2008, Rocket Lawyer offers self-service lawyer-vetted legal documents (contracts, NDAs, leases, wills, living trusts, power of attorney, business formation paperwork) plus DIY business services (LLC and corporation formation, registered agent service, DBA filings, annual reports, trademark registration), RocketTax tax preparation, and an "Ask a Legal Pro" attorney network for live consultations and document review. The platform is anchored by a membership model — Standard, Plus, and Pro tiers — that bundles unlimited documents, e-signatures, Rocket Copilot AI contract review, and varying numbers of Legal Pro questions and live consultations. Rocket Lawyer also operates a partner developer program with public REST APIs — exposed through an Apigee-backed developer portal at developer.rocketlawyer.com — that lets third parties embed lawyer-vetted document creation, electronic signature, and event-driven workflows into their own products. Four APIs are published with OpenAPI 3.0 specifications and live sandbox + production environments: the Authentication API (OAuth 2.0 access / service / scoped tokens), the RocketDocument v2 API (interview-driven document creation), the RocketSign and Binders API (electronic signature and document bundle management), and the Events API (subscription + pull-based event notifications). Both Embedded UX components and a "build your own UX" path are supported, and partner onboarding is managed through api@rocketlawyer.com and a self-service developer portal.
r.name: Rocket Lawyer

r.description: Rocket Matter provides cloud‑based legal practice management software for law firms of all sizes. The platform combines case management, time tracking, billing, document automation, and client collaboration tools into a single, secure solution. Founded in 2008, Rocket Matter helps firms streamline workflows, improve client service, and increase profitability through an intuitive, modern interface and robust integrations.
r.name: Rocket Matter

r.description: Rocket Pool is a decentralized Ethereum liquid staking protocol that lets anyone participate in Ethereum proof-of-stake without running a full 32 ETH validator. Stakers deposit ETH and receive rETH, a rebasing-free yield-bearing liquid staking token that automatically accrues consensus and execution layer rewards and is freely composable across DeFi. On the supply side, permissionless node operators can run a Rocket Pool minipool with as little as 8 ETH (and a smaller RPL bond) — Rocket Pool pairs operator ETH with the rETH-backed deposit pool to fund full beacon-chain validators, and operators earn consensus rewards plus a commission from rETH users and RPL inflation rewards. The protocol is governed on-chain through the Protocol DAO (pDAO) and the Oracle DAO (oDAO) and is specified by Rocket Pool Improvement Proposals (RPIPs). The reference node software stack is the Smart Node (rocketpool CLI plus a Go daemon) distributed as Docker images, alongside Go and TypeScript/JavaScript libraries (rocketpool-go, rocketpool-js) for reading and writing protocol state directly against the Rocket Pool smart contracts on Ethereum mainnet. Rocket Pool has no centralized REST API, no hosted developer platform, no API keys, and no pricing — all participation is on-chain via Ethereum JSON-RPC and the protocol's deployed contracts.
r.name: Rocket Pool

r.description: Rocketable acquires profitable SaaS products and infuses them with AI, operating a portfolio of software businesses that are run, improved, and grown by AI agents. Backed by Y Combinator, True Ventures, Bloomberg Beta, and INDIE.vc, the San Francisco company buys established SaaS products generating at least $500K in annual revenue and works toward support that resolves problems in seconds and features and fixes that ship in minutes or hours instead of quarters. The public site runs two intake flows — apply to join the team, and submit a SaaS product to be acquired — plus a newsletter on automating software businesses with AI agents. No public API or developer surface is published.
r.name: Rocketable

r.description: Rocketlane is an AI-powered Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform that unifies customer onboarding, project delivery, resource management, time tracking, and professional-services financials in one system. Its public REST API (base https://api.rocketlane.com/api/1.0/) exposes projects, tasks, phases, spaces, space documents, custom fields, time entries, time-offs, resource allocations, users, and invoices, authenticated with a workspace api-key header and paginated with cursors. Outbound webhooks broadcast task, project, and phase lifecycle events, and a first-party CLI (@rocketlane/rli) supports building apps for the Rocketlane Marketplace. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead (8vc, Insight Partners); enriched from its live developer surface.
r.name: Rocketlane

r.description: RocketReach is a Seattle-based B2B contact data and sales intelligence provider that maintains a database of 700M+ professional profiles and 60M+ companies and exposes it through a REST API for email, phone, and social-handle discovery plus company firmographics. The platform is used for sales prospecting, recruiting, marketing enrichment, and CRM hydration, with results returned as structured profile and company objects and optional webhook delivery for asynchronous lookups.
r.name: RocketReach

r.description: Rocketrip was a New York City corporate travel cost-savings platform that gave business travelers a personalized budget (a "Price to Beat") and rewarded employees who booked flights, hotels, and rail below it, sharing the savings between the traveler and the company. It was backed by Canaan Partners, GV, Bessemer, and Y Combinator. As of this enrichment pass the rocketrip.com and www.rocketrip.com domains 301-redirect to Tabhi (tabhi.ai / tabhi.com), the developer, docs, and api subdomains no longer resolve, and no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI could be found — the standalone Rocketrip product and its API surface appear to have been retired or folded into Tabhi.
r.name: Rocketrip

r.description: RockFi is a French private wealth management firm positioning itself as a modern family office, pairing experienced private-banking advisors with technology to serve high-net-worth entrepreneurs, executives, athletes, and independent professionals. Its fixed-fee model offers life insurance (France and Luxembourg), structured funds, private equity, SCPI real estate, PEA and securities accounts, customized investment mandates, and consolidated real-time portfolio monitoring, tax optimization, and wealth-transmission planning. Registered with ORIAS (23004556) under ACPR and AMF oversight. Backed by Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile has been enriched from the public site.
r.name: RockFi

r.description: Rockmelt was a Chromium-based social web browser startup founded in 2008 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), designed to integrate Facebook, Twitter, and web feeds directly into the browser chrome. The company was acquired by Yahoo in August 2013 and its products were discontinued shortly after. It was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment confirms the company is defunct with no live web, developer, or API surface.
r.name: Rockmelt

r.description: Rockport Trade Systems is a global trade management (GTM) software company providing customs compliance, import and export management, and trade-content solutions to enterprises. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners, it was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company operates a corporate marketing website but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface, and the site actively blocks automated access (HTTP 403), so no API artifacts could be harvested.
r.name: Rockport Trade Systems

r.description: Rocksalt is a B2B inbound and social-engagement platform, headquartered in Redwood City, California and founded in 2023 by Arjun Moorthy (CEO), Anita Moorthy (CMO), and Ajoy Sojan (CTO). The product helps founders, executives, and subject-matter experts build visibility and win business on LinkedIn and Reddit in roughly ten minutes a day: an AI-powered digest surfaces the industry conversations worth joining, suggests personalized comments grounded in the user's expertise, assists with post creation, and adds team collaboration workflows plus analytics and HubSpot CRM sync. Rocksalt raised seed funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2025. It is a marketing SaaS application delivered through a web app rather than a public developer API; this profile was surfaced from the Lightspeed portfolio and enriched with the company's public identity and web properties.
r.name: Rocksalt

r.description: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage, developed at Facebook (Meta) based on LevelDB. It uses a Log-Structured Merge (LSM) tree design optimized for fast, low-latency storage on flash and RAM. RocksDB provides a C++ library with language bindings for Java, Python, Ruby, Rust, and other languages, and is widely used as the storage engine inside databases, data streaming systems, and distributed key-value stores.
r.name: RocksDB

r.description: Rockset was a real-time analytics database company (Greylock portfolio, infrastructure sector) that was acquired by OpenAI in June 2024. The standalone product and API have been wound down: rockset.com now 301-redirects to OpenAI's acquisition announcement, and the former developer surface (docs.rockset.com, api.rs2.usw2.rockset.com) no longer resolves in DNS. There is no live public API to enrich; this profile is retained as a historical company record.
r.name: Rockset

r.description: RockSolid (rocksolid.network) is a DeFi platform offering actively managed, institutional-grade liquid vaults. It lets institutions, protocols and projects launch tailored, white-label vault products that give their communities streamlined access to higher yields and DeFi strategies typically reserved for large investors, sourcing yield from protocols such as Uniswap, Aave, Morpho and Yearn. Vaults are built on the ERC-7540 Asynchronous Tokenized Vault standard (Lagoon Finance implementation) and are audited. RockSolid publishes a public, read-only REST Vaults API that exposes vault metadata, curators, rewards, latest performance (NAV, APR/APY, TVL), strategy allocation snapshots by period, and calculated APR/TVL — plus smart-contract integration docs for on-chain deposit/redeem. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures.
r.name: RockSolid

r.description: Rockstar Games is an American video game publisher headquartered in New York City and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive Software (NASDAQ: TTWO). Best known for the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption franchises, Rockstar operates online services for GTA Online and Red Dead Online, the Rockstar Games Launcher PC client, and the legacy Rockstar Games Social Club identity / authentication platform. Rockstar does not publish a public developer portal; its HTTP API surface is internal and consumed only by first-party clients (game executables, the Rockstar Games Launcher, and Rockstar's mobile companion apps). The most visible public-facing API is its OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 identity provider at signin.rockstargames.com, which exposes standard /connect/authorize, /connect/Token, /connect/introspect, and /.well-known/jwks endpoints. Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S and will include a "significant online mode" succeeding GTA Online.
r.name: Rockstar Games

r.description: Rockwell Automation is a global provider of industrial automation and digital transformation solutions, helping manufacturers boost productivity, sustainability, and agility. The company offers a portfolio of hardware, software, and services including programmable logic controllers (PLCs), industrial networking, motor control, safety systems, and the FactoryTalk software suite for MES, SCADA, historian, remote access, and industrial data management.
r.name: Rockwell Automation

r.description: Rockwell Collins was a major American company providing avionics and information technology systems and services to government agencies and aircraft manufacturers. In 2018, Rockwell Collins was acquired by United Technologies and became part of Collins Aerospace, a subsidiary of RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies). Collins Aerospace provides flight deck systems, cabin electronics, mission systems, communications, and advanced data services including FlightAware AeroAPI for aviation data. The Collins Digital Exchange offers API products for aerospace and defense integration.
r.name: Rockwell Collins

r.description: Rockwell FactoryTalk is a portfolio of software products by Rockwell Automation that supports the design, operation, and maintenance of industrial control systems and connected manufacturing operations.
r.name: Rockwell FactoryTalk

r.description: roclub (roclub GmbH) is a German health-tech company operating a remote-control platform for diagnostic medical imaging. Its software lets healthcare organizations perform MRI and CT examinations remotely ("Remote Scanning") and support on-site technicians from anywhere ("Remote Support"), with real-time screen sharing and device control across multi-vendor scanners (Siemens, Philips, GE, Canon). roclub also runs a marketplace of qualified medical technologists ("rocStars") who can be booked on demand, together with session documentation, scheduling, and built-in liability insurance ("roCover"). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation was found during enrichment.
r.name: Roclub

r.description: Rodeo is a consumer social app that helps people wrangle their social life: save the things you want to do — social posts, screenshots, links and photos — and then do the things you saved together with friends, while Rodeo wrangles the details and keeps you organized. Tagline: "Save it. Do it." Backed by Foundry Group and Seedcamp. As of this enrichment pass Rodeo publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs or .well-known discovery surface — it is a consumer mobile/web product, not an API provider.
r.name: Rodeo

r.description: Rodin Therapeutics * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
r.name: Rodin Therapeutics *

r.description: Roger (operated by Sanos Services GmbH, Berlin, Germany) is a B2B SaaS practice-management platform for dental clinics. It layers automation and AI onto existing German dental practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM Z1, Charly, Dampsoft, Evident and Dento Office, adding patient recall, digital intake forms, WhatsApp/SMS communication, AI-assisted documentation with billing-position capture, digital treatment-plan signing, factoring with default protection and instant payout, and outsourced ZMV/reception staffing. The product is DSGVO/GDPR-compliant and hosted in Germany. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery, Roger publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.
r.name: Roger

r.description: Rogers Communications is Canada's largest wireless carrier and, following its 2023 acquisition of Shaw Communications, one of the country's largest cable, internet, and media companies. It operates a national 5G mobile network, broadband and TV services under the Rogers, Fido, chatr, and Shaw/Ignite brands, and owns Rogers Sports & Media. In the telecom API value chain Rogers sits squarely on the network-operator side, not the developer-facing side: it has no first-party developer portal, publishes no OpenAPI or Swagger definitions, runs no sandbox, and ships no first-party SDKs. Its legacy developer programme, Rogers Catalyst, is dead — www.rogers.com/developer still 301s to a meta-refresh page pointing at rogerscatalyst.com, a domain that no longer belongs to Rogers (re-registered through NameCheap with registrant privacy in December 2023) and that now serves a one-byte blank page. Rogers' network capabilities reach developers only through intermediaries: EnStream LP, the identity and fraud joint venture it co-owns with Bell Mobility and TELUS, which resells Canadian carrier Number Verification and SIM Swap data on a sales-led, contract-first basis with no public documentation; Aduna, the Ericsson-and-carrier joint venture that announced an EnStream partnership in February 2025 to bring Bell, Rogers, and TELUS network APIs onto a CAMARA-aligned platform; and, historically, a Canada-exclusive private preview of Microsoft's Azure Programmable Connectivity announced at MWC 2023, whose public documentation has since been retired. On 2026-06-30 Vonage commercially launched SIM Swap Detection and Silent Authentication across Canada, connecting to Bell, Rogers and TELUS via Aduna's integration with EnStream — the first documented, self-serve way to buy Rogers-derived network signals, though the contract, docs and sandbox all belong to Vonage. Rogers is partner-gated and reachable only through aggregators — the CAMARA posture is real but wholesale, and nothing is callable from a Rogers-owned domain.
r.name: Rogers Communications

r.description: Rogo is a New York-based artificial intelligence company building an AI platform purpose-built for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded by Gabriel Stengel, John Willett, and Tumas Rackaitis, Rogo serves 300+ institutions and 35,000+ bankers and investors with AI agents that execute end-to-end financial workflows — producing institutional-grade Excel models, investment memos, diligence materials, and slide decks. Its platform (including the Felix assistant) integrates with firm systems (SharePoint, CRM) and financial data providers (LSEG, FactSet, Capital IQ, PitchBook, Preqin, Dow Jones, SEC filings) and is custom-deployed with enterprise-grade, single-tenant security. Customers include Truist Securities, Nomura, and Baird. Rogo raised a $160M Series D led by Kleiner Perkins. Rogo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and published security/compliance posture.
r.name: Rogo

r.description: Rogue Wave Software was a developer-tools and high-performance-computing software company known for products such as TotalView, Klocwork, IMSL numerical libraries, PV-WAVE, and its Zend PHP and open-source support lines. It was acquired by Perforce Software in 2019 and the brand has since been fully absorbed into Perforce; the historical roguewave.com domain now 301-redirects wholesale to perforce.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. This enrichment pass found no independent Rogue Wave API surface, developer portal, documentation, or well-known endpoints — everything resolves to Perforce.
r.name: Rogue Wave Software

r.description: Rohirrim is an AI-native Unified Acquisition Platform that automates and accelerates government procurement for both agencies and contractors. Its UnifiedAcquire product helps government agencies manage procurements from market research through award by automating acquisition documents and centralizing institutional knowledge, while UnifiedRespond (RohanRFP) helps companies identify, match, and draft RFP responses faster and at lower cost. The company targets federal agencies, government contractors, Fortune 500 firms, and healthcare organizations, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners. Rohirrim publishes no public developer API surface today; this profile captures its public web, content, and security-posture footprint.
r.name: Rohirrim

r.description: Rohlik (Rohlik Group) is a European online grocery service founded in 2014 by Tomáš Čupr and headquartered in Prague, Czechia. It operates fast, same-day and sub-hour grocery delivery across several markets under local brands — rohlik.cz in Czechia, Knuspr in Germany, Gurkerl in Austria, Kifli in Hungary, and Rohlik in Romania — combining an owned fulfillment/logistics stack with a wide fresh and private-label assortment. On the developer side, Rohlik runs an official hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants search the catalog, build and manage a cart, discover recipes, track and repeat orders, and manage shopping lists on behalf of a signed-in customer, secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect via identity.rohlik.cz. Rohlik is backed by Index Ventures and Partech.
r.name: Rohlik

r.description: Rohm and Haas Company was an American specialty chemicals manufacturer founded in 1909 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company produced electronic materials, specialty polymers, adhesives, coatings, paints, and process chemicals. On April 1, 2009, Rohm and Haas was acquired by The Dow Chemical Company for approximately $18.8 billion in cash and stock. The Rohm and Haas brand has since been largely retired and its product lines, technologies, and businesses have been integrated into Dow (now Dow Inc., NYSE: DOW). Some legacy product brands persist under Dow but the standalone company no longer exists.
r.name: Rohm and Haas

r.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. (Nasdaq: ROIV) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical holding company that accelerates the development and commercialization of medicines through its distinctive "Vant" model, a network of nimble, focused subsidiary companies such as Immunovant, Priovant, and Pulmovant. Founded in 2014, Roivant advances a pipeline spanning immunology, dermatology, and other therapeutic areas, and has delivered multiple FDA approvals and Phase 3 trial successes. Roivant is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; it operates a corporate and investor web presence but publishes no public developer API surface.
r.name: Roivant

r.description: Roivant Sciences (Nasdaq: ROIV) is a holding company that builds focused subsidiary biotech and health-tech operating units called "Vants." Founded by Vivek Ramaswamy in 2014 and now led by CEO Matt Gline, Roivant has launched companies across immunology (Immunovant, Priovant, Covant, PsiThera), pulmonology (Pulmovant), delivery technology (Genevant, Proxima), virtual care (Zest Health), and health-data infrastructure (Datavant, Lokavant). Roivant's most material technology surface is operated by Datavant — the US health-data exchange and tokenization network it co-founded — which connects 80,000+ hospitals and clinics, links data for 100% of US payers, and operates a public EHR data-extraction API under the Healthjump brand. Lokavant operates a customer-only Clinical Trial Intelligence Platform on AWS. The drug-discovery Vants (Immunovant, Priovant, Genevant, etc.) do not expose developer APIs.
r.name: Roivant Sciences

r.description: Rokid is a Chinese AR and AI wearables company that designs smart glasses and the operating system that runs on them. Its consumer line spans Rokid Glasses, Rokid AI Glasses Style, Rokid AR Spatial and Rokid Max 2, and its enterprise line is Rokid Glass3 / Sprite, backed by the YodaOS and YodaOS-Sprite operating systems. Rokid exposes three distinct developer surfaces. The Sprite Enterprise cloud OpenAPI at api.rokid.com covers device management, message push to glasses, AI agent chat logs, RTC remote-collaboration meeting history and AI work-assistant task records, authenticated with a bearer API key issued by sales. Terminal SDKs for the glasses and the companion phone are distributed from Rokid's own Maven repository at maven.rokid.com, with a dated release changelog and a provider-published Agent Skill package for AI coding tools. Separately, the global storefront implements the Universal Commerce Protocol with a live MCP endpoint, an llms.txt and an agents.md for buying agents.
r.name: Rokid

r.description: Rokt is an eCommerce technology platform that uses AI and machine learning to serve personalized non-endemic offers and ads during transaction moments. APIs cover ecommerce placement integrations, conversion event tracking, reporting and analytics, custom audience management, and data governance.
r.name: Rokt

r.description: Roku is the leading TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, offering a comprehensive operating system that powers smart TVs, streaming players, and audio devices. Roku provides a robust developer program for building channel apps, monetizing through Roku Pay, integrating analytics, and controlling devices via the External Control Protocol. The platform supports both BrightScript and SceneGraph frameworks for app development, and the Nabu Cloud developer cloud for managing remote test devices and channel builds.
r.name: Roku

r.description: RolePoint was an employee referral, internal mobility, and talent-acquisition software company that helped recruitment teams source, refer, and redeploy talent through referral programs and internal mobility marketplaces, with a "Connect" API layer for integrating into ATS/HRIS systems such as iCIMS. The company was acquired by Jobvite in 2019 and folded into the Jobvite Talent Acquisition Suite; the standalone rolepoint.com domain no longer resolves and no independent developer portal or API surface remains reachable. It is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company.
r.name: RolePoint

r.description: ROLI (Luminary ROLI Ltd.) is a British music-technology company known for expressive electronic instruments — the Seaboard, LUMI Keys keyboards, and the modular BLOCKS system — together with companion software such as ROLI Dashboard, ROLI Connect, Equator, and ROLI Learn. Its instruments pioneer MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression) for per-note pitch, timbre, and dynamics control. For developers, ROLI publishes first-party SDKs under the github.com/weareroli organization — the C++ BLOCKS-SDK and roli_blocks_basics for building applications that talk to BLOCKS hardware, and the archived mpejs library for MPE MIDI in the browser. ROLI is backed by Balderton Capital and Index Ventures. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with real developer, SDK, and domain-security artifacts.
r.name: roli

r.description: Roll was a social token infrastructure platform for the creator economy, letting creators and communities mint and manage their own branded ERC-20 tokens on the Ethereum blockchain. Founded in 2017 in New York City and backed by Techstars, IOSG Ventures, and Fabric Ventures (a $10M Series A), Roll offered developer APIs and OAuth-based integrations so third-party apps could query tokens and balances. The custodial Roll app and its developer API (docs.tryroll.com / api.tryroll.com) were sunset in April 2025 and permanently shut down on 2025-05-26; the company web surface no longer resolves. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this pass confirms the company is defunct with no live API surface remaining.
r.name: Roll

r.description: Rollbar is a real-time error tracking and monitoring platform for software teams. It automatically captures exceptions and errors from web, mobile, and server-side applications, groups them by root cause, and provides actionable alerts to speed up debugging. Rollbar provides SDKs for over a dozen platforms including JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Swift, .NET, and Java. The REST API enables programmatic management of projects, items, occurrences, deployments, teams, notifications, and source maps. The RQL (Rollbar Query Language) provides SQL-like queries for error analysis.
r.name: Rollbar

r.description: Rollee is an Open Finance / employment-data platform that lets fintechs, lenders, and HR platforms verify the income, employment, and work history of both salaried and self-employed workers in real time. Through a single API and the embeddable Rollee Connect flow, Rollee aggregates data from 70+ sources — gig-economy platforms (Uber, Bolt, Deliveroo, Just Eat, Stuart, and more), government tax portals, payroll systems, and digital wallets — and normalizes it into a common "Rollee Standard" schema covering income, transactions, employment, activity, assets, banking info, documents, and vehicles. It powers consumer lending, vehicle financing, tenant and income verification, earned-wage access, and recruitment / work-history checks. The platform is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR-compliant, and is backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest.
r.name: Rollee

r.description: ROLLER is a cloud-based venue management platform for the attractions and leisure industry — trampoline parks, family entertainment centers, museums, zoos, aquariums, water parks and amusement venues. It unifies ticketing and online bookings, point of sale, memberships and passes, digital waivers, integrated payments, a CRM and guest experience score, self-serve kiosks and gift cards in a single system. ROLLER exposes two public APIs — a real-time REST API for products, sessions, availability and bookings, and a Reporting (Data) API for extracting venue data to external warehouses and BI tools — plus webhooks for event-driven integrations and OCTO API compatibility for channel/distribution partners. API access is an add-on to a ROLLER subscription and is authenticated with OAuth2 client credentials.
r.name: ROLLER

r.description: Rollins is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Rollins API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
r.name: Rollins

r.description: Rolls-Royce plc is a British multinational aerospace and defense company manufacturing aero engines (Trent series), defense propulsion, and power systems. Rolls-Royce does not publish a public developer API. The company operates supplier portals at suppliers.rolls-royce.com and maintains a small GitHub presence with the qc-cfd open-source repository covering quantum computing for computational fluid dynamics research.
r.name: Rolls-Royce

r.description: Rollstack is a business-intelligence reporting automation platform that connects live data from BI and analytics tools directly into presentations, documents, and emails. It lets teams build recurring QBRs, financial decks, board reports, and client scorecards that stay in sync with their underlying data by embedding dashboards and visualizations into Google Slides, Google Docs, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Word, and email, then refreshing them on a schedule. Rollstack integrates with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, Omni, Lightdash, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and Snowflake, and distributes the resulting content through Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Authentication is handled through Auth0 (OpenID Connect) with SAML-based single sign-on. Rollstack is backed by Insight Partners.
r.name: Rollstack

r.description: Rollup is a browser-based, real-time collaboration platform for engineering teams building complex hardware. It supports the full hardware development lifecycle across modular tools for systems engineering, systems modeling, requirements management, technical documentation, CAD viewing, and design reviews, with modules that interlink so changes propagate across a project. Rollup markets first-class APIs and developer-friendly features so teams can integrate it into new and existing systems; the platform exposes a REST API (authenticated with API keys or OAuth tokens) with pagination and websockets. Rollup serves early-stage hardware companies from small satellite builders to robotics firms, and offers Self-hosted and GovCloud options for ITAR/EAR export-controlled data. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Thiel Capital ($5.6M seed) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.
r.name: Rollup AI

r.description: Rome Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 365 datasets.
r.name: Rome Open Data

r.description: Rome Therapeutics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing therapies that target the "repeatome" — the vast repetitive, non-coding regions of the human genome (the "dark genome," including LINE-1 and other transposable elements) implicated in cancer and autoimmune disease. Its discovery engine pairs ROMEMap, a proprietary high-resolution database of annotated functional repeats, with ROMEQuant, a machine-learning method for quantifying repeat expression and prioritizing targets and biomarkers. Backed by a16z and GV, the company raised a $77M Series B (2021) plus a $72M Series B extension to advance its lead program into clinical development. These are internal research/data-science tools; the company publishes no public developer or web API. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.
r.name: Rome Therapeutics

r.description: Rome Tools, Inc. was the company behind Rome, a unified, Rust-based developer toolchain for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, HTML, Markdown, and CSS, intended to consolidate the roles of a formatter, linter, compiler, and bundler (replacing tools like Babel, ESLint, webpack, and Prettier) into a single fast tool. Rome shipped as a command-line tool and VS Code extension rather than as a hosted web service, so it has no REST/HTTP API, OpenAPI, webhook, or event surface. The project's GitHub repository (github.com/rome/tools) was archived on 2026-07-21 as read-only, the rome.tools domain no longer resolves, and the effort has been succeeded by the community-maintained Biome project (biomejs.dev). Rome Tools was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment confirms it is a defunct open-source CLI toolchain with no API surface to catalog.
r.name: Rome Tools

r.description: Rome2Rio is a multi-modal travel planning platform founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2011, and part of the Omio Group since 2019. It covers 240+ countries, 10 million+ locations, and 20,000+ transport operators, enabling door-to-door route discovery across flights, trains, buses, ferries, and driving. Developers can access route search, geocoding, and autocomplete capabilities through the Rome2Rio REST API, which returns JSON responses covering routes, segments, duration, and operator information for any two points worldwide.
r.name: Rome2Rio

r.description: Romit was a bank-agnostic digital wallet and payment-gateway platform for the card-not-present merchant-acquiring industry, built by a team of ex-Robocoin (bitcoin ATM) founders and backed by the 500 Global (500 Startups) accelerator. The Romit Merchant Suite let merchants stop chargebacks, reduce fraud and resolve disputes, while its consumer wallet let customers securely store payment methods, view transactions and communicate with merchants. Its OAuth2 REST API (api.romit.io/v1) exposed Banking (cards + linked bank accounts), Identity/KYC, Transfer (authorize/capture/refund/void money movement), Subscription, Plan and Invoice resources. Romit (romit.io) has since ceased operations; this profile captures the API surface derived from the surviving public evidence.
r.name: Romit

r.description: ROMTech (ROM Technologies, Inc.) is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Brookfield, Connecticut that builds connected orthopedic rehabilitation technology. Its flagship product, the PortableConnect Adaptive Telemed Technology, is a prescription, clinician-delivered home rehabilitation device for patients recovering from total knee replacement, total hip replacement, joint manipulation and ACL repair. Adaptive pedal technology adjusts automatically to a patient's current range of motion across four therapy modes (passive, active-assisted, active and resistance); the AccuAngle Bluetooth wearable measures knee flexion and extension during each session; and the PortableConnect App runs a prescribed protocol of three to five daily sessions over a typical four-to-eight-week plan. Session data — range of motion, adherence and key health metrics — streams to a Clinician Portal where the prescribing surgeon reviews real-time reports and adjusts the protocol remotely, with in-app telemedicine for face-to-face follow-ups. The technology began as the ROM3 Rehab device. ROMTech was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025 and to the LexisNexis Top 100 Global Innovators for 2026, and sells to clinicians, health systems and the Department of Veterans Affairs. ROMTech runs no public developer program: it publishes no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer documentation, and the Clinician Portal at portal.romtech.com is a closed single-page application backed by a private, undocumented API at middleware.romtech.com/api.
r.name: ROMTech

r.description: A community-built, open source HTTP API that returns Ron Swanson quotes from the NBC television series Parks and Recreation. Returns one or more quotes per request as a JSON array of strings, with an optional case-insensitive full-text search over the quote corpus. The service is a small Node.js / TypeScript Express app authored by James Wright and hosted on Heroku.
r.name: Ron Swanson Quotes

r.description: Rondo Energy is an Alameda, California industrial decarbonization company led by CEO John O'Donnell that builds the Rondo Heat Battery (RHB), a thermal energy storage system that converts intermittent wind and solar electricity into heat stored in thousands of tons of refractory brick at temperatures up to 1,500C and returns it as continuous steam, thermal oil, superheated air, or combined heat and power at rated outputs from 2MWth to over 100MWth. The RHB is sold as a drop-in replacement for a fossil-fuel boiler, via capital purchase, lease, or heat purchase agreement, into cement, food and beverage, chemicals, fuels and ethanol, textiles, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceuticals, and direct air capture. Rondo operates the world's largest industrial heat battery and has announced a 90GWh factory plan with Siam Cement Group, backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Catalyst, Energy Impact Partners, Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund, Rio Tinto, SABIC, Aramco Ventures, and the European Investment Bank. Rondo sells hardware and delivered heat, not software: it publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.
r.name: Rondo Energy

r.description: Rondo Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Hayward, California, developing immune-cell engaging bispecific antibodies designed to treat solid tumors by unleashing the immune system while maximizing efficacy and minimizing side effects. Founded in 2019 by Shelley Force Aldred and Nathan Trinklein, its pipeline includes RNDO-564 (Phase 1 for bladder cancer) plus programs targeting ovarian, endometrial, and renal cancers, backed by a Series A led by Canaan and Red Tree Venture Capital and a collaboration with Eli Lilly. Rondo publishes a corporate and pipeline website but exposes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.
r.name: Rondo Therapeutics

r.description: Rondonia Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 14 datasets.
r.name: Rondonia Open Data

r.description: Ronin is an Ethereum sidechain originally built by Sky Mavis to power Axie Infinity and a wider game and NFT economy. The network exposes a standard Ethereum-style JSON-RPC interface on mainnet and the Saigon testnet, the Ronin Explorer, a canonical bridge to Ethereum, and the Skynet Web3 data API for indexed accounts, NFTs, contracts, and transactions. Sky Mavis layers on game and platform APIs (Axie Infinity Origins, AXP, Ronin Market Partner, Ronin Store, Account, Wallet, Gas Sponsoring, Katana Swap) administered through the Ronin Developer Console.
r.name: Ronin Network

r.description: Roofline (RooflineAI GmbH, Köln, Germany) is a 2024 RWTH Aachen University spin-off building a retargetable AI compiler stack for edge deployment. Its three products are an SDK that compiles models ahead of time from any framework — the product page shows a single Python call, attic.compile(model, (input,)) — a lightweight C runtime with Python bindings that executes the compiled model and orchestrates heterogeneous SoCs, and a Performance Dashboard fed by a roofbench command-line tool running nightly benchmarks across hundreds of models for latency, throughput and memory footprint. The stack is built on open-source MLIR and IREE with proprietary hardware-specific optimization on top, and targets NPUs, MCUs and heterogeneous SoCs with quantization (INT8, blocked, symmetric, asymmetric, dynamic), dynamic shapes for on-device LLMs and mixture-of-experts support. Published work includes NXP eIQ Neutron NPU LLM enablement, Vulkan 1.3 and Arm SVE support in IREE, and day-0 support for Liquid AI LFM2. Roofline is a strategic partner of the Edge AI Foundation and raised a seed round from Serena and First Momentum Ventures. It sells compiler licenses to hardware vendors and embedded software teams: there is no developer program, no public API, no documentation host and no registry-published package. Every product page ends at a Contact Sales form, and the only machine-readable document Roofline publishes anywhere is an llms.txt on its marketing site.
r.name: Roofline

r.description: Roofr is an all-in-one roofing software and CRM built for roofing contractors, bundling aerial roof measurement reports, an instant online estimator, digital proposals with e-signature, integrated payments, material ordering, a job calendar, and pipeline/CRM tooling into one platform to help roofers win, run, and close jobs. Roofr does not publish a public developer API or self-serve documentation: the only API key it issues (under Settings and Integrations) exists to connect Roofr to Zapier, and any broader programmatic access is sales-gated behind a demo. Automation for external systems is delivered primarily through Zapier triggers (new Instant Estimator lead, proposal signed, proposal marked lost) rather than a documented REST API. Roofr is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital.
r.name: Roofr

r.description: Roofstock is a residential real estate investment platform and online marketplace for buying, selling, and managing single-family rental (SFR) homes. It gives individual and institutional investors research, analytics, certified property listings, and end-to-end services spanning acquisitions, property management (Mynd), portfolio accounting software (Stessa), tenant screening (RentPrep), asset management, and dispositions across dozens of U.S. markets. The company reports hundreds of thousands of users and over $10B in transacted volume. Roofstock operates a private web API (api.roofstock.com) and a GraphQL endpoint powering its marketplace applications; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, first-party SDKs, or documented API access. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Roofstock's public web surface.
r.name: Roofstock

r.description: Rook is a CNCF graduated cloud-native storage orchestrator for Kubernetes, providing the platform, framework, and support for Ceph distributed storage systems to natively integrate with cloud-native environments. It automates the deployment, configuration, provisioning, scaling, upgrading, and monitoring of storage systems through Kubernetes operators and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), with primary support for Ceph block storage, shared filesystems, and S3-compatible object storage.
r.name: Rook

r.description: ROOK provides a unified Health Data API that aggregates data from wearables, medical devices, electronic health records (EHR), and laboratory results. By offering a single integration point, developers can collect, normalize, and analyze health data across thousands of sources without building multiple connectors. The platform supports real‑time streaming, secure data handling, and comprehensive analytics to enable personalized health insights and interoperability for healthcare applications.
r.name: ROOK

r.description: Rookout is a live application debugging platform founded in 2017 in Tel Aviv, Israel that lets developers set non-breaking breakpoints in running production, staging, and development applications to capture full-stack debug data — variables, stack traces, logs, and metrics — without redeploying, restarting, or stopping services. Rookout pioneered the "live debugger" category for cloud-native and Kubernetes-hosted applications and shipped language agents/SDKs for Python, Java/JVM, Node.js, .NET, Go, and Ruby that attach to running processes and stream snapshots back to the Rookout web IDE or developer's IDE. Dynatrace announced its acquisition of Rookout on July 31, 2023 and closed the deal in Q2 of Dynatrace's fiscal year ending September 30, 2023. The standalone Rookout product has since been folded into the Dynatrace platform as the Dynatrace Live Debugger (and Live Logger), and the rookout.com and docs.rookout.com domains now redirect to dynatrace.com. There is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, webhook catalog, or CLI for Rookout — the developer surface consists entirely of language agents, deployment integration examples, IDE extensions, and the Explorook desktop helper that exposes local source folders to the Rookout web debugger. The Rookout GitHub organization remains public and continues to maintain those agents, tutorials, and integration samples under Apache-2.0.
r.name: Rookout

r.description: Roomi is a consumer roommate- and room-rental matching platform that connects verified renters looking for roommates with people posting available rooms, sublets, spare rooms, and monthly rentals across more than 200 cities. The service offers a searchable listing experience with filters for amenities, duration, and property type, roommate verification and ID/background checks, an in-app booking and messaging system, and a safety-check service. Roomi is delivered primarily through free iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience built on Bubble.io, monetized through premium features such as background checks and listing boosts. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead of DCM Ventures.
r.name: Roomi

r.description: RoomKeyPMS is a cloud property management system (PMS) for independent hotels and small chains across the US and Canada, with a team of hoteliers behind roughly 70,000 managed rooms. Alongside the core PMS it sells Pulse (AI marketing and guest messaging), Embedded Payments, Capital (growth financing), Mobile Guest, a built-in Distribution/CRS module, and an integrations marketplace. RoomKeyPMS publishes a real REST API (JSON or XML, selectable via request header) documented publicly at its support portal under three API types - Pulling Reservation Data, POS, and Statistics and Forecasts. The API is described as "a one-way interface that allows you to draw out key data from your hotel or chain environment" for use in marketing (e.g. exporting guest lists to MailChimp) and BI tools (e.g. Cvent). It is partner-gated - a hotel's IT team must email RoomKeyPMS support and the property must sign off before an API key and per-hotel credentials are issued - so no open self-serve signup or public sandbox exists. Endpoint paths and query parameters below are taken directly from RoomKeyPMS's own published support articles; the exact API base host is inferred from the same documentation (RoomKeyPMS hosts its interactive Help/reference pages alongside the live API) and should be confirmed once credentials are issued.
r.name: RoomKeyPMS

r.description: RoomRaccoon is an all-in-one hotel management software platform for independent hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, hostels, and small chains, founded in 2017 by Tymen van Dyl and Nadja Buckenberger and headquartered in Breda, Netherlands with major operations in Cape Town, South Africa, plus offices in Valencia, Spain and Lisbon, Portugal. The platform bundles a cloud Property Management System (PMS), a Channel Manager that synchronises rates, availability, and restrictions across 200+ OTAs, metasearch engines, GDSs, and bedbanks, a commission-free Booking Engine for direct website bookings with bookable add-ons, RaccoonPay for integrated, multi-currency guest payments, and RaccoonRev for competitor insights and revenue management. RoomRaccoon advertises 400+ integrations with partners such as Booking.com, Expedia, Lightspeed, and Sage, and was named World's Best Hotel Channel Manager at the 2023 World Travel Tech Awards. A connectivity / partner API exists at api.roomraccoon.com (e.g. POS endpoint at /api/?type=POS&version=2) but is access-controlled: prospective integrators must request an API key and Hotel ID by emailing connectivity@roomraccoon.com, and no public OpenAPI specification, public SDKs, or public GitHub organisation are published.
r.name: RoomRaccoon

r.description: Roomstorm is a real-time B2B hotel room marketplace, best known for building the airline industry's first fully automated platform for providing hotel accommodations to distressed passengers during flight disruptions. Founded by Maksim Izmaylov and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2014), the San Francisco company connects airlines, hotels, and travelers so that irregular-operations (IROPS) rebooking, room sourcing, invoicing, and voucher issuance happen programmatically instead of through manual phone calls. Its backend exposes a JSON REST API (documented in API Blueprint) covering authentication, bookings, hotels, rooms, vacancies, organizations, vouchers, and airport search.
r.name: Roomstorm

r.description: Roon is a digital health platform (operating as CareSpace Health Inc.) that helps people navigate serious and critical health conditions by connecting them with trusted answers from leading medical experts. Rather than relying on "Dr. Google" or legacy content sites, Roon publishes thousands of short, doctor-created video answers covering conditions such as ALS, glioblastoma (GBM), dementia, PCOS, fertility, and women's health, organized so patients and caregivers can quickly find vetted guidance for their journey. Founded in 2021 by Vikram Bhaskaran, Arun Ranganathan, and Dr. Rohan Ramakrishna, Roon delivers its experience primarily through consumer iOS apps and its website, and raised a $15M Series A co-led by Forerunner Ventures and FirstMark. Roon is a consumer-facing health information product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.
r.name: Roon

r.description: Roost is a Sunnyvale, California home-telematics company that helps property and casualty insurance carriers modernize homeowners and commercial insurance with smart, in-home sensors and monitoring. Its Protection360 commercial loss-prevention service and Security360 white-label home-security bundle detect water leaks, extreme temperatures, and smoke-alarm events, delivering real-time alerts and risk data to insurers, property owners, and third parties. Roost partners with dozens of top P&C carriers, but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged directly with its engineering team.
r.name: Roost

r.description: Rooster is a subscription mobile reading app built by Plympton, Inc., a literary studio co-founded by Jennifer 8. Lee, Yael Goldstein Love, and Jacky Chang. Rooster delivers serialized fiction to readers' phones in short, commute-sized installments for a flat monthly fee, drawing on Plympton's DailyLit heritage of serialized reading. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Rooster is a consumer-facing app; Plympton publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.
r.name: Rooster

r.description: Root (formerly Slim.ai) is a container and dependency security company backed by Insight Partners. Its "secure supply" platform delivers end-to-end, autonomous vulnerability remediation for container images and application packages: a fleet of AI agents (Agentic Vulnerability Remediation, AVR) researches, patches, tests, and ships Root Patches within minutes of CVE publication, without base-image changes or forced version upgrades. Root operates the Root Image Catalog (cr.root.io), Library Catalog, and OS-package registry (pkg.root.io), and exposes a REST API (api.root.io) for querying patch status, security findings, subscriptions, and pulling SBOM, VEX, and provenance artifacts, plus Standard-Webhooks notifications and a first-party CLI (rootio_patcher).
r.name: Root (fka Slim.ai)

r.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.
r.name: Root Global

r.description: Root Insurance is a usage-based auto insurance company that prices policies primarily based on driving behavior captured via smartphone telematics. Root provides a REST API platform for insurers, MGAs, and distribution partners to build, embed, and operate insurance products — covering quoting, policy administration, claims processing, premium collections, and data management. The Root Bind API enables partners to embed auto insurance quoting and checkout directly into their applications.
r.name: Root Insurance

r.description: ROOTE provides a French-language mobility platform that offers live mobility data, geocoding, nearby transport options, and urban services via a REST API. The service targets developers building AI agents, mobile apps, and location‑based products, delivering real‑time information on transport options, routes, and availability across multiple cities.
r.name: ROOTE

r.description: Rootly is an incident management platform that automates incident response workflows and integrates with existing tools.
r.name: Rootly

r.description: Roper Technologies is a diversified technology holding company (NASDAQ: ROP) that acquires, manages, and develops niche market-leading software and technology-enabled businesses. Over three-quarters of revenue comes from software products across three segments: Application Software (legal, healthcare, government, education, and insurance vertical SaaS), Network Software (construction, transportation, and insurance network platforms), and Technology Enabled Products (medical devices, industrial, and RF identification). Key subsidiaries include Aderant (legal software), Clinisys (laboratory informatics), Deltek (project-based business ERP), Frontline Education (K-12 HR software), Vertafore (insurance technology), IntelliTrans (supply chain visibility), ConstructConnect (construction information), DAT Solutions (freight matching), and iPipeline (life insurance SaaS).
r.name: Roper Technologies

r.description: ROR (Research Organization Registry) is a global, community-led, curated registry of open persistent identifiers for research organizations. It provides unique, stable identifiers (ROR IDs) for over 120,000 universities, companies, government labs, nonprofits, and other organizations involved in scholarly research. The registry is maintained collaboratively by California Digital Library, Crossref, and DataCite, with all data available under the CC0 license. ROR offers a free REST API for querying, searching, and retrieving organization records, and is integrated as the preferred organization identifier across Crossref, DataCite, and ORCID platforms.
r.name: ROR

r.description: Rose Rocket is a Toronto-based transportation management system (TMS) for freight brokers, carriers and 3PLs, sold as an AI-native, configurable operations platform rather than an off-the-shelf template. The product covers order intake, dispatch, tendering, tracking, documents, invoicing and billing, with no-code custom fields, boards and workflows, in-product AI agents (TED, Rosie, Rocky) and role-based access control down to the widget. Its developer surface is the Platform Model API, a single generic object-CRUD REST API served at network.roserocket.com/api/v2/platformModel that reads and writes every domain object — customer, order, task, stop, manifest, commodity, partner, quote, invoice, bill, asset, tag, contact, document — through one set of /objects operations keyed by objectKey, plus user groups, boards, events and webhook destinations. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 (authorization code or client-credentials service account) against an Auth0-hosted authorization server at a.roserocket.com. API access is not self-serve: credentials come from an account representative or the partnership team, and the pricing page lists "unlimited API access" as an Enterprise tier feature.
r.name: Rose Rocket

r.description: Rosebud is an AI-powered journaling application for personal growth, combining journaling, habit-building, and emotional support in one experience. Users write or speak entries and receive conversational AI feedback, long-term pattern recognition, guided modes (including Internal Family Systems), automated weekly insight reports, and voice journaling, with end-to-end encryption for privacy. It is available on iOS, Android, and the web. Rosebud is a consumer product with no public API, SDK, or developer platform; it is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Initialized Capital, and Khosla Ventures.
r.name: Rosebud

r.description: Rosebud AI is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and deploy playable 3D games and interactive worlds from natural-language prompts, a workflow the company calls "Vibe Coding" — you describe scenes, rules, and behaviors and an AI assistant named "Rosie" writes and applies the underlying JavaScript. The platform runs on a custom engine designed for AI-era game development, featuring deterministic WASM-based physics, native real-time multiplayer, instant link-based sharing, and a built-in "Juice API" for camera effects, particle systems, and spatial audio. Founded in 2019 in San Francisco by CEO Lisha Li (Ph.D. in machine learning, UC Berkeley), Rosebud AI is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company ships a hosted consumer product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK packages, MCP server, or developer portal.
r.name: Rosebud AI

r.description: Rosentic is a developer-tools company whose product checks the open branches in a git repository against each other before merge, catching the function-signature mismatches, HTTP route contract breaks, GraphQL/typed-schema conflicts and Protobuf/gRPC changes that pass CI on every branch individually and break main when parallel AI coding agents land together. The engine is deterministic tree-sitter AST analysis across 13 languages with no LLM in the scan path, shipped as a GitHub Action that runs on the consumer's own runner and as rosentic-mcp on PyPI, a local MCP server and CLI with nine tools. Hosted surfaces on api.rosentic.com: Rosentic Remote, an MCP endpoint behind OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; an A2A 0.3.0 agent card with five skills and a live JSON-RPC endpoint; and a Bearer-key REST feed. Detection is free at every tier; paid plans buy stored history and quotas. No OpenAPI is published.
r.name: Rosentic

r.description: Rosetta.ai is a Taipei-based e-commerce personalization and marketing automation platform that uses AI, image recognition, and deep learning to tailor the online shopping experience for every visitor. Its product suite spans Rosetta Engage (AI product recommenders), Rosetta AdMatch (personalized advertising and traffic acquisition), Rosetta Analytics (machine-learning consumer and product insight), and Rosetta Automation (multi-channel EDM, SMS, and LINE marketing). The platform is delivered as a hosted SaaS dashboard and as a Shopify app ("Personalization Upsell Dealer"), integrating with storefronts through Google Tag Manager and product-feed connections rather than a public developer REST API. A first-party REST API does run at api.rosetta.ai — the production tag authenticates to it with a Bearer token and an application/vnd.rosetta-ai.v2+json media type — but Rosetta.ai publishes no reference, no specification and no developer program for it, so it is an internal contract rather than a product. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from Rosetta.ai's public marketing site, GitBook help center, CDN distribution, and GitHub organization.
r.name: Rosetta.ai
