Sira Medical operates as a clinical AR software vendor and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.
s.name: Sira Medical

s.description: Siren is a digital health company that makes temperature-monitoring smart socks to prevent diabetic foot ulcers. The seamless, machine-washable socks require no charging or smartphone; embedded sensors continuously track foot temperature to detect the early inflammation that precedes an ulcer, and licensed nurses review the data and alert the patient's healthcare provider. Siren pairs the hardware with a remote patient monitoring service billed through providers and payers, and operates as a HIPAA-regulated healthcare business rather than a developer platform. It is backed by 500 Global and DCM Ventures. As surveyed for the API Evangelist network, Siren publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.
s.name: Siren

s.description: Siren (Siren Solutions, siren.io) builds the Siren Platform for investigative intelligence: Siren Investigate, an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch-based investigation, link-analysis and search application used by law enforcement, intelligence, cyber and financial-crime teams. Siren Investigate exposes documented REST APIs (Status, Health, Query Generator, Dashboard, Search, Object Definitions, Reconciliation, Refresh Fields) plus a JavaScript scripting API, served from each customer's own self-hosted Siren Investigate instance.
s.name: Siren

s.description: Sirenic is a French pay-per-call API for official company data across France and Europe, built for AI agents. It serves company search and profiles by SIREN/SIRET from INSEE Sirene and INPI RNE, establishments, officers, filed accounts and ratios, BODACC legal alerts, a default-risk score, sanctions screening against six official lists, KYB dossiers, live VIES VAT and IBAN checks with a ready-to-invoice verdict for the 2026 French e-invoicing mandate, public-procurement records, watchlists with Ed25519-signed webhooks, and profiles, accounts and events from thirteen European registers plus LEI/GLEIF groups. Every /v1 route is a GET priced per call ($0.002 to $1.00) and paid either through the x402 protocol in USDC or EURC on Base with no account, or with an srn_live_ API key and prepaid euro credits. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1, llms.txt, an RFC 9727 api-catalog, an MCP server, an A2A agent card, x402 discovery and OAuth metadata from api.sirenic.eu.
s.name: Sirenic

s.description: Siri began as Siri Inc., a spinout of SRI International's CALO artificial-intelligence program, backed by Menlo Ventures and Morgenthaler Ventures. The company shipped an iOS virtual-assistant app in February 2010 and was acquired by Apple in April 2010. Siri now ships as Apple's built-in voice assistant across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and HomePod. There is no independent public REST API or developer portal for Siri; the developer surface is SiriKit, an on-device Apple framework (Intents/App Intents) that lets iOS apps expose actions to Siri rather than call Siri as a web service.
s.name: Siri

s.description: Sirion (SirionLabs) is an AI-native enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. SirionOne manages the full agreement lifecycle - authoring, negotiation, e-signature, a searchable contract repository, metadata and clause extraction, obligation and performance management, and supplier / counterparty governance. The platform exposes REST "Business API & Integrations" capabilities plus pre-built connectors (Salesforce, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, DocuSign, iPaaS) and configurable webhooks, secured with OAuth 2.0 client credentials. API access is enterprise / contract-gated - credentials are provisioned per tenant and the API reference is available to authenticated Sirion users. Endpoint paths and schemas in this entry are MODELED from public product references, not copied from a public reference document.
s.name: Sirion

s.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.
s.name: Sirius

s.description: Sirius XM Holdings is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, providing satellite radio, digital streaming, podcast, and advertising services through SiriusXM, Pandora, and AdsWizz brands. The Pandora Developer API enables partners to build personalized music and podcast streaming experiences using GraphQL. AdsWizz, a SiriusXM company, provides programmatic audio advertising APIs for ad insertion, targeting, and measurement across streaming and podcast platforms.
s.name: Sirius XM

s.description: Siro is an AI sales coaching platform for in-person and field sales teams. Reps record their live sales conversations from the Siro mobile app, and Siro transcribes each conversation, surfaces coaching insights, generates scorecards and summaries, and extracts structured fields (budget, objections, decision makers, timelines) that are pushed back into the team's CRM. Siro publishes a documented REST API and webhook surface that enables fully bidirectional, custom CRM integrations: syncing appointments/engagements, opportunities and accounts into Siro, matching recordings to CRM entities, and pulling recording details, summaries, entity extractions and coaching scorecards back out. The platform ships prebuilt integrations for Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Pipedrive, Zoho, SalesRabbit, Leap SalesPro, Hatch, CompanyCam and a range of dealership DMS and home-services tools. Siro is backed by CRV and Index Ventures.
s.name: Siro

s.description: Sirocco is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Sirocco

s.description: Sirona Medical builds RadOS, the Radiology Operating System — a cloud-native platform that replaces the fragmented legacy radiology IT stack (separate PACS, reporter, diagnostic viewer, and worklist) with one integrated, browser-based system for radiologists and radiology practices. The platform unifies DICOM imaging, structured reports, worklist state, clinical context, and live events behind a single data layer, adds platform AI (auto-impressions, hanging protocols, quality assist, and orchestration of third-party FDA-cleared algorithms), and integrates via managed DICOM, HL7, and FHIR. It is an FDA Class I device platform, SOC 2 Type II certified for six consecutive years, and HIPAA compliant. A public developer surface (the RadOS/Amplify SDK plus a GraphQL API) is announced as on the roadmap; no shipped public API exists yet. Backed by 8vc.
s.name: Sirona Medical

s.description: SirsiDynix is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
s.name: SirsiDynix

s.description: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals

s.description: SIRUM (Supporting Initiatives to Redistribute Unused Medicine) is a nonprofit and the country's largest redistributor of surplus prescription medication. It connects unused, in-date medicine from manufacturers, wholesalers, pharmacies, and nursing homes with patients who cannot afford their prescriptions, operating under drug-donation laws across the United States. SIRUM runs a logistics and matching platform that routes donated medication to community partners and individuals in need, aiming to close the gap for the tens of millions of Americans who skip prescribed medication because of cost. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.
s.name: Sirum

s.description: Image management solutions like optimization, manipulation, hosting
s.name: Sirv

s.description: Sisense is a business intelligence and analytics platform that enables organizations to build and embed analytics into applications and workflows. It provides REST APIs for managing dashboards, data models (Elasticubes and live models), users, groups, data security rules, and builds. The platform supports both extract-based and live data model architectures with comprehensive programmatic administration capabilities.
s.name: Sisense

s.description: Sisu Clinic is a doctor-led medical aesthetics and cosmetic medicine provider that operates a network of clinics offering treatments such as anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, and skin and skincare services delivered by qualified medical practitioners. It is a consumer healthcare brand rather than an API provider - no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface was found on its website or in developer registries during this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.
s.name: Sisu Clinic

s.description: Sisu Data was an a16z-backed augmented-analytics / decision-intelligence startup that automatically surfaced key drivers and anomalies in structured business data. It was acquired by Snowflake in October 2023 and the standalone product and developer surface were subsequently wound down. As of this enrichment pass the sisudata.com domain no longer hosts a product, developer portal, API, or documentation — it 301-redirects to the LinkedIn "Sisu is joining forces with Snowflake" announcement, and its TLS certificate expired in November 2024. No public API surface exists to enrich; this profile is retained as an a16z portfolio record only.
s.name: Sisu Data

s.description: Site24x7 is a full-stack cloud monitoring platform with a REST API for managing monitors, on-call schedules, alerts, SLAs, and accessing availability and performance metrics. The platform covers website uptime, server infrastructure, cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), application performance (APM), real user monitoring (RUM), network devices, databases, and synthetic transactions. The API uses OAuth 2.0 via the Zoho Developer Console and supports multiple regional data centers across the US, EU, India, Australia, Japan, Canada, UK, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.
s.name: Site24x7

s.description: SiteAdvisor, Inc. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: cybersecurity. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: SiteAdvisor, Inc.

s.description: SiteAware is the construction industry's first AI-powered Digital Construction Verification and Quality Management Platform for buildings. It verifies every installed element and flags real-time deviations across structure, envelope, and interior construction, giving field teams and business executives actionable data and analytics to catch issues before they lead to expensive rework. SiteAware is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.
s.name: SiteAware

s.description: Sitecore is a global digital experience platform that combines content management, marketing automation, e-commerce, customer insight, and personalization to help brands deliver personalized customer experiences. Through its developer documentation at doc.sitecore.com and api-docs.sitecore.com, Sitecore provides REST, GraphQL, and event-streaming APIs spanning XM Cloud, Customer Data Platform, Personalize, OrderCloud, Content Hub, and Discover.
s.name: Sitecore

s.description: Sitefinity CMS is a .NET-based content management system developed by Progress Software that provides REST APIs for managing content items, pages, users, roles, taxonomies, media, and e-commerce resources. Developers use the Sitefinity REST API to build headless front-ends, integrate third-party systems, automate content operations, and extend the platform with custom modules.
s.name: Sitefinity CMS

s.description: Sitefire is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform — the marketing suite for the agentic web and a self-described System of Record for AI visibility. It monitors how AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews) mention and cite a brand across tracked topics, diagnoses why content is or isn't cited using its 4C content classification, and generates actionable briefings plus AI-optimized articles that publish directly to CMS platforms such as Webflow and Framer. Sitefire connects to analytics (GA4, Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront) to measure AI referral and crawler traffic, and exposes its data and content workflows to AI agents through an official hosted MCP server (Spark) and a published Agent Skills bundle. A small public, unauthenticated REST API books product demos. Sitefire is a Y Combinator (W2026) company.
s.name: Sitefire

s.description: SiteJabber is a consumer review platform, rebranded as SmartCustomer at smartcustomer.com, where shoppers read and write reviews about online businesses, services and products. Operating for over twenty years, it emphasizes consumer protection through review moderation and verification, and offers a browser extension that surfaces business ratings while users browse. On the business side it is an official Google Review Partner that distributes verified reviews to Google Seller Ratings, Google Business profiles and Google Shopping Ads, and it sells review sourcing, moderation, showcasing widgets, competitive intelligence and e-commerce integrations across four contact-sales packages. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It does publish a developer API: the SmartCustomer Business API, a 31-operation REST surface documented at api.sitejabber.com covering business ratings, consumer reviews and moderation, reviewer messaging, review requests by email and SMS, a full product-review and catalog surface, and two CCPA-shaped customer-privacy operations. A prior enrichment pass recorded no API; that was wrong — the reference is served from the pre-rebrand api.sitejabber.com host, which is not linked from the current consumer or business site navigation.
s.name: SiteJabber

s.description: Siteline is billing and accounts receivable software built specifically for commercial subcontractors (trade contractors). It centralizes pay applications (including AIA G702/G703 progress billing), lien waivers, lien rights, compliance documents, change orders, collections, and A/R reporting in one workflow, replacing the spreadsheets, PDFs, and GC payment-portal logins that AP/AR teams juggle every month. Siteline integrates with construction accounting systems (Sage, Foundation, Viewpoint/Vista, Spectrum, QuickBooks, Acumatica, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, CMiC, and others) and with GC payment portals (Textura, GCPay, Procore Pay) so billing data flows without double entry. Founded in 2019 by Claire Wilson and Gloria Lin, backed by Menlo Ventures and First Round Capital; subcontractors have billed over $10B across 200,000+ projects on the platform. Siteline publishes no public developer API — integrations are managed connections rather than a self-serve API.
s.name: Siteline

s.description: SiteMinder is an Australian hotel commerce platform (ASX SDR) that connects hotels with more than 450 online distribution channels, including OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, Agoda), metasearch sites (Google, Trivago, TripAdvisor), and global distribution systems. Through its developer portal at developer.siteminder.com, SiteMinder publishes five integration APIs spanning property management system connectivity (pmsXchange), booking channel distribution (SiteConnect, Channels Plus), metasearch publication (SMX), and direct booking flows (Direct Booking API). The platform serves more than 53,000 properties across 150 countries and manages over three million hotel rooms.
s.name: SiteMinder

s.description: Profile for SiteOne Landscape Supply in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 904).
s.name: SiteOne Landscape Supply

s.description: SiTera is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of matrix-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: semiconductors. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: SiTera

s.description: Sitetracker is a global software company whose deployment operations management platform is built natively on Salesforce, used to plan, build, operate and maintain critical infrastructure at scale — fiber and wireless networks, towers, data centers, space and satellite, utilities, renewable energy, battery storage and EV charging. The product set spans Project Management, Financial Management, Agreement Management, Field Work Management, Site & Asset Management, Reporting & Analytics, Sitetracker GIS Link, Sitetracker Mobile and the Scout AI assistant. Because the platform is a Salesforce managed package, its programmable surface is the Salesforce Platform API — Sitetracker states that its standard and custom objects are API-ready and reachable over REST, SOAP and Bulk APIs, called against each customer's own Salesforce org rather than a Sitetracker-operated API host. Sitetracker publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; the object and integration documentation sits behind a Salesforce Community login.
s.name: Sitetracker

s.description: Sitoo provides a Retail POS and Unified Commerce Platform, delivering point‑of‑sale solutions for Android and iOS, composable technology, inventory management, self‑checkout, and RFID capabilities. The company serves retailers across fashion, beauty, accessories, furniture, jewelry, luxury, sports, and more, offering integrated commerce experiences and partner ecosystems. Sitoo’s platform is MACH‑certified, enabling flexible, API‑first integrations for modern retail operations.
s.name: Sitoo

s.description: SIX operates the financial market infrastructure of Switzerland and Spain, including SIX Swiss Exchange, BME, and Swiss interbank clearing and securities services, alongside SIX Financial Information, one of the largest global market data vendors. It sells real-time, intraday, end-of-day, and historical pricing, reference data, corporate actions, and regulatory/ESG datasets from more than 900 price sources, delivered via the SIX Web API (REST/JSON, GraphQL, WebSocket), the SIX Bulk API, streaming Market Data Feed, SIX Flex and Valordata Feed files, and Snowflake cloud shares. A public developer portal at developer.six-group.com fronts the bLink open banking platform, the debiX debit card API, and a shared Kong-based API catalog with Swiss interbank clearing and settlement APIs. Financial data access is enterprise and sales-gated with MTLS certificate authentication, while several Swiss payment infrastructure APIs are publicly documented with downloadable OpenAPI.
s.name: SIX

s.description: Six Deg is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Six Deg

s.description: Six Sigma is a data-driven process improvement methodology that uses statistical analysis to reduce defects and variability in business processes, targeting fewer than 3.4 defects per million opportunities. Organizations across manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and technology adopt Six Sigma frameworks (DMAIC for improvement, DMADV for design) to drive quality excellence, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction. APIs in this domain connect quality management systems, statistical analysis tools, process mining platforms, and business intelligence systems.
s.name: Six Sigma

s.description: Sixfold is a New York City-headquartered AI company building purpose-built artificial intelligence for insurance underwriting across Property & Casualty and Life & Health lines. Founded by Alex Schmelkin (CEO, previously co-founder of Unqork), Jane Tran (COO), and Brian Moseley (CTO, previously Head of Developer Experience at American Express), Sixfold processes unstructured submissions, automates risk research, produces appetite fit scores, generates cited case narratives, and applies underwriting guidelines consistently across submissions. The platform classifies risk using industry standards (SIC, NAICS, ISO), supports 40+ P&C and Life & Health business lines, and deploys either standalone or via a flexible API into existing underwriting workbench, CRM, and policy administration systems. Customers include Zurich North America, Guardian, Generali GC&C, Skyward Specialty, AXIS, and Mosaic Insurance, collectively representing roughly $265B in gross written premium. The company raised a $30M Series B in January 2026 and operates from offices in New York City and Lloyd's of London. Sixfold is the named provider behind these capabilities and is distinct from Cytora, a separate UK-based insurance AI provider. The platform is sold as enterprise SaaS to insurance carriers; there is no public self-serve developer portal, public API reference, SDKs, or open-source release — API integration is delivered under enterprise engagement.
s.name: Sixfold

s.description: Sixt is a global mobility services provider offering car rental, ride‑hailing, and subscription services. With a heritage spanning over a century, Sixt operates in more than 110 countries, delivering premium vehicles and flexible booking options through its website and mobile apps. The company emphasizes digital transformation, providing customers with online reservations, fleet management, and a range of mobility solutions tailored to business and leisure travelers.
s.name: Sixt

s.description: Sizable Energy is a Milan, Italy based clean-energy company developing offshore pumped hydro energy storage. Its patented system pairs subsea and floating reservoirs connected by pipes with reversible pump-turbines that move saturated sea-salt brine between them to deliver long-duration, grid-scale energy storage. The modular, scalable design leverages proven pumped-hydro technology with zero land use and integrates with floating wind and solar installations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.
s.name: Sizable Energy

s.description: SJ is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: stockholm-trip) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.
s.name: SJ

s.description: SJSemi (SJSemiconductor (Jiangyin) Corp.) is a Chinese semiconductor Middle-End-Of-Line (MEOL) pure-play foundry and outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) provider, founded in 2014 as a joint venture between JCET and SMIC and headquartered in the Jiangyin High-Tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu, with offices in Shanghai and Santa Clara, California. The company operates a 12-inch wafer bumping, wafer-level chip-scale packaging, chip probing and final-test line, and supplies advanced packaging and 3D multi-die integration services — Cu pillar, RDL, fan-out, TSV and silicon interposer 2.5D — into smartphone, 5G communications, high-performance computing, data-center and automotive electronics supply chains. It is a contract manufacturer of physical semiconductor packaging services and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface contract.
s.name: SJSemi

s.description: SK Finance Ltd (skfin.in) is a Jaipur, India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) providing asset-backed retail lending. Its products span commercial vehicle, car, tractor, construction-equipment and two-wheeler loans alongside secured business loans and home-renovation / mortgage finance, delivered through a physical branch network with EMI calculators, online EMI payment, a branch locator, a loan-application portal and a customer "Refer and Earn" referral program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate/marketing website (Next.js) with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or other machine-readable API surface.
s.name: SK Finance

s.description: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. is South Korea's largest mobile network operator, headquartered at SK T-Tower in Jung-gu, Seoul, and the telecom arm of SK Group. It runs the country's largest 5G and LTE network, sells fixed broadband and IPTV through subsidiary SK Broadband, operates the T world retail and care channel, and has repositioned itself as an "AI company" around its A.X sovereign Korean LLM family, the NUGU voice assistant, and the A. (A dot) assistant. Its position in the telecom value chain is that of a facilities-based incumbent carrier: it owns the radio access network, spectrum, SIM base, and identity rails that the rest of the Korean digital economy authenticates against. Its API posture is split in an unusual way. SK Telecom does run a genuine, self-serve public developer portal — SK open API at openapi.sk.com, operated by SK Telecom Co., Ltd. — but what it publishes there is AI, big-data and mobility product APIs (speech synthesis, face recognition, congestion and floating-population analytics, video analysis), not network APIs. The legacy T developers subdomains developer.sktelecom.com and developers.sktelecom.com both resolve in DNS to 211.188.149.18 and refuse connections on port 443 — a dead developer programme with dangling hostnames. On the network-API side SK Telecom is a named CAMARA participant and appears in the CAMARA landscape as an operator, has an organisation page in GSMA's Open Gateway directory, signed a domestic MoU with KT and LG Uplus in October 2024 to standardise six network APIs through Korea's TTA, endorsed the Bridge Alliance API Exchange, and signed an MoU with Aduna through subsidiary SK telink in September 2025 — but no CAMARA endpoint (Number Verification, SIM Swap, KYC Match, Quality on Demand) is callable from any SK Telecom-operated developer portal. Developers who want SK Telecom network capability reach it through aggregators — Bridge Alliance BAEx on Singtel's Paragon platform, surfaced through Nokia's Network as Code developer portal, or Aduna — not from SK Telecom directly.
s.name: SK Telecom

s.description: SK Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm run by general partners Paul Kedrosky and Eric Norlin that backs science-driven founders who are deep domain experts in their startup's field. The firm invests around themes surfaced through the founders' technology conferences (Defrag, Glue) — identity, software infrastructure, security, and emerging technologies — providing early capital, practical guidance, connections, and pathways to later funding rounds. Its portfolio spans 50+ companies including Blockstream, Wealthfront, Rachio, Sphero, Premise, FullContact, and Klue, with notable exits including FanDuel, Remitly, Cloudability, and Kinvey. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and profiled in the API Evangelist network; SK Ventures publishes a marketing website but no public API surface.
s.name: SK Ventures

s.description: Skai (formerly Kenshoo) is an AI-powered commerce media platform that helps brands and agencies centralize retail media, paid search, and paid social data, then plan, activate, optimize, and measure omnichannel marketing campaigns across Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Walmart, Instacart, Kroger, Target and 120+ other publishers and marketplaces. Skai publishes a real, anonymously readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 contract — 117 paths, 158 operations, 155 schemas — served through a Redoc developer hub at developers.skai.io and callable at services.kenshoo.com, covering reporting (synchronous and asynchronous), bulk entity management, campaigns, ad groups, ads, portfolios, product groups, custom columns, incrementality testing and budget pacing. Alongside the REST API, Skai runs first-party hosted MCP servers at mcp.kenshoo.com — a read-only Reporting MCP and a write-access Operations MCP for bid, budget and status changes with preview and approval — authenticated with OAuth 2.0 or a 90-day personal access token. Products include Celeste AI (a GenAI commerce-media agent), the Skai Data Hub, Retail Media, Search & Social, Omnichannel Planning, and Digital Shelf Optimization.
s.name: Skai (Kenshoo)

s.description: Skale Labs is the team behind SKALE, an Ethereum-compatible, zero-gas-fee blockchain network positioned as "the blockchain for a billion agents" with programmable privacy. SKALE runs application-specific L1 SKALE Chains on Base and Ethereum with instant finality and no user gas fees, and exposes an Ethereum JSON-RPC API plus first-party SDKs (BITE threshold-encryption, MPP machine payments), a SKALE CLI built for AI agents, a hosted documentation MCP server, and installable Agent Skills. It supports agentic commerce via the x402 payment protocol and ERC-8004 onchain identity, and native programmable privacy through threshold encryption (encrypted and conditional transactions, confidential tokens).
s.name: Skale Labs

s.description: Skan AI is an enterprise process-intelligence and agentic-AI platform that observes how work actually happens across desktop, web, mainframe, legacy, VDI, and office applications without integrations, then distills those observations into a "context graph of work" that powers AI agents to execute complex business processes. The platform layers Observation, Distillation, Context (Agent Operating Procedures), Agents, and Control, and ships as Process Intelligence, Engineering Intelligence, and an AI Agent Builder. Skan serves financial services, insurance, healthcare, high tech, and energy/utilities with in-environment processing so customer data never leaves the enterprise perimeter. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. Skan is an enterprise SaaS product; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — its documentation portal is gated and its architecture is described as cloud-native and API-first for in-product integration only.
s.name: Skan

s.description: Skandia is a Swedish financial services company offering pensions, insurance, and banking solutions. The company provides a range of products for private individuals and businesses, focusing on retirement planning, savings, and investment services. It operates primarily in Sweden and aims to help customers secure their financial future through tailored financial products and advisory services.
s.name: Skandia

s.description: Skanska is a global construction and development company delivering complex building and infrastructure projects across diverse market sectors. With a focus on sustainability, innovation, and community impact, Skanska builds for a better society, offering services in commercial development, transportation infrastructure, and building construction worldwide.
s.name: Skanska

s.description: Skatteverket is Sweden’s national tax authority, responsible for tax collection, registration, and enforcement for individuals and businesses. It provides a wide range of e‑services, including tax filing, personal identification numbers, and information on duties and benefits. The agency aims to simplify tax processes through digital services and transparent communication with the public.
s.name: Skatteverket

s.description: Skechers U.S.A. is an American lifestyle and performance footwear company (Fortune 500) that designs, develops, and markets a diverse range of footwear for men, women, and children across 170+ countries. Skechers operates direct-to-consumer digital commerce through its website and mobile app, wholesale partnerships with retailers, and a global network of owned and franchised retail stores. Their digital commerce infrastructure relies on e-commerce APIs for product catalog management, inventory, order management, customer accounts, and loyalty programs.
s.name: Skechers U.S.A.

s.description: Skedulo is the Deskless Productivity Cloud, a field service and mobile workforce management platform used by enterprises to schedule, dispatch, optimize, and track deskless workers. Its developer platform exposes 21 REST services (scheduling, availability, optimization, rules, notifications, resource tracking, geoservices, files, configuration, onboarding and more) plus a full GraphQL API, webhooks and triggered actions for real-time events, a `sked` CLI, first-party SDKs and UI components, and an MCP server. Authentication is via Bearer JWT API tokens, with regional API hosts for the US, AU, UK and CA. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.
s.name: Skedulo

s.description: Skeleton Technologies is an Estonian-German energy storage manufacturer, founded in Tartu, Estonia in 2009 by Oliver Ahlberg and Taavi Madiberk, that designs and builds high-power supercapacitor and SuperBattery systems on its patented Curved Graphene material. Its product line spans SkelCap ultracapacitor cells, supercapacitor modules, and the GrapheneUPS, GrapheneGPU and GrapheneBBU power systems aimed at AI data centers, grid stability, defense, automotive, heavy transportation and industrial customers. The company has raised close to EUR 400 million, counts Marubeni and Siemens among its backers, and manufactures at its ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 certified Leipzig Superfactory in Germany, a Varkaus facility in Finland and a Curved Graphene plant in Bitterfeld-Wolfen. Skeleton sells physical power hardware; it operates no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.
s.name: Skeleton Technologies

s.description: Skello is a European (French) workforce management SaaS for shift-based businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and health. It provides employee scheduling and shift planning, time and attendance tracking, absence and leave management, labor-cost and legal-compliance controls, team communication, and payroll preparation exports. Skello is a Partech portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Skello publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or status page; integrations are delivered through its own partner program rather than a documented public API.
s.name: Skello

s.description: SkenarioLabs is a Helsinki-based real estate finance data intelligence company (founded 2015) that turns fragmented building data into auditable, asset-level intelligence for European banks and financial institutions. From a single address it reconstructs complete building profiles covering automated valuation, climate and transition risk, energy performance, technical condition, and renovation potential — aligned with CRREM, EU Taxonomy, ECB, EBA, CRR3, MEPS, and SFDR frameworks. It serves 200+ institutional clients monitoring over 60 billion euros of collateral and scores more than one million assets monthly. SkenarioLabs delivers its intelligence ad hoc into loan origination, portfolio audit, and continuous risk-monitoring workflows rather than through a public self-serve developer API.
s.name: SkenarioLabs

s.description: Skeps is a business-to-business embedded finance and pay-over-time platform that lets merchants and lenders offer point-of-sale financing directly inside their own websites, retail stores, and one-to-one sales channels. Built as a microservices platform, Skeps embeds banking and lending services into the buyer journey: its patented technology securely and in real time matches a customer to the best financing offer from a multi-lender network of national banks, credit unions, and fintech lenders, powering pre-approval, offer testing, and checkout financing. Skeps serves verticals including home improvement, retail, telecom, travel and hospitality, health and wellness, automotive, veterinary, financial institutions, and cobrand card programs. It operates an enterprise, request-a-demo sales model and is backed by Accel; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from its public web surface.
s.name: Skeps

s.description: Sketch is a digital design tool for Mac providing a REST API for managing workspaces, documents, libraries, components, prototypes, and share links in the Sketch cloud collaboration environment. The Cloud REST API (api.sketch.cloud/v1) supports Personal Access Token and OAuth 2.0 authentication, enabling workspace member management, document access, and SCIM provisioning for enterprise identity workflows.
s.name: Sketch

s.description: SketchDeck.ai is a B2B SaaS company whose flagship product, LIFT, is AI-powered material takeoff and counting software for the structural steel fabrication and erection industry. LIFT analyzes uploaded blueprints and shop drawings to automatically extract quantities and generate Bills of Materials, with claimed 95-99% accuracy and up to an 80% reduction in takeoff time so estimators can complete bids in minutes rather than hours or days. The platform adds revision management and exports data to industry estimating programs; the company reports more than $25 billion in projects bid through LIFT to date. SketchDeck.ai is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-request website only - there is no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification surface to catalog.
s.name: Sketchdeck.ai

s.description: Sketches are probabilistic data structures used in computing and data engineering to approximate answers to queries over large data streams with controlled error bounds and dramatically reduced memory requirements. Common sketches include Count-Min Sketch (frequency estimation), HyperLogLog (cardinality estimation), Bloom Filter (membership testing), and T-Digest (quantile estimation). APIs in this domain include sketch-native databases like Apache DataSketches, Redis probabilistic data structures, and cloud analytics services that implement sketch algorithms for real-time analytics, approximate query processing, and streaming analytics.
s.name: Sketches

s.description: Sketchfab is the largest dedicated platform for publishing, sharing, discovering, buying, and embedding interactive 3D content on the web. Founded in Paris in 2012 by Cedric Pinson and Alban Denoyel and acquired by Epic Games on July 21, 2021, Sketchfab hosts millions of 3D models from artists, museums, scanning rigs, and studios — much of it Creative Commons licensed. The platform exposes a public REST Data API for programmatic upload and content management, a JavaScript Viewer API for controlling the embedded WebGL/WebXR viewer, a Download API delivering glTF/GLB/USDZ, an oEmbed endpoint, and OAuth 2.0 authentication, alongside native exporters for every major 3D / DCC tool. Following the Fab.com launch in 2024 the Sketchfab Store has been retired into Epic's unified content marketplace while the publishing, viewing, and developer APIs remain on sketchfab.com.
s.name: Sketchfab

s.description: SketchPro is an AI copilot for Autodesk Revit that helps architects and engineers automate construction documentation directly inside their live project models. Delivered as a native Revit plugin (not a public developer API), it executes natural-language instructions to handle dimensioning, tagging, view creation, sheet setup, and scheduling, while adapting to each firm's standards, naming conventions, and documentation logic through an admin-configured AI Knowledge Base. Founded in 2023 and used by architecture practices including SOM, 10 Design, and Little, SketchPro is backed by Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or event/webhook surface; API access is described as "contact vendor / not publicly documented."
s.name: Sketchpro

s.description: Skew is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Skew

s.description: Skience, a product of The Athene Group, is a wealth management technology company that delivers a Salesforce-based platform for firms undergoing digital transformation. Its platform serves broker-dealers, registered investment advisors (RIAs), and enterprise wealth management organizations with digital client and advisor onboarding, automated account opening, data management and aggregation, and advisor productivity tooling built natively on the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud ecosystem. Skience is backed by Insight Partners and operates as a private SaaS provider; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, but it does maintain a SafeBase-hosted trust center documenting SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 2 + HITRUST attestations and a responsible disclosure program.
s.name: Skience (The Athene Group)

s.description: Skild AI is a Pittsburgh-founded robotics AI company developing the Skild Brain, a general-purpose, omni-bodied physical AI system intended to control many different robot embodiments across many tasks without being tied to a specific hardware design. The company is initially targeting three application platforms: security and inspection robots that can navigate dangerous environments, mobile manipulation systems combining grasping and navigation, and autonomous packing with dexterous skills. Skild publishes a research blog discussing topics such as learning from humans and video data. The company is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Felicis, SoftBank, Bezos Expeditions, and other investors. Skild AI does not currently publish a public API, SDK, model weights, or developer documentation; commercial engagement appears to run through direct partnerships and pilots.
s.name: Skild AI

s.description: Skillbridge (skillbridge.co) was a New York-based online marketplace for freelance consultants and independent professionals, connecting organizations from Fortune 500 companies to early-stage startups with vetted specialists for short-term engagements. Founded in 2013, it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. Skillbridge was acquired by Toptal in 2016 and folded into what became Toptal Business; the skillbridge.co domain now 301-redirects to toptal.com/finance. The company operates no independent developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or event surface, so there are no technical artifacts to enrich.
s.name: Skillbridge

s.description: Skilljar is a customer education and external learning management (LMS) platform, now part of Gainsight, used to build, publish, and measure training academies, courses, learning paths, and certification programs for customers and partners. Its REST API provides comprehensive programmatic access to the platform: courses and lessons, published courses and catalog pages, learning paths, training domains, users and groups, enrollments and progress, quizzes and question banks, purchases and promo codes, instructor-led and virtual (VILT) training, and real-time webhooks. The published OpenAPI 3.0.3 definition covers 160 paths and 340 operations across 420 schemas, with an HTTP Basic API-key v1 surface and a newer v2 OAuth 2.0 surface (PKCE, ~89 scopes).
s.name: Skilljar

s.description: Skills Directory (skillsdirectory.com) is a security-first directory of agent skills for Claude, Claude Code and other coding agents. It indexes over 100,000 skills, scans each one automatically for credential reads, network exfiltration, unpinned remote code and prompt-injection vectors, and publishes a public A-F security grade. It offers a key-authenticated REST API (v1) for listing, searching and scanning skills, a public Registry API for CLI installers, live security-grade badges, and a hosted MCP server for Claude Code for Pro members.
s.name: Skills Directory

s.description: Skillshare is a New York City–based online learning community for creators, founded in 2010 by Michael Karnjanaprakorn and Malcolm Ong. The platform hosts thousands of on-demand video classes across creative disciplines — illustration, design, photography, animation, lettering, film, productivity, writing, and business — taught by working creators and industry professionals. Skillshare operates on a paid subscription model (Premium membership) that grants members unlimited access to the class catalog, project-based learning, and a discussion community where students submit class projects for feedback. The company has a teacher revenue-share program in which class creators are paid based on watch time and student enrollments, and runs Skillshare for Teams as a B2B offering for organizations to give employees access to the catalog. Skillshare does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, partner API, or SDK. The platform's programmatic surface is limited to internal web/mobile clients and an affiliate/marketing referral program; there is no documented developer portal, public webhook system, or third-party integration API for the Skillshare catalog, enrollments, watch-time, or teacher-payout data.
s.name: Skillshare

s.description: Skillsync gives AI coding sessions a permanent home — "GitHub for your agent sessions." Developers install the `skl` CLI, sign in once through the browser, and publish a coding session; they can then revisit past work, share the full context behind a change, and turn workflows that worked into reusable skills. The CLI discovers sessions from Claude Code (full support), Codex and OpenCode (beta), and also pi, Campfire, Cursor, Grok, Amp, and Antigravity, and ships a Model Context Protocol server (`skl mcp`) that gives an assistant a long memory over past and published sessions. Skillsync is a Y Combinator (W2026) company; it exposes no public REST API — the CLI and its bundled MCP server are the integration surface.
s.name: Skillsync

s.description: SkimBit Ltd, operating as Skimlinks, is a London-founded content-monetization and affiliate-marketing platform (now part of Taboola) that helps publishers and content creators earn commerce revenue from the products and merchants they mention in editorial content. Skimlinks automatically affiliates outbound merchant links, tracks the resulting clicks and commissions across thousands of affiliate networks and merchant programs, and pays publishers a share of the revenue. For developers, Skimlinks exposes a suite of publisher-facing REST APIs — the Merchant API (merchant programs, domains, verticals and offers), the Reporting API (raw commissions, aggregated performance, trending/purchased products, payment status and deactivated merchants) and the Product Key API (product details, pricing, availability and merchant alternatives across a billion+ product offers) — plus the Skimlinks JavaScript on-page monetization script and a batch Data Pipe delivering event-level clicks, impressions, commissions and product-purchase data to cloud storage.
s.name: SkimBit

s.description: Skimmer is pool-service business management software (customers, bodies of water, service stops and routes, work orders, quotes, invoices, and billing) used by residential and commercial pool-service companies. Skimmer exposes a real, documented public REST API at https://publicapi.getskimmer.com, with a Zudoku-based developer portal at https://devportal.getskimmer.com. The API is enterprise-oriented and access is sales-led - it is available only on Skimmer's top ("Owning the Market" / Enterprise) tier and provisioned through Skimmer's sales team rather than self-service signup. Authentication is via a per-account skimmer-api-key request header, and the API is rate limited to 500 requests per minute per key.
s.name: Skimmer

s.description: SKIMS is an American shapewear, loungewear, and apparel brand co-founded in 2019 by Kim Kardashian with Jens and Emma Grede, headquartered in Los Angeles. It sells solutionwear, underwear, loungewear, swim, and ready-to-wear direct-to-consumer through skims.com and via wholesale partners, and is the official underwear partner of the NBA, WNBA, and USA Basketball. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Thrive Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. This consumer retail brand publishes no public developer API surface; the profile carries a live domain-security probe of its web infrastructure.
s.name: Skims

s.description: Skinory offers a free, public read‑only JSON API delivering real‑time CS2 and CS:GO skin price data, historical price trends, Steam inventory valuation, and detailed statistics for professional teams and players. The service operates without authentication for basic limits, supports optional API keys for higher quotas, and enforces open CORS for client‑side use. Comprehensive documentation, including endpoint details, rate limits, and licensing information, is available at https://skinory.io/en/developers, with the full OpenAPI 3.1 specification provided at /api/openapi.json.
s.name: Skinory (submitted as g2push)

s.description: Skinseoul Lab operates skin-seoul.com, a direct-to-consumer Korean beauty (K-beauty) e-commerce brand selling skincare and cosmetics to international customers, backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a Next.js storefront fronted by Cloudflare with an Express commerce backend; enrichment probing (2026-07-21) found no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. The api.skin-seoul.com host returns only a plaintext "OK" health response, indicating an internal storefront backend rather than a documented public API.
s.name: Skinseoul Lab

s.description: Skio is a subscription-management platform for Shopify DTC brands (acquired by Recharge in 2026), powering recurring orders, passwordless subscriber portals, and one-click Shop Pay checkout. Its public developer API is GraphQL-first, served from https://graphql.skio.com/v1/graphql, with a data model that mirrors Shopify GraphQL objects - most entities carry a platformId holding the corresponding Shopify GID. Read queries use Hasura-style where/order_by/limit/offset arguments; writes are purpose-built mutations (createSubscription, cancelSubscription, pauseSubscription, applyDiscountCode). A newer public REST API has also been announced.
s.name: Skio

s.description: Skip (originally Skip Protocol, skip.money) is the interchain infrastructure company that rebranded to Cosmos Labs and is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Interchain Foundation, leading engineering and growth for the Cosmos blockchain stack. Its skip.money and skip.build domains now redirect to cosmos.network. The team maintains the open-source Cosmos SDK, the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol (IBC), the CometBFT consensus engine, and Cosmos EVM — the most widely adopted Layer 1 blockchain toolkit, deployed across 200+ chains. There is no independent Skip-branded hosted API; the public developer surface is the Cosmos SDK node REST + gRPC interfaces documented at docs.cosmos.network, with source on the cosmos GitHub organization.
s.name: Skip

s.description: Skip Scooters (operated by Skip Transport / Waybots) was a San Francisco-based dockless shared electric scooter (micromobility) startup and one of the early operators permitted in San Francisco, also running fleets in Washington, D.C. Backed by Accel, the company wound down and its assets moved to Helbiz around 2020. It is no longer operating: its former consumer app and rider domains (rideskip.com is a parked for-sale domain, skip.com now resolves to an unrelated retailer) have no live developer, documentation, or API surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical portfolio-company record; the enrichment pipeline found no public API to harvest.
s.name: Skip Scooters

s.description: Skipjaq, Inc. was a machine-learning performance-optimisation startup that marketed itself as "Performance Optimisation as a Service" and was backed by Accel. Its proprietary automated workload-optimisation software ran repeated optimization tests against a customer's application (hosted in the cloud on AWS EC2 instances behind Elastic Load Balancers) and used machine learning to tune configuration for better application performance, throughput, and latency without manual, expert tuning. The product was delivered as a cloud SaaS and was offered under a beta test agreement. The company is now defunct: the skipjaq.com domain no longer resolves on any common TLD (.com/.io/.ai/.co.uk all return no A/NS records as of 2026-07-21), the last archived snapshot of the site dates to May 2025, and there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, first-party SDK, or live API surface. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio lead.
s.name: Skipjaq

s.description: SkipOdds is a sports-odds data API from SkipSeek Inc. that publishes de-vigged consensus win probabilities — the SkipOdds Index — across 13 sports: soccer, American football, basketball, baseball, hockey, college football, college basketball, tennis, golf, cricket, rugby, MMA and boxing. Every surveyed bookmaker price for a market is averaged and stripped of its margin so the returned probabilities sum to exactly 100%, with fair decimal odds, the number of books surveyed, and the margin removed carried alongside. The surface covers fixtures, tournament outrights, line movement over a configurable window, and threshold-triggered webhook alerts, and is offered three ways: a public OpenAPI 3.0.3 REST contract, an anonymous streamable-http MCP server, and a keyless embeddable widget. Data is informational only — no bets are taken, no funds held, and no bookmaker names exposed.
s.name: SkipOdds

s.description: Skippr builds "The Live AI Employee" — real-time AI agents that see, talk, and operate software. Its embeddable voice/vision agents demonstrate products, onboard new users, join customer video calls, and complete software tasks autonomously, so teams can drop an AI employee into their product, meetings, and internal tools. Skippr also ships a browser extension that runs AI product reviews from a PM, designer, content-strategist, and accessibility perspective, plus a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that feeds those findings to AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. Developers integrate via the @skippr/live-agent-sdk npm package. Skippr is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified.
s.name: Skippr

s.description: SkipTheDishes is a Canadian online food-delivery marketplace headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, founded in 2012 and acquired by Just Eat (now Just Eat Takeaway.com) in 2016, under which it operates as the group's Canadian brand. It connects diners with local restaurants and a network of independent couriers for on-demand food delivery and pickup across Canadian cities via its consumer website and mobile apps, and runs a restaurant partner onboarding program and a courier (Skip Network) program. As of this enrichment pass SkipTheDishes publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. The primary domain is served behind Cloudflare bot protection and the partner/partners subdomains are static marketing/onboarding pages, so no OpenAPI, webhook, or SDK surface is available to harvest.
s.name: Skipthedishes

s.description: Skipton Building Society is a UK mutual building society founded in 1853 and headquartered in Skipton, North Yorkshire. It is the fourth-largest building society in the United Kingdom, owned by and run for the benefit of its members rather than shareholders, and is the parent of the wider Skipton Group (which includes the Connells estate-agency group and Skipton International). Skipton is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and PRA, and is a member of the Building Societies Association. Its core business is retail savings and residential mortgages together with financial advice; it does not offer personal current accounts. Within UK Open Banking (PSD2 / OBIE) Skipton has historically acted as a consumer of Open Banking data - notably using Experian's Open Banking service to verify mortgage-affordability from applicant bank data - rather than as an account-servicing payment service provider (ASPSP) publishing a public developer platform. As of this profile Skipton exposes no public developer portal and is not listed among the CMA9 or the wider set of banks and building societies that publish live UK Open Banking Open Data or Read/Write APIs; the Open Banking API entries below are represented as the shared OBIE standard the society would conform to if it published these surfaces, and are explicitly unverified for Skipton.
s.name: Skipton Building Society

s.description: Skiptown is a modern pet-care company operating premium dog daycare, boarding, grooming, and walking services alongside its signature Dog Bar & Park — an indoor/outdoor social club where owners enjoy craft cocktails and coffee while dogs play off-leash. Backed by Techstars, Skiptown runs company-owned locations in Charlotte, Atlanta, and Denver and offers franchise expansion opportunities. Its consumer experience is delivered through a mobile app for booking, curbside dropoff, and daily photo updates. Skiptown does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and security posture.
s.name: Skiptown

s.description: Skool is an all-in-one community platform that combines discussion communities, online courses, live calls, and gamification in a single product, founded by Sam Ovens and popularized in partnership with Alex Hormozi. As of this review, Skool does NOT publish an official public or partner developer REST API. The only official programmatic surface is a Zapier integration, gated to the paid Pro plan, that exposes a small set of triggers and actions via a per-group API key used solely to link a Skool group to Zapier - it is not a general-purpose developer API. All broader "Skool API" offerings found in the wild (Apify actors, docs.skoolapi.com, reverse-engineered clients, Chrome extensions) are unofficial third-party tools built on Skool's undocumented internal endpoints and are not endorsed or supported by Skool. This catalog entry is an honest gated stub: no public API surface is modeled because none is documented.
s.name: Skool

s.description: Skootar is a Thai on-demand courier, messenger, and logistics platform serving Bangkok, its surrounding provinces, and Chonburi. It offers same-day document delivery, cheque and bill collection, parcel shipping, business food delivery, and on-demand pickup-truck and moving jobs across a fleet of motorcycles, cars, and trucks, all with real-time tracking. Orders can be placed 24/7 through the website, the mobile app, or an API intended for high-volume businesses to wire delivery ordering into their own back-office systems. Skootar reports more than 130,000 business customers, 26,000+ drivers, and 9.2 million+ completed deliveries over 12 years, and is backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is published; API access is arranged through its business/enterprise channel.
s.name: Skootar

s.description: Skopenow is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) platform built to modernize digital investigations. Founded in 2015 and backed by Techstars, it fuses public records, consumer data, crime data, news, and online content with AI-powered fraud and threat-detection models to generate intelligence reports on entities, uncover and visualize networks between people and organizations, and surface operational risks. Its product suite spans Grid, Pre-Check, Workbench, Link Analysis, and Rabbit, serving global security, insurance, government, law enforcement, legal, and media teams — more than 1,500 organizations, including a fifth of the Fortune 500. Skopenow ships as a login-gated web application rather than a public developer API.
s.name: Skopenow

s.description: Skout is a location-based social discovery and dating mobile app that lets people meet, chat, and make connections with others nearby or worldwide. Operated by the ParshipMeet Group, Skout is distributed as consumer iOS and Android applications and an in-browser experience, and was an early a16z portfolio company. It is a consumer product with no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and published legal/support pages. Added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.
s.name: Skout

s.description: Skry is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Skry

s.description: Skuad is a global HR and employment platform (now part of Payoneer as Payoneer Workforce Management) that lets companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 160+ countries without setting up local legal entities. It provides employer-of-record (EOR) services, international payroll in 70+ currencies, contractor management and payments, benefits administration, background verification, and built-in compliance with local employment, tax, and labor laws. Skuad was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from Skuad's public web presence. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.
s.name: Skuad

s.description: Skuid is a low-code application-development platform for building custom, data-connected user experiences on top of Salesforce and other enterprise systems. Builders assemble Pages from configurable UI components bound to Models, which read and write data through Data Sources (Salesforce, REST, OData, SQL, Google, OpenAI, and more). Rather than a hosted REST API, Skuid exposes a client-side JavaScript API (skuid.model, skuid.$, snippets, and component-specific APIs) plus a data-source Merge API, and ships first-party developer tooling — a Go deployment CLI (skuid-cli) and a Salesforce DX plugin (skuid-sfdx) for moving metadata between environments. Skuid was acquired by Nintex and is now delivered as Nintex Apps. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of ICONIQ Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.
s.name: Skuid

s.description: Skullcandy is a US consumer-audio brand that designs and sells headphones, wireless earbuds, gaming headsets, and Bluetooth speakers. Its e-commerce storefront at skullcandy.com runs on Shopify, and rather than a traditional developer program the brand exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for catalog search, cart, checkout and fulfillment, a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 (including a customer-account MCP scope), and read-only storefront JSON endpoints for products and collections. This profile captures that agent- and API-facing surface as discovered on the live site.
s.name: Skullcandy

s.description: Skupos is a retail technology platform for the convenience store industry that connects independent c-store retailers, distributors, and consumer brands through a single data network. Its SaaS platform delivers scan-data automation, back-office and financial management, tobacco scan-data incentives, digital loyalty and funded promotions, and GasBuddy integration. Founded in 2016 and backed by Insight Partners, Skupos was acquired by PDI Technologies in 2023 and now operates as part of the PDI Essentials product suite. Skupos runs an authenticated production API at api.skupos.com but publishes no public API specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.
s.name: Skupos

s.description: Sky Mavis is the studio behind Axie Infinity and Ronin, an EVM blockchain crafted for developers building games with player-owned economies. Its developer platform exposes a set of API-gateway products for building on Ronin: the Skynet Web3 API (query accounts, NFTs, tokens, blocks, contracts and transactions), a Ronin JSON-RPC API for node connectivity, the Axie Infinity Origins and AXP game-data APIs, Ronin Market and Ronin Store partner APIs, and Ronin Waypoint, an OAuth2/OIDC account service and keyless wallet for game onboarding. Access to gateway products is authenticated with an X-API-KEY issued from the Ronin Developer Console, while public JSON-RPC and the Waypoint OIDC surface are openly reachable. Official SDKs ship for JavaScript/TypeScript, Unity, Android and iOS.
s.name: Sky Mavis

s.description: Face Detection, Face Recognition and Face Grouping
s.name: SkyBiometry

s.description: Skybox Security was a cybersecurity vendor, headquartered in San Jose, California with R&D in Israel, whose Security Posture Management Platform combined attack surface visibility, network modelling and attack-path analysis, firewall assurance and change management, vulnerability and exposure management, and its own threat intelligence feed for large hybrid enterprise and OT networks. It raised roughly $335 million in venture and private-equity funding, including a $50 million round in February 2023, before ceasing operations on February 24, 2025 and laying off approximately 300 employees across the United States and Israel. Tufin acquired a limited portion of Skybox's business and technology and retained select personnel, but did not assume Skybox's customer contracts or support obligations; it instead runs an "ExpressPath for Skybox Customers" migration programme onto the Tufin Orchestration Suite. Skybox exposed a REST API and integrations (Splunk, ServiceNow, Elasticsearch) to its customers, but the reference lived behind customer/partner credentials at docs.skyboxsecurity.com and no machine-readable contract was ever published publicly. Every skyboxsecurity.com host now 301-redirects into tufin.com, so nothing served on those hosts can be attributed to Skybox any longer.
s.name: Skybox Security

s.description: Skybox Imaging was a satellite imaging and geospatial-analytics company (founded 2009, Mountain View, CA) that built a constellation of small high-resolution Earth-observation satellites (SkySat) and the analytics to turn frequent imagery into commercial insight. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Bessemer, Khosla Ventures and others, it was acquired by Google in 2014 (~$500M), renamed Terra Bella, and its satellite business was sold to Planet Labs in 2017. The skyboximaging.com domain is no longer a live product surface; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph and historical reference.
s.name: Skyboximaging

s.description: Skycatch built spatial data capture, processing, and analytics for mining and construction sites, turning drone and aerial imagery into high-precision 3D data, volumetrics, and AI-driven site insights. Its products included Spatial Sight, Spatial DataHub (datahub.skycatch.com), and EdgeServer for on-site edge processing. Skycatch was acquired by Caterpillar Inc. on July 7, 2026 (following Caterpillar's RPMGlobal acquisition) to expand its mining technology capabilities. A developer platform exists at docs.skycatch.com but is password-gated, and no public API specification is available. Originally surfaced as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company.
s.name: Skycatch

s.description: Skydance Media is a Santa Monica, California diversified entertainment company founded in 2010 by David Ellison, producing event-scale film, television, animation, sports and interactive entertainment — Top Gun: Maverick, the Mission: Impossible films, Reacher, Grace and Frankie, Spellbound, and the VR titles The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners and Behemoth through Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media. Skydance completed its merger with Paramount Global on 7 August 2025 to form Paramount Skydance Corporation, and skydance.com continues to operate as the label site for the Animation, Film, Television, Sports, Interactive and New Media divisions. Skydance publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no SDK and no OpenAPI of its own. The only machine-readable, anonymously readable surface on its own host is the WordPress REST API at skydance.com/wp-json — the CMS content API behind the label site, which serves pages, the media library, categories and site search as JSON.
s.name: Skydance Media

s.description: Skydio is a U.S. manufacturer of autonomous drones for public safety, defense, and enterprise customers, building self-flying aircraft such as the X10, X10D, X2, and S2+ along with the Skydio Cloud platform for fleet management, mission planning, live telemetry, and media sync. Skydio exposes a public REST API through Skydio Cloud (apidocs.skydio.com) for managing vehicles, docks, flights, missions, media, alerts, webhooks, and users, alongside on-vehicle integration interfaces such as the Control & Telemetry ICD, Android Intent API, and Attachment ICD for partners and developers.
s.name: Skydio

s.description: SkyDrive Inc. is a Japanese advanced air mobility manufacturer, founded in July 2018 by members of the CARTIVATOR volunteer project, that develops, manufactures, sells and operates eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) aircraft. Its flagship aircraft, SKYDRIVE (model SD-05), is a compact three-seat electric aircraft in type certification with the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and in concurrent validation with the US Federal Aviation Administration, and is produced with official manufacturing partner Suzuki Motor Corporation at Suzuki's plant in Iwata, Shizuoka. The company is headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, with offices in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Yamaguchi and a US subsidiary, SkyDrive America. SkyDrive is a hardware and aircraft-operations company; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract of any kind.
s.name: SkyDrive

s.description: Skydropx is a Mexican multi-carrier shipping and logistics platform that lets e-commerce sellers and businesses compare rates, generate labels, schedule pickups, and track parcels across national and international carriers from a single API. Its modern Skydropx Pro API (base https://pro.skydropx.com/api/v1) is a REST interface secured with OAuth2 client-credentials Bearer tokens and covers quotations, shipments, labels/orders, pickups, address templates, tracking, and account credit balances. A separate classic Skydropx API (https://api.skydropx.com/v1, authenticated with an API key Token header) and a Radar tracking API also exist. Billing is prepaid - the platform is free to use and you pay per label from a wallet balance.
s.name: Skydropx

s.description: Skyfire is the open identity and payments layer for AI agents. It lets AI agents securely create accounts, verify a real-world identity (Know Your Agent, KYA), and autonomously pay for digital services using token-based authentication and stablecoin settlement. Developers use Skyfire to monetize APIs, tools, MCP servers, and content directly to agents. The platform issues three signed, interoperable KYAPay token types — kya (identity), pay (payment), and kya-pay (combined) — that buyer agents present to seller services over a simple REST API and a hosted MCP server. Sellers validate and charge tokens, discover services, and manage seller-service lifecycles, while enterprises manage users and agents through admin APIs. Skyfire is backed by DCVC, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Trinity Ventures.
s.name: Skyfire

s.description: Skyflow is a data privacy vault platform that lets companies isolate, protect, and govern sensitive customer data (PII, PCI, PHI) and secrets in a zero-trust vault, then use it safely through tokenization, encryption, polymorphic de-identification, and fine-grained data governance. Developers integrate via the REST Data API and Management API plus first-party SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Java, JavaScript, React, React Native, Android, and iOS, and client-side Skyflow Elements for securely collecting and revealing data. Skyflow also ships an MCP Data Protection layer for agentic AI. Backed by Insight Partners and Seedcamp.
s.name: Skyflow

s.description: SkyFoundry, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, develops SkySpark, an analytics and informatics platform that connects, stores, analyzes, and visualizes data from smart devices, automation and control systems, meters, and sensors to "find what matters" in large equipment and facility datasets. SkySpark automatically detects issues, patterns, deviations, faults, and cost-reduction opportunities across intelligent buildings, industrial, agriculture, energy, government, and healthcare facilities, and has been applied to over 15,000 buildings spanning more than a billion square feet. SkySpark is a native Project Haystack server: external applications integrate through the Haystack HTTP REST API (ops such as read, hisRead, hisWrite, pointWrite, watchSub/watchPoll, eval, commit, and nav) with Zinc, JSON, Trio, and CSV data formats, and authenticate using the Haystack SCRAM (SHA-256) handshake with bearer authTokens. The company sells through a network of 140+ OEM, systems-integrator, and value-added-distributor channel partners rather than a self-service public SaaS.
s.name: SkyFoundry

s.description: Skyfri is a cleantech software and hardware company headquartered in Oslo, Norway that builds an operating platform for owners and operators of solar and battery energy assets. Founded in 2021, Skyfri combines an edge-native monitoring and control device (the SSI hardware, which speaks Modbus and SCADA over isolated RS-485 ports to inverters, meters, and sensors) with a cloud platform that automates operations, maintenance, and asset performance management. The software delivers real-time data processing, operational management, weather forecasting, dynamic benchmarking, plant insights, and fault detection to monitor generation and address underperformance and equipment failure across a global portfolio of solar and battery assets. The company has offices in Denver, London, Oslo, Singapore, and Bangalore and is backed by Speedinvest. Skyfri exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; its platform is delivered as a customer application at app.skyfri.com.
s.name: Skyfri

s.description: SkyGiraffe was an enterprise-grade mobility platform that let companies build customized, job-specific mobile apps with no coding, connecting mobile workforces to corporate systems of record such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce and ServiceNow. In 2016 the company added developer access, exposing a single secure endpoint for third-party apps to read from and write to those backend enterprise systems through the SkyGiraffe platform. Backed by 500 Startups (now 500 Global), Microsoft Ventures, and Trilogy Equity Partners across ~$10.5M in funding, SkyGiraffe was acquired by ServiceNow on October 25, 2017 and its technology and team were absorbed into ServiceNow's Now Platform mobile capabilities. The independent skygiraffe.com domain no longer hosts a product, developer portal, or API — it 301-redirects to ServiceNow's acquisition announcement — so there is no live, independent API surface to enrich.
s.name: SkyGiraffe

s.description: Skyhigh Security is a cloud-native Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that protects enterprise data across web, cloud, and private applications. Its portfolio spans Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Data Loss Prevention (DLP and Advanced DLP), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). Skyhigh exposes REST "SSE APIs" (served from regional myshn.net hosts) for user management, querying and modifying DLP/policy incidents, and forensics reporting, secured with IAM bearer tokens. Formerly the cloud business of McAfee Enterprise / MVISION Cloud, Skyhigh Security is a Greylock-backed cybersecurity company holding FedRAMP High, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO/IEC 27001 authorizations.
s.name: Skyhigh Security

s.description: SkyKick is a Seattle-based cloud automation company whose Microsoft 365 migration, cloud backup, SaaS security and cloud automation products for managed service providers were acquired by ConnectWise in September 2024. The SkyKick brand's own domain no longer serves a website — skykick.com answers HTTP 404 "Site Not Configured" and www.skykick.com no longer resolves — and the products now ship as ConnectWise Cloud Backup and ConnectWise SaaS Security. The SkyKick Partner Integration API is still live, on ConnectWise Cloud Services: an Azure API Management gateway at apis.cloudservices.connectwise.com, fronted by the ConnectWise Developer Portal running on SkyKick's own APIM instance (skykick.developer.azure-api.net, also served as developers.cloudservices.connectwise.com). Authentication is OAuth 2.0 client credentials plus an Azure APIM subscription key. The API reference itself is gated: developer access must be provisioned by an administrator inside the Cloud Services partner portal, so no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, MCP server or agent card is published anonymously.
s.name: SkyKick

s.description: Skyline Champion is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Skyline Champion API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
s.name: Skyline Champion

s.description: Skylo Technologies is a satellite communications company based in Mountain View, California, operating a global Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) that lets standard smartphones and IoT cellular devices connect directly to satellites over 3GPP Release 17 direct-to-device (D2D) standards for SMS, sensor telemetry, and other low-bandwidth messaging. Founded in 2017 and backed by DCM, SoftBank, Intel Capital, Innovation Endeavors, BMW i Ventures, Samsung Catalyst, Next47, Seraphim Space, and NGP Capital, Skylo has commercial service across the US, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. Skylo does not publish a public REST/HTTP API; developer integration is device-level (certified modules such as Quectel, Murata, Blues Notecard and Particle) with detailed procedures gated behind a partner Knowledge Base. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its developer surface.
s.name: Skylo

s.description: Skymerse is a Y Combinator-backed aviation company building one AI system for airline flight operations — from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit.
