It runs a real GitHub organization (github.com/sofarsounds) of internal engineering repositories, and its production backend is served from api.sofarsounds.com (Heroku), but neither exposes a published, documented API for third-party developers.
s.name: Sofar Sounds

s.description: Soff is an AI-powered quoting platform for U.S. distributors that turns inbound RFQs into won deals. It automatically captures requests for quotes from email, generates instant quotes and PDFs, tracks quote performance (won vs. lost), logs activity into ERP/CRM systems, and analyzes customer behavior and lost-deal reasons. Backed by Y Combinator (S24) and General Catalyst, based in San Francisco, and SOC 2 Type II certified. As of this enrichment pass Soff publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or well-known discovery surface.
s.name: Soff

s.description: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI) is a US member-centric digital financial services company and federally chartered bank holding company. Alongside its consumer banking, lending and investing business it operates SoFi Tech Solutions - the B2B financial technology platform formed from its acquisitions of Galileo Financial Technologies and Technisys, and rebranded under the SoFi name in 2026. SoFi Tech Solutions is the API business: a card issuer-processor and banking-as-a-service platform whose public developer hub at docs.tech.sofi.com publishes eleven OpenAPI definitions covering 258 operations - the 167-operation Program API for accounts, cards, authorizations, ACH and bill pay, plus Payment Hub, Dispute, Loan, Risk and Public Config APIs and three client-hosted webhook contracts. The platform declares ISO 20022, ISO 8583, Nacha ACH, EMV and 3-D Secure in its own contracts, and discovery runs through a real RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset.
s.name: SoFi Technologies

s.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican digital health insurance company that modernizes traditional medical coverage for enterprises, individuals, and families. Its plans combine zero-deductible major and minor medical care, preventive care with an assigned primary-care physician, and unlimited no-cost video consultations, all managed through a mobile app and an HR administrative portal. Sofía operates its own integrated medical network (SofíaMed) of hospitals and specialists, offers add-ons such as maternity, mental health, dental, and international coverage, and reimburses claims in an average of five business days. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Sofía positions insurance as a digital-first, member-centric health experience rather than a paper policy.
s.name: Sofia

s.description: SoftBank Corp. is a multinational conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, operating across telecommunications, internet services, AI, robotics, and investment. The company provides a wide range of consumer and enterprise services, including mobile communications, broadband, energy solutions, and a portfolio of technology investments. Its public website offers information on corporate philosophy, sustainability initiatives, news, and support resources, reflecting its role as a major player in the global technology and finance sectors.
s.name: SoftBank

s.description: SoftBank Vision Fund (managed by SoftBank Investment Advisers) is one of the world's largest technology-focused investment funds, launched in May 2017 by SoftBank Group and anchored by the Public Investment Fund of Saudi Arabia. Now operating across two funds (SVF1 and SVF2) with combined assets under management reported at roughly $150B+, the fund pursues Masayoshi Son's long "AI economy" thesis, backing high-growth companies across the AI stack: hardware and semiconductors, the software infrastructure to gather, process and deploy data, and the applications built on top of it. It typically writes large late-stage growth checks (Series C/D and beyond, often $100M to several billion) into 300+ companies worldwide, spanning enterprise software, consumer internet, health tech, fintech, logistics, transportation, frontier tech, edtech and proptech across the Americas, EMEA and Asia. Headquartered in London, with major offices in the US and Asia, its portfolio includes many unicorns and household names such as Arm, ByteDance, and Aurora.
s.name: SoftBank Vision Fund

s.description: Softheon is a healthcare technology company that provides SaaS software for health plans, brokers, and government agencies to run shopping and enrollment, billing and payments, member renewals, reporting and analytics, and compliance across the ACA marketplace, ICHRA, dental, and Medicare Advantage markets. Its all-in-one platform automates health-insurance administration end to end and is increasingly layering in agentic AI to streamline operations at scale. Founded around 2000 and headquartered in Stony Brook, New York, Softheon operates a developer portal (developer.softheon.com) and a compliance trust center, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners.
s.name: Softheon

s.description: SoftPro is the market-leading provider of title, escrow, and real estate closing software, used by title agents, escrow officers, and closing attorneys to produce settlement documents, manage closing files, and disburse funds. SoftPro 360 is its integrated vendor marketplace, a business exchange built into the SoftPro desktop and hosted products that lets users order title, escrow, and closing products and services - e-recording, closing protection letters and policy jackets, remote online notarization, eClosings, lien releases, property records, tax certificates, identity verification, and wire-fraud protection - from 100+ integrated service providers without leaving their SoftPro file, with order data flowing automatically back into the file. Partner and vendor integration with SoftPro 360 is delivered through a partner-gated web-service integration secured with API keys; SoftPro does not publish an open, self-service developer API or public API reference.
s.name: SoftPro

s.description: Softr is a no-code platform for building client portals, internal tools, and web apps on top of Airtable, Google Sheets, and the native Softr Database. Its public REST APIs let you manage app users (create, invite, activate, magic links) and read and write records in Softr Databases programmatically using a Softr-Api-Key header.
s.name: Softr

s.description: Software (software.com) is the developer-productivity company behind the Code Time and Music Time editor plugins, now rebranded and operating as Antenna (antenna.dev). Antenna is an AI-native development intelligence platform — a control plane for AI-driven software development that measures AI-tool adoption, engineering productivity shifts, and financial ROI across an engineering organization. It integrates with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Windsurf, Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, Augment Code), Git providers (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), Jira, Slack and Microsoft Teams, and exposes a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI agents can query engineering metrics in natural language. Backed by 8vc; reports serving 900K+ developers across 10K+ companies.
s.name: Software

s.description: Software Advice is a free online service that helps businesses navigate the software buying process by providing software reviews, comparisons, and personalized recommendations. As a Gartner subsidiary founded in 1999, Software Advice covers over 300 software market categories with user reviews, ratings, and expert advisory services to help buyers find the best software solutions for their needs.
s.name: Software Advice

s.description: Software AG provides enterprise integration and API management through webMethods, a platform for connecting applications, processes, and people across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. The webMethods platform includes API Gateway, Developer Portal, Integration Server, and cloud-native integration services. Software AG was acquired by IBM in 2024.
s.name: Software AG

s.description: Software Applications Incorporated is an AI‑focused software startup that builds innovative applications such as the Sky natural‑language interface for macOS. Founded by former Apple engineers, it was acquired by OpenAI in 2025, expanding OpenAI’s desktop AI capabilities. The company offers a suite of automation tools for businesses and individuals, integrating deep data and application workflows.
s.name: Software Applications Incorporated

s.description: Software architectural patterns are reusable solutions and best practices for organizing software system architecture. Key patterns include MVC (Model-View-Controller), Microservices, Layered Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), Hexagonal Architecture, and Service-Oriented Architecture. These patterns are documented by Microsoft Azure Architecture Center, AWS Well-Architected Framework, and the broader software engineering community.
s.name: Software Design Architectural Patterns

s.description: Software design patterns are reusable solutions to commonly occurring problems in software design. Originally catalogued by the Gang of Four (GoF) in 1994, they include 23 patterns organized into Creational (Factory, Builder, Singleton, Prototype, Abstract Factory), Structural (Adapter, Bridge, Composite, Decorator, Facade, Flyweight, Proxy), and Behavioral (Chain of Responsibility, Command, Iterator, Mediator, Memento, Observer, State, Strategy, Template Method, Visitor, Interpreter) categories.
s.name: Software Design Patterns

s.description: The Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) encompasses all processes, tools, and methodologies involved in planning, developing, testing, and delivering software from inception to retirement. Modern SDLC platforms integrate project planning, source control, code review, automated testing, security scanning, CI/CD pipelines, and release management into unified developer experience platforms. This profile covers the landscape of APIs, tools, and platforms that support each phase of the software development lifecycle.
s.name: Software Development Lifecycle

s.description: Software Engineering Daily is a podcast and media platform dedicated to covering software engineering topics through daily technical interviews and discussions. Founded by Jeff Meyerson in 2015, the platform publishes episodes five days a week featuring conversations with software engineers, startup founders, and technology leaders on topics ranging from distributed systems, cloud computing, databases, and programming languages to AI, machine learning, and the business of software. The platform also offers a membership program for premium content and provides open-source backend and mobile apps for community development.
s.name: Software Engineering Daily

s.description: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is a network architecture approach that decouples the network control plane from the data forwarding plane, enabling dynamic, programmatically efficient network configuration. SDN controllers expose northbound REST APIs for network applications to define routing, load balancing, and security policies, while southbound APIs communicate with switches and routers. Key SDN controllers include OpenDaylight, ONOS, and Floodlight.
s.name: Software-Defined Networking

s.description: SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider that helps organizations acquire, manage, and optimize their technology investments. The SoftwareOne Marketplace Platform is a comprehensive digital marketplace connecting vendors and clients, enabling software procurement, license management, cloud spend optimization, and partner ecosystem integration. The platform exposes REST APIs for clients and partners to automate software purchasing, subscription management, reporting, and catalog operations.
s.name: SoftwareOne

s.description: SoftwareSuggest is a business software discovery and recommendation platform that helps organizations find, compare, and select the right software solutions for their needs. Founded in 2014 by AppItSimple Infotek Pvt. Ltd. and headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, the platform covers over 800 software categories, lists more than 50,000 software products, and hosts over 40,000 verified user reviews. The platform serves both software buyers looking to evaluate and purchase solutions and software vendors seeking qualified leads and market visibility. SoftwareSuggest does not currently publish a public developer API but operates as a data provider via marketplaces such as Datarade for business data products.
s.name: SoftwareSuggest

s.description: SOFY is an AI-powered software testing platform that autonomously writes, executes, and maintains no-code tests across mobile, web, API, and enterprise applications. Testers describe intent in natural language and SOFY's AI agents generate and self-heal the automation as the app changes, running against 2,000+ real devices in the cloud plus web and ERP surfaces (SAP, Dynamics 365). SOFY exposes a public REST API at https://public.sofy.ai for CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps): upload application builds, trigger scheduled test runs, poll status, and abort runs, with outbound webhooks on run completion. SOFY is a portfolio company of 500 Global.
s.name: SOFY

s.description: Soha Systems was a cloud-delivered secure application access company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. Its "Soha Cloud" service let enterprises grant users and third parties fast, secure, per-application access to internal apps without a traditional VPN, an early software-defined perimeter / zero-trust network access (ZTNA) approach. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Menlo Ventures, and Cervin Ventures, Soha Systems was acquired by Akamai Technologies in October 2016, and its technology became the basis for Akamai Enterprise Application Access (EAA). The company no longer operates independently and publishes no standalone developer portal, documentation, or public API; its former domain (soha.io) now resolves only to Akamai edge infrastructure and serves no content.
s.name: Soha Systems

s.description: Sojern is an AI-powered digital marketing platform built for the hospitality and travel industry. Powered by the Sojern Traveler Ecosystem, it unifies real-time traveler intent data, AI-driven audience predictions, and multichannel media activation across display, social, video, connected TV, SEM, metasearch, email, and native channels to help hotels, destinations, attractions, airlines, and agencies drive direct bookings, improve ROI, and grow guest loyalty. The platform spans audiences, creative services, activation, optimization, measurement, and attribution, plus guest-experience tools. Sojern publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract. Its integration surface is the partner-side Sojern Universal Pixel and server-to-server postback described in its Technology Specifications for Partners, while the customer portal is backed by an authenticated GraphQL endpoint whose introspection is disabled for anonymous callers. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.
s.name: Sojern

s.description: Sojo Industries is a national industrial-automation and supply-chain technology company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Bristol, Pennsylvania, serving the food and beverage industry with robotics-driven variety packing, multi-packing and assembly. It operates fixed Sojo Hubs across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, California and Texas plus Sojo Flight mobile manufacturing lines that are trucked to a customer's own plant to eliminate freight, labour and packaging cost. Its software arm is Sojo Shield, a blockchain-backed track-and-trace platform — a Built for NetSuite SuiteApp — that captures geolocated critical tracking events from the factory floor through to the retailer so brands can meet the FDA FSMA Rule 204 Food Traceability requirements, and Sojo Seal, GPS-enabled tamper-evident seals. Its API surface is the Sojo Shield platform API at api.sojoshield.com and a production Model Context Protocol server for "Victoria", the SOJO Planning Assistant, which exposes production, machine-telemetry, dieline and pallet-pattern planning tools to MCP clients.
s.name: Sojo Industries

s.description: Soketi is a next-gen, Pusher-compatible, open-source WebSocket server. It implements the Pusher protocol so existing Pusher SDKs and applications can drop-in replace Pusher Channels with self-hosted Soketi. Written in Node/TypeScript with Rust adapter; deployed via npm, Docker, Kubernetes, or systemd. Open source under MIT license.
s.name: Soketi

s.description: Sokowatch — rebranded as Wasoko in 2022 — is a pan-African B2B e-commerce and distribution platform serving informal retailers (the mom-and-pop dukas, kiosks, and neighborhood shops that move the majority of fast-moving consumer goods across the continent). Founded in 2016 in Nairobi, Kenya by Daniel Yu, the platform lets small shopkeepers order FMCG inventory via a mobile app or SMS, with free same-day delivery to the shop door, eliminating costly trips to wholesalers. Wasoko layers embedded fintech on top of commerce: buy-now-pay-later inventory credit, working-capital loans for shopkeepers who often lack access to traditional banking, and digital payments. At peak the company operated across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In December 2023, Wasoko announced a merger with Egyptian B2B peer MaxAB, which closed in August 2024 to form MaxAB-Wasoko, Africa's largest B2B informal-retail network with more than 450,000 merchants across eight countries (combining MaxAB's North African footprint in Egypt and Morocco with Wasoko's Sub-Saharan reach) and roughly 4,000 employees, co-led by Daniel Yu and MaxAB founder Belal El-Megharbel. Post-merger the group exited underperforming markets (Zambia, Uganda, Senegal) and pivoted harder into fintech, where margins exceed core distribution. Wasoko's revenue model is wholesale-to-retail product sales plus fintech (credit, payments) and logistics fees. The platform is operated as a closed retailer-facing app; there is no public developer API, SDK, partner integration program, or open-source release for the commerce, logistics, or fintech surface. The legacy Sokowatch GitHub organization exists but contains only forks of third-party tools (Apache Superset, Fineract CN, Botpress, Kutt, Portainer) used internally, with no first-party libraries or specifications.
s.name: Sokowatch / Wasoko

s.description: Sol Reader is a wearable e-reader — marketed as the world's first wearable e-reader — built by Sol and backed by Initialized Capital. The device is a lightweight (104g) headset with dual 1.3" 271ppi side-lit E Ink displays, adjustable diopter optics and IPD, a handheld remote, and 25+ hours of battery for a distraction-free reading experience. It reads a connected Kindle library and DRM-free EPUB uploads, offers the Sol Store with over one million titles, plus AI question-answering and an AutoPilot speed-reading mode. Sol is a consumer hardware company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.
s.name: Sol

s.description: Solace Health is a US healthcare navigation company that connects patients with human patient advocates and care coordinators whose services are covered by insurance, including Medicare. Through solace.health and the app.solace.health member portal, patients are matched with an advocate who helps them understand diagnoses, prepare for appointments, coordinate care, manage bills, and navigate the healthcare system. Solace is a consumer-facing healthcare service company; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer program, API, SDKs, or API documentation.
s.name: Solace

s.description: Solactron, Inc. is a Silicon Valley solar technology company developing high-performance, monolithically integrated thin-film solar modules on glass substrates. Its proprietary "Thin Film 2.0" process uses a tunable compound chemistry targeting greater than 34% efficiency by capturing over 95% of the solar spectrum, aiming for the highest efficiency and lowest cost at gigawatt scale. Backed by 500 Global, Solactron is a deep-tech hardware and materials manufacturer positioned in the renewable energy and utility-scale photovoltaic market. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website only (Home, Technology, Company, Careers, Contact) and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable discovery surface.
s.name: Solactron

s.description: Solana is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for fast, secure, and scalable decentralized applications and marketplaces. It exposes a JSON-RPC 2.0 API over HTTP and WebSocket for querying accounts, transactions, programs, token balances, blocks, and cluster state, as well as submitting and simulating transactions. Three public clusters are available — Mainnet, Devnet, and Testnet — with dedicated API nodes for each environment.
s.name: Solana

s.description: Provides various endpoints to interact with the Solana Blockchain
s.name: Solana JSON RPC

s.description: SolarCity was a San Mateo, California based provider of residential and commercial solar energy systems, founded in 2006 by brothers Peter and Lyndon Rive with backing and board chairmanship from their cousin Elon Musk. The company designed, financed, installed, and monitored rooftop solar and energy-storage systems, and became the largest residential solar installer in the United States before its 2012 IPO (NASDAQ: SCTY). In November 2016 SolarCity was acquired by Tesla, Inc. in an all-stock deal valued at roughly 2.6 billion US dollars and was absorbed into Tesla's energy-generation and storage business; the SolarCity brand was subsequently retired and its products relaunched under Tesla (Solar Roof, Solar Panels, Powerwall). SolarCity no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no standalone developer portal, public API, or OpenAPI surface. The solarcity.com domain remains registered under Tesla's DNS infrastructure but no longer serves a live website.
s.name: Solar City

s.description: Solar Mosaic, Inc. (trading as Mosaic) was a residential clean-energy lender founded in Oakland, California in 2010, originally as a solar crowdfunding platform and from 2014 as a point-of-sale financing platform for residential solar, battery storage and other sustainable home improvements funded through third-party capital partners. Mosaic originated loans through a dealer/installer channel and backed more than $15 billion in home energy loans across roughly 360,000 households. Its integration surface for installer and capital partners was the Mosaic Financing API, documented on a password-protected ReadMe developer portal at developer.joinmosaic.com. Solar Mosaic filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the Southern District of Texas on 2025-06-09 and its loan portfolio was acquired in September 2025 by Solar Servicing LLC, which stated it would not originate new solar loans. As of this profile the joinmosaic.com website 301-redirects to solarservicingllc.com, the api.joinmosaic.com host returns HTTP 503, and the Mosaic status page reports "Page Inactive".
s.name: Solar Mosaic

s.description: SolarBridge Technologies was a solar power-electronics company that developed AC photovoltaic (ACPV) technology for residential and commercial solar, including its TrueAC modules, the Pantheon and Pantheon II microinverters, and the SolarBridge Management System for monitoring installed systems. The company was acquired by SunPower in 2014 and no longer operates as an independent business; its former marketing site is preserved at solarbridgetech.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. SolarBridge was a hardware and embedded-electronics company and does not publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.
s.name: SolarBridge Technologies

s.description: SolarCycle is a technology-driven solar recycling company founded in 2022 that provides certified end-of-life management for solar energy systems. It recovers up to 97% of panel materials (silver, copper, gold, aluminum, glass), recycles power electronics such as inverters and transformers, and handles logistics and field operations for large-scale solar projects, achieving 100% landfill diversion. SolarCycle operates seven facilities across Georgia, Illinois, Texas, Nevada, and Arizona and is building a domestic recycled-solar-glass manufacturing plant, serving major solar companies including Q Cells, AES, Orsted, and Sunrun. It is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall. This is a physical circular-economy operations business with no public developer or API surface.
s.name: SolarCycle

s.description: SolarEdge Technologies provides a cloud-based Monitoring API that enables web services and third-party applications to access real-time and historical solar production data stored on the SolarEdge monitoring server. The REST API delivers site energy measurements, power flow data, inverter technical telemetry, battery storage status, equipment inventory, and environmental benefit metrics for SolarEdge-connected systems. Authentication is handled via an API key generated through the SolarEdge monitoring portal, and all requests are made over HTTPS with responses returned in JSON format. The platform supports both site-level and account-level queries, with bulk call options allowing developers to retrieve data across multiple sites in a single request. SolarEdge serves residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar installations globally, making their API central to energy management integrations, home automation platforms, and fleet monitoring solutions.
s.name: SolarEdge

s.description: Solaren is a combination energy and aerospace company headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, founded in 2001 by a team of satellite engineers and space scientists. Solaren designs, develops, integrates, deploys and operates space solar power (SSP) plants: solar arrays on a patented lightweight solar power satellite in geosynchronous orbit convert sunlight to electricity, convert that electricity to radio-frequency power, and beam it to an earth receiving station that returns it to the grid as baseload power. The company's business model is to own and operate its SSP plants and sell continuous, zero-emission electricity to utility and government customers; it signed the world's first power purchase agreement for space solar electricity, with Pacific Gas & Electric. Solaren is a hardware and energy-generation company and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.
s.name: Solaren

s.description: Solaris SE is a Berlin-based embedded-finance / Banking-as-a-Service platform operating on a full German CRR commercial banking license. Its REST API lets partners embed regulated banking into their own products: digital banking with local German IBANs and SEPA credit transfers, direct debit and instant payments; debit and credit cards with 3D Secure, tokenization and spending controls; KYC/KYB identity verification (Bankident, VideoIdent, AutoIdent, Fourthline); and lending products including overdrafts, Splitpay and consumer and business loans. The API uses OAuth2 client-credentials bearer tokens, HMAC-SHA256-signed webhooks for ~80 real-time events, page-number pagination, and a structured Money object, and is certified under ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS 4.0, DORA and GDPR.
s.name: Solaris

s.description: API for managing Solaris Zones (containers) and virtualization on Oracle Solaris systems.
s.name: Solaris Zones

s.description: Solarize is a German energy software company offering a meter-to-cash billing platform as a software-as-a-service for utilities, municipal utilities (Stadtwerke), and energy providers. The platform converts metering data into a revenue stream through automated billing and invoicing, metering data management, monitoring and reporting, and flexible electricity-product configuration. Solarize exposes a REST API at api.solarize.energy covering customers, sites, meters, contracts, measurements, readings, invoices, payments, pricing, and outgoing webhooks, enabling open-architecture integration with ERP, CRM, and metering-operator systems.
s.name: Solarize

s.description: SolarWinds provides a comprehensive suite of APIs enabling programmatic access to its IT infrastructure management, monitoring, and observability solutions. These APIs cover database performance analysis, network performance monitoring, web help desk, IP address management, network configuration management, server and application monitoring, and more, allowing customers to integrate SolarWinds capabilities into their own tools and workflows.
s.name: SolarWinds

s.description: Solazyme is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Solazyme

s.description: Solcast is a solar and renewable energy data company, acquired by DNV in 2023, that provides high-resolution, satellite-derived solar irradiance, PV power, weather forecasting, and historical climate data via a developer API. Its data covers live, forecast, historical, and typical meteorological year (TMY) datasets for rooftop PV, advanced PV, grid aggregations, and soiling models globally.
s.name: Solcast

s.description: Sold * was a consumer resale service (a mobile app that sold your unwanted items on your behalf, handling pricing, listing, and fulfillment). Backed by GV, the Sold team was acqui-hired by Dropbox; the service was shut down and no longer accepts items. The homepage at usesold.com now serves only an acquisition/shutdown notice. No developer portal, API, documentation, or well-known surface exists (all api/developer/docs subdomains fail to resolve; /.well-known/*, /llms.txt, and /openapi.json return 404). Sector: consumer.
s.name: Sold *

s.description: Solda.ai is an AI sales-agent platform that provides fully automated, autonomous sales departments powered by AI agents. Its voice- and text-based AI sales representatives execute the full sales cycle end to end, handling outbound cold outreach, inbound calls, follow-ups, callbacks, conversion optimization via A/B testing, and use cases such as credit-card and loan upselling, card activation, debt collection, and B2B lead qualification. The company markets primarily to banking and fintech customers and states compliance with SOC 2, HIPAA, and the EU AI Act. Solda.ai is a venture-backed company (Accel portfolio) headquartered in Middletown, Delaware. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.
s.name: Solda.ai

s.description: Soldo is a pan-European spend management and prepaid business card platform that pairs Mastercard company cards with software for budgeting, expense tracking, and accounting reconciliation. The Soldo Business API (v2.0, OpenAPI 3.1) lets businesses programmatically issue and control cards, manage wallets and internal transfers, read and reconcile transactions, run expense reports and reviews, manage users, groups and roles, handle documents and receipts, and subscribe to 81 webhook event types. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, with request-signed "advanced authentication" (SHA512withRSA fingerprints) layered on top for money movement and sensitive changes. Soldo also operates a separate PSD2 / Open Banking API.
s.name: Soldo

s.description: Soldo is a spend management platform that pairs prepaid Mastercard company cards with software for controlling, tracking, and reporting business spending. The Soldo Business API (v2) gives developers programmatic access to that platform - creating and controlling cards, managing wallets and internal transfers, searching and enriching transactions, running expense reviews and reports, handling business trips, vehicles, subscriptions, pre-approved spend, users, groups, and roles, plus a large webhook event surface for event-driven integrations. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 client-credentials, with an additional RSA request-signing layer (advanced authentication) for money movement and sensitive changes. Soldo is FCA-authorised and certified to PCI DSS Level 1, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 9001, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
s.name: Soldo Software and Services

s.description: Soldsie was a social-commerce platform founded in 2012 in San Francisco by Chris Bennett and Arrel Gray that let retailers sell directly through social media: customers bought products by commenting "Sold" on a merchant's Facebook or Instagram post, while a backend dashboard handled invoicing, customer tracking, and waitlists. Backed by 500 Startups (now 500 Global) and e.ventures, it raised roughly $1M in seed funding and a $4M Series A (2014), and had processed over $25M in transactions across more than 1,000 merchants. The product is now defunct: the soldsie.com apex no longer resolves and www.soldsie.com returns a broken redirect, so there is no live developer portal, API, or documentation surface to enrich.
s.name: Soldsie

s.description: Sole Society is a women's footwear, handbags, jewelry, and accessories e-commerce brand, surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the standalone brand no longer operates its own storefront. The domain solesociety.com resolves to MarkMonitor-managed nameservers, its HTTPS endpoints do not respond, and http://solesociety.com redirects (HTTP 200) to https://www.dsw.com/, so the domain appears to have been folded into DSW / Designer Brands. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, MCP server, or other machine-readable API surface was found for this brand. This profile remains a lead-stage company record with no API artifacts.
s.name: Sole Society

s.description: Solera is a Westlake, Texas headquartered vehicle lifecycle management software, data, and services company operating in more than 100 countries, and one of the claims-technology intermediaries that sits between property and casualty insurers and the repair, salvage, and fleet economy rather than underwriting risk itself. Its insurance-facing business is automobile physical damage claims — first notice of loss intake, photo and AI damage assessment, repair cost estimating, total loss valuation, parts sourcing, and claims workflow — delivered through the Audatex and Qapter brands alongside Vehicle Repair (Identifix, Autodata, Hollander), Dealer Solutions (DealerSocket, cap hpi), and Fleet Solutions (Omnitracs, SmartDrive, eDriving) divisions. Its API posture is characteristic of the United States insurance market seam — there is no self-serve developer portal on solera.com, no signup, and no public API key. The Solera Integrations portal at na.api.solera.com returns HTTP 200 to an Audatex user ID and password login wall, and onboarding is a provisioned B2B integration run through a Solera account representative with a kickoff meeting and UAT. What is genuinely public is a set of anonymously readable Swagger UI reference pages and machine readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 documents on the Audatex demo API host, plus PDF integration guides on na.api.solera.com/files, covering assignment dispatch and first notice of loss, claim image retrieval, and GIC integration. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 against an IdentityServer discovery document at dispatch-login-demo.audatex.com with resource scopes including b2b.fnol.api, gofnol.api, estimatics.api, and hqclaims.api. Solera does not reference ACORD anywhere in its public integration documentation. Its published standards alignment is CIECA instead — Audatex is documented as a Corporate Technology member of the Collision Industry Electronic Commerce Association and licensed to use CIECA standards, with the BMS 5.7 schema as the data mapping baseline for estimate return, which is the auto physical damage sector's analogue to ACORD rather than ACORD itself.
s.name: Solera

s.description: Solera Health is a Phoenix, Arizona based preventive-care benefits manager that acts as a single integration point between health plans, employers and a curated network of non-clinical digital health providers. Its HALO omni-condition management platform lets a payer or employer contract, configure, enroll and report across eight condition networks - weight management, diabetes prevention and management, hypertension, behavioral and mental health, musculoskeletal, tobacco cessation, women's health and digestive health - spanning 25+ partner point solutions including Calm, Headspace, Lyra Health, Sword Health, WeightWatchers and Dario Health, alongside customer contracted solutions Solera did not source. Solera operates an Azure API Management gateway on its own domain for those partner and payer integrations, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract.
s.name: Solera Health

s.description: Solestial is a space solar energy company developing space-stable silicon photovoltaics — radiation-hardened, ultrathin flexible silicon heterojunction solar cells and modules for spacecraft. Its products are the only solar products on the market that self-cure radiation damage at operating temperatures, offering competitive performance at lower cost than III-V multijunction solar. Solestial has flight heritage across multiple spacecraft and works with customers including NASA, Boeing, and the U.S. Space Force. This is a hardware and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.
s.name: Solestial

s.description: Soley Therapeutics is a science-first, tech-enabled drug discovery and development company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, using human cells as biological sensors to uncover first-in-class medicines. Its cell stress sensing platform captures time-resolved cellular responses across thousands of features and applies computer vision and machine learning to compress them into compact signatures, screening hundreds of thousands of compounds per week on proprietary automation and robotics. The company is advancing a lead oncology asset for acute myeloid leukemia toward an IND filing, a second oncology asset for solid tumors in IND-enabling studies, and non-oncology stress-reducing candidates for neurodegenerative and metabolic disease. Soley raised a $200M Series C in January 2026, bringing total funding to roughly $290M. The platform is an internal discovery engine: Soley is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.
s.name: Soley Therapeutics

s.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.
s.name: Solfacil

s.description: Solid (formerly Wise) was a venture-backed fintech-as-a-service / embedded finance platform offering banking, card, and payment APIs to fintech builders. Solid raised more than $80M, including a 2022 Series B led by FTV Capital. The company subsequently became the subject of significant legal trouble - including litigation with FTV Capital and reported customer disputes - and substantially wound down operations through 2023-2024. As of this profile, the solidfi.com site is not responding to requests and no active API or onboarding pipeline appears to be operating. This is an honest historical record; treat any API references as unverified / inactive.
s.name: Solid (Solid.fi)

s.description: SolidStage is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: SolidStage

s.description: Solidus Labs is a crypto-native market-integrity and compliance technology company founded in 2018 by former Goldman Sachs engineers, headquartered in New York with offices in Tel Aviv and London. Its HALO platform is a unified compliance control hub spanning eight modules — Trade Surveillance, Transaction Monitoring, Stablecoin Monitoring, Token Monitoring, Execution Quality, Case Management, Agentic-AI Workflows and Professional Services — used by regulated exchanges, broker-dealers, market makers, custodians, OTC desks, stablecoin issuers and regulators across digital assets, derivatives, equities and fixed income. The publicly documented developer surface is the TokenSniffer API, the programmatic face of Solidus Labs' Token Monitoring module: a key-authenticated REST API over smart-contract scam detection, the TokenSniffer "Smell Test" risk score, malicious token/pair/address feeds across 15+ chains, and a v3 webhook subscription API for real-time scam and rug-pull notifications. The HALO platform itself is delivered to contracted customers through regional dashboards and is not publicly documented.
s.name: Solidus Labs

s.description: Sollis Health is a members-only concierge medicine and 24/7 private emergency care company operating staffed medical centers in New York and the Hamptons, Southern and Northern California, and South Florida. Membership provides unlimited access to emergency-trained physicians, on-site imaging and laboratory diagnostics, house calls, virtual visits, travel medicine, specialist coordination, care navigation and patient advocacy. Sollis is a membership service rather than insurance, and it complements rather than replaces a member's existing clinicians. Individual, family, pediatric and corporate memberships are sold, along with a Platinum tier and bespoke employer plans. Sollis operates its own member-facing software — a Member Portal and an internal Navigator clinical dashboard — backed by first-party APIs secured with Microsoft Entra External ID (Azure AD B2C); those APIs are not published as a public developer program.
s.name: Sollis Health

s.description: SoLo Funds is a Techstars-backed, Los Angeles fintech that operates a community-driven peer-to-peer lending marketplace delivered as a consumer mobile app for iOS and Android. Members request small, short-term loans that other members choose to fund, with borrowers offering an optional tip and donation rather than mandated interest, positioning the platform as a member-to-member alternative to payday and overdraft borrowing. SoLo Funds is a consumer financial-services product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its only publicly reachable operational surface is a hosted status page.
s.name: SoLo Funds

s.description: Solo.io is a cloud-native application-networking company founded in 2017 that builds enterprise and open-source API gateways, service mesh, and agentic-AI infrastructure. Its products include Kgateway Enterprise (formerly Gloo Gateway), an Envoy-powered Kubernetes Gateway API ingress and API gateway; Solo Enterprise for Istio (formerly Gloo Mesh), a hardened Istio service mesh with ambient mode; Agentgateway Enterprise, a Rust-based AI-native gateway for LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic; Kagent Enterprise, a Kubernetes-native agent runtime; and Agentregistry Enterprise, a registry for agents, MCP servers, and AI tools. Solo.io also ships Gloo Portal, a developer portal whose Portal Server REST API manages API products, teams, apps, subscriptions, API keys, and OAuth credentials, and contributes the kgateway, agentgateway, kagent, and Istio ambient-mesh open-source projects.
s.name: Solo.io

s.description: Solomon (Solomon AI, solomontax.ai) is an agentic AI platform for tax preparation aimed at accounting firms, automating the preparation of review-ready individual 1040 returns for high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients. The system interprets K-1/K-3 footnotes, applies multi-state SALT rules to K-1s, reconciles rental and real estate investments, analyzes brokerage statements for foreign income, and produces workpapers and audit trails, positioning itself to replace legacy tools such as SurePrep and K1x. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.
s.name: Solomon

s.description: Solovis is a multi-asset investment analytics and portfolio management software platform for institutional investors, including endowments, foundations, pension plans, outsourced CIOs (OCIOs), and family offices. It aggregates data across public and private asset classes into a single dashboard for portfolio modeling, performance analysis, risk analytics, and reporting. Core products include Portfolio Analytics, Risk Analytics, Predict (performance and risk prediction for asset allocation), Risk Pro (factor-based risk analytics, formerly Venn Pro), and Analyst Services for outsourced data capture and portfolio data aggregation. Solovis became part of Nasdaq's investment intelligence business following its 2020 acquisition. The platform is delivered as a private, authenticated SaaS accessed through a client login; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, OpenAPI specification, or `/.well-known/` discovery surface. The host api.solovis.com exists but is fully authentication-gated (HTTP 401) with no public specification.
s.name: Solovis

s.description: SOLS Energy is Malaysia's leading residential and commercial solar energy company, on a mission to make green energy a basic human right. It has completed more than 8,900 solar installations across Malaysia spanning residential (Green Homes), commercial (Green Business), and off-grid indigenous community projects (Green Impact), and also offers EV charging (ChargeSingh) and a Solar Academy apprenticeship program. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass SOLS Energy publishes a consumer marketing website (blog, FAQ, contact, privacy and terms pages) but no public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.
s.name: SOLS Energy

s.description: Sols Systems is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Sols Systems

s.description: Solscan is a leading Solana block explorer with a Public API (free, basic) and a Pro API (paid, with full account, transaction, token, NFT, and DeFi endpoints). The Pro API serves decoded on-chain data and is the primary commercial product. Authentication uses a token (Bearer or query parameter) and is required for all Pro endpoints.
s.name: Solscan

s.description: Solsten (originally 12traits) is a Berlin- and Minneapolis-based psychological-AI company that builds audience intelligence for product, marketing and research teams, pairing validated psychographic measurement with behavioural telemetry to model how real people think, decide and engage. Its product suite spans Traits (assessment-driven psychographic personas for a company's real customers), Navigator (a library of 200,000+ pre-profiled audiences drawn from 2M+ questionnaire respondents) and Elaris (audience-aware generative content). The public developer surface is a small REST API at api.solsten.io covering assessment completion, per-user assessment status, segment/persona user lists and GDPR-style user-data deletion, plus a documented Microsoft Azure PlayFab webhook and a cloud-object-storage bulk ingestion contract for behavioural events and KPIs.
s.name: Solsten

s.description: Solstice is a community solar platform that lets households, renters, and businesses benefit from renewable energy without installing rooftop panels. Subscribers reserve a portion of a nearby solar farm and earn monthly savings on their electric bill through solar credits, while businesses can purchase community solar subscriptions and renewable energy credits (RECs). Solstice also offers subscriber-management solutions for solar developers and asset owners. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public API surface was found during enrichment.
s.name: Solstice

s.description: Solu Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, pioneering a novel class of antibody therapeutics that unlock cell-surface targets by combining small molecules with effector antibodies through proprietary linker technology. Its two platform technologies are CyTAC (Cytotoxicity Targeting Chimera), which links cell-surface targets to antibodies that kill pathogenic cells, and TicTAC (Therapeutic Index Control Targeting Chimera), which gives long-acting small-molecule agonists and antagonists antibody-like pharmacokinetics. Its lead program, STX-0712, is a CyTAC targeting the GPCR CCR2 in Phase 1 trials for chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, with additional oncology and immunology programs advancing. Solu is a portfolio company of the venture firm DCVC. The company operates as a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.
s.name: Solu Therapeutics

s.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.
s.name: Solugen

s.description: Soluto is a consumer technology-support and device-protection brand operated under Asurion; its former standalone product site (asurion.com/soluto-service) now redirects into Asurion's Tech Help experience. Soluto began as an independent software company and its engineering organization still maintains a public open-source presence of 52 repositories on GitHub (github.com/Soluto). The enrichment pass found no standalone public Soluto product API, developer portal, OpenAPI, MCP, or webhook surface of its own — only the GitHub organization and the Asurion-hosted brand page.
s.name: Soluto

s.description: Solv Health operates a consumer marketplace (solvhealth.com and the Solv app) for booking same-day urgent care, primary care, and lab appointments, plus a provider-facing platform (scheduling, intake, patient acquisition, reputation management, messaging, payments) sold to clinics and health systems. There is no self-serve public developer API or published API reference on solvhealth.com; API access is gated behind a sales-led partnership. Solv states it exposes "interoperable APIs" that power custom booking experiences on partner websites and apps, a "Final Mile" API/network that lets digital-first and virtual-care partners (e.g. Included Health) hand patients off to real-time same-day appointment availability at Solv's national network of urgent care clinics, and bidirectional EHR interoperability (APIs, HL7, FHIR, and RPA) that syncs patient demographics, appointment status, and documents with systems like Epic, Athena, Cerner, Allscripts, DrChrono, eClinicalWorks, Experity, and NextGen. None of these capabilities have a published base URL, endpoint reference, or self-serve API key signup; access is provisioned per partner/clinic inside a commercial contract.
s.name: Solv Health

s.description: Solve Intelligence builds AI-native software for patent attorneys and intellectual property teams. Its Patent Copilot is an in-browser document editor, comparable to a word processor, with an AI assistant purpose-built for the patent lifecycle: application drafting, claim drafting, office action response and prosecution, invention harvesting and disclosure enhancement, claim and invalidity charting, prior-art and freedom-to-operate searching, infringement and validity analysis, standard-essential patent mapping, patent translation and proofreading. The company was founded by patent attorneys, AI researchers and software engineers, is used by hundreds of law firms and in-house IP teams across six continents, and has raised roughly $55M from Y Combinator, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, 20VC, Operator Collective and Visionaries. Its public machine-readable surface is a first-party remote Model Context Protocol server, "Solve MCP", which brings global patent literature, non-patent literature, jurisdictional legal texts and case law, and SEP standard documentation into an agent session for subscribers.
s.name: Solve Intelligence

s.description: SolveAI is an enterprise AI platform that helps organizations turn complex business problems into custom AI applications, providing tooling to align stakeholders and then build, deploy, and maintain AI solutions across the enterprise. The company is backed by Accel, GV, and Northzone. As of this profile SolveAI publishes a marketing website at solve.ai (a static single-page app on S3/CloudFront) with no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, webhook surface, or MCP server; this entry captures the verifiable identity and domain-security posture only.
s.name: SolveAI

s.description: SolveBio is a platform for biomedical and genomic datasets that lets developers query, harmonize, and automate bioinformatics workflows over curated reference data through a REST API and first-party client libraries (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, and R). SolveBio has been rebranded to QuartzBio, a Precision for Medicine company: the solvebio.com website now redirects to quartz.bio, the legacy API is served as the QuartzBio EDP REST API on per-customer instance hosts, and the SolveBio SDKs are being deprecated in favor of the quartzbio packages (Python client end of maintenance 2026-03-31). Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched from its public GitHub organization and package registries.
s.name: SolveBio

s.description: Solvela is a Solana-native payment gateway for AI agents: an OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy at api.solvela.ai where every paid request is settled per call in USDC-SPL over the x402 protocol (HTTP 402 challenge, signed payment, retry) with no API key and no account, plus a trustless on-chain escrow scheme, a spend-down voucher channel, a 15-dimension smart router across 44 models from six upstream providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, NVIDIA NIM), an A2A 0.3.0 agent card, a stdio MCP server and SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Go and Rust. The gateway is open source (BUSL-1.1 gateway, Apache-2.0 libraries) at github.com/solvela-ai/solvela.
s.name: Solvela

s.description: Solvely is an all-in-one AI study platform for students from K-12 through graduate level, trusted by more than 10 million students across 5,000+ universities worldwide. It combines multi-model homework help with step-by-step solutions, an AI note taker that transcribes lectures into structured notes, a quiz maker, an essay writer, math and equation solvers (algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics), auto-generated flashcards and study guides, mock exams, an exam predictor, and cheat sheets. Solvely is available on the web, iOS, Android, and as a Chrome/Edge browser extension, with free and paid (Solvely Unlimited) tiers. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.
s.name: Solvely Ai

s.description: Solventum is a Fortune 500 healthcare company spun off from 3M in 2024, focused on healthcare technology including medical-surgical solutions, dental and orthodontic products, health information systems, and purification and filtration technologies. Solventum serves hospitals, clinics, dental practices, and healthcare IT organizations worldwide.
s.name: Solventum

s.description: Solvimon is an IPO-ready billing and monetization platform for usage-based and hybrid pricing that unifies metering, CPQ (quote-to-cash), subscriptions, invoicing, payments and revenue recognition in a single system. It is PSP-agnostic (Stripe, Adyen, Checkout.com) with multi-currency support, and exposes four REST APIs - Configuration, Transaction, Identity and Event - secured with an X-API-KEY header, plus header-based idempotency, HMAC-signed webhooks, an official hosted MCP server, an embeddable Frontend SDK and two TypeScript client libraries. It targets AI-native usage-based startups through IPO-ready enterprises.
s.name: Solvimon

s.description: Solvo is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of index-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: fintech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Solvo

s.description: Solvo.ai is a revenue-orchestration company building the decision layer for revenue management in container logistics. Its live pricing engine ingests market rates, capacity manifests, booking history, port congestion, customer behaviour and contract terms, then uses models trained on tens of millions of historical bookings to produce a ranked, capacity-aware rate recommendation per lane, equipment type and segment. Trade managers accept, adjust or override these recommendations on Solvo's Decision HUB, and every decision feeds back as training signal through a bidirectional integration with the carrier's commercial stack. Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Solvo positions itself as the only proven, live pricing engine built specifically for container shipping, with one of the world's top carriers in production. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio company; Solvo currently publishes a marketing and insights site only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs or specifications.
s.name: Solvo.ai

s.description: Solvvy was a conversational-AI and customer-support automation platform that let companies deploy self-service virtual agents to understand end-customer questions, resolve issues, and deflect support tickets across chat and web channels. Zoom announced a definitive agreement to acquire Solvvy in May 2022 and folded its natural-language and workflow-automation technology into Zoom Contact Center and the Zoom Virtual Agent product. As of this profile the standalone Solvvy brand is discontinued: solvvy.com no longer serves a site (HTTPS connection refused) and the company publishes no independent, live public API, developer portal, or documentation. This repo is retained as a historical company record; there is no active API surface to enrich.
s.name: Solvvy

s.description: Soma (Soma Insurance Services) is a commercial insurance brokerage that positions itself as the fastest brokerage for complex businesses, placing customized commercial-lines coverage across industries including retail, trucking, hospitality, healthcare, finance, technology, manufacturing, and construction. Coverage lines include general liability, commercial auto, cyber liability, professional liability, and builder's risk. Backed by Accel and Cowboy Ventures in the insurance-tech sector. As of this enrichment pass Soma publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.
s.name: Soma

s.description: Soma Energy is an AI-powered energy intelligence platform that optimizes how power is produced, stored, and consumed. Founded by former Amazon and technology leaders, it coordinates power generation, battery storage, and large energy consumers such as data centers. Its Intelligence Platform combines three products: AI Trader, which automates energy procurement, hedging, and dispatch for independent power producers (IPPs); BESS Dispatcher, which manages battery energy storage systems; and Load Optimizer, which coordinates data-center workloads with grid conditions to cut energy costs and turn facilities into flexible grid assets. Soma Energy is an early-stage company backed by Uncork Capital. As of this profile the company exposes no public API, developer platform, or documentation.
s.name: Soma Energy

s.description: Somatus is a value-based kidney and heart care management company founded in 2016 and headquartered in McLean, Virginia. It partners with health plans, provider groups and nephrology practices to slow the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD), end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) and congestive heart failure, surrounding patients with in-home and virtual care teams of nurses, community health workers, pharmacists, dietitians and social workers across all 50 states and DC. Its proprietary RenalIQ technology platform applies predictive analytics and machine learning across claims, clinical and social data to prioritize interventions, and is surfaced to partners through a patient portal and a provider/health-plan self-service portal. Somatus is HITRUST CSF certified and holds NCQA accreditations for Case Management, Population Health and Health Equity. Somatus publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; RenalIQ is delivered as a partner portal rather than a public API.
s.name: Somatus

s.description: Somethings is a teen mental health support platform that connects adolescents with Certified Peer Specialist Mentors through a mobile app for iOS and Android. Rather than traditional therapy or AI chatbots, teens can call or chat anytime with trained mentors who have personal lived experience overcoming challenges like anxiety, depression, self-harm, eating disorders, and ADHD, backed by clinical supervision. The service is HIPAA-compliant and sold to health plans, insurers, employers, and directly to parents. Somethings is a venture-backed company in the API Evangelist network; it operates a consumer/clinical mobile product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.
s.name: Somethings

s.description: Somite (now operating as Cellular Intelligence) is an AI-native TechBio company backed by Khosla Ventures building a universal virtual cell-signaling foundation model to engineer cellular fate. In 2026 the company rebranded from Somite to Cellular Intelligence and entered an agreement with Novo Nordisk to advance STEM-PD, a clinical-stage cell therapy for Parkinson's disease that carries FDA Fast Track Designation. The company works at the intersection of machine learning and regenerative medicine and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface.
s.name: Somite

s.description: Sommelier (rebranding to "Somm") is a decentralized asset-management and DeFi vault protocol whose smart-contract "cellars" run automated yield strategies on Ethereum. It publishes a public, read-only HTTP API that exposes on-chain vault performance data — daily and hourly snapshots (APY, TVL, share price, total assets), protocol-wide total value locked, per-cellar snapshots, and integration datasets for Kelp and ether.fi points and balances. All endpoints are unauthenticated GET requests with path-based parameters and a { "Response": ... } envelope; the API currently serves the ethereum network. Backed by Multicoin Capital.
s.name: Sommelier

s.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.
s.name: Somnee

s.description: Somos Internet is a Colombian residential and business fiber-optic internet service provider (ISP) delivering high-speed home and enterprise broadband across cities including Medellin, Bogota, Sabaneta, Rionegro, Caldas and Laureles. The company is building AI-ready digital infrastructure for Latin America and raised a $40M Series B backed by Ribbit Capital. It offers fiber internet plans, parental controls, TV channel line-ups, and Wi-Fi routers to homes, businesses, and property developers. No public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or other programmatic surface has been identified for Somos Internet; it is a consumer and enterprise connectivity provider rather than an API platform.
s.name: Somos Internet

s.description: Sona is an AI-powered workforce management platform for large, multi-site organizations in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics. It unifies labor demand forecasting, autonomous staff scheduling, core HR (onboarding, absence, training), and payroll automation, with a Raffy AI assistant that guides manager decisions plus real-time analytics across locations. Sona ships 95+ pre-built integrations (ATS, POS, LMS, tipping, earned-wage-access, and care-planning systems) and advertises a private API for building bespoke integrations, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (Northzone, Polychain, Speedinvest) and enriched via the local pipeline.
s.name: Sona

s.description: Sonans is an AI software company building an intelligence layer for fashion merchandising. Its collaborative AI agents replace manual coordination with autonomous workflows that bridge buying decisions and cross-functional execution, turning raw design sketches and purchase orders into production-ready assets including photorealistic product imagery, marketing copy, and catalog data synchronized across ERPs, Shopify, and B2B commerce platforms. Sonans serves fashion brands and designers (streamlining design cycles, asset enrichment, and multi-channel product launches) as well as retailers and merchants (automating assortment planning, catalog enrichment, and inventory management). The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Sonans operates a web application at app.sonans.ai but publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.
s.name: Sonans

s.description: Sonantic was a London-based AI voice company that built hyper-realistic, emotionally expressive text-to-speech models for entertainment, gaming, and film. The company is best known for recreating Val Kilmer's voice for Top Gun: Maverick after he lost his speaking voice to throat cancer. Spotify acquired Sonantic in June 2022 for a reported 93 million euros, and the underlying TTS technology has since been folded into Spotify products, most visibly the Spotify AI DJ feature launched in 2023. As of 2026, Sonantic no longer operates as a standalone product or public API. This apis.yml entry exists as a historical and archival record of the company, its technology, and its acquisition.
s.name: Sonantic

s.description: Sonar (SonarSource) provides code quality and security analysis tools for developers. Products include SonarQube (self-hosted), SonarCloud (cloud-hosted), and SonarLint (IDE plugin), offering continuous inspection through static code analysis across 30+ programming languages.
s.name: Sonar

s.description: Sonar Mental Health provides 24/7 text-based wellbeing coaching and care navigation for youth. Trained Wellbeing Coaches lead the conversations, supported by AI tooling that surfaces context and flags risk without making independent decisions, delivering between-visit and after-hours support, escalation and care coordination to higher levels of care, and real-time insights dashboards for measurement-based care across schools, health systems, primary care, and EAP pathways. The company reports serving 20,000+ young people with higher engagement between visits, and is backed by 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture (SOC 2, HIPAA), and public web properties.
s.name: Sonar Mental Health

s.description: Sonarly is an AI production-reliability platform (Y Combinator W2026, Paris) that turns noisy production alerts into clear, deduplicated bug reports and ships ready-to-merge fix pull requests. It connects to a team's code (GitHub/GitLab) and their error and observability stack — Sentry, Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, SigNoz, CloudWatch, GCP, and many more — then triages every alert to remove noise and duplicates, investigates logs, traces and metrics to find the root cause, and generates a fix PR or alerting-rule recommendation. Sonarly exposes a read-only public REST API (v1) for pulling bugs, incidents and analysis runs into custom dashboards, signed outbound webhooks for live events, and a device-code style setup-session API that lets a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor) onboard a tenant end-to-end. Onboarding is fully agent-native and documented at sonarly.com/llms.txt.
s.name: Sonarly

s.description: SonarQube is a leading code quality and security platform that provides Web APIs for managing projects, quality gates, issues, and integrations with CI/CD pipelines to deliver clean, secure code.
s.name: SonarQube

s.description: SonarSource (Sonar) builds the industry-standard tooling for code quality and code security, trusted by large engineering organizations to keep code Clean. Its product line spans SonarQube Cloud (formerly SonarCloud, the hosted SaaS analysis service), SonarQube Server (self-managed), SonarQube for IDE (formerly SonarLint), and the SonarQube Community Build. SonarQube Cloud exposes a REST Web API for programmatically managing projects, issues, quality gates, quality profiles, rules, measures, hotspots, permissions, webhooks, and user tokens, plus a family of first-party scanners (npm, PyPI, Maven, Gradle, .NET, and Docker) for wiring analysis into CI/CD pipelines.
s.name: SonarSource

s.description: Sonatus, Inc. is a Sunnyvale, California automotive software company, founded in 2018, that builds cloud-to-edge vehicle AI software for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Its Fastlane platform pairs in-vehicle Fastlane Edge software with Fastlane Collector for dynamic, policy-driven vehicle data collection, Fastlane Insight for cloud-side analysis, and Fastlane Copilot for quick-start integration, alongside the Sonatus Automator vehicle-automation product. Sonatus states its technology is deployed in more than eight million vehicles worldwide, and it is backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Kia, LG, Marvell, NEC, Foxconn and Translink Capital. Sonatus sells to vehicle OEMs and tier-one suppliers rather than to individual developers: it markets an SDK comprising Sonatus Automator, APIs and documentation, but that developer surface is delivered to contracted OEM customers and is not published on any public developer portal.
s.name: Sonatus

s.description: Sonatype provides software supply chain management solutions including Sonatype Lifecycle (IQ Server), Sonatype Repository Firewall, SBOM Manager, and Nexus Repository. The Lifecycle Public REST API provides 188 endpoints for application portfolio management, policy enforcement, vulnerability reporting, component analysis, SBOM generation, source control integration, and software composition analysis across the SDLC.
s.name: Sonatype

s.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager provides a comprehensive REST API for managing software artifacts, repositories, and components across the software development lifecycle. It supports popular formats including Maven, npm, Docker, PyPI, NuGet, RubyGems, Go, Helm, APT, Yum, Cargo, Terraform, R, Swift, and more. The API covers repository configuration, component and asset management, security, blob stores, search, tasks, cleanup policies, staging, and system administration.
s.name: Sonatype Nexus

s.description: Sonde Health is a Boston-based digital health company that turns short voice samples into vocal biomarkers — objective, AI-derived measures of respiratory, mental and cognitive fitness. Founded out of PureTech Health, Sonde has banked over 1,000,000 voice samples from more than 80,000 subjects to train its Health Check models. Partners integrate through the Sonde Platform Service API (a HIPAA-aligned REST API on api.sondeservices.com secured with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and fine-grained sonde-platform/* scopes), through on-device Passive, Cued and Edge SDKs for Android and iOS, and through OEM integrations such as Qualcomm's Snapdragon Sound platform. The cloud flow is upload-and-score: register a subject, request a signed storage URL, upload a WAV sample, then create an inference job and poll for Respiratory Symptoms Risk, Mental Fitness voice-feature scores, M3/PHQ-2 questionnaire scores, or an English transcription.
s.name: Sonde Health

s.description: Sonder is a hospitality company that designs, leases, and operates a global portfolio of boutique, design-forward apartment-style accommodations and hotels for short- and extended-stay travelers. Guests book directly through Sonder's website and mobile app, where a tech-enabled experience spans contactless check-in, in-app service requests, and 24/7 local support across cities in North America, Europe, and the Middle East. In 2024 Sonder entered a long-term licensing agreement with Marriott that lists its properties in the Marriott Bonvoy program. The company is publicly traded and was backed by venture investors including Greylock. Sonder publishes no public developer API; the only machine-facing surface documented here is its responsible security-disclosure program and the site's domain-security posture.
s.name: Sonder

s.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.
s.name: Sondermind

s.description: Sonera is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of amplify-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-ml. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
s.name: Sonera

s.description: Sonetel provides business phone numbers and communication services for entrepreneurs and small businesses, offering local phone numbers in 78 countries that ring in the Sonetel app for iPhone and Android or forward to any phone worldwide, with SMS on some number types, call recording, AI call summaries, call scoring and suggested follow-up emails. Sonetel publishes a developer API documented at docs.sonetel.com (Stoplight-hosted), with its API docs source maintained in the Sonetel GitHub organization.
s.name: Sonetel

s.description: Songfinch is a Chicago-based direct-to-consumer music gifting platform that pairs customers with a curated community of independent professional singer-songwriters to produce one-of-a-kind personalized songs. A buyer picks an artist by genre, mood and tempo, submits the story and details behind the occasion through a guided song builder, and the artist writes, records and delivers an original recording to a shareable song page, with add-on products spanning lyric prints, vinyl, CDs, sheet music, QR plaques, streaming release and rights upgrades. Songfinch operates a two-sided marketplace — a consumer storefront plus an artist application and artist admin — and has paid out tens of millions of dollars to independent artists. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract; api.songfinch.com is a private first-party application backend for its own storefront.
s.name: Songfinch

s.description: Music Events
s.name: Songkick

s.description: Get all the services on which a song is available
s.name: Songlink / Odesli

s.description: Songstats provides music data analytics through its Enterprise API, enabling music industry professionals to access streaming statistics, audience data, chart positions, playlist placements, and catalog information for artists, tracks, record labels, and collaborators across all major streaming platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Deezer, TikTok, and more. Integrated with Radiostats for radio airplay data across 40,000+ stations.
s.name: Songstats

s.description: Provides guitar, bass and drums tabs and chords
s.name: Songsterr

s.description: Songtradr is a Santa Monica, California B2B music company that builds licensing, rights and music-data infrastructure for brands, agencies, digital platforms, artists and rightsholders. Founded in 2014, it operates a global sync-licensing marketplace alongside acquired businesses including Bandcamp, 7digital, MassiveMusic, Big Sync Music and the AI music-metadata company Musicube. Its public developer surface is the Songtradr API — a JWT-authenticated REST API, documented with a live OpenAPI 3.1 description, that returns deep music metadata (musical features, genre predictions, tags, taggrams, tag strengths, contributors, similarity vectors) and drives auto-tagging: rightsholders upload audio through a presigned S3 link and Songtradr's models classify it against a taxonomy of 350+ descriptive tags across 30+ categories, then expose semantic search over the results. First-party API clients are published for Python, JavaScript/Node and Ruby.
s.name: Songtradr

s.description: Songtrust is a New York City-based music publishing administration platform and a Downtown Music company.
