s.description: Syscap is a Monterrey-based Mexican financial technology company that provides a private-credit and funding-management platform for non-bank financial intermediaries (SOFOMs and financieras). Its software helps loan originators manage funding lines, organize documentation, automate tax compliance, generate amortization tables and electronic signatures, and give funders a 24/7 transparency portal with balance reports and transaction tracking. More than 140 financial institutions across Mexico use Syscap to manage private debt. The company operates a web application and a mobile app; it does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.
s.name: Syscap

s.description: Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing, and distributing food products to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, and other foodservice customers. Sysco operates the Sysco Shop ecommerce platform (US, Canada, Bahamas) backed by an Apollo GraphQL supergraph composed of domain subgraphs for ordering, product, pricing, delivery, and accounts. Programmatic access is partner/customer-gated through the login-only APIC Developer Portal and through traditional EDI (X12) trading-partner integration; Sysco does not publish a self-serve public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or open GitHub presence.
s.name: Sysco

s.description: Sysdig is a cloud and container security platform that provides runtime threat detection, vulnerability management, cloud security posture management (CSPM), compliance automation, and observability for containers, Kubernetes, and cloud environments. Sysdig Monitor offers full-stack monitoring and alerting while Sysdig Secure delivers runtime security, vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, incident response, and compliance reporting.
s.name: Sysdig

s.description: Sysdyne Technologies is a Stamford, Connecticut software company that has served ready-mix concrete producers worldwide since 1976. Its cloud-native platform spans the full production lifecycle — Slabstack quoting and CRM, Concrete-Go central dispatch, Batch-Go batch automation, Delivery-Go / iStrada delivery management and paperless e-ticketing, QuickLink ERP/accounting sync, and Insight-Go operational analytics. Sysdyne exposes the ConcreteGO "Webcrete" SOAP web-service API plus full-suite interoperability, letting producers integrate dispatch, batch, and delivery data bi-directionally with ERP, accounting, and telematics systems such as QuickBooks, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Acumatica, Samsara, and Geotab.
s.name: Sysdyne Technologies

s.description: SYSPRO is a manufacturing and distribution ERP platform providing a REST API and integration framework for managing production orders, inventory, purchasing, sales, financial accounting, and supply chain operations. The platform supports integration via e.net Solutions business objects, OData RESTful endpoints, and WCF services, enabling ISVs and custom application developers to extend and connect with the SYSPRO ecosystem.
s.name: SYSPRO

s.description: System Initiative is an AI-native infrastructure automation platform. It builds an interactive digital twin of your cloud infrastructure — modeling every resource as a "component" inside reviewable "change sets" — so that engineers and AI agents can discover, simulate, and safely apply changes to production. It works alongside Terraform, Pulumi, and GitOps and can be adopted incrementally. System Initiative exposes a workspace-scoped Public API (the "luminork" server) with bearer-token auth, first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs, and a first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents can model and automate infrastructure programmatically. Backed by Amplify Partners and Battery Ventures.
s.name: System Initiative

s.description: Systemax Inc. (now operating as Global Industrial Company, NYSE: SYX) is a B2B direct marketer of industrial, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products in North America. The company sells storage and shelving, material handling equipment, safety products, tools, HVAC, office supplies, and thousands of other industrial products to businesses, educational organizations, and government entities through its Global Industrial brand. Systemax was founded in 1949 and rebranded its primary segment to Global Industrial in 2021.
s.name: Systemax

s.description: Govornment owned liqour store in Sweden
s.name: Systembolaget

s.description: systemd is a suite of basic building blocks for a Linux system. It runs as PID 1 and is the system and service manager that bootstraps the rest of the userspace, supervises long-running services, and exposes a coordinated set of D-Bus and Varlink IPC interfaces for managing services (systemd1), users and sessions (logind), network interfaces (networkd), name resolution (resolved), containers/VMs (machined), home directories (homed), boot entries (boot1/sysupdate1), system hostname/locale/timedate, OOM protection (oomd), portable services, and image imports. The project also publishes a stable command-line surface (systemctl, journalctl, networkctl, resolvectl, loginctl, machinectl, hostnamectl, timedatectl, localectl, busctl, varlinkctl, bootctl, homectl, coredumpctl, oomctl, portablectl, importctl, systemd-analyze and more). systemd is dual-licensed (LGPL-2.1-or-later for libraries and most code, GPL-2.0-or-later for select tools) and developed openly on GitHub at systemd/systemd.
s.name: systemd

s.description: Systems Center, Inc. was a mainframe and enterprise systems-management software vendor best known for the NetMaster network-management product line. The company was acquired by Sterling Software of Dallas in a 1993 deal (approximately $185M), after which NetMaster was folded into Sterling's data-communications portfolio and rebranded (Connect:Direct lineage); Sterling Software was itself acquired by Computer Associates in 2000. Systems Center was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. An enrichment pass (2026-07-21) searched for any live website, developer portal, or API surface and found none: the company is defunct with no independent public presence, so no API artifacts apply.
s.name: Systems Center

s.description: Systems Engineering, Inc. (SEI) is a US multiple listing service (MLS) software vendor whose NAVICA product line serves REALTOR boards and associations: NAVICA MLS, NAVICA NEXT, Showing Manager, Mobile Plus and Client apps, Association Management System (AMS), STREAMline, Data Share, Tax/public-data and web solutions. For data access SEI operates both RETS and RESO Web API servers that meet RESO compliance requirements including the RESO Data Dictionary (RESO certification record T00000075); access requires an agreement between the board/MLS, the participating office, the third party and SEI, with monthly fees. Partner integrations (dotloop, zipLogix, CRS, Property Panorama) use SSO and per-listing integration. No public API reference, base URL or machine-readable contract is published.
s.name: Systems Engineering, Inc. (SEI)

s.description: SYSTRAN is a machine translation and natural language processing company offering neural (Pure Neural Machine Translation / PNMT) translation across 50+ languages. The SYSTRAN Translate API is a RESTful service (base https://api-translate.systran.net) that translates text, files, and HTML, detects and lists supported languages, and manages translation profiles, user dictionaries, and corpora. The broader SYSTRAN Platform / SYSTRAN.io surface adds NLP operations - morphology, tokenization, segmentation, named entity recognition, and language identification. Requests authenticate with an API key (key query parameter or Authorization header). SYSTRAN sells access as a Developer cloud subscription (14-day / 500,000-character free trial) plus Professional SaaS and Enterprise cloud/on-premise plans, billed per character.
s.name: SYSTRAN

s.description: Syzygy Plasmonics is a Houston, Texas deep-decarbonization company commercializing photocatalytic chemical manufacturing. Its Rigel reactor cell uses photonic energy from renewable electricity in place of combustion heat to drive reforming reactions, and its NovaSAF / GHG e-Reforming pathway converts waste biogas into low-carbon sustainable aviation fuel, independently assessed as eligible for both ISCC EU RFNBO and Advanced BioSAF certification. Adjacent targets include hydrogen from ammonia e-cracking, syngas, methanol, butadiene and other commodity chemicals, sold as reactor hardware plus a licensing and front-end engineering support package. Syzygy is a hardware and process-licensing business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-08-29 it publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.
s.name: Syzygy Plasmonics

t.description: t is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
t.name: t

t.description: A major American wireless network operator and the second-largest carrier in the United States. Known for its Un-carrier strategy disrupting the wireless industry with simplified plans, no-contract offerings, and aggressive 5G network expansion.
t.name: T-Mobile

t.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm (NYSE: TROW) offering a broad range of investment management strategies and retirement solutions to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Founded in 1937, the firm manages mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, and retirement plans including 401(k) services. T. Rowe Price does not offer a public REST API but provides institutional client portals, data feeds, and integrations with retirement recordkeeping platforms and open banking aggregators such as Plaid and Finicity.
t.name: T. Rowe Price

t.description: T2P Co., Ltd. (DeepPocket) is a Bangkok, Thailand fintech founded in 2011 that provides comprehensive payment solutions for enterprises of all sizes. Its products include a payment gateway (cards, mobile wallets, in-store), a white-label digital wallet platform, corporate and prepaid card issuance, spend management with real-time controls, business escrow, the DeepBlok loyalty program, and the DeepPocket consumer e-wallet app for top-ups, payments, and global money transfers. T2P is backed by 500 Global, Benchachinda Holding, DTAC Accelerate, and J Ventures, and reports serving 10M+ customers and 30+ corporate clients. T2P holds PCI DSS compliance but publishes no public developer API surface; integrations are arranged directly with the company.
t.name: T2P

t.description: t4game (呈天游 / Bstonegames) is the brand of Beijing Chengtian Network Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese online-game developer and operator founded in 2008 and headquartered in Beijing. The company designs, publishes, and operates mobile, PC, and web-based games — including titles such as 醉江湖online (Drunk Rivers and Lakes Online) and 诛神传奇/诛神online (Zhushen Online) — spanning role-playing, real-time strategy, and shooting genres. Its public presence at t4game.com is a consumer-facing game portal (player login, registration, and recharge), company and culture pages, a product catalog, game/media news, and recruitment listings. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, CLI, MCP server, or other machine-readable API surface could be found.
t.name: t4game

t.description: Taalas is a Toronto-based semiconductor company building "Hardcore Models" — AI models etched directly into custom silicon rather than executed as software on general-purpose GPUs, under the tagline "The Model is The Computer." Its first product, the HC1 technology demonstrator, hard-wires Meta's Llama 3.1 8B into an 815mm2 / 53-billion-transistor die on TSMC's 6nm process and is publicly demonstrated through the ChatJimmy chatbot. Taalas exposes that silicon to developers through a hosted inference REST API at api.taalas.com, which publishes two OpenAPI 3.1.0 contracts: a root API with health, model-info and a Taalas-native /generate operation, and an OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface with /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions. Access is by bearer API key issued through an application form; applications are currently closed due to demand.
t.name: Taalas

t.description: Taascom (branded "The As A Service Company", taascom.com) is a San Jose, California company founded in 2019 that provides an IoT-based servitization SaaS platform helping equipment makers shift from transactional capex sales to recurring subscription, pay-per-use, and outcome-based revenue models. Its packaged offerings include Device-as-a-Service, Auto-Replenishment-as-a-Service, and Uptime-as-a-Service. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found a marketing-stage web presence only — no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface at the time of this pass.
t.name: Taascom

t.description: Tab (tab.travel) is a London-based payment platform built specifically for independent tourism and hospitality businesses — hotels, hostels, tour operators, retreat centers and activity providers. It lets these merchants take card payments wherever their guests are, from in-advance deposits and online booking pages to in-person, on-the-move transactions via a mobile app, and to plug into an existing booking engine, PMS or OTA ecosystem. Tab natively handles 140+ currencies, pays out weekly in the merchant's local currency, and advertises transparent pricing from 2.9% per transaction with no hidden fees. Founded in 2015 by Mark Datta and backed by Y Combinator (W2015), Tab also operates a consumer-facing social-commerce guide for discovering and booking travel. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Tab does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs or API documentation.
t.name: Tab

t.description: tab32 is a cloud-based dental practice management, imaging, and analytics platform for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). tab32 offers a real, commercial API - powered by Google Apigee and HIPAA / SOC 2 Type II compliant - that exposes tab32's patient, provider, schedule, charts, notes, ledger, and payments data objects to DSOs and third-party developers. Access is partner-gated, not open self-service - developers reach the API through tab32's developer API portal after establishing a partnership or enterprise relationship, and full endpoint reference, authentication, and base URL details live behind that portal rather than on the public website. The API entries below are modeled from tab32's publicly documented data objects and API messaging; their endpoint paths are not published publicly and are therefore illustrative, not confirmed.
t.name: tab32

t.description: TabaPay is an instant money movement platform for fintechs, banks, and payment companies. One Unified API accepts payments (pull) and sends payouts (push) across debit and credit card networks (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, Accel, STAR), RTP by The Clearing House, and ACH, with cross-border push-to-card, 3D Secure, account verification (AVS, ANI, OFAC), tokenized card storage, KYB/KYC verifications, ledgers, and real-time transaction monitoring. TabaPay is a PCI DSS Level 1 service provider, SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II certified, and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. APIs are not publicly self-serve: clients board through TabaPay and receive a dedicated FQDN plus bearer credentials for sandbox and production.
t.name: TabaPay

t.description: Tabby is the MENA region's largest buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) provider, founded in 2019 by Hosam Arab (ex-Namshi) and Daniil Barkalov, originally in Dubai and now headquartered in Riyadh ahead of a planned IPO. Tabby reached a $3.3B valuation in a February 2025 Series E ($160M co-led by Blue Pool Capital and Hassana Investment Company), making it the most valuable fintech in the Middle East, and reports 15M+ users, 40,000+ merchants, and $10B+ in annualized transaction volume across KSA, UAE, and Kuwait. The Tabby API powers split-purchase checkouts (Pay-in-4 interest-free, monthly plans up to 12 months), payment lifecycle management, webhooks, and dispute resolution, complemented by Tabby Card (Visa-enabled), Tabby Shop discovery, Tabby Care purchase protection, and the Tabby Plus loyalty programme. Public developer surface includes a versioned REST API across two regional hosts (api.tabby.ai for UAE/Kuwait, api.tabby.sa for KSA), an OpenAPI 3.1 specification, iOS / Android / Flutter / React Native SDKs, and certified Magento 2, Shopify, WooCommerce, Salla, Zid, OpenCart, ExpandCart, Matjrah, Salesforce, and Odoo plugins.
t.name: Tabby

t.description: Tabby is an open-source, self-hosted AI coding assistant - a privacy-first alternative to GitHub Copilot from TabbyML (Apache-2.0). You run the Tabby server yourself (Docker, a consumer-grade GPU, or your own cloud); there is no shared multi-tenant API and no external calls to third parties. The server exposes an OpenAPI-documented REST surface (Swagger UI at /swagger-ui, spec at /api-docs/openapi.json) for code completion, OpenAI-compatible chat completions, an Answer Engine backed by a doc-ingestion knowledge base, health, model registry, and telemetry events. Because it is self-hosted, the base URL is your own instance (default http://localhost:8080). TabbyML also offers hosted Team and Enterprise plans.
t.name: Tabby

t.description: Tabit is a mobile-first, cloud-based restaurant point-of-sale and hospitality management platform from Tabit Technologies. Its product suite spans tableside mobile ordering and payments (PAD/Pay), online ordering (Order), kitchen display (Chef), self-service kiosks, delivery (Wheels), guest management, gift cards, and hotel F&B/PMS integration. Tabit does not publish a public, self-service developer API or API reference; integrations are delivered through a partner program and an integration-request process rather than an open developer portal.
t.name: Tabit

t.description: Open Table Format is a category of open standards for organizing and managing data in data lakehouses. The three dominant formats are Apache Iceberg (the emerging industry standard with snapshot-based metadata and broad engine support), Delta Lake (Databricks-originated, transaction-log-based), and Apache Hudi (upsert-optimized with Copy-on-Write and Merge-on-Read modes). These formats bring ACID transactions, schema evolution, time travel, and efficient query planning to data lake storage. Apache Iceberg defines a REST Catalog API (OpenAPI spec) that enables standardized catalog operations across implementations like Polaris, Nessie, AWS Glue, and Google BigLake.
t.name: Table Format

t.description: Table22 is a subscription commerce and growth platform built specifically for food & beverage businesses. It enables restaurants, wine shops, wineries, butchers, bakeries, specialty grocers, and retailers to launch and grow subscriptions, clubs, memberships, pre-orders, and product drops that generate predictable recurring revenue beyond their four walls. The full-service platform combines branded storefronts, an order management system, white-glove fulfillment coordination, automated lifecycle marketing and CRM, five-star consumer support, and AI tools for hospitality. Over 1,000 merchants across 40 U.S. states use Table22, representing $100M+ in revenue impact. Pricing is success-based (15% revenue share, no upfront or setup fees). Table22 is a sales-led SaaS with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, website surface, and machine-readable llms.txt.
t.name: Table22

t.description: TABLEAPP (Tableapp Sdn Bhd, part of FunNow Ltd) is a real-time restaurant discovery and reservation platform serving diners across Malaysia (Klang Valley) and Thailand. Consumers discover restaurants and book tables with instant confirmation through the TABLEAPP website and iOS/Android apps, and the TABLEAPP ELITE membership unlocks free signature dishes at partner restaurants, alongside dining vouchers and gift cards. Restaurateurs list on both TABLEAPP and FunNow and manage reservations and guest preferences with the TABLEAPP Manager tools. TableApp is a 500 Global portfolio company; it operates a private mobile-app backend (api.tableapp.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.
t.name: TableApp

t.description: Tableau is a visual analytics platform transforming the way we use data to solve problems—empowering people and organizations to make the most of their data.
t.name: Tableau

t.description: APIs and integration points for Tableau Desktop, a data visualization and business intelligence platform from Salesforce. Tableau provides REST APIs, embedding APIs, extension APIs, and SDK tools for building custom visualizations, automating server operations, and extending analytics capabilities.
t.name: Tableau Desktop

t.description: Tableaux de Bord (French for "dashboards") is an API industry topic covering dashboard and data visualization APIs. The landscape includes open-source platforms such as Grafana (with its comprehensive HTTP API for dashboards, datasources, and alerting) and Metabase (with its REST API for questions, dashboards, and administration). These tools enable programmatic creation and management of business intelligence dashboards for monitoring, analytics, and operational visibility.
t.name: Tableaux De Bord

t.description: TableCheck is a restaurant booking and guest-experience platform (founded 2011, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan) used by thousands of restaurants across 35+ countries to consolidate reservations, availability, guest CRM, memberships, and POS integration into one system. TableCheck exposes a production JSON/REST API, partitioned into components - Availability, Web Booking, Booking, CRM, POS, and Site Controller - under https://api.tablecheck.com/api. Access is partner-gated, and a per-environment secret_key is issued by the TableCheck API team on approval, while some components (notably the direct Booking API) are available only by special arrangement. Each component publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 description.
t.name: TableCheck

t.description: Tabnine provides AI code completion, chat, and agentic workflows across IDEs and CLI, with strong support for SaaS, VPC, and air-gapped on-prem deployments. The Enterprise Context Engine indexes a customer's codebase, dependencies, and architecture. Tabnine's consumer surface is via IDE plugins (VS Code, JetBrains, Eclipse) and the Tabnine CLI; there is no general-purpose public REST inference API for end-developers.
t.name: Tabnine

t.description: Taboola (NASDAQ: TBLA) is a New-York-headquartered native and discovery advertising company founded in 2007 by Adam Singolda. Its Realize performance marketing platform serves recommendation widgets across major publishers (a 30-year exclusive partnership with Yahoo since 2022) and offers advertisers programmatic access via the Backstage API for campaign management, audience targeting, conversion tracking, and reporting. The company also operates Connexity (commerce media), Skimlinks (publisher monetization), and DeeperDive (content discovery), and recently shipped Abby (AI ad assistant), the GenAI Ad Maker, and an official Realize MCP server for AI-driven campaign management.
t.name: Taboola

t.description: Tabs is an AI-native revenue automation platform for B2B companies that streamlines the entire contract-to-cash lifecycle — contract ingestion, billing generation, invoicing, collections, cash application, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and reporting. Its Universal (External) API v3 exposes the underlying revenue data model of customers, contracts, obligations, billing terms, performance obligations, invoices, payments, credit memos, products, commitments, and renewals, while a dedicated Usage API (Beta) ingests high-throughput usage events with strong idempotency. Tabs also operates an official read-only MCP server over its "Commercial Graph" so AI agents can query live billing, revenue, and contract data. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst ($91M+ raised through its 2025 Series B), Tabs integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Plaid, Anrok, and Avalara.
t.name: Tabs

t.description: Tabs (tabs.inc) is an AI-native revenue automation platform for B2B companies that unifies billing, collections, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and reporting on top of a contract-driven data model. Tabs ingests executed contracts, uses AI to extract commercial terms, automatically generates invoices, schedules ASC 606-compliant revenue, drives collections, and produces real-time ARR, cash, and AR reporting. The public Tabs Platform REST API (https://api.tabsplatform.com, documented at docs.tabsplatform.com) exposes the core data model - customers, contracts, items, revenue categories, obligations, invoices, payments, usage events, and performance obligations - so contract, billing, and revenue data can flow into the rest of the finance stack (ERP, CRM, payment, and tax systems). Supports subscription, usage-based, metered, and hybrid billing models. Authenticated with an API key passed in the Authorization header.
t.name: Tabs

t.description: TabTabTab runs coding agents in the background, triggered by webhooks, schedules, Slack, or direct requests. You wire up a trigger once and work comes back to you: code changes arrive as pull requests you can verify before you merge, while ops and data-analysis jobs skip the PR and report back when done. Agents run on a persistent cloud VM ("environment") on your own Codex or Claude Code accounts, coordinated by an always-on meta agent that routes work across projects and dispatches isolated worker sessions. Every pull request ships with receipts — a browser test video, a password-protected preview URL, and a trace of what triggered the run — so verification is a two-minute review instead of a re-investigation. Drive it from the dashboard, from Slack, or with the official tabtabtab CLI and the published tabtabtab agent skill.
t.name: TabTabTab

t.description: Tabular was an independent, managed cloud data platform and storage engine built on Apache Iceberg, founded in 2021 by Ryan Blue, Daniel Weeks, and Jason Reid — two of the original creators of Apache Iceberg and a former head of Data Engineering at Netflix. Its central product was a managed Iceberg catalog exposed over the open Apache Iceberg REST Catalog protocol (an OpenAPI-defined common API), giving any compute engine vendor-neutral access to a single copy of data. Databricks agreed to acquire Tabular in June 2024 and closed the deal that month; the founders joined Databricks and the standalone product was wound down. As of this enrichment pass the tabular.io domain no longer resolves and the tabular-io GitHub organization has no public repositories, so there is no live first-party API surface to harvest. This profile is retained as a historical/acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network.
t.name: Tabular

t.description: Tachyus provides AI-powered operational optimization and greenhouse-gas emissions management software for the energy and industrial sectors, combining data, reservoir physics, and machine learning. Its Tachapps platform spans Strateon (production and injection allocation), Aqueon (conventional reservoir management and optimization), and Aurion (GHG emissions accounting, monitoring, forecasting, and regulatory reporting). The Tachapps REST API (v1) is organized around Projects, Wells, and Production Data, using Bearer API-token authentication with scopes, JSON over HTTPS, cursor-based pagination, and per-plan rate limits.
t.name: Tachyus

t.description: Tacit Networks was an early-2000s enterprise networking vendor and one of the leading providers of WAN Optimization technology for Wide Area File Services (WAFS), letting distributed offices access centralized file servers over the wide area network at LAN-like speeds. Backed by Canaan Partners (Series A led by Maha Ibrahim), JP Morgan, Chevron Technology Ventures and RRE Ventures, the company was acquired by Packeteer in May 2006 (subsequently absorbed into Blue Coat Systems and Symantec). It is defunct: it operated no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface, so this profile carries company identity only and has no API artifacts to enrich.
t.name: Tacit

t.description: Tackle.io is the Cloud Marketplace and Co-Sell platform that helps software vendors list, sell, co-sell, and meter through the AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud marketplaces. The Tackle developer surface spans nine services: a core Platform API (authentication, webhooks, metering/usage records, products, subscriptions, disbursements, invoices, registrations), a Prospect buyer-signal scoring API, Co-Sell APIs for AWS Partner Central, Microsoft Partner Center, and Google Cloud, Private Offer APIs for the AWS and Microsoft marketplaces, a public Contracts API, and a SCIM 2.0 user-provisioning API. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 client-credentials (machine-to-machine) issuing short-lived JWT bearer tokens gated by fine-grained RBAC permissions.
t.name: Tackle.io

t.description: Tacoda is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of union-square-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
t.name: Tacoda

t.description: Community-driven taco database
t.name: TacoFancy

t.description: Tact.ai was a Redwood City, California conversational-AI and field-engagement company founded by Chuck Ganapathi that built an AI sales assistant ("Tact Assistant") unifying CRM, email, and calendar data into a voice- and chat-driven interface for enterprise sales teams, later concentrating on the life sciences vertical. It was backed by Accel, Redpoint Ventures, Upfront Ventures, Microsoft's M12, and Salesforce Ventures. In November 2023 its field-engagement and conversational-AI technology was acquired by Aktana and the standalone company wound down. The tact.ai domain no longer hosts a product: it resolves to an Afternic domain-for-sale parking page (nameservers ns1/ns2.afternic.com), and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal to enrich.
t.name: Tact.ai

t.description: Tactic was a cryptocurrency and digital-asset accounting platform founded in 2021 in New York and backed by Lux Capital. Its product aggregated on-chain activity and exchange/custody data (Coinbase and others) into a unified treasury view and crypto sub-ledger, automatically categorizing transactions, calculating USD gain/loss and taxable events, and reconciling the crypto sub-ledger to traditional accounting software such as QuickBooks. Tactic launched from stealth in 2022 (originally on choosetactic.com, later the exact-match tactic.com) and raised roughly $13.6M before being acquired by TaxBit in January 2023 to augment TaxBit's digital-asset accounting suite. The standalone product, developer portal, and API surface have been retired; the tactic.com domain is now listed for sale and no independent developer surface remains.
t.name: Tactic

t.description: Tactile Games is a Danish mobile game studio headquartered in Copenhagen, founded in 2014, that builds and publishes casual free-to-play puzzle titles for iOS and Android. Its portfolio includes Lily's Garden, Penny & Flo, Makeover Match, the Cookie Cats series (Cookie Cats, Cookie Cats Pop, Cookie Cats Blast), and the Simon's Cat games. Tactile is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. It is a consumer game publisher rather than an API producer: it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.
t.name: Tactile Games

t.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.
t.name: Tacto

t.description: Tacton provides CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) software that helps manufacturers and complex‑product sellers streamline their sales processes. Their platform enables engineering‑to‑order, AI‑driven configuration, and seamless integration with ERP and CRM systems, improving buyer experience across industries such as chemical, energy, medical, and industrial equipment. Tacton’s solutions focus on digital transformation, enabling faster quoting, accurate pricing, and better collaboration between commercial and technical teams.
t.name: Tacton

t.description: Taddy is a GraphQL API for podcasts and comics, giving developers access to over 4 million podcasts and 200 million episodes, plus real-time full-text search, automatically generated episode transcripts, chapters, iTunes metadata, daily top charts, webcomic and creator data, and webhook notifications for new or updated content. All queries hit a single GraphQL endpoint at https://api.taddy.org authenticated with X-USER-ID and X-API-KEY headers.
t.name: Taddy

t.description: Taddy provides a GraphQL-based podcast API giving developers access to over 4 million podcasts and 200 million episodes with real-time search, episode transcripts, webhooks, top charts, and comic book data. Taddy simplifies building podcast applications by aggregating and standardizing RSS feed data at scale with daily updates of 1,000 new podcasts and 50,000 new episodes.
t.name: Taddy API

t.description: Tadeus is an AI voice agent platform for workforce platforms: one agent holds real, adaptive voice conversations with every employee at scale, in their own language, and returns structured, timestamped records to the HCM, payroll, scheduling and compliance systems people already use. It works from the transcript rather than the audio and reports comprehension and engagement signals about responses rather than inferring emotion, which is the position its published EU AI Act documentation rests on. The public Integration API is a 47-operation REST surface for creating interview templates and campaigns, inviting participants individually or in bulk, creating anonymous sessions, and retrieving transcripts, structured results with per-response quality signals, and cross-session AI insights. Tadeus went generally available on 14 July 2026 and also ships a hosted, first-party MCP server so agents can commission interviews and query results as tool calls.
t.name: Tadeus API

t.description: tado provides smart heating and cooling solutions that enable users to control thermostats, radiators, boilers, underfloor heating, and air conditioners via a mobile app. The platform offers energy savings of up to 22% on average, integrates with smart EV charging, and supports smart energy tariffs. With a focus on user-friendly automation, tado helps households reduce heating costs and improve comfort through intelligent climate control.
t.name: tado

t.description: TAE Technologies (formerly Tri Alpha Energy) is a Foothill Ranch, California fusion energy company founded in 1998, pursuing commercial fusion power using aneutronic hydrogen-boron (p-B11) fuel in an advanced beam-driven field-reversed configuration (FRC). Because the p-B11 reaction is aneutronic, TAE's approach produces virtually no neutron flux or on-site radioactive waste compared with conventional deuterium-tritium concepts. The company has built a progression of plasma machines — Sewer Pipe, CBFR-SPS, C-2, C-2U, and C-2W ("Norman") — and is constructing Copernicus in Irvine, California to demonstrate net energy gain, with Da Vinci planned as the grid-connected power-plant demonstration. TAE has raised more than USD 1.2 billion from investors including Google, Chevron, NEA, Goldman Sachs, Vulcan, Venrock, Wellcome Trust, and the Kuwait Investment Authority, and runs research collaborations with Japan's National Institute for Fusion Science (NIFS). Two operating subsidiaries commercialize spin-off technology: TAE Life Sciences develops accelerator-based Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) systems for cancer treatment, and TAE Power Solutions builds modular, software-controlled power-management systems for e-mobility and battery applications. TAE is a private hardware and deep-science company; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or public open-source code repository.
t.name: TAE Technologies

t.description: Tagged is a social discovery and dating platform founded in 2004 and based in San Francisco, where members browse profiles of people nearby or worldwide, chat, play social games, exchange tags and virtual gifts, and make new connections. Originally a standalone social network backed by early investors including Uncork Capital (formerly SoftTech VC), Tagged was acquired by MeetMe in 2017 for roughly 60 million dollars and today operates as a consumer brand within The Meet Group (part of the ParshipMeet Group) alongside apps such as MeetMe, Skout, and LOVOO. The current tagged.com is a consumer-facing web and mobile social-dating experience with no public developer program or API; a legacy REST-style API (tagged.com/api.php) that once powered third-party integrations has been retired. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record rather than an API producer.
t.name: Tagged

t.description: Taggle Internet Ventures Private Limited was an Indian online group-buying / daily-deals platform (taggle.com) incorporated in 2010 in Bangalore, Karnataka, that brought consumers together to purchase discounted products and services from merchants across food & beverage, wellness, and beauty. It raised an early venture round in 2010 and is now reported as permanently closed. The enrichment pass found no live developer program, public API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or documentation for this entity. Note: the taggle.com domain is now operated by an unrelated Australian digital water-metering company, Taggle Systems, which is a distinct company and not the subject of this record. This profile was surfaced during VC-portfolio mining and is retained as a historical/closed-company stub with no API surface to enrich.
t.name: Taggle Internet Ventures

t.description: TagoIO is an IoT cloud application development platform that enables businesses to build, deploy, and manage IoT applications with a comprehensive REST API. The platform provides full programmatic control over devices, dashboards, data storage, analysis scripts, alerts, and user management. TagoIO exposes regional REST API endpoints covering device data ingestion, entity management, access control policies, and file storage, all secured with token-based authentication. Plans range from a free tier supporting five devices up to an enterprise-grade TagoDeploy option supporting millions of devices with dedicated cloud instances and customizable rate limits.
t.name: TagoIO

t.description: Tagomi was an institutional-grade cryptocurrency prime brokerage founded in 2018 in New York that offered smart order routing and cross-exchange best-execution across 14+ digital-asset venues, a library of advanced trading algorithms, post-trade reporting, and one-click settlement and custody for professional and institutional investors. Coinbase acquired Tagomi in May 2020 in an all-stock deal (reported at roughly $70-100M) and folded it in as the foundation of Coinbase Prime. The tagomi.com domain now 301-redirects to Coinbase Prime, and no independent Tagomi API, developer portal, or documentation surface remains.
t.name: Tagomi

t.description: Tagove was a live chat, video chat, and co-browsing customer support platform (a 500 Global portfolio company) that now operates as Acquire.io. Acquire is an omnichannel customer support and conversational engagement platform whose developer platform (developer.acquire.io) exposes a REST API for conversations/cases, messages, contacts, companies, chatbots, knowledge base, analytics, and account settings, plus outbound HMAC-SHA256-signed webhooks, iOS/Android/JS SDKs, and an embeddable live-chat and co-browse widget. This profile was enriched from the Acquire developer documentation; no machine-readable OpenAPI is published.
t.name: Tagove

t.description: tagSpace is a Spatial AI platform, part of the tagStorm group, that lets creators and brands publish interactive augmented-reality experiences and spatial content anchored to real-world places. Through its create, explore, and publish surfaces, tagSpace offers a creator-economy platform where makers showcase spatial "tags," and its tagAI layer applies AI to spatial content. It markets to brands and enterprises (B2B) with named partners including RTL, Telekom, Telstra, Warner Music Group and others. The public site is a Framer marketing presence; as of this enrichment pass tagSpace exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or well-known API metadata. This profile remains an identity-only company record.
t.name: tagSpace

t.description: Tahoe Therapeutics (formerly Vevo Therapeutics) is a South San Francisco digital-biology company building the "ground truth for biological superintelligence." Its Mosaic platform generates perturbative single-cell data in vivo at gigascale, and it trains AI models — including the Tahoe-x1 single-cell foundation model (up to 3 billion parameters) and the Rhaister family of perturbation-response models — on the resulting data to discover novel drug targets and predict how patient cells respond to drugs. Tahoe openly publishes datasets (including the 100-million-cell Tahoe-100M atlas) and model weights on Hugging Face, ships the tahoe-x1 Python package on PyPI, and operates Tara, an autonomous research agent. The company does not run a public REST API. Backed by Amplify Partners; raised $30M in 2025.
t.name: Tahoe Therapeutics

t.description: Taiga is an open-source agile project management platform with a comprehensive REST API for managing projects, sprints, user stories, issues, tasks, epics, wiki pages, webhooks, and team member assignments. The API supports both standard bearer token and application token authentication, with optional server-side throttling. Available as a cloud-hosted service or self-hosted deployment.
t.name: Taiga

t.description: Tailcall is a high-performance GraphQL API gateway and runtime that lets developers compose multiple upstream REST, gRPC, and GraphQL APIs into a unified GraphQL schema. Built in Rust, it offers declarative configuration via .graphql files with directives for HTTP, caching, batching, and security controls. The open-source runtime (Apache 2.0) supports deployment on AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, and bare metal. Tailcall Inc has subsequently shipped ForgeCode, a CLI coding harness built on the same performance-first ethos.
t.name: Tailcall

t.description: Tailor Technologies builds Tailor Platform, a headless, API-first ERP for retail, e-commerce and manufacturing operators. Its control plane is exposed as a single 254-RPC ConnectRPC service published as Protocol Buffers, and every application built on it gets an automatically generated GraphQL API over TailorDB with resolvers, pipelines, executors, workflows, an auth service and an OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway. The company ships a TypeScript SDK, a CLI, a Terraform provider, a React application framework (AppShell) and a first-party MCP server, and publishes llms.txt on both its marketing and documentation hosts. Tailor is a Y Combinator (S22) company and has raised $37M through Series A.
t.name: Tailor

t.description: Tailor Brands is an AI-powered business-building platform for small businesses and entrepreneurs, combining company formation with branding and ongoing compliance. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York with R&D in Tel Aviv, it began as an automated logo maker and expanded into a full SMB stack: LLC and C-corp/S-corp formation, EIN issuance, registered agent service, annual reports and state filings, business licenses, trademarks, legal documents, bookkeeping and invoicing, payments, business bank accounts, domains, websites, digital business cards and print. In January 2026 the company launched Tailor Embedded, exposing its business-formation and compliance engine to partner platforms as a cloud-native, API-first product with JSON:API endpoints, real-time webhooks and native idempotency, alongside a separate Model Context Protocol (MCP) beta for AI agents. Both programs are early-access and admission is by application, so no public API reference or machine-readable contract is published.
t.name: Tailor Brands

t.description: Tailorbird is a CapEx orchestration platform for the multifamily real estate industry, replacing spreadsheet-based capital planning with AI-generated property intelligence. The platform produces unit-level as-builts, takeoffs, and interior models, runs renovation ROI and five-year capital plans, and tracks spend and budget variance in real time across apartment portfolios. Tailorbird ingests PCAs and property documents, integrates with major property-management ERPs including Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, and MRI via custom APIs and ELTs, and maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance. Founded in 2020 and based in Princeton, New Jersey, it serves 28 of the NMHC Top 50 operators and manages more than $2B in annual CapEx across over one million mapped units. It is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company.
t.name: Tailorbird

t.description: Tailored is a stub added to the API Evangelist network from 500 Global's portfolio. The only anchor on this record is the assigned website boatbound.co, which resolves to a defunct, repurposed domain (HTTP 200, behind Cloudflare, now serving unrelated content). That domain originally belonged to Boatbound, a peer-to-peer boat-rental marketplace and 500 Startups portfolio company that was acquired by Boatsetter in 2017 and wound down. No live developer portal, API, OpenAPI, documentation, SDK, or other developer surface could be found for this record; it has no discoverable API surface pending manual identity verification of the "Tailored" name.
t.name: Tailored

t.description: Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear operating the Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, K&G Superstores, Moores Clothing for Men, and Joseph Abboud brands. The company operates over 1,000 retail locations across North America and e-commerce platforms at menswearhouse.com, josbank.com, and kgstores.com. Tailored Brands is preparing for an IPO in 2026 following its 2020 restructuring. No public developer API is currently available.
t.name: Tailored Brands

t.description: TailorMed is a medication success platform that removes access, affordability and adherence barriers across the patient medication journey. Its software connects patients, health systems, clinics, pharmacies and life sciences companies to financial assistance, copay, foundation and free-drug programs, and keeps patient, prescription and program data in sync with the record of care via HL7/FHIR, a REST API, or SFTP file exchange. The product line spans TailorMed Core, Connect, Complete, Amplify and Alliance. TailorMed runs a versioned integration program — an Application Data API, a Claims Data API, a webhook guide and an HL7/FHIR data exchange — documented on a customer-only Implementation Hub; no machine-readable contract is published publicly.
t.name: TailorMed

t.description: Tailscale is a zero-config mesh VPN built on WireGuard that creates secure private networks between devices, users, and services with identity-based access controls, Access Control Lists (ACLs), DNS, and device sharing. Tailscale eliminates traditional VPN complexity with peer-to-peer connectivity and SSO-based authentication. The Tailscale REST API provides programmatic control over tailnets, devices, users, ACLs, and keys using API tokens or OAuth client credentials.
t.name: Tailscale

t.description: TAINA Technology provides a fully automated, AI-driven regulatory tax compliance platform that validates and manages IRS W-series forms, CRS self-certifications, FATCA, CARF, and withholding tax documentation for banks, asset managers, and other financial institutions. Its Tax Form API lets institutions programmatically submit forms and supporting documents for validation, receive results and status codes via real-time webhooks, and retrieve preview and signed PDFs for electronic signature, deployed either embedded into an existing onboarding journey or as a standalone hosted portal. The platform adds OCR of scanned forms, intermediary structure management, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
t.name: Taina

t.description: Taito.ai is an AI-native people operations (HRIS) platform headquartered in Helsinki, Finland, built for teams scaling from roughly 30 to 300 employees. It unifies the employee lifecycle in one system — a people directory, time-off and attendance, documents and eSignatures, and performance reviews — alongside AI "people agents" that handle onboarding, reminders, payroll reporting, and policy questions on demand from Slack, Claude, or any MCP-compatible tool. Every platform action is exposed over the Model Context Protocol rather than a public REST API. Pricing is a single per-seat tier covering both the people-ops and performance modules. The company is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant, publishing audit reports on a Vanta-hosted Trust Center, and raised a $2.7M seed round led by Accel.
t.name: Taito.ai

t.description: TaiVPS (taivps.net) is a Vietnamese hosting provider selling Cloud VPS, VMware Windows/Linux VPS, web hosting, reseller hosting and domain names. It publishes a Vietnamese-language API reference (taivps.net/api-docs) describing token-authenticated POST endpoints under https://taivps.net/api/ for listing products and OS images, buying, upgrading, reinstalling and controlling VPS instances, and reading account balance.
t.name: TaiVPS

t.description: Taiyaki Studios is a Tokyo-based startup working to redefine how anime is consumed, delivering stories that are immediate, engaging, and satisfying. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain Capital in the DeFi/NFT (web3) sector, the studio pairs anime content production with web3 and AI technology and creator-community building. As of this enrichment pass Taiyaki Studios publishes only a marketing website (taiyakistudios.com) and a contact email; it exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.
t.name: Taiyaki Studios

t.description: Taizen is a managed agentic AI platform for go-to-market teams that automates win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence and sales-asset production. Its agents continuously read recorded sales calls (Gong, Fireflies, tl;dv, Granola, Genesys Cloud), CRM deal data (Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, Clari), survey and review signal (Typeform, SurveyMonkey, G2) and existing collateral (Google Drive, SharePoint) to detect recurring objections and competitor moves, then auto-generate battlecards, rep-training drills and AI-roleplay scenarios, and deliver them into Slack. Taizen also books and runs AI-led interviews with lost buyers. Its machine surface is not a REST API but an agent surface: a remote, OAuth-protected MCP server at eu.mcp.usetaizen.com positioned as one connection in place of fifteen-plus individual MCP connectors, and a first-party open-source Claude plugin of thirty GTM Agent Skills. Backed by Techstars, the company emphasizes built-in governance, no model-vendor lock-in, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR posture with an EU data region, and open sources supporting retrieval tooling on GitHub.
t.name: Taizen

t.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO) is a US interactive-entertainment holding company headquartered in New York City that develops and publishes video games through its labels Rockstar Games, 2K, Zynga and Ghost Story Games. It is a Fortune 1000 corporation. Take-Two operates real API infrastructure — api.take2games.com and the T2GP (Take-Two Game Platform) API at api.t2gp.take2games.com, the backend behind its launcher and account system — but it runs no public developer program: no developer portal, no published reference, no machine-readable contract, no SDKs, and no plans or rate limits. Its developer-surface hosts (docs.take2games.com, dev.take2games.com) redirect every request to a FusionAuth SSO login.
t.name: Take-Two Interactive Software

t.description: Take2.ai builds autonomous AI agents purpose-built for healthcare recruiting, automating the end-to-end hiring workflow from candidate sourcing through screening, interviewing, credential verification, and scheduling. Its product suite includes an AI Interviewer that conducts 24/7 phone interviews and syncs scoring and transcripts back into the recruiter's system, an AI Sourcer that re-engages past applicants to build pipelines for hard-to-fill clinical roles, an AI Verifier for real-time credential and certification checks, and an AI Scheduler for interview coordination. The platform integrates with most ATS and HRIS systems, is hosted on AWS in the United States, and is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Take2.ai is a Techstars-backed company serving enterprise healthcare organizations. As of this profile the company exposes a customer-facing SaaS product and ATS/HRIS integrations but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal.
t.name: Take2.ai

t.description: Takealot is South Africa's largest online retailer and the flagship brand of the Takealot Group, a Cape Town-headquartered e-commerce holding company that is majority-owned (approximately 96%) by Naspers through its consumer-internet arm Prosus. The Group operates a connected ecosystem of consumer brands — Takealot.com (general merchandise marketplace), Mr D (on-demand food and grocery delivery), Superbalist.com (fashion and homeware, divested in September 2024 to a South African consortium led by Blank Canvas Capital but historically associated with the Group), and TFS (Takealot Fulfilment Services, the Group's first- and last-mile logistics arm) — and employs more than 7,300 people across South Africa. Takealot.com itself is a 1P-plus-3P hybrid marketplace where Takealot Retail sells its own inventory alongside thousands of third-party Marketplace sellers; sellers list, price, fulfil, and analyse their offers through the Seller Portal at seller.takealot.com and programmatically via the public Takealot Seller API. The Seller API is the company's primary external developer surface — a Swagger 2.0 / OpenAPI REST API at seller-api.takealot.com that exposes offer management (single and 10,000-item batch create / update / patch), stock-health and storage-fee diagnostics, and sales / order / customer-invoice reporting, authenticated with per-seller API keys minted from the Seller Portal and governed by per-key rate-limit headers (x-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / Reset). There is no public buyer-side / catalog / consumer-facing API, no published OAuth flow, no webhook surface, no SDKs, no CLI, and no developer Slack / forum; the Group's GitHub presence (TAKEALOT org) is a small set of archived infrastructure forks (Diamond, statsite, kafka-connect-bigquery, protoc-gen-bq-schema, Newtonsoft.Json, Lithium) rather than a maintained developer platform. The Seller API is the integration point that powers South Africa's marketplace-listing tool ecosystem (Stock2Shop, Wherehouse, Flowgear, OrderEazi, and similar) and is the canonical artifact to profile for any Takealot capability work.
t.name: Takealot

t.description: TakeCareOS is an AI-powered operating system for home care and disability-services agencies. It consolidates fragmented back-office operations — shift rostering and scheduling, GPS-enabled clock-in/out, participant/client CRM, shift notes and incident reporting, timesheet management with variance detection, invoice generation synced to accounting tools (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks), team messaging, and compliance and credential tracking — into a single platform. An AI assistant called Atlas drafts documentation, converts PDF forms to digital, and automates administrative work while requiring human approval. Founded by Ragav Sachdeva and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), the company is based in San Francisco and serves NDIS and Medicaid HCBS providers. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface.
t.name: TakeCareOS

t.description: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a Japanese multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1781 and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (4502) and the New York Stock Exchange (TAK). It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Japan and Asia, and operates globally across oncology, rare genetic and hematologic diseases, neuroscience, gastroenterology, plasma-derived therapies and vaccines, a portfolio substantially expanded by its 2019 acquisition of Shire. Takeda is a software consumer rather than a software vendor: it runs large internal API and data platforms, but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract. The one machine-readable document it does serve to automated clients is an llms.txt at its corporate root, which indexes its verified country websites and states an explicit LLM usage and attribution policy.
t.name: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company

t.description: TakeLessons was an online and in-person lessons marketplace founded in 2007 by Steven Cox and headquartered in San Diego, California. It connected students with independent instructors for music, languages, academic subjects, cooking, and professional training, handling scheduling, payments, and instructor discovery. Microsoft acquired TakeLessons in September 2021 to expand its edtech offerings, then wound the service down: the last day to book lessons was August 15, 2024 and the consumer site closed on November 15, 2024. The company is now defunct and publishes no live website, developer portal, or API surface; this record is retained as a portfolio-lineage stub for the API Evangelist network.
t.name: TakeLessons

t.description: Takenos is a Latin American fintech offering a digital dollar wallet built for freelancers, remote workers, and businesses who need to receive cross-border payments. It lets users get paid from abroad, hold and save in digital dollars with daily yield, and spend via international (TakeCard) and local (SpicyCard) debit cards plus QR payments. Riding the LATAM stablecoin and onchain-finance wave, it targets remittance friction and local-currency inflation across markets including Argentina and Bolivia. Backed by a $5M seed round (investors include 500 Global). No public developer API is documented; this profile was enriched from public sources.
t.name: Takenos

t.description: Takeoff Technologies, Inc. is an eGrocery micro-fulfillment company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It paired KNAPP-built robotic storage-and-retrieval hardware with its own cloud software stack — order management, inventory, pick routing, labor management, and delivery orchestration — into micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs) installed inside or beside existing supermarkets, so grocers could assemble online orders in minutes instead of sending shoppers down the aisles. Customers and partners included Albertsons, Wakefern Food Corp., Woolworths Group and Chilean grocer SMU. The company filed for Chapter 11 in May 2024 and Woolworths Group acquired its micro-fulfillment assets in August 2024. Takeoff never published a public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification anywhere on its public surface, and the marketing site at www.takeoff.com no longer serves TLS. A closed API gateway at api.takeoff.com remains live and actively certificate-maintained, serving customer integrations behind authentication.
t.name: TakeOff

t.description: takepayments (a trading name of Payzone UK Limited) is a United Kingdom payment gateway and merchant-services provider that lets businesses accept card payments online, in person, and over the phone. Its online payment gateway offers Hosted (redirect) and Direct (server-to-server) integrations for e-commerce checkouts, delivered as SOAP v1.1 XML and HTTPS form-POST requests authenticated with a merchant ID and a pre-shared-key signature hash, alongside ready-made shopping-cart plugins and backend SDK code packs. Its newer Terminal API is a modern REST/JSON surface hosted on Azure API Management, secured with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials via Microsoft Azure AD, that pairs and drives card machines (Move5000, PAX A920 Pro) for Start-Transaction, Pairing, Split Bill & Gratuity, and Pay at Table flows. takepayments runs a real public developer portal at developer.takepayments.com but does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger definition; its API reference is documentation-only, and merchant onboarding is sales-led rather than open self-serve.
t.name: takepayments

t.description: Taker is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia-based restaurant technology company (founded 2018, backed by 500 Global) providing an all-in-one online ordering and restaurant-growth platform used by 1,000+ restaurants. Its product suite spans Taker Channels (branded web/mobile ordering), Taker GO (delivery operations), Taker Flow (operations optimization), Taker Grow (marketing automation), and Taker 360 (a unified dashboard across delivery aggregators). The Taker GO delivery-integration API connects restaurants and delivery service providers (DSPs) with bearer-token auth for order creation, tracking, cancellation, and asynchronous status delivery via webhooks, across published sandbox and production environments.
t.name: Taker

t.description: TakeWheels (branded "Wheels", operated by Wheels Labs) was a shared electric micromobility platform based in Los Angeles, founded in 2018, that offered seated pedal-assist e-bikes and dockless light electric vehicles for short-distance urban trips. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital, which participated in the company's 2019 Series A. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or any machine-readable developer surface for this company. As of this pass the primary domain (takewheels.com) no longer resolves to the company: it issues a 301 redirect to an unrelated third-party site, indicating the business is defunct and the domain has been repurposed. This profile is retained as a historical portfolio lead with no active API surface.
t.name: TakeWheels

t.description: Tako is an AI answer-engine API for authoritative, source-grounded data. It serves live financial, macroeconomic, and company data as cited answers, structured knowledge cards (charts, tables, maps), and embeddable visualizations for agents and applications. Developers build with four core APIs — Search (fast structured knowledge cards with no LLM in the loop), Answer (a single written, cited response), Contents (the exact numbers behind a card, as CSV), and Agent (asynchronous deep research runs) — plus a Data Graph for discovering what data exists, and Thin-Viz for turning your own data into embeddable Tako cards. Tako pulls from authoritative government, academic, think-tank, and licensed providers (S&P Global, SimilarWeb, YouGov, NOAA) — not scraped web content. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, an official hosted MCP server, Python and TypeScript SDKs, an installable Agent Skill, an llms.txt, a Machine Payments Protocol surface, and emphasizes zero data retention, SOC 2 compliance, and guaranteed SLAs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital.
t.name: Tako

t.description: Taktile is an agentic decision platform for financial institutions that combines AI speed with human oversight to automate and optimize high-stakes decisions across banking and insurance. Its Decision Engine, AI Agent Manager, Case Manager, and Context Layer power onboarding and KYC, credit underwriting, AML and fraud investigation, claims processing, and insurance underwriting. Teams design, test, deploy, and monitor decision flows and AI agents through a no-code studio backed by real-time APIs (the Taktile API and Flow API), with enterprise-grade infrastructure, data integrations, and governance controls.
t.name: taktile

t.description: TAL is Australia's largest life insurer by inforce risk-only premium (NMG Consulting, 2023), owned by Japan's Dai-ichi Life Group and underwriting through TAL Life Limited (ABN 70 050 109 450, AFSL 237848). Operating in the Australian market for roughly 150 years, TAL writes life cover, income protection, total and permanent disability and critical illness, and reports paying $4.7 billion in benefits to 57,000 customers and their families in its most recent year. It distributes through three channels — financial advisers via the login-gated TAL Adviser Centre, group insurance inside superannuation funds, and direct/embedded offers including backd by TAL, a payroll-embedded product built with Sydney insurtech Cover Genius. TAL is not API-less, it is API-private: certificate transparency and live probing surface a real partner API estate — an OpenID Connect partner identity tenant, a bearer-protected Group Life B2B integration estate (glsb2b), per-distributor API hosts including one named for the Iress adviser software, and a production Underwriting Rules Engine GraphQL endpoint — none of which is documented, registrable or self-serve. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI, and no published ACORD or AL3 position. Australia's Consumer Data Right was designated to extend to insurance but was deferred, so no open-insurance mandate forces a public surface here.
t.name: TAL

t.description: Tala is an AI-native digital financial services company providing instant credit, digital wallets, money transfers, and cash-out services to underserved consumers in informal economies. Built on a proprietary, patent-pending credit-decisioning model trained on billions of dollars of lending data, Tala has delivered more than $7B in credit access to over 13 million customers across Kenya, Mexico, the Philippines, India, Vietnam, Guatemala, Panama, and the Dominican Republic. The company also offers Embedded Credit infrastructure for partners. Tala reaches customers primarily through consumer mobile apps; no public developer API or documentation portal is currently published.
t.name: Tala

t.description: Talaria Technologies, Inc. was a developer-tools startup based in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2011, that built a dynamic web application server and runtime infrastructure for web developers — notably a just-in-time (JIT) compiler and runtime for PHP intended to help developers build and run websites more efficiently. It was surfaced as an Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) portfolio/investment-list company. Per public company-intelligence sources (indexed.vc, PrivCo, Bloomberg, CB Insights), Talaria was acquired by Google in 2013 and ceased operating as an independent company; it maintains no active website, developer portal, or public API surface today.
t.name: Talaria Technologies

t.description: Talasim was a Jordanian user-generated-content website that curated photographs of funny signs on cars, stores, and roads, positioned as an online comedy and self-expression channel. Backed by Seedcamp, it was acquired by the regional reviews-and-listings community Jeeran (Amman, Jordan) in March 2010, with its engineering team absorbed into Jeeran's localisation efforts. The company no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no developer, API, or documentation surface; the referenced jeeran.com domain no longer serves a live site (TLS handshake failure). This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio stub and has been enriched to reflect its acquired, no-API status.
t.name: Talasim

t.description: Tale is an open-source (MIT) AI platform from Ruler GmbH (Spiez, Switzerland) for knowledge, chat, agents, skills and automations, self-hosted or run as Tale Enterprise in CH/EU clouds. Each deployment exposes the Tale Platform API (REST under /api/v1 with Bearer organization API keys), an MCP endpoint at /api/v1/mcp with 22 documented tools, webhook triggers and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible model endpoints.
t.name: Tale

t.description: TaleMonster Games is a fully remote mobile game studio whose mission is to create games that surprise, challenge, and evolve with players. The team is united by a shared obsession for product craft and a deep love for games, and ships casual mobile titles to iOS and Android. Its debut title, Match Valley, is a casual match puzzle game published on the Apple App Store and Google Play. TaleMonster Games publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public company and product identity.
t.name: TaleMonster Games

t.description: Talen Energy is an independent power producer and energy infrastructure company and a Fortune 1000 firm. The company operates a portfolio of nuclear, natural gas, oil, and renewable power generation facilities across the United States and supplies wholesale electricity into competitive markets. Talen Energy does not publish a public developer portal or external API.
t.name: Talen Energy

t.description: Talend (now part of Qlik) provides data integration, quality, and API management capabilities through cloud-native APIs for ETL, data pipelines, and application integration. The Qlik Talend Cloud platform exposes REST APIs for orchestrating tasks and plans, executing data integration jobs, managing remote engines, configuring connections, monitoring execution history, and administering identities, workspaces, and environments.
t.name: Talend

t.description: Talentium is an end-to-end, AI-powered hiring platform that automates candidate sourcing, screening, and outreach so founders, in-house talent teams, and recruitment agencies can fill roles faster. It combines deep talent search across public sources (including technical talent on GitHub), your own network, and applicant pools with AI ranking, a unified candidate-communication inbox, interview assistance, branded career pages with job-board distribution, and ATS pipeline tracking — plus an autonomous hiring assistant ("Ted") and 60+ integrations. The platform is GDPR-compliant, hosted in EU data centers with end-to-end encryption, and is available on the Google Cloud Marketplace. Backed by EQT Ventures. This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Talentium publishes no public developer/API surface as of this pass.
t.name: Talentium

t.description: TalentLMS is a cloud-based learning management system (LMS) with a REST API for managing users, courses, categories, branches, groups, and enrollments, as well as accessing completion and assessment report data. The API supports over 50 endpoints covering user and course lifecycle management, group and branch administration, and retrieval of test and survey results. Authentication uses API key-based HTTP Basic Auth on V1 and header-based API keys on V2. TalentLMS V2 introduces versioned requests, clear rate-limit response headers, and a dedicated developer hub.
t.name: TalentLMS

t.description: Talently is a Latin American tech hiring and talent marketplace connecting software engineers and digital professionals (Tech, Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Experience) with technology companies across LATAM and the United States. The platform offers pre-evaluated talent, free job postings, and a suite of hiring tools including per-country tech salary calculators, a technical glossary, and specialized job boards. Backed by 500 Global. Public web surface spans talently.tech plus hire, match, admin, strapi, and stream subdomains; it publishes an llms.txt catalog for AI agents but exposes no public developer/API documentation at this time.
t.name: Talently

t.description: Talentpluto (Pluto) is an AI voice-agent platform for professional discovery and recruitment, founded in 2025 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch out of New York City. Professionals talk to Pluto for about ten minutes about what they have done, what they are great at, and what they want next; Pluto turns that private conversation into a discoverable professional profile that the person controls and that can be shared with people and AI agents. For hiring, companies describe what they need and Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and facilitates warm introductions when there is mutual alignment. The company positions Pluto as a source of truth for career context in an internet increasingly built for agents. As of profiling it is a consumer- and recruiter-facing product with no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or other machine-facing surface; this profile is a network stub awaiting a real API surface to enrich.
t.name: Talentpluto

t.description: TalentQL is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
t.name: TalentQL

t.description: Tales is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
t.name: Tales

t.description: Talk Labs (TalkLabs) builds AI-powered voice simulations for corporate learning, turning training theory into practical, hands-on skills. Its platform provides AI trainers that role-play realistic customer scenarios so frontline sales and customer-service staff can practice conversations on demand. Capabilities include 24/7 AI coaching with no capacity limits, voice-based simulations in 50+ languages, progress-tracking and analytics dashboards, LMS integration, and a no-code AI lesson builder, with deployment within a week of contract. It serves banks, retail, hospitality, financial services, and restaurants. Backed by 500 Global and founded by Serge Sarkisian (CEO) and Ilia Krotov (CTO). No public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found at the time of this profile.
t.name: Talk Labs

t.description: Talk-A-Bot is a Budapest-based, Techstars-backed enterprise chatbot company building compliance-first conversational AI for regulated industries including banking, healthcare, government, retail, and HR. Its platform emphasizes "zero hallucination" answers grounded only in verified knowledge bases, full conversation logging and audit trails, EU-based infrastructure with on-premise deployment options, and daily human review. Products include an FAQ Chatbot, an Agentic Chatbot, FeedbackHub, and the CHEQ internal-communications assistant, deployed across web, mobile, Messenger, and Viber. The company markets an API-first architecture for integrating with customer systems (CRM, ERP, payments, ticketing, HR) but publishes no public self-serve developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK; engagement is full-service. Compliance posture spans HIPAA, DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR, and PCI DSS.
t.name: Talk-A-Bot

t.description: Talkable is a referral marketing and loyalty platform that helps e-commerce and subscription brands acquire and retain customers through referral programs, loyalty campaigns, and advocacy incentives. It provides a RESTful JSON API (v2) for origins (off-site purchase and event ingestion), offers and shares, referrals, people, coupons, loyalty members, metrics, assets, and traffic sources; native iOS and Android SDKs plus an official Ruby gem; a nine-event webhook surface; and a customer-facing hosted MCP server that lets AI agents operate a Talkable program over the Model Context Protocol using OAuth 2.1 or API keys. Talkable is backed by 500 Global.
t.name: Talkable

t.description: Talkdesk is a cloud contact center platform with Customer Experience Automation (CXA) capabilities including omnichannel engagement, workforce engagement management, quality management, analytics, and a marketplace of partner integrations. The Talkdesk developer surface exposes REST APIs and webhook delivery across three documented webhook services: the Events API (partner-app lifecycle events signed with ECDSA), the Webhook Trigger API (Talkdesk Connections triggers for call, agent, contact, and note events), and the Automated Notifications bridge for Digital Connect (DCE). This index currently models the webhook surface as an AsyncAPI 2.6 document.
t.name: Talkdesk

t.description: Talkiatry is an online psychiatry (telepsychiatry) platform that connects patients with in-network, employed psychiatrists and therapists for virtual mental health care. Patients begin with a free online assessment that matches them to a psychiatrist, then attend video visits for evaluation, medication management, and talk therapy. Talkiatry treats conditions including ADHD, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and OCD, works with major insurance plans, and operates as a HIPAA-compliant, LegitScript-certified telehealth provider. The company is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Talkiatry publishes a consumer telehealth website but no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.
t.name: Talkiatry

t.description: Talking Computers is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building Facility, described as "The Workplace for AI" and delivering autonomous organizations for enterprises. The company deploys fleets of AI Infrastructure Engineers that collaborate over week-long time horizons, run hundreds of experiments in parallel, and learn from them to optimize customers' training and inference infrastructure to their specific workloads. Talking Computers reports partnering with companies to speed up GPU kernels to 6x state-of-the-art and to cut the latency of voice models to roughly half that of competitors. As of enrichment, the company is an early-stage two-person team and publishes only a marketing presence at talkingcomputers.ai (a single-page application); it exposes no public API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from verified public sources.
t.name: Talking Computers

t.description: TalkJS is a chat API and SDK for adding messaging to web and mobile apps.
