Win-Win also offers B2B tooling for nonprofits and corporations to launch their own gamified fundraising campaigns, alongside a consumer mobile app. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API or developer surface is currently published.
w.name: Win-Win

w.description: Winc is a direct-to-consumer online wine club and retailer (winc.com) offering curated, personalized wine subscriptions and single-bottle purchases matched to a member's palate profile. The winc.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a hosted UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) MCP endpoint, Shopify Customer Account API authentication (OpenID Connect), and published /llms.txt and /agents.md agent instructions that let AI shopping assistants discover the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Originally surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched from its public agent-facing surface by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.
w.name: Winc

w.description: WinCL (윈클) is a Korean integrated carbon-management platform that helps enterprises calculate greenhouse-gas emissions, produce climate disclosures and reports, and offset their footprint end-to-end. It combines WinCL Monitoring (emissions accounting and climate disclosure), a WinCL Marketplace for buying globally certified carbon credits (Verra, Gold Standard) and I-REC renewable-energy certificates, a WinCL Reward marketing layer, and consulting services. The WinCL API (api.wincl.io, 271 operations, Bearer JWT) exposes wallet, credit box, certificate box, product, order, Stripe/KCP payment, and Hedera on-chain minting/offset operations so customers can embed carbon purchasing and credit retirement directly into their own applications.
w.name: WinCL

w.description: WindBorne Systems operates a global constellation of long-duration Global Sounding Balloons and pairs that proprietary in-situ atmospheric data with WeatherMesh, its AI-based numerical weather forecast model. The WindBorne Data API serves real-time balloon observations, soundings, super-observations, constellation and flight-path metadata, point and gridded WeatherMesh forecasts, tropical-cyclone tracks, and population-weighted heating/cooling degree-day insights. Access is via a Bearer API key over REST, an official Python library and CLI, and a hosted Model Context Protocol server for AI agents.
w.name: WindBorne Systems

w.description: Winden (Winden Technologies, Inc.) is a US fintech offering an AI-powered business credit card built to maximize cash back on every purchase. Its Visa commercial card advertises 2% unlimited cash back, and its Scout AI automatically hunts for discounts and promo codes at checkout. Alongside the card, Winden bundles business banking-style services: virtual cards with custom spend limits and merchant locks, free domestic ACH and wire transfers, invoicing and payment management, an AI CFO for accounting and cash-flow projections, 24/7 concierge support, and integrations with common accounting and payroll software. Winden is a consumer/SMB financial product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface.
w.name: Winden

w.description: Windfall is an AI-powered people intelligence platform that helps go-to-market teams personalize workflows with wealth and career data, serving 1,500+ organizations across finance, retail, education, healthcare, and nonprofits. The Windfall API delivers enriched household and career data for a single person record in real time — submit basic PII and receive JSON in one HTTPS request. One operation (enrichRecord) returns up to 32 documented household fields (net worth and its confidence bounds, property, life events, philanthropy, political giving, financial signals) and 26 career fields (job title and level, job-change signals, employer firmographics, LinkedIn URL), with availability set by the customer's plan. US coverage only; the database is rebuilt weekly; rate limited to 5 requests/second; and a non-billed sandbox with 15 deterministic fictitious personas and a header-driven error simulator mirrors production for integration testing. Access is contractual — tokens are issued by Windfall and API credits were bundled into existing subscriptions when the API opened to all customers and partners in May 2026.
w.name: Windfall

w.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.
w.name: Windfall Bio

w.description: Windfall (windfall.com, formerly windfalldata.com) is a people-intelligence and AI platform that personalizes go-to-market workflows with wealth and career data. Its developer-facing Windfall API delivers enriched household and career data on a single-record basis in real time: submit a person record with basic PII and receive that individual's household net worth, a stable Windfall ID, and career signals such as a LinkedIn URL and title, returned as JSON in one sub-second request. Coverage is United States, data is refreshed weekly, and the API is used for real-time lead routing and grading, marketing enrichment, and analytics scoring. Authentication is a Windfall-issued header token with a dedicated sandbox environment of deterministic test personas. Windfall is SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
w.name: Windfall Data

w.description: Windmill is an open-source developer platform and workflow engine for turning scripts into webhooks, workflows, and internal apps. It supports TypeScript, Python, Go, PHP, Bash, C#, SQL, and Rust, and serves as an open-source alternative to Retool, Airflow, and Temporal for building comprehensive internal tools including endpoints, workflows, and UIs.
w.name: Windmill

w.description: A free, keyless VIN-lookup service that returns the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) PDF plus an NHTSA vPIC specification decode for any 17-character US VIN. Serves decoded vehicle specs, EPA fuel economy, crash ratings, and recalls over an open, CORS-enabled JSON API with no registration, no API key and no paid tiers. Factory PDFs are available for 20 makes (Ford, Lincoln, the GM and Stellantis brands, Subaru, Kia, Hyundai, Genesis, Toyota and Lexus from model year 2025, and Nissan and Infiniti as Nissan's copy stamped "Unofficial Copy"); every other make still returns a full specification decode. A remote MCP server at https://windowsticker.org/mcp exposes the same lookup to agents.
w.name: Window Sticker VIN API

w.description: Windstream Holdings is a leading provider of advanced network communications and technology solutions including managed services, cloud computing, and broadband to consumers and businesses across the United States. The company operates the Kinetic broadband brand for consumer and small business customers and Windstream Enterprise (now Uniti Solutions) for business customers, offering SD-WAN, UCaaS, OfficeSuite UC, contact center services, and high-capacity network transport. Windstream delivers voice, data, and managed networking solutions to more than 18 states with over 2.1 million fiber-to-the-premise passings.
w.name: Windstream Holdings

w.description: Windsurf (formerly Codeium) is the AI-native code editor and plugin family from the Codeium team, featuring Cascade - an agentic chatbot that collaborates with the user across files. Built on a VS Code base with proprietary inference, MCP server support, Devin Cloud sessions, and the SWE-1.5 fast agent model. Plans range from Free / Light / Pro / Max / Teams / Enterprise. No public REST API for application developers.
w.name: Windsurf

w.description: Windwalk Games is a gaming-focused company whose mission is "Creating Communities Through Gaming." The company builds and grows player communities and audiences around games and gaming brands. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Windwalk Games operates a single marketing website (windwalk.games) and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable developer surface, so there are no API artifacts to catalog.
w.name: Windwalk Games

w.description: Windward is a Maritime AI company headquartered in London and Washington D.C. delivering mission-grade, multi-source maritime intelligence for defense agencies, law enforcement, customs, energy and commodity traders, marine insurers, shippers, and financial institutions. Founded by CEO Ami Daniel, Windward fuses AIS data, remote sensing (EO, SAR, RF GEOINT), proprietary behavioral analytics, and generative AI into a single Maritime AI platform covering vessel screening, ownership and entity resolution, sanctions exposure, deceptive shipping detection, ship-to-ship transfer analysis, IUU fishing detection, smuggling detection, container tracking, and maritime infrastructure protection. Windward exposes its intelligence through the API Insights Lab, a unified GraphQL API at developer.windward.ai providing programmatic access to vessel risk scores, Organization Defined Risk (ODR), ultimate beneficial ownership, early detection signals, tracked shipments, carriers, and detention & demurrage data, along with webhooks and workflow automation. The company has no public REST/OpenAPI surface, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub org — its API is GraphQL-only with managed onboarding and expert-led implementation support.
w.name: Windward

w.description: Windy.com is a weather visualization platform serving high-resolution forecast models, animated weather maps, and a global webcam network. The Windy API exposes three developer products - a Point Forecast API for multi-model numerical weather data at a coordinate, an embeddable Map Forecast API based on Leaflet, and a Webcams API for the world's largest webcam repository.
w.name: Windy

w.description: Wine Vybe is a wine, beer, and liquor database API platform that provides access to comprehensive beverage data including wine regions, grape varieties, tasting notes, food pairing recommendations, awards, producer information, brewery and distillery details, and custom taste profiles. The platform serves app developers and businesses through RESTful APIs hosted on RapidAPI.
w.name: Wine Vybe

w.description: Wine-Searcher is the world's leading wine search engine and marketplace, providing access to prices, availability, and data on over 15 million wines from retailers worldwide. The Wine-Searcher API allows developers to integrate wine pricing data, merchant listings, critic scores, vintage availability, and wine details directly into websites and applications. Typical API consumers include wine apps, websites, blogs, market research companies, wine investment platforms, and insurance services.
w.name: Wine-Searcher

w.description: Wine Access is an online wine retailer that curates limited-production and hard-to-find wines from around the world, sourced and vetted by its team of sommeliers and wine experts. Beyond direct e-commerce, the company operates a portfolio of subscription wine clubs (Discovery, Connoisseurs, Champagne, Collector's, Decanter, and Sunset clubs), a wine podcast and editorial content platform at discover.wineaccess.com, corporate and personal gifting, gift cards, and climate-controlled shipping. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this profile, Wine Access publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider.
w.name: Wineaccess

w.description: Wing is Alphabet's drone delivery subsidiary, spun out of Google X in 2018, with operating headquarters in Palo Alto, California and significant operations in Australia, Finland, Ireland, and the United States. Wing designs, builds, and operates a fleet of small fixed-wing electric VTOL aircraft that autonomously pick up and deliver packages to customers' homes, and it operates an unmanned traffic management (UTM) stack used by drone pilots and aviation authorities. Wing was the first company to receive an FAA Part 135 Air Carrier Certificate for drone delivery (2019) and is an approved LAANC USS in the United States and an approved drone airspace authorization provider for CASA in Australia. Wing's commercial surface is split across two main platforms — the Wing Delivery Platform, a partner-only API and UI suite that lets retailers, restaurants, and logistics providers embed drone delivery into their own order flows (Walmart, DoorDash, Papa Johns, and others), and OpenSky, a consumer drone airspace authorization app and partner API. Wing also co-founded the InterUSS Platform open-source UTM project, now hosted by the Linux Foundation. Wing's revenue comes from per-delivery fees charged to merchant partners and from drone-as-a-service operations rather than from public developer APIs; the Delivery Platform API and OpenSky API are not openly published and there is no public OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal at the time of profiling.
w.name: Wing

w.description: Wing Cloud is the company behind Wing (Winglang), an open-source, cloud-oriented programming language created by Elad Ben-Israel, the creator of AWS CDK. Wing unifies infrastructure and application code into a single model: a "preflight" phase compiles to Terraform/CloudFormation while an "inflight" phase compiles to JavaScript for runtime. Developers build and test distributed cloud systems locally with the Wing Simulator and Wing Console, then deploy to any major cloud provider. The project is MIT-licensed, ships the `wing` CLI (npm: winglang) and the standalone Wing SDK (@winglang/sdk, Apache-2.0), and the company is backed by Battery Ventures. Wing is a language and developer-tooling company; it does not publish a public REST/HTTP API.
w.name: Wing Cloud

w.description: Wing Security is an AI security platform providing automated discovery, risk assessment, and governance of AI agents, SaaS applications, and app-to-app integrations. The platform delivers SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and continuous observability for AI tools across enterprise environments.
w.name: Wing Security

w.description: Wing Venture Capital is an early-stage venture firm founded in 2013 by Peter Wagner and Gaurav Garg (both former partners at Sequoia Capital and Accel) and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Wing invests at the stealth, seed, and Series A stages in companies building the "AI-first" technology stack, and positions itself as a long-term company builder rather than a passive investor. Its thesis spans autonomous applications, AI and machine learning, data platforms and infrastructure, product-led growth (PLG), Web3, and bio x data. Wing raised its fourth flagship fund, Wing Four, a $600M early-stage vehicle, in 2023. Notable outcomes across its portfolio include Snowflake, Cohesity, Gong, Shape Security, and Deepgram, and it operates a Founder Success Platform plus the ET30 (Enterprise Tech 30) research program led by its research team.
w.name: Wing Venture Capital

w.description: Wingspan is a contractor payments and payroll platform built for the independent workforce, giving enterprises a single system to onboard 1099 contractors, collect W-9 and compliance documents, run approval-based payroll, pay collaborators by ACH or instant payout, and file 1099 tax forms. Its REST Payments API (OpenAPI 3.1) covers payables, invoicing, collaborators and groups, payable/invoice/1099 batches, deductions, eligibility requirements, custom fields, reporting, and webhooks, with embeddable onboarding and payout-settings UIs.
w.name: Wingspan

w.description: Wingstop Inc. (NASDAQ: WING) is a US-based quick-service restaurant chain specializing in cooked-to-order chicken wings, tenders, and sides across thousands of franchised and company-owned locations. Wingstop is digital-first - digital transactions account for the large majority of systemwide sales - built on its proprietary MyWingstop ordering platform and the Club Wingstop loyalty program, with consumer ordering via wingstop.com, native iOS and Android apps, and third-party delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Wingstop does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. There is no developer.wingstop.com (the host does not resolve), and ordering, loyalty, menu, and POS integrations flow through bilateral corporate and franchisee technology programs rather than open developer endpoints.
w.name: Wingstop

w.description: Wingtra AG is a Swiss drone manufacturer headquartered at Giesshübelstrasse 40 in Zürich, with a second office in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. It builds the WingtraOne GEN II and WingtraRAY VTOL tail-sitter mapping drones — fixed-wing aircraft that take off and land vertically — together with the RGB, multispectral and LiDAR payloads they carry, the WingtraGROUND GNSS base station, and the software that turns a flight into survey-grade output: the tablet-based Wingtra App for flight planning and capture, and the browser-based WingtraCLOUD for site organization, PPK geotagging, coordinate transformation across 6,500-plus published coordinate systems, photogrammetry processing and sharing, sold in WingtraESSENTIAL, WingtraPRO and WingtraUNLIMITED tiers. Wingtra publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK or partner API program. Its machine-readable surface is incidental rather than offered: the customer and partner portal at my.wingtra.com is backed by a GraphQL API at api.my.wingtra.com whose schema answers anonymous introspection, and the WingtraCLOUD web client calls a versioned REST API at api.sky.wingtra.com that is closed to unauthenticated callers. Integration with the wider geospatial toolchain is delivered as file exchange — Trimble Business Center, ArcGIS Online, Propeller, Pix4D, Bentley iTwin and DroneDeploy — not as an API.
w.name: Wingtra

w.description: Wingu * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: Wingu *

w.description: Winn.ai is an AI-powered revenue execution platform for B2B sales teams that joins live sales calls to provide real-time playbook guidance, coach representatives on messaging and objection handling, and automate administrative work such as meeting note-taking, follow-up drafting, and CRM data entry. The product sits on top of a team's existing sales stack and reports outcomes including higher playbook adoption, dramatically higher CRM fill rates, and a large reduction in post-call admin work. Winn.ai is a privately held company backed by Insight Partners. WINN.AI sells API access as an Enterprise-plan feature ("Get conversation data and AI insights, in any tool") and runs a live, undocumented remote Model Context Protocol server at https://app.winn.ai/mcp, discovered through the RFC 9728 OAuth protected-resource metadata it publishes; the endpoint is gated by OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE and advertises a single read-only scope, sessions:read. There is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI document, SDK, CLI, webhook catalog, status page or changelog, and both pricing tiers are sales-gated. The company operates a Vanta-hosted trust center covering SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR.
w.name: Winn.ai

w.description: Winnebago Industries is a leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products under the Winnebago, Grand Design, Newmar, Chris-Craft, Barletta, and Lithionics Battery brands. The company designs, manufactures, and markets recreational vehicles, marine products, and supporting components. Winnebago Industries does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.
w.name: Winnebago Industries

w.description: WINT (also styled Wint) is an AI-powered water management and leak-detection platform for commercial and industrial facilities. Its IoT flow sensors, automated shut-off valves, and 24/7 staffed monitoring center use signal processing and anomaly detection to catch leaks in real time across main feeds, domestic cold and hot water, HVAC loops, cooling towers, and irrigation systems, reporting 20-25% average water-consumption reduction and up to 90% less water damage and insurance loss. WINT is backed by Insight Partners and carries NSF International, ISO, and USGBC affiliations. During enrichment no public developer API, documentation, well-known discovery surface, OpenAPI, or SDK was found; this profile captures the company's public web properties and a live domain-security probe.
w.name: WINT

w.description: Wintermute is a leading global algorithmic trading firm and cryptocurrency market maker providing institutional-grade liquidity across centralized exchanges, decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, and over-the-counter (OTC) markets. Its offerings span OTC spot trading for hundreds of tokens, options with bespoke structures, forwards, CFDs, programmatic "API liquidity", and a DeFi trading and liquidity-provisioning arm, plus Wintermute Ventures, an early-stage investment vehicle. Access to Wintermute's trading services is institutional and onboarding-gated through the node.wintermute.com portal (authenticated via an Auth0-backed OIDC / OAuth2 identity provider); there is no public self-serve developer API or open OpenAPI at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and Pantera Capital.
w.name: Wintermute

w.description: Wintrust Financial Corporation is a Rosemont, Illinois-based financial holding company operating a network of chartered community banks (Wintrust Bank, N.A. and its affiliates) primarily across Illinois, Wisconsin, Indiana and Florida, plus specialty lending, wealth management and mortgage businesses. Wintrust does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; its programmatic surface is delivered through commercial treasury management. Wintrust describes "API banking" that connects businesses directly to its secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) for account balance and activity reporting, payment files (Positive Pay, ACH, wires, EDI, lockbox) and data-format translation (NACHA, EDI 820, BAI2). Consumer and small-business account data is reachable to third parties through open-banking aggregators — Plaid is the confirmed aggregator supporting Wintrust / iBusinessBanking access.
w.name: Wintrust Financial

w.description: Wiom is an Indian consumer internet company offering recharge-based home broadband: shared WiFi delivered over a community mesh network so households can pay only for the internet they actually use, without a mobile-data plan or a traditional fixed-line broadband contract. It was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wiom operates a consumer marketing website (a React single-page application) but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, so this profile carries verified identity and a live domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.
w.name: Wiom

w.description: Wired (wired.com) is an American technology and culture magazine published by Condé Nast, covering how emerging technologies affect culture, the economy, and politics. Founded in 1993, Wired provides RSS feeds for programmatic content consumption across categories including Business, Science, Security, Politics, Gear, Ideas, Culture, and AI. The magazine also maintains a YouTube channel, newsletters, and social media presence.
w.name: Wired

w.description: WiredScore is the global standard-setting organization for digital connectivity and smart technology in the built environment. It assesses, benchmarks, and certifies buildings through two programs — WiredScore (digital connectivity) and SmartScore (smart building technology) — across office, residential, industrial, and hotel asset types. Landlords, developers, and occupiers in more than 40 countries use its certifications and its network of Accredited Professionals to demonstrate that a building meets modern technology and connectivity expectations; over 4,000 buildings covering roughly one billion square feet have been certified. WiredScore is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface.
w.name: WiredScore

w.description: Wireframes are low-fidelity visual representations of user interface layouts used in early design stages to establish structure, hierarchy, and functionality before high-fidelity design work begins. Major wireframing tools including Figma, Balsamiq, Axure, UXPin, Sketch, and Miro offer APIs and developer integrations for programmatic access to design assets, metadata, and collaboration workflows.
w.name: Wireframes

w.description: WireMock is an open source tool for mocking HTTP services and APIs. It enables developers to build stable, predictable development environments by creating mock APIs that simulate the behavior of real services. WireMock provides a comprehensive admin API for managing stub mappings, recording real traffic, verifying requests, and modeling stateful behavior through scenarios. The project is governed by the WireMock community on GitHub and supports Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET, Go, PHP, and Kotlin clients.
w.name: WireMock

w.description: Wireover Co. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: Wireover Co.

w.description: Wireshark is the world's foremost and widely-used free and open-source network protocol analyzer. It lets you capture and interactively browse the traffic running on a computer network. Wireshark provides a powerful dissector framework with a Lua scripting API, C/C++ plugin architecture, TShark command-line tools, and the libwireshark library for developers building network analysis tools.
w.name: Wireshark

w.description: WisdomAI is an enterprise agentic analytics platform built around an Adaptive Context Engine that governs business context across distributed data sources (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, SharePoint, and more). It powers conversational business intelligence, AI-powered dashboards, and analytics agents that the company reports deliver 95%+ answer accuracy in production. For developers, WisdomAI exposes a GraphQL API (queries, mutations, and WebSocket subscriptions), a React and Node embedding SDK (@wisdomai/react, @wisdomai/node), and a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, all governed by row-level and column-level security, SSO, and SCIM/JIT provisioning so teams can build custom and embedded analytics experiences.
w.name: Wisdom AI

w.description: WisdomTree is a global asset manager issuing ETFs and tokenized funds. Through WisdomTree Connect it offers an OAuth2-secured REST API for institutions to create subscription and redemption orders, manage wallets and track settlement of regulated tokenized assets, plus a DataSpan Fund Data API for NAV, aggregates, accruals and shares outstanding per fund ticker.
w.name: WisdomTree

w.description: Wise (formerly TransferWise) provides cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts for personal and business customers. The Wise Platform API exposes profiles, balances, transfers, recipients, quotes, multi-currency accounts, cards, statements, and webhooks.
w.name: Wise

w.description: Wise (formerly TransferWise) was surfaced as a portfolio company of sapphire-ventures, but this stub is a DUPLICATE of the canonical in-network provider `wise` (all/wise, aid: wise). The portfolio domain www.transferwise.com returns a 301 redirect to https://wise.com/ (probed 2026-07-21), which is the domain of the existing fully-enriched Wise repo. No artifacts are maintained here; see the canonical repo for the Wise Platform API profile.
w.name: Wise (TransferWise)

w.description: Wise Systems provides autonomous routing and last-mile delivery optimization software powered by machine learning. Its platform helps fleet operators plan strategy, optimize and dynamically re-route deliveries, dispatch in real time, track driver performance, and improve last-mile efficiency across industries including auto parts, beverage, building materials, container management, field service, food service, healthcare, linen services, parcel/courier, and retail. Wise Systems exposes an internal "Engine API" during customer implementations to connect data inputs and outputs, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs. Backed by Techstars and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
w.name: Wise Systems

w.description: Wisear is a Paris-based neurotechnology company building an AI-powered neural interface that lets people control devices through voiceless and touchless commands. Its technology reads biosignals captured by everyday wearables such as wireless earphones, AR/VR headsets and smartglasses, turning subtle facial and neural gestures into hands-free device controls. Wisear targets use cases across consumer audio, industrial augmented reality, walkie-talkie and emergency communications, gaming headsets, the metaverse and accessibility. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Wisear publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal — this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.
w.name: Wisear

w.description: WiseCricket (WISECRICKET HOLDING KY) offers AI-powered fiscal and accounting audit software for businesses ("Software de Auditoria Fiscal y Contable con IA para Empresas"). The Spanish-language platform applies artificial intelligence to tax and accounting compliance, helping companies automate financial and tax audits and surface issues. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found a marketing landing page but no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or well-known discovery surface.
w.name: WISECRICKET HOLDING KY

w.description: WiseLayer is an AI-powered accounting automation platform that provides named "digital workers" (AI agents) for finance and accounting teams, automating tasks such as accruals, vendor communications, payroll accounting, bank reconciliations, depreciation and amortization, lease accounting, and prepaid expenses. The platform emphasizes transparent, explainable AI ("AI that shows its work") with natural-language interaction, automated email digests, and 300+ integrations into ERPs, billing, procure-to-pay, and HRIS systems. WiseLayer was acquired by BlackLine (NASDAQ: BL) and its product is now offered as Verity Accruals by BlackLine. WiseLayer was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. The company operates a SaaS application at app.wiselayer.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.
w.name: Wiselayer

w.description: Wiser Solutions is a retail and commerce intelligence company that provides pricing, market, and MAP (minimum advertised price) intelligence to brands and retailers. Its platform collects online and in-store data, tracking billions of products daily across hundreds of thousands of stores, to power price optimization, competitive price monitoring, promotion and assortment tracking, review analytics, and unauthorized-seller enforcement. Wiser serves hundreds of brands and large retailers and integrates with major eCommerce platforms and marketplaces. As of this profile Wiser publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through its platform, dashboards, and partner connectors.
w.name: Wiser

w.description: Wisetack is an embedded consumer financing (pay-over-time) platform for real-world services. Home service, auto repair, dental, medical, and veterinary businesses offer customers monthly payment options delivered via text or link, with approval in minutes; financing is provided through Wisetack's lending partners. Wisetack embeds into 50+ vertical SaaS and field service management platforms (Housecall Pro, Jobber, JobNimbus, Thryv, Square) through a partner REST API with webhook reporting. Backed by Greylock and Insight Partners; SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
w.name: Wisetack

w.description: Wish, operated by ContextLogic Inc., is a global mobile-first e-commerce marketplace that connects value-conscious consumers with merchants and manufacturers around the world, with a large share of inventory shipped direct from suppliers. The Wish Marketplace V3 API lets sellers and ERP partners programmatically manage their storefront and operations: create and update products and variations, synchronize inventory and pricing, retrieve and fulfill orders, modify tracking and shipping-carrier assignments, run bulk create/download jobs, manage support tickets, penalties and infractions, run ProductBoost and promotion campaigns, meet EU/EPR product compliance obligations, and subscribe to webhooks for real-time order and product events. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 (authorization code flow with 37 scopes) plus OpenID Connect, using bearer access tokens over HTTPS, with production and sandbox environments.
w.name: Wish

w.description: Wishbird Experiences is Mexico's largest online marketplace for gift experiences, offering more than 450 original activities across the country, from adrenaline adventures like skydiving and bungee jumping to spa treatments, gourmet dining, hot-air-balloon and helicopter flights, and weekend getaways. Experiences are sold as gift cards (Wishcards and Wishbox products) redeemable within a twelve-month window, with checkout via credit card, PayPal, and Mercado Pago. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce business and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.
w.name: Wishbird Experiences

w.description: Wishup is a remote-work outsourcing platform that matches businesses with pre-vetted virtual assistants, bookkeepers, and automation specialists, typically onboarding a trained professional within 60 minutes. Its managed talent handles inbox and calendar management, CRM and social-media work, bookkeeping, project management, and AI-driven workflow automation across industries such as healthcare, e-commerce, real estate, startups, nonprofits, and legal services. Wishup runs a client-facing Employee Management App for task tracking and real-time feedback, but publishes no public developer API or developer portal.
w.name: Wishup

w.description: WISK is a bar, restaurant, and hospitality inventory and cost-management platform that tracks items, counts inventory across venues, scans and reconciles supplier invoices, and integrates with 60+ POS systems to compare theoretical vs. actual usage. WISK's programmatic surface is partner-gated - a documented Public Sales upload API lets POS providers and partners push sales data into WISK, and customer API access is offered on the top (Premium) plan. There is no public, self-serve developer portal or published OpenAPI as of this catalog date.
w.name: WISK

w.description: Wisk Aero is an autonomous, all-electric eVTOL air taxi developer and a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company. Wisk is developing its Generation 6 aircraft, a four-passenger self-flying eVTOL designed to operate under human supervisor oversight from a multi-vehicle supervision center, pursuing certification under three FAA programs: Type Certification, Production Certification, and Operation Certification. Wisk evolved from earlier Kitty Hawk programs and has logged over 1,750 autonomous test flights across five aircraft generations since 2010. Announced launch communities include Houston, Texas and Brisbane, Australia (in support of the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games). In March 2026 Wisk was selected by the White House to help lead the safe U.S. introduction of autonomous air taxi flight. Wisk is hardware- and operations-focused, with no public consumer or developer APIs.
w.name: Wisk Aero

w.description: Wispr AI is the company behind Wispr Flow, an AI voice-to-text dictation product that turns natural speech into polished, formatted text in any application across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android, with AI auto-edits, a personal dictionary, voice snippets, tone styling, and support for 100+ languages. Wispr has raised $81M to build what it calls the Voice OS, publishes an enterprise trust center with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA attestations, and operates a public backend API at api.wisprflow.ai whose OpenAPI describes authentication, dictionary, teams, history, notes, and payments surfaces used by its clients.
w.name: Wispr AI

w.description: Wispr AI is the company behind Wispr Flow, an AI voice-to-text dictation product that turns natural speech into polished, formatted text in any application across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android, with AI auto-edits, a personal dictionary, voice snippets, tone styling, and support for 100+ languages. Wispr has raised $81M to build what it calls the Voice OS, publishes an enterprise trust center with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA attestations, and operates a public backend API at api.wisprflow.ai whose OpenAPI describes authentication, dictionary, teams, history, notes, and payments surfaces used by its clients.
w.name: Wispr AI

w.description: Wispr Flow is a voice-to-text dictation application from Wispr that lets people type roughly 4x faster by speaking naturally in any app or field on macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android. It uses AI models for accurate, context-aware transcription in 100+ languages, applying AI auto-edits that remove filler words and fix grammar, a personal dictionary for names and jargon, voice snippets for reusable templates, and tone styling. Enterprise features include SSO, SCIM user provisioning, MDM deployment, a privacy/zero-retention mode, and compliance posture covering SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and HIPAA. Wispr Flow ships as consumer and enterprise desktop/mobile apps rather than a public developer API. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures.
w.name: Wispr Flow

w.description: Wisq is an AI platform for human resources that automates HR service management, HR operations, and employee relations. Its conversational AI HR agent, Harper, answers employee requests across chat, email, Slack, Teams, SMS, and mobile, while its proprietary HR Language Model (HRLM) provides HR-specific reasoning, aiming to resolve the majority of routine HR cases without a human in the loop. Founded by Jim Barnett and Chih-Po Wen (formerly of Glint), Wisq is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Shasta Ventures, and True Ventures. Wisq operates a private, login-gated product and publishes no public developer API at this time.
w.name: Wisq

w.description: Wistia is an all-in-one video marketing platform for businesses that combines branded video hosting, webinars, video editing, webcam and screen recording, and deep viewer analytics for B2B marketing teams focused on lead generation, brand control, and content performance. Founded in 2006, Wistia is used by more than 425,000 businesses and integrates with major marketing automation and CRM platforms. Wistia ships an unusually complete developer surface for its category: a frozen evergreen Data API at https://api.wistia.com/v1 alongside a header-versioned modern API at https://api.wistia.com/modern with dated stable releases (2026-01), OpenAPI 3.1 descriptions made discoverable through an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset, OAuth 2.0 with RFC 8414/9728 discovery and dynamic client registration, a hosted MCP server at https://api.wistia.com/mcp/api, a Go CLI, a Speakeasy-generated TypeScript SDK, and the Aurora `<wistia-player>` web component.
w.name: Wistia

w.description: WIT Soundivew is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: WIT Soundivew

w.description: Wit.ai is a natural language processing (NLP) platform from Meta that lets developers build applications and devices you can talk or text to. It turns spoken or written user input into structured, machine-readable data — extracting intents, entities, and traits — and provides speech recognition (speech-to-text), dictation, and speech synthesis (text-to-speech). Developers train an app with example utterances, then call the Wit HTTP API with a Bearer server access token to parse messages, transcribe audio, and manage an app's entities, intents, traits, and utterances. Wit.ai is free to use and ships official client SDKs for Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, iOS, Unity, and Unreal. It was founded in 2013, backed by a16z, and acquired by Facebook (now Meta) in 2015.
w.name: Wit.AI

w.description: WiTag Inc is an augmented reality mobile gaming company founded in 2016 by Thomas Suarez that built AR laser tag gameplay using only a smartphone's built-in sensors and radios, with no extra hardware. Lightspeed Venture Partners led a seed investment in 2017. As of July 2026 the company appears dormant, its website witag.co no longer resolves in DNS, no app is listed in the Apple App Store, and no public API or developer surface was found.
w.name: WiTag

w.description: Wited (formerly Portal Educativo) is a Chilean edtech company backed by 500 Global that delivers online academic support and homeschooling across Latin America. Its two products - Reforzamiento (tutoring, homework help, and exam prep for K-12 students in traditional schools) and Colegio Online (a complete online school for homeschoolers) - combine curriculum-aligned courses, interactive exercises, the Max AI tutoring chatbot, live teacher support (Profes Express), and a parent progress dashboard. Wited operates in Chile, Mexico, Colombia, Panama, Argentina, Brazil, Spain, and the United States. The consumer platform runs at app.wited.com against a private backend (api.wited.com); the company publishes no public developer program or API.
w.name: Wited (Portal Educativo)

w.description: WithAI is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company building Multiplier, a secure AI platform for institutional investors and independent equity hedge funds. Multiplier unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI agents, human work, and firm knowledge so investment teams can research stocks and manage portfolios more efficiently, with an integration ecosystem spanning Bloomberg, FactSet, Enfusion, Snowflake, and other market data and infrastructure platforms. WithAI does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation.
w.name: WithAI

w.description: Withco, now operating as With at with.us (the original with.co domain 301-redirects there), is rebuilding main street one share at a time. The company helps small business owners buy the commercial buildings they operate in, stacking the owner's investment, seller financing, and community investor capital to meet the deal price, grounding offers in comparable sales, and giving each business a public investor page to tell its story to potential backers. Withco is a consumer/community real-estate platform and publishes no public developer API surface.
w.name: Withco

w.description: WithCoverage is a technology-driven risk management and commercial insurance platform that aims to replace the traditional insurance broker for growing businesses. It pairs a team of insurance advisors, claims specialists, and attorneys with an AI-powered digital platform to analyze policies, reduce premiums, manage certificates of insurance, and handle claims proactively as companies scale. Headquartered in New York City and backed by venture investors including 8vc, WithCoverage operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the company currently exposes no public developer API surface (client access is through the app.withcoverage.com web application).
w.name: Withcoverage

w.description: Within (Within Unlimited, Inc.) is a Los Angeles virtual-reality studio founded in 2014 by Chris Milk and Aaron Koblin, both alumni of Google's Data Arts team. Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) led the company's 2016 Series A. Within builds Supernatural, a VR fitness service for Meta Quest headsets that pairs live human coaches with rhythm-mapped workouts set in 360-degree virtual locations; its earlier work spans immersive 360 video and AR (Clouds Over Sidra, Wonderscope). Meta Platforms acquired Within in February 2023 after the FTC's challenge to the deal failed, and it now operates as a Meta studio. Within is a consumer VR product company and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; its primary domain within.com is currently parked. This profile is retained as an a16z portfolio lead with no API surface to enrich.
w.name: Within

w.description: Within3 is a life sciences engagement and insights-management platform used by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to run virtual advisory boards, engage key opinion leaders and healthcare professionals, and collect, structure, and analyze scientific and medical insights across the product lifecycle. The company emphasizes AI-assisted insights management and secure, compliant stakeholder engagement. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company; an enrichment pass found no public developer/API surface (no API, docs, or developer subdomains resolve and no /.well-known discovery documents are served).
w.name: Within3

w.description: Withings is a connected health device platform providing a REST API for accessing data from smart scales, blood pressure monitors, sleep trackers, thermometers, and fitness watches. The API uses OAuth2 for authentication and provides access to a wide range of health biomarkers including body composition, cardiovascular data, sleep metrics, activity tracking, and clinical-grade measurements. Partners and developers can integrate Withings health data into their applications for remote patient monitoring, wellness platforms, and research applications.
w.name: Withings

w.description: Withlocals is an experiential travel platform that connects travelers with verified local hosts for private, personalized tours, food experiences and home dinners — over 2,500 experiences in more than 250 destinations (per withlocals.com). It publishes a Withlocals Partner API for distribution partners, documented at developers.withlocals.com, and maintains the WithlocalsDev GitHub organization.
w.name: Withlocals

w.description: WitnessAI is an AI security and governance platform that lets enterprises safely deploy and manage AI across their workforce. Its platform spans three pillars: Observe (visibility into all AI activity, shadow-AI discovery, and cataloging of applications and agents), Control (governance policies, audit trails, and compliance across human and AI workforces), and Protect (runtime security that blocks prompt injection and jailbreaks and filters harmful outputs). It addresses data leakage, prompt-injection attacks, unauthorized agent activity, and compliance gaps. The company is backed by GV. As of this profile no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published; engagement is via sales/demo.
w.name: Witness AI

w.description: Witness Systems, Inc. was a workforce optimization software company founded in 1988 and headquartered in Roswell, Georgia. It built quality monitoring, call and screen recording, and performance management software for contact centers, sold under the Impact 360 and eQuality product lines, and traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker WITS. Verint Systems acquired Witness Systems in 2007 for approximately $950 million, folding its products into Verint's Workforce Optimization suite. The company no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no public API; its former domain (witnesssystems.com) no longer resolves.
w.name: Witness Systems

w.description: WiTricity AI Tech, LLC is a wireless power transfer company founded on the highly resonant magnetic-resonance research published by an MIT team led by Marin Soljacic in 2007. The company holds the foundational patent portfolio for wireless power transfer over distance and commercializes it by licensing intellectual property, reference designs and engineering services to automakers, Tier 1 suppliers and charging hardware manufacturers rather than by selling software. Its product surface is hardware and IP: the MR/1 charging system, light-, medium- and heavy-duty EV wireless charging, smart-city and transit infrastructure, autonomous-vehicle and ground-support-equipment fleets, and bidirectional V2G energy arbitrage. WiTricity chairs several SAE J2954 working groups, the interoperability standard for wireless EV and PHEV charging. As of a probe on 2026-09-04 the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no machine-readable contract and no public code repositories; its integration story is delivered through licensee engineering support, not a public API.
w.name: WiTricity

w.description: Wittlebee is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: Wittlebee

w.description: Wivity Inc. is a Web3 governance consultancy that helps organizations form blockchain consortia and infrastructure DAOs, design Web3 infrastructure, and optimize decentralized governance through its Wivity Governance framework, drawing on experience running standards working groups for organizations like the SunSpec Alliance and OMA3. A 500 Global portfolio company, Wivity does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or client libraries.
w.name: Wivity

w.description: Wix is a cloud-based web development platform that allows users to create professional websites and online businesses. The Wix developer platform provides a comprehensive REST API, JavaScript SDK, and CLI for building custom apps, headless storefronts, and site extensions across eCommerce, CRM, bookings, blog, events, and more. Developers can customize Wix sites, build marketplace apps, and integrate Wix capabilities into any frontend.
w.name: Wix

w.description: Wiz is a cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) that provides agentless security across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and containers, covering CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, vulnerability management, DSPM, and threat detection in a unified security graph. The Wiz GraphQL API exposes inventory, issues, vulnerabilities, configurations, and reporting using OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication.
w.name: Wiz

w.description: Wiz Freight (Wiz Logtec Solutions Private Limited) was a Chennai, India based digital freight forwarder founded in 2020 by Ramkumar Ramachandran and Ramkumar Govindarajan, offering ocean, air and surface freight booking, instant rate discovery, live shipment tracking, digital documentation and multi-currency freight payments through its own technology platform. The company raised roughly $58.6M from Tiger Global Management, Nippon Express Holdings, SBI Investment, Stride Ventures, Foundamental and Axilor Ventures. Trade press reported in September 2025 that the company had suspended export bookings amid an executive exodus, and as of September 2026 its public surface is gone: wizfreight.com serves a GoDaddy Website Builder placeholder, the former booking portal path 404s, and the sit.wizfreight.net platform host no longer resolves. No developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract was ever published on a reachable host, and none survives today.
w.name: Wiz Freight

w.description: Wizard is an AI-powered personal shopping agent for consumers. Shoppers describe what they want in natural language and Wizard searches across retailer websites, customer reviews, trusted editorial, and social content to return a tightly curated set of product recommendations, with direct checkout from retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Apple, and Target. The company is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wizard is a consumer-facing web/app product and exposes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface (developer/docs/api subdomains and /.well-known/security.txt all return 404).
w.name: Wizard

w.description: Get information from the Harry Potter universe
w.name: Wizard World

w.description: Wizehire is a Houston, Texas hiring platform for small and mid-size businesses that combines an applicant tracking system with AI candidate matching (Talent Match), an AI recruiting assistant delivered as a Chrome extension (Scout), DISC+ personality and skills assessments, candidate texting, interview scheduling, expert human hiring coaches, and employee onboarding. Job posts syndicate to 100+ boards including Indeed, LinkedIn and ZipRecruiter, and the platform connects to HRIS, payroll, background-check and e-signature systems — ADP Workforce Now, RUN Powered by ADP, Ceridian Dayforce, Gusto, Paychex, Paycor, Paylocity, UKG, QuickBooks, Checkr and Dropbox Sign — plus Zapier and real-estate CRMs via a customer-issued API key. Wizehire serves real estate, insurance, dental, legal, automotive and hospitality operators, and publishes an NYC Local Law 144 AEDT bias audit for its automated employment decision tooling.
w.name: WizeHire

w.description: WizerMe (Wizer) is an edtech platform used by more than 700,000 teachers to build interactive, self-grading digital worksheets. Educators turn existing PDFs and documents into engaging assessments with multiple-choice, video, audio, open-response, and puzzle question types, record video or audio instructions, apply differentiation rules, monitor student work in real time, schedule availability and time limits, and sync grades with Google Classroom. Students submit answers as text, audio, or video. Wizer offers a free tier (Wizer Create) and a premium tier (Wizer Boost) plus school and district plans, and is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is currently published.
w.name: WizerMe

w.description: WizzPass is a visitor and workplace access management platform, surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. At the time of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence at wizzpass.com is dormant behind Cloudflare (HTTP 409 / error 1001) and refuses TLS handshakes, so no live developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or API surface could be reached. Email infrastructure is active (AWS SES inbound in eu-west-1, SPF authorizing Amazon SES and TeamSupport), indicating an operating SaaS organization even though the site itself is not currently serving. This profile records the honest probed state and awaits a future pass once the web/API surface is reachable.
w.name: WizzPass

w.description: WizzyWig is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: WizzyWig

w.description: WM (formerly Waste Management, Inc.) is North America's largest integrated environmental solutions company, serving nearly 20 million municipal, commercial, industrial, and residential customers through collection, transfer, recycling, landfill, and waste-to-energy operations. WM does not run a self-serve, publicly-signup developer platform. It publishes a documented partner/customer REST API at api.wm.com covering account-level service and billing data - service details and pickup schedules, live service status and truck ETA, routing and hauling material information, pricing, invoices and aging balance, communication preferences, contacts, cases, tickets, and account activity notes. Access requires a WM-issued ClientId plus a JSON Web Token (JWT) and is granted on request to existing commercial/enterprise customers and integration partners by emailing apiaccess@wm.com; there is no open, self-serve API key signup.
w.name: WM

w.description: WNP is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: WNP

w.description: WNS Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The WNS Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.
w.name: WNS Holdings

w.description: Wochit is an enterprise-grade, cloud-based video creation platform that helps organizations produce professional, on-brand videos at scale. It offers three products: Studio, an AI-powered video creation workspace paired with one of the world's largest licensed content libraries; Frame, a white-label, embeddable video editor that SaaS platforms and marketplaces integrate into their own products; and WAVE, an automated video engine that mass-produces videos from templates and data. Wochit serves media companies, publishers, nonprofits, and enterprises that need repeatable, high-volume video production. Wochit does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and security posture.
w.name: Wochit

w.description: Wodify is gym, fitness, and CrossFit box management software covering membership management, billing, class scheduling, lead and client CRM, digital waivers, and workout/performance tracking. The Wodify API is a REST interface at https://api.wodify.com/v1, authenticated with an x-api-key header, that lets partners and gym operators manage leads, clients, memberships, classes, programs, services, appointments, workouts, financials, and communications programmatically.
w.name: Wodify

w.description: Woebot Health is a clinical mental health company founded in 2017 by Dr. Alison Darcy that delivers an AI-powered, CBT-based conversational agent ("Woebot") for evidence-based mental health support. The company operates an enterprise (B2B) model, partnering with health systems, payers, employers, and providers to embed Woebot into existing care pathways and digital front doors. The Woebot Health Platform offers a partner API library for transmitting aggregated, validated patient-reported outcomes (PHQ-8/PHQ-9, engagement, satisfaction, topic modeling) into EMRs and value-based care workflows. The partner API is gated to enterprise customers — there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve developer portal.
w.name: Woebot Health

w.description: Wolf (fromwolf.com) is a white-label, multi-tenant staffing and gig-work platform that lets staffing companies run their own branded on-demand workforce. Its API coordinates job seekers, clients, campaigns (client orders), shifts, tenders (a seeker's request to work a shift), applications, timesheets, availability, notifications, and in-app chat — everything needed to build a client- or worker-facing staffing interface on top of the Wolf backend. Each tenant runs on its own database and authenticates with a tenant key plus a platform API key or per-user authentication token. Wolf was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.
w.name: Wolf

w.description: Wolfram|Alpha is a computational knowledge engine that provides answers to natural language queries using a vast curated knowledge base and computational algorithms. The Wolfram|Alpha API suite gives developers programmatic access to computational intelligence for web, mobile, voice, and AI agent applications. APIs range from the full-featured Full Results API to specialized LLM, Short Answers, Simple, Spoken Results, Conversational, Fast Query Recognizer, Summary Boxes, and Instant Calculators APIs.
w.name: Wolfram|Alpha

w.description: Wollit is a UK-based credit-health subscription service (£9.99/month) that helps consumers build and strengthen their credit profile. Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority for credit-broking activities, Wollit reports rent and subscription payments to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion, and bundles a suite of consumer tools: Rent Reporting, Payment Reporting, an AI credit assistant (Olli), Affordability Boost, Credit Smart lessons, and Credit Wins. It is a consumer-facing fintech app and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.
w.name: Wollit

w.description: API for obtaining information about e-books available on the WolneLektury.pl website
w.name: Wolne Lektury

w.description: Wolt is a marketplace and last-mile delivery platform (part of DoorDash) operating across Europe and beyond. Its developer surface exposes two production APIs: the Order / Marketplace API, which delivers consumer orders into a merchant POS or in-store system and drives them through accept, ready, and delivered states with refunds and group-order support; and the Wolt Drive API, which provides on-demand last-mile delivery via shipment promises, delivery creation, courier tracking, and webhooks. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 issuing one-hour bearer JWTs (Wolt Drive uses a Merchant Key bearer token), with HMAC-SHA256 / HS256-JWT signed webhooks for order and delivery lifecycle events.
w.name: Wolt

w.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Brands include Merrell, Saucony, Wolverine, Sperry, Sweaty Betty, and Hush Puppies. The company operates global wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and digital commerce channels. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.
w.name: Wolverine World Wide

w.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.
w.name: Womaness

w.description: Wombo is the AI company behind Dream by WOMBO, a consumer AI art and video generator, and w.ai, a decentralized AI supercomputer that pools idle GPU compute worldwide to serve affordable on-demand inference. The w.ai developer platform exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API at api.w.ai/v1 covering model discovery, text and vision-language chat completions with tool calling and streaming, text-to-image generation and editing (FLUX, SDXL), and object detection and segmentation (YOLO11n, SAM2) over images and video, plus a `wai` CLI and rentable Jupyter/SSH compute environments. Backed by 500 Global.
w.name: Wombo

w.description: Wompi is the payment gateway of Grupo Bancolombia, serving Colombia (COP). Its REST API creates and tracks transactions across local payment methods - CARD, NEQUI (mobile wallet), PSE (online bank debit), and Bancolombia Transfer / Collect - plus card and Nequi tokenization, reusable payment sources, and hosted payment links. Public-key endpoints are browser-safe; private-key endpoints are server-side.
w.name: Wompi

w.description: Womply (legally Oto Analytics, Inc.) was a small-business software company founded in 2011 by Toby Scammell that spent a decade building marketing, reputation, and payments software for roughly 500,000 Main Street businesses, and during the Paycheck Protection Program built the application-intake and identity-screening technology its lender partners used to process loans for sole proprietors and the smallest businesses. The company sold in 2021 for approximately $1.1 billion and is no longer operating; womply.com today is a primary-source documentary record of Womply's PPP role, sourced to court rulings, the JAMS arbitration award, SBA data, and the company's own production files. No public developer/API surface remains — this profile captures the company's identity and the record site's published artifacts.
w.name: Womply

w.description: Wonder is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel, bain-capital-ventures, bloomberg-beta, bullpen-capital, forerunner-ventures, general-catalyst, gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.
w.name: Wonder

w.description: Wonder Brands is a Latin American digital-first e-commerce company that builds and operates a portfolio of 15+ consumer product brands (including AlebriPets, Tropical Heal, Somos Reyes, Kingsman, KingsHouse, and KingsPort) spanning mattresses and bedroom furniture, sports equipment, home appliances, travel gear, tools, home and garden furniture, pet and baby products, and personal care. Operating an online-first omnichannel model across Uruguay, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile, it fulfills over 2 million annual orders from 25,000+ square meters of warehouse space, backed by proprietary technology for product optimization, marketing, pricing, and demand forecasting. Backed by QED Investors. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.
w.name: Wonder Brands

w.description: Wonder Workshop (GitHub org "playi", originally Play-i) is an educational technology company that makes the Dash, Dot, and Cue programmable robots and the Make Wonder K-8 coding and robotics learning platform, used by more than 40,000 schools across 65 countries. Its developer surface is a set of official SDKs that give granular realtime control of the physical robots' sensors and actuators over Bluetooth Low Energy: WonderPy (Python, on PyPI), @wonderworkshop/wwjs (JavaScript, on npm), and an iOS/Android robot framework shipped in the playground sample-app repository. There is no HTTP/cloud REST API, OAuth, or webhook surface; integration happens locally over BLE. Backed by GV.
w.name: Wonder Workshop

w.description: Wonderbly is an online publisher that makes personalized books and gifts for kids and adults. Founded in 2013 (originally as Lost My Name), it lets customers design and buy books customized with a recipient's name, themes, and occasion, and has delighted over 10 million readers worldwide. The consumer e-commerce site operates across 40+ language and regional storefronts (US, UK, AU, CA, DE, FR, NL, IT, ES). Backed by GV. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found during enrichment; this remains a company profile lead in the API Evangelist network.
w.name: Wonderbly *

w.description: Wondercraft is an AI audio creation platform for producing podcasts, audio ads, meditations, and audiobooks. Its public REST API generates audio content from an AI-written or user-supplied script, supports a two-host Convo Mode, lets callers attach platform voices and background music by ID, and exposes asynchronous jobs that are polled for status and a finished MP3 download URL.
w.name: Wondercraft

w.description: Wonderful is an applied-AI company building an enterprise AI platform for critical, high-volume workflows. It combines an AI platform (run any model, any modality, any use case, fully governed) with local deployment teams and a strategic partnership model to help large organizations accelerate AI adoption. Wonderful powers agentic automation for enterprises such as national telecom operators, energy providers, and financial-services firms, covering customer-service containment, collections across millions of clients, internal IT automation, and end-to-end billing resolution, with reported outcomes like a 91.5% containment rate across millions of customers. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and IVP. Wonderful sells an enterprise platform with deployment services rather than a self-serve public developer API; its developer documentation is login-gated.
w.name: Wonderful

w.description: Wonderment is a post-purchase order-tracking and shipment-visibility platform for ecommerce brands (built for Shopify), now part of Loop as Loop Tracking. It ingests carrier tracking data, surfaces proactive delivery updates, powers branded self-serve tracking pages, and reports on shipment performance. The public REST API (versioned 2022-10, hosted at api.wonderment.com) lets merchants search shipments by order name or tracking code, list and download shipment report exports, and fetch delivery-date predictions for shipping methods, plus webhooks for shipping events. Originally a CRV-backed company, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its ReadMe developer hub.
w.name: Wonderment

w.description: Wonderschool is a child care platform that connects families with licensed care and equips providers with software and services to start, operate, and grow their child care programs. It also serves government agencies with licensing, subsidy management, enrollment coordination, and statewide substitute-teacher pools, and offers employers child care benefit programs. Backed by a16z and Uncork Capital, Wonderschool operates as a B2B/B2G SaaS business; it publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center (SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF) but no public developer API, SDKs, or webhooks were found during enrichment.
w.name: Wonderschool

w.description: Wonderskin is a direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand best known for its WONDER BLADING all-day peel-off lip stain, along with longwear eyeliners, serum foundations, blush, brow products, skincare, and beauty tools sold through its Shopify-powered online store. The company runs a SKINSIDER loyalty membership, publishes THE SKINSIDER beauty and lifestyle blog, and partners with athletes and celebrities on product marketing. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Insight Partners. As a consumer e-commerce retailer, Wonderskin publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures the brand identity, customer-facing web properties, and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.
w.name: Wonderskin

w.description: Wonolo is an on-demand staffing marketplace, founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, that connects businesses needing flexible frontline labor with a pool of vetted independent workers ("Wonoloers") for warehousing, manufacturing, food production, retail, hospitality and general labor jobs. Businesses post job requests and are matched to available workers in real time without resumes or interviews, for one-off, ongoing and temp-to-hire needs. Wonolo operates a REST integration API (V2) on api.wonolo.com that lets customers create and manage job requests, jobs, workers and users programmatically and receive webhook callbacks, so scheduling, timekeeping, HR and CRM systems can be wired directly into the staffing platform.
w.name: Wonolo

w.description: WOO Sports makes a sensor-based performance-tracking system for kitesurfing, wingfoiling, and windsurfing. The WOO 4.0 device mounts to a board and measures jump height, airtime, G-force, and landing impact, syncing sessions through the WOO Sports mobile apps (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, and Garmin) to a global community platform with leaderboards, spots, activity feeds, and events. More than 100,000 riders use WOO to track sessions and compete, including on the GKA Kite World Tour. WOO Sports is a Techstars-backed brand operated under Boards & More. This profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; no public developer API was found (docs.woosports.com is a consumer user guide, not an API reference).
w.name: WOO Sports

w.description: WOO X is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering spot, margin and perpetual futures trading. Its V3 REST API at api.woox.io exposes public market data (instruments, orderbook, klines, trades, funding rates) and authenticated trading, account, asset/wallet, spot-margin and futures endpoints, documented at developer.woox.io with a published OpenAPI definition and a documentation MCP server.
w.name: WOO X

w.description: WooCommerce is the world's most popular open-source eCommerce platform, built on WordPress. It provides a comprehensive REST API for managing products, orders, customers, coupons, reports, webhooks, and store settings, plus a public-facing Store API for headless frontends. WooCommerce also delivers real-time events via webhooks for order, product, customer, and subscription lifecycle changes.
w.name: WooCommerce

w.description: Wooden Street (operated by Ufurnish Technology Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian direct-to-consumer furniture and home-furnishing brand founded in 2015 in Jaipur, Rajasthan by Lokendra Ranawat, Virendra Ranawat, Dinesh Pratap Singh and Vikas Baheti. It sells solid-wood and custom-made furniture, mattresses, home decor, modular kitchens and wardrobes through woodenstreet.com and a company-owned, company-operated network of experience stores across more than 100 Indian cities, backed by its own manufacturing and warehousing. The company is venture-backed (Indian Angel Network and Rajasthan Venture Capital Funds, then WestBridge Capital in 2022 and a Series C led by Premji Invest) and appears in the API Evangelist network via the secondary-market harvest, where it is listed on EquityZen and Nasdaq Private Market. As of this enrichment pass Wooden Street publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI definition, SDK, Postman collection, MCP server or agent card anywhere on its public surface, and its robots.txt explicitly disallows /api/. A first-party backend host, api.woodenstreet.com, is reachable and answers with a JSON envelope, but it is the undocumented private backend for the retail storefront and mobile apps rather than a published API product.
w.name: Wooden Street

w.description: Woodpecker CI is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) continuous integration and delivery engine, forked from Drone and maintained by a community organization on GitHub. It is self-hosted: an operator runs a Woodpecker server plus one or more agents (Docker, Kubernetes, or local backends) against a Git forge — GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, or Bitbucket. Pipelines are declared in `.woodpecker/` YAML workflow files validated by a published JSON Schema, and every server exposes a documented Swagger 2.0 REST API under /api covering repositories, pipelines, secrets, registries, crons, agents, forges, orgs and users, plus Server-Sent Event streams for pipeline events and step logs. Agents talk to the server over a published gRPC/protobuf contract. A first-party Go client library (woodpecker-go), a woodpecker-cli command line tool, DEB/RPM packages, container images and a Helm chart are all published by the project.
w.name: Woodpecker CI

w.description: Woodstock (Woodstock K.K., Tokyo) is a Japanese investment platform offering zero-commission, 24-hour US stock trading in JPY with fractional shares down to 0.0001-share increments. A Financial Products Intermediary registered with the Kanto Financial Bureau (No. 965), with customer assets held by affiliated broker AlpacaJapan, Woodstock's programmatic surface is a hosted Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok manage portfolios, research US stocks, and place real trades after OAuth plus passkey authorization. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Coinbase, and Sony.
w.name: Woodstock

w.description: Profile for Woodward in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 803).
w.name: Woodward

w.description: Wooga is a Berlin-based mobile game developer founded in 2009 and a subsidiary of Playtika, specializing in story-driven casual games such as June's Journey, Ghost Detective and Pearl's Peril. Wooga publishes no public API or developer portal, but maintains an active open-source GitHub organization with its atlas Gradle plugin suite for Unity and mobile build automation, published to the Gradle Plugin Portal and RubyGems. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and hv-capital.
w.name: Wooga

w.description: Wootric (now part of InMoment) is a customer experience platform with a REST API for managing NPS, CSAT, and CES surveys, accessing feedback responses, and managing customer experience programs. The API supports end user management, survey distribution via email and SMS, response retrieval with promoter/passive/detractor filtering, metric summaries, and multi-region deployments across US, EU, and AU environments.
w.name: Wootric

w.description: Woowa Brothers is the Seoul-based technology company behind Baedal Minjok (Baemin), South Korea's leading food delivery platform, alongside B-Mart quick commerce, Baemin Connect rider services, and robotics initiatives for serving and delivery robots. A subsidiary of Delivery Hero since 2021, the company runs a strong engineering culture through its Woowahan tech blog and first-party open-source libraries on GitHub (NestJS libraries, WoowahanJS, Redis tooling), but it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.
w.name: Woowa Brothers

w.description: WoowUp is a customer marketing and loyalty CRM platform built for retail and ecommerce brands across Latin America. Founded in Buenos Aires and backed by 500 Global, WoowUp centralizes customer, purchase, and product data from POS and ecommerce platforms (VTEX, Magento, Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Tienda Nube) and activates it through segmentation, campaigns, loyalty programs, web push notifications, and abandoned-cart recovery. Its REST API v3 lets developers sync users (multi-ID), purchases, products, coupons, benefits, points, and custom events, with client libraries published in PHP.
w.name: WoowUp

w.description: Easily create word clouds
w.name: Word Cloud

w.description: Worders is a culturalization and localization company (a Partech portfolio company) that crafts translated, culturally-adapted content for global brands with in-country linguists. Alongside the services business it runs a Ruby on Rails translation-management platform (admin.worders.net) and publishes the Worders API V1 at api.worders.net — an OpenAPI 3.0.1-documented surface for freelance invoice verification and Plunet TMS automation covering customers, freelancers, invoices, orders, purchase orders, quotes, and order templates.
w.name: Worders

w.description: Wordnik is the largest online English dictionary by number of words.
